campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar1.h3m.epilo: With your enemies defeated, part of this land has returned to the rule of your king, Británec. Now you must press on towards Sosaria, the occupied capital. After a week's journey, however, you learn that the evil here has awakened the dark mage Modain. You must stop him, or you will never take Sosaria!
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar1.h3m.prolo: Before the priest Modyn was charged with saving Sosaria, he lived in a monastery dedicated to the god of the harvest. Then the enemy invaded. Panic swept the land, and people lived in constant fear for themselves, their loved ones and their possessions. The enemy exploited their weakness and captured the capital. Only the monastery still resisted. The harvest god held his servants under his protection. To help the people at last, he entered the body of the priest Modyn during a service. Thus was born the Avatar, mankind's defender against evil.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar1.h3m.regio: Here the Avatar first strikes against the forces of evil. Neutral armies and servants of Evil stand in his way. Defeat all your enemies and open the road to Sosaria.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar2.h3m.epilo: You walk across the battlefield, memories of the struggle just ended still haunting your thoughts. Yet Modain is defeated. You press on towards Sosaria, this time no longer alone: Sir Brittish accompanies you.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar2.h3m.prolo: You look out from your tent. A dark wall of clouds rolls in from the south. It seems your army will have to march to its new positions in foul weather. Yet supplies are dwindling fast, and any further delay would mean heavy losses. You give the order to march!
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar2.h3m.regio: Conquering the last region was easy. Now, however, the mighty mage Modain awaits you. Whether the Avatar succeeds lies in the hands of fate alone.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar3.h3m.epilo: At last this land, too, is free. May the shadow of darkness never fall upon it again. You have destroyed Minax's castle, and the surrounding forces of evil have scattered. You have also freed Gavon, leader of many an uprising against Evil. The three of you now set out towards a dark—or perhaps bright?—tomorrow. Yet the task that first sent you on your journey still awaits: freeing Sosaria.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar3.h3m.prolo:
Minax is a gifted sorceress. Magic fascinated her even as a small child. Later, when she met Modain, he taught her the most terrible spells the world had ever known. After his death, Minax swore bloody vengeance upon you. Her magical power made her ruler of this land. And as you approached her territory, she resolved to destroy you. She summoned a storm that struck your ship. Unable to withstand the fury of the elements, it was wrecked.
You awoke on the shore near a shipyard. Only a handful of warriors survived from the entire crew; the rest must have perished. You have no choice but to find a new refuge and take your revenge on Minax.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar3.h3m.regio:
After defeating Modain, you and Brittish hurry to Sosaria's aid.
Yet Modain's teachings did not die with him. His apprentice Minax continued studying dark magic, and when she judged herself powerful enough, she unleashed a new reign of terror.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar4.h3m.epilo: Your task is complete. The chief strongholds of the necromancers and barbarians lie destroyed, and the Lady of Angels is dead. But what comes next? You leaf thoughtfully through your journal when it suddenly grows hot and burns to ashes in your hands. That must have been magic! And indeed, a faerie dragon is laughing before you. When he finally calms down, he introduces himself as Zawarathu, messenger of the dragon lords. They need your help on one of their estates, he says. To get you there as quickly as possible, the dragon offers you a ride on his back. You climb aboard and fly off towards a new adventure.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar4.h3m.prolo:
A great obstacle lies between you and the land near Sosaria: the River Alangora. The voyage along it is long, and Sosaria is still some 200 miles away. Although many dangers might have awaited you, the journey has passed without trouble. The crew are in good spirits, and Gavon is teaching the cabin boy to shoot a bow...
Could this merely be the famous calm before the storm? You find yourself asking that question more and more often...
Then Gavon wakes you. You have arrived. You bid the crew farewell and set out on dry land!
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar4.h3m.regio: Here the battles for Sosaria will be decided. With Gavon and Sir Brittish to help you, you will surely free it. But for how long?
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar5.h3m.epilo:
Qemalisor has become Lord Zlor and is overjoyed. Now he will seek to extend his domain as far as he can, even at his neighbours' expense. Glory to the new Lord Zlor, the necromancer Qemalisor, and death to all who oppose him!
But now let us return to the Avatar.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar5.h3m.prolo: We turn to an entirely different corner of the land, where the selection of Lord Zlor is under way. The present ruler has prepared dreadful traps and dangers for his challenger. The necromancer Qemalisor seeks the title. A terribly difficult trial awaits him, but he believes he will claim the title at any cost!
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar5.h3m.regio: Here unfolds a story of which the Avatar initially knew nothing. The reports that later reached him contradicted one another.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar6.h3m.epilo: You have defeated the azure dragon, Akár Bloodcloak, the Headhewer and the Lord of Tyr. The dragon lords have confirmed your suspicions: from the moment you passed through the monolith, you were in an entirely different world. Now, however, all is well. The dragon lords have entrusted you with another task, one that should preserve the values you fought for forever.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar6.h3m.prolo: You accepted the dragon lords' invitation to a grand hunt on one of the princes' estates. Though it lies some 2000 miles from Sosaria, the journey on a faerie dragon's back seemed no longer than a ride of a few miles. You are already looking forward to the hunt. Your quarry is to be... an Azure Dragon. Under any other circumstances, the dragon lords would never send you to kill one of their brothers. This one, however, serves Evil.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar6.h3m.regio: We return to the Avatar. In this land he will join the hunt to which the dragon lords invited him. This hunt will bring him either glory or death!
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar7.h3m.epilo: The enemy hordes have been slaughtered. By defeating the Wanderer, you have finally fulfilled your task. Generations of your descendants will tell of your deeds. Now you may return home and enjoy a well-earned rest.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar7.h3m.prolo: The dragon lords have another task for you. A land faces destruction, and every hero in this world has been summoned to defend it. Victory can be won only by defeating the hero who dwells on the infernal island at the heart of the region. You must not fail, or all your efforts so far will have been in vain!
campaign.[ab] - avatar.Avatar7.h3m.regio: This is our last encounter with the Avatar in this campaign. Will he emerge alive from the final clash? If so, good will triumph. If not... better not to dwell on it.
campaign.[ab] - avatar.description:
Until now, the Avatar has been a hero of good. His fate lies in your hands alone. On his journey he may meet such figures as the dark mage Modain, his apprentice Minax, the faerie dragon Zawarathu, the ranger Gavon and others...
{Created by H&D
campaign.[ab] - avatar.name: The Avatar's Adventures
campaign.[ab] - cas utrpeni.Campagin 1.h:
The attack on the North has been repelled...
The Fortress of Fire lies in ruins, and the devil's minions have been driven back beyond the bounds of time and space.
Yet victory has come at a terrible price...
Lord Michael is dead, and much of the land lies devastated...
The people have been left without a ruler, gripped by fear of the days to come...

The shores of the Green Land are already in sight, and the Northern Harbour will soon welcome your ship.
Or so you hope...
Leaning against the railing, you watch anxiously as black clouds gather over the Inland Sea... The waves slowly rise, and the wind grows stronger... May the coming storm show mercy to the ship and her crew...
The northern holdings of the Green Land. This part of the realm is ruled by Lord Michael, a brave and just knight who faithfully serves his king and his people.
campaign.[ab] - cas utrpeni.Campagin 2.h:
The enemy is defeated... Black smoke still rises from the ruins of the infernal city.
The dark seed has been torn from the womb of the Green Land before it could take deeper root...
The demon's head, displayed in the Monastery of Luna, proves that the enemy is not invincible. Emboldened by your deed, the people rise up and pursue the fleeing imps that so recently overran the entire region...
The followers of Chaos have been driven back whence they came...
The time has come to rebuild all that their invasion destroyed.

War rages in the North...
The spawn of Hell are trying to invade the Green Land. The Northern Harbour lies in ruins, and safe passage there is impossible. The captain of your merchant ship has therefore decided to sail around the continent and land at the first suitable place on the western or southern coast...
After several days at sea, a small bay looks promising. It once served as a harbour for merchants from the southwestern islands... But who knows what it looks like today? Pirates began raiding merchant ships, and trade gradually dwindled... Still, it is worth a try.
The southern peninsula. Old Šelpa has a shipyard in one of its bays. Once he offered harbour to ships trading in the south; now, with trade in decline, he ekes out a living on the brink of poverty.
campaign.[ab] - cas utrpeni.Campagin 3.h:
Wagons laden with the materials needed to rebuild the Temple of Light crawl northwards...
The road winds through the forest, and time drifts lazily by.
Suddenly, an arrow pierces one of the drivers' throats... His body shudders in its death throes, then falls limply from the seat beneath the wheels...
A hail of further arrows mercilessly cuts down the caravan...
An arrowhead buried in its flank sends Tuvok's horse into a panic. Maddened with pain, the beast throws its master to the ground. Shaken, Tuvok rises, only to be struck by another arrow... He sinks to his knees, slowly losing consciousness...
He can barely make out the archers hidden in the treetops as they massacre the last members of the caravan...
The precious cargo falls into the hands of forest bandits...

The Temple of Light will not be completed in time. No one can yet imagine the consequences...

Lord Michael's curse must be broken...
His soul, afflicted by the curse an infernal demon laid upon him before his death, still wanders lost between worlds.
The only way to free it is to repair the Temple of Light, destroyed in the war in the North, and perform the proper rites within...
Yet time is desperately short. The mass must be celebrated before the solstice, which comes in four weeks...
Otherwise, Lord Michael's soul will be lost to the forces of Chaos forever...
It seems the mages have found a way to repair the Temple in so little time. They will use their golems, who can work day and night... They therefore begin making them at once. The sole obstacle is a shortage of building materials: the land is exhausted by war, and the storehouses stand almost empty...
The territory of the Green Land's mages. Here stands the Golem Factory.
campaign.[ab] - cas utrpeni.Campagin 4.h:
Lady Marion's timely arrival turned the tide of the fateful battle, but she could not prevent Lord Michael's death...
At least she carried his body out of the battle and buried it in a secret place in the forest, near her mother's grave...
The soldiers of the Green Land will search the battlefield for their lord in vain...
They will find him neither among the living nor among the dead, and their amazement will give way to confusion...
Thus will arise the legend of a brave knight who prevailed in a terrible battle against the forces of evil, and who will one day return to defend his land when he is needed...
The enemy's defeat has changed the course of events to come... Linnarfin Aladal will sail safely into the Northern Harbour, as will Sebastian Valmount... The sorcerer's apprentice Tuvok will not die on the trade road, and will become a mighty mage... Ibeer will not fall beneath an undead warrior's sword, and will continue to devote himself to girls and mead...
But Lady Marion is trapped in a temporal paradox... The future from which she came to save the Green Land no longer exists, and she cannot return to it.
Her fate thus remains shrouded in mystery...

~ The End ~

The meditation of the monk keeping vigil in the crypt where Lord Michael lies at rest is suddenly broken by a grating sound. The heavy lid of the sarcophagus slides aside, and the dead body, bathed in a magical aura, slowly rises from its stone bed... A bony arm reaches out, and an iron grip begins crushing the poor man's throat...
The gaze of those glowing eyes bodes ill...
The curse has come to pass. Lord Michael's spirit, bound by the forces of Chaos, has returned to finish what the powers of Hell could not...
Here unfolds the final chapter of the first tale of the Green Land.
campaign.[ab] - cas utrpeni.description: A sudden invasion by the powers of evil shatters the peaceful life of the Green Land. The days of peace are gone, and the forces of Chaos use every means to destroy all that is good...
campaign.[ab] - cas utrpeni.name: A Time of Suffering
campaign.[ab] - gryfi rise.Gryfi rise ca: Demons stormed our towns and villages. We fought bravely, but in the end we fell. Those who survived now seek salvation and a new land. We shall see what fate has in store for us.
The demons have driven us into these remote lands. We shall see what awaits us here.
We have won another battle, but I sense evil drawing near. What could it be?
The time has come to destroy the goblins in their very lair.
Shortly after the great battle, the goblins attacked us again. We repelled them, but if we are to prevent further raids, we must defeat them once and for all.
The elves thanked us and promised that whenever we need help, we need only ask.
It is worse than we feared. The goblins have plundered everything, and the elves have taken refuge in a fortress beyond a mighty mountain range. We must hurry to their aid.
The elves here live under goblin rule. If we help them, perhaps they will repay our kindness.

We have won the battle, but not the war. The creatures of the swamps rose up and we helped them, but now we must leave them. Today a scout came to me with news of a human land to the north under demon rule. A few towns still hold out. We must go to their aid.
Our scout reported that a vast demonic army was marching from the east. I asked how this was possible. He replied that the demons' land lay to the east. They have lured us straight into a trap!
Your scout has brought news of a vast approaching demon army. And that is not all: their own land lies directly to the east.
An army of titans rose up and drove the demons away. The time has come to take the offensive.
When I arrived, I saw nothing but devastation. Perhaps it is not too late.
This seems to be the last human land in the region. We must bring it to our side.
We have prevailed and driven the enemy into the griffin mountains. The time for the final battle has come.
The final battle is upon us. We must destroy Xellos, lord of the elements.
The greatest battle we have ever known is upon us.

And so it ends. The war is over, and griffins—indeed, all creatures—may once again live freely throughout the world. Edric, the most renowned general in human history, has become king of a new realm: the Griffin Empire. And I leave to watch over my people. The dragon people. I shall guard my descendants, who sadly can no longer take human form or speak the human tongue. I shall protect them as they protect the world of men. After the war of monsters and dragons, the war of men and swamp creatures, the war of demons and swamp creatures, and the war of men and demons, peace returns at last.

The journal of Kulos, the last living dragon

All our enemies have been driven into the land of the griffins. It is said that a sacred place lies here, home to thousands of griffins and the birthplace of every griffin. If we find them, victory will be ours.
campaign.[ab] - gryfi rise.description: Demons invaded human towns and villages, driving their inhabitants from their homes. Those who survived now seek salvation and a new home. Will they find one? What dangers will fate place in their path?
campaign.[ab] - gryfi rise.name: The Griffin Empire
campaign.[ab] - honza 1.Honza_ctvrty pri:
Everything turned out well. Your plan worked to the very last detail. You have become the uncrowned ruler of the entire region. Now you have just one worry—heaven forbid that some "Foolish Honza" should turn up...
The End... ?
Created by Hidden

You handed Nemakačenko his daughter, and he gave you a plane ticket to the Canary Islands so you could rest after your arduous task. You would discuss business when you returned. You were happy as a clam.
You went off to pack, but scarcely had you passed through the gates of Nemakačenko's residence when a car screeched to a halt beside you. Suddenly everything went black, and you remember nothing more. You woke somewhere on the outskirts of town in a stinking sewer.
So that was Nemakačenko's gratitude! 
You will not let him get away with this! You resolve to destroy him for good and take control of all his businesses.
Fortunately, your past adventures have won you a few good friends in the underworld. You will seek them out and begin preparing the final blow. Revenge is so sweet, after all...
Your journey will end in this land. Will your bones rot here, or will you emerge victorious? Many obstacles and tasks await you. Are you brave and persistent enough to overcome them?
campaign.[ab] - honza 1.Honza_druhy prib: The birds you brought back caused an absolute sensation. N@va television and the other media gave them plenty of publicity (for a suitable fee, naturally), and visitors are pouring in. A tidy sum is slowly but surely building up in your account...

Nemakačenko liked your work, and now he has another offer for you. He is expanding his business interests and has decided to open a private zoo. To attract as many visitors as possible, he wants something no other zoo can offer. If you bring him a flock of legendary phoenixes from distant lands, he will give you a 25% share of the zoo's profits. After a little thought, you accept.
You will spend several gruelling weeks in this picturesque land. Gathering the phoenixes will take some time. You must not idle, but get to work at once.
campaign.[ab] - honza 1.Honza_prvni prib:
Your first task is done. You have disposed of the kidnappers and found the magic pouch. You have also received a handsome reward. Nemakačenko had already bought a new, far better pouch, so he gave you the old pouch of gold. You need never worry about money again.
But Nemakačenko has made you another rather interesting offer. You are deciding whether to accept it or go home.

When Honza's parents stopped his pocket money and confiscated his Junior bank card, the poor lad had to find a way to earn a living. He did not want a job—who would slave away for peanuts!? And he had no experience in black-market currency trading yet.  So he picked up Annonce, but this time ignored the "Pleasant Moments for Two" section. He turned to "Earning Opportunities", and an advertisement near the top immediately caught his eye.
* * * * * ATTENTION, ATTENTION ! ! ! * * * * *
Last night, multimillionaire Nemakačenko's mistress was kidnapped. Nemakačenko's magic pouch (for gold, of course) vanished with her. A handsome reward awaits whoever returns it. 
* * * * * ATTENTION, ATTENTION ! ! ! * * * * *
Honza had plenty of experience with crime for his age. Not that he was a criminal, but no ordinary mortal could watch as many action films and detective stories in a lifetime as Honza had seen. He decided to seize the opportunity by the scruff of its neck. To avoid looking like a country bumpkin, he threw on some exotic clothes and set off to see Nemakačenko.

In a certain unnamed town lived Foolish Honza. To be clear, Foolish was his surname. Honza was not foolish at all, just terribly lazy. One day, however, his parents ran out of patience. They refused to go on feeding him while he lay about at home. Honza had no choice but to set out into the world. And he made it this far.
campaign.[ab] - honza 1.Honza_treti prib: You found Pipinka Nemakačenková and razed the entire Church of Satan to the ground. Only smouldering ruins remain. Now you will set off home. If Nemakačenko keeps his word, you are set for life and will live like a king.

You had enjoyed several weeks of rest when your boss, Nemakačenko, suddenly summoned you. His only daughter, Pipinka, had become involved with some cult. Apparently she had not been home for almost a month, and her father feared something might happen to her. If you find her and bring her home, he will give you her hand in marriage and make you an equal business partner. Few could resist such a tempting offer.
Find Nemakačenko's daughter to complete this scenario's objective. Naturally, you must not lose your main hero. Fight honourably, but without mercy. Your efforts will be duly rewarded.
campaign.[ab] - honza 1.description: An almost fairytale story set in the present day. Join Honza in a world full of adventures and several difficult tasks. Any resemblance to real living people is purely coincidental. The author did not intend to offend anyone with this story—and if you do recognise yourself in its hero, that is your problem!
campaign.[ab] - honza 1.name: The Tale of Foolish Honza
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_1.h3m.ep:
Surprisingly, everything turned out well. Květinka accepted Honza's proposal. And there was a wedding people talked about for years...
Honza and Květinka lived happily and peacefully. They had three handsome, wise sons. As the boys grew up, Honza suggested one day that they should venture out into the world to gain experience. To give the journey some purpose, however, he charged them to bring him three magical objects: a helm, a sword and a shield that had belonged to the mighty mage Čáryfuk. He had died in Nemakačenko's service, as one of the commanders of his personal guard. Unfortunately, his magical possessions had vanished somewhere in the chaos of battle, and now Honza wanted them back.
The sons had no choice but to venture out into the world. The three agreed who would fetch what, and arranged a meeting place where they would reunite once their tasks were done.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_1.h3m.pr: After all those experiences, Honza decided to take a break from adventures for a while. He had everything he could wish for and lacked nothing to make him happy. But alas! After a while he grew tired of solitude, so he decided to find a wife to brighten his idle hours and help spend his vast fortune. Do not call him crazy—that was Honza's decision (the poor fellow has no idea what he is getting into).
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_1.h3m.re: Somewhere in this territory is a prison where Květinka is being held. You must find and free her. Honza and Květinka carry the Ambassador's Sash and Clover of Fortune from this scenario into the next. Leave them with the heroes who have these artifacts.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_2.h3m.ep: Victory is yours. You feel proud and happy to have won the helm and brought it safely to your castle. Now pack your things quickly and head home to your parents. First, however, you must wait for your brothers at the agreed meeting place.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_2.h3m.pr:
The eldest son, Honzíček, decided to bring his father the magical helm of the archmage Čáryfuk. Without delay, he saddled his horse, took a few friends and set off for the region where the magical helm had last been seen.
One of the adventurers who had joined Honza on the expedition in which Čáryfuk fell had settled there. The magical helm was probably the real reason why Hamoun (as this hero is called) had suddenly left Honza's service.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_2.h3m.re: Somewhere here lies the magical helm that Honzíček must find and bring to his castle.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_3.h3m.ep: Honza's second son, Pepíček, has completed his task too. Now hurry to the agreed meeting place to join his brothers, and then off home!
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_3.h3m.pr: Honza's second son, Pepíček, was extraordinarily lucky. He set out to obtain the magical sword of the mage Čáryfuk, and stumbled upon it by sheer chance. No sooner had he arrived in this region than a band of smugglers attacked him. But Pepíček was ready for them. He and his companions crushed the smugglers, though they suffered enormous losses themselves. In their hideout he found the sword he sought. Since it had lain unused for a long time, Pepíček had it reforged by the first blacksmith he found. Now he need only bring it to his home, which unfortunately lies at the other end of this land.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_3.h3m.re: Pepíček must bring the magical sword safely to his castle.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_4.h3m.ep: After obtaining the dragon's treasure, getting the magical shield was child's play. Mazánek hastily packs his things and sets out for the meeting with his brothers. He can hardly wait to sit over his spellbooks again and absorb more spells.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_4.h3m.pr: Honza and Květinka's youngest son was the darling of the whole family. In short, a little spoilt pet. Since everyone called him Mazánek, the name stuck. Ever since childhood, Mazánek had spent all his time poring over spellbooks, and had learned a great deal. His knowledge of magic should help him obtain the shield of the mage Čáryfuk. This will be Mazánek's first adventure. He is actually rather looking forward to it.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_4.h3m.re: Honza's youngest son, Mazánek, must find and obtain the magical shield of the mage Čáryfuk in this land.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_5.h3m.ep:
As soon as the brothers freed the armies of sharpshooters from their prisons, the enemy panicked. Seeing several legions of such feared warriors bearing down upon him, he fled the land in terror.
The whole family is together again. Nothing mars their happiness now. Honza has decided to leave this land to his sons and find a new home with Květinka. They have even picked a site for their new residence. First, however, they want their sons to grant them one request...
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_5.h3m.pr:
All three brothers are together again after a long time apart. Their reunion, however, is interrupted by some very unpleasant news. Enough idling, then—it is time to fight again. 
The brothers are no longer novices, and hope to make short work of the enemy. Or do you doubt them?
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_5.h3m.re: Here the brothers must free their parents and rid the land of foreign invaders. Do not delay: reunite the whole family.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_6.h3m.ep: Though the entire task ultimately fell to Mazánek alone, he brought it to a successful conclusion. By building the Grail structure in New Home, he convinced the local inhabitants of his peaceful intentions. Everything turned out well, but the brothers learned an interesting piece of news...
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_6.h3m.pr:
After a while, however, Honza and Květinka began to long for greater luxury. They decided to move to a beautiful land. There is just one catch. This very land was the last target of Čáryfuk's conquests. They say he left not one stone standing upon another. But the countryside is magnificent. According to the latest reports, a few castles remain there too. One is said to be quite well preserved, because the road to it is protected by a gate that even Čáryfuk could not overcome. Honza and Květinka have chosen that castle as their new home...
Now they want their sons to open the road to New Home and build the Grail structure there, so that they can afford a little luxury in their old age.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_6.h3m.re: Find the Grail and build the Grail structure in the town of New Home.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_7.h3m.ep:
The deed is done. Every member of Čáryfuk's family is dead. Unfortunately, something regrettable happened.
Just before Čáryfuk's mother-in-law gave up her sinful soul, she laid a terrible curse upon the brothers.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_7.h3m.pr:
This has gone too far! It cannot be a coincidence. Wherever the brothers go, they encounter Čáryfuk's name or his family. It must stop.
Now the brothers have also learned that Čáryfuk's mother-in-law plans to attack New Home very soon. The sheer nerve!
The brothers have therefore decided to wipe out Čáryfuk's entire family, down to the last member. They have set out for their land, and preparations for a great battle begin...
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_7.h3m.re: Destroy Čáryfuk's entire family. None may survive. Only then will you win. But do not lose any of your main heroes. You will need them yet.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_8.h3m.ep:
It is over... Only you know who won in the end. It was entirely up to you whom to favour: the heroic brothers or their parents. Either way, the better side won.
If you enjoyed the campaign, recommend it to your friends and acquaintances. You can also send your thoughts to the authors at:
Draque@wo.cz or Hidden@wo.cz
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_8.h3m.pr:
Honzíček, Pepíček and Mazánek managed to destroy Čáryfuk's entire family. Unfortunately, they paid dearly for their victory. A curse fell upon their heads, and the sons turned against their own parents. Only one side can emerge victorious from this struggle.
On, then, to the final campaign, and may the better side win...
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.Honza_2_8.h3m.re: Who will win the final battle? The sons, or their parents? Whom you favour is entirely up to you.
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.description:
In the previous instalment, Honza acquired a tidy fortune. After all those adventures, he decided to settle down and lead a peaceful life. But as so often happens—man proposes . . .
Created by H&D
campaign.[ab] - honza 2.name: Honza's Further Adventures
campaign.[ab] - hvezdna brana.Hvezdna br:
We have landed on planet Earth with the intention of occupying it.

                        – log of the flagship of Sokar's fleet –
We have gained the power of the dragons. Our strength has grown, and we are another step closer to conquering this planet.
We must obtain dragons. They are the mightiest beings from the Sun to Orion's Belt.
After many battles, we have finally discovered the humans' main stronghold. We must destroy them!
campaign.[ab] - hvezdna brana.hvezdna br: After many battles, we have finally conquered this planet!
The time for the final battle has come. Or rather, the final massacre.
campaign.[ab] - novy svet.Nove zeme cast: Sylvan has arrived in a land he heard of as a small boy. Now he must explore it.
The time for a great battle has come. This is goblin country, and we shall kill them all.
Let my cousin tremble! The time has come to reclaim what is rightfully mine.
Sylvan has returned to his homeland. The time has come to take revenge on his cousin.
It is over. Now I can build a new, better world. A world of the undead.
The end draws near. My cousin will fall before my might! I, Sylvan the dark knight, shall defeat him!
The final battle Sylvan has awaited so long is upon us.
campaign.[ab] - novy svet.description: Sylvan is a king's son, and desires the throne above all else. But when his father dies and his moment seems to have come, he discovers that his cousin is the rightful heir. Now Sylvan must find a new land.
campaign.[ab] - novy svet.name: A New World
campaign.[sod] - ad 1420.description: As Jan Žižka of Trocnov, take command of the Hussite armies and lead them against crusaders, papists and apostates from the true faith. sasa.batora@seznam.cz
campaign.[sod] - ad 1420.name: AD 1420
campaign.[sod] - ad 1420.zizka 2.h3m.reg: The Bohemian State without Lower Lusatia
campaign.[sod] - ad 1420.zizka 5.h3m.epi:
Thus lived, fought and died the greatest Czech commander, Jan Žižka of Trocnov. I am no writer, so I shall borrow the words of someone better qualified:
"With the Hussite movement, a Slavic—one might almost say Tolstoyan—vision of the world first enters European consciousness. Simple peasants, a nation of thoughtful men and kindly, devout mothers, suddenly attain an incredible experience of true Christianity... Yet the world is not such as to tolerate these aspirations... The combined robber-knighthood of the Empire is stronger. The Hussites send desperate appeals for help to the West. Have they no friends there, such as Phiulibert, Archbishop of Paris? The West is silent. Darkness descends upon the ravaged meadows and forests of Bohemia... When will a clear answer finally thunder forth: the Czechs have fought for our cause, not merely for the last twenty years, but for centuries. If we do not now fight for their cause with fanatical resolve, we shall seal our own destruction."
Franz Werfel, autumn 1938
campaign.[sod] - ad 1420.zizka 5.h3m.reg: The Bohemian State and Its Neighbours
campaign.[sod] - akrij.Axim_1.h3m.prolog:
After many years of peace and quiet, a man once again appeared among the barbarian tribes of the Northern Island, proclaiming himself another incarnation of the legendary Unifier. He promised that if the others followed him, together they would defeat the mangy human rabble who had driven them from lands of plenty and prosperity into the barren northern wastes. 

The king of Akrij therefore decided to send an army of seasoned soldiers to crush the uprising. His son Kristián took command.

The battle was hard and bloody, but in the end the kingdom prevailed. Many fine men died, and much needless blood was shed. After many months of war's hardships, Kristián is at last sailing back to the shores of his homeland.

Imagine his astonishment when, even from afar, he sees columns of black smoke twisting in the wind and rising into a dark sky, towns in ruins, and darkness spreading across the land like a creeping mist.
campaign.[sod] - akrij.Axim_1.h3m.region:
{Homecoming

All recruited heroes carry all their experience, primary and secondary skills, artifacts, spells and troops recruited from the people of the Kingdom of Akrij into their next battle.
campaign.[sod] - akrij.Axim_2.h3m.prolog:
Prince Kristián has organised and trained a militia and built a fortress on the only road into the duchy. There is nothing more he can do to ensure the inhabitants' safety. 

Somehow, however, word of these activities has reached the enemy, and attacks from the south are growing stronger. Before long, the defensive line will be breached. He must head south and attack the enemy positions. As the saying goes, the best defence is a good offence.

On the eve of his departure, however, a messenger from Karel's estate in the southeast arrived in Kristián's camp, bloodied, starving and exhausted, begging for help. There, too, the people had managed to fortify themselves and successfully resist the spreading evil. Unfortunately, their defeat was now only a matter of time.

For the first time in ages, Kristián's spirits rose. Allies are always welcome. First, he simply has to reach them...
campaign.[sod] - akrij.Axim_2.h3m.region:
{Back in Battle

All recruited heroes carry all their experience, primary and secondary skills, artifacts, spells and troops recruited from the people of the Kingdom of Akrij into their next battle.
campaign.[sod] - akrij.Axim_3.h3m.prolog:
After fierce fighting, Kristián, hungry and exhausted, has finally fought his way to his ally. It is astonishing how quickly his ally organised a defence and stayed alive between the closing blades of the enemy's pincers. They must have learned of the danger here at the very beginning, allowing enough time to organise their defence and build fortifications. Otherwise, they would have had no chance of survival. 

Kristián firmly believes that here, at last, he may find some answers...
campaign.[sod] - akrij.Axim_3.h3m.region:
{Magic Again

All recruited heroes carry all their experience, primary and secondary skills, artifacts, spells and troops recruited from the people of the Kingdom of Akrij into their next battle.
campaign.[sod] - akrij.Axim_4.h3m.prolog:
The lands of the Kingdom of Akrij have at last been wrested from the clutches of the undead and other infernal monsters. What grieves Kristián most is his father's death. How could his father have turned against his own son? His father's body was carefully carried out of the underground and buried with due ceremony.

Now Kristián gazes bitterly towards the Ice Mountains. That is where all these horrors began. What might await him there?
campaign.[sod] - akrij.Axim_4.h3m.region:
{The Ice Mountains

All recruited heroes carry all their experience, primary and secondary skills, artifacts, spells and troops recruited from the people of the Kingdom of Akrij into their next battle.
campaign.[sod] - akrij.Axim_5.h3m.epilog:
The cheering throughout the kingdom seems endless. Once again, storytellers will have tales to tell for years to come. Kristián savours the sweet moments of victory. Only his father's death clouds his joy. 

The wonderful news is that the elves have decided to form a lasting alliance with humans. Their suffering in the face of a common enemy has finally convinced them how trivial their quarrels are.

The kingdom's lands are safe once more. At least for now. 

Yet evil is always everywhere, patiently awaiting the moment when the fragile balance of power is disturbed again...
campaign.[sod] - akrij.Axim_5.h3m.prolog:
And so the mountain castles in the Ice Mountains have been reclaimed as well. The rescued mages have reopened the mountain pass. With knowledge found in the Magical Library, they have managed to reverse the direction of the rift in space. At least no further evil will pass through it into this land. 

Unfortunately, the danger remains. A truly powerful army must be gathered to pass through the rift into enemy territory, destroy the mastermind behind this evil and rid the world of all his devilish minions once and for all. 

Only then can they be certain that no further evil will come from him.
campaign.[sod] - akrij.description: After many years of peace and quiet, when heroic deeds and terrible wars against infernal monsters survive only in tales told around evening fires or to children at bedtime, the dark clouds of death begin gathering once more above the Kingdom of Akrij...
campaign.[sod] - akrij.name: Rending the Veil
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam1.h3m.epi:
You must press on from your base and find some strange device (a monolith) nearby. It is your only chance of getting home. Or so you hope. 
It is the only thing you can do at this point...
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam1.h3m.pro: Something must have gone wrong during training. Now it is clear that you are somewhere you probably will not survive for long. Your equipment has either vanished somewhere in space-time or broken. Your only weapon is a sword you obtained from some subversive character.
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam1.h3m.reg:
Here you will learn where you are and what you are doing here.

You also carry over everything you might find that the author has allowed for. You cannot carry over undead troops or level 6 and 7 troops.
Alexej+Sasa carry over; other heroes are unimportant.
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam2.h3m.epi:
The monks told you the strange device was to the south. Clearly they were not lying. But they also said they had seen it many years ago and did not know whether it still worked. 
In your view, it simply has to work: without that monolith, you are lost and will never get home. So you can only hope...
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam2.h3m.pro:
A group of monks lives here who may know where the strange device is. But will they tell you? Clearly, you will only find out at the monastery...
The sole problem is that barbarians and necromancers are besieging it. The monks will defend their monastery fiercely. But how long can they hold out? Perhaps a few days, perhaps a month. You must take the monastery at any cost!!! Otherwise, the books containing information about the monolith will be destroyed.
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam2.h3m.reg:
Could the strange device be here?

You also carry over everything you might find that the author has allowed for. You cannot carry over undead troops or level 6 and 7 troops.
Alexej+Sasa carry over; other heroes are unimportant.
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam3.h3m.epi:
According to the local seer, the monolith broke recently. It had been working, but suddenly the power within burst out, causing an explosion. He assembled the artifact for you, but could not offer you his monolith. As you were about to leave, he stopped you and said:
" I know I have disappointed you in part, but perhaps this information will help: a monolith that might still work lies to the north. "
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam3.h3m.pro:
You set out south from the monastery. The power that filled you gave you strength for another battle... but will it be the last? No one knows......
The land here is ravaged by war between the forest folk and the necromancers. The barbarians are not idle either, plundering everything they find. The forest folk will be friendly; indeed, they have sent a messenger offering peace. That is good, for the goal of your mission lies in their territory. It is a seer who can assemble an orb to block disruptive elements, allowing you to get home safely. Home—when you think of those romantic evenings by the fire, your beautiful house and your loving wife...
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam3.h3m.reg:
Could you get home? No one knows...
And remember: 
"War is cruel only when it is fought over senseless things."


You also carry over everything you might find that the author has allowed for. You cannot carry over undead troops or level 6 and 7 troops.
Alexej+Sasa carry over; other heroes are unimportant.
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam4.h3m.epi:
When you captured the castle, you hurried forward, thinking this was the end of your painful journey home. But when you reached the place where the monolith should have stood, there was only a heap of rubble and stones. The infernal creatures who occupied this fortress had destroyed it. This truly is the end of your journey. A journey meant to lead you home, which instead brought you to a land you barely know, a land inhospitable to strangers. Now you will return to the monastery, knowing you will never get home. And knowing, too, that you must live here until you die...

campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam4.h3m.pro:
It looks like the final battle. You arm your men so they will be strong and able to win again. You are weary of constant fighting, and with that weariness comes the oppressive feeling that you will never get home...
You are also troubled by doubts about whether the seer was right to say the monolith here works. If it is missing or broken, you will have to stay here...
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.Kam4.h3m.reg:
Will you find your goal here? Will the so-called monolith be here? Did the seer tell the truth? Still, it is worth a try... isn't it?


What do you carry over here? You would like to know, wouldn't you?
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.description: You must have made a mistake while training with Chrono equipment (Teleport). It transported you elsewhere in both space and time. You do not know where you are, or whether you will survive. Perhaps your fate is to remain here... But who knows? Perhaps this civilisation is not so primitive. Well, go and meet your fate.
campaign.[sod] - cesta domu.name: The Road Home
campaign.[sod] - culinan.name: Culinan (from the net)
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_1.h3m.ep:
Honza overcame the perils of nature and hostile pirates. Meanwhile, he learned which land held his Květinka prisoner.
So he boards a ship once more and sets out to free her. Who would have thought history would repeat itself? This time, he is determined to wipe the entire land where Květinka is imprisoned off the face of the earth.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_1.h3m.pr: Honza has endured a long, gruelling journey through underground tunnels. Slowly but surely, however, he is nearing his destination. Where is he heading? And why is he alone, with only a handful of warriors? In a moment, all will become clear.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_1.h3m.re: Honza is trying to reach his home so that he can begin taking steps to free Květinka. He may reach level 10 and carry the Admiral's Hat into the next scenario.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_2.h3m.ep: At last Honza and Květinka are together again. Let us give them some privacy (after so long apart, they surely have plenty to talk about). Meanwhile, we shall visit the still-mysterious barbarian woman Achillea, who tried to help Honza.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_2.h3m.pr: After a long voyage with no serious trouble, Honza has reached the land where Květinka is supposedly imprisoned. He even managed to rent a residence, though it is hardly luxurious. Its inhabitants regard Honza with suspicion. He himself has no experience with the local warriors yet. He has fought them a few times, but never commanded such troops. Still, he hopes he and his new warriors will soon grow accustomed to one another, and that they will help him in his task.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_2.h3m.re:
Honza must find the prison where the enemy holds Květinka and free her. But he will win only after bringing the Diplomat's Ring she carries to the castle of Dark Malice. It was in that castle, at an occult gathering of dark forces, that the plan to capture Květinka was born.
Heroes may reach no higher than level 15. In later scenarios, Honza carries over the Admiral's Hat, and Květinka the Clover of Fortune.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_3.h3m.ep: Achillea's banner flew above every castle in this land. She performed many heroic deeds, and all barbarians will speak her name with respect. She has fulfilled her promise to Honza, and now need only deliver the artifacts she obtained. Then she will return here and begin building her own mighty empire.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_3.h3m.pr: Since Honza kept his promise and left the barbarian Achillea's territory alone, she gratefully offered to recover the three artifacts that a descendant of the mage Čáryfuk had wheedled out of him. Reliable sources told her where the villain had fled. Besides, this offers her a chance to win fame through her deeds and gain new territory for herself. She has made one final burnt offering to her god and sets out in search of glory.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_3.h3m.re:
In this land, the fair barbarian Achillea must recover the three artifacts that a descendant of the mage Čáryfuk tricked Honza into surrendering at the start.
Heroes may reach level 15, and Achillea carries the Cornucopia into her next scenario.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_4.h3m.ep: At last the Elixir of Life is in your hands. You bid Achillea farewell and hurry to Květinka so that she may be healed as soon as possible.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_4.h3m.pr:
When Achillea brought Honza the artifacts she had recovered for him, she and Květinka immediately became friends. But after her ordeals in prison, Květinka is growing weaker by the day. Only the Elixir of Life can help her.
And so Honza and Achillea set out once again...
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_4.h3m.re: Honza and Achillea must obtain the Elixir of Life here. All heroes may reach level 17.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_5.h3m.ep:
The ambitious pretender King has been destroyed, and with him all the forces of evil have been defeated. Peace and quiet reign in the land.
The question remains: for how long...
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_5.h3m.pr: As you approach Květinka's homeland, you can already see black smoke hanging over it from afar. What on earth is happening there? Surely there cannot be a war?
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_5.h3m.re:
Destroy the enemy's chief leader, King, who organised the attack on Květinka's homeland.
Heroes may reach no higher than level 20. Květinka carries her Clover of Fortune into the next scenario, and Honza the Bow of the Sharpshooter.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_6.h3m.ep:
Even the Dragon Lord could not withstand the heroic armies of Honza and Květinka. He and his servants have been defeated. The King of Titans is free once more and may begin rebuilding his kingdom.
Honza and Květinka did not ponder the seer's proposal for long. They decided to do everything they could to bring eternal peace to their sons' souls.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_6.h3m.pr: One day, as Honza and Květinka were preparing for a pleasure cruise, an enormous Titan appeared in the harbour. Everyone immediately began preparing for a fierce battle. Their efforts were needless, however. The Titan had come with no hostile intent, but to ask for help.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_6.h3m.re:
Defeat the Dragon Lord, who attacks neighbouring lands with his dragon hordes. As a reward, you will learn a very interesting piece of information.
Heroes may advance to any level, but carry absolutely nothing into later scenarios :-).
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_7.h3m.ep:
Honza has successfully completed all his tasks. His sons' souls are now free. He himself has had enough of adventures, and retires for a well-earned rest.

T H E  E N D . . .
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_7.h3m.pr: Honza bids Květinka farewell, sits by the fire with his friends one last time, and sets off to see the seer and fulfil the tasks he will be given.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.Honza3_7.h3m.re: To bring his adventures to a successful end, Honza must obtain 3 vials containing his sons' blood and give them to the White Mage for a purification ritual. There are no restrictions on his advancement.
campaign.[sod] - honza 3.description:
You have already shared many interesting experiences with Honza. What awaits him this time? Do not hesitate—join him in new adventures.

map.[ab] - at ziji rebelove.event.0.desc: Most of the army and the people have rebelled. They fled to the rebel camp at Nibiru and now march together on the capital, Prague. We must overthrow Queen Tyranka! Christian, the queen's former general, leads us. Victory will be ours!
map.[ab] - at ziji rebelove.guards.18.11:
You have encountered a small band of men! 

"Who are you?"

"We are rebels. The queen took every family's money to pay the army. It is terrible! The soldiers told her they needed no money and would be happy just to survive the war. She took it anyway and kept it for herself! That is why we shall join you."
map.[ab] - at ziji rebelove.guards.32.11: "Halt, rebels! You will never reach the village of Hosnigtun, however hard you try!"
I do not like this. Why would the queen guard Hosnigtum with such a large army? Unless they have rebelled there too...
map.[ab] - at ziji rebelove.guards.38.17: A trap! Everyone back! Damn it, there is no time! To arms, knights!
map.[ab] - at ziji rebelove.guards.38.41: Here are the harbours. From here we can sail to the capital, Prague, and overthrow Queen Tyranka. But beware: the queen surely has a strong army!
map.[ab] - at ziji rebelove.header.descr: The evil Queen Tyranka has long ruled our land with a cruel hand. Some even claim she is a sorceress. She sends us to war against elves, goblins and monsters from the swamps and jungles. Though these peoples have done us no harm, the queen declares war on them again and again. One day, however, everything changed...
map.[ab] - at ziji rebelove.header.name: Long Live the Rebels
map.[ab] - at ziji rebelove.monster.16.1: "Well, well, rebels! Ha ha! What will you do now? May I join you?"
map.[ab] - at ziji rebelove.monster.26.3: "Look! They are besieging Hosnigtun! At them!"
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.0.description:
Since you must pay the local inhabitants a tax on storing wood and ore, your superiors have "persuaded" them to pay you taxes too. They explained that you maintain order in the land and do your work well.
Your task is a little easier once again...
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.1.description: You are now in your hometown. Once again you have heard your superior's instructions on how to destroy everyone. You nod at everything he says, but will do the job your own way all the same. Then your superior has just three words left for you: Into the fray!
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.10.description: The bandit raids have not stopped—quite the opposite. Now your money has begun disappearing too.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.12.description: Your scouts have finally discovered the location of the Vial of Dragon Blood. It once belonged to the beastmaster Lantal. But the vial attracts all dragons, so several dragons decided to steal it from him. Their night raid succeeded. Fearing Lantal might take it back, the dragons hid with the vial behind an altar of one of the elements.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.2.description: To make things easier for you, your superior has assigned you one of the high priests of the monastery where you lived until recently.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.3.description: Wood and ore are scarce in this land. You brought some supplies, but had to use them to pay the toll.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.4.description: Every week, you must pay the people of this land a tax on storing wood and ore.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.5.description: As if that were not enough, someone is stealing your wood and ore.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.6.description: You must hurry! Your enemies are gathering armies against you!
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.7.description: Your scouts have learned that your enemies have summoned some scholars to help them with their difficult task of destroying you.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.8.description: Fortunately, the toll collectors were careless, and in an unguarded moment you managed to load some wood and ore back onto your wagon.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.event.9.description: The thefts of wood and ore have now been joined by thefts of other resources.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.0.1.1.message: You have entered the underground. Somehow, you sense that the strongest enemy you will face in this land is here.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.0.5.0.message: So this is where the Vial of Dragon Blood is hidden! But you also see dragon guards who will not surrender it easily. Do you still wish to take it?
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.1.31.0.messag: You are in luck. The instructors have just returned from their lunch break and can give you a lesson.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.10.34.0.messa: You have reached a secret place where thieves hide their loot, including spells and magical treasures. They also hold prisoners in their den. Unfortunately, the thieves return just as you approach the hideout. You will have to kill them.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.11.31.0.messa: On the right bank, where a stream joins the great river, you see suspicious movement. It looks as though someone is trying to hide something there. You should certainly go and investigate.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.15.14.1.messa: You discover that 2000 gold pieces have flown out of your purse.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.15.33.1.messa: Because you disobeyed the prohibition, the god Teramis has cursed you and emptied your treasury.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.17.35.0.messa:
"Where does this gate lead?" you ask the sprite.
"I do not know. A treasure cave, perhaps," he replies.
If the sprite is telling the truth, victory is within your grasp.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.20.35.0.messa: Ahead you see a hero—an enemy hero. It would be wise to dispose of him. Or coax some information out of him.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.21.35.0.messa: The thunderbirds have imprisoned two sprites here. That explains why the birds had gems.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.24.14.0.messa: Near the mountains, you discover a chest containing an ancient artifact. Before you can take it, however, someone taps you on the shoulder. You turn and see a group of five titans. Do you wish to fight them for the chest?
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.25.2.0.messag: You stand before a Griffin Conservatory. Rumour has it that a few angels are held prisoner here. If you freed them, they would surely help you in your just struggle out of gratitude.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.29.32.1.messa: His lordship fancies some dragons, does he??? If you defeat them, perhaps a few will join you.
map.[ab] - avatar:0.guards.3.2.0.message: This is a rare ancient artifact. But the devil Devilios and his ten lieutenants guard it. Do you wish to fight them for the artifact?

map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.0.description: At last you have reached these lands. At first glance, they look magnificent. The inhabitants of Castle Reela welcome you with wild cheers. They know you have come to free Sosaria from enemy rule. While you celebrated your arrival with the locals, Gavon went to visit his relatives and Sir Brittish wandered the countryside. On his return, he brought fresh news. He discovered there are no loose resources here, only mines, guarded by elementals. These are controlled by the King of the Elements, who is far from pleased to see you. He would dearly like to be rid of you forever. The barbarian chieftain Crooked Shank feels much the same. And Sir Brittish has not even mentioned the local necromancers or your original enemy yet.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.1.description: Sir Brittish also brought good news. A young traveller named Lamanda wishes to ally with you. She dislikes what the King of the Elements is doing against you. But she has another reason too. Lamanda wishes to continue studying Water Magic, which is forbidden to all subjects in the Conflux called Castle of the Elements. Brittish also visited wizards and mages, who likewise pledge their support. He occupied a nearby garrison, so their town is now within sight. You decide to head there.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.10.description: Today a host of the Lady of Angels' finest warriors arrived to help her. If you have not yet captured Sosaria and are seeing this message, your chances of freeing it are very slim.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.2.description: Your scouts have learned that the necromancers have captured many alchemists and are forcing them to work for them.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.3.description: The scouts have discovered that the enemy fighting under the red banner has vast quantities of resources in his storehouses.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.4.description: Someone is trying to remove you from this game of the mighty. Some resources have vanished from your storehouse.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.5.description: You inspect the storehouse every day to make sure nothing disappears, but it does no good.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.6.description: After fleeing the Castle of the Elements, the heroine Lamanda ended up on your island. She is now near the Conflux town of Asgard, home to a renowned magical tower devoted to Water Magic.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.7.description: Your scouts have discovered that the knightly sabotage group Red Thorn is responsible for the missing resources. You hired a few assassins and ordered them to eliminate its members.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.8.description: The hired assassins have done their work, but not entirely successfully. A few saboteurs escaped them. Even so, the assassins demand their promised reward. You disagree, and pay them only a proportionate sum. The remaining members therefore swear vengeance upon you.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.event.9.description:
Your scouts have finally discovered who commands the armies beneath the red banner. It is someone called the Lady of Angels. They have also given you all their information about her. One document listing her transgressions particularly catches your eye:

1. Promoting Satanism - 100 lashes
2. Rejecting the Church - 300 lashes
3. Sacrificing 100 people to the dark powers - 100 years in prison
No appeal permitted!

She must be a great sinner indeed. Apparently, she has also summoned some depraved angels! Only a few can reach Sosaria each week. But beware! The sooner you defeat her, the better. In a few months, an entire legion will arrive!
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.1.0.0.message: How did you pick up this scroll? You must be cheating!!!
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.1.59.0.messag: Look how much those bandits had here!
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.1.69.0.messag: A priest approaches you while you are still some distance away. He has come to collect money. The local church has none, so it charges an entrance fee.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.11.13.0.messa: As you approach the garrison, elementals emerge from the earth and air. They do not want you to pass. Unfortunately, you will have to fight your way through.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.11.26.0.messa: During working hours, alchemists mix various liquids here, turning them into mercury. It would be wise to claim this laboratory for yourself.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.15.47.0.messa: The castle is near now, and you look forward to studying new water spells.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.16.65.0.messa: In the distance, you see the outline of some rocks. After a moment, however, it darkens and the rocks vanish. What could it be?
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.17.58.0.messa: Where the rocks once stood lies gold. Without hesitation, you gather it.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.2.7.0.message: "Today the Wandering Knight roams the cursed plains, unable to find that Scroll of Forgiveness, for over the years sulfur has buried the path to it, and now a lonely sulfur dune stands there," the old man concluded.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.3.22.0.messag: The local wizards enjoy carving runes into obelisks. This one is already covered in them. A few wizards are still bustling around the other.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.3.28.0.messag: On the way to the workshop, a monk stops you. "I am here to help you on your travels. The dragon lords sent me," he recites at once. He chants a few more incantations, then vanishes. You feel that you have learned from his words.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.3.5.0.message: A vast knights' castle stands before you. Could it be the one you seek? The noisy castle garrison breaks your reverie. They seem impatient to attack you.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.3.6.0.message: Look! Is that the Wandering Knight roaming nearby? You would not want to meet this apparition even in your worst nightmare! Yet here he is, wandering somewhere around you! That does your army's morale no good either.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.3.8.0.message:
After your horse takes a few steps, the old man stops again. He continues his tale:
"Apanagu decided that if Felinsalir was so powerful, he would challenge him to a duel. The wizard accepted. Two days later, a shrivelled old man arrived at the duelling ground.
""What are you doing here, old man? I am waiting for Felinsalir,"" Apanagu began threateningly.
""If you wish to overcome Felinsalir, you must bow to me,"" the old man replied.
""Never!"" the knight shouted angrily.
Instead, he sought to murder the old man. As soon as he drew his sword, the old man grew into a handsome young mage.
""So you have no respect for age, and meant to kill a poor old man instead?!? I see you are even prouder than I was told! Thus shall it be: trees and mountains will rise between you and Castle Roxqen. You will never reach home. But you shall not die! You must find a scroll written by my hand that will absolve you,"" the mage declared.
And as he said, so it happened. Ever since, no one has called Apanagu anything but the Wandering Knight."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.3.9.0.message:
On the road to the castle, an old man stops you. He wants you to hear his tale. Since you are tired and reluctant to go on, you stop and listen. The old man begins:
"Long ago, a knight named Apanagu lived in Castle Roxqen. His skill at arms was renowned throughout the land. Apanagu therefore believed himself mightier than anyone. But one day he learned that a mage named Felinsalir dared claim to be more powerful. Apanagu grew angry and sent two executioners to cool his head. He thought they would overcome him.
That very day, the executioners' heads came rolling up to the castle. Then the knight was truly enraged."
The old man walks on towards a castle. "Come along! A little exercise will do you no harm."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.31.57.0.messa: A family of elves out hunting would like to join you.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.4.21.0.messag: "Welcome, Avatar," the chief wizard greets you. "Word of your heroic deeds has spread across the continent. We can offer indirect guidance to the hiding place of the supreme artifact—the Grail. The runes on the obelisks will lead you to it. If I may advise you, build the Grail structure in Reela."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.4.58.0.messag: Bandits leap at you from the surrounding bushes!
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.5.10.0.messag: As if on cue, bandits emerge from the surrounding jungle. You could try that scroll.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.5.24.0.messag: Some absent-minded soul has left another large pile here. Or perhaps they could not carry it?
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.5.28.0.messag: A small group of wizards comes out through the gate to meet you. A rousing welcome is already being prepared in their town.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.51.7.0.messag: You cannot stand necromancers—no sooner do they settle somewhere than they start dragging those rotten bones along!
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.6.10.0.messag: So you have taken the scroll for summoning servants.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.7.11.0.messag: Out of nowhere, a young sorcerer sits before you. "Welcome, hero! I was beginning to think you were just an old wives' tale. But I see you are alive and have made it this far. Since you are here, I shall try to help you. Take the scroll you see before you. Whenever you need my servants, hold it in your hand and read it. My servants will surely come to your aid.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.8.11.0.messag: A dense jungle has grown on this magical terrain. You and your company must literally hack your way through.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.8.63.0.messag: Cyclopes and goblins rush out of the castle.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.9.12.0.messag: There! Through the gate at last!
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.9.23.0.messag: If you wish to win the genies' favour, you will have to fight their leaders to prove that you are a hero.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.guards.9.63.0.messag: You find a small chest. Looking inside, you discover gems and gold, so you decide to keep it.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.header.description: At last you are approaching Sosaria. Will you take it, or will this be your final adventure?
map.[ab] - avatar:1.header.name: The Battle for Sosaria
map.[ab] - avatar:1.header.rumor.0.text: Look for the old man—he tells a good tale.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.header.rumor.1.text: Have you heard of the Wandering Knight?
map.[ab] - avatar:1.header.rumor.2.text: Ice Elementals are terrorising the Great Lake.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.128.biography: Lamanda's father. Once he fell under the necromancers' control, he could never escape it.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.128.name: King of the Elements
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.138.biography: Lamanda is in fact the only daughter of the King of the Elements. From her youth, she showed a desire to become a water traveller. She helped all the people of the Castle of the Elements. Then her father fell into the necromancers' hands. They enslaved him, and now he obeys only their commands. One of those commands was to destroy the Avatar and his armies. But they had not reckoned with Lamanda. She left because of the evil being done in her hometown and joined the Avatar.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.138.name: Lamanda
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.144.name: Castellan
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.146.biography: A great sinner—more is written about her in the timed events.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.146.name: Lady of Angels
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.2.biography: Surely everyone knows the legend of the Wandering Knight—don't you?
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.2.name: Wandering Knight
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.67.name: Dead Spirit
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.71.name: Shadowy Fext
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.77.biography: An executioner cuts off heads and hangs people from the gallows. This one, however, is a little different.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.77.name: Chief Executioner
map.[ab] - avatar:1.heroes.99.name: Crooked Shank
map.[ab] - avatar:1.monster.1.23.0.messa: "The wizards of the local town stationed us here to guard this mine. If we judge your aims to agree with ours, we may help you."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.monster.2.59.0.messa: You have found a bandit hideout. And, of course, the bandits themselves!
map.[ab] - avatar:1.monster.28.36.0.mess: You see the only unintelligent beings of the Conflux. All they know is that they must guard this mine, even at the cost of their lives.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.monster.60.13.0.mess: "Come on, come closer. We are just waiting for the harvest!"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.monster.60.69.0.mess: "You want take our treasure. We attack!"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.monster.61.12.0.mess: "Come on, come closer. We are just waiting for the harvest!"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.monster.62.11.0.mess: "Come on, come closer. We are just waiting for the harvest!"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.monster.63.10.0.mess: "Come on, come closer. We are just waiting for the harvest!"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.monster.63.43.0.mess: "There may be fewer of us, but we are not as stupid as those water elementals!"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.monster.64.44.0.mess: "We thought it strange at once that you had reached this place. You must be some sort of hero. Hero or no hero, someone has broken through this barrier. We shall defend our masters!"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.1.25.0.complet: "So you have seen reason after all. Will you take this reward?"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.1.25.0.firstVi: "I have an interesting offer for you. Bring me 100 Gremlins before the time limit, and I shall reward you."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.12.69.0.comple: "So here is the vial! In exchange, I offer you another that you will need in the future!"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.12.69.0.firstV: "Welcome, hero. I could help you on your travels. Just bring me the Vial of Dragon Blood. If you do not have it, try my neighbour next door. He offers the same reward, but for something else."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.12.69.0.nextVi: "So you do not have the Vial? Once again, I advise you to try my neighbour next door."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.2.4.0.complete: "Then you may enter the castle, hero!"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.2.4.0.firstVis: "You must be an experienced hero to enter the castle. Before entering, therefore, you must defeat the Ice Elementals that have ravaged the beautiful lake."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.2.4.0.nextVisi: "Still nothing? Either you do not know where the Great Lake is, or you are no experienced hero."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.28.26.0.comple: Now nothing bars your way to Sosaria. Do you wish to pass?
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.28.26.0.firstV: Unfortunately, magical walls surround Sosaria. One of your soldiers advises you that to deactivate them, you must kill Shadowy Fext. They say his magical power sustains these walls. Where he is hiding now, however, is unknown.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.28.26.0.nextVi: The magical walls still stand. Unless you defeat Shadowy Fext, passage will be impossible.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.32.61.0.comple: "So you have the 60000 gold already? Then go right through. Beyond this gate is enough material to build your first little boat. That part is free. Ha ha ha!"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.32.61.0.firstV: "If you wish to pass, you need one little permit. That permit is 60000 gold."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.32.61.0.nextVi: "Unless you bring me 60000 gold, there will be no little boats. But I know you will come back."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.33.59.0.comple: "So you are a true hero. Your reward shall be further training. Do you wish to train now?"
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.33.59.0.firstV: "Welcome. I can help you in your mission. Simply raise your Attack, Defense, Spell Power and Knowledge to 10. Then I shall give you a reward."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.33.59.0.nextVi: "You still have not reached the required level. You could at least try. The reward is tempting..."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.50.37.0.comple: You give them the arm, and the entire army departs contentedly. Do you wish to cross the bridge leading to the castle?
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.50.37.0.firstV: A vast undead army surges towards you, surely strong enough to slaughter you and your troops. But they will leave you alone if you bring them the right arm of the barbarian called Crooked Shank.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.50.37.0.nextVi: Without the arm, the undead will not hesitate to kill you.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.63.45.0.comple: You have overcome the challenges of the trials. The guard therefore lets you through.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.63.45.0.firstV: "For a long, long time, elementals have been ravaging our lake. Once it was among the most beautiful in the land. But one day the elementals settled here, and things have looked grim ever since. I know an experienced warrior could kill them. Your task is clear: pass a trial proving that you are a hero of level 25 or higher. If you fail, I regret that I cannot let you through."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.63.45.0.nextVi: You attempted the hero's trials. You did not fare well, however, and the guard threw you out. You still have much to learn.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.67.2.0.complet: As soon as you approach with the required army, the orcs fall silent. Do you wish to march your army through and drive the orcs away?
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.67.2.0.firstVi: The local orc garrison will not let you through unless you frighten them. Find 50 Champions, and the orcs will scatter.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.67.2.0.nextVis:
Still do not know where to find those 50 Champions? Then those fat, farting, stinking orcs will not run away.
Suddenly, you remember that you need only capture a knights' castle in the northwestern region...
It is said to be the only town where you can train your Cavaliers into better warriors...
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.9.69.0.complet: "Thank you, thank you, thank you! These are exactly the warriors I needed! You may take your reward."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.9.69.0.firstVi: "Welcome! As my neighbour may have told you, I shall reward you if you bring me 50 Champions. But if you have the Vial of Dragon Blood, go to my neighbour instead. He will give you the same reward for it."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.quest.9.69.0.nextVis: "Still nothing? You will have to search. For your information, Champions can be recruited in Castle Roxqen."
map.[ab] - avatar:1.sign.11.71.0.message: This road leads back the way you came.
map.[ab] - avatar:1.sign.16.44.0.message:
