map.[ab] - avatar:2.event.0.description:
The Avatar has made it this far—to the land where Minax dwells. Since Minax has held this island for a long time, hardly anyone is likely to feel kindly towards you. You decide that if they are hostile, you will be too: you will sweep them all from the face of the earth.
Perhaps worst of all, a terrible storm struck as you sailed to this island in a great lake. You had to throw all your supplies overboard to keep the ship from capsizing in the heavy seas.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.event.1.description: You can strengthen your advantage by capturing every lighthouse in the land. Do not forget the castle a passing traveller told you about yesterday, either. It is said to stand on a small island east of Paradise Home. If you capture it soon enough, pilgrims passing that way may take a liking to it and settle there. That will give your army valuable reinforcements.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.event.2.description: It would be wise to free the ranger Gavon, one of the leaders of the rebellion against Minax. Gavon trains excellent bowmen—some adventurers say they are true sharpshooters.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.event.3.description: Your scout has discovered that Gavon is imprisoned in the southwest.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.event.4.description: You have heard of a second town that withstood Minax. She left it alone because it stands in a magical field that allows every mage on this island to replenish magical energy. If Minax attacked this place, she would surely use a massively destructive spell and deprive herself of the ability to cast magic. You should therefore go to this town and take control of it. It lies north of Paradise Home. Do so as soon as possible, for pilgrims sometimes pass nearby. If they take a liking to the town, they may settle there.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.event.5.description: Unfortunately, the Avatar has only just reached these parts and has not had time to take any village or castle. Much work lies ahead. The best course would be to capture the village of Paradise Home, which has withstood Minax's latest attack. To avoid wasting her strength, Minax decided to cut this region off from the rest of the island with impassable mountains. But she forgot one crucial thing: the village stands on the seashore and can build a shipyard. By the time Minax realises this, it will be too late.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.event.6.description: The scout has added to his report: Gavon is held by Arch Devils, dreadful monsters of Hell. But his report does not reveal how many there are.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.event.7.description: As if that were not enough, your scouts have learned that Minax has sent her two minions against you. And you thought you might be bored!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.event.8.description: The scouts have learned something else: the minions are fighting each other! One believes he has the perfect chance to destroy the other. At least your task is a little easier.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.1.58.0.messag: You were warned! For breaking the prohibition, you will pay—with YOUR LIFE!!!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.12.55.0.messa: The first resource pointing towards the treasure.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.13.57.0.messa: The second resource pointing towards the treasure.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.14.44.0.messa: This town is so beautiful. Unfortunately, its fortifications are rather poor. You will surely find a way to remedy that.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.14.59.0.messa: Another resource pointing towards the treasure.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.14.69.0.messa: By saving the old sea dog from sacrifice to the god Lug, you have earned the helm of the sea dogs' captain.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.15.57.0.messa: The countryside here seems to be dying. Who could have destroyed it like this?
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.15.61.0.messa: Another resource pointing towards the treasure.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.16.38.0.messa: You hear the monks' devout prayers. Looking closer, you see a building. Why, here is the new monastery! Perhaps some monks will wish to join your army.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.16.56.0.messa: Mother Earth must have breathed a long-awaited sigh of relief. These creatures will never ravage her again.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.16.63.0.messa: Another resource pointing towards the treasure.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.17.28.0.messa: "So you will not listen?!? Then we shall give you trouble!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.17.65.0.messa: Another resource pointing towards the treasure.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.18.27.0.messa: The trolls will not tolerate your intrusion into their territory!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.18.33.0.messa: "Want some capable archers? Then enter our cottage!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.18.67.0.messa: The final resource pointing towards the treasure.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.19.26.0.messa: Bridges over the troll river Umbeza.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.21.32.0.messa: "We know of your mission and would like to help. There are many of us here. We shall let you take a few warriors each week."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.24.28.0.messa: "Welcome, traveller. We are capable warriors indeed, and you may hire us as guards or recruit us into your army. Whatever your answer, do not forget to visit our blacksmith. He is truly gifted."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.25.41.0.messa: Well, well! Another Pandora's Box. More reinforcements, perhaps???
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.25.47.0.messa: "The direct road is blocked again. It seems to be a tradition. Knowing these villains, Minax is sure to be barricaded in Hell," you mutter to yourself.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.26.37.0.messa: Having defeated the persistent guards, you can at last see beyond the forest and mountains. A magnificent plain lies before you! It is so beautiful that even your surliest soldier brightens.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.26.45.0.messa: Among the "impure", unprocessed sulfur, you find a pile of freshly refined sulfur.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.27.34.0.messa: Only the sufficiently refined may enter this town.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.27.36.0.messa: Welcome to the territory of the town of Elanhon. It is the largest town in the land so far.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.28.31.0.messa: The tree-men are pleased by your visit. Only a few rebels regard you with hostility.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.28.35.0.messa: Several miles ahead, you see a large band of orcs. Their chieftain wears a rather fine pendant around his neck. Not that you are a thief and murderer, but you find yourself longing to own it.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.28.51.0.messa: At last you see a sawmill. You will badly need its wood. Without it, you could never complete this mission.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.29.35.0.messa: You approach a LARGE group of orcs. Indeed, their chieftain wears a pendant around his neck—it looks like a golden lion's head!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.30.24.0.messa: Even from afar, you hear dragons roaring. Their nests must be nearby.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.31.26.0.messa: The unicorns are already casting shy glances at you.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.33.11.0.messa: A harbour! You can hardly wait to meet the Avatar again!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.34.8.0.messag: In gratitude, the sinful souls have allowed you to open this box. They say your reward lies within.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.36.21.0.messa: The dragons are not exactly pleased by your presence. Still, what can they do? They have accepted you among them. Plainly, you are a nuisance to them here.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.39.7.0.messag: To the south, you see a clean river! At last you can wash off all that filth properly.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.42.69.0.messa: Old sea dog Mati has a shack on the coast of this island. They say he has charted the entire sea around it.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.44.2.0.messag: You have fallen into a goblin latrine. You stink terribly, so you should wash yourself thoroughly in clean water.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.48.51.0.messa: Look! A Tree of Wisdom. And it is speaking to you! You must go closer to find out what it wants.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.52.10.0.messa: In the distance, you hear a devil laughing. Was it real, or did you imagine it? Probably real, since your entire army heard it too.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.53.11.0.messa: You prepare to fight the source of that laughter. And you do not wait in vain!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.56.17.0.messa: You stand just before Minax's castle. Evil holds complete sway here. The air is utterly saturated with the stench of sulfur. You must capture the castle quickly, or you and your whole army will suffocate in this reek!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.6.1.0.message: The mage Ehajinon lives here. What might he demand for passage?
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.67.64.0.messa: The sea rages because you killed its favourites too: the water elementals. It has unleashed the greatest storm you have ever known. To calm it, you had to throw a considerable quantity of resources into its waters.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.67.65.0.messa: You have stumbled into a battle between earth and water elementals. Since they wanted to settle it themselves, without a mortal's help (not knowing you are no mortal), they abandoned their fight and turned on you!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.7.55.0.messag: Follow the resources! They will lead you to the treasure!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.71.26.0.messa: You should have been more careful and heeded the advice in the bottle. You had to throw some supplies overboard to keep the ship afloat, and used more wood to repair it.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.guards.9.63.0.messag: Well, look at that! Among the pikemen's possessions was the Lion's Shield of Courage, celebrated by countless generations!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.header.description: Heroes may reach level 35 and carry their skills, experience, spells, the Blackshard of the Dead Knight and the Vial of Dragon Blood into the next scenario (if they had them at the start).
map.[ab] - avatar:2.header.name: The Expedition Against Minax
map.[ab] - avatar:2.heroes.116.name: Minion 2
map.[ab] - avatar:2.heroes.148.biography: Gavon grew up with a bow in his hands. He shot his first arrow at the age of three. When he came of age, he entered the service of the Ormalis troops. As he rose through the ranks, he trained them in archery. His pupils were among the best. Then he received a letter telling him his property had been stolen. He came here, only to discover a trap. He was captured, and his troops were defeated by vastly superior numbers. The enemy wanted him to teach their magogs accurate shooting too. But these infernal beings never learned, so his enemies threw him in here.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.heroes.148.name: Gavon
map.[ab] - avatar:2.heroes.59.biography: Modain's apprentice, Minax, will be defeated in the end anyway. Or will she?
map.[ab] - avatar:2.heroes.59.name: Minax
map.[ab] - avatar:2.heroes.65.biography: This minion has served Minax since time immemorial. To win still greater trust from her, he has joined this war.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.heroes.65.name: Minion 1
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.12.61.0.mess: The bandit pikemen have been waiting for you for quite some time. They thought that as a hero, you were sure to have plenty of money!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.14.52.0.mess: Welcome—to your G R A V E!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.17.55.0.mess: "You would like some treasure, would you?"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.17.68.0.mess: "You must be another adventurer who wants to steal our treasures!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.18.41.0.mess: "Stomp, stomp, tread! We shall gobble you up, from your toes to your head!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.2.69.0.messa: "Well, well! Come to see the prisoner? Then you are mistaken! He is allowed no visitors!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.22.44.0.mess: "Another hero! Would you like to share a few cakes with us?"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.22.61.0.mess: "We would hand this treasure over only to a dark hero—which means not you!!!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.23.53.0.mess: "We fought to win this dwarven mine, and we mean to keep it!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.25.40.0.mess: "We will not give you Pandora's Box for nothing, stranger!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.26.36.0.mess:
The forest guard shows no mercy and immediately demands a pass.
But you do not have one!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.30.52.0.mess: "Drinking mercury is the only thing keeping us in this world. So do not take it from us!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.31.17.0.mess: Judging by the hungry looks on the rust dragons' faces, you should not have taken their sulfur...
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.34.9.0.messa: "We were once mortals, but we sinned. As punishment, we must guard this box. We would be grateful if you killed us in this form."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.40.10.0.mess: "You had better stay away from here!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.43.2.0.messa: Your eyes must be playing tricks on you! Water elementals in the desert!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.43.5.0.messa: These "people" look as though they have been stung by bees or some other insects. Perhaps they tried to raid this hive. And they are very angry about it!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.50.7.0.messa: "It has been a long time since anyone made it this far. But no one has ever made it past us!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.monster.67.59.0.mess: "We do not care about any key. You would have to go through our nests to get it. And we shall see to it that you never do!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.28.27.0.comple:
"So you defeated them after all? Wait here a moment," he says, locking himself in his shack. A few hours later he emerges and hands you a ring.
"Ehajinon will certainly be looking for this ring. I do not know where he lives, but he lets no one cross his territory for free."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.28.27.0.firstV: "As you may already have heard, I am a dwarven blacksmith. If you defeated the rust dragons, I would reward you with a ring—the Diplomat’s Ring. The wizard Ehajinon's diplomat once owned one, but lost it on a mission. I managed to obtain the plans for making it. But I am missing one last ingredient: a rust dragon's heart."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.28.27.0.nextVi: "I cannot make you the ring until the dragons have been defeated."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.3.45.0.complet: "Have you finally brought me a full sack of those little yellow things? Good, you may pass."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.3.45.0.firstVi: "The fee for using the lighthouse is 15000 gold. If you do not pay, you cannot get to the lighthouse."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.3.45.0.nextVis: "You still have not brought the required sum? I know, it is a little overpriced, but I have to make a living somehow!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.36.1.0.complet: "Have you finally brought me a full sack of those little yellow things? Good, you may pass."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.36.1.0.firstVi: "The fee for using the lighthouse is 15000 gold. If you do not pay, you cannot get to the lighthouse."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.36.1.0.nextVis: "You still have not brought the required sum? I know, it is a little overpriced, but I have to make a living somehow!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.7.1.0.complete: "Thank you. At last I shall be able to find a new, capable diplomat."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.7.1.0.firstVis: "Welcome, traveller. As you may have heard from others, I shall not let you pass for free. You must bring me the Diplomat’s Ring that my diplomat lost on his journey from the mainland to this island. Understand?"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.7.1.0.nextVisi: "You have rather disappointed me. Without the ring, no one may pass."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.70.45.0.comple: "Have you finally brought me a full sack of those little yellow things? Good, you may pass."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.70.45.0.firstV: "The fee for using the lighthouse is 15000 gold. If you do not pay, you cannot get to the lighthouse."
map.[ab] - avatar:2.quest.70.45.0.nextVi: "You still have not brought the required sum? I know, it is a little overpriced, but I have to make a living somehow!"
map.[ab] - avatar:2.sign.13.27.0.message: Many ships have already met their doom on this island. Take care that yours does not join them!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.sign.14.51.0.message: Paradise Home is a few miles down the road.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.sign.2.44.0.message: Western Lighthouse. The next lighthouse is to the north, near the desert.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.sign.2.57.0.message: Harbour closed for reconstruction. Unauthorised persons may not enter the harbour!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.sign.20.25.0.message: Welcome to the trolls' river, the Umbeza.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.sign.29.47.0.message: This road is blocked by a landslide.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.sign.3.68.0.message:
{Prisoner:} Gavon the ranger
{Charged with:} attempted assassination of Minax
 {Prosecutor:} Minax herself
{Defence counsel:} none 
{Witness:} God (as the accused called him)
map.[ab] - avatar:2.sign.37.2.0.message: Northern Lighthouse. The next lighthouse is to the east, near Harbour Stronghold.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.sign.70.44.0.message: The last lighthouse in this land's network of lighthouses.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.16.43.0.event.0: Minax is very angry with you. She sent efreet messengers to make that clear. What if she sends saboteurs, as her late teacher Modain used to do?
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.16.43.0.event.1: It is just as you suspected! Minax has sent saboteurs against you, and no ordinary ones—invisible ones! You certainly did not expect that. You will have to find a way to repay her!
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.16.43.0.event.2: You have repaid Minax. With sabotage, of course. At least you have recovered something to make up for your losses.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.16.43.0.name: Paradise Home
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.event.0: Today centaurs moved to New Elanhon and built stables for themselves.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.event.1: Dwarves have established mines near this town and moved here to be closer to their work.
The little garden of trees has begun to flourish.
The unicorns have found a permanent home here, so some improvements are being made to their grounds today.
Today is a glorious day. The dragon lords have decided to house some of their subjects here.
The dragon lords have now sent some more capable subjects here as well.

This is a day that every chronicle of this land will remember. Saflos, a famous hero born here, has arrived in town. He has not come empty-handed: he carries the Grail. And he has chosen this very town as the place to build its shrine.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.event.2: The centaurs are improving their stables to make them more comfortable.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.event.3: The dwarven mine is prospering, so the dwarves have arranged better lodgings for themselves.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.event.4: This town has begun to grow, attracting some elves.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.event.5: Elven women riding pegasi spotted the elves in town and decided to move here too.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.event.6: An even larger group of elves moved here today, so the elves must rebuild their cottage.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.event.7: Where there are elves, trees grow too. The elves grew several trees, which suddenly began to come to life.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.event.8: The pegasi have become more demanding. Their elven riders had to improve their home.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.event.9: Today some unicorns came running from somewhere, asking for lodgings. You found them a place at once.
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.30.22.0.name: New Elanhon
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.41.43.0.name: Vampire Club
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.46.26.0.name: Altar of Gorgons
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.58.16.0.name: Headquarters
map.[ab] - avatar:2.town.68.42.0.name: Harbour Stronghold
map.[ab] - avatar:3.event.0.description: As the Avatar's campaign reaches its height and he enters the lands near Sosaria, the annual election is taking place in the southern lands of Evil: the election of Lord Zlor. This election resembles the Festival of Life, with a few exceptions. We now enter its final stage.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.event.1.description: The time has come to elect a new Lord Zlor from among the necromancers and demons. This election is held every 5 years. Even the greatest ruler held the title for only 20 years. That could change now. Become Lord Zlor and keep the title until your death (you could naturally live to be as old as 350 :-) ).
map.[ab] - avatar:3.event.2.description: You can become Lord Zlor only by passing all 6 trials. You have already passed 5. Only the final, additional trial remains; it is being held for only the second time in the history of the Election of Lord Zlor. You must deal with the remaining candidate: the current Lord Zlor. The only way to do that is to capture every creature dwelling in this part of the necromantic and demonic lands. This vast battlefield has been opened after 50 years, so it is teeming with creature dwellings. New vegetation brought by overlords from foreign lands has also spread here. 50 years ago, for the first time, no fewer than 2 candidates passed all five trials. That was why the organisers devised this additional trial.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.event.3.description:
In a spare moment, your teacher tells you a legend:
" In the days before there was a Lord Zlor or any other leader of evil, the forces of evil were scattered across the land, and this place was a barbaric wilderness. Then the forces of good decided to strike their enemies a crushing blow. At first they succeeded, for the forces of evil were disorganised. That lasted until the dark knight Darakin appeared. He swiftly organised the forces of evil, and together they marched against the army of good camped in this region. But the army of good was ready, and the two sides fought a battle that this land would remember for a long time." Your teacher falls silent for a moment...
map.[ab] - avatar:3.event.4.description: ...then continues: "The forces were evenly matched, and the battle lasted a week. Even the leader of good, King Dobror, fell. Before he died, he cursed the side where the entire army of evil stood and blessed the side occupied by the army of good. The combatants abandoned the battle and scattered across the countryside. After several years of searching in vain for a way out, all the warriors settled in the basin, each on their own side. A few brave souls even managed to penetrate enemy territory, where they now guard the enemy's dwellings and let no one enter. Yet you MUST enter them to complete your victory. However, you can enter this basin only from underground."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.event.5.description: But heretics and demons had met on the battlefield. Their battles were so fierce that part of the underground collapsed with every clash. Now all that remains below ground is one long passage linking your territory to the enemy's. Many warriors have also settled underground, driven from their natural homes by the candidates. Your master told you all this before the final trial. Good luck!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.event.6.description: This is absurd! Your scouts have discovered that Lord Zlor sold his soul to the darkest devil, who sent him reinforcements. This made you furious, and since you dislike bearers of bad news, you executed one of the scouts. Through a dark ritual, you transferred his soul into your own body, and you feel stronger than ever before.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.event.7.description: Your teacher visits you again. He begins speaking from the doorway: "There you are at last. I have something important to tell you. A treacherous hero from Zlor's ranks has captured a neutral necropolis in the necromancers' territory. You should show him that this place has belonged to the necromancers since time immemorial."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.event.8.description: Your teacher comes to see you again today. He is so agitated that he does not even dare knock, teleporting straight into your tent instead. His hands are visibly shaking. At first he can manage only incomprehensible sounds, but then he says: "Horrible! I have discovered that a rebellion has broken out underground. The rebels have elected a leader and decided to halt the Election of Lord Zlor and declare independence. You must eliminate their leader before they carry out their plan!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.guards.0.38.0.messag: "Hellooo!!! Here we are!" comes a sudden cry from directly ahead. To your delight, the skeletons you lent to the Quest Guard are waiting for you here.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.guards.105.53.0.mess: Few peasants can know about this part of the village. Some thugs have a hideout here!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.guards.106.53.0.mess:
You certainly showed those thugs.
Had they known what awaited them, they would surely have preferred to lay down their weapons!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.guards.107.28.0.mess: Damn! That gold was a trap!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.guards.52.87.0.messa: This club is made from the fine wood of guardian trees. The smell of the sweaty hand that held it perhaps an hour ago still hangs over it. Do you wish to take it?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.header.description: Now for something completely different: in the south, on the border between the necromancers and demons, the Election of Lord Zlor is under way. Who will win? Only the best :-). This event will greatly affect the Avatar's campaign.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.header.name: Election of Lord Zlor
map.[ab] - avatar:3.header.rumor.1.text: Your teacher is a very wise lich.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.header.rumor.3.text: Beware of the underground inhabitants: they are rebels.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.header.rumor.4.text: Your great-great-grandfather was Lord Zlor too.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.header.rumor.5.text: Only a man can become Lord Zlor.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.header.rumor.6.text: Warlocks and overlords from Nighon may also interfere in the Election of Lord Zlor.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.header.rumor.7.text: This land is about 7000 miles from Antagarich by sea.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.header.rumor.8.text: Have you heard about the great battlefield?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.heroes.153.biography: No one had ever heard of this hero before. And that is bad news for the Election of Lord Zlor. The rebel leader is certain to interfere in it.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.heroes.153.name: Rebel Leader
map.[ab] - avatar:3.heroes.57.biography: Lord Zlor XI. is Qemalisor's eternal enemy. He has no intention of letting him take his hard-won title.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.heroes.57.name: Lord Zlor XI.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.heroes.62.name: Xaxy
map.[ab] - avatar:3.heroes.72.name: Septokora
map.[ab] - avatar:3.heroes.76.biography: Qemalisor is a vampire who wants to become Lord Zlor. And if he won the title, he could hold it for a very, very long time. With the player's hand guiding him, he is certain to succeed.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.heroes.76.name: Qemalisor
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.103.101.0.me: "It is not that we support the current Lord Zlor, but there is something we do not like about you. Are you that necromancer, by any chance? " wonder some creatures the likes of which you have never seen. Once they make up their minds...
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.103.57.0.mes: "We have heard that a necromancer wants to sack this village to get some skeletons for his army. And you look far too much like the necromancer they described!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.106.95.0.mes: "At last someone has paid our ransom. Will you take us into your army?"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.107.52.0.mes: "Who let you into this part of the village? Only professional murderers may enter!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.44.44.0.mess: You see elite marksmen cleaning their crossbows. But when they spot you, they abandon their polishing and charge at you!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.44.50.0.mess: "Anyone who goes to see devils must be a devil himself. And we HATE devils!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.44.85.0.mess: "Come on, then. Let us get this over with!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.49.49.0.mess: You see horses grazing on the local plants. But your army is making a racket, and the horses come running towards you. What could they want?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.51.45.0.mess: "Another vandal who wants to burn us! We shall show him!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.52.40.0.mess: "So you are another worshipper of Satan? We shall show you what we do to people like you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.54.58.0.mess: You hate elves. The moment you saw them, you attacked. And they intend to defend themselves!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.56.49.0.mess: "It is a necromancer! He must have come for his beloved skeletons!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.58.53.0.mess: You hate pegasi. The moment you saw them, you attacked. And they intend to defend themselves!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.60.57.0.mess: "So you just will not leave us alone? We saw how you slaughtered our friends. Now we shall slaughter you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.64.39.0.mess: "What?!? That is the necromancer our commander told us about! Everyone, get him!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.64.49.0.mess: "Another brave soul who wants to visit the bony dragons!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.66.53.0.mess: The birds attack without warning. They were probably guarding their nest.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.69.33.0.mess: "So you want to defeat Lord Zlor XI.? We shall not let you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.71.52.0.mess: "So you want to defeat Lord Zlor XI.? We shall not let you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.74.34.0.mess: "So you want to defeat Lord Zlor XI.? We shall not let you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.77.41.0.mess: "So you want to defeat Lord Zlor XI.? We shall not let you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.82.34.0.mess: "So you want to defeat Lord Zlor XI.? We shall not let you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.84.41.0.mess: "So you want to defeat Lord Zlor XI.? We shall not let you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.84.47.0.mess: "So you want to defeat Lord Zlor XI.? We shall not let you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.88.106.0.mes:
"Do you want to enter our hive or not?" the dragon flies ask.
"Why else would I have come all this way?" you reply.
Your answer angers the dragon flies, and they attack!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.89.103.0.mes: "Ha! It is the other candidate for Lord Zlor!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.monster.98.100.0.mes: "We heard that you need help fighting Lord Zlor."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.0.39.0.complet: So you are one of Lord Zlor's minions after all! Come on in, then.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.0.39.0.firstVi: Only Lord Zlor's most faithful minions may enter here. You must carry their badge to pass.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.0.39.0.nextVis: You will find the badge in the great basin.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.10.107.0.compl: The guard acknowledges that you have reached level 20. Do you wish to pass now?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.10.107.0.first: The lands beyond me are very dangerous. I doubt you would survive there. But I shall let you through if you gain enough experience to reach at least level 20.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.10.107.0.nextV: The local guard will let no one through below level 20.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.102.101.0.comp: "There you are at last. I shall give you a necromancer's delicacy in exchange for them. Agreed?"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.102.101.0.firs: "I have heard of your journey, and perhaps I could help you. Not far from here, dragon flies are holding lizardmen captive. Break into their nest and bring me some."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.102.101.0.next: "Well? Have you not found the nest yet, or are you afraid to go there?"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.104.56.0.compl: "There you are. You found them after all. Do you wish to enter the village?"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.104.56.0.first: "Only peasants are allowed here. If you are one, surely you will have no trouble finding 100 more peasants."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.104.56.0.nextV: No one answers your furious pounding on the gate.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.107.97.0.compl: "Since you have kept your promise, we shall keep ours."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.107.97.0.first: "If you want help, all you have to do is pay. The creatures behind us are obedient."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.107.97.0.nextV: "If you do not bring us the cash, we shall not let you in, and we shall set the guards on you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.27.32.0.comple: To pass or not to pass? That is the question!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.27.32.0.firstV: Our enemy is powerful indeed. You will not be allowed through unless you bring these resources.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.27.32.0.nextVi: You will have to sort out those resources yourself.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.28.88.0.comple: You finally took the hint! Or did you not need a hint?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.28.88.0.firstV: This tower belongs to a powerful wizard. He will let you pass if you bring him the artifact Angel Feather Arrows.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.28.88.0.nextVi: Guess whose wings provided the material for this artifact. And where did the armies of Good and Evil meet?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.29.53.0.comple: "We see that your primary skills are at level 10, as we required. Do you wish to pass now?"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.29.53.0.firstV: "Only a hero with Attack, Defense, Spell Power and Knowledge at level 10 may pass. We have our own reasons for this."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.29.53.0.nextVi: "We see that not all your primary skills are at level 10 yet. Go away."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.45.86.0.comple: Do you wish to enter the ring?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.45.86.0.nextVi: You cannot even afford admission! And you will never get past the burly bouncers!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.49.87.0.comple: Do you wish to enter that old hag's house?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.49.87.0.firstV: Even Baba Yaga's chicken will not scratch for nothing. Pay me 3500 gold, little man, to learn this skill (if you can still learn anything).
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.49.87.0.nextVi: You cannot even afford admission! And you will never get past the burly bouncers!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.50.93.0.comple: Do you wish to enter the ring?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.50.93.0.firstV: Not just anyone may enter this library. Admission: 5000 gold.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.50.93.0.nextVi: You cannot even afford admission! And you will never get past the burly bouncers!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.51.87.0.comple: Do you want to get closer to the artifact?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.51.87.0.firstV: Fight the artifact's guardians. Admission: 5000 gold.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.51.87.0.nextVi: You cannot even afford admission! And you will never get past the burly bouncers!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.51.90.0.comple: Do you wish to visit the old and wise seer?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.51.90.0.firstV: A very wise seer. Admission: 3500 gold.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.51.90.0.nextVi: You cannot even afford admission! And you will never get past the burly bouncers!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.52.92.0.comple: Do you wish to enter the Arena?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.52.92.0.firstV: Arena (improves Attack and Defense). Admission: 4000 gold.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.52.92.0.nextVi: You cannot even afford admission! And you will never get past the burly bouncers!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.52.93.0.comple: Here you can gain the skills to defeat Xaxy. But beware. Everything here costs money!
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.52.93.0.firstV: This is the entrance to the training centre. But first you must reach level 3.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.52.93.0.nextVi: The local guard will let no one through below level 3.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.53.105.0.compl: The guard has already heard that Xaxy is dead, so the threat has passed. Do you wish to pass now?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.53.105.0.first: This guard protects the lands beyond from raids by a criminal named Xaxy. No one may pass until the threat is gone.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.53.105.0.nextV: The guard is still afraid of Xaxy and refuses to open the gate.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.53.89.0.comple: "So you are the vampire thirsting for wisdom whom I have heard so much about?"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.53.89.0.firstV: "When you reach at least level 5, I shall teach you things you have never even dreamed of."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.53.89.0.nextVi: "Ugh! You again? Come back when you reach level 5, as I told you before."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.87.1.0.complet: "So you have completed the task. Do not worry, the skeletons will return to you later..."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.87.1.0.firstVi: "I shall let you pass if you leave me 500 Skeleton Warriors. I need them to carry out a task for me. Once they have finished it, I shall send them after you."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.87.1.0.nextVis: "What is the point of being a necromancer if you cannot raise an army!"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.88.103.0.compl: Reaching the first level was far too easy, was it not? Well, you may pass if you wish.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.88.103.0.first:
You will encounter this sort of guard often on this map.
It is a Quest Guard, who will give you quests. If you return without completing a quest, he may give you a hint. This is a demonstration Quest Guard, so you may pass immediately.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.89.52.0.comple: The guard has no further objections. You may now pass.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.89.52.0.firstV: This guard will not let you pass until you bring him proof that you have killed the murderers in a village.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.89.52.0.nextVi: The thugs are hiding nearby: just a few miles to the east is a village, and their hideout is at its far end.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.93.55.0.comple: "The peasants can now return home. Will you allow them to do so?"
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.93.55.0.firstV: "These peasants are afraid to go home. If you could defeat the crusaders, they could return."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.93.55.0.nextVi: "The peasants are still afraid of the crusaders guarding the entrance to the village."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.96.93.0.comple: The guard acknowledges that you have reached level 10. Do you wish to pass now?
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.96.93.0.firstV: "The lands beyond me are very dangerous. I doubt you would survive there. But I shall let you through if you gain enough experience to reach at least level 10."
map.[ab] - avatar:3.quest.96.93.0.nextVi: The local guard will let no one through below level 10.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.sign.48.88.0.message: This witch will teach you an art that makes the spells you know more effective.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.sign.99.11.0.message: Welcome to the Great Salt Desert.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.town.108.105.0.event: Your teacher has finally hired workers to build a fort. Their work will be finished in a few days.
Those workers are quick: the fort is already finished! You paid them a little extra to put up a few more buildings.
The dark powers have decided that you are the most suitable candidate for Lord Zlor, so they will send you a few little skeletons each week for your needs.
map.[ab] - avatar:3.town.108.105.0.name: Monastery of Evil
map.[ab] - avatar:3.town.4.3.0.name: Zlor's Residence
map.[ab] - avatar:3.town.67.75.0.name: Deganis
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.0.description:
The dragon lords have transported you to this region. Their longtime friend, the Unknown One, has been operating here for some time.
But on his latest mission he was captured by nomads commanded by a hero named the Bandit. You should free the Unknown One. He is also an experienced adventurer and could help you.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.1.description: The dragon lords have also managed to teleport one of your best friends here: Sir Brittish. So after a long time apart, you will meet your old friend again.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.10.description: The first reinforcements from Erathia arrived today. That country has been watching your progress for a long time. The Erathians advised you to destroy all the orange heroes first. Then you could move against your other enemies.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.11.description:
A message has arrived from the mayors of the other desert towns:
"Avatar,	we know that an evil bandit hero named the Bandit is terrorising this territory. Please eliminate him as soon as possible. Although we have secured our towns behind a single gate, it is only a matter of time before he finds its key. His henchmen are very powerful, but we trust you will find a way to protect us. You must protect our towns, even if that means occupying them with your army.
Good luck!
--The mayors of the desert towns"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.12.description: You have been in this region for two months now. You have more or less found your feet and have a fair grasp of this conflict. Your warriors are no pushovers, but true aces. Aces who have already got you out of more than one nasty battle. You are no ordinary general either. Once you complete this task, you will be mightier still. You wonder whether you might eventually ask to be granted noble status.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.13.description: More reinforcements have arrived from Erathia. They are quite pleased with your progress. The local nobles cannot send you any more recruits, but at least you have their trust.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.14.description: Another month of your stay here has passed. Your progress is now plain to see. If this continues, the region will soon lie at your feet. Whoever destroys that infernal hero will become the great sovereign ruler of the infernal lands. And whoever rules those lands will command such monsters that other heroes will lay down their weapons before him.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.15.description: A magical field exploded near your newly acquired castle this morning. Many people were injured, and some even died. You had to pay compensation to their families.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.16.description:
A breathless scout woke you before dawn. Angry at being woken so early, you brushed him off and went to get dressed. Once you had dressed and eaten breakfast, you summoned him.
He told you that the mighty necromancer Quemalisor had arrived from the far south. He became ruler of the necromantic and demonic lands in the south long ago. Now he has learned that an aura of magical energy is gathering in this region. According to his calculations, in a few years the land here will turn into magic plains. Plains that should be the largest in the entire known world.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.17.description: Another messenger came to you. He had learned that Quemalisor had joined the Pilgrim, who wants to conquer this land. You have therefore decided to foil their plans.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.18.description: Today marks a month since the magical field exploded here. You sense that the cause is the concentration of the Pilgrim's evil power. Unless you "voluntarily" cut short his stay here, another magical field may explode. And so it will continue until the magical field consumes everything good in this region. Or until the Pilgrim dies.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.19.description: You sense that the magical field has grown far stronger. This cannot go on. The local inhabitants are terribly afraid and have asked you to do something about it.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.2.description: Sir Brittish has struck up a friendship with a local hero named Baldhead. This hero is quite powerful, so you should regard his alliance as a small gift.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.20.description: It was only a matter of time before the magical field exploded again. But it exploded somewhere entirely different. You do not know where.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.21.description: Today you finally used your magic to discover where the magical field exploded. It was in your mining district. Most of the workers are unconscious, so you immediately sent doctors there. They cannot return to work for three days. You have therefore lost three days' resource production, as well as the resources already mined that the workers had not yet transported to the nearest town.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.22.description: You have received a message from the dragon lords warning you not to discard a single artifact you acquire on your journey. Without some of them, you would be unable to complete your mission.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.3.description: Your scouts have discovered that the Bandit is wreaking havoc nearby (about 70 miles from your new base). You need the Shackles of War to stop him escaping. If you have not found them yet, keep looking.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.4.description: An old legend claims that the Shackles of War can be found in one of the crypts in this desert. Who knows whether it is true.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.5.description:
Your scouts submitted a more detailed report today. It states that:
- Baldhead has no ill intentions towards you
- a heroine named She-Dragon has raised the teal flag against you
- a female overlord from Nighon has also arrived in this land as She-Dragon's ally
- Kostěj and his relative, the Death Knight, fight against you under the purple flag
That is about all their report contains.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.6.description:
Today the scouts have submitted another report, which states:
- the hero Faerie Descendant flies the pink flag together with Prajzlík
- the Lord of Pegasi commands the orange flag, with the hero Rabiah as his subordinate
- nothing is yet known about the red flag
The scouts expect to give you further details in about a week.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.7.description:
The scouts have uncovered the final details:
- Faerie Descendant is the twin brother of your friend Gavon
- purple has allied with pink
- teal has allied with orange
The countries of Antagarich have learned of this conflict and decided that:
- Eeofol will support red
- Erathia will support you
- Bracada will support Baldhead
- AvLee will support the Lord of Pegasi
- Deyja will support Kostěj
- Nighon will support She-Dragon
- AvLee had intended to support Faerie Descendant, but abandoned that decision upon learning that he had made a pact with the necromancers
- Krewlod and Tatalia have distanced themselves from this conflict.
This means the coming struggle will be no ordinary battle: two entire continents will be involved.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.8.description: This time you have learned from your previous battles and stationed strong guards at your resource stores. You need no longer fear raids. But ensuring that security has cost you a great deal of your resources.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.event.9.description: A month has now passed since this mad expedition began. You must kill the Pilgrim, who fights under the red banner. What have you actually accomplished this month? Almost nothing. You must try harder to bring down the enemy as soon as possible.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.106.128.0.mes: A stench of death rises from the depths of the mysterious tomb. It is so overpowering that it completely hypnotises you. As you stare spellbound into the tomb, a group of undead emerges. You watch in horror as these slow, silent monsters attack...
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.11.74.0.messa:
Why have you, who once fought for the ideals of truth and light, suddenly chosen the path of death?
Know that for every creature this path is the last: prepare to meet your maker!
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.112.110.0.mes: Who could have left this wood here?
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.113.76.0.mess: Well, well! These are no longer Firebirds! They have become more like "Rotbirds"!
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.114.114.0.mes: Ewwwwwwww! You want to reach into the pool where that murky water flows?
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.118.121.0.mes: You certainly did not have to work very hard to find such a pile of money.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.125.99.0.mess: You can smell the sharp scent of sawdust and cut timber from afar.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.127.121.0.mes: Once you passed through the gate, the guards told you to be more careful than ever. This is more than just a desert now, and defeating the Bandit is nothing compared with what lies ahead.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.131.126.0.mes: A stench of death rises from the depths of the mysterious tomb. It is so overpowering that it completely hypnotises you. As you stare spellbound into the tomb, a group of undead emerges. You watch in horror as these slow, silent monsters attack...
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.133.112.0.mes: This place does not look very welcoming.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.136.128.0.mes: A stench of death rises from the depths of the mysterious tomb. It is so overpowering that it completely hypnotises you. As you stare spellbound into the tomb, a group of undead emerges. You watch in horror as these slow, silent monsters attack...
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.138.122.0.mes: Opening treasure chests does not pay!
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.138.4.0.messa: When you finally made it beyond the gate, storm elementals materialised out of thin air before your eyes. Ice elementals joined them, taking shape from the frozen mountain peaks.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.140.129.0.mes: The unmistakable sounds of mining come from the mysterious mine. Suddenly you hear a sound that does not belong in an ordinary mine. You go inside to see what is happening. As you enter, a chill runs down your spine. Undead. This sensation comes only when you enter a place where such creatures dwell...
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.141.141.0.mes: You stop admiring the magnificent sword you received for killing the azure dragon. You wave it above your head a few more times, then sheath it with a satisfied smile. You can hardly wait to try it in your first battle.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.142.138.0.mes: You have served the dragon lords well. That is why this dwelling is grander than any you have ever seen (apart from the castles you had built yourself).
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.142.84.0.mess:
You defeated all but one of the firebirds. He told you:
"I am sorry, but my brothers were hostile. They did not know what a kind hero you are. But I knew. I must tell you something. More of our brothers flew near the Training Centre in the north. Go and see what has happened to them."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.15.73.0.messa: You have chosen the path of life. To preserve your own life, you must first overcome the guards of this path!
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.16.76.0.messa: Will you take the path of life or death?
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.25.44.0.messa: A beautiful pendant! Strange... it feels as though you have seen it before!
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.34.30.0.messa: See, searching paid off. You found the remains of an alchemist's workshop.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.57.1.0.messag: A consolation prize. This is not the right island.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.65.6.0.messag: Here is the true fairytale treasure!
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.67.3.0.messag: The treasure is not quite worthy of a fairytale, but at least it is some reward for your efforts.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.guards.87.37.0.messa: Have you really taken a fancy to the possessions of the dead? Shame on you!
map.[ab] - avatar:4.header.description: A diabolical hero is fighting the world's finest adventurers for this region. Unfortunately, these heroes are divided. They have split into several factions. Each faction has a different view of how to finish off the enemy and what to do with this land.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.header.name: The Final Battle
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.100.biography: The Bandit is one of the most feared robbers in the known world. He has pillaged many villages and towns. When he discovered that war had broken out near his position, he made his way there. Wherever there is war, there are excellent opportunities for plunder and smuggling.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.100.name: Bandit
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.133.biography: The Pilgrim was once good, but then he looked across the border between Evil and Good. The forces of evil seemed better and more destructive to him, so he stayed on the side of Evil and rose into the elite ranks of hell's servants.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.133.name: Pilgrim
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.14.biography: The Unknown One is one of this land's many heroes. But few have followed the Avatar's campaign as closely as he has. The Avatar did not even know someone was watching him. When the Unknown One had an opportunity to see the Avatar in action, he seized it at once.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.14.name: Unknown One
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.148.name: Faerie Descendant
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.151.biography: Before Mutare fought her way to the crown of Nighon, she decided to help one of her countrywomen: She-Dragon.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.153.name: She-Dragon
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.23.name: Rabiah
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.28.biography: Prajzlík is one of the few dwarves to become a hero. One day his enemies called him a "pravej hajzlík"—a proper little bastard—and the name stuck for a while. But some warriors could not get his whole name out in the heat of battle, so they shortened it. Now everyone calls him that.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.28.name: Prajzlík
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.31.name: Lord of Pegasi
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.41.biography: Baldhead was once human too. Then he began to show signs of goblinisation. Although he halted the disease with the Centaur's Axe, he never managed to undo its effects.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.41.name: Baldhead
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.65.name: Death Knight
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.74.name: Kostěj
map.[ab] - avatar:4.heroes.76.name: Quemalisor
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.101.23.0.mes: "We have spent many days guarding a fanatical seer who hates the lizard people. He is a danger to those around him, so no one should visit him!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.110.137.0.me: "Only azure dragons may own this gold mine. If we simply let you have it, the azure dragons would kill us anyway. Better a tiny chance of living than a certain chance of death!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.111.126.0.me: "What a lovely hero you are! May we hold you in our arms?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.114.120.0.me: "You may have defeated the Bandit, but you will never survive in these lands!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.115.76.0.mes: "We must avenge our rotting on at least one mortal. And you are offering yourself up!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.116.139.0.me: "We have heard about the war you are fighting. Erathia has chosen you as her favourite. And we are her soldiers. Allow us to join you."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.118.130.0.me: "Surprised that we belong to the Bandit too, are you? Either way, we shall not surrender this mine willingly!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.119.79.0.mes: "Sir! My closest kin flew north to let the wind blow the drops of water from their bodies. But they failed. On the way, they fell exhausted into the water. Only I escaped. Go and see what has happened to them on the other shore. I can no longer see that far. I am very old, and I feel I shall die soon. Give me a merciful death."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.120.140.0.me: "You must be yet another grave robber. Some people say we are stupid. But that does not mean we are stupid enough to let you plunder our ancestors' tomb!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.122.134.0.me: "Perhaps the rust dragons told you that they are the sole masters of the desert. They clearly had no idea that we exist too. They will pay for their mistakes. And so will anyone who might listen to them—or has already listened to their nonsense!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.123.127.0.me: They would not be minotaurs if they passed up a chance to profit from something!
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.124.97.0.mes: "We were told that some fool would try to steal the wood we processed with our own hands. Now we see how wise we were to post such a guard here."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.127.120.0.me: "If you want to see Swan Lake, follow the stream."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.128.31.0.mes: "We heard that you were hired by a seer who wants to get rid of us. That is why our bows are already drawn!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.128.95.0.mes: "Something has happened to our pool! Just a month ago, we were fishing gems out of the whole pool, but then some fireballs flew into it, and it almost stopped producing gems altogether! If you discover which hooligan is responsible, please visit the seer in the straw hut. He will reward you fairly."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.129.88.0.mes: "At last, someone who might help us. A few of my brothers recently fell into a nearby lake. Their flames became damp, so they flew north and have not returned. If you promise that we shall find them together, we could join you."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.130.72.0.mes: "Only the best of the best may enter the new training centre. Our task is to test whether you are one of them."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.131.107.0.me: "Do not trust that old fellow in the shack. He bought the mushroom he lives in from us for a few pennies. We heard that hobgoblins are threatening to take his summer residence, worth 200.000 gold, unless he pays them 300.000. He has only a tenth left to pay. He will surely try to wheedle something out of you."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.132.134.0.me: "Are you loyal to the Bandit or not? Answer!" the trolls bellow. Instead of wasting time on a reply, you attack at once.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.135.139.0.me: You rather like this specimen of firebird. How about having it for breakfast, roasted in its own fire?
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.135.44.0.mes: "Are you the adventurer who wants to kill Kostěj? If so, you will need the key to his castle's main gate. That necromancer has oppressed us here for a long time, so we shall not stop you getting it. But you must not have any weak little worms in your army, or you will become one of the many courses on our varied menu!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.136.117.0.me: "Many heroes have tried to kill us. But we have the advantage in numbers!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.137.143.0.me: "We are waiting here for the Bandit so we can give him these plans of the gate. With them, he and the Pilgrim will be able to conquer the whole world!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.138.113.0.me: "This fortress serves only our master. And that is certainly not you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.138.140.0.me: "Welcome, Avatar! We have been waiting for you for a long time. Will you allow us to join your army?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.143.120.0.me: "Greetings, mortal. Are you ready to end your journey here?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.143.83.0.mes: "At last someone has freed us. We flew here once, but the guards would not let us go home, saying we were not in Erathia's service. Meanwhile, we managed to dry our wings. If we had met our brothers sooner, we could have become phoenixes again. But that guard said no! They said they would let us out when the Avatar arrived. So we were imprisoned because of you. Now we are lesser creatures. And you will pay for that!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.2.73.0.messa: "Our flails are always ready for battle. And you have surely come with impure intentions!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.28.84.0.mess: "No one may enter our training centre! An unauthorised person would gain access to a devastating weapon!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.34.143.0.mes: "Only someone from a people of mighty warriors may enter this cave. They call themselves barbarians. As we can see, you bear none of the ritual markings of the ogre shamans. So you are no barbarian!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.4.142.0.mess: "You will not escape our petrifying gaze!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.46.141.0.mes: "Look out! An enemy! How could he have got past our perfect guard? Whatever the answer, we shall defend our lives!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.53.140.0.mes: "We are the sole masters of the desert. If anyone told you otherwise, it must have been the Bandit, whom we have had our eye on for a long time."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.61.140.0.mes: "This mine belonged to the Conflux of the elements alone. And it shall remain so!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.67.141.0.mes: "Only a true ace can reach this place, not some thief like the Bandit."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.67.4.0.messa: The creatures are coming towards you. And their intentions do not look friendly!
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.71.139.0.mes: "Only a person who follows the true faith—faith in the one God—may enter this library. And you are a heathen. We therefore cannot allow you into the library."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.72.95.0.mess: You see the lizard lords bathing in a nearby pool of lava. What hardy creatures! After a few minutes of bathing, one of them spots you. You have no choice but to run. A few drops of lava still cling to the lizards, and if they attacked now, they could fly straight over you and burn you. Although you ran very fast, the lizards caught up with you! At least the lava is gone from their bodies now.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.76.131.0.mes: "This is the only mine in the area where ore is quarried. We were driven out of the swamps and teleported here. Only a stone house can protect us from the heat of this desert. So listen: you will not take this mine!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.8.86.0.messa: "Line up the sights, take aim just right. Bang! No more breathing after tonight!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.81.135.0.mes: "We are the sole masters of the desert. If anyone told you otherwise, it must have been the Bandit, whom we have had our eye on for a long time."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.84.132.0.mes:
"We are the only swamp species that likes this climate. But sometimes we too must retreat into the cool. That is what we have this mine for. And now a hero has come to lay claim to it.
Who do you think you are?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.84.36.0.mess: "Only the dead may see this shield. And you are not dead! Now you will learn what it is like when corpses grin at you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.86.1.0.messa: "Until recently, you thought you were the best. We shall show you how wrong you were!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.89.38.0.mess: "Do not take the possessions of the dead, or things will go badly for you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.91.140.0.mes: "Did no one tell you that you must ask the owner for his crystal mine?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.monster.95.134.0.mes: "This temple is dedicated to mighty golems. Respect the ancient traditions and do not enter. We shall gladly help you with that."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.1.35.0.complet: "This evening I discovered that the raids have stopped. Accept the reward of a grateful seer."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.1.35.0.firstVi: "Recently, raids from the Dark Forest have begun targeting the inhabitants. You should find out what is happening there."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.1.35.0.nextVis: "People fear for their lives. You really should go and look in that forest."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.100.88.0.compl: "Welcome. So you are one of the heroes of Good?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.100.88.0.first: "That is the only way to prove to me that you support the Avatar."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.100.88.0.nextV: "So you are not with the Avatar? Get out of here!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.102.22.0.compl: "Phew. What a relief. Thanks to you, my family's deaths have been avenged, and I can give you a gift worthy of your help in my hour of need!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.102.22.0.first: "I hate the lizard people. I hate them because one of them killed my family several years ago. Please avenge them. The tribe that killed them lives somewhere in the swamps. Find out where, and kill that tribe of murderous archers!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.102.22.0.nextV: "Have you still not avenged my wife and children? Unless you avenge them at once, the tribe will grow stronger and kill me too!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.108.108.0.comp: "So you want to buy this grand dwelling after all? They say phoenixes live there and breed regularly!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.108.108.0.firs: "We bought this dwelling from a fool. Just bring us 40.000 and it is yours."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.112.76.0.compl: "So you helped the firebird after all?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.112.76.0.first: "Have you done the bird on the other shore a favour?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.112.76.0.nextV: "You really have no right to force your way in here!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.113.134.0.comp: "So those cows have mooed their last? We hope you will also kill the ones whose entrance we are blocking."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.113.134.0.firs: "To enter this cave, you must first kill these cows' more intelligent kin."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.113.134.0.next: "These cows bother us because they give us no milk. They are simply useless. Exterminate this species throughout the desert."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.118.125.0.comp: Defeating the Bandit has opened the way through this gate.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.118.125.0.firs: This guard protects the lands beyond from raids by a criminal named the Bandit, who is helping the Pilgrim destroy this land.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.118.125.0.next: "The Bandit is still roaming this region."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.118.80.0.first: "You must have visited this creature's friends. Bring me at least 10 of them."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.118.80.0.nextV: "So you are giving up after all?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.118.96.0.compl: You wait a while for the mage to bring you the shield you requested. It looks sturdy and beautiful. Will you take it?
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.118.96.0.first: "To reach the Pilgrim, you must kill all the superior kinds of Fortress creatures. Defeating them will earn you artifacts, which you must bring to me. I need them to make a special artifact that will serve you well in battle. Judging by you, however, you will surely also use it to open the gate of the Pilgrim's castle. You must bring me these components: the Emblem of Cognizance, Clover of Fortune, Crest of Valor, Speculum, Spyglass, Statesman's Medal and Badge of Courage."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.118.96.0.nextV: "Unless you defeat those monsters and bring the artifacts, you will never reach the Pilgrim."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.119.73.0.compl: "At last we have some new cadets! Leave them here if you wish to pass."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.119.73.0.first: "This training centre is outdated now. Bring us 100 Halberdiers to raise its standard a little."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.119.73.0.nextV: "We really cannot do without those halberdiers."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.122.84.0.compl: "So you solved those problems after all. Take your reward and go before I change my mind!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.122.84.0.first: "I know about the problems of the faerie dragons and the various birds. Have you solved them?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.122.84.0.nextV: "I am not going to give you a reward for nothing!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.126.39.0.compl: "Now that you have killed Kostěj, I can become human again. Will you grant me my freedom?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.126.39.0.first: "Until Kostěj falls in battle, I shall remain enchanted into this tower, to which no one has a key."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.126.39.0.nextV: "Do you think I will not know when Kostěj is dead?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.133.106.0.comp: The old fellow takes the promised 20.000 and scurries away. As your reward, you find a scroll and a few crumbs of food in his shack. Will you take the scroll, or catch up with the old fellow, give him a beating and take the cash back?
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.133.106.0.firs: "I am very poor and can only afford to live in a mushroom. If you bring me, say, 20.000, I can move away, and everything you find here will be yours alone."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.133.106.0.next: "I can hardly fit into this mushroom any more. I only asked for a contribution of 20.000. No less, no more."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.137.121.0.comp: "So you killed them? See, it could be done. At last I can give you this reward. Will you accept it?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.137.121.0.firs: "Dragon flies terrorised this entire region for a long time. Then I managed to herd them into a small valley north of here. Destroying them was beyond my strength. If you defeat them, I shall reward you."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.137.121.0.next: "I already told you I cannot handle it alone. You must hurry, or they will multiply and I shall no longer be able to keep them there."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.14.133.0.compl: "Now that you have defeated the Greater Basilisks, accepting this reward should be no trouble at all."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.14.133.0.first: "Perhaps you have completed my relatives' quests. For a change, I want you to defeat the Greater Basilisks southwest of here."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.14.133.0.nextV: "Did I not ask you to do something? Have you done it?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.141.85.0.compl: "I see that you are one of those fighting for Erathia's cause. Go on, then!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.141.85.0.first: "That is the only way to prove that you are with the Avatar."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.141.85.0.nextV: "Only the Avatar's supporters may enter here."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.34.142.0.compl: "See, you are capable of doing as you are asked. You may pass."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.34.142.0.first: "We cannot let you through unless you bring us Faerie Descendant's head."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.34.142.0.nextV: "We really cannot do without that head."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.59.3.0.complet: You have fulfilled the condition of the prophecy. Do you wish to enter the interior of this island?
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.59.3.0.firstVi: Whoever reaches level 37 shall find fairytale treasures on this island.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.59.3.0.nextVis: An ancient prophecy cannot be fooled.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.62.1.0.complet: "Wonderful! You defeated them! Glory to you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.62.1.0.firstVi: "No one has ever managed to defeat the Chaos Hydras on the other island. If you are such a fine hero and defeat them, a... reward awaits you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.62.1.0.nextVis: "I told you. Neither you nor anyone else can defeat those hydras."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.64.6.0.complet: You have fulfilled the condition of the prophecy. Do you wish to enter the interior of this island?
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.64.6.0.firstVi: Whoever reaches level 37 shall find fairytale treasures on this island.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.64.6.0.nextVis: An ancient prophecy cannot be fooled.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.68.140.0.compl: "So you do come from the Avatar after all. Here is the promised reward."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.68.140.0.first: "I shall give my reward only to the Avatar or his supporters. Please bring me 10 Enchanters to prove you are one of them."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.68.140.0.nextV: "You are no follower of the Avatar. Ugh! Get out!"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.75.76.0.comple: "At last, after thirty long years, I shall fly on my broomstick again. Before I leave, I would like to give you this reward."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.75.76.0.firstV: There is only one group of lizards in the entire lava region. If you defeated them, the skies would be clear, and I could fly on my broomstick again."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.75.76.0.nextVi: "You really are thick. Do you need me to repeat it?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.81.82.0.comple: The magical lock has finally opened. Do you wish to enter?
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.81.82.0.firstV: "Only one wizard ever made an artifact that fitted the gate of the Pilgrim's castle. But the Pilgrim never paid him for it, so the mage grew angry and left. He threatened to give a copy of the artifact to the greatest hero of Good one day. You need only find that mage and persuade him to give you the artifact."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.81.82.0.nextVi: You try dropping one of your possessions into the opening, but it does not fit.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.84.44.0.comple:
"So you have brought me those 500 warriors I asked for? Perhaps I shall change my mind after all," says the seer.
You wait here for about 10 hours. He changes his mind.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.84.44.0.firstV: "If you bring me, say, 500 Battle Dwarves, perhaps I shall change my mind and let you through."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.84.44.0.nextVi: "I have not changed my mind yet."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.95.129.0.compl: "At last I can no longer hear that idiotic mooing. Will you accept this reward?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.95.129.0.first: "I have a tempting offer for you. Defeat the gorgons that have settled among the desert mountains and, together with the dragons and phoenixes, turned this grassy land into a desert. Then return here."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.95.129.0.nextV: "Unfortunately, you have not proved anything to me yet."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.95.45.0.comple: "You may enter now. But beware: do not rob the graves of the dead, or you will face the consequences."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.95.45.0.firstV: "Entry to the realm of the dead must be paid for in gold."
map.[ab] - avatar:4.quest.95.45.0.nextVi: "You must be planning to cause trouble here if you cannot afford admission, must you not?"
map.[ab] - avatar:4.sign.128.72.0.messag:
The new training centre is ->->->->->
The old training centre is <-<-<-<-<-
map.[ab] - avatar:4.sign.133.70.0.messag: Welcome to the new training centre, where everyone is better off than at the old one.
map.[ab] - avatar:4.sign.3.78.0.message: Warning! You are entering the Dark Forest.
