map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.2.57.0.messag: Now let us go and deal with Modain!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.21.32.0.messa: At last you can open the way to Modain. Who knows what lies beyond this gate...
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.3.58.0.messag: That gate must lead to Modain's residence, since some of his finest guards are watching it.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.38.53.0.messa: You take hold of the sword lying in the goblins' treasury. How could those loathsome goblins have got their hands on it?
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.46.67.0.messa: Some gremlins emerge from the nearby training centre. They even wear blue cloaks as a sign of their initiation. When they see their kin lying dead, they attack you!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.47.68.0.messa: The gremlins were right when they said they would turn into skeletons. They are already attacking you from behind!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.52.38.0.messa: "You are entering the land of monoliths," declares a notice on a nearby tree.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.57.70.0.messa: You can hear the faeries chattering from afar. What gossips they are!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.58.47.0.messa:
So this is the famous university of magic. You feel a field of magical energy surrounding you. There is much you can learn from the mages.
But what is this?? You see monsters outside the university. They must have slain the genies who helped the mages. You must get rid of these infernal creatures!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.62.68.0.messa:
More and more scholars from the University of Magic rush to defend the book. If you want it, you will have to fight for it.
Will you try?
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.63.65.0.messa: The chief mages of this land apparently live here. They guard precious relics: spellbooks. Some of the spells in these books may be very powerful indeed...
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.63.68.0.messa:
More and more scholars from the University of Magic rush to defend the book. If you want it, you will have to fight for it.
Will you try?
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.64.68.0.messa:
More and more scholars from the University of Magic rush to defend the book. If you want it, you will have to fight for it.
Will you try?
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.69.69.0.messa:
A strangely shaped box. Could it be one of the Pandora's Boxes that were so common in your homeland?
And will you trust the genie?
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.71.1.0.messag: You have overcome all the perils of Hell and the Underworld and freed Sir Brittish. Beyond his prison lies a key which, according to your scouts, should open the way to Modain himself.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.guards.71.60.0.messa: Even so, a band of rebellious workers has refused to follow you on your mission. Instead, they stole some of your construction timber. You should remind them that following you is better than defying you.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.header.description: The Avatar and Sir Brittish can reach level 23 here. Their skills, experience, spells and the artifacts Blackshard of the Dead Knight and Vial of Dragon Blood (if acquired in the previous scenario) will carry over to the next scenario.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.header.name: Meeting Modain
map.[ab] - avatar:5.heroes.51.name: Modain
map.[ab] - avatar:5.heroes.6.biography: Sir Brittish, the firstborn son of King Británec, was abducted just before his coronation. Although tournaments had trained him in certain combat skills, he could not escape. So he waited for someone to free him. And someone did.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.heroes.6.name: Sir Brittish
map.[ab] - avatar:5.heroes.74.name: Necromancer
map.[ab] - avatar:5.heroes.91.name: One-Eye
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.1.70.0.messa: You see a large family of imps. They stand here trembling and do not look remotely eager for battle.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.19.58.0.mess: "We want peace! You will not steal anything from us! That clatter of your mates' weapons is dreadful!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.19.70.0.mess: These dwarves do not like manticores. That is why they are here at this hatchery. Whenever a new one is born, they kill it immediately. And they may kill you too!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.2.56.0.messa: "Where do you think you are going, you wretched earthbound worm?"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.20.4.0.messa: "So you want to defeat Modain and our master, the Necromancer!!! You will never defeat them while we stand here!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.21.33.0.mess: That previous guard was only the first round!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.22.65.0.mess: "Could we find decent, well-paid employment in your army?"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.25.61.0.mess: A goblin says to a hobgoblin, "Someone is coming!" The hobgoblin replies, "Run for it!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.29.40.0.mess: "We shall never surrender our loot to you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.3.40.0.messa: "Easy, easy now. Or you will get a ball over the head!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.32.66.0.mess: "If that is where you want to go, let us help you get there!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.38.54.0.mess: "A-a-are you l-l-laughing at usss? Y-y-you shall know our wrath!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.4.66.0.messa: This hired guard knows only one means of communication: combat!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.47.47.0.mess: "So you would not leave us alone even if we begged on our knees? Then we have no choice but to fight you!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.47.57.0.mess: The gnolls sing: "Heigh-ho, heigh-ho, why march away to war? Better to sit in the pub and get drunk." It does not rhyme at all, but the gnolls clearly do not mind. All that matters is bellowing at the tops of their lungs.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.47.66.0.mess: "Unfortunately, we cannot give you this spell, or we shall turn into skeletons. What!?! You still want it? There is nothing for it: we must fight you."
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.52.58.0.mess: Gnolls approach from the nearby pub. You can see at a glance how drunk they are. Clearly, they intend to fight.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.55.52.0.mess: For two days, a mad alchemist has been turning stone into iron plates here. But this released a tremendous amount of energy, and the plates assembled themselves into golems. And guess what they did when they saw you!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.58.64.0.mess: "So you will not leave us alone, you {m a n i a c} !!!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.59.70.0.mess: "We gossip and gossip, and perhaps we shall tear you to pieces too!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.6.59.0.messa: "You have finally arrived. Please follow me. I am to escort you to my master's hut."
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.60.4.0.messa: "Hail the Necromancer! Hey, you in particular cannot pass here! Intruder! Attack!!!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.60.6.0.messa: "Do not come here! You will end up in hellfire!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.61.4.0.messa: "Hail Modain! Hey, you in particular cannot pass here! Intruder! Attack!!!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.61.46.0.mess: "You must be new here. Come with us, then. We shall show you around."
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.62.3.0.messa: "Hail Modain! Hey, you in particular cannot pass here! Intruder! Attack!!!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.62.41.0.mess: The guardians of this obelisk are... goblins!!!! You almost laugh yourself to death. And while you roll on the ground laughing, they attack!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.63.3.0.messa: "Hail the Necromancer! Hey, you in particular cannot pass here! Intruder! Attack!!!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.63.62.0.mess: These zombies seem to be a demonstration of necromantic strength. If this is how strong necromancers are, you will soon bury them back in their graves.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.63.67.0.mess:
"So you think we shall give you our mightiest relics?????
Prepare for a thorough beating instead!!!!!!!!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.64.2.0.messa: "Hail Modain! Hey, you in particular cannot pass here! Intruder! Attack!!!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.64.3.0.messa: "Aah, at last we shall drink blood!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.65.2.0.messa: "We were once servants of Lantal, a hero from the swamps. Then you came and killed us. Now we shall return the favour!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.66.2.0.messa: "Hail Modain! Hey, you in particular cannot pass here! Intruder! Attack!!!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.66.52.0.mess: The peasants in this land are well disposed towards you.

map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.68.46.0.mess: One thing the Avatar dislikes is his enemies picking their noses.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.69.3.0.messa: Dragon ghosts are hardly your favourite creatures. You quickly draw your sword and attack!
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.69.60.0.mess: The peasants in this land are well disposed towards you.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.69.67.0.mess: "Please listen, my lord. Our university of magic was recently attacked by infernal monsters. Please liberate it. There should be something in Pandora's Box that might help you."
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.7.1.0.messag: "Our lunch has arrived just in time!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.7.68.0.messa: "So you mean to rob us of the Conflux's wealth?! We do not like that one bit!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.70.3.0.messa: "So you are the Avatar? Well, we imagined you rather differently..."
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.70.31.0.mess: "Please free our brothers. They will gladly join you. And please leave us alone. We attack only the very weak. We have to eat something, after all."
map.[ab] - avatar:5.monster.8.64.0.messa: "We did not gather this wealth for you. So hands off!"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.quest.7.58.0.complet: "Thank you, thank you, thank you. Will you make the exchange, please?"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.quest.7.58.0.firstVi: "I need 15 Mages and 20 Arch Mages. You see, I am founding a new university of magic. Bring them to me and you will receive a reward, understood?"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.quest.7.58.0.nextVis: "Please hurry. I need to establish the university as soon as possible."

map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.event.0: You originally entered this region from the west, but bad weather and the vast necromantic armies forced you to change direction and eventually settle in this castle. Then the necromancers attacked you...
map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.event.1: ...and you defeated them at great cost. Only a few loyal followers remain in your army.
Damn it! Some supplies have vanished again!
Your subjects are pleased with your management of the town, so they have built you a structure for free as a token of thanks.
You have agreed with your scouts to pay them for each report they deliver rather than give them regular wages.

At dawn today, 12 messengers arrived at your main castle to bring you and your companion sad news. The chief abbot of the monastery of the god of harvest died a few days ago. Chaos has broken out in the monastery, and it is in danger of falling under the control of dark forces.
You immediately called a council of war, and after long hours reached this decision: your friend the High Priest will return to the monastery to restore order. But first he will help you complete your difficult task in this region. You plan to free Sir Brittish, who could take his place. The messengers have decided to stay so they can accompany the High Priest on his return journey.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.event.2:
One morning a breathless messenger brought you a letter from the king. It reads:
"Avatar,
the situation is grave. Today this country's entire army, including over 50 titans, was defeated. Defeating this army was not enough for the enemy: he was brazen enough to imprison my son, Sir Brittish. I therefore beg you to free him. Modain, who commands the enemy forces, demands a ransom of 5.000.000 in gold, or he will sacrifice him to a dark deity. Since our entire country does not possess that much gold, his demand is impossible to meet. Free my son and defeat that wretched worm. Only then will you cleanse this land of infernal monsters. After that, you will easily deal with the undead.
-- Británec, King of Sossaria"
map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.event.3: But the dark mage Modain has made it known that unless you surrender to him, you will experience hell on earth.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.event.4: The dark mage would not listen and has sent saboteurs. You deduce this from the disappearance of some of your emergency supplies from the storehouse.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.event.5: It is strange that you have not heard from your scouts in a long time. What if something has happened to them?
map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.event.6: Your scouts have discovered that Modain has built an unprecedented altar to the gods of hell in his town. You know from a legend that wherever this altar appears, one species of creature multiplies uncontrollably.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.event.7: The scouts have found the Necromancer's residence. It lies northwest of your castle. There is also a Two-Way Monolith nearby.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.event.8: Your scouts have discovered that beyond Sir Brittish's prison is a key that should unlock the way to Modain's castle.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.event.9: The local inhabitants have offered you their services.
map.[ab] - avatar:5.town.60.56.0.name: Snowy Hall

map.[ab] - avatar:7.event.0.description:
The prince arrived just as you did. In his hunting clothes, he stood before you and the other hunters and gave a short speech:
"I see you are ready. I hereby declare the great hunt open, and I hope it will be remembered for a long time. Whoever ravages my forest most thoroughly... will win this trophy!" Suddenly you look more closely and see the prince raise a magnificent sword: the Sword of Doom! "Onward, then! The hunt ends when someone brings the grand prize: the hide of the azure dragon we have come here for!"
map.[ab] - avatar:7.event.1.description: You have learned something interesting. This region is very peculiar, and strange things happen here. You should therefore not believe everything you see or hear. Moreover, kleptomaniacs are running wild throughout the land, springing up like mushrooms after rain. Watch out for them!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.1.62.1.messag: An unfamiliar voice whispers to you: " Come. Come. Come! COME! You cannot escape your destiny anyway. I know that you lost all your spells because of the dark mage. So I shall teach you some. Do not ask why. It is fate's will. I was once a powerful wizard, killed by the lord of the azure dragons in an uneven battle. Many innocent creatures fell in that battle. But my spirit found no peace after death. Fate decreed that I could be freed only by teaching my spells to someone who had lost their own. That must be why you are here. Absorb the art of these spells, then. Come, let us sit in the shade beneath that tree, and I shall teach you something!"
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.1.71.0.messag: Where have you ended up? You must be in another world! This cannot be! You must get out of here as quickly as possible!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.12.13.1.messa: You were right. It was just another convincing illusion.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.12.17.1.messa: Damn! This looks like another apparition! You seem to see the HEADHEWER again! And you thought you had killed him!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.12.18.0.messa: The kleptomaniacs have struck again. You did not even notice when they cut off your fattest purse.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.12.23.1.messa: Ah. It was only an illusion.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.12.67.1.messa: At last you will deal with that azure dragon. Apparently none of the other hunters has made it here yet. You will be the one to win the grand prize.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.13.39.1.messa: The monks speak to you again: "The time has come for the final confrontation. Pass through this underground and kill the Lord of Tyr. There is a tent beyond him. In the desert there is a gate through which you can return home and complete your task. Good luck!"
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.13.65.0.messa: What might this box contain? Who put it here? Was it the villagers or the local thieves? You would love to know the answers to all these questions. But now one important question arises.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.14.27.1.messa: This cannot be! It must be a nightmare! Akár Bloodcloak is still alive!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.16.71.0.messa: You can already hear those would-be thieves shouting from here. You draw your sword before approaching them. And just as you do, the kleptomaniacs emerge from the bushes!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.17.71.0.messa: Damn it! Even though you defeated the kleptomaniacs, they still managed to steal some gold from your purse.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.19.61.1.messa: Back at last! The azure dragon hunt can begin in earnest!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.2.71.0.messag: "Oh, and one more thing," Kluba remembers. "We have no mines here, unless you count the two sawmills on this island as mines. I only mention it because you look like some sort of hero. We need someone like you in Půtka."
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.20.4.0.messag: You see a knight in the distance. He stands about three metres tall, and his black armour is covered with sharp spikes. And his sword is a marvel worthy of very few warriors!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.20.7.0.messag:
The wind carries human speech to you from afar. You listen for a moment and hear:

I am like a god and serve death. What lives now, I have not killed yet.
All are dead; those who live shall be dead.

I am hell, forever burning; to kill them is my constant yearning.
Everyone calls me Horror—my name is Horror.

I, the knight Horror, fulfil this bloodthirsty task.
I shall destroy all the devil's seed, cut them down like slender reeds.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.21.12.1.messa: Damn... This hero is no illusion!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.21.9.1.messag: Look, more signs. This will be another illusion.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.22.52.0.messa: So you defeated those vile thieves. Or did someone call them bandits? What matters is that as you approached the sawmill, two tall kleptomaniacs attacked you!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.25.50.0.messa: Suddenly you spot movement behind a large tree ahead. What is happening there? Surely more kleptomaniacs cannot be hiding there!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.28.9.1.messag: Here the Headhewer is torturing monks, quite sadistically! Stinking entrails lie all around, along with monks who are not dead yet.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.3.55.0.messag: Damn it! Even though you defeated the kleptomaniacs, they still managed to steal some gold from your purse.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.30.14.1.messa: You see that to the south, the passage abruptly ends at a gate with a black barrier that you cannot open.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.35.27.1.messa: Two tall crags stand before you like warning fingers. It seems you are approaching somewhere interesting. Or perhaps not...
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.37.65.0.messa: Zombies crawl out of the mud beside the road and attack!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.38.54.1.messa: Phew! At last the undead attacks have stopped. Once again, you have learned firsthand that artifacts are well guarded.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.38.55.1.messa: More and more undead join the attack of their fallen comrades!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.38.56.1.messa: More and more undead join the attack of their fallen comrades!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.38.57.1.messa: More and more undead join the attack of their fallen comrades!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.4.29.0.messag: Bulls that love fire and breathe it roam these deserts. These bulls are called... bulls of Hell. A herd of them is roaming over there now. And it looks aggressive.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.4.56.0.messag: As you approach a seer's hut, you hear branches cracking around you. Suddenly, swarms of kleptomaniacs surround you!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.40.28.1.messa: You have just found the Headhewer's private harem! Several blank-eyed pixies and faeries stand around, chattering foolishly.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.40.59.1.messa: More and more undead join the attack of their fallen comrades!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.42.24.1.messa: You head north as the pixie instructed. There is indeed a surprise waiting for you. Unfortunately, it is not the one you expected! It is a trap, and revenge for slaughtering the faeries and pixies. You happen to step on a stone, and suddenly the Headhewer rushes at you from a secret hiding place! He has even summoned firebirds to help him! Sadly, your journey ends here.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.42.59.1.messa: Your fears grow with every step, and suddenly you feel the chill of the undead ahead...
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.43.59.1.messa:
The cave walls depict various battles. Several pictures catch your eye, showing the same moment through different eyes. One portrays endless ranks of unfamiliar people, all the flesh falling away from their legs. The next shows swarms of skeletons running in confusion across a red plain, attacking one another. Only one picture stands apart from the rest. A detail in it shows a cruel, bony skull with glowing red eyes. The skull wears a chilling smile and a precious crown upon its head.
You suspect whose portrait you are examining, and the worst fears fill your heart...
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.45.55.1.messa: Fortunately for you, this cave contains nothing except an obelisk.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.46.23.1.messa:
Have you forgotten the rampaging kleptomaniacs again?
Now comes a battle you will not soon forget!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.46.56.1.messa: A strange door bars your way into the small cave, with red-hot eyes shining brightly upon it. To pass through, you had to press those eyes with your BARE hand (how disgusting).
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.46.61.0.messa: When you stop to water your horses, skeletons attack you!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.46.63.1.messa: Look what the vampires left behind in their lair!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.53.3.1.messag: At last you have reached the legendary Headhewer's lair. You see the passage split in two ahead. You hesitate over which way to go. Then you decide to count your warriors: if their number is odd, you will take the right passage. Otherwise, you will go left.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.53.5.1.messag: You have barely taken a few steps when the long-dead monks appear again and speak in one voice: "If you manage to kill the Headhewer, the hero who lives here, we can promise you only one thing. We shall be free again, able to peer into mysteries that would surely remain hidden from you, and we shall help you with all our strength. But we can give you no guarantee. You have no choice but to trust us. Once you kill the Headhewer, we shall appear to you one more time..." With these words the monks dissolve, and a fading voice whispers: "...The Headhewer carries the Orb of Driving Rain. You must obtain it at any cost..."
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.58.50.1.messa:
Bats hidden on the ceiling attack you, and wisps of something white that resembles souls pour out of the walls.
More and more appear, and they are all attacking you!

map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.59.20.1.messa: The Headhewer's entire army rushes towards you. A behemoth tries to swipe at you with its paw, but an unknown magical force slows it down. What a miracle that the Headhewer's army is magically bound to one place.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.60.68.0.messa: As you travelled through this region, bats flew at you from a nearby cave. You thought they were merely setting out to hunt insects. But these were no ordinary bats. They are notorious blood drinkers!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.61.20.1.messa: You spot a garrison full of rebels. They seem to be gathering their forces here to attack the Headhewer. A powerful spell surrounds the entire garrison, absorbing all magical energy from spells. You might defeat the rebels, but only at the cost of needless losses. How about looking for a back entrance? The Headhewer's castle must be supplied somehow. And supply detachments surely do not travel this way.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.62.60.1.messa:
You can already smell the undead from here. The urge to get out grows ever stronger.
{Heeelp!!!!!!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.63.27.0.messa: A strange stone forest fills the entire broad space before you. A forest of statues. Statues of every shape stand here like trees in an ancient wood. Statues of warriors and fantastic flying beasts. And that statue over there—did it really move?
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.67.25.1.messa: More and more souls appear, and now wraiths have joined them!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.67.27.1.messa: More and more souls appear, and now wraiths have joined them!

map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.69.31.1.messa: Several souls of Akár's victims are already flying towards you.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.69.70.0.messa: An unpleasant breeze of decay wafts up from underground. You have no doubt that undead live down there.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.7.55.0.messag: This is the only obelisk on this continent. The villagers' reports make it clear that there are more on the other continents. They say this land's obelisks lead to the legendary Grail. Not every land contains a Grail. Not every land allows you to build a Grail structure. But this is one of the better lands. You must find the Grail and build its shrine in Půtka!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.70.25.1.messa: More and more souls appear, and now wraiths have joined them!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.71.24.1.messa: You found this strange armour beside one of the skeletons. One of your soldiers says it is sacred armour of great value.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.71.30.1.messa: More and more souls appear, and now wraiths have joined them!
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.71.54.1.messa: At the end of this path lies the Tome of Fire (necromancers usually call it the Book of Blood). Every step towards it could kill you! Each step is accompanied by an excerpt from the Book of Blood (always three words per step).
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.71.56.1.messa: The most precious fluid in the ...
map.[ab] - avatar:7.guards.9.69.1.messag: That rebellious azure dragon should be hiding here in this castle! Your experience with similar villains tells you he will certainly not be alone; he has surely summoned helpers.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.header.description: A prince you know has invited you to a hunt. Of course, you did not take much persuading. You will find out how it all turned out once you embark on this adventure.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.header.name: A Visit to Tyr
map.[ab] - avatar:7.header.rumor.0.text: "Hello, my name is Trahom. Be careful. A disease called kleptomania is very common in this region."
map.[ab] - avatar:7.heroes.102.biography: The Headhewer comes from distant shadows. Nothing is known of his origins. But it is known that he is the only one of his kind.

map.[ab] - avatar:7.heroes.88.biography: The Lord of Tyr is a powerful priest-mage-warlock who was never human. His malice is almost beyond belief. He is responsible for laying waste to entire worlds; countless wars have been fought in his name, and the rivers of his victims' blood could drown this entire region.

map.[ab] - avatar:7.quest.7.43.0.complet:
You approach the tower and pound on the doors. A little hatch opens, and a wrinkled old man peers out. "Well? Have you found the knight Horror?"
"Of course, sir."
"And the knight? Has he completed the task I gave him?"
You reach into your bag, pull out the Necklace of Swiftness and hand it to the old man. His little eyes light up, and with a speed you would never expect from someone so old, he snatches the necklace from your hands.
"At last I have what I was looking for!"
At that moment there is a flash and a deafening crash, and the tower sinks into the ground.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.quest.7.43.0.firstVi: "If you wish to proceed, you must find the knight Horror. I once charged him with obtaining a rare necklace for me. But time passes, and the knight still has not returned. Please find him and bring him to me."
map.[ab] - avatar:7.quest.7.43.0.nextVis: "Have you still not managed to find the knight Horror? I am sorry, but until he gives me what I sent him for, I cannot let you through."

map.[ab] - avatar:7.town.15.62.0.event.0: You recently arrived in Půtka. The locals are friendly towards you but know nothing about the azure dragon. You will have to search the surroundings and ask the travellers here.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.town.15.62.0.event.1: Today is an unusual day. Several inhabitants of Půtka want to join your army. You agreed, for soldiers are desperately scarce. They are not very experienced, and you can form only weaker detachments from them, but something is better than nothing.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.town.15.62.0.event.2: Quite recently you learned of the thieves' guild's activities on this continent. The guild even has a base here, quite close to Tyr Fortress. You will have to infiltrate it.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.town.15.62.0.event.3: Thanks to your presence, this village is growing wealthy. Since you drove out several thieves, trade has flourished. Profits far exceed expenses, so the mayor decided to ask the king for permission to raise the village to the status of a small town. After hours of discussion, the king agreed.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.town.15.62.0.event.4: Thanks to your presence, this small town is growing wealthy. Since you drove out several thieves, trade has flourished. They have even begun growing precious spices here. Profits far exceed expenses, so the mayor decided to ask the king for permission to raise the small town to the status of a city. After hours of discussion, the king agreed.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.town.15.62.0.event.5: Today is a glorious day. This city continues to flourish, new residents have moved here, and it has all manner of amenities. When the king saw what had happened to the city in just a few weeks, he decided to make it his royal seat and raise it to the status of capital. The inhabitants are very happy, so some have joined your army again. The king has even given you a small reward.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.town.15.62.0.event.6: The grateful inhabitants of Půtka see that you are a true hero, so they have decided to fortify their town and build a stronghold in it.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.town.15.62.0.event.7: Word has reached you that the main quarry, the azure dragon, has summoned reinforcements. He surely senses that his days are numbered.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.town.15.62.0.event.8: A caravan of travellers stopped in Půtka today. They told you that on their journey they had seen a group of monstrous dragons disappearing through an underground gate. You realised they must have been more reinforcements for the azure dragon. That scoundrel will surely defend himself by every means possible.
map.[ab] - avatar:7.town.15.62.0.name: Půtka

Pardal must be nearby: you seem to have found his famous mushroom patch, and you promptly gobble a few. Hmm, an excellent experience.
"Where are you off to, young man?" asks an old man smoking a hookah by the road. "Many brave souls have tried to claim the treasures in this castle, but none has come out alive, for mighty {DRAGONS} live there!"
"Crazy old man, he has no idea who he is dealing with," you think, toss a small coin into his hat and prepare to move on. But the old man says: "For that coin, I shall conjure up a little luck for you, you {madcap}," then mutters a few words and returns to his smoking.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.guards.2.11.0: “Halt, wretched mortal! So you fancy visiting the library? We shall show you a better way—straight to hell!”
So this is the old junk that lunatic was hiding here! It is fit only for scrap.
You meet a drunken beggar... Wait, it is Antiperla! He has run out of beer money again, so you lend him enough for at least one.
You have found powerful helpers: elementals. Your army's spirits rise at once.
Kossut was so stunned by your victory that he did not even manage to flee. You grabbed him by the throat, took his scroll and left his fate to the little monsters in your army.
You were already looking forward to subduing Kossut, the diggers' boss, and taking control of the mine, when he suddenly pulled a scroll from his pocket, muttered a few words in Japanese, and stone giants came charging at you. If you survive, be sure to lynch Kossut and take that damned scroll.
The moment you entered this place, you sensed something was wrong. Just as you were about to pick up the artifact, your fears were confirmed. Suddenly, hordes of skeletons began clawing out of the ground all around you. Will you grind their bones to dust, or run away as usual?
As you passed the warriors' dwellings, several decided to join you rather than fight endlessly in the arena.
So much gold lying around... Oh no! Those pesky dwarves again!
Gold! Lovely coins! Unfortunately, they belong to dwarves who will not give them up so easily.
Are you brave enough to open Pandora's Box?
Magic is so abundant in these parts that almost any lamp might be enchanted, and one of your warriors has found just such a lamp. Its former owner must have been an evil man, however, for the genies you summoned look anything but friendly.
As you ride through the forest, several stray beholders suddenly open fire on you. Teach them how to treat visitors.
At last, you have found a deposit of much-needed sulfur.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.header.descri: Ever since Pardal the Great began his reign, no one has doubted his superhuman strength and power. Those who so much as tried to defy Pardal's will ended up serving in his army as skeletons or zombies. And you, Bobula, will be no exception!
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.header.name: BoBula's Doom
They say Pancava is the finest tavern for miles around.
You will never find the Holy Grail.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.heroes.74.bio: Pardal the Great, also known as the Invincible
"Who dares disturb us?!" thundered the dragons, immediately swooping down upon you.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.22.21: At first, the minotaurs wanted to destroy you, as is their custom. But when they saw minotaurs in your own army, they changed their minds and offered their services.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.39.67: Pardal has also summoned a few imps to watch over his disobedient sister.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.52.61: Apparently an alchemist lives nearby and experiments with golems. A few of his failures have settled in this particularly inconvenient spot.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.57.47: What riches might these runts be guarding?
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.59.56: The elves living in this forest dislike visitors, and they especially hate dimwits like you. They attack without warning.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.59.70: An old legend says that a powerful artifact gives these thundering birds of prey their strength. It is time to find out how much truth there is in it.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.60.50: Dwarves are renowned for their love of gold. They must be hiding some nearby.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.64.28: No one has ever left the Valley of the {Stone-Eaters} alive. And you will be no exception!
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.64.43: You have caught the local band of thieves fleeing with their stolen goods. Will you steal the stolen goods from the thieves?
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.65.62: A band of drunken orcs hurls filthy insults at you and makes fun of you. Surely you will not let them get away with that...
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.66.45: As usual, the dragons have found a little treasure and are guarding it carefully.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.68.33: The local woodcutter must be quite a miser: he thought nothing of paying Čáryfuk to enchant several trees into dendroids.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.70.46: No one knows where these ancient beasts came from. Perhaps they survived for centuries in the nearby mountain caves.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.70.49: A few diamonds have somehow grown heads (then torsos, two arms, two legs, two balls, a cock... ahem), and now they are ready to show you why they are called the hardest mineral.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.monster.70.56: The griffins have taken such a liking to this spring that they are unlikely to give it up easily.
map.[ab] - bobulova zhouba.quest.21.15.0: You call triumphantly to the mage. He pokes his head out and says, "Celestial Necklace of Bliss! Well, you certainly have courage. You may go and look around by the sea, but mind you don't trample my flowers!"

You pound on the gate, and a very old mage peers out of a little window. "Greetings, foolish Bobula. So you think you can destroy the almighty Pardal? Well, I wouldn't wager much on you, but since it's you, I'll help. It won't be free, though. Bring me the Celestial Necklace of Bliss, which I have sought in vain for years, and I will let you through to the sea. Keep your eyes open, and you will find a little something that should prove very useful to you."
You knock on the gate, but there is no reasoning with the old fellow: "Don't come back here without the Celestial Necklace of Bliss!"
West - Library
North - Valley of Snobs
South - Krakonoš's Domain
The remains of the old bridge, destroyed by Bedřich the Great during his unsuccessful campaign against Pardal.
Pardal the Great realised that you were trying to build a mighty army and sent several thieves into your castle. They broke into your treasury and stole 5000 gold pieces and some resources.
Word reaches you that Pardal became furious with his sister and had her imprisoned somewhere underground. They say she has a powerful artifact which she might lend to her rescuer for a while.
Pardal the Great invited the alchemist {Kuba} out for a few beers. Kuba let himself be swayed and promised to help dispose of you.
{Little Bedřich} sends his regards and wishes you luck. He has also sent a few beholders to lend a hand.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.event.0.descrip: You have been entrusted with supplying materials for the restoration of the Temple of Light. While others gather wood and stone, your task is to deliver 165 piles of gems in time to build the sanctuary's dome. Without these stones, the building's magical power cannot be restored. The caravan must therefore set out within three weeks!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.event.1.descrip: Another day gone. Remember, you have little time!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.event.2.descrip:
How can you get a caravan to leave here for the Temple of Light within three weeks?
It seems a superhuman task... But there must be a way! You can do it!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.event.3.descrip:
This is the final day...
Lord Michael's soul will be lost forever because of you...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.event.4.descrip:
How many gems were you supposed to gather?
200?
300?
No, that seems far too many... If you remember rightly, it was around 150 piles...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.guards.3.25.0.m: This artifact shop competes with the one in the north. Now you begin to see who was behind the burglary at Master Gremlin's and who employs the Green Gremlins!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.header.descript: The tale of Tuvok, a wizard's apprentice.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.header.name: A Race Against Time
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.heroes.42.biogr:
A pupil of the Arch Mage himself, he has been entrusted with overseeing the delivery of enough materials to repair the Temple of Light.
The other mages consider him too young, irresponsible and prone to selfishness. The Arch Mage trusts him nonetheless.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.heroes.42.name: Tuvok
This gremlin is carrying one of Master Gremlin's missing artifacts!
Stop, thief!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.monster.14.26.0:
This gremlin is carrying one of Master Gremlin's missing artifacts!
Stop, thief!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.monster.15.32.0:
This gremlin is carrying one of Master Gremlin's missing artifacts!

Stop, thief!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.monster.20.14.0:
Heeelp!!!
Poor Gremlin has been robbed!
All my beloved little artifacts are gone! Boo-hoo, sniff, sniff... Only a few are left in my little shop...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.monster.28.28.0:
This gremlin is carrying one of Master Gremlin's missing artifacts!
Stop, thief!
This gremlin is carrying one of Master Gremlin's missing artifacts!

map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.monster.4.6.0.m: They have plenty of golems in the north. We can use these for our own needs now.
This gremlin is carrying one of Master Gremlin's missing artifacts!
Stop, thief!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.quest.29.18.0.c:
Ah, just what I had in mind! I'll give you 100 crystals for them!
Two for each one. Agreed?
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.quest.29.18.0.f: Say, young man, could you spare me about 50 golems? I need workers to dig new mine shafts. I'll pay you well for them.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.quest.29.18.0.n:
I need Stone Golems. No one else can do the job as well as they can.
You mages have plenty of them, after all. Surely you can spare a few...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.sign.20.12.1.me:
This is the fellow you need to cut down to size. Of course, that is technically impossible, so you will lose this game :-)
It is necessary for the story to continue.
LEKI
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:0.town.35.3.0.eve: Two piles of ore were needed to make golems today...
We must get trade moving a little. It is the only way to meet that impossible deadline...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.0.descrip:
A message from the priest on the Island of Final Rest: 
I have established telepathic contact with Father Berdorth. Everyone thought he had fallen in the Last Battle, but in truth he is imprisoned with part of his army somewhere in the northwestern Land of Fire.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.1.descrip:
To our southern allies:
We, the archers of the east, salute our allies in the south. Our company awaits you at the southeasternmost tip of the Land of Fire, near Dragon City. On to victory!!!
P.S. We hope to remain hidden from the hellish monsters until you arrive.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.10.descri:
You really can learn anything at the market in Podhorská...
Someone has brought word of a lookout observatory somewhere near the old harbour, where partisans keep watch for the enemy.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.11.descri:
Today is a day of horror...
The monks of the Island have discovered that Lord Michael's sarcophagus has been desecrated!
An inscription has been written in blood on its stone lid:
"LET HE WHO STOOD AGAINST THE FORCES OF CHAOS BE FOREVER CURSED, AND MAY HIS SOUL FIND NO REST AFTER DEATH!"
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.2.descrip:
News from the north has spread across the land.
It is a letter to the people from Lord Michael:
The enemy outnumbers us enormously. Thank goodness the archers of the east are coming to our aid on both flanks... I can see some already drawing their bows and crossbows... perhaps we shall prevail...      Lord Michael
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.3.descrip: A week has passed since battle with the demons began, and still there is no news... Who knows what happened there...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.4.descrip:
A soldier arrives in the village:
Oh God, we lost, and Lord Michael is dead... I carried his body out of the Land of Fire and left it in the care of the monks on the Island... It was a terrible battle, and the archers from the ea... arghhhh - an arrow in the soldier's throat cuts his words short...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.5.descrip:
You awaken on a beach, another crewman lying beside you. You are alive. Sadly, you are probably the hurricane's only survivors...
But is this nightmare over? You look around and sense that the once beautiful Green Land lies beneath a shadow of fear and uncertainty...
What is happening here?
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.6.descrip:
Night is over, yet the sky remains dark...
Now a red glow rises on the horizon... nooo!!! Those are not the first rays of sunlight. Fiery writing spells out an ultimatum across the sky... Spring will come, and with it hell shall engulf the Green Land.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.7.descrip: Some people abandon their work and flee south... Each takes whatever they can carry, including resources... Theft from the storehouses grows ever more frequent...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.8.descrip:
Many fear the coming days, but some are forming small bands and hiding across the countryside, preparing for guerrilla warfare...
It might be worth trying to unite them... But who knows where all their troops are hidden...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.event.9.descrip:
People whisper at the market in Podhorská: 
Several partisans are said to be hiding in the eastern crags, where crystals are mined...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.0.51.0.m: To the south, you see an obelisk rising towards the sky. Strange shapes are carved upon it...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.0.53.0.m:
You hear branches crack...
The motionless trees begin closing in around you, suddenly cutting off your retreat. Echoing voices speak to you:
"No stranger has ever beheld our sacred obelisk... And you will be no exception!!!"
Branches crack suddenly, and a deep rumbling rises from the heart of the woods...
The trees begin to move... tendrils of once peaceful plants coil around you... The forest attacks!
The forest is dark and hostile... They do not seem fond of intruders here... But you have permission to enter, so surely no harm will come to you...
Or will it?
"Hssss... Land-dwelling worm, this wreck belongs to us now!"
A small band of warriors is hiding in a cave at the foot of the cliffs... After a brief discussion, they decide to come with you...
You also learn that there may be another band nearby...
Damn, you've stepped in... you don't want to know what. The drinking bouts at this dive must be pretty wild... Well, at least you'll be more careful next time...
The vomit on the steps guarantees that you will find capable recruits here.
A thoroughly drunken man lies here. No one is around... What might the fellow have in his pockets?
A band of partisans is preparing for guerrilla warfare here...
You hear one soldier remark:
"I can't see the men who fortified themselves near Podhorská anywhere... We could use them too."
Before you can question him further, he disappears into the crowd...
You try to enter the mines, but a barricade blocks the entrance. A distinctly unfriendly fellow stands upon it...
"This place is taken! Think you're the only ones who thought of hiding from the demons? Get out, but leave your belongings!" At his signal, a band of ruffians pours out from behind the barricade...
A small band of warriors is hiding in a cave at the foot of the cliffs... After a brief discussion, they decide to come with you...
You also learn that there may be another band nearby...
Another survivor stands on the shore... You wave joyfully, but when he turns, you see madness in his eyes...
With a terrible roar, he draws his sword and lunges at you. His screams make it clear that he blames you for the ship's sinking...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.2.25.0.m:
The captive monk should be somewhere around here...
Deep in your heart, you pray that he has resisted the temptations of the hellish monsters and remained faithful to the Green Land and the cause of good... Perhaps the tortures of his prison have not broken him...
A band of partisans keeps watch in this makeshift observatory for enemies approaching from the north.
Cleverly built platforms nestle among the treetops... These people do not intend to surrender their alchemist's laboratory to the enemy without a fight...
The water around the ships begins to foam... Sea monsters start clambering aboard...
"Hssss... Land-dwelling worm, this belongs to us now!"
You see a small band at the crossroads...
They are volunteers from the village of Lipov, a little way south.
They gladly join your company...
You meet a group of fellows here...
"Errr... greetings, sir... errr... we're certainly not doing any shady business here... uh... we're here... errr... because of you... yes... errr... we want to help you... errr... don't we, lads? 
Well, better battle than prison, eh...
"Hssss... Land-dwelling worm, down to the depths with you!"
Here is the entrance to the Grove of Eternal Rest... 
A sign by the entrance reads, "Please be quiet. This is a place of meditation."  
P.S. Please do not rob the tombs.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.3.44.0.m:
The trees suddenly begin to move... turning their crowns towards you, they speak:
We, the guardians of the forest's northern border, understand why you are here and will gladly join your army... We will help you drive the devil from our land.
How maddening... Just offshore, a ship rocks on the waves, having miraculously escaped the storm. Unfortunately, you have no way to reach it...
A company of monks emerges from the monastery. Their blue cloaks and hoods, drawn low over their brows, shine in the setting sun. You feel immense power pulsing around them... This is the help you need...
The sawmill is deserted... No one has worked here for a long time... It is time to change that.
You need a new ship, after all.
The monsters in the forward fortress await you... The prince of hell knows you are in his domain, but he never suspected your army was so powerful... You will scatter this little band with ease! Won't you?
The path begins to vanish among the roots of ancient trees...
Their crowns conceal the sky, and suddenly the sounds of the forest surround you...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.33.7.0.m:
Here lies the seat of all evil. Pillars of fire line a road paved with human skulls. You must raze the city and destroy the demon Diabolus and his fiendish monstrosities! Your armies look to you, and desperate resolve stirs in every heart... 
Lead us TO THE ATTACK!!!
This is the battlefield where Lord Michael fell... Ruin and devastation lie everywhere... Nightmare creatures still feast upon the bodies of the Green Land's soldiers... The stench of decay spreads in every direction... Dread begins to tighten its grip on your soldiers' throats... You stand at the edge of the valley of death...
Beside the obelisks, you see a monk laboriously copying the design on the stone into a thick book.
Ha! There are the new docks. You can see people working feverishly on new ships.
You see a group of armed men...
Their leader, a knight with a great axe, snarls at you:
"Halt! This ship is ours! You're not the only one who wants to get out before the demons arrive!"
He draws his axe and charges at you.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.4.54.0.m:
Deep voices suddenly thunder all around:
"Intruder... intruder... destroy the intruder!!!"  
The trees begin to move... Suddenly, you are trapped!!!
A group of demonic monstrosities dances wildly around a campfire. They are surprised, but have no intention of retreating.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.5.28.0.m:
ARMAGEDDON!?!?
That word sounds familiar, but right now you cannot remember what it means...
You see two hares nibbling a carrot beneath its leafy tops... They clearly couldn't care less that the end of the world is coming...
You stand where the little forest river Stříbřenka flows into the bay...
This is the entrance to the eastern elven forest... The guards are watchful, however, and admit only those with permission...
This is said to be a very powerful spell...
If so, you must try it!
The statue has been utterly destroyed... Perhaps the people of Podhorská will manage to build a new one in time...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.56.7.0.m: A deep chasm blocks your path... It seems you cannot go this way.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.57.7.0.m:
Flames begin to bar your path...
Smoke fills the air, and the heat grows unbearable...
Suddenly, you see hosts of inhuman creatures emerging from the fire towards you...
The forest ends here, and the road continues into mountains inhabited by dwarves. They are skilled warriors and even finer smiths and miners…
The forest folk come here to learn...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.6.63.0.m: A band of partisans is preparing for guerrilla warfare here... They have no intention of leaving their village at the demons' mercy...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.60.3.0.m: Who knows what the archfiend teaches his minions here...
Far to the south, you see a dwarven mine... 
WAIT! 
You see something else... An army of dwarves camps around great fires. Could this be the promised aid the dwarf in the east spoke of?
White shadows fly through the forest... Hundreds of pounding hooves shake the earth... Here graze Lady Marion's war unicorns...
You hear something to the north, but the trees grow too thickly to see through... What could it be?
This is a magical place of peace and quiet... You long to lie down in the soft grass and forget the horrors lurking beyond...
But you cannot. You walk on towards the gravestone, when suddenly you feel your body rise several feet above the ground. You spread your arms and let magical energy flow into you...
Hmm... What might this enchanted corner of the forest conceal?
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.guards.9.58.0.m: A band of partisans is preparing for guerrilla warfare here...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.header.descript: The tale of Linnarfin and Lady Marion.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.header.name: The Beginning of the End
The people greatly fear the coming days...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.29.biogr:
Lady Marion, Lady of the Forest.
Daughter of Lord Michael and Rachel, Lady of the Forest. Her mother died in childbirth, and her father rules the Green Land. She was therefore raised in the traditions of both the forest folk and the people of the Green Land. She lives in her forest and dislikes leaving it, except perhaps to visit her father.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.29.name: Lady Marion
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.51.biogr: One of hell's demonic commanders. He answers only to the Unnamed One.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.51.name: Horned One
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.53.biogr: One of the Unnamed One's chief demons. Sent to lay waste to the Green Land in his master's name.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.53.name: Threehorn
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.6.biogra:
Linnarfin Aladal.
Born the son of a poor fisherman on the Western Coast, he fled home in search of adventure. Fate led him to a pirate ship, where he served as a cabin boy. Two years later, during an attempted raid on a merchant ship, the ship was sunk and Linnarfin captured. He persuaded a merchant to take him as a slave, a better fate than execution. After five years, he was freed and began trading on his own. This is his first voyage.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.6.name: Linnarfin
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.61.biogr: Threehorn's right hand. Accompanies him on every mission.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.61.name: Red-Eyed Xqo
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.8.biogra: Father Berdoth, the Warrior Priest. A great exorcist and champion against the powers of the "Other Side".
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.heroes.8.name: Father Berdoth
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.16.51.0: Welcome, sir. Unless we find a powerful ally, the demons will utterly ravage our beautiful Green Land... Become our leader and help us in our search... The monks say that Lady Marion, Lady of the Forest, may be sympathetic to our cause. We must go southeast, find her and ask for aid.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.17.56.0: Welcome, sailor. You survived the storm, but will you survive the days ahead? Hellish monsters are overrunning our land. Their invasion must be stopped. Lord Michael is preparing for a desperate battle against overwhelming odds. If he loses, nothing will stop the devilish army from laying waste to the Green Land.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.23.57.0: I'm sorry, but your ship is utterly wrecked. The storm sank all our ships too. Those demons must be behind it. We began building new docks in the east, but I don't know whether they are finished yet... Perhaps you can find a new ship there...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.23.71.0:
You see men hurrying south.
You try to speak to them, but one shouts before you can say a word...
"You won't stop us! Nobody will stop us! No demons will get us or keep us from heading south!"
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.30.21.0:
God!!! Those walking dead are wearing the tattered uniforms of the Green Land's soldiers!!!
Nooooooo!!!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.31.48.0: Welcome, brave traveller. The peace of the dead should not be disturbed outside the appointed rituals. Yet these times demand even such deeds... The monks of the temple will aid you, and the teachers will teach you things you do not yet know.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.33.55.0: Ho-ho! Welcome, welcome. I am Master Gremlin. Quite windy here by the water lately, wouldn't you say? That's why I built this windmill. Go and take a look if you have a moment. Sometimes I watch the sea from its roof, too... We can watch together if you like.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.37.67.0: I am truly sorry, but under the Most Ancient Accord, no outsider may enter the forest under any circumstances without knowing the secret password. Your only chance is to seek out the monk on the island. He may tell you the password you need...
Welcome. Give the password to the guards deep in the eastern mountains. Our brothers may help you. We have great trouble with monsters from the western swamps and must defend our own homes... But wait, take this sword. Perhaps it will give you strength in battle. You must pay for the war machines, though...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.43.67.0: Greetings, Lady Marion! It is a beautiful day, and no one has brought any ill tidings to our forest... Do enjoy your ride...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.46.37.0: Welcome. I am Brother Duanadan. I know why you are here. Enter my humble dwelling. We must search the old records for the password needed to enter the Forest.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.50.60.0: Welcome. Tell our kin in the west what you need. They will surely help. Oh... I almost forgot: you need a password to enter the Dendroid Forest. They will gladly tell you in the tent. Good luck.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.55.45.0: Damn it, that wretched storm knocked down our lighthouse statue. Take the wreckage away if you like. It is no use to us now.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.57.61.0: Welcome. I am keeper of the unicorn herd of the sacred forest. Find their grazing grounds and take them into battle with you.
The horde of monsters charges at you without a moment's hesitation...
The prison guards are surprised, but not for long... Confident in their strength, they bar your way!
Well, well, a new student... Come along for your first lesson. And your last! Heh heh heh!!!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.64.17.0:
"Ha! Lord Michael also thought he could rely on our archers. Unfortunately, he never guessed that we value our northern friends' gold more than our agreements with the south. Prepare to die!"
{GOD! TREACHERY! FOUL TREACHERY!}
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.65.69.0: Welcome. We know what is happening in the north, and though the horror is far away now, one day it will reach our caves. We cannot spare many warriors: goblins threaten us from beyond the mountains, and many dwarves must forge weapons. Even so, accept what little we can offer.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.70.43.0: "This is sacred ground. Only these extraordinary times allow me to let you pass."
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.monster.71.55.0: Welcome. Command me: I am the island's guardian, and I am at your service.
Our brothers have told us what is at stake. The forest folk will go with you. Do not venture deeper into the woods. Some dendroids there are friendly, but in these dark times others trust no one without roots...
"Welcome to our village. It may be tiny, but it is picturesque."
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.sign.11.69.0.me:
The sign reads in neat lettering:
Welcome to Podhorská, the northernmost village in our land.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.sign.12.35.0.me: ...a terrible storm... that is no howling wind, but the roar of horrors from another world... we are surely going to sink...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.sign.14.56.0.me:
North to the Drunken Sailor Tavern
East to the harbour
South to Podhorská
West to the forest (though the guards won't let you in anyway)
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.sign.22.58.0.me:
Neat lettering reads:
Welcome to the Northern Harbour of our beautiful Green Land.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:1.sign.23.67.0.me:
The Last Crossroads
West to Podhorská
North to the Harbour

{The Land of Fire has begun to sink!}
This is the latest news from the north. Amid tremendous tremors and vast clouds of smoke and sulfur, the cliffs have begun to collapse, and the black earth is being devoured by the insatiable sea...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.35.descri: War in the north is said to be raging... At least, that is what the scattered reports brought by people fleeing south suggest...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.36.descri: The people of the Green Land are said to have bravely resisted the invasion of hellish monsters... Some say the defenders are led by the mysterious Lady of the Forest, Lady Marion. Others speak of an unknown stranger with a mane of fair hair, who appeared from nowhere at just the right moment...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.37.descri: Unconfirmed reports of victory in the north... Lady Marion—yes, the Green Land truly has such a powerful ally in the north, commanding the might of dragons—has defeated the monstrosities of Chaos with the aid of Linnarfin Aladal, a young merchant captain!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.38.descri: Today, the Green Land's victory has indeed been confirmed. The people rejoice, and refugees speak joyfully of returning home...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.39.descri: Word has arrived of strange events in the north... So far, there are only meaningless fragments of bewildering reports...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.4.descrip: Something sinister is certainly afoot... The third Week of the Imp in a row bodes ill! We must get to the bottom of this!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.40.descri: Something very strange is happening in the north... The Land of Fire is awakening... At least, so say some travellers coming south to join the flourishing trade...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.41.descri:
Smoke from the volcanoes of the Land of Fire is visible to the naked eye from the Green Land's northern coast... A few brave souls reportedly sailed out to investigate, but never returned...
The people are troubled...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.42.descri: It seems that the defeat of the monsters of Chaos in the north has brought about strange events in the Land of Fire...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.43.descri:
The tremors in the north seem to be slowly subsiding...
Unconfirmed reports speak of a newly founded Guild of Far Explorers, bringing together sea captains determined to explore the newly formed sea...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.5.descrip:
The bandits' raid is sudden and unexpected!	The screams and sobs of the terrorised people echo through the night...	But the raiders' chief target is your treasury and the riches stored within!
The people, rejoicing in the northern victory, are dismayed by this event...
Their rising spirits fall once more...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.6.descrip: No one slept a wink last night...	The first faint tremors culminated at dawn in a mighty earthquake that destroyed people's homes... Great quantities of materials must be spent on essential repairs...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.7.descrip: Mild tremors during the night have unsettled the local people…
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.event.8.descrip: The ground trembled faintly again tonight... The people fear an earthquake...

map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.17.133.0: Huge boulders block the way across the mountains. No one has maintained this once busy pass for years... A few years of uncleared avalanches and rampant vegetation have taken their toll... You probably cannot get through here... You would need wings...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.17.138.0: You descend through the pass to the far side of the mountains. The landscape here is more hostile... Swamp stretches as far as the eye can see. The ground is treacherous, and a foul smell rises from the dark pools... This will be a difficult journey...

You stand a short way from the gate and survey your surroundings. You seem to be in a maze of rocks. Well... if the legends are true, the answer to the Grail's whereabouts should lie here...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.21.122.0: The battlements of an ancient fortress loom ominously above the pass. map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.4.62.0.m: This must be the Gate of the Dead... The souls' wailing is almost unbearable... Your heart races, and your shirt clings to your sweaty body... Yet there is no doubt... The road to the Grail leads this way!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.4.81.0.m: The tent is cleverly hidden beneath the trees and commands an excellent view of the behemoths' lair. The hunters' leader must have spent a long time here watching these creatures and devising ways to hunt them.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.40.104.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.40.106.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.40.131.0:
Outside a reed hut, you see reptile skins hanging on wooden racks... Sunlight playing across their surface has a strangely hypnotic effect...
Yes, on closer inspection, you realise they are basilisk skins.
The reeds along the river, motionless until now, begin swaying in a sudden gust... The enemy's attack is so sudden that at first you can only stare at your foe in horror...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.42.137.0: On the way to the house, he continues: "Help me take revenge and kill the high priest, and I will reward you as generously as I can. The high priest wears a strange amulet around his neck. Bring it to me as proof that you have done the deed, and the reward is yours. Come inside, and we shall discuss it further.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.42.138.0: The hut's occupant answers your question: "I must live here because I rebelled against the priests, who have become utter fanatics lately. Almost every day they sacrifice one of our people to their god. My brother and I went to the temple to protest, but they imprisoned him, and I had to flee.
The riverside trail sometimes vanishes into the marshy growth along the banks...
Dark shadows fly towards you with hideous shrieks. The attack is so sudden that at first you can only stare at your foe in horror...
The riverside trail sometimes vanishes into the marshy growth along the banks...
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
A band of barbarians suddenly springs upon you from ambush!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.48.1.0.m: The founder of this little town is buried in a secret place in the forest…
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.48.100.0: A band of barbarians suddenly springs upon you from ambush!
The dark gods have answered your prayers! An undead army rises from the depths of the crypt, ready to obey your every command!
You see several soldiers locked in fierce battle with a mass of undead. The monsters seem to be trying to cross the river, while a handful of brave defenders struggles to stop them.
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.5.62.1.m:
Suddenly, all is silent... 
You look around, but everything is lost in pitch darkness... Finding the right path will not be easy...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.5.63.1.m:
The renegade mage Šedivec must be hiding somewhere here...
You must find him at any cost and prevent his escape!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.54.135.0: A sharp pain shoots through the back of your hand! You crush the annoying insect, but another bloodthirsty swamp fly immediately attacks!
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.55.113.0: A tower of giants guards the border between the desert and the lands around the Golden Forest...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.55.128.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!

Argh-bell. Once a beautiful city on the shore of an inland lake, now a den of evil. As in many parts of the Green Land, the creatures of darkness have sown their seed here. A mighty vampire lord has made it his residence and now terrorises the surrounding lands.
A band of barbarians suddenly springs upon you from ambush!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.57.131.0: Strange, dog-like people operate this old windmill. They show no hostility. You seem more an interesting diversion from their daily routine...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.57.143.0: An artifact dealer's hut is well hidden among the reeds. Examining the surroundings, you discover a path leading east from his house, apparently much used. You take a few steps along it, but realise that it is deadly dangerous for anyone who does not know it well. You wisely turn back...
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
A band of barbarians suddenly springs upon you from ambush!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.59.129.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
This fortress atop a crag once kept the whole region safe. Now only a few veterans remain... Perhaps they will share their experience with you...
Old Šelpa, shipbuilder and trader, has a hut beneath those trees. The once prosperous merchant seems to have fallen on harder times since the days when the trade route crossed the Southern Seas...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.60.107.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.61.106.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
