map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.64.109.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.64.130.0: Before you stands the priests' temple, an imposing stepped structure rising above the treetops. A long staircase leads to the dark entrance into the sanctuary's depths.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.64.139.0: A sharp pain shoots through the back of your hand! You crush the annoying insect, but another bloodthirsty swamp fly immediately attacks!
The townsfolk built ships here to cross to the other shore or sail south downriver. The shipyard stands on this islet because, during droughts, the water near the shore was too shallow to build larger ships.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.69.6.0.m:
It is time to destroy the servants of hell!!!
Their devilish plan to conquer the Green Land by establishing a base almost at its heart must be stopped... Forward, then! Let our blades run red with their blood!!!
Taking the city will not be easy… Numerous behemoths guard the walls, apparently in the khan's service…
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.7.92.0.m: Several hunting lodges stand in a picturesque little valley enclosed by cliffs. Some hunters busily dress their kills, while others tell merry tales around campfires. This is a good place for a short rest.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.70.108.0: Desert birds nest here. Perhaps some of the young could be tamed…
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.70.136.0: A dreadful stench fills the area. Water bubbles in dark pools, and strange splashing betrays something hidden within. Going farther would be very dangerous...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.70.138.0: This looks like a sacrificial site... The remains of bodies suggest grisly rituals to appease evil gods.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.71.140.0: You suddenly glimpse a small figure beside the pond. It looks like a girl from the people who inhabit these wetlands.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.71.142.0: Your deed does not go unanswered... You sense movement behind you. Spinning around, you stare in amazement as a huge dragon-like head rises from a pool on a long neck... then another... and a third! Moments later, the whole monster hauls itself ashore. There is no slipping past it... This will be a mighty battle...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.74.107.0: You have been without water too long... Dark silhouettes of birds circle overhead.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.74.109.0: Your horse stumbles and collapses from exhaustion. That is the signal the scavengers have awaited...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.74.136.0: The monks must have meditated here before they began worshipping their new god.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.76.126.0: A sharp pain shoots through the back of your hand! You crush the annoying insect, but another bloodthirsty swamp fly immediately attacks!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.77.105.0: Stones lie everywhere, and dangerous fissures cut across the ground… This place is truly inhospitable…
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.78.112.0: You cannot go any farther this way...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.79.108.0: All these rocks look the same, damn it! Which way now?
As you follow the trail, you suddenly see movement among the trees... A group of ruffians is walking a short way ahead...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.8.11.0.m:
Ironically, the experiment intended to find a way to destroy our enemies helped them instead...
Our friends from the west are already working hard to discover the infernal prince's whereabouts. Since conditions here are unsuitable, however, they followed the river south.
If you remember rightly, the road through the mountain pass should lead straight to the Green Land...
Looking towards the mountains, however, you see a dark cloud hanging above them, obscuring much of the sky. The south truly seems changed...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.8.80.0.m: Now you understand everything that hunting exotic creatures entails…
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.81.127.0: A black mass of rock towers towards the sky. Loathsome flying reptiles circle overhead, their cries echoing above the treetops...
Seeing your eagerness to learn, a wise scholar meditating in this peaceful place reveals the secrets of warfare to you!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.83.110.0: Your horse stumbles and collapses from exhaustion. That is the signal the scavengers have awaited...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.83.114.0: A sudden shout makes you look back. What you see delights you: a group of goblins from the settlement has come to swell your ranks. They are weary from crossing the desert, but glad to have caught up with you in time.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.83.126.0: A dark shadow suddenly passes overhead. You look up and see one of the flying creatures diving towards you...
You creep after the group that caught your attention... Their voices carry back to you... You listen to their conversation... They seem in excellent spirits... Unfortunately, they are getting too far ahead again... Hurry after them!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.84.107.0: You have been without water too long... Dark silhouettes of birds circle overhead.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.84.124.0: The windows of the ancient prison, built into the cliffs ages ago, stare at you like the eyes of a nightmare beast... God! A sudden cry draws your attention to one of its many windows... SOMEONE IS IN THERE!!!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.84.130.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
An inconspicuous trail seems to lead deeper into the dense forest, home to all manner of creatures...
You have gone too far north… Your goal lies farther south!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.85.104.0: This is a true maze… And this does not seem to be the right way…
They are celebrating a fine haul! They laugh about robbing a dwarf who lives somewhere west of here, beneath the mountains!
So it is true! These are no honest folk, but miserable scoundrels who deserve no mercy!
The fighting monks, the Zealots, have their monastery here! Your devoted servants and the mortal enemies of hellish monsters!
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.87.128.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.87.131.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
You ride into a forest clearing... The bandits are disappearing beneath the trees at its southern edge! Now you can catch them and punish their crimes!
The river flowing out of the lake has heavily overgrown banks... Fortunately, you can sail through the grasses with only a little difficulty... Perhaps it will be easier downstream...
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.9.12.0.m: Their leader fought his way east and is now somewhere unknown, trying to build a portal to their world so he can summon reinforcements...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.9.57.1.m: You have a grim feeling that once you pass through this gate, there may be no turning back...
The band of ruffians has nowhere left to run! This is their secret lair! See justice done!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.92.116.0: You creep through the undergrowth towards the place where the true khan is imprisoned... His former wife is just leaving the old prison gates. She answers the hateful shouts from a barred window with wild laughter and mockery... She is certainly involved too!
The unicorn herd seems to sense your plea... The mightiest among them slowly approaches and joins your army...
The unicorn herd seems to sense your plea... The mightiest among them slowly approaches and joins your army...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.95.116.0: At last, the true khan's prison has been found! Your work deserves a fitting reward!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.guards.95.8.0.m: This is the Dragon Shepherd's house... But he refuses to speak further until you prove that you, too, are their friend...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.header.name: The Hidden Threat
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.101.biog: A false khan planted by the "Other Side" to wreak evil.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.101.name: Darghar
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.102.name: Khan Gragh
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.112.biog: Zun - ak. One of two brothers who protested against the priests' fanaticism. Imprisoned for it in the fortress beneath the Black Crags.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.112.name: Zun - ak
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.147.biog: A dreadful drunkard and reveller, but a loyal vassal of the Green Land, ready to fight for it at any time.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.147.name: Brudr Ibeer
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.22.biogr: The bandit leader who terrorises the entire region.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.22.name: Bandit Chief
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.42.biogr: The renegade mage Šedivec, expelled from the fellowship of mages for experimenting with black magic.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.42.name: Šedivec
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.5.biogra: Sebastian Valmount, son of a lord of Falcon's Eye, is learning the fur trade. He is returning from the Northern Isles, where he went to buy new goods.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.5.name: Sebastian
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.57.biogr: The Red Demon is one of the Nameless One's favourites. He forced his way through the realms to sow evil in the very heart of the Green Land.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.57.name: Red Demon
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.73.name: Dark Rider
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.74.name: Alucard
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.76.name: Dark Rider
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.77.name: Dark Rider
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.99.biogr: The barbarian khan's treacherous wife, hungry for power.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.heroes.99.name: Jgha - na
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.1.107.0: Ah, forgive me. Just a moment more, and my prayer will be finished. The little god of luck matters greatly to us. A hunter without luck... well, you understand.
Your soul will never leave these crags, mortal!
The dragon has no intention of leaving its cave willingly...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.10.45.0: Your soul will never leave these crags, mortal!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.104.110: I cannot tell you much; I am only an apprentice. Ask one of the masters.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.107.114: Have a drink. See how refreshing the water is…
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.108.102: Oh! Well, well, could the tide finally be turning?
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.108.107: I used the power of the four elements to locate the enemy... Thanks to this place's abundant magic, we were also able to raise a portal leading straight to him! Remember, once you enter, there is no escaping your fate!
I am sorry, but while raiding bands from the eastern forest threaten our village, I cannot spare a single man... My scouts report that their leader has his eye on our harvest again... As long as he remains, I need my soldiers to defend the village...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.11.81.0: Of course you can join our guild. You need only pass a test of skill, heh heh. I've spent weeks stalking that fine Ancient Behemoth over there, but I think I'll leave it to you. Kill it and bring its hide to my tent, a little west of its lair.
Leaving the road does not pay… Your presence has angered the forest guardians!
Our task is to watch for approaching bandits...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.114.105: I used my third eye to find the demon's stronghold... It cost me much strength, but at last I found it... Right in the heart of the Green Land! Come and see!
But we have already paid our taxes this year…
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.115.109: Ah yes, it is true. We must restore the Lake Tower to defeat the enemy!
Please contribute to the repair of our monastery...
This spell will surely prove useful in battle!
There is no turning back now, intruder!
You see a sturdy fellow wielding his pitchfork with practised skill...
G-g-good d-d-day...
Well, speaking is not his strength, but he shifts manure splendidly.
Our task is to watch for approaching raiders...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.12.32.0: The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
Please do not disturb the peace of the dead...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.121.102: We are at your service. Just give the word!
I am a courier for the scouts of Greenleaf... If you have already visited our village and spoken to the mayor, go east. Follow the road and turn south among the trees at the large boulder to find the next scout... But if you have not spoken to the mayor, see him first so you know what is happening!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.122.107: Hello, hello! What a pleasant meeting... Well, I decided to help these clever fellows a little. They'd be lost without me... But shh! Don't tell them; they'd be terribly upset! Besides, I have something for you. You wouldn't get anything like this from them, heh heh...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.124.122:
The dragon perched on the crag fixes you with its deep eyes... It studies you for a while, then speaks:
"Your enemy is powerful. If you fall to him, our world as we know it will perish too... Take this ring to the Dragon Shepherd in the north as a token of friendship. He will help you!"
I am a scout from the village a little south of here, though you probably guessed that...
I've tracked a fairly large band... They seem to be heading northeast towards the crags...
We built this enclosure from thick trunks, and our wizard strengthened it with a mighty spell... Perhaps it will keep the Wind Riders on the Field of Desolation...
Welcome to the guild of the Guardians of the Plain... Our most sacred duty is to guard the wall our ancestors built... It is the only thing keeping the Wind Riders, also called Dark Riders by men, on the Plains of Desolation...
I am sorry, but even if we wished to, we could not open a passage through the enclosure... It has no gate, and our wizard's spell prevents anyone crossing it another way...
Leki, master mapmaker, does not wish to be disturbed. He is working on another map!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.128.103: Yes! To sum up... To achieve complete victory, we must prove to all the people of the Green Land that the enemy can be defeated! Once you slay the demon, cut off his head and bring it to the Monastery of the Moon... Let everyone see it! Let all the people stand with us, rather than only some!
"May the gods protect you on your journey."
An elven hunter quenching his thirst at the spring greets you with these traditional words. "Visit our seasonal camp to the northwest if you need to recover your strength."
The fleeing bandits are only a few steps from the forest… But this time they will not escape!
To shorten your journey to Zen Tower, take the Underground Path. Its entrance lies northeast of the city.
The bandits are only a few steps from the trees… But this time they will not escape!
If you truly wish to enter the lands guarded by the Spirits of the Stone Forest, you must know the secret word that opens their gate... Come into the tent, and we shall find it in my records.
Eh? Huh?! Whaaat?!?
Aren't you away travelling?!!? Heh heh? Hic, hic! Well, I know I'm meant to guard the gate, but, hic, the Tripod lads had a little problem here, and I, hic, had to help!!! Heh, of course, I'll give you the keys right away... Burp! Eh, where are the little devils?! 
Kal Kal frantically searches his pockets, to no avail... Suddenly remembering, he bends towards the fire and picks up a tankard. The keys are inside!!!
{I put them there so I could keep an eye on them...} he explains...
Ah, now you know why he kept looking at the bottom of his tankard... {HE WAS CHECKING THEY WERE STILL THERE!}
Seeing they can no longer escape, the bandits suddenly turn on you... Their desperate resolve makes them dangerous foes...
I guard the Plains of Desolation... My task is to keep the Wind Riders, also known among men as Dark Riders, within their territory... If you enter the Plains of Desolation, know that you are certain to meet them!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.15.13.0: Ah… Welcome. Something terrible has happened. Come into the city; part of it still stands… I will tell you what happened…
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.16.34.0: Welcome. I guard the last land not yet conquered by the vampire lord! This is our final bastion of resistance. Go and speak with our leader.
Basilisks... Terrifying tales are told of these monsters. They say their gaze can turn an enemy to stone!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.17.18.0: Where did these servants of hell come from?
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.19.30.0: Welcome. I guard the last land not yet conquered by the vampire lord! This is our final bastion of resistance. Go and speak with our leader.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.19.99.0: No, I am not the hunters' leader. I am Anabom, a senior hunter. I have just run that unicorn to exhaustion, but I cannot decide whether to finish it or let it live in this beautiful forest. It is such a beautiful, noble beast, after all...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.21.33.0:
Ah! At last, someone who can help drive the undead from our land and destroy their vampire ruler! Let me accompany you and help you fight!
One more thing: enter our shrine. We have a powerful spell against the undead!
Greetings! My people sent me to watch the road for a hero who could help us out of our predicament. If you are not in too great a hurry, please come with me to our village a little east of here. You will learn more there.
Hello, I'm Master Gremlin. Bitterly cold all of a sudden, isn't it? Winter has come early. Shall we go into the windmill? I have something there that fell from the sky the other day... Perhaps it will interest you...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.23.59.0: You will never carry the secret of these crags away, mortal!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.23.99.0: Trapped among thorny bushes, the unicorn turns towards you. In its eyes, you see a desperate determination to fight for its life.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.24.30.0: Welcome. I guard the last land not yet conquered by the vampire lord! This is our final bastion of resistance. Go and speak with our leader.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.25.87.0: Welcome, welcome! Come and listen to hunting tales.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.26.34.0: Welcome. I guard the last land not yet conquered by the vampire lord! This is our final bastion of resistance. Go and speak with our leader.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.27.10.0: The undead seem to infest this entire region!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.27.87.0: ...and would you believe it, the arrow bounced off her skin as though it were stone. Then she turned and leapt at me. But I was quicker, and as she passed above me, I drove my dagger into her soft belly. I tell you, that gargoyle was the worst thing I ever hunted...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.29.18.0: The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.29.25.0: The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
I am a mage from the west, preparing to travel towards the lake and then south along the river... There lies an untouched region brimming with magic... My friends are seeking a way to reveal the hidden enemy there.
This pond belongs to us, stranger!
We have finished everything and are discussing when to leave for the Green Land. If you have no objection, we can travel together. Just visit the huts first. Some sleepyheads are nursing yesterday's hangovers, and you may even need to bribe them to come today, ha ha...
And you must be the hero the chief is talking about.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.34.21.0: The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.34.50.0: Your soul will never leave these crags, mortal!
The chief delivers a fiery speech: We have lived in the Fortress's shadow too long. It is time to drive the dark powers from the pass. Today we had to close a second mine because it became haunted... I call upon you to attack the dark gate! Look, here is the hero who will lead us.
You must still persuade those who stayed home out of fear. Gold will surely be a compelling argument!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.35.31.0: The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.39.11.0: Thank you for saving us! We thought we would all perish here!
At first the creature fears you, but then it gathers courage and speaks in broken Common: Please help me, stranger. You are not from here, so surely you have the courage to save my beloved from death's grasp. The priests mean to sacrifice her to the three-headed god. I will give you everything I have.
More and more monsters rush out of the lair to help drive off the intruder…

Thank you for saving me. I've been here two days, and that monster simply would not give up. I belong to a caravan carrying goods west from our city and back. Behemoths attacked us here the day before yesterday... It is strange; normally that never happens...

The behemoth ignores you, absorbed by a creature hiding in a cleft between the rocks. Only when you come closer does it turn and look at you...

map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.64.97.0: Nrghu ah! In our khan's name!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.65.87.0: Hey, you! I'm the finest tracker in this part of the desert. I don't know if this helps, but recently I found the tracks of many horses leading southeast from the city into the stony wastes... They all seemed to be in a great hurry.

Alaaaarm!!!

map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.69.95.0: Wait, stranger. If you have not been there yet, come first to our settlement a little northwest of here.

map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.monster.76.56.0: Feel free to stroll through our meditation grove.

He may have hidden elsewhere, though... Mages usually secure their hiding places with a spell, often a magically locked gate or the like... If you encounter such a thing, there is only one way to open it, namely...

Your soul will never leave these crags, mortal!

You furiously rattle the lock, to no avail. Without Kal Kal's key, you cannot get through...

I know it is little, but it is all I can give.
Bring me proof that the bandits will no longer raid our village!
As long as the bandit leader lives, he may still attack us, and I cannot spare any soldiers...
Yes! This one looks perfect, and he even has his own pitchfork! I'll take him!

map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.quest.136.140.1: The gate's magical lock resists for a while, but at last you succeed. The method the island mage taught you works! Thank goodness you remembered the right passage! The way is clear!

Only a mage could open this magically sealed gate...
ONARB ES IRVETO!!!
The gate blazes with light, and the way is clear...
No one may pass the gate without knowing the secret word that opens it...
You try every opening incantation you can think of, without success...

map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:2.town.18.105.0.e: All the hunters have withdrawn from the woods to the Golden Forest... Suddenly, the village is packed, and the marketplace is bursting at the seams. The horses also need stabling, and the town needs improving in general...
The stables for the tame unicorns are finished!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.event.0.descrip:
The ship draws alongside the Island of Final Rest, and a funeral procession steps onto the pier...
Priests, Lady Marion followed by Linnarfin, Sebastian and his cousin Ibeer.
Together they bear the coffin of Tuvok, the wizard who did all he could, yet failed to complete his task...
The Heroes of the War have come to consult Father Berdoth after the funeral on breaking Lord Michael's curse... They intend to seek the answer in the Temple's library...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.event.1.descrip:
The procession enters the Garden of Remembrance, when its leading ranks suddenly halt.
The terrible death cry of a monk in the front row chills the blood of everyone present.
Panic erupts, and instinct drives the people to turn and run towards the ship...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.event.2.descrip:
Tuvok's coffin falls to the ground with a crash of splintering wood...
The sight before Lady Marion stops her heart. Directly opposite stands her father, clutching the unfortunate monk's severed head in one hand and his sword in the other.
Unable to move, she watches the gleaming blade rise towards the sky, ready to split her skull...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.event.3.descrip:
But the blow does not find its mark. Sebastian's blade stops it just short of its target. At once, Ibeer's strong arms seize Marion and fling her beyond Death's reach.
"Run, my lady!" Sebastian cries, barely parrying another thrust.
Black clouds engulf the sky, clear only moments ago. Lightning splits the horizon, and the dark spirit of the undead lord cries out in triumph.
Dead riders come to their master's aid on the wings of the storm...
Still shaken, Marion rises and slowly backs away from her father...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.event.4.descrip:
As if in a dream, she sees Linnarfin shouting at her:
"Go, my lady. Run to the ship while you still can!!! You must save yourself!!! We do not matter, but you must save your father's soul!"
Lord Michael's steel gauntlet strikes him to his knees, but before the sword can pierce his throat, Ibeer thrusts his own weapon into the undead lord's flank...
The sword sinks to the hilt without inflicting any serious injury...
You see a ship rocking rudderless upon the restless sea...
You need not search long to discover the cause...
The steward holds out his hand, and you have no choice but to pay the required sum.
The steward holds out his hand, and you have no choice but to pay the required sum.
The steward holds out his hand, and you have no choice but to pay the required sum.
The water around your ship begins bubbling wildly. The attack from the depths is sudden and unexpected.
Aha! So this is why the sea is restless... Air Elementals have decided to claim this part of the world for themselves...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.23.7.1.m: A strange scroll sealed in a bottle bobs upon the waves here...
Your friends are dead...
But you must survive and find a way to save Lord Michael's soul, and the others' too...
Where can you seek help? Perhaps in Forest City!
Or perhaps someone on the Island of Forest Wisdom can advise you...
For now, Lord Michael is trapped on the island, but he will soon find a way off it. You must act quickly.
Who knows where the whirlpool might lead...
This is the most intriguing part of the newly formed archipelagos. The valley has changed greatly since your last visit. Where the hellish city of terror stood only recently, a vast whirlpool now leads into the unknown... Lured by the promise of a great reward, one ship recently tried to explore it... Sadly, it never returned...
You order your ship to slow and approach the other vessel. Sailors lean on its rail, examining your ship.
Suddenly, their captain calls out, and they draw weapons... From snatches of words carried by the wind, you realise they take you for a rival vessel, surely carrying valuable records. They mean to seize them and sell them to the Guild of Far Explorers...
Before you can order a turn, the pirates grapple your ship... Your men hurriedly cut the ropes, but their foes are highly experienced... The first pirates are already aboard...
I hope you meet Danon's fate! You won't return from distant seas either, and your magic rings won't save you, just as his didn't save him!
You have no idea what the sailors on the passing ship could mean by these shouts...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.41.5.0.m:
Sadly, the crew is dead... They were plainly young and inexperienced. Your sailors wrap the unfortunate souls in sails and commit them to the blue depths of the sea that claimed them...
The captain is to be the last to leave his ship... You are about to wrap his remains yourself when you notice the rings on his hand... A mighty artifact, whose loss to the seabed would be beyond reckoning...
You try to remove it, but it clings fast to the dead man's finger... There is nothing for it but to draw your dagger and cut the finger off... This rather gruesome deed puts something truly precious into your hands...
Ship on the horizon!
It looks like one of the Guild of Far Explorers' vessels. Surely they could provide new information.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.42.5.0.m: At first the ship seemed deserted, but now you see several bodies lying on deck... Apparently it ran aground, and its crew has suffered here for heaven knows how long...
The recent earthquake destroyed Forest City...
There has not yet been time or money to rebuild it. Only a few huts and the entrance gate stand here for now...
As the Land of Fire gradually sinks, the new Guild of Far Explorers has begun to flourish. These brave souls mount expeditions north to map the newly formed volcanic archipelagos. Yet the price of knowledge is often high: many seafarers have met their deaths in unknown waters.
A one-legged sailor stops you outside the administrative building.
The joining fee is 15000 gold pieces... Then you can enjoy all the benefits, such as ship repairs in the docks and cheaper beer at the tavern... There is more, but those two interest newcomers most. Heh heh heh... 
Oh, and of course, here is an artifact marking your membership in the Guild.
Ordinary captains receive different sorts of rings according to their merits. But your deed deserves more...
You sail past a remarkable formation. Once a volcanic crag in a strategic position, it now has new inhabitants. The cliff's black lava walls are coated in ice, formed by the Azure Dragons' freezing breath...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.55.7.0.m:
You see the name EXCELSIOR on the ship... This was the vessel of one of the Guild of Far Explorers' founding members!
So it, too, met a sad fate, like most ships that dared venture into distant seas...
A tremendous force hurls you out of the teleportation gate, which immediately collapses in on itself... The way back is closed, and everyone who should have followed you is probably lost in time and space forever...
The Island of Forest Wisdom has become uninhabitable. Thanks to the magical aura surrounding these lands, the plants survived, and the salt water did not turn the beautiful trees into a dead forest. But the ground is utterly waterlogged, and attempting to travel across the island would be suicide. You must turn back...
The forest ends here, and the road continues into mountains inhabited by dwarves. They are skilled warriors and even finer smiths and miners…
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.58.7.0.m:
The half-dead castaway has been revived!
From his fragmented words, you learn that he is one of the Guild of Far Explorers' founding members...
He thanks you for saving him and promises a reward if you take him home...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.6.8.0.me: The water around your ship begins bubbling wildly. The attack from the depths is sudden and unexpected.
Yes.
In a stone niche behind the sarcophagus lies your mother's enchanted cloak, untouched by the years. As you draw it out, you hear footsteps behind you. Turning sharply, you see the keeper of the graves approaching through the trees.
 Ah, my lady, I remembered where one of the artifacts we so desperately need was hidden. But I see you have already found it yourself. Good. He smiles and invites you back to his dwelling.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.9.14.0.m: The friendly waves from the other ship's sailors are merely a treacherous ruse! As soon as you draw alongside, their friendly faces turn greedy for your possessions...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.9.58.1.m:
Lord Michael's knees suddenly buckle... A black arrow of the kind used in the east juts from his side...
The devil instantly seizes his momentary advantage...
With a tremendous leap, he falls upon the knight, knocks off his helmet and sinks his teeth into his throat...
You reach him too late to prevent any of it...
You were only a step away from saving your own father...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.9.60.1.m: There is Lord Michael! He is fighting an enormous horned devil... Only ten paces separate you! You must be swifter than fate!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.9.61.1.m: Amid the battle, you see the one Lady Marion has already killed once galloping along... This time, however, only his personal guard surrounds him! He cannot hide behind his city walls! He has nowhere to flee!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.9.64.1.m:
The battle is already raging, and the Green Land's troops are slowly succumbing to the enemy's overwhelming numbers!
You must kill their leader! That will sow fear in their black hearts, and perhaps turn victory in your favour!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.guards.9.66.1.m:
Something is happening behind you... You turn and suddenly see a monk in a blue hood emerging from the portal...
Then another... and another...
Until a whole company stands there!
To battle, then! Together, let us destroy the Prince of Hell!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.header.descript: The heroes of the Green Land meet for the first time, only to part forever a moment later.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.header.name: The Hour of Pain
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.heroes.48.biogr: This demon is to blame for everything!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.heroes.48.name: Demon
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.heroes.74.biogr: This is Lord Michael, Lord of the Northern Green Land. Because the burial deadline was missed, his spirit is in evil's power. He now has only one aim: to kill every living thing. His faithful champions accompany him, transformed into Dark Riders...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.heroes.74.name: Lord Michael
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.10.62.0: We are leaving the Dendroid Forest... Ruin and devastation have befallen it...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.11.56.0: Look what happened. The great earthquake that caused the Land of Fire to begin sinking destroyed our forest too... Huge waves flooded our groves and clearings, and the salt water killed every tree... Our home is ruined. We can only wander the world, seeking a new place to settle...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.15.51.0: Oh dear. The recent earthquake destroyed our tavern....
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.15.69.0: The waves driven by the earthquake brought destruction even to areas farther inland. Many trees died... On the other hand, we can thank the gods that we were spared the fate of Dendroid Forest.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.16.64.0: My lady, can we help you?
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.18.56.0:
Hiring a ship costs money. Remember to pay before you board, my lady.
It seems the harbourmaster does not know his own brother (sister).
Ah, welcome, my lady...
The recent earthquake caused the dwarven workshop to collapse...
All the workers perished in the ruins. Their relatives from the east asked me to come and tend the grounds around their graves...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.23.18.1: Nooo! I found the Sword first, and it belongs to me alone! One day I will find a way to get it out of the rocks, but only after I kill you!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.23.58.0: My lady, we have rebuilt North Harbour, but this time on the eastern side of the bay. We hope it will be better protected against future storms.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.23.62.0: We have almost no building materials left. Supplies from the south are often attacked by bands of robbers... Please try to do something about it, my lady.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.23.69.0: We wish to travel south, my lady, but we will join you if you wish!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.33.55.0: I was watching the funeral procession through my spyglass, my lady, and saw what happened. We must warn the people quickly!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.38.67.0: The unicorn runs back and forth in confusion until it notices you. Recognising its mistress, it bounds joyfully towards you.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.40.53.0:
North Harbour has been repaired, so we have closed the temporary docks.
And pay no attention to the shouting. It is a new ship trying to join the Guild of Far Explorers, and this is how they try to scare off the competition...
Who is Danon? A young fellow who claimed that his magic ring would keep him safe on distant voyages... Nobody has seen him for quite some time...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.43.63.0: Welcome, my lady. We are doing all we can to rebuild the town as quickly as possible.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.45.38.0:
Welcome. It is good to see you again...
I have little advice for you this time. Perhaps I can direct you to my teacher, who lives on the Isle of Woodland Wisdom. He is ancient, yet time seems never to have touched him...
And one more thing... You could also investigate the whirlpool that appeared among the ruins of the infernal town...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.46.69.0: Oh, my lady, I cannot help you, but perhaps our queen can...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.52.48.1:
Done, my lady!
Perhaps this will let us reach the Land of Fire in time!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.53.69.0:
We granted your mother eternal youth.... the fairy queen tells you...
Time never touched her, for she was partly its mistress. Go to her.
Her secret is hidden in a stone chest behind her grave.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.54.53.1:
Oh, Lady Marion?
What...
Wait! You are not the Lady of the Forest!
But...
No, it is you, you just look somehow different, and what happened to the gate?
There is no time for a long explanation, but the Lord
of the Isle quickly grasps the situation...
Then we must act very quickly... I believe the battle has not yet begun, my lady, so perhaps we can prevent the things you describe!
The Lord of the Isle summons all the monks and, after a brief discussion, sends a small group to its northern end.
There is only one way to do what cannot be done in time!
Ride to the northern end of the island. The monks will follow you!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.58.57.0:
The old librarian welcomes you:
Perhaps I have found a way to save our land...
We must open the Gate of Time and put everything right at the very beginning...
Go to the keeper of Lady Rachel's graves. Perhaps you will find answers to all your questions there.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.monster.67.48.0: As you already know, I am the keeper of Lady Rachel's graves. It falls to us to save Green Land. Come, I will tell you more.
A small group of demons gets in your way... Over their heads, you can see that Lord Michael's duel with the devils' leader remains undecided...
I am sorry, but the people fear the sea will advance as far as our village. So they have all abandoned it and gone south.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.44.54.0.c:
The crew of this ship saved my life. Without them, I would have died somewhere far away, and fish would be eating my bloated corpse. They deserve admission to the guild, says the rescued castaway. After a moment's thought, the guard agrees:
Very well, enter our guild.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.44.54.0.f: Members of the Guild of Far Explorers only, the sailor replies when you try to enter.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.44.54.0.n: Your story is interesting, but it is hardly enough to gain admission to our Guild. You must understand that we cannot accept everyone who has sailed the sea a little... How would that be fair to sailors who spend their entire lives aboard ships?
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.45.68.0.f:
Unfortunately, we cannot let you into the area inhabited by fairies unless you are accompanied by someone immune to the forest's enchantment.
You might fall into a magical sleep and never awaken, as Lady Rachel did...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.45.68.0.n: Forgive me, but you really cannot enter without an escort. You might fall into a magical sleep and never awaken, as Lady Rachel did...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.67.60.0.c:
Excellent!
This is exactly what we were missing.
The monks insert the temporal information into the gate's magical formula...
In theory, the gate should now function not only as a teleportation device for travelling between places, but also for travelling through time...
Then enter first, my lady, urges the head of the monks... We shall follow you and help you with your task...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.67.60.0.f: We must apply the artifact containing the temporal information to the gate. Only then will it function properly...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.67.60.0.n: We must apply the artifact containing the temporal information to the gate. Only then will it function properly...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.68.47.0.c:
By combining the powers of all three artifacts that control time, you successfully determine the moment to which you must return to put the twisted beginning right...
You place the temporal information in a most appropriate artifact: an Hourglass.
Now you must hurry to the Isle of Woodland Wisdom, where conditions may be suitable for opening the Gate of Time.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.68.47.0.f:
To open the Gates of Time, we need three magical artifacts linked to that dimension...
With their help, we can put the twisted beginning right.
But we must hurry before the power of Chaos grows too strong for us to do anything. We must be ready by the third full moon!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.68.47.0.n: Hurry! There is little time left!
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.69.70.0.c: If you are willing to pay for my work, you may take this ring.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.69.70.0.f:
I am Torgin the blacksmith. And it is true that I am the finest craftsman in my trade.
For a suitable reward, I will forge whatever you wish.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.quest.69.70.0.n:
A necklace?
Why, certainly. I can make one for you, but it is very intricate work and takes a great deal of time. Besides, you know my price.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.11.69.0.me: A once handsome sign lies utterly ruined in the dust of the road...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.14.56.0.me:
North to the Drunken Sailor tavern
East to the harbour
South to Podhorská
West to the forest
The last line has recently been crossed out.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.22.7.1.mes: There is nothing else in the bottle...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.23.57.0.me:
Neat lettering reads:
Welcome to the Northern Harbour of our beautiful Green Land.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.23.67.0.me:
The Last Crossroads
West to Podhorská
North to the Harbour
East to the woods
South to Lípová and onward towards the Capital
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.26.43.0.me: Here rests Sir Falidvin, treacherously murdered at the temple gate.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.26.45.0.me:
Here lies the brave Lord Michael.
...The word "lies" has been crossed out and replaced with "stands"...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.28.40.0.me: Here rests Lord Depresor, the Goblin-Slayer.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.3.34.0.mes:
On a rock in the middle of the strait stands a sign:
Welcome to the Great Northern Bay, whose waters wash the northern shores of the Green Land.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.30.43.0.me: Here rests Gardeion, brother of Lord Depresor.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.33.8.0.mes:
The message in the bottle warns:
Only an experienced captain can navigate the perils of the whirlpool...
All others will find only death here...
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.42.49.0.me: A sign on the rock announces that the Guild of Far Explorers has its headquarters in the southern bay.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.69.70.1.me:
Lord Michael's town.

map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.70.32.0.me:
On a rock in the middle of the strait stands a sign:
Welcome to the Great Northern Bay, whose waters wash the northern shores of the Green Land.
map.[ab] - cas utrpeni:3.sign.71.42.0.me: Here, upon an evergreen bed, rests fair Rachel, the forever young wife of Lord Michael and mother of Lady Marion.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.event.0.desc:
Welcome to everyone about to play this map!

You will find a great many quests here. Some must be completed to finish the map, while others are optional. Still, it is in your interest to complete them, as they usually pay quite well. Some will not help you much, though. That is entirely up to you!

This map has nothing to do with the film {Independence {Day}, apart from perhaps the title. It is set in the world of the great peoples of ancient South America, the Aztecs and Maya, who must rid the world of all evil under your command.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.event.1.desc: The Aztecs & Maya, the most advanced ancient civilisations of Central and South America. Their peoples lived in peace and tranquillity for many years, until devils and many other enemies entered their lives, intent on subjugating them. But what sort of great nations would let themselves be treated like that? Their enemies are numerous and spread throughout the land; some people have already joined them out of fear. So the Aztecs and Maya rose up and resolved to destroy all the devils and drive them back to hell, where they belong. The day this happens will be recorded as their {Independence {Day!}
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.event.2.desc: Of course, it is now up to you how you handle this. The road "to hell" will not be easy. At the start, choose whether to play as the Aztecs (Castle) or the Maya (Conflux). You will see how it works, but I will reveal no more.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.event.3.desc: The tomb robbers have shown their true colours again, plundering more of your ancient rulers' tombs.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.event.5.desc: Money, as though it had fallen from the sky!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.event.6.desc: It has been 250 days since you set out to fight the forces of hell! A little surprise awaits you on this momentous day:
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.event.7.desc: A whole year of wars and battles lies behind you. Your war against hell has dragged on for a very long time. At this rate, your Independence Day keeps slipping farther away while hell grows stronger! Pull yourself together and give them what for!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.event.8.desc:
This map was inspired by the "megalomaniac" map {Lord {of War} by Gwhenwyfar, translated by Khamul. {Independence {Day} is similar to that map. You will not find quite such enormous battles here, but some are truly worth it! 

I wish the best of luck to all you Heroes fans I know, and of course to those I do not!

{FIREBIRD
{firebird@email.cz
{http://www.mageo.cz/home/FIREBIRD/
A great treasure belonging to the inhabitants of these plains.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.10.13: Your path now leads straight to the Aztecs' main castle. If you wish to play as the Maya, take the other route!
Here is some wood, but the troops you will still need are elsewhere!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.102.1: That strange chest again. What could it hold this time?
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.104.4: Volcanoes are already visible to your right, which means hell is close by. Before you know it, several fiends have appeared on your deck!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.105.1: The treasure of the lords of hell...
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.106.3: You would find that handy, wouldn't you? But you will not get it just for batting your pretty eyes!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.107.2: Hello! A warm welcome, isn't it?
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.107.6: You rescued a castaway (who died anyway). With his last strength, he told you he had seen darkness from hell itself, but it had taken the form of two monsters rather than one. He also told you it was the dreaded Diablo, which means that Diablo actually exists twice in this world!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.11.12: You are leaving your homeland now. Be careful and trust no one. You never know who is in league with the devil!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.11.14:
You will return through this teleporter more than once!

But what is this? The mines in sight already belong to someone. Yes indeed, hell's reach is long!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.112.8: A mysterious islet in unknown distant waters holds another of these strange chests. Will you open it?
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.113.2: Welcome to the realm of darkness, home to both faces of hell: Diablo 1 & 2! It is very desolate here. Do not expect hospitable country!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.12.13: Your path now leads straight to the Maya's main castle. If you wish to play as the Aztecs, take the other route!
Here is some ore, but the troops you will still need are elsewhere!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.125.8: The stronghold of Diablo's first face is in sight!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.134.1: The stronghold of the terrible Diablo is now in sight! Worse still, this is his second, far more dreadful and darker form. This is one of those places on earth where no human foot has ever trodden. I also hope that before reaching here, you disposed of Diablo's first face nearby.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.134.3: The road ahead is buried. You must find a way around!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.134.6: Are you sure you know what you are getting into? Others like you have come before, and none returned. They never even got this far /my brother, for instance/!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.136.4: Here lie those who came before you...
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.137.1: Depending on your progress, this is probably your second-to-last major battle!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.139.9: If you take this artifact, a cruel punishment will befall you for your insolence!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.14.11: This gateway to unknown worlds will cause you much trouble!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.14.14: Here are some troops from nearby Mayan villages.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.14.22: A great deal of mercury, but you are not the only one who wants it!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.14.41:
The day of reckoning is probably approaching, if you are well enough equipped!
Depending on your progress, this is the last enemy castle. This enemy is not difficult!

Your people's Independence Day is within reach!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.16.18: And here comes the welcoming committee...
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.19.11: A large amount of gold never comes for free!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.19.22:
Plains of Eternal Snow...

WELCOME!

You are hardly likely to meet any fiends here...
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.2.2.0: Azure dragons in these parts? What could it mean? Are they friendly /try putting your head in their jaws, as you would with a tiger/, or not? Who will try? In any case, we will not fight for nothing!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.20.11: A large amount of gold never comes for free!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.20.41: If you can walk on water, enter. If not, leave...
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.20.44: You thought you would cross the water with ease, but you were mistaken.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.21.20: Large sums come at a high price. Remember that!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.21.36: Entrance to the northern territory. The Plains of Eternal Snow are nearby.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.24.98: Does the journey begin here again?
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.26.11: When you saw this strange-looking chest again, your first thought was whether it might be another trap...
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.31.14: Ferry service across the River of the Dead...
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.32.12: A great treasure of ancient civilisations! Will you take it?
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.38.12: "Quite a large treasure. Will you accept the battle?"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.38.13: This looks like your first encounter with hell. Are you brave enough?
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.39.14: On the River of the Dead, expect nothing but the dead!
The day of reckoning is probably approaching, if you are well enough equipped!
Depending on your progress, this is the last enemy castle. This enemy is not difficult!

Your people's Independence Day is within reach!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.40.34: Even travelling over water can be dangerous. Take great care! The peoples of hell are everywhere!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.43.10: You have just decided to take this shortcut along the coast. But will it be easier? The answer is: YES!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.47.13: What other spell could you wish for?
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.48.14: More dead have their sights set on you!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.49.21: This scroll will let you walk on the surface of the water.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.55.14: More and more dead stand against you!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.59.13: I know a dark little channel where the water runs deep. Just strike a rock there, and trouble comes in heaps!
{WARNING!}
As soon as you remove the red guard tower here, you will allow the blue enemy to reach the prison and free the commander imprisoned there. If that happens, you will never win your Independence Day!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.60.10:
The way home!
But as so often happens, even this road is blocked!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.63.36: ... could it all happen without a fight?
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.68.31: You have been ambushed by a large group of aquatic creatures!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.68.63: You are entering the lands of a desert people who sold themselves to hell!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.69.14: Here in the southern seas, you have found a strange-looking chest. You wonder whether to open it...
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.70.29:
"That was the first round of the trial we will put you through, warrior!" says the king of the underwater world!
"Now comes the second round. Prepare to die!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.71.14: "Did anyone give you permission to sail in here?"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.71.28: This is an artifact any hero could wish for!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.79.38: Do not avoid the battle in this castle. There is something here you will need!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.79.42: Snow is unfamiliar to you; it never fell in your homeland. Everything here looks strange, everything is too much alike, everything resembles itself. Where could this lead?
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.79.46: The tower of the ice mages who oppose you!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.79.59: So which way will you go?
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.8.142: Here are some troops from nearby Aztec villages.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.89.12: Sailing these waters with a small army is no easy matter. Do you have a large army or not? A little test is already waiting for you!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.guards.98.12: You have found the only channel to the other side, the side of evil and hell.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.header.descr: The Aztecs & Maya, two ancient peoples, are threatened by infernal forces and other enemies. Fight for their {Independence {Day!}
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.header.name: Independence Day
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.heroes.128.b: Leader of the rebellious Maya. The one you might finish this map with!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.heroes.2.bio: Leader of the rebellious Aztecs. The one you might finish this map with!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.heroes.56.bi: This hero will kick your arse! Whether you like it or not!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.heroes.6.bio: Red Angel is the nickname of this warrior, who already has much enemy blood on his hands.
"What do you want, worm?"
"Your hide!"
"Is that supposed to be a joke?"
"Listen, little dragons, we have rugs made from the likes of you back home!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.monster.11.1:
"Welcome! Whether you choose the path of the Aztecs or the Maya, you will need me! I will join you now, and you can choose which people you wish to play as. {Castle} is the Aztecs, and {Conflux} is the Maya. It makes little difference which people you choose. Pick whichever appeals to you more."
"Then keep the other hero or dismiss him. That is your business."
"Warrior, you are unlucky enough to have to get past us, but you have no chance!"
"We guard the entrance to the breeding grounds of the desert world's warriors. You are an intruder, you do not belong here, and you will lose your head!"
"You also need to reach another enemy who is still tormenting your nearby homeland. I am the key to reaching him. Take me with you!"
After a long search, you have finally found the dragons you must slay to gain access to the blue Keymaster's Tent!
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.monster.17.5: "If you take me with you now, you will be able to use the other castle too!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.monster.29.1: "We are at your service against the evil ones, sir!"
"What do you want, worm?"
"Your hide!"
"Is that supposed to be a joke?"
"Listen, little dragons, we have rugs made from the likes of you back home!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.monster.65.1: "Welcome, adventurer. I am your pass to the first of your enemies. It is entirely up to you which one you choose to face first. Just make sure nothing happens to me!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.monster.72.1:
The forest moves a short distance away...

... suddenly, a creature begins to materialise there...

... now you can see it. It is a strange dragon, unlike anything the Aztecs/Maya have ever seen. After a very brief attempt to persuade it, you conclude that it is definitely not on your side.
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.monster.74.1: "So you are the Aztec/Mayan king? What a joke! You call yourself a hero? Come on, show us what you can do!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.monster.83.3: "Our stronghold will never belong to you!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.quest.104.53: Will you give up the artifact?
The artifact you need is in the Rocky Mountains!
"As I said, in the Rocky Mountains, far from here. Now leave!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.quest.108.14: "Excellent, Diablo has fallen! Here is your reward!"
An old man lives in this tree, a war veteran who has long awaited Diablo's destruction!
"Diablo still lives. Go and find him!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.quest.110.20: "I see the castle now flies your colours. Enter."
"You will have to conquer this nearby castle!"
"The castle still does not belong to you. Leave!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.quest.136.13: As you stepped into the gateway, it opened by itself. Diablo's first face is gone from this world, but save your pat on the back for later. His second face is still here!
Until Diablo's first face is destroyed, you will never reach the second, which lies beyond this gate!
"Diablo's first face is still among us. Kill that one first!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.quest.17.105: Destroy the group of Sharpshooters (Sharpshooter) nearby.
"Find the warrior named Red Angel. He has what you need!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.quest.31.109:
"So you did not freeze to death there?" the mage asks with a touch of humour.
"Excellent. If you give me that shield, the way is open. But remember, death awaits you there!"

"Welcome, brave leader of the Aztecs / Maya. I guard the monolith that leads to one of your great enemies. This enemy is far better than you, so if you decide to enter, prepare for hard times. Once you have gathered all your courage, search the \"Plains of Eternal Snow\". There you will find what I want," one of the white mages tells you.
"In the Plains of Eternal Snow. Go..."
"Welcome! Surely you can see the rust dragons nearby. Kill them, and you may pass!"
"I have a surprise for heroes of this level!"
"Come and see me when you reach level 25!"
"You found it! Impossible! Here is the promised scroll. Use it well!"

Before handing over the artifact, make sure you have Expert Earth Magic and Wisdom (Wisdom)!

"Welcome, brave commander. If you bring me the artifact I request, I will give you a spell so powerful that it exists only 2 times in this world. It is written on my scroll and on another that is lost somewhere."
"You do not have the artifact, so you get nothing. I cannot tell you where it is hidden; I do not know myself!"
map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.quest.78.134: They were speechless when they discovered you had actually succeeded. You are free to enter!

The war veterans in this guard tower want you to kill a group of faerie dragons. They no longer know exactly where they are; their only advice is that they are said to be somewhere in hell.

"We may not know exactly where they are, but we know they are not dead yet," say the veterans.

map.[ab] - den nezávislosti.sign.28.20.0:
These soldiers are loyal to you!

If they are still here when you arrive!

Things are looking up in "Hide Aztek"!

map.[ab] - gryfi rise:0.header.descripti: After the greatest battle in the land of demons and the death of Xellos, lord of the elements, we drove all our enemies here, into the Griffin Mountains. Here we will destroy them all with the help of the griffins who dwell here.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:0.header.name: Griffin Empire Part 7. Epilogue
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:1.event.0.descript: We encountered a group of gnolls. They stopped us and asked for help. They told us how hideously the demons had subjugated all the creatures of the swamps. They built a tower in the swamps and placed the Orb of Vulnerability inside it. Two such orbs exist. One is in the swamps, the other far away in the land of demons. They act as a one-way portal. The demons send spells through the one in their own land. A dimension door carries them to the swamps, where they destroy everything from trees to dwellings, and kill. "We could have left, but the demons locked many of our valuables inside the tower and imprisoned our women and the creatures who live in the swamps there. We managed to escape. Expect all of them to fight against you."
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:1.event.1.descript: This morning, it occurred to you that if you captured the orb and brought it to the castle, the monks might be able to reverse its effect. Any spell the demons sent through it would then turn against them. It is our only chance.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:1.guards.40.4.0.me: All the women and creatures have fled back to the swamps. Now we must capture the orb.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:1.header.descripti: Our scout told us a great demon army was approaching from the east. I asked how that was possible, and he told me that the land of demons lay to the east. The demons have lured us straight into a trap!
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:1.header.name: Griffin Empire Part 4.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:1.sign.36.4.0.mess: Tower of the Orb of Vulnerability
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:2.event.0.descript: You have received a letter from Prince Christian: Thank you for coming to our aid. The demons are powerful, but many monsters also dwell underground and attack us. Our only good fortune is that these creatures kill one another too. To win, we must find the holy Grail and build its sanctuary. This will revive the army of titans left here by the mages, the first inhabitants of this land. The demons, however, exterminated every last mage. Good luck!
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:2.header.name: Griffin Empire Part 5.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.event.0.descript: Your chief adviser, whom Prince Christian assigned to you, told you this yesterday: Xellos is the lord of the elements. He is the last of the Beasts. All the other Beasts were exterminated in the war between the Dragons and the Beasts. The Dragons and Beasts were the first inhabitants of this land. After all the Beasts died, Xellos gained the power of the elements. Nobody knows how, but he gained it. He slaughtered all the Dragons himself. Yet that power was too great even for him. He locked himself inside a tower that dampens his power. Whenever he casts a spell, he regains his full strength, but as soon as he finishes, it is suppressed again. We must find the entrance to that tower and destroy him once and for all. But beware: he sees everything and can use the elements against us from anywhere, wherever we are.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.guards.28.33.0.m: A firebird flew over your head.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.guards.30.33.0.m: You barely had time to look around before many of your men were dead. Fire elementals are attacking!
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.guards.32.35.0.m: You had scarcely crossed the river of lava when magma elementals emerged.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.guards.52.66.0.m: Hmm, what is this? It has begun to rain, but only over you. The water starts taking shape, then solidifies.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.guards.55.12.0.m: What happened? The mud beneath you hardened and took shape. This Xellos is really starting to annoy me.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.guards.59.9.0.me: I think this leads to the passage into the tower
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.header.descripti: The time for the final battle has come. We attacked with all our strength and conquered the entire south. Now we must destroy Xellos, lord of the elements. Some claim he is also a demigod. He comes from the ancient race of Beasts, the first and most powerful inhabitants of this land.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.header.name: Griffin Empire Part 6.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.monster.66.3.0.m: Captain, we are soldiers of the eighth cavalry. We would gladly join you.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.16.51.0.co: Excellent, here are all the Halberdiers.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.16.51.0.fi: I can turn your 30 Archers into 60 Halberdiers. Just bring them here.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.16.51.0.ne: Think it over. Either bring them or do not.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.19.62.0.co: Excellent, I have finished training them. Here they are.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.19.62.0.fi: I can train your infantry into excellent archers. Just bring 25 Halberdiers, and I will train them into Marksmen.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.35.55.0.co: I managed to clone a few of them. Here you are.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.35.55.0.fi: Hello, I am a scientist. I am currently researching cloning. If you bring me some guinea pigs, I may be able to clone them.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.35.55.0.ne: Hurry, I have not got all my life.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.53.17.0.co: At last! Give me 12000 gold, and here are my best men.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.53.17.0.fi: For 12000, I will give you my best men. If you give me 12000, you will receive 20 Crusaders.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.53.17.0.ne: Certainly not! That is not enough. I need 12000 gold. I will not give you my men for what you have.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.57.8.0.fir: For 7 Earth Elementals and 7 Fire Elementals, I can offer you a respectable army of 20 Marksmen.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.57.8.0.nex: No luck finding 7 Earth Elementals and 7 Fire Elementals?
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.62.47.0.co: At last! Give me 10 wood, and I will join you.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.62.47.0.fi: A noble knight came out of the cottage. I need wood to build my wife a bathroom. If you bring it to me, my brother and I will join you.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.62.47.0.ne: Certainly not! That is not enough. I need 10 wood. I will never finish the bathroom with what you have.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.64.3.0.fir: I am a surgeon studying internal organs. If you bring me one Imp, I will give you my assistants: 10 Crusaders.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.71.34.0.co:
Excellent, I will give them armour.


Half an hour later

Here they are.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.71.34.0.fi: The blacksmith came out of the cottage and told you he could turn your 2 Cavaliers into 2 Champions.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.71.34.0.ne: No luck finding 2 Cavaliers? Without them, I will have nobody to upgrade.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.quest.72.48.0.fi: You have entered a mercenary tavern. For 1000 gold, 30 Marksmen will join you.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:3.sign.7.57.0.mess:
Volcano of Doom

In honour of the first demon to fall into the volcano, after whom it is named. His name was Fuck This Fate.
He died in the year xxxxx
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:4.guards.1.30.1.me: The element of water is next.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:4.guards.20.38.1.m: The next element we must defeat is fire.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:4.guards.44.6.1.me: The fairy who first spoke to you approaches and says: You have defeated all four elements and proved yourself the fairies' chosen one. Here is our strength, the power of the four elements.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:4.guards.5.4.1.mes: The first element you must defeat is earth.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:4.guards.56.68.0.m: On the road, you encountered an old man. You asked what he was doing here, and he told you he was investigating the secret of Fairy Lake. He claimed it might be the last chance to destroy the goblins. Perhaps you should try to unravel Fairy Lake's secret. Incidentally, the man's name was Al Pacino. And before I forget, he gave you this hat.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:4.guards.61.66.0.m:
Suddenly, fairies surround you, and one of them says:

Halt, strangers! What do you want here?

I am Niris, leader of these people. Demons drove us from our land, and now we seek salvation and a new home.

Al Pacino told you that the four elements of the earth cannot be defeated easily. But if you are the chosen one, who knows? We must go on.

Hmm, that is interesting. Our legends tell this very story: one day, a chosen one will come who will lead us and be able to wield our power. But to prove yourself, you must pass a trial. You must defeat all four elements of the earth.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:4.guards.69.7.0.me: The people of this town welcomed you without minding that you were a stranger. A man they call the steward approached and said that goblins ruled this land. They invaded long ago, and this lone fortress still resists them. Help us stop them.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:4.header.descripti: The demons have driven us into these parts. What awaits us here?
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:4.header.name: Griffin Empire Part 1.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:4.town.71.6.0.name: AntiGoblin
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:5.event.0.descript: Our men have done good work. They fortified the camp and built a Town Hall. Here we will found a new town.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:5.event.1.descript: To win, we must capture their fortress. But it is well fortified.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:5.header.descripti: Before long, more goblins from the north attacked our rear. We defended ourselves, but to be rid of them, we will have to destroy them. That is why we have come here, to Lake Quake, where the goblins have their fortress. We will literally have to exterminate them to be left in peace.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:5.header.name: Griffin Empire Part 2.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:6.header.descripti: The elves are plagued by goblins. We offered to help them if they would then help us. They agreed and withdrew to the fortress of Oversoul beyond the Great Mountain Range.
map.[ab] - gryfi rise:6.header.name: Griffin Empire Part 3.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.1.31.0.messa: That strange structure looks like a subway entrance designed by a drunken architect. What could lie beyond it?
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.10.26.1.mess:
Heeelp! Heeelp!
You really are not imagining it. Someone is calling for help from the old prison. But the shouting has also woken the dozing scoundrels. . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.14.26.1.mess: You were just reaching for the prison's rusty bolt to free the poor creature when the door suddenly flew open and a gang of vagabonds rushed at you. It seems those outside were only an advance guard.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.17.1.0.messa: A dull thud came from behind the trees, as though someone had slammed something shut. What could it be?
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.18.0.0.messa: You see an old chest surrounded by a gang of shaggy little people. Damn, they are dwarven robbers who have hidden their loot here. They will surely want to dispose of an inconvenient witness. You waste no time and follow the motto: the best defence is attack!
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.19.18.1.mess: So it probably is not a subway after all. . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.21.1.1.messa: You have heard that dragons like to hoard ancient treasures. This one had so much junk that you would need a removal crew to carry it all away. But an old, richly decorated box right on top caught your eye. You looked inside and found several rings.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.22.1.1.messa: You see the blue monster the knights told you about. Rather than wait for it to attack, you draw your sword and charge . . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.26.21.1.mess: You chopped those monsters into splinters. At least you have added some wood to your supplies.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.4.4.0.messag: What terrain! Those blasted swamps again. You wonder what else is in store for you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.4.6.1.messag: You have had enough of all this trudging about. Why did you not stay at home?
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.8.17.0.messa: At last! You can see the swamps will soon end. What a relief!
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.9.26.1.messa: Suddenly, you think you hear a deep rumbling. You stop and listen quietly. Then it dawns on you: that is snoring. Now you can see them too. A gang of scoundrels lies nearby, snoring so loudly the surrounding rocks are crumbling. Ruffians like these are no laughing matter. You had better slip past them quietly.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.guards.9.33.1.messa: Oh, nooo! A TV N@va crew rushes up to ask how your search is going. They get everywhere, the bastards! You nearly ride your horse to death trying to escape them.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.header.description: Your journey begins here. You must find the Endless Sack of Gold and bring it to your town. Your main hero can advance to a maximum of level 15. Along with his abilities and spells, he carries the Endless Sack of Gold and Celestial Necklace of Bliss into the next scenario, if he finds them.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.header.name: The First Journey
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.heroes.11.biography: Adelaide had a very sad childhood. She grew up in a broken home with an alcoholic mother. So she left home at twelve and made a living with her body. No, she did not bite her nails. (The slower readers will understand in a few years.) She had the figure and the face for it, but rather less between her ears. Mainly for these reasons, she ended up as Nemakačenko's companion.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.heroes.26.biography: Honza lived a quiet, peaceful life until he set out to seek his fortune in the world. Now he works for the multimillionaire Nemakačenko, and sometimes he has his work cut out just staying alive.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.heroes.26.name: Honza
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.1.5.0.messa: A hideous buzzing suddenly drowned out every sound around you. A swarm of disgusting insects rose from a nearby tree and attacked your party.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.10.13.0.mes: A tent camp stands beside the forest, occupied by some peculiar scouts. You have arrived just as they are earning their bravery badges, with orders to attack every passer-by.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.13.12.1.mes: We, descendants of ancient times, will let you go no farther! Behind us lies the grave of our lawyer, who helped us in our hour of need. We killed a few people "by accident", and he got us off with suspended sentences.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.14.4.0.mess: You did not pick the best time to buy wood for cladding your cottage. The sawmill workers are on strike because the previous owner has not paid them for six months. Before you can explain what you want, they attack without warning.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.15.16.0.mes: Fairies like pretty, glittering trinkets. These ones look ready to defend theirs at any cost.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.16.13.0.mes: This is a private club, stranger. Members' cards only. Or do we have to explain it with our fists?
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.19.16.0.mes: A tectonic fault here causes magical energy to well up around the mines. There is so much of it that diamonds spontaneously gather into monsters called diamond golems. Having been created by magic, they are almost impervious to spells.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.19.33.1.mes: Some little blind monsters crawled out of an underground fissure. It seems their infrared vision was drawn to your lit Marlboro. They look harmless enough, but there are as many of them as pensioners at the post office on pension day.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.20.2.1.mess: What are you doing here? Even tax collectors dare not set foot here!
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.24.24.0.mes: The owner of this mine has hired some strange security guards. It looks as though he signed a pact with the devil to obtain his minions . . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.27.22.1.mes: Something about that dead forest bothered you from the start. You were right. Suddenly, the dead trees began waving their branches, and not in greeting. They pulled their roots from the ground and moved towards you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.3.15.1.mess: Get lost, stranger! We stole these boots fair and square!
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.3.32.0.mess: We know how much you would like to look down below, but you will not get there so easily. The only way through is past us!
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.31.26.0.mes: Now that is interesting. It looks as though some beautiful horses escaped from someone's ranch and took a liking to this wilderness. It must have happened long ago, because they look thoroughly wild.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.31.8.1.mess: These doggies do not look like house pets! You will have to "play" with them a little differently.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.35.13.0.mes: Anyone wishing to enter the arena must first prove themselves worthy . . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.5.19.0.mess:
Haven't got any, won't give any, won't lend any!
These little boots are mine!
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.7.3.0.messa: You went to the quarry to look for stone suitable for building a fireplace. Suddenly, a herd of wild boar rushed at you from the little wood.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.monster.8.10.0.mess: Hey, lad, get lost! We collect the protection money here! This is our turf!
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.10.19.0.compl: Yes! Exactly what I needed! As a reward, I offer you this pendant. What do you say? Shall we shake on a good deal?
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.10.19.0.first: I had a precious ring, an old family heirloom. It means a great deal to me. But one day, my hut was burgled and the ring vanished too. If you find it on your travels, bring it back. I will reward you generously. You will recognise it by the relief of a White Dove.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.10.19.0.nextV: Have you brought it? I need the Diplomat's Ring. You must search thoroughly.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.10.6.1.comple: Welcome, hero! We see you have passed the test. Will you exchange that hide for free passage?
