map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.10.6.1.firstV: The tower guards stop you. "Only true heroes may go farther. An azure dragon's hide will serve as your pass. If you wish to pass, you must bring its hide for us to see. As it happens, a dragon lives underground here. You are sure to find it if you take the northeastern route."
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.10.6.1.nextVi: You again? Empty-handed again? You must bring us an azure dragon's hide, or you will go no farther.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.18.3.0.comple: At last! Exactly what I needed! Are you willing to exchange the pendant for this necklace?
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.18.3.0.firstV: Long ago, a wizard knew how to make powerful magical artifacts. But it was so long ago that nobody now knows how to make a new, powerful artifact. I would like to learn, but I need one of the old artifacts. First, I must understand how they were made. If you bring me the Necklace of Ocean Guidance, I will reward you well. You will recognise it easily: its pendant looks like a golden dolphin.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.18.3.0.nextVi: Still nothing? You must bring me that pendant as soon as possible. Try searching harder.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.25.32.1.compl: Welcome, stranger. I see the moment of my release is near. Will you give me those boots so I may depart in peace?
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.25.32.1.first: You have reached a tower where the ghost of a dead knight wails. He must guard this passage and cannot depart for the realm of the dead. You can free him and gain free passage by bringing him the boots stolen from his corpse.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.25.32.1.nextV: Well, traveller, have you brought my boots? I am still waiting for someone to free me.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.29.2.1.comple: We see you have had better luck hunting than we have. Will you exchange the trolls for free passage?
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.29.2.1.firstV: Troll hunters have settled in the guard tower. They refuse to let you pass unless you bring them 10 Trolls. They need to meet their capture quota and have not encountered a single troll in a long time.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.quest.29.2.1.nextVi: Unless we get those 10 Trolls, you will not go another step!
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.event.0:
A few notes before you begin
* Remember that you will play the entire campaign with Honza. If he dies, the whole campaign ends. 
* In the first three scenarios, your main hero can advance only to a certain level. Do not rush to complete a map's objective before reaching that level or visiting every location that improves your abilities. You will be better prepared for the next scenario. This applies to every scenario. 
* Since the campaign editor has certain limitations, some things are done the way they are, and no other way :-).
I would also like to thank Gremlin and Leki for their comments and help testing the campaign. Special thanks to Gremlin for his patience in checking the text of every map and his valuable feedback from testing the whole campaign. Thank you!!!
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.event.1: Nemakačenko's secretary called to say her boss had discovered a hot lead. He will have it checked and then send you a message.

In a town that shall remain nameless lived Foolish Honza. To be clear, Foolish was his surname. Honza was not foolish at all. He was simply terribly lazy and as crafty as they come. One day, however, his parents became fed up and refused to keep supporting him while he lounged about at home, never having done anything useful in his life. So our dear Honza had to set out into the world. As we already know from the prologue, Honza entered the service of the multimillionaire Nemakačenko. What happens to him next depends entirely on you. . .

Well, here you are. Nemakačenko's gorillas have brought you to his cottage, where his girlfriend was kidnapped. You have been given the run of the place: the cottage, not the girlfriend :-). To tell the truth, there is not much in it. Nemakačenko never told you that the scoundrels thoroughly cleaned out his cottage during the kidnapping too. (It probably means little to him, and who knows what he kept here if he did not even report it.) You will have to work hard to put the place in order and make it fit to live in.
You must do it quickly, because all sorts of tramps roam the area. Only a few of his lackeys have stayed behind to help you. They also left you a mobile phone so you can report any news.
The gorillas have driven off, and there is nothing for it but to begin your search.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.event.2: A removal van arrived with the gorillas and brought you some furnishings. So Nemakačenko clearly knows what state the place is in. He could have put it in order before sending you here.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.event.3:
You received a text message on your mobile:
The hot lead proved false. Continue your search. 
N.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.event.4:
Your mobile's battery has run out, and you have no way to recharge it. So there will probably be no more messages from Nemakačenko. You must rely on yourself.
He could have had electricity installed . . . 
. . . or bought a generator . . .
. . . or built a wind turbine . . 
. . . or             . . .
It will work out somehow.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.event.5: This is starting to annoy you. Some scoundrels have robbed you again. You will have to keep a proper watch on the place.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.event.6:
Unbelievable!
You went to get wood for new shutters, and when you returned, you found the door kicked in. Some uninvited guests helped themselves to part of your supplies.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.event.7:
Now you are really angry!
Your supplies have been plundered again! It must have been those campers on the nearby forest clearing. You pick a few lads and decide to launch a punitive expedition against them.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.event.8: The punitive expedition succeeded. You recovered all your supplies and a little extra. They must have stolen it from the surrounding cottages.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.event.9: A travelling salesman stopped by. A badge on his pink jacket read: Want to lose weight? Ask me how. He tried to foist some health food on you, but he was no match for you. Instead, you managed to sell him your dead mobile phone.
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.12.4.0.name: Horní Lhota
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.13.29.0.name: Dolní Horní
map.[ab] - honza 1:0.town.27.8.0.name: Horní Dolní
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.15.5.0.messa: You did not take the guards' threats seriously. But who told them to pick a fight with you?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.17.6.0.messa: You stop in astonishment and watch four bound elements swirling in perfect harmony nearby. You do not see a spectacle like that every day. It is even prettier than your visit to Křižík's Fountain.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.2.23.1.messa: After defeating the dragons, you claimed the treasure they had hoarded here.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.21.17.0.mess: You see a monk meditating beneath a tree. Monks are supposed to help people, aren't they? Why not ask him for some good advice?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.24.15.0.mess: Look, it seems nobody is home. You will simply move in, and that is that. Unlike you, the previous tenants are out of luck. People do it all the time these days.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.25.8.1.messa: It does not look much like a hotel, but you hope they will feed you and let you rest. You have had enough of all this trudging about. The gates are opening, and someone is coming towards you. But why are there so many of them? Wouldn't the landlord alone be enough?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.26.60.0.mess: It does not look much like a hotel, but you hope they will feed you and let you rest. You have had enough of all this trudging about. The gates are opening, and someone is coming towards you. But why are there so many of them? Wouldn't the landlord alone be enough?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.27.20.0.mess:
The clearing ahead glows with a strange light. You have never seen anything like it.
So many fires together! But they could start a forest fire! Quickly, put out those flames!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.29.55.0.mess: What terrain! Cracks and rocks everywhere . . . Your horse nearly broke a leg. Now it can barely drag itself along. You must have new horseshoes made for it.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.36.35.1.mess: Someone was looking for this. Now, if only you could remember who.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.53.19.0.mess: Well, since they were so rude, you will take over the Alchemist's Lab for your own use.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.54.42.1.mess: Let us see why the giants defended that little chest so fiercely.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.56.10.1.mess: That statue looks familiar. Wasn't someone asking you for it?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.57.46.0.mess: It does not look much like a hotel, but you hope they will feed you and let you rest. You have had enough of all this trudging about. The gates are opening, and someone is coming towards you. But why are there so many of them? Wouldn't the landlord alone be enough?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.59.28.0.mess: You cancelled the security guards like an invalid tenancy order. Now let us see how much you have in your account.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.60.10.0.mess: A gang of drunks staggered out of the nearby tavern after being refused any more drinks. When they spotted you, they decided to have a little fun with you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.66.26.0.mess: A beggar stops you and asks for a little food. As it happens, you just bought a cheeseburger for a snack, so you offer it to him. He thanks you, much to your surprise, and says he overheard two local mobsters discussing a mysterious Grail somewhere in these parts. He tucks the cheeseburger into his overcoat and vanishes into thin air. There goes your snack; you will have to buy another.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.guards.9.46.1.messa: It does not look much like a hotel, but you hope they will feed you and let you rest. You have had enough of all this trudging about. The gates are opening, and someone is coming towards you. But why are there so many of them? Wouldn't the landlord alone be enough?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.header.description: Your task in this region is to gather 100 Phoenixes. Your hero can advance to level 25. He enters the next scenario with all his attributes and experience. Besides the artifacts he has at the start, he can also carry over the Cape of Velocity and Titan`s Gladius if he obtains them.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.header.name: The Second Journey
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.15.4.0.mess: Heeey! Trying to slip through without a ticket? You will pay dearly for that!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.25.21.0.mes:
Leave my little ones alone. They have done nothing to you. Please do not take them from me!
The poor things are so helpless.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.29.25.0.mes: The blacksmith does not wish to be disturbed. He has too much work before the coming harvest!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.31.13.0.mes: The little fire burns bright, but you will not roast your bacon on it!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.39.8.0.mess: So you fancy a trip to the underworld? We can grant your wish!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.42.16.0.mes: We mine here! We need those diamonds for our magic staves, to store magical energy!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.43.21.0.mes: Leave our tree alone. Vandals like you tore off half its branches last time. Do you know how long we had to tend it before it recovered?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.43.4.0.mess: Halt! You must not enter this mine! No mining has taken place here for years! The mine has collapsed, and we must let nobody inside, to prevent further casualties!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.44.9.0.mess: This precious helmet belongs to our herd leader. We know how it goes: first you seize the helmet, then you seize us . . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.48.25.0.mes: Where do you think you are pushing? Get in line. We were here first . . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.50.7.0.mess: Have you still not realised these sacred stones belong to the forest folk? Then keep your hands off them!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.52.19.0.mes: Several clay statues stand outside the Alchemist's Lab. But as you approach, you realise your mistake. The alchemists have summoned earth elementals to protect them.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.54.8.0.mess: That obelisk is ours! It bears the history of our people. We will not let you smear your filthy paws all over it!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.55.3.0.mess: So you want some little stones, do you? Come on, then!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.58.27.0.mes: Security guards stop you outside the local bank branch and tell you that you cannot enter armed. But you desperately need the cash. Put down your trusty weapon? Surely those clowns cannot be serious?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.60.23.0.mes: Dragons like their privacy and hate uninvited guests. The inhabitants of this dragon town have used a powerful spell to control the trees along the road. They hope the trees' numbers will protect them from unwanted visitors.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.60.5.0.mess:
Ubleauiii ouebaa buuu . . .
The zombies had no time to say anything else. You are in no mood for such nonsense, so you attack them at once.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.63.2.0.mess: Where do you think you are going, bumpkin! Turn around and clear off, or we will drive you out at a run. Do you think you can stroll in here as though it were a pigsty?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.monster.68.20.0.mes: Where are you rushing off to, yokel! Our lady friends are expecting far better company! Surely you do not think they would go with a bumpkin like you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.33.14.0.compl: That is it! I can exchange it for the sword with which I performed many heroic deeds. Do you agree to the trade?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.33.14.0.first: Welcome, friend. I have a favour to ask. I have been in this world a very long time, and my days are numbered. But I would like to stay a few more years. The Ring of Vitality, which grants life-giving strength, could help me. Bring it to me, and you will not regret it.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.33.14.0.nextV: You still do not have the ring? I do not have much time left.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.51.23.0.compl: Yes, that is it! Will you return it for this finder's fee?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.51.23.0.first: I once had a powerful talisman. But I lost it underground while searching for a rare rock for a spell. If you see it on your travels, bring it to me, and you will receive a generous finder's fee.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.51.23.0.nextV: You have not seen my talisman anywhere yet? A pity. Perhaps you will find it someday.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.65.13.0.compl: So you succeeded. Do you want to make the trade with me, then?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.65.13.0.first: I have heard of your mission. I could help you a little. I am Lucifer's agent, recruiting reinforcements for the infernal realm. If you bring me 10 Arch Devils and 10 Efreet Sultans, I will trade them for 20 Firebirds.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.65.13.0.nextV: I see you have not found much yet. I cannot help you for now.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.65.49.0.compl: So you found the statue after all. Will you return it to me for these birds?
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.65.49.0.first: I have heard you are gathering birds. I once had a favourite falcon too. He was so dear to me that when he died, I had a statue made of him. But I lost it. If you find it for me, I will get you some birds.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.quest.65.49.0.nextV: Still nothing? Never mind. Try looking more carefully.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.sign.41.39.1.messag: Warning! You are entering another sector!
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.town.11.44.1.name: Kostivin
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.town.12.29.0.name: Lost Village
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.town.26.14.0.name: In Seclusion
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.town.28.59.0.name: Rarachov
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.town.28.7.1.name: Sulfur Den
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.town.50.60.1.name: Nemanice
You have rented this villa, which will serve as your command centre. From here, you will venture into the surrounding countryside in search of phoenixes. You have your work cut out, for they are rare birds. Nobody has ever seen more than two together. It will probably take weeks to assemble a whole flock.
Even Nemakačenko admitted you could not chase phoenixes across such a vast region alone, so he assigned you another assistant. Since he is junior to you, you allotted him a stretch of wilderness and chose a slightly more civilised area for yourself. Let the lad learn that life will not coddle him.

You received a message from Nemakačenko:
"I thought you would make a little more effort. So far, you have achieved very little. At this rate, even our great-grandchildren will never see that zoo!"
Maintenance workers came to the villa and installed some new equipment. They said it was on Nemakačenko's own orders.
What a dirty trick! Nobody told you that you would have to pay the villa's rent yourself! You might as well have stayed in a hotel and spared yourself the trouble.
The villa's owner has come for the rent again. You have no choice but to pay if you want a roof over your head. Still, you managed to talk him into a lower price, since you are renting long-term.
Good news from Nemakačenko. He sees you are doing your best and has given you a special bonus. Not much, but every little helps.

A strange epidemic broke out in your creature dwellings. You had to summon a specialist urgently. A good thing you did. If you had ignored it, all your monsters would have died within a week. Instead, the outbreak was caught early, and you lost nothing. Except, perhaps, the money you had to pay the specialist.

Some people! A health inspector came to check on you, and when he saw everything you were keeping in the villa, he wanted to shut the place down immediately. Luckily, he was only human too, and easily bribed.
Your miners have struck a rich vein. A yield like the one they brought you today is a rare sight.
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.town.54.13.0.name: Guesthouse
map.[ab] - honza 1:1.town.57.45.0.name: Ugla - Ugla
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.guards.19.6.0.messa: You lucky thing. I have never found anything valuable in my life, and you nearly break your leg tripping over a bag full of gold.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.guards.27.7.0.messa: These zombies had a peculiar fondness for robbing travellers. But not many can have passed this way, because there is not much gold.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.guards.30.26.0.mess: They say the third time is the charm. Apparently not here. This is already the third group of warriors from the nearby School of War.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.guards.31.21.0.mess: That School of War in your territory is a damned nuisance. More of its graduates stand before you, looking even more dangerous than the previous ones.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.guards.32.44.0.mess: A tent stands beyond the stone gateway. A little rest would not go amiss. But suddenly you hear a strange rustling in the bushes beside the road and stare in disbelief. You have never seen such overgrown lizards in your life. Some pesky insects also begin attacking from the air. Rest will have to wait.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.guards.38.26.0.mess:
Private property!
No unauthorised entry!
Members of the Church of Satan only!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.guards.40.26.0.mess: Those cattle certainly gave you a run for your money. Let us hope they do not have mad cow disease. It seems to be spreading lately.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.guards.61.11.0.mess: That is the end of you lot. You have sacked that devil's den and found a strange orb on the main altar, resting on a stand covered in mysterious runes. You cannot read them, but you feel the magical aura radiating from the orb. It seems to have been their sacred object.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.guards.61.9.0.messa: It looks as though the sect's monastery lies beyond this gate. Though at first glance, it looks more like a prison.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.header.description: Your task is to find Nemakačenko's daughter Pipinka, who has joined a sect. Your hero can advance to level 35 and, as usual, carries his abilities and skills into the next scenario. He can add the Legs of Legion and Orb of Vulnerability to his existing artifacts. He forgets his spells when the scenario ends.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.header.name: The Third Journey
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.heroes.120.biograph: Nemakačenko's spoiled daughter grew up in luxury from the cradle. She always had everything she could wish for. Sometimes she was so idle and pampered she could think of nothing else to want. That proved her undoing, and she ended up here.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.heroes.120.name: Pipinka
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.11.10.0.mes: That does not look like ordinary livestock.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.13.17.0.mes: Mages from the ogre village have come to this mine for magical crystals. They do not like the idea of sharing, so they have decided to get rid of you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.18.20.0.mes: If a hero can be found to destroy these ghosts, the curse on the magical plain will end.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.19.19.0.mes: A great battle between the armies of two powerful mages once took place on this magical plain. The soil's magical power sometimes causes the combatants to appear by the memorial obelisk and wage an endless battle. It is unwise to pass by at such a time.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.22.20.0.mes: A group of black warriors is searching these parts for a helmet their tribal shaman lost here. Afraid you might find it first, they attack without warning.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.22.25.0.mes: Outside the dwarven settlement, you met a few minotaurs who had just had their axes sharpened. They look angry because, as usual, the dwarves cheated them. It seems they intend to take their anger out on your party.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.27.6.0.mess: The one with the meat cleaver probably is not a butcher. Especially since he is swinging it at you. . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.28.17.0.mes: You met elven warrior women who had just passed their examination at the School of War. In high spirits, they decided to put their lessons into practice.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.29.29.0.mes: You have heard that these warriors are masters of the whip. It seems you are about to find out first-hand.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.30.23.0.mes: Your words proved true. You had barely taken a few steps when the ring of countless swords being drawn rang out.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.38.21.0.mes: You must not disturb our master. He is preparing a new edition of the Atlas of All Seas.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.41.6.0.mess: Some dangerous-looking lads stopped you outside the tower. They seem uninterested in discussion and get straight to business.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.42.26.0.mes: The grazing herd grew restless at the sight of your red flag. Choosing that colour was probably foolish. You look like an envoy from a certain eastern power. But it is too late to change colours now. Slowly but surely, the herd is moving towards you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.45.8.0.mess: The exchange office is closed to the public today! So we will not let you in!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.53.16.0.mes: Only members of the Church of Satan may enter the Plain of Wisdom to further their knowledge. You do not look like a member of our order. You will pay with your miserable life for trying to set foot on our sacred ground!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.6.2.0.messa: The gatekeepers refuse to speak with you. The only language they know is that of swords.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.61.12.0.mes: So you want to join our sect? I do not think that will work. We only accept very rich people and help them rid themselves of their possessions. You do not look as though you have any money at all.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.monster.9.14.0.mess: Outside the local savings bank, you met a few strangers going to deposit their savings. Something about you must have bothered them, because they suddenly drew their axes and came at you. Perhaps they mistook you for a member of the Church of Satan.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.quest.31.13.0.compl: I see you have brought my lost pendant. Shall we make the exchange, then?
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.quest.31.13.0.first: I once had a peculiar skull pendant, but it mysteriously vanished. If you find it and bring it back, I will give you something to help your army grow faster.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.quest.31.13.0.nextV: You have not found my pendant yet? Never mind. You must search harder.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.quest.41.5.0.comple: We see you have made an effort. You will find the first part of the answer to your question in the tent beyond this gate. Will you pay to enter the tent?
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.quest.41.5.0.firstV: A gang of dealers lives in the tower and knows the local underworld well. If you pay them enough, they can give you a lead on where to find Nemakačenko's daughter.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.quest.41.5.0.nextVi: Well? Have you scraped the money together yet?
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.15.6.0.message:
Do not think about morality when doing
the wrong thing at the right time.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.16.14.0.messag:
It is much easier to preach what you practise
than to practise what you preach.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.17.66.0.messag:
Beware of homosexuals!
They are easy to spot: men who hiss when you touch them with a moistened finger.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.22.22.0.messag: Never have two vices at once!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.22.4.0.message:
Here lies the "Ultimate Motorist"
He gained and lost his life through a burst rubber.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.23.56.0.messag:
Want to feel like the cleverest one?
Surround yourself with birdbrains . . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.24.62.0.messag:
If you already have three children, do not try for a fourth!
Statistics say every fourth person on earth is Chinese!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.26.41.0.messag: The shortest minds usually take the longest to catch on.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.28.67.0.messag: Can a fool be made a fool of?
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.3.69.0.message:
Here lies a great poet who killed himself for a great love. His last words were:
"Comrades, do not shoot . . ."
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.31.18.0.messag:
Better to sin and feel guilty afterwards
than never to sin at all.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.31.6.0.message:
There is a great difference between good and evil.
The problem is knowing which is which.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.34.45.0.messag: It is hard to show moderation in what you find pleasurable.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.42.27.0.messag:
Different land, different customs.
But indecency is the same everywhere.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.45.10.0.messag: It is always the other person who is intolerant.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.45.19.0.messag:
Virtue is its own reward.
You can admire it at home, alone, on a Saturday night.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.45.30.0.messag: If you resist temptation, it may never return.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.49.12.0.messag:
Do not smoke or drink, my son!
Buy some weights, not a whore, for fun!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.51.15.0.messag:
Plain of Wisdom
No unauthorised entry!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.52.47.0.messag:
The plural of person is people.
When people multiply, you get a person.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.53.22.0.messag:
Alcohol is poison.
But doing without it is a pain.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.53.34.0.messag: Keep in shape with a regular hangover!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.61.6.0.message: Come and join us. The Church of Satan awaits you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.64.39.0.messag: Do not fear obstructions; we have plenty of substitutions!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.67.21.0.messag:
If you are ill, blame the water.
Off to the pub, as you ought to!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.7.61.0.message:
Do not drink alcohol on an empty stomach!
Have at least a beer first!
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.sign.70.14.0.messag: Even an executioner can be a good person . . .
You cast your information net wide and discovered that a certain Church of Satan has been growing increasingly popular lately. You should probably look into it. According to the latest reports, it targets wealthy businesspeople, especially their easily fooled offspring. Then, slowly but surely, all their wealth finds its way into the sect's coffers. So you will probably have to find their nest . . .

You have arrived in these parts, and it looks as though you are in the right place. Advertising leaflets for the Church of Satan are plastered all over the land. Everywhere you look, their billboards display their mottos and slogans. Poor people. No wonder they go completely mad, looking at this every day, at every turn.

Your scouts' first reports have arrived, confirming you are in the right place. Barbarian tribes inhabit part of this region and could not care less about any Church of Satan. They do not want strangers in their territory. Two other peoples live here, however, and the sect is enjoying success in their lands.
The sect's headquarters lie in a territory none of the local peoples has yet reached. A military garrison prepared to do anything guards its entrance.

Today, you saw a black ship heading towards the sect's territory, its deck crowded with hooded figures. Heart-rending wails rose from below decks, giving you goosebumps. The Church of Satan's recruiters were probably taking more sheep to their temple, fooled by their honeyed words.

A soldier who stood watch last night came to tell you he had caught a strange fellow prowling around the castle during his patrol. The captain of the guard questioned him and discovered he was a sect member. But he had no further success. The fanatic preferred death to revealing anything about their sect.
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.town.19.12.0.name: Red Fortress
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.town.21.55.0.name: Kovářovice
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.town.48.14.0.name: Sektin
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.town.51.57.0.name: Skřetíkov
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.town.62.34.0.name: Mountain Girl Cottage
map.[ab] - honza 1:2.town.8.35.0.name: The Back of Beyond
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.0.101.0.mess: It looks as though Nemakačenko is getting desperate. He is delaying his defeat as long as he can. But you have only the final two gates left, and you have no intention of giving up.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.0.102.0.mess: You see gold scattered on the ground. Nemakačenko must have been in such a hurry to hide that he had no time to pick it up.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.101.7.1.mess: Now you can see the monster. Locked behind a sturdy gate, it is having a snack. You hope you will not end up as dessert. It scoops sulfur into its enormous maw like a giant excavator. It has no manners at all. It smacks its lips, grunts with delight, and has just belched so mightily that several litres of acid splashed almost to your boots.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.102.4.1.mess: After a hard battle, the monster finally falls. You quickly take out a special vial, fill it with dragon blood and hurry away. Dangerous acid is beginning to eat through everything around you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.102.72.1.mes: There is the key to the third gate. You cannot help thinking of your detectives, who passed this way alone, without a fighting party. You must admit they did good work.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.103.107.0.me: Wherever you step, half-rotten bones crunch beneath your feet.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.103.16.0.mes:
You notice another castaway and head towards him. But what is this? A ship suddenly sails from behind a rocky promontory. A skull-and-crossbones flag flutters from its mast.
Alarm! All hands on deck! Pirates ahead!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.104.103.0.me: Every inch of ground is strewn with tiny bone fragments. Someone ought to send a cleaning crew here.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.105.101.0.me: You should probably leave this place as soon as possible, before you turn all the souls of the dead against you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.106.98.0.mes: Why did you not listen to your inner voice? Suddenly, wailing surrounds you, sending chills down your spine. The unhappy souls of the dead, disturbed from their eternal rest, begin flitting through the air. More and more appear, until you feel surrounded by a living mist.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.107.106.0.me: A loud crack tells you that you have stepped on a skull.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.107.38.0.mes: The shipwrecks you pass warn you not to take the warnings about pirates lightly . . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.107.48.0.mes: Beware! You are sailing into territory ruled by sea pirates!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.107.78.0.mes:
Unknown friend, my days are numbered. I was a brave corsair and amassed an enormous treasure in my lifetime. It is of no use to me now. If you are interested, I hid it on a small islet in the southern sea, near the Island of the Dead. Search at the foot of the rock, and perhaps you will find it.
Captain Cook.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.12.73.0.mess: You will not get away with this! What have you done to our lady friends? You will suffer dearly for it!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.12.75.0.mess: What hard work! Nobody seems to have visited this island for a long time. Swamps lie everywhere, surrounded by wild jungle teeming with vermin. But as your detectives told you, the key to the fourth gate should be hidden here. There is nothing for it but to press on and hope to find it. Looking ahead, though, this will be no walk in the park.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.12.97.0.mess: At last, you can see the first of the fabled seven gates. The men's flagging morale lifts a little.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.13.100.0.mes: The first gate has fallen. Only six remain.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.13.103.0.mes: You are through the second gate. But knowing Nemakačenko, you suspect this was merely the warm-up.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.13.72.0.mess: More and more heads emerge from the bottomless swamp. Luckily, the key is already in the right hands.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.2.0.0.messag: The monster finally lets out its last roar and collapses with a dull thud. Nothing now stops you from taking the key to the final gate.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.23.105.0.mes: You were lucky this time. A wave hurled you towards the shore, but your helmsman reacted quickly and correctly. At the last moment, the ship avoided a submerged rock.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.23.51.0.mess: Well, we have a little time to spare. Let us learn something from the sages' ancient books.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.23.97.0.mess: An unpleasant incident. Several stones broke loose from the cliff, dragging a veritable avalanche down with them. Naturally, it happened just as you sailed past. Or could it have been Nemakačenko's trap? Fortunately, nobody was seriously hurt; only a cabin boy suffered a minor injury. You had the torn sail and several broken deck planks replaced. But the incident did little for the crew's spirits.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.23.98.0.mess: The pilot ran up to warn you of submerged reefs ahead. You must continue with the utmost caution.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.32.83.0.mess: Remember, man does not live by bread alone. How about visiting the nearby library?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.33.102.0.mes: It looks as though you have entered a rocky labyrinth. As you already know, Nemakačenko's private island is hidden somewhere within it.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.33.7.0.messa: Shall we spend a little time in the library's cool shade? Perhaps its wise scrolls can teach us something.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.38.106.0.mes: You can barely squeeze through the narrow strait. The ship's sides almost scrape the surrounding rocks. At least the water is deep enough. Ahead, in the more open sea, a tall rock rises like a warning (or threatening?) finger.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.4.107.0.mess: It seems Nemakačenko will foul this world's air for a few more days. Another important task probably awaits you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.50.35.0.mess:
The sun is shining, the grass is green, the birds are singing, someone is drowning over there. . . 
Why doesn't he let go of that log? At least it would be over quickly. . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.64.105.0.mes: This is probably not the right place. Or someone has played a joke on you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.66.2.0.messa: That old sea dog is quite an eccentric. He keeps sea monsters as pets in the bay, and they seem to think it is feeding time . . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.67.3.0.messa: An old sea dog lives here in the little bay. He spent his long life navigating these waters as a pilot. Perhaps he has some charts for sale.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.7.107.0.mess: At last, solid ground again after so long. You kiss the earth beneath your feet while your ship's crew watches with contempt. You do not care. You will never be a sea dog.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.70.70.1.mess: Do you feel strong enough to set foot in this territory?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.77.72.0.mess: Let us see what new things they can teach us here. . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.85.105.0.mes: Congratulations! You have found Captain Cook's treasure!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.86.78.1.mess: You certainly enjoy picking on the weak. How about teasing some dragons?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.88.94.1.mess: You must not sit idly by! You must gather the means to build the strongest possible army. Otherwise, your talk of revenge was just an old woman's idle chatter.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.89.4.0.messa: Yes, those lads miscalculated. They probably thought they were facing a beginner. They will not think that again. In fact, they will not think again at all.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.9.0.0.messag: This really looks almost like the end of the world. But the key to the final gate should be hidden somewhere here.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.91.92.0.mess: Luckily, Nemakačenko was not a megalomaniac who had at least fifty gates built on his island.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.91.93.0.mess: Well, look what the elven commander left behind. . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.92.91.0.mess: That is done. Now, quickly, get the key.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.93.90.0.mess: Aaah, there is the key to the first gate. Hurry and get it. You are beginning to feel like a contestant on Fort Boyard. Except those contestants were chasing something quite different.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.95.107.0.mes: This must be the largest burial ground you have ever seen. The earth is so full of the dead that it has pushed some bodies to the surface. Perhaps that is why they built a crematorium right at the entrance.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.95.78.1.mess: You accepted the genie's offer and defeated him easily. He muttered an incantation, and it felt as though fireworks exploded in your head. Soon everything settled down, and you discovered you remembered some forgotten spells again. You are a little wiser once more.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.97.107.0.mes:
Crematorium Operating Regulations

                    Article 1
The crematorium administration shall, in particular: 
a/ accept bodies authorised for cremation, store them temporarily and cremate them
b/ accept and cremate exhumed remains (undecomposed bodies) and other human remains (§18, Decree No.19/88 Coll.), provided cremation is permitted and the healthcare facility has no incinerator of its own
c/ when a crematorium employee accepts a body from a funeral service, record it in the register of received bodies, which shall contain: 
- the deceased's first name and surname
- year of birth
- ceremony (no ceremony)
- which funeral service delivered the deceased
- whether the deceased had yellow or white prosthetic fittings or other ornaments
- signature of the funeral service driver who delivered the deceased
- signature of the crematorium employee who accepted the deceased
d/ maintain a cremation register recording every body or exhumed remains delivered to the crematorium for cremation, every cremation and other important particulars
e/ ensure that coffins used for cremation comply with Article 5
f/ take every precaution to prevent bodies or ashes from being confused with one another
g/ ensure that cremation is performed correctly and respectfully, and that the cremation equipment functions and is operated correctly in accordance with the instructions of the cremation furnace manufacturer FDI 
h/ place the ashes in an urn (ash container) bearing the particulars required by Article 14, and seal the urn properly afterwards
ch/ store cremated remains temporarily and release urns containing them to authorised persons
i/ ensure cleanliness, regular disinfection, proper ventilation and order in the crematorium, its sanitary operation, and facilities for employees' personal hygiene

                    Article 2
Conditions for cremation.
Unless the Chief Public Health Officer designates territorial districts from which bodies and exhumed remains must be cremated at particular crematoria, bodies may be cremated here regardless of where death occurred, and exhumed remains regardless of the burial ground in which they were interred. 

                    Article 3
Bodies and other human remains may be cremated only under the conditions prescribed in §15, Decree No.19/88 Coll./ 

                    Article 4
Rooms for the temporary storage of bodies. 
Bodies shall be stored temporarily only in a room set aside for this purpose and equipped with effective ventilation and refrigeration.

                    Article 5
Preparation of the coffin and body.
1/ Bodies and exhumed remains intended for cremation shall be cremated in coffins (other remains in boxes). Coffins must meet the following conditions: 
a/ they must be made of wood, thin zinc sheet or another environmentally suitable combustible material complying with Czech technical standards. 
b/ they must not exceed 225 cm in length, 75 cm in width and 75 cm in height, including the base
c/ they must have no fittings or decorations made of non-combustible materials, 
d/ they must be made leakproof. 
2/ If delivery of the coffin and body to the crematorium follows prolonged transport, if the exhumed remains are undecomposed, or if special regulations so require, the wooden coffin must have a zinc lining and be hermetically sealed. 
3/ Objects made of non-combustible or poorly combustible materials must not be placed in the coffin.

                    Article 6
Removal of jewellery and other ornaments.
Jewellery and other ornaments shall not be placed in the coffin with the deceased, particularly rings, necklaces, earrings, clasps, decorations and the like.

                    Article 7
Acceptance of the coffin and body, and measures to establish identity
1/ Every coffin containing a body or exhumed remains delivered to the crematorium for cremation must bear a label stating the deceased's first name and surname, and the date and place of death. If this requirement is not met, the crematorium administration shall ask the person delivering the coffin to supply the missing particulars. Every body received must be entered in the cremation register without delay. 
2/ When accepting a coffin and body, the crematorium administration shall verify that the label matches the death examination certificate, check the deceased's name on the forearm or thigh (written by the hospital), and accept the order form. A body cannot be accepted without the death examination certificate and order form. An exception concerning the order form applies where the body was brought to the crematorium for temporary storage from a home, street, shop or similar place and the examining physician did not request an autopsy. 
3/ Before being placed in a coffin, bodies of persons who died of a communicable disease, or had one that did not cause their death, must be wrapped in cloth soaked in disinfectant solution. Until the funeral, they must be kept only in a mortuary or a designated area of the crematorium, which must be thoroughly disinfected after the funeral. 
4/ Coffins used for burial shall contain a layer of absorbent material and, if burial is delayed or climatic or transport conditions require it, an impermeable layer. In such cases, viewing of the deceased must not be permitted. The coffin must be securely closed and clearly marked with an identification label. Where a coffin contains the body of a person referred to in paragraph 3, its lid must bear a label reading "Do Not Open" on the appropriate form, stamped by the healthcare facility and signed by a physician. The same procedure is required if the body is severely disfigured or decomposing.
5/ Immediately upon acceptance, the crematorium administration shall attach to the coffin a fireproof identification plate bearing the same number as the body's entry in the cremation register and the number marked in advance on the urn.
6/ Sequential numbering shall continue uninterrupted throughout the crematorium's operating lifetime

                    Article 8
Cremation.
1/ The deceased must be cremated no later than 96 hours after death is confirmed by the examining physician. The 96-hour period may be exceeded only if: 
a/ it was not possible to notify the bereaved of the death in time,
b/ funeral arrangements are delayed by non-working days or public holidays
c/ the bereaved have a justified and substantial interest in making time-consuming arrangements connected with the funeral 
d/ the funeral service encounters exceptional and unforeseeable technical or operational difficulties
e/ funeral arrangements must comply with the requirements of the competent authorities, particularly those involved in criminal proceedings, and the body is stored in refrigerated premises or premises approved by the competent public health authority. If an autopsy has been performed, cremation may take place immediately afterwards. Where an autopsy was ordered by an authority involved in criminal proceedings, cremation is permitted only with the consent of the prosecutor or investigator.
2/ The crematorium administration must ensure that all hygienic and respectful practices are observed during cremation, that the deceased's ashes do not mix with those of another person and that no confusion occurs. Remains must be completely cremated and freed of non-combustible matter.
3/ During the cremation itself, only employees operating the cremation equipment, their superiors and inspection authorities may enter areas adjoining the furnace chamber. Exceptional permission may be granted only by the head of the organisation administering the crematorium, in accordance with principles for such exemptions agreed with the municipal public health officer. 

                    Article 9
Placing ashes in the urn.
1/ After every cremation, the ashes must be carefully collected in full, together with the fireproof identification plate.
2/ The urn bearing the number marked in advance must be labelled and hermetically sealed. 
3/ A label shall be attached to the urn identifying the crematorium where cremation took place. The label shall also state the cremation's sequential number from the cremation register, the deceased's first name and surname, and the dates of birth, death and cremation.

                    Article 10
Cremation register.
1/ The cremation register shall contain the following particulars: 
a/ consecutive cremation numbers
b/ the deceased's first name and surname
c/ day, month, year and place of birth
d/ last place of residence
e/ day, month, year and place of death
f/ day, month and year of cremation
q/ name and address of the person ordering the funeral 
h/ particulars of the authorisation for cremation
ch/ other notes

                    Article 11
Duties of crematorium employees.
Crematorium employees shall: 
a/ maintain confidentiality in all matters relating to the crematorium's operation 
b/ always be neatly and cleanly dressed and observe personal hygiene, 
c/ treat the bereaved and visitors courteously 
d/ show respect for the deceased being cremated.

                    Article 12
Crematorium sanitary facilities.
Crematorium employees must use their own designated /marked/ sanitary facilities /showers, washrooms, toilets and changing rooms. Separate sanitary facilities are provided for the bereaved and other visitors.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.98.107.0.mes: You pause to decide whether to go on at all. Not a scrap of bare ground is visible beneath the bones of every shape and size. In places, almost complete skeletons can be seen.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.98.20.0.mess: Thank you for saving us, stranger. Only a tenth of our original crew remains. Had you come a few days earlier, everyone could have been saved. This is all that remains of our captain. Take it as a token of our gratitude.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.guards.99.21.0.mess: The remnants of an unfortunate crew cling with their last strength to a flimsy raft, tossed by the waves battering the coast. You order the lifeboats lowered.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.header.description: The final battle approaches. Nemakačenko has hidden from you like a vile rat. Your scouts have discovered only that he is hiding on a private island beyond the fabled seven gates. You must track him down and face him in a fight to the death.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.header.name: The Fourth Journey
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.heroes.115.name: Nemakačenko
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.monster.1.0.0.messa: Where do you think you are going! Urghh. . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.monster.103.3.1.mes: The monster raises its head and studies you curiously. Perhaps its tiny brain is wondering how you will taste in full armour. But rather than wait for it to try a bite, you draw your sword and attack.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.monster.12.74.0.mes: What are you doing in our territory, you wretched worm! You would barely feed one of our heads!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.monster.35.93.0.mes: My master, who summoned me from the bottle, ordered me to guard this shipyard for him and let nobody near it. It was a terribly long time ago, but I must not disobey his command.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.monster.51.36.0.mes:
Hey, you! Help me save my friend. He fell into the mountain lake and is drowning! He can barely hold on.
What? You cannot swim? I ought to break you in two!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.monster.90.4.0.mess:
The black riders leaving the chief surveyor's place look strange. Black clothes, black horses . . . Something is wrong. Let us hope the surveyor is still alive.
Your doubts only grow when the black riders draw swords from beneath their cloaks and charge you in close formation.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.monster.92.92.0.mes: An arrow whizzes past your head. A group of elves stands before you, determined to let you go no farther. What else can you do? The key is within reach, so you must fight your way through.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.monster.94.45.1.mes: I guard the key to the fifth gate and may give it to nobody without special permission. Try touching it, and you are a dead man.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.monster.96.107.0.me: Do not think this cursed soil has no room for one more sinful body!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.monster.96.78.1.mes: I have heard what happened to you. I could help, for I am a magical genie. But as a matter of principle, I give nothing away. If you duel with me and win, I can teach you some of the spells that vanished from your head.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.0.100.0.compl: You see, hero? That was not so terrible. Will you exchange the vial for free passage?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.0.100.0.first: A powerful mage lives in the tower and refuses to let you pass unless you bring him a vial of dragon blood. He did tell you, however, that he knows of a dragon breeding ground somewhere deep underground, in a small sulfur cavern to the north.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.0.100.0.nextV: I really will not let you through otherwise. Keep pestering me, and I will turn you into a dragon and have enough blood to sell!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.28.83.0.compl: Well done. It is exactly my size. Shall we shake on a good deal?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.28.83.0.first: I am preparing for a long journey through wild country. The natives there like shooting passing travellers with bows. So I need something like a bulletproof vest. If you get me the Breastplate of Petrified Wood, I will give you some of my warriors.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.28.83.0.nextV: The day of my departure is near. Do you still not have the vest?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.54.22.1.compl: It seems the centaur people will have something to celebrate. Will you return their axe?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.54.22.1.first: The chief of the centaur people visited me recently. Someone stole their ceremonial axe. Whoever brings it back can expect a reward.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.54.22.1.nextV: Nothing yet? That axe must be somewhere.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.79.100.1.comp: I knew you could do it! Will you sell me the amulet for a good price?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.79.100.1.firs: Terrible! Terrible! Such misfortune in my old age! Help me! I can no longer hunt for food, and I face starvation. My sight is failing, and I cannot shoot anything. But I know there is an amulet for my affliction. Bring it to me, and I will pay you royally.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.79.100.1.next: Still nothing? Please try harder! It is getting worse and worse!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.80.89.0.compl: Yes! That is it! Will you sell it to me, then?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.80.89.0.first: I am looking for a nice birthday present for my dwarven cousin. He wants to become a warrior, so I think a Shield of the Dwarven Lords would delight him. Find me one, and I shall pay you well.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.80.89.0.nextV: Have you found that shield yet? My cousin can hardly wait.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.86.39.1.compl: Hurrah! I am saved! Will you give it back to me?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.86.39.1.first: Stranger, help me! One of my rare statuettes has gone missing! My collection is worthless without it! And I must soon send the whole collection to an international exhibition. If I cannot recover it, it will be an international disgrace! Find it, and I offer you two months' worth of Magogs from my farm.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.86.39.1.nextV: Have you still not found the statuette? This will be the end of me. . .
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.95.70.1.compl: Let us see what can be done. By my calculations, I can turn them into 30 Magogs for you. Agreed?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.95.70.1.first: I experiment with transforming creatures. Bring me 50 Familiars, and I shall try to turn them into other creatures.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.quest.95.70.1.nextV: Have you brought me those Familiars?
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.sign.103.24.0.messa: ...SOS...volcanic island in sight...heavy seas...God help us...if anyone finds this message, hurry...SOS...
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.sign.106.31.0.messa: ..SOS...pirates pursuing us...mainmast and rudder damaged...will try to escape in the lifeboat...volcanic island on the horizon...will attempt...SOS...
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.sign.13.3.0.message:
The end of the civilised lands.
Proceed at your own risk!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.sign.44.104.0.messa: Somewhere in the cold northern waters lives an old sea dog who knows these seas like the back of his hand. Pay him a visit; he may be able to help you.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.sign.69.69.1.messag:
Warning!!!
You are entering green dragon territory!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.sign.74.106.0.messa: Here lie the bones of Captain Cook.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.sign.84.16.0.messag: The ocean waters grow colder and colder. The weather is as changeable as April, too.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.sign.88.3.0.message:
Chief Surveyor.
Maps for sale - cash only!
No credit or leasing!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.sign.88.74.1.messag:
Warning!!!
The red dragons' lair begins here!!!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.sign.94.106.0.messa:
Isle of the Dead
Keep quiet and observe the rules!
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.18.44.0.name: Štírov
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.27.15.0.name: Vílíkov
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.35.63.1.name: Dračín
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.43.75.0.name: Backwater Lhota
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.49.45.0.name: Gremlin City
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.60.38.1.name: Skeleton Village
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.61.21.0.name: Žoldákovice
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.63.67.1.name: Ďáblice
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.74.79.0.name: Kolohnaty
Here you begin plotting your fiendish revenge. Once you have enough capable, courageous fellows at hand, you will emerge onto the surface, and woe betide Nemakačenko. While you recover, you will at least try to discover where that damned traitor is hiding. He must know that if you survived, you will be coming for his throat.
You still feel a little strange, but worst of all, that blow to the head knocked every magical formula and spell clean out of your mind. You hope to learn them again in a few days.

First of all, you must discover where Nemakačenko's hideout actually is. You have therefore decided to hold interviews the day after tomorrow for detectives to search for it. Luckily, you had some cash tucked away in a secret account, so you can afford to hire only the best.

Payday arrives, and both detectives turn up right on cue. You can hardly blame them, though, for they bring more news. They have found no further key, but they have learned that the key to the second gate is hidden somewhere right by the gate itself, if a key to it even exists.
Despite their best efforts, they could not discover how to get through the next-to-last gate. That may prove a little more complicated. Well, you will see for yourself when you get there. After coming so far, surely one little gate will not stop you.
So all that remains is to bid them farewell - after paying their fee, of course.
What a dreadful blow! Your chief treasurer has brazenly embezzled your funds. You must take stock of what remains. If only you could get your hands on that scoundrel . . .

Your detectives seem capable. Their first report confirms that Nemakačenko has hidden on his private island, beyond some rocky labyrinth. Seven gates guard the approach, and you must obtain their keys.
That merely confirms what you already knew. You eagerly await word that your detectives have located the keys, so you can seize them.
Fortune smiles upon you. You bought a Bingo ticket out of curiosity and won a tidy sum.

Your headquarters are crowded today. Plenty of applicants have turned up, all "eager for work" (or rather, "eager for money"). You have never seen such a queue, even when you once passed the Employment Office.
But you have your own ways of separating the wheat from the chaff. In the end, only two remain whom you decide to hire. One is a former agent of the StB secret police, which alone guarantees that he has plenty of excellent contacts. The other once worked with Inspector Kojak. He may not look the part, but his references speak for themselves. You pay them a small advance so they can begin their investigation.

Another report from your detectives arrives. They have discovered that the key to the first gate is almost within reach. It lies on the surface, almost directly above your base. All you need do is go outside and seize it unnoticed.

Your detectives have found the key to the third gate. It is right here underground, a few days' journey north of your base. The trouble is that it lies in the red dragons' lair. Your agents barely escaped with their lives. On their way, they found a poor wretch travelling from the north. He was in a terrible state after the red dragons had mauled him. From his feverish ramblings, they gathered that the key to the fifth gate should also lie in the far north. Unfortunately, they could not confirm this: the poor fellow never regained consciousness, and they dare not venture there themselves. They have had quite enough encounters with dragons already.
Today you had to pay your detectives their fee for the work done. Being generous, you added some payment in kind for the difficult conditions in which they work (see the red dragons' lair).
You have heard nothing from your detectives for a long time. What can have happened to them? You only hope they are still alive.
At last, news! Your detectives are returning. They want to speak to you in person. What could have happened?

The detectives finally arrive at your base. Funny how they arrive on the very day their fee is due :-). But what a state they are in!
They do bring more good news, however. They have discovered where the key to the fourth gate is hidden. It lies on a tropical island in the western sea. Unfortunately, the island is straight out of a horror story: tropical jungle teeming with ravenous vermin. Both detectives will need at least a week to recover from their ordeal. 
You give them leave and pay their usual fee, plus some payment in kind, lest they change their minds and cancel their contract with you.

A week later, the detectives report again. They have found the key to the last gate. It took some time because the key lies on the mainland's northwesternmost promontory and is well guarded. They also discovered that Nemakačenko had one of his greatest rivals removed. He falsely accused him of drug smuggling and had him imprisoned somewhere underground. The prison lies somewhere in green dragon territory.
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.82.92.1.name: Devil's Hole
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.84.46.0.name: Snowbound Village
map.[ab] - honza 1:3.town.89.58.1.name: Little Flame
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.21.71.0.mess: What else did you expect, wandering so close to the thicket? You were practically asking to be ambushed...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.22.58.0.mess:
Damn! That gold was bait! And you took it. A ring of scoundrels begins to close around you.
Will you fight them for the gold?
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.23.4.0.messa:
Something glitters in the snow.
Why, it is a ring! Perhaps it will come in handy.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.23.51.0.mess: "We are sure to line our pockets today...." comes a voice from a nearby thicket.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.26.62.0.mess: That heap of sulfur would be useful. But first you must defeat its guards! Will you try?
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.27.48.0.mess: Beyond this gate lie the Untamed Lands your scouts told you about. From this distance, they seem peaceful. Yet their warning about hordes of robbers and cutthroats still troubles you.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.27.57.0.mess: Suddenly, a voice rings out: "Well, well, who has brought us his little gold pieces?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.27.65.0.mess: Your scouts were quite right: this land is full of villains. Unless your eyes deceive you, another gang is attacking ...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.28.52.0.mess: A harsh voice bellows from the bushes: "Your money or your life!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.28.9.0.messa:
Those guards were not there for nothing. They were protecting their female commanders, who lay resting beneath a cloak.
Will you fight them for the cloak?
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.29.43.1.mess: What a coincidence! A ring lies on the ground. Some mushroom picker must have lost it here.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.29.58.0.mess: A lovely little pile of diamonds. If only it were not so well guarded. Will you fight the guards for it?
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.3.48.0.messa: The clatter of your horse's hooves echoes through the narrow canyon. It seems to have angered the birds nesting on the crags. They circle nervously above your company for a while, then suddenly swoop down to attack...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.3.65.0.messa: The collapsed mine suddenly comes alive.... From underground fly the souls of miners buried forever in its depths...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.30.67.0.mess: Someone ought to give this whole accursed region a thorough cleansing. You meet nothing but scoundrels at every turn.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.32.56.0.mess: "Aaaah... Someone is bringing us his money. . . "
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.33.52.0.mess: You might have guessed that such a heap of crystals was not lying here by chance. As you can now see, it is well guarded. Will you fight for the crystals?
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.34.54.0.mess: Oh no! It is a trap! And now you can see those who laid it . . . Will you fight them for the gold?
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.35.13.0.mess: A band of ragged ruffians attacks you from the nearby forest. They seem to have slipped in from barbarian territory.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.35.62.0.mess: This is getting almost tedious... Someone else wants to line his pockets at your expense...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.36.16.0.mess: That fight was worth it. The bow is a fine one indeed.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.37.19.0.mess: Well, that might come in handy.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.37.23.0.mess: Hmm, I have heard of people losing their heads. But losing their legs?...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.37.60.0.mess: Good heavens! What a cauldron of mercury! You order it loaded, but your helpers have barely moved when its guards rush out of the nearby forest. Will you fight them for the cauldron?
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.38.41.1.mess: Let us see what those mages were guarding so fiercely.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.39.2.0.messa: At the edge of the forest, you spot a snow hare caught in a trap. Taking pity on it, you slowly open the jaws. You tend its wounded leg and set it free. The hare runs off, then returns a moment later. It lays something shiny in the snow before you, twitches its tail and runs away. You pick up the object and discover that the grateful hare has brought you a ring.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.41.58.0.mess: The peaceful air is suddenly shattered by the clash of drawn weapons, and another horde of scoundrels comes charging at you . . .
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.42.13.0.mess: So this must be where barbarian territory begins...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.43.58.0.mess:
This countryside has quite a different character. You are unlikely to meet any robber hordes here. That knightly house seems able to keep order in its domain.
Then again, they have yet to meet Honza...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.43.66.0.mess: This is beginning to get on your nerves. Where do all these cutthroats keep coming from?
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.49.27.1.mess: Before the labyrinth entrance lie heaps of crumbling bones: adventurers who could not defeat the minotaur. Beside one heap lies a ring with a strange eye. Its former owner is unlikely to need it again. You, however, may find it useful.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.56.55.0.mess: You stand before the castle gates as terrified servants flee. A footman approaches and offers you a gold ring, supposedly a family heirloom, in exchange for safe passage.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.66.39.0.mess:
At last, you are getting back into shape. You enjoy this adventurous life, but Květinka is always on your mind. If only you were with her already....
That thought keeps driving you onward....
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.69.7.0.messa: At last! You seem to be nearing your goal...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.70.24.0.mess:
These waterless lands are truly dreadful... How do those barbarians stand it?
And this thirst.... Sweat beads on your brow at the mere thought of a beer bottle beaded with condensation...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.70.3.0.messa:
Only a few more steps.... Words cannot express how you feel...
But what is this? A wizard suddenly appears before you and says: "Honza, take this sash. The wind once brought it to me from the desert. But I have had a vision that one day you will need it. Keep it with you, therefore, and do not part with it!!!"
With these words, the wizard vanishes, and a magnificent sash slowly drifts to the ground. "Very well," you think, stuffing it into your backpack. "It will hardly take up much room. And if it may prove useful someday, why throw it away?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.guards.70.71.0.mess: Aaaah!! A Tree of Knowledge. Time to learn a little...
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.header.description: Honza must find and rescue his bride-to-be, Květinka. To complete this scenario, he must also capture every creature dwelling. At least he will improve his fitness a little, having neglected it badly in recent years. So make him work for it: the better you train him, the better off he will be.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.header.name: The First Adventure
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.heroes.145.biograph: A very charming young woman who ran a successful business until the tax office came to inspect it. Then she had to take an "enforced holiday" until Honza freed her.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.heroes.145.name: Květinka
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.heroes.26.biography: If you want to know anything about Honza, play his first adventure and you will learn everything. Those who played Honza's previous adventure know him only too well.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.heroes.26.name: Honza
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.11.5.0.mess: "Ha, ha, ha... You think you can defeat us?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.11.9.0.mess: Those birds block your way to the obelisk. How about ruffling their feathers a little?
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.12.35.0.mes: "Halt! Not another step! Or you shall taste our blades!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.14.54.0.mes: "We can see we would stand no chance against you. We would rather enter your service. Will you accept us?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.15.29.0.mes: "There is no room for you in that tent. We can barely squeeze in ourselves."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.20.27.0.mes: "Come on, then! Since you are so eager to fight...."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.21.7.0.mess: "Yes, you are right. That pendant is valuable indeed. Whoever wins the duel shall have it."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.23.23.0.mes: "We have been freezing here long enough. A little fight to warm us up would do us good."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.24.4.0.mess: "This factory has always belonged to us. How dare you claim you received it in restitution?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.24.45.0.mes: "The mages dwelling in this tower ordered us to let no one inside!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.27.12.0.mes: "You will pass only over our dead bodies!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.27.50.0.mes: "Where are you rushing off to, you bumpkin?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.28.16.0.mes: "The trading post is taking stock. A huge shortfall is suspected. Stop getting in the way!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.28.8.0.mess: "Our swords have lain idle too long! At last they shall drink a little blood!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.29.58.1.mes: "We know you would like to visit this tent. But we are charged with defending it against all intruders."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.29.6.0.mess: "Anyone could claim that sack was theirs!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.3.27.0.mess: "Only true heroes may enter the Cloud Temple. Do you think you are one of them?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.3.32.0.mess: "Nothing to do with me! I am just passing through!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.3.45.0.mess: "Have you a pass for this gate? You do not know what we mean? Then we shall explain it another way!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.31.26.0.mes: "You want that shield? Then you will have to fight for it!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.33.3.0.mess: "Do not think you will get those crystals so easily!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.34.48.0.mes: "There are no bouts in the arena today. But if you are so eager to fight, we are at your disposal."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.35.16.0.mes: "We know you like that bow. But you will not get it for nothing."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.36.19.0.mes: Those dogs do not look very tame.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.38.9.0.mess: "Heeey! How about a little fair fight?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.39.3.0.mess: "We bought that mill! And we shall not give it up so easily!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.4.38.0.mess: "No, no, no! You are not getting a helmet!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.4.6.0.messa: "We have not fought anyone for ages. How about a little battle?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.41.47.0.mes: "Now show us what you are really made of..."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.5.4.0.messa: "No, we really cannot let you pass!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.5.40.0.mess: "Very well, if you insist... Let battle commence!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.5.64.0.mess: "Come on, come on... We can hardly wait for you!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.monster.6.35.1.mess: "Anyone could say they wanted to enter the tent!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.quest.30.28.0.compl: "Well, I see you have brought me the shield. Would you like to make the exchange?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.quest.30.28.0.first: "My New Year's resolution was to help the first traveller who stopped at my door. But it will not be for nothing. Bring me the Shield of the Dwarven Lords, and I shall help you in turn."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.quest.30.28.0.nextV: "I see you have had little luck so far. Unless you bring me the Shield of the Dwarven Lords, I cannot help you."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.quest.45.35.0.compl: At last you have defeated those accursed little creatures, and I can go and gain new knowledge. Are you ready to accept your reward?
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.quest.45.35.0.first: There is an old library in the west of this region. I need to study something there, but devilish minions have seized its entrance. Defeat them, and I shall teach you a few tricks to improve your attacking skills.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.quest.45.35.0.nextV: Do not despair. I know there are many of those devilish minions, but I am sure you can defeat them.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.quest.70.2.0.comple: "A truly magnificent collection. Will you exchange it for safe passage?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.quest.70.2.0.firstV: "Yes, I am guarding a captive woman here. I can hand her over if you help me. I am assembling a collection of valuable rings, but I am still missing a few pieces. Bring them to me, and I shall release the prisoner to you."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.quest.70.2.0.nextVi: "I see you still lack some rings. Come back when your collection is complete."
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.sign.28.47.0.messag: Beyond this gate lie the Untamed Lands.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.sign.48.15.0.messag: Welcome - we do not come bothering you, either!
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.town.10.29.0.name: Mrazíkov
Workers returning from the mountains to their settlement tell you they saw a magical plain north of your castle, where a wondrous tree grows. You should go and see whether there is any truth to it.

Your scouts have discovered that the last creature dwelling is well hidden. You can reach it only after freeing Květinka from prison, for the dwelling lies beyond her prison.
Note – Since you will meet Květinka again in the future, I recommend taking her to places that improve her skills before capturing the last dwelling. Also let her keep her Clover of Fortune – she will need it.
The fresh air in these parts agrees with your creatures. They have bred in abundance this week. Thank goodness those dreadful frosts are over.
A report from your scouts: the artifact the seer wants is probably in the Untamed Lands as well.
Your brave scouts have managed to seize some resources in the Untamed Lands. They also report that resources are plentiful there, but nearly all are well guarded.

After a long silence, your scouts finally report. They have found the prison you seek. It lies in a remote corner of barbarian territory.
They have also learned that, among her belongings, Květinka has a Clover of Fortune that brought her luck in business. You should let her keep it, for she will need it again in the future.
I know you would like some resources or warriors. But you are out of luck. You will get nothing more.

A report from your scouts arrived this morning, saying that the underground caverns hold great riches and many artifacts.
Once your army is strong enough, you should go and have a look. You may find something useful there.

The scouts have discovered the location of the much-needed Gem Pond. Before you can reach it, however, you must pass a Quest Guard. Unfortunately, you cannot claim the Gem Pond until you complete a certain quest.
You will find that Quest Guard directly west of your castle.

Honza discovered that finding a good wife would be far from easy. The advertisements he placed in every newspaper with even a modest readership brought so many replies that the poor postman nearly gave himself a hernia.
But as so often happens, most applicants were after Honza's fortune rather than Honza himself. In desperation, he finally remembered the two detectives who had served him so well on his last adventure. It proved a wise decision. Once again, they did not disappoint him.
A few days later, they sent him a photograph and some basic information about a young lady.

Good heavens! Honza fell head over heels like some teenager. But there was one rather substantial catch. The young lady in question was currently on an "enforced holiday" for tax evasion. Honza saw no problem with this; indeed, it rather impressed him. He therefore resolved to find Květinka, as the young lady was called, and get her out of prison at any cost. Then he would ask for her hand.

And so we begin. . .	
You have purchased this estate and, as always upon entering a new land, sent your scouts out to explore.
Unfortunately, all that idleness has taken its toll on your fitness. Mountains of the finest food and scarcely any exercise have done their work. Before the first reports arrive from your scouts, it would be wise to look around and get back into shape. It may take a while to regain the form you were in when you finished off Nemakačenko.

Dreadful frosts have gripped the countryside these past few days. Your people, pampered by their luxurious lives, are unused to such weather. Everywhere, fires roar up the chimneys. Today, however, your chamberlain reported that all your firewood has been used up.
What a nuisance!!! You will have to order more wood and give your people a talking-to.
The wood you ordered has arrived. With the delivery comes the bill, of course.

The first reports from your scouts have arrived. So far, they have roughly established the following:
- wild barbarians dwell in the northeast, launching savage raids far and wide
- an ancient knightly house, famed for its heroic expeditions, has its seat in the southeast
- to the south lie the "Untamed Lands", full of wandering gangs, scoundrels and murderers (but also untold riches)
- underground lie three vast caverns; unfortunately, your scouts could not discover what they contain, for each entrance is well guarded
Good news. The foreman of the masons you hired last week has come to report that they finished the building you wanted this morning. Pay them, and they will move on to their next contracted job.
Your scouts report that the Untamed Lands are rich indeed. Danger lurks at every turn, however. You should venture there only with a strong escort.
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.town.33.38.0.name: Ice Temple
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.town.57.19.0.name: Rocky Eyrie
map.[ab] - honza 2:0.town.58.54.0.name: Green Court
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.guards.16.5.0.messa: A rather pleasant sight. To the north, beneath the rocky massif, stands a Dwarven Treasury. It would be worth a visit someday.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.guards.20.26.0.mess: Bad luck. Hamoun did not have the magical helmet with him. It must be too valuable to carry about casually. Perhaps it is hidden nearby.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.guards.21.32.0.mess:
You have entered Hamoun's territory. You can hardly believe your eyes at everything he has hoarded here.
Now you understand why the rest of the land is so poor. You ought to do something about it.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.guards.26.25.0.mess: Not far ahead lie a warrior's remains, guarded by strange black riders.
