map.[ab] - honza 2:1.guards.29.26.0.mess: A fine shield indeed. It fits your hand perfectly.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.guards.30.26.0.mess: The owner of this necklace must have slain a great many dragons. You seldom see so many dragon teeth together.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.guards.31.34.0.mess: "You think you defeated the guards earlier? Those were only apprentices. Now you shall see how masters fight! "
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.guards.34.32.0.mess: Beyond the gate, you can see the goal of your efforts. It fills you with courage, and your men are delighted that the campaign is nearing its end.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.guards.35.25.0.mess: Well, look! Gates! They remind you of your father's adventure, and his tale of how Nemakačenko hid himself away. Who knows whether Hamoun has hidden the magical helmet behind these gates?
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.header.description: Find the magical helmet of the mage Čáryfuk and bring it to your castle. The better you train Honzíček, the better for you. You will meet him again in the future. The artifact he must obtain will accompany him on his next adventure.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.header.name: The 1st Son's Adventure
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.heroes.117.biograph: Grab, grab, and I have more than that lot.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.heroes.117.name: Hamoun
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.heroes.12.biography: The eldest son of Honza and Květinka. As a child he was extremely lively, almost unmanageable, so he was sent to a monastery to be brought up. Since then he has got on very well with monks, who taught him to control and harness his inner energy.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.heroes.12.name: Honzíček
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.monster.18.20.0.mes: "Hamoun paid us well to guard the mine. We keep our word. His death changes nothing!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.monster.18.25.0.mes: "Before they began mining gold here, this was our lair. We drove off every intruder, and we shall not let you enter our territory either!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.monster.23.21.0.mes: "Do you know how much work it took us to build this mine? And you want to take it just like that? You are sorely mistaken! We would rather die than surrender it!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.monster.25.23.0.mes: "Oh, we have seen your sort before! So far we have dealt with everyone who coveted this mine!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.monster.25.27.0.mes: It seems these guard dogs take their duty seriously...
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.monster.26.32.0.mes: "This sacred tree has always belonged to our village. We shall let no one taste its fruits of wisdom."
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.monster.29.25.0.mes: "Our chieftain fell here in combat with Hamoun. Leave his remains in peace!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.monster.30.31.0.mes: "You are getting no mercury! We barely have enough ourselves!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.monster.32.34.0.mes: "You are not the first to covet the helmet of our chief mage, Čáryfuk. But as you can see, the magical helmet is still behind us. No one has yet managed to take it."
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.quest.20.27.0.compl: "We have heard that Hamoun is dead. Do you now wish to pass?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.quest.20.27.0.first: Beyond these guards lies Hamoun's territory. While Hamoun lives, no one may enter.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.quest.20.27.0.nextV: You cannot pass while Hamoun is alive.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.event.0: You have arrived in a real backwater. The land is poor and the neighbours are very hostile. All the country's wealth is concentrated in a single region. Unfortunately, it belongs to the great Hamoun, who lets no one touch his possessions. You have also learned that Hamoun took part in the expedition on which Čáryfuk fell. Perhaps he has the helmet after all. If it is so valuable, he surely claimed it. He is a greedy fellow through and through...
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.event.1: What a way to run things. How can you survive when resources are utterly scarce? Perhaps you should take Hamoun to task.
Hamoun's men struck again in the night, leaving all your warehouses and your treasury empty. You should eliminate Hamoun as soon as possible.
Another small gift from your brothers.
A message arrives from your father. He is pleased to see how you are doing and proud that you can manage without his help. If only he knew......

Hamoun's men tried to rob your resource stores again last night. This time, however, you were ready and repelled their raid. You even captured one of the robbers. Under questioning, he confirmed that he once saw the helmet in Hamoun's possession. Unfortunately, he did not know whether Hamoun still had it.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.event.2: You decide to write to your father about your situation. You are still managing, but a little help would be welcome.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.event.3: Your mother writes that your father is away on business. He should return in a few days and will then get in touch. She has no access to the account, but sends you something from her modest savings. She has also sent some craftsmen to help put your estate in order.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.event.4:
The craftsmen have worked quickly. Today they finished one of your main buildings, which had stood half-built.
They would not even take payment, saying your mother had already settled the bill.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.event.5: Your father has written, but his reply brings little comfort. He says you went out to gain experience and prove your worth. You must learn to stand on your own feet and stop relying on your parents.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.event.6:
Hamoun has shown just how greedy he truly is. His men have taken all your supplies. You are utterly penniless. Unless someone helps you, you will never complete your task.
It upset you so much that you had to complain to someone, and you wrote to your mother about everything.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.event.7: The post has been unusually quick. You wrote to your mother only the day before yesterday, and her reply is here already. She broadly agrees with your father, but will still try to help you somehow. Once again she sends something to tide you over.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.event.8: Your lucky day. Your brothers heard from your mother about your troubles and decided to help as well. They know you would not abandon them in similar circumstances. They secretly sent part of their company to aid you.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.event.9: Another message from your brothers. They realised that although they sent you troops, they do not know whether you can afford their wages. Just in case, they send some gold to pay them.
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.14.5.0.name: Old Monastery
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.29.9.0.name: Zanziwor
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.6.13.0.name: Sauriosa
map.[ab] - honza 2:1.town.7.29.0.name: Theodenie
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.10.3.0.messa:
A gang of vagabonds suddenly bursts out of the forest.
{Your money or your life!!!
You keep your life, but your purse has a new owner.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.11.71.0.mess: A truly magnificent bow! You have always longed for one like it!
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.13.60.0.mess: Aaaah, familiar country. Home is not far now.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.16.55.0.mess: Your family had many friends among the wood elves in these parts. Perhaps you will meet some.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.16.57.1.mess: Mushrooms grow all around you: a mushroom picker's paradise, provided they are edible....
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.16.58.1.mess: Some mushroom picker must have lost this here...
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.20.38.1.mess: There is little underground so far. Who knows how long it has been since a human set foot here....
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.23.36.1.mess: You would not want to bathe here. That water must be dreadfully icy.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.28.63.0.mess:
A group of wood elves blocks your path. At first you fear another ambush.
It turns out, however, that they are travelling to your estate to offer you their services. They say another, smaller group is nearby.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.3.10.1.messa: It looks much as underground usually does. Stale air, dim light, and only the hollow echo of your footsteps somewhere high overhead, where you suppose the ceiling must be. In the distance, the flames of a small fire flicker.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.39.30.0.mess: A little slant-eyed reed-dweller all but drags you into his stall......
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.39.50.1.mess: At last, you have met a living soul. Some primitive, croaking little creatures approach, and their behaviour looks far from friendly...
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.4.4.0.messag: You have done this land a great service by ridding it of the smugglers. Perhaps you will find kindred spirits here to accompany you on your journey.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.40.29.0.mess: "Pwease, pwease - buy! Only a few cwowns!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.43.50.1.mess: Aaaah... So people have been here after all. The collapsed shaft of a long-abandoned mine and the remains of a miners' cart prove it.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.5.5.0.messag: Just beyond the border, you meet an old friend. Upon hearing your task, he teaches you a few useful spells. He says they may help you in your quest.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.51.6.0.messa: A band of wood elves emerges from the forest. Their leader salutes you and offers you his service and that of his company.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.52.31.0.mess: No wonder this territory remained hidden from human eyes for so long. With the rich profits from their mines, the dwarves hired some fairies to conceal their whole domain with magic.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.56.70.0.mess: The club fits your hand perfectly.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.56.71.0.mess: That battle was worth it. The shield is a fine one indeed.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.58.71.0.mess: What a battle! But at last it is behind you.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.59.71.0.mess: Those ogres are guarding some fine things. There are so many of them you can scarcely count them.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.66.26.0.mess:
You slowly begin to recognise the surrounding countryside. You remember that your estate lies south of here. Unless your memory deceives you, though, there is no way through.
On the other hand, many inhabitants here were often attacked by the smugglers. Perhaps gratitude will persuade them to accompany you on your journey.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.66.68.1.mess:
Once again, only an underground lake filling almost the entire cavern....
Is there any point wandering through these depths?
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.67.10.0.mess: A procession of unicorns emerges from the forest. Their commander steps forward and offers his services and those of his entire company.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.guards.70.53.0.mess: Now, quickly collect the papers and send them to Pepíček!!!
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.header.description: Pepíček must bring the magical sword to his estate. You must not lose Pepíček, and he may advance no higher than level 25. The artifact he must bring to his town will accompany him on his next adventure.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.header.name: The 2nd Son's Adventure
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.heroes.21.biography: The middle son of Honza and Květinka. From childhood he showed a gift for archery. He made many friends among the elves, who acknowledge him as their unofficial leader.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.heroes.21.name: Pepíček
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.heroes.24.name: Jean
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.0.69.0.mess: "These treasures belong to our order! We shall not let you seize them!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.11.21.0.mes: "Hero, take us into your company. We wish to fight at your side."
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.11.56.0.mes: "Welcome, friend. Take us into your company."
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.13.8.0.mess: "Allow us to fight at your side. It would be a great honour."
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.14.69.0.mes: "Leave the bow behind us alone! It belonged to our leader, who is buried here."
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.15.58.0.mes: "We bring you this gift. But we had to rest a while after our long journey."
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.18.55.0.mes: "We do not know you, stranger! Leave us alone!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.18.57.0.mes: "Welcome, friend. Take us into your company."
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.2.30.0.mess: "Hero, take us into your company. We wish to fight at your side."
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.23.71.0.mes: "We are guarding these treasures for you. You may collect them and take us into your company."
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.33.5.0.mess: "Do you think we are guarding this for you?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.52.43.0.mes: "Where do you think you are going? We have guarded this passage for ages, and no one has ever got past us!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.54.31.0.mes: "Where do you think you are going? This is our territory!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.57.71.0.mes: "Would you like to take it? First prove yourself worthy!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.60.7.0.mess: "Welcome, hero. Your fame has preceded you. We would be honoured to fight at your side. Will you take us into your company?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.68.7.0.mess: "Welcome, hero! May we join you on your journey?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.69.22.0.mes: "Thank you for everything you have done for our people. Allow us to join you."
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.69.30.0.mes: "We owe you nothing! We could handle the smugglers ourselves! We know how to fight. We can prove it to you!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.70.3.0.mess: "We care nothing for heroic deeds! We can look after ourselves!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.70.54.0.mes: "We have obtained new travel papers for your friend Pepíček. Come with me into the tent, and we shall hand them over."
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.monster.8.68.0.mess: ""Take us with you! We have no future in this land!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.town.3.44.0.name: Štítnice
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.town.40.15.0.name: Bahníkov
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.town.46.39.0.name: Beneath the Forest
What a mess! In the few days Pepíček spent away from his estate, some coup took place here. A state of emergency has been declared, and the borders are closed. He must wait until his friends send a new passport before he can return home. Even then, the journey will be arduous. Only a pitiful remnant of his company survived the battle with the smugglers, and the road home is long....

Word reaches the castle that Pepíček has obtained the magical sword, but lost almost his entire company. He now stands at the border, unable to pass without the necessary papers. You must urgently obtain travel papers for him.
You can hardly wait. The lottery draw is in a week....
What dreadful luck. Of 250 tickets, only one won anything: the "enormous" sum of 10 gold. You resolve never to buy another lottery ticket as long as you live.

What chaos! The coup has turned the whole land upside down. Your scouts have finally discovered that the nearest office where you can obtain new papers for Pepíček is close by, only a few days' journey north of the castle. You immediately dispatch swift messengers to make the arrangements.

A report from your messengers:
The local officials were most unhelpful and would not hear of it. Bribes were necessary, and their attitude changed as if by magic. Everything is arranged, and you may collect the papers. They should be ready tomorrow.
Another message from Pepíček. He is growing impatient about those travel papers. You ought to hurry and send them without delay. He cannot wait forever.

Unexpected help. Pepíček's brothers have remembered him. They have sent a small company to help, along with money for their wages. Since they did not know his exact whereabouts, they sent the reinforcements to his castle.

A lottery-ticket seller visits you. He offers a ticket for a lottery you have never heard of. He says he has travelled far, and it is his last ticket. Taking pity on him, you buy it. The draw is in just 3 days.

Good news. Your ticket has won the grand prize - { 1000 000!!!}. There is one little catch, however. The foundation running the lottery is currently in financial difficulties. Unfortunately, they cannot pay the whole prize at once. They propose weekly instalments instead, with some extra payment in kind by way of apology.
An instalment of your lottery winnings has arrived.

The lottery-ticket seller visits again today. He is setting out with a fresh batch. After your last experience, you decide to try your luck again. But you will not do things by halves: you buy every ticket.
map.[ab] - honza 2:2.town.71.67.0.name: Elfínov
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.0.39.0.messa: From the derelict shipyard on the shore, lifeless masts point skyward like warning fingers...
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.13.18.0.mess: The goblins who keep a boar farm nearby dislike anyone disturbing their pets. They make their feelings quite clear.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.16.20.0.mess: You should learn to stay away where you are not invited! Those vagabonds sitting around the fire certainly did not want your company...
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.18.14.1.mess: Perhaps the dealer's brother has taken shelter in the humble dwelling visible beyond the gate.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.19.13.0.mess: So that miser must be behind this gate. What will he want for the magical shield?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.21.4.0.messa: How about a little lesson at the Tree of Knowledge?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.23.51.0.mess: There seems to be no way farther south. A deep chasm blocks your path.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.25.13.1.mess: Beyond the castle gate lies a spacious courtyard. Little dragons flit about, looking adorable at first glance. But first impressions are often misleading....
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.29.10.1.mess: This must be the castle the dealer told you about. It looks rather derelict. You only hope his brother still lives there...
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.35.58.0.mess: These barbarian lands are most inhospitable...
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.39.17.0.mess:
An old beggar woman rests in the shade of the trees. Taking pity on her, you give her a few gold pieces.
{I know of your mission, young man...}
"How strange. How could you know, grandmother?"
{I know much more besides. A little ahead is a tent where you will find the key to {one {gate. But it will not help you much. Only beyond that gate will you {find the key {that opens the way to the dealer. You will have to {descend {underground......
"Thank you...." But no one hears your words. The old woman has vanished without you even noticing....
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.41.7.0.messa: The mill ahead seems to have unwelcome visitors. How about helping the miller? Perhaps he will reward you...
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.5.33.1.messa: The dragons will not surrender their treasure so easily. Will you defeat the crystal dragon guards?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.53.18.0.mess: First secure a steady supply of resources: a wise idea...
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.54.66.0.mess: These must be dangerous waters indeed. Several wrecks on the treacherous shoals and the drifting wreckage you glimpse from time to time bear witness to that.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.55.12.0.mess: Let us have a little look around the castle...
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.55.13.0.mess: What a heap of gold!!! Who left it just lying here?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.55.24.0.mess: Ore is always useful for construction....
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.58.56.0.mess: Warm water spreading from the nearby whirlpool has made this cove a paradise for aquatic plants. The beauty of the sight lifts your spirits.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.6.32.0.messa: You see what look like masts beyond the trees. A closer look reveals what they really are. What sort of man lets a shipyard fall into such ruin?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.6.32.1.messa:
The dragons will not surrender their treasure so easily.
Will you defeat the red dragon guards?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.6.33.1.messa: The dragons will not surrender their treasure so easily. Will you defeat the gold dragon guards?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.6.41.0.messa: The owner of that shipyard behind the trees seems not to have used it for a long time. The forest has already grown right up to it. A few more years, and the trees will swallow it entirely...
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.62.20.0.mess: Where might this mysterious gate lead from?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.64.10.1.mess: You seem to be nearing the end of the cavern at last. But so far there is no sign of the legendary dragon treasure.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.64.2.1.messa: Damn! Teleportation through a monolith! You will never get used to that.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.64.65.1.mess: That monolith journey has left you feeling dreadful. Your stomach churns and your head spins. You did not feel this ill even after your last birthday celebrations, when you got as drunk as a tsarist officer.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.65.4.1.messa: You crushed the dragons to dust. From the few bones they left behind, you made yourself a necklace as a keepsake.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.66.71.0.mess: Well, look at that! A gold mine on a little volcanic island! How about increasing your income a little?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.68.15.1.mess: This fellow evidently never found the dragon treasure... All that remains of him is bleached bones.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.7.32.1.messa:
The dragons will not surrender their treasure so easily.
Will you defeat the black dragon guards?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.7.33.1.messa: The dragons will not surrender their treasure so easily. Will you defeat the rust dragon guards?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.70.22.1.mess: Well, look at that! A closed gate. Can you get through this way at all?
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.71.21.0.mess: You ought to visit your southern neighbour sometime. Who knows what sort of fellow he is? The gate ahead, however, seems to have a very strong garrison.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.guards.8.35.1.messa: It seems this is not over yet. You cannot believe these heaps of treasure have no guards...
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.header.description: Mazánek must find the magical shield of the mage Čáryfuk and bring it to his starting town. It will be a challenge, for until now he has never set foot beyond his home. He may reach level 25. The artifact he must obtain will accompany him on his next adventure.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.header.name: The 3rd Son's Adventure
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.heroes.140.biograph: Honza's youngest son, the darling of the family. Always buried in books, he developed a love of magic. He has every gift needed to become a fine wizard.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.heroes.140.name: Mazánek
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.12.21.0.mes: "We found this blacksmith first! If you want a war machine, find another!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.17.9.0.mess: "You want to go underground? We can arrange that!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.18.9.1.mess: "What a visitor! At last, someone to amuse ourselves with!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.19.49.0.mes: "Where do you think you are going? You cannot even offer a polite greeting!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.19.49.1.mes: "These underground caverns have always been our home! And we did not invite you!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.20.13.1.mes: "Gold, gold, gold! Everyone wants nothing but gold from us. What on earth do you humans see in it?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.25.11.1.mes: "What do you want, little man!? Surely you do not mean to drive us away? A few heroes have tried that already and achieved nothing. You will fare no better!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.26.12.0.mes: "We have none, will give none, will lend none! We barely have enough ourselves..."
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.27.17.1.mes: "Čáryfuk's own mother-in-law charged us with guarding this tent. We shall defend its entrance at any cost!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.32.19.0.mes: "We do not let just anyone into our library!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.33.5.0.mess: "You want to go underground? We can arrange that!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.33.5.1.mess: "Why not leave us alone and go your own way?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.34.25.0.mes: "You want to go underground? We can arrange that!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.36.11.0.mes: "Clearly, you have never met true masters of magic. Watch closely, then: this may be the last thing you ever see!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.38.3.0.mess: "You will grind nothing here! But we can grind you up!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.42.15.0.mes: "If you insist, let us get on with it!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.46.11.0.mes: "Aaaah, another innocent for our swords to dance upon..."
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.46.6.0.mess: "You want to go underground? We can arrange that!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.48.69.0.mes: "You want to go underground? We can arrange that!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.50.19.0.mes: "Everyone wants diamonds, preferably for nothing. I see you are no exception. But that will not work with me. You must earn them!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.53.8.0.mess: "Take us with you. We are lost and know no one in this land..."
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.55.33.0.mes: "How about a little battle to warm up? Would you be in the mood?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.58.54.0.mes: "Now, stop that! These shipyards are not for sale. Otherwise, we shall show you just how skilfully we wield our axes!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.63.12.0.mes: "Aren't you brave, picking on those smaller than you?!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.65.3.1.mess: "Another adventurer coveting what is not his. We have a little surprise for your sort. YOU SHALL DIE!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.70.69.0.mes: "This gold belongs to Hell! Soon your soul will belong to it too!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.8.18.0.mess: "What? You want to reopen this mine? Then we shall have no peace in our nests! Put that idea out of your head at once!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.monster.8.34.1.mess: "I dislike people who covet others' treasures!!! Prepare to fight!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.17.13.1.compl: "So you are a hero after all! You actually did it! At last I can return home and live with my brother again. I offer you this ring, which will serve as a pass to the secret path in the northeastern cavern. Shall we make the exchange?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.17.13.1.first:
"I shall gladly help you if you help me. Until recently, I lived with my brother in a nearby castle. But after Čáryfuk died, his mother-in-law sent her magical dragons against me, and I had to leave. All because my brother had obtained Čáryfuk's shield and would not return it. She cared nothing for the fact that I had driven my brother out over the matter. Now I have neither brother nor home.
But you bring me hope. If my brother lives, I shall gladly forgive him and take him back. First, however, I should like to move back in myself. Kill the dragons keeping me from my castle. Succeed, and I shall tell you how to obtain the fabled dragon treasure. You will find the key to the castle gate in the tent. "
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.17.13.1.nextV: "I thought you were no coward. But I must have been mistaken, since you have yet to dare face the dragon."
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.21.11.0.compl:
"That is it!!! That is it!!! That is it!!! Give it here!!!
Do you agree to the exchange?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.21.11.0.first: "Yes, I managed to obtain the shield of the mage Čáryfuk. But it cost me a great deal of money, so I shall not let it go cheaply. I will trade it for the dragon treasure hidden somewhere underground. If you are interested, visit my brother, who will help you find the way. Our family estate lies directly beneath your feet."
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.21.11.0.nextV: "You cannot fool me. Bring me the entire dragon treasure! Otherwise you shall never get the magical shield!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.65.64.1.compl: "I see you are well prepared. Will you exchange the necklace for safe passage?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.65.64.1.first:
An old wizard who has settled in this tower welcomes you.
"Yes, I guard the way to the fabled dragon treasure. Only an amulet made of dragon bones will open my doors. Without such a thing, you cannot pass."
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.65.64.1.nextV: The wizard is adamant. He will let no one pass without the Necklace of Dragonteeth.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.70.18.1.compl: "Well done! Do you still want to pass? Know that nothing good awaits you there."
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.70.18.1.first: "Have you a pass? Personally, I shall be satisfied if you bring me a ring with a dragon's eye. Then I shall let you through."
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.quest.70.18.1.nextV: "Without the right ring, I shall not let you pass!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.sign.31.67.0.messag: Exchange your horse for a fresh mount.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.town.12.35.0.name: Sněhulákov
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.town.27.10.1.name: Dračinec
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.town.27.45.0.name: Lost Lhota
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.town.34.59.0.name: Wolf Holes
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.town.43.43.1.name: Old Hole
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.town.46.18.1.name: Kostíkov
So Mazánek, too, had to leave home. He refuses to be outdone by his brothers and wants to prove that he will one day be a great warrior. Unlike his brothers, however, he favours magic. He maintains that magic, too, can win great victories.

Mazánek has discovered that the magical shield he must bring his father should be somewhere in this land. According to what he has learned, the great hero Strašpytel carried it off after Čáryfuk's death. Unfortunately, Strašpytel celebrated that death so endlessly that he drank himself to death.
His heirs, whose entire inheritance he had drunk away, sold the shield to a dealer for an immense sum. The dealer paid almost his whole fortune for it. He thus became the owner of the magical shield, but also utterly destitute. Even his own brother threw him out of their parents' castle, refusing to feed such a good-for-nothing.
The dealer settled somewhere in this land and lives as a hermit in a tree. Mazánek must find him and obtain the shield at any cost.
Your guards caught some scoundrels trying to break into your treasury. You had the rogues imprisoned and paid your guards a well-earned reward.

Your border patrols report seeing a crystal dragon fly over your territory.
You immediately send patrols to search along its path. You once heard that these dragons shed crystals from their hides.
What if it dropped something over your land?
The patrols sent to search where the crystal dragon was seen have returned. The tale you heard proved true: they found some crystals.

A letter arrives from your brothers, asking whether you need help. Although your situation is hardly ideal, you proudly refuse.
You do not want to remain the pampered darling of the family forever. At last, you must prove that you can manage without your family's helping hand.
Messengers arrive from your brothers, bringing warriors for your army. Your brothers explain that you would help them too. You should see this as brotherly aid, rather than a lack of faith in you.
Your scouts have discovered that the dealer you seek is in the northwest of the land. Before visiting him, you must find the Keymaster's Tent. Your scouts have yet to locate it.

Only now do you realise what sort of place you have moved into. This estate's finest years are long behind it. Worse, the old, leaking roof threatens to collapse on your head at any moment. 
Since you will be staying a while, you order renovations and set aside the necessary funds.
The renovations are dragging on. Meanwhile, materials have become dearer, and the funds you set aside will not cover the work. You must contribute more.

The firm you hired to renovate your estate has gone bankrupt. All the money you spent is lost, and your estate remains in dreadful condition.
Nevertheless, you decide to give up on the whole renovation business.

Mazánek has really done it this time. Experimenting with new spells again last night, he lost control of an enormous surge of magical energy. Luckily, there were no serious consequences. It merely sent the weather completely mad. A dreadful cloudburst rages outside.

The weather is still behaving strangely. The rain has eased a little, but it keeps falling. Now you realise you should have carried on with the renovations after all. Water has soaked the entire upper floor, and the ground floor looks little better. The damage is enormous.

You will have to undertake those renovations after all. Wishing to avoid the same fate as last time, you decide to place all the work in expert hands. You invite tenders from firms willing to put the place in order.

The tendering is over, and you have finally chosen one of the firms bidding for the contract. You pay its representative an advance and hand over the necessary resources.
In return, the firm promises to finish the renovations within 14 days.

You can hardly believe it. The firm has actually kept its word, and the renovations are complete. You inspect the quality of the work to be sure, and find a second cause for amazement. 
Everything is exactly as the contract specified. Moreover, they have behaved like true professionals: besides fulfilling every term, they have completed all the unfinished buildings. You pay the remaining agreed fee without protest.
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.town.59.15.0.name: Refuge
map.[ab] - honza 2:3.town.59.40.0.name: By the Forest
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.event.0.description:
Honzíček, Pepíček and Mazánek successfully completed the tasks their father had set them. All three arrived safely at the meeting place and boasted to one another of their adventures.
But a messenger shattered the happy scene with sorrowful news. Their homeland had been attacked, the enemy had captured their parents, and the invaders were spreading throughout the country, taking town after town. Only three castles in the very heart of the land remained: those Honza had built for his sons as a reward for obtaining the artifacts.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.event.1.description:
Enemy spies already lurk around the castles, assessing whether these final obstacles can be taken. Then the whole land will belong to the enemy.
Our heroes have no choice but to saddle their horses and ride to their castles at once. They take neither their armies nor the spoils won in battle, merely ordering their warriors to follow as quickly as possible.
Now all three stand before their castles, and the battle to save their parents and their country begins....
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.event.2.description: The brothers have settled in a little. They begin surveying the countryside and taking their first steps towards freeing their parents. But all eagerly await the armies that should be following them.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.event.3.description: The reinforcements still have not arrived. What could have delayed them?
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.event.4.description: The vanguards of their armies have reached all three brothers. Their commanders report that the main forces should arrive very soon. They are moving more slowly because they are bringing supplies.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.event.5.description: Today the scouts told the brothers they had found the key to the gate behind Honzíček's castle. It lies a few days' journey to the northeast. Unfortunately, another gate protects the key. First they must discover where its key lies.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.event.6.description: Good news: the scouts have found the key they mentioned last time. But you must travel to the northwestern desert to collect it.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.event.7.description: The scouts have found two more important keys. One lies on the northern ice plains, the other on the southern ice plains.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.event.8.description:
A report from the scouts.
"We found another important key underground, a little less than two days' march southeast of Strašnice Castle."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.event.9.description:
A messenger delivers an urgent dispatch from your scouts. It reads:
"My lord, when you set out for the northwestern desert to collect one of the keys, descend underground through one of the desert's gates. In the far northwestern cavern you will find the last key you need."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.29.35.0.mess: The monks were right. No sooner have you dealt with one enemy than hordes of basilisks, dragon flies and gorgons attack you.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.38.42.0.mess:
"We know you have come a long way. But that alone is no reason to hand over these resources," say the warriors beside them.
Will you fight them for the resources?
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.38.47.0.mess: "Catch the spy! He must not escape alive!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.42.44.0.mess: In the distance, you glimpse a lone sharpshooter trying to hide behind a nearby lookout tower. What might that fellow be up to?
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.44.30.0.mess: Surprisingly, your stay on this magical plain does you good. Within minutes, all your old wounds heal and your scars slowly fade away. Your mind grows calm, and you see that your company feels the same.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.44.31.0.mess: Now you know what became of the two legions of sharpshooters that came to aid your father. The enemy must have subdued them with some mighty spell or caught them in a trap. Seeing those ranks of warriors behind locked gates, you know the enemy never faced them in open battle.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.45.30.0.mess: How dreadful. You would dearly like to kick whoever devised this prison right in the @#&$%$!!!!
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.46.30.0.mess: To the north, your mother is imprisoned behind sturdy gates. Even from this distance, you can see her waving encouragement. She must be longing for the whole family to be together again.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.48.31.0.mess: The enemy must truly be terrified of sharpshooters to have locked them behind so many gates.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.56.52.0.mess: "Catch the spy! He must not escape alive!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.6.92.1.messa: Let us see what we have actually found...
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.60.65.0.mess: "Catch the spy! He must not escape alive!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.69.46.0.mess: Fine cards indeed... but quite unsuitable for a game of mariáš.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.85.15.0.mess: You face a terribly difficult decision. This mysterious Pandora's Box once belonged to the evil mage Čáryfuk. Who knows what he hid inside? What if it contains artifacts even finer than those you and your brothers obtained on your last adventure? But what if Čáryfuk sealed all his malice and dark power within it? Consider carefully and choose wisely. Do you wish to open the box?
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.guards.88.15.0.mess: It seems these dragons have never met a proper hero before. Ha, ha, ha...
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.header.description: All three brothers must free their parents and prevent the enemy from seizing their homeland. The key to ultimate victory is to gather an army of 2000 Sharpshooters, whom the invaders fear desperately. If you manage to assemble them, every enemy will flee in panic.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.header.name: Freeing the Parents
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.header.rumor.0.text: Beware of the valley of the undead.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.1.2.0.messa: "Aaaah! At last you have come! Now we can drain your soul..."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.10.4.1.mess: "You must be tired of living if you are so determined to enter this tent!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.16.20.0.mes: "Only the end of the world would make us let you in!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.18.26.0.mes: "You wish to enter land consecrated to the undead? One thing is certain. You shall enter, but only after your death!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.22.27.0.mes: You see lizards. Enormous lizards. They hover above your head like steam above a pot. After gawking at you for a while, they swoop down...
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.30.93.0.mes: "You must be tired of living if you are so determined to enter this tent!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.31.36.0.mes: "You had better turn back. We shall not surrender the mine willingly!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.32.38.0.mes: "The swamps are dangerous! You should not come here without experience and a good army."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.4.18.0.mess: "We drain, we drain, and you we shall drain too."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.44.34.0.mes:
The final obstacle has fallen. One of the generals steps before the ordered ranks of sharpshooters and says:
"Thank you for freeing us. Our entire army is now at your service. Lead us, and together we shall drive the hated invaders from this land. I guarantee they will never again dream, even in their worst nightmares, of troubling peaceful people in other countries."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.44.38.0.mes: "Please do not kill me! I am merely passing through this land to join my unit. Your father sent our people a plea for aid against the foreigners invading this country. Our ruler has already sent two legions of warriors here, but I cannot find their camp. I was delayed because my horse broke a leg on the way. In the end, I had to put him down, so now I travel on foot. Take me into your company; perhaps I shall yet find my unit."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.47.41.0.mes: "We spent years gathering these treasures. You cannot simply walk in and take them from us!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.47.82.1.mes: "You must be tired of living if you are so determined to enter this tent!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.48.34.0.mes:
When the gate opens, the sharpshooters' leader steps forward and says:
"Free again at last! The enemy stupefied us all with some dark spell, and we awoke behind these gates. Thank you for freeing us; we offer you our services. Please accept this modest gift as a token of our gratitude for our release.
But do not forget to free our comrades too. They are imprisoned somewhere nearby. On quiet nights, the wind carries their voices to us. Hurry, so we can fulfil the mission that brought us to your country."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.48.65.0.mes: "We protect smith - we not let you go to him!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.49.43.0.mes: "Why are you calling us slowworms?!? Go away before we show you out - in a coffin!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.57.46.0.mes: "Where are you headed, wretched worm? While we stand guard, you shall not set foot through this gate!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.59.3.0.mess: "You must be tired of living if you are so determined to enter this tent!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.63.72.0.mes: Please do not kill us! Your enemy promised us prosperity and plenty of food if we moved here. But in truth he meant to kill us. Our entire village once stood here, but after his raid, only about a third of us remained. Luckily, he has not returned since. We have lived here for years without anyone finding us, until you came. Once again, we beg you: do not kill us. Some of our more warlike halflings would even like to go with you.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.69.54.0.mes: "We dislike living creatures. Except as food..."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.7.27.0.mess: "So you wish to enter land consecrated to the undead? One thing is certain. You shall enter, but only after your death!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.70.47.0.mes: "What do you need those cards for? We stole them fair and square."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.monster.87.15.0.mes:
"Before he was slain, the mighty wizard Čáryfuk entrusted us with guarding this Pandora's Box.
Many heroes have sought it already, but all met with misfortune. I think you shall soon follow them!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.42.28.0.compl: "Yes, that seems to be it. Will you exchange it for safe passage?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.42.28.0.first: "Of course I can let you pass. But only if you bring me the magical Golden Bow."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.42.28.0.nextV: "Without the Golden Bow, I shall not let you take another step!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.44.33.0.compl: "Well, that will do. Will you exchange that Clover of Fortune for safe passage?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.44.33.0.first:
"I cannot simply let you pass. But we can come to an arrangement. Before she married, when your mother still ran her business, she had a magical Clover of Fortune. It was part of the reason her business prospered.
Bring me that magical Clover of Fortune, and I shall open the way."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.44.33.0.nextV: "Until you bring me the Clover of Fortune, we have nothing to discuss!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.46.28.0.compl: "Yes, that is my sash! Will you return it? Then I shall let you pass."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.46.28.0.first: "As I understand it, your father obtained a magnificent sash somewhere, with a dove on its clasp. That sash once belonged to me, but I lost it in a desert storm: the wind carried it away with some of my baggage. Bring it to me, and I shall open the way."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.46.28.0.nextV: "Try asking your father; perhaps he can advise you."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.48.33.0.compl: "Those are the ones!!! Will you give me my fortune-telling cards?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.48.33.0.first: "I have waited a long time for a hero. You see, I have a problem: magical dragons stole my fortune-telling cards. Bring them back, and I shall let you pass."
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.quest.48.33.0.nextV: "I do not want your ordinary mariáš cards. I want my fortune-telling cards!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.sign.67.64.0.messag:
Visit our tavern.
Home cooking, modest prices.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.sign.79.85.0.messag: Road construction has been halted for lack of funds.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.sign.83.97.0.messag:
On a half-rotten sign you read:
{"Sh.tty Swamps"
You can only guess what the author meant...
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.26.56.1.name: Hrobnice
A messenger reaches Mazánek.
"My lord, part of your army has arrived. They have taken quarters in the castle for now. They await your arrival and can set out with you on your next undertaking."

A breathless messenger runs up to Mazánek:
"My lord, the main body of your army arrived a few hours ago. They have all taken quarters to rest after their arduous journey. They brought some supplies as well."
The rest of Mazánek's army has finally arrived.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.40.45.0.name: Western Refuge
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.43.13.0.name: Kennels
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.44.33.1.name: Manín
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.47.58.1.name: Ohnivín
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.5.37.0.name: Klášternice
A messenger reaches Honzíček.
"My lord, part of your army has arrived. They have taken quarters in the castle for now. They await your arrival and can set out with you on your next undertaking."

At last, Honzíček's wait is over too. A breathless messenger catches up with him and delivers good news:
"My lord, the main body of your army arrived a few hours ago. They have all taken quarters to rest after their arduous journey. The supplies will arrive in a few days."
At last, those few stragglers have reached Honzíček's castle with the supplies.
Now Honzíček, too, has his entire former army together again.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.57.51.0.name: Stone Rampart
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.60.32.0.name: Zlobřice
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.62.37.1.name: Hellhole
A messenger reaches Pepíček.
"My lord, part of your army has arrived. They have taken quarters in the castle for now. They await your arrival and can set out with you on your next undertaking."

A breathless messenger runs up to Pepíček:
"My lord, the main body of your army arrived a few hours ago. They have all taken quarters to rest after their arduous journey. They brought some supplies as well."
At last, Pepíček too receives the remnants of his army.
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.63.64.0.name: Southern Stronghold
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.68.71.1.name: Strašnice
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.70.7.1.name: Pohrobkov
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.85.32.1.name: Great Hole
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.88.84.0.name: Lakeside Settlement
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.9.29.1.name: Settlement of Sins
map.[ab] - honza 2:4.town.96.53.1.name: Hrobín
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.event.0.description:
Scarcely had the brothers entered this land when something unexpected happened. Just beyond the border, local inhabitants surrounded them. Before they could draw their weapons, nets dropped from the trees, and moments later all were bound like swaddled infants.
One brother did manage to escape. The youngest, Mazánek, caught sight of the falling nets from the corner of his eye and uttered the first suitable spell that came to mind. It carried him several miles away. Unfortunately, it took him alone. There was no time for a more complex spell to save them all.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.event.1.description:
Yet Mazánek had a stroke of luck amid his misfortune. His spell left him before an old University of Magic. His first thought was to help his brothers. He took out his crystal ball and began examining their plight.
After a moment's concentration, an image appeared: his brothers being led away somewhere. {They are still alive!} He breathed a sigh of relief. Concentrating again, he began to hear voices in his mind. He gathered that the locals believed the brothers were followers of Čáryfuk, come to plunder and ravage their land once more.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.event.2.description:
The situation, briefly, is this: the locals have imprisoned the brothers in an underground cavern at an unknown location, from which they cannot escape unaided. Worse, the place is cursed, beyond even Mazánek's magical power. The locals are counting on the vanished brother trying to rescue the others. Then they will hang them all together. If he fails to appear within six months, they will at least hang those they caught. They cannot keep feeding them forever.
A fine prospect indeed. The only hope is to find the Grail and build a Grail structure in New Home. That might convince the locals that the brothers came in peace.
Everything now depends on Mazánek alone....
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.event.3.description:
The first thing you notice is the true beauty of nature here. Yet Čáryfuk's devastation is visible everywhere. Every mine has been destroyed; you cannot even tell where they once stood. You also see ruins suggesting that sawmills were once plentiful.
Sadly, none of them remains.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.event.4.description:
It seems the inhabitants of this once-beautiful land either perished in the attack by Čáryfuk's army or retreated into the surrounding forests.
Now they distrust every stranger they see. No one has attacked you yet ... But who knows what else you may encounter.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.event.5.description: Another important discovery: the country is not quite as thoroughly plundered as it first appeared. Čáryfuk did not manage to carry off all its wealth. The locals saved some and hid it in treasuries and caches throughout the land, well guarded by their militia.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.0.47.0.messa: Did you really have to wander into such a remote place? Now you are likely to fall prey to savage robbers.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.1.22.0.messa: Perhaps this is the last tent. At least, you have seen no others.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.1.62.0.messa: While resting, you notice a lynx climbing a nearby tree towards a crow's nest. Unwilling to hurt it, you climb up too and chase it away. In the nest you find a collection of shiny stones and a ring.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.10.10.0.mess: Since you are so diligent about collecting everything... You deserve something extra for your efforts.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.10.19.0.mess: You stumble over what appear to be the bones of a great dragon. A closer examination reveals that they would make suitable greaves.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.11.1.0.messa:
Very well, then. Since you insist on searching everywhere....
So you cannot complain, here is something for your trouble.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.11.49.1.mess: Many different creatures live underground. Now you will become better acquainted with one strange species inhabiting this region.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.12.47.0.mess:
{"Halt! Hands up and turn {your {pockets {inside out!"}
The scoundrels before you think they have found easy prey.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.14.25.0.mess: There really is nothing here. Unless you count what you stepped in beneath that bush.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.14.28.0.mess: What have the dwarves hoarded here for us?
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.2.21.0.messa: No sooner have you collected the key from the tent than the guards rush at you, having been napping somewhere off to the side until now. But they are too late: the key is already in your pocket. You spur your stallion, and he shoots away like an arrow, his mane streaming behind him like a battle standard. Even a bird could not keep pace with him now. Far behind, the guards' helpless curses fade away, unable to harm you.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.2.31.0.messa: You see a water goblin trying to drown an old man in a nearby pool. This enrages you. You rescue the old man and drag the water goblin onto dry land. Uncomfortable in the open air, he offers you a magical pendant in exchange for his freedom.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.2.4.1.messag:
You approach the first of three strange megalithic structures, scraping away the dirt with your hands and tearing off the creepers covering its surface. Beneath them, mysterious runes begin to show faintly.
After a little patient work, the strange writing sees daylight again for the first time in centuries. Slowly, you begin copying the runes into your notebook...
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.20.1.0.messa: I cannot understand why you keep wandering into remote corners instead of trying to free your brothers as quickly as possible!
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.20.41.1.mess: So this is where the dog, or rather the treasure, was buried! The poor fellow searching for it came very close to success. But now you will be the one to enjoy the treasure.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.20.54.1.mess: It seems you are not alone in wanting refreshment from the magical spring...
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.20.66.0.mess:
{"My lord!"}
You look around for a moment, then spot a figure at the forest's edge.
{"I saw how you dealt with those scoundrels. 
{I have always wanted to {serve a warrior such as you. 
{Will you take me and my friends into your army?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.21.29.0.mess: You see a cyclops bathing in the river. As a joke, you take his clothes and wait to hear his curses. But then you discover that his tunic has magical powers, and quietly slip away with it.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.21.66.0.mess: You gave those villains a thorough thrashing and collected their plundered treasures.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.22.37.1.mess: The mystery is solved! There lies our mysterious digger, or at least what remains of him. Some people simply have no luck in life.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.22.66.0.mess:
{"Halt! Hands up and turn {your {pockets {inside out!"}
The scoundrels before you think they have found easy prey.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.23.28.0.mess: What have the dwarves hoarded here for us?
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.24.37.1.mess: Well, look at this! The whole place has been dug up! What was someone searching for? Treasure, perhaps?
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.24.40.0.mess:
{"Halt! Hands up and turn {your {pockets {inside out!"}
The scoundrels before you think they have found easy prey.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.25.36.0.mess: You see several sets of tracks leading through the underground gate. None leads out. Might some company await you below?
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.25.6.0.messa: Ahead stands another storehouse concealing this land's riches. Extra supplies are always worth having.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.27.16.0.mess: Those half-dead trees will serve no further purpose. You order some felled and their timber taken to your storehouse.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.27.49.0.mess:
You approach the first of several strange megalithic structures, scraping away the dirt with your hands and tearing off the creepers covering its surface. Beneath them, mysterious runes begin to show faintly.
After a little patient work, the strange writing sees daylight again for the first time in centuries. Slowly, you begin copying the runes into your notebook...
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.28.48.0.mess:
Here are the remaining obelisks. Now you have not the slightest doubt that you will find the Grail.
You quickly ready your pencil and notebook to copy the mysterious runes that will lead you to it.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.28.64.1.mess: Some creatures approach, plainly hungry. This time they have made a dreadful mistake: this will be their last hunt. It seems they will lose those hungry heads of theirs.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.29.14.0.mess: How strange that this mill survived the enemy raids. Perhaps someone inside survived too and could work for you!
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.3.34.0.messa: Somewhere ahead, desperate cries for help ring out. What could be happening?
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.3.46.1.messa:
You approach the first of three strange megalithic structures. With your hands, you scrape away the dirt and tear off the creepers covering its surface. Beneath them, mysterious runes begin to show faintly.
After a little patient work, the strange writing sees daylight again for the first time in centuries. Slowly, you begin copying the runes into your notebook...
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.3.69.0.messa: Well, look at that! All the places where treasures of every sort are hidden!
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.30.47.0.mess: You have passed the gate barring your way to the castle. Now you need only find the Grail and build a Grail structure in your parents' New Home.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.31.13.1.mess: Another tent with a key. It is bound to prove useful.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.31.23.0.mess: That little fellow must be cheerful, to feel like dancing. Why not visit him? Perhaps his good spirits will move him to give you something.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.31.30.1.mess: Some creatures approach, plainly hungry. This time they have made a dreadful mistake: this will be their last hunt. It seems they will lose those hungry heads of theirs.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.31.48.1.mess: A pleasant surprise is not all that awaits in every remote place...
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.32.12.1.mess: Your presence has attracted some blind little monsters. They make ideal underground guards: in eternal darkness they need no ordinary sight, for they see by infrared.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.32.20.0.mess: The old witch beside the road seems to have been waiting for you. As you approach, she hands you a small statuette and walks away without a word.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.32.34.0.mess: What did you expect to find here? All you have done is annoy your troops by dragging them to the ends of the earth.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.34.18.0.mess:
All that remains is to settle here and consider how to free your brothers. In the meantime, of course, you must search for the Grail. You certainly will not be bored.
Finding the Grail would be the best way to convince the locals of your good intentions. Then they might release your brothers.
But remember: you have only six months. Otherwise, all is lost...
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.34.57.0.mess: What have the dwarves hoarded here for us?
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.34.8.0.messa: A merchant from a distant land offers you his people's latest invention. It brings distant objects within arm's reach, and is called . . . a Spyglass. He even offers it very cheaply.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.35.69.0.mess: You glimpse figures beneath a nearby cliff. But they do not seem to be the ones you seek. Then you remember that the locals also call the Valley of White Cliffs the Valley of Trolls. Soon you will have a chance to learn why firsthand...
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.36.67.0.mess: A picturesque little valley opens before you, entirely encircled by white cliffs. This must be the valley the last halfling mentioned. Yet you have a feeling it had another name as well, though you cannot recall it. Now to find that fellow with the sword.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.38.26.0.mess: A band of savage (and none too clean) orcs attacks your company. You defeat them easily, and the survivors scatter in every direction. One fallen orc wears a shiny horned helmet. Since it looks rather fine, you take it as a souvenir.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.39.63.0.mess:
{"Halt! Hands up and turn {your {pockets {inside out!"}
The scoundrels before you think they have found easy prey. Though these rogues have especially dangerous leaders, you refuse to be intimidated.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.4.10.0.messa:
This estate is evidently less deserted than it first appeared. Some peasants have sheltered here from the enemy, and they certainly will not surrender it willingly.
You did not want to bring violence to this land, but what can you do? You have no other choice.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.4.3.1.messag:
And three more obelisks....
You quickly ready your pencil and notebook to copy the mysterious runes that will lead you to the Grail.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.40.20.0.mess: Well done. You certainly have a nose for hidden treasure.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.40.31.0.mess: You stop to help a foreign diplomat whose wagon axle has broken. In thanks, he gives you a ring with a mysterious inscription. He says it reads: "Help those you meet upon your journey."
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.42.10.0.mess: What have the dwarves hoarded here for us?
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.42.29.0.mess: The cliff nearby is crumbling, and you are short of ore. You immediately assign some men to quarry stone here, to provide at least the most essential supplies.
map.[ab] - honza 2:5.guards.42.70.0.mess:

map.[ab] - honza 2:5.town.12.58.0.name: New Home
Your workers have brought the quarried stone.

The most dreadful morning of your life. You watch the locals preparing to execute your brothers this evening. Unfortunately, you can do nothing. The local population has grown considerably, and they have allied with a mighty enemy whose armies are flooding the land and surrounding your forces. You will not escape this adventure unscathed. When the sun sets, your body will surely swing on the gallows beside your brothers'.
You have failed!!! And your brothers trusted you so much ...
Keep idling like this, and you will never make it! Remember, you have only five days left!!!

Your scouts return from exploring underground and report several strange stone obelisks in the caverns, covered in ancient runes. Unfortunately, none of them can read runes, so they cannot tell you what they mean. You, however, will surely manage. You should go and look.

Your scouts report seeing all manner of treasures hidden in the unlikeliest places throughout the land. Unfortunately, they could not bring them back without delaying their reconnaissance. You ought to search such places yourself.
I wonder whether you will make it at this pace. I certainly would not want to be in your brothers' shoes...

You have learned something interesting. Čáryfuk's mother-in-law has recently taken an unusual interest in the castle your parents chose as their new home!!!
Yes, the very woman whose faerie dragons you killed while obtaining the magical shield of the mage Čáryfuk!
That is rather too many coincidences. First your father kills Čáryfuk while defeating Nemakačenko, then you brothers obtain his most valuable possessions, and meanwhile you destroy his mother-in-law's beloved pets....
Who knows what else lies ahead...

How unpleasant! Resources are scarce enough, and now someone has emptied your stores. It must have been a professional, for only the rare resources were taken, every last one. Perhaps you relied too much on the locals' fear of you. As you can see, your treasures hold no terrors for them.
You should look for some of those hidden treasures your scouts mentioned. Or repay the favour by emptying the many treasuries scattered about the land.
An eye for an eye, a treasure for a treasure...

Tomorrow, the reprieve the locals granted your brothers expires. It seems tomorrow will be the worst day of your life. Unless, of course, a miracle lets you build a Grail structure in New Home. But miracles happen only in fairy tales...

Three months have passed. You have experienced much and achieved a good deal, but you are still far from completing your task. If you mean to finish in time, you should hurry. Remember, half your time has already gone.

You woke this morning with an uneasy feeling. After a while, you realised why. You have been in this land for a month and a half. For six long weeks, you have had to manage everything alone. Yet you have achieved very little so far.
It does nothing for your spirits to realise that a quarter of the reprieve the locals granted your brothers has already passed. Unless you hurry, your brothers may die!
Remember, the only way to free your brothers is to find the Grail and build a Grail structure in New Home.

Time has marched on. Four whole months have passed, and the fifth is already in its second half. You have accomplished a fair amount, but the grand finale still awaits.
Do not delay! You must find the Grail and build a Grail structure in New Home as soon as possible! Only then will you convince the locals of your friendly intentions. Then your brothers will be free.
Only one month remains until your brothers' execution. It is high time you did something! Or do you want to let them die?
You have three weeks left to complete your task. Unless you build a Grail structure in New Home by then, all will be lost. Your brothers will hang, and who knows what awaits you...
Hurry! Time is running out. Only 14 days left, and ...
Your last week to turn everything around has begun. Otherwise, your brothers' fate is sealed!
Get moving, get moving!!! Only six days left!
