map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.0.description:
Mazánek was lucky after all. He managed to find the Grail and build a Grail structure in New Home. The people of the land realised that the brothers posed no threat; on the contrary, their parents wanted to improve the country. They released Honzíček and Pepíček from prison and apologised to all the brothers for their mistake.
However, they revealed that Čáryfuk's family really did lay claim to New Home. His mother-in-law Rebbeca was apparently the most determined to take it. The locals had even heard that Čáryfuk's entire family planned to storm New Home very soon.
That truly angered the brothers. They decided to rid themselves of that damned family once and for all. That is why they are here now: to root out those weeds.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.1.description:
The brothers have spread out across the country and sent out scouts to assess the enemy's strength. They are no longer novices, and hope to wipe out that accursed family within a few weeks.
First, however, they must build bases from which to attack the individual members of Čáryfuk's family. Once their scouts report back, they will know exactly where to strike.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.10.descriptio: Today the brothers had to pay another instalment on the loan from the unknown donor.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.11.descriptio: On the very day the brothers were due to pay another instalment, the mysterious stranger got in touch. His message told them not to send the next payment yet, as his finances were beginning to improve.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.12.descriptio:
What bad luck. The mysterious benefactor has asked the brothers for a small loan. He has run into trouble and needs a little financial help for a few days.
After discussing it, the brothers decided to lend him the money. Surely it would repay them handsomely in the future.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.13.descriptio: Today the mysterious benefactor repaid what the brothers lent him a week ago. He generously added a little something in goods as well.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.14.descriptio: A message arrived from the mysterious benefactor. He has finally overcome his financial difficulties and can afford to sponsor the brothers as he originally promised. He immediately sent a tidy pile of gold as his first contribution.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.15.descriptio: Another contribution arrived from the mysterious benefactor today.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.16.descriptio: The scouts have discovered that some of the underground colonies they mentioned also shelter former servants who escaped from Čáryfuk's family. They know the castles well, and some might even tell you how to enter those protected by Border Gates.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.17.descriptio: The scouts report that it is possible to travel between the different territories. However, the roads are blocked by garrisons of very powerful warriors. On the other hand, those garrisons will also protect you from enemy invasions, at least for a while.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.2.description:
The first reports from the scouts have arrived.
They have discovered that Čáryfuk has quite an extensive family. They own about half a dozen castles in this country. The members of this peculiar family are rather eccentric. The worst of them is Čáryfuk's mother-in-law, Rebbeca. Beware of her!
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.3.description: A wandering storyteller stopped by and told you a legend about a fabulous treasure somewhere underground. The way to it is heavily guarded, though, and who knows whether the legends are true at all. Besides, you find it hard to believe that such a treasure would simply lie there for anyone to take.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.4.description: Your scouts report several underground colonies where local inhabitants have taken refuge from Čáryfuk's family. All the underground entrances are guarded by the strongest warriors from the colonies. The colonists do not rely solely on these guards: they protect their individual dwellings too. If you captured one of these colonies, you would gain a steady supply of new warriors for your armies.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.5.description: The scouts have pulled off quite a feat. In disguise, they infiltrated an enemy castle and discovered something interesting. Čáryfuk's family has fallen out!!! The others resent Rebbeca's leadership. She claims the largest share of the wealth and even expects the other family members to pay her for her "office". The entire sprawling family has therefore split into several groups. At least that will make your work easier.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.6.description: The reports are confirmed! Čáryfuk's family really is divided. There have even been skirmishes between some of its members. The scouts report that the whole great family has split into three groups. Each has established its own base and blocked access with a Border Gate.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.7.description:
The brothers received a message from an unknown benefactor who seems very wealthy. He writes that he will support their fight. Čáryfuk's family has been a thorn in his side for a long time too. They borrowed a heap of money from him, but show little inclination to repay their debts. In return for his help, he hopes to receive a share of the wealth the brothers acquire.
Well, there are all sorts of strange people in the world. And the brothers can use any help they can get.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.8.description: A tidy sum has arrived from the unknown benefactor. He apologises that he cannot give it as a gift, only as a loan. Unfortunately, his finances are not at their best just now. He believes things will improve in time.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.event.9.description: Today the brothers had to pay the first instalment on the loan from the unknown donor.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.guards.1.139.0.mess: After rescuing a little boy from a pack of wolves, you return him to his father's estate. The grateful nobleman rewards you with a Badge of Courage.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.guards.131.124.1.me: Ahead, you see a tent where a few former servants of Čáryfuk's family live. Perhaps they could tell you how to enter one of the castles.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.guards.134.121.1.me: "Welcome, hero. Yes, you are right. Some of us did serve the dark knight Boozer at Okailern Castle. We fled that cursed place just as they began building a Border Gate to keep intruders out. Had we stayed, that vile Boozer would surely have drained not only our blood, but our souls as well. You are very lucky: during our escape, one of us managed to steal a spare key to the gate. Take it and destroy that nest of Satan!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.guards.39.136.1.mes: To your left, you see a tent where a few former servants of Čáryfuk's family live. Perhaps they could tell you how to enter one of the castles.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.guards.42.136.1.mes: "Welcome, hero. Yes, you are right. Some of us once served at Grundamon Castle, under the brother of Čáryfuk the mage himself. We managed to flee that cursed place just as they began building a Border Gate to keep intruders out. That lunatic should have stayed locked away in the institution where he belongs. You are extremely lucky: during our escape, one of us managed to steal a spare key to the gate. Take it and destroy that accursed den of sin."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.guards.43.3.0.messa: A short distance away, you see an enormous hole. You once heard that the enemy summons reinforcements through it from Hell itself. Judging by the stench rising from it, you could almost believe it.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.guards.60.63.1.mess: Welcome, hero. Yes, you are right. Some of us did serve Rebbeca herself at Evillon Castle. We fled that cursed place just as they began building a Border Gate to keep intruders out. You are very lucky: during our escape, one of us managed to steal a spare key to the gate. Take it and destroy that nest of Satan!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.guards.64.64.1.mess: Ahead, you see a tent where a few former servants of Čáryfuk's family live. Perhaps they could tell you how to enter one of the castles.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.guards.72.64.1.mess: You can hardly believe it. You have reached the fabled treasure cave. But the legends also say that its treasures are heavily guarded. You will probably find that out for yourself soon enough...
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.header.description: All three sons have decided to destroy Čáryfuk's entire surviving family. They are growing tired of running into them at every turn. If they succeed, they will earn the gratitude of the whole world.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.header.name: Against Everyone!
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.0.biography: The only full brother of Čáryfuk the mage. He was originally confined to an institution for the mentally disabled, but escaped and became ruler of a small territory through his family's connections. What he lacks in brains, he makes up for in strength.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.0.name: Ada Čáryfuk
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.109.biograph: A cousin of Čáryfuk the mage. Small in stature, but terribly bad-tempered. She had a difficult childhood. Daily beatings taught her to endure great pain, which comes in especially handy in battle.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.109.name: Pizizubka
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.51.biography: A half-brother of Čáryfuk the mage. He has shown sadistic and paedophilic tendencies since childhood. That is why he owns a large imp farm, where he goes to satisfy his perverse desires.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.51.name: Hugo Čáryfuk
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.52.biography: After the death of her son-in-law, Čáryfuk the mage, she became the unofficial leader of the entire family. The others respect her authority, because she punishes any disobedience to her orders severely.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.52.name: Rebbeca
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.68.biography: A half-sister of Čáryfuk the mage. She devoted her whole life to frolicking with knights and continues this hobby after death. The only difference is that she has switched to dead knights. She practises her art as skilfully as she did while alive.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.68.name: Cassandra
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.71.biography: An uncle of Čáryfuk the mage. An incorrigible drunkard during his lifetime, he has continued his indulgence after death. The only difference is that he now drinks his victims' blood. He has become a regular visitor to sobering-up stations, where the blood of drunks reminds him a little of his days among the living.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.heroes.71.name: Boozer
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.1.62.0.mess: "Our underground colony sent us here to guard the entrance and protect its dwellings from intruders. How can we trust that you do not intend to slaughter those helpless victims? And even if you defeat us, our colonists are well prepared for the likes of you."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.119.133.1.m: "How dare you set foot here! Prepare to die!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.120.142.1.m: "We will never serve you! We would rather die with honour!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.125.130.0.m: "You will not defeat us so easily. We have a mighty sword, and with it we have never lost a battle."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.128.86.0.me: "Our underground colony sent us here to guard the entrance and protect its dwellings from intruders. How can we trust that you do not intend to slaughter those helpless victims? And even if you defeat us, our colonists are well prepared for the likes of you."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.129.2.0.mes: "Our underground colony sent us here to guard the entrance and protect its dwellings from intruders. How can we trust that you do not intend to slaughter those helpless victims? And even if you defeat us, our colonists are well prepared for the likes of you."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.135.143.1.m: "Leave us alone! We want no master!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.139.120.1.m: "We do not know how you got this far. But we will do everything we can to make sure you never leave!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.141.139.1.m: "We will not be enslaved again! We would rather die in battle!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.141.142.0.m: "Our underground colony sent us here to guard the entrance and protect its dwellings from intruders. How can we trust that you do not intend to slaughter those helpless victims? And even if you defeat us, our colonists are well prepared for the likes of you."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.142.132.1.m: "Rather than serve someone again, we would sooner die fighting for freedom!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.15.123.0.me:
Suddenly, camouflaged warriors leap out of the bushes. They were so well hidden that you never noticed them. You are so startled that your ...beeeep... (censored) goes limp.
But there is no reason to panic. Their leader steps forward and offers you his services and those of his entire company.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.19.141.1.me: "We will never serve you! We would rather die with honour!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.22.95.0.mes: "We won this mine from the dwarves fair and square. Do you think you can just stroll up and we will hand it over willingly? You are sorely mistaken. Let us have a fair fight, and the winner gets the mine!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.26.130.0.me: "Another one trying to steal the wood we need to build our nests!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.3.129.1.mes: "Where do your feet lead you, traveller? You surely intend to conquer our home. We cannot possibly allow that. And stop shaking, you little coward! Draw your sword and at least die fighting honourably!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.30.123.1.me: "We do not know how you got this far. But we will do everything we can to make sure you never leave!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.31.140.0.me:
At the Magic Lantern, you catch a pretty girl trying to recruit your sprites for work in some nightclub. You warn her: "If I catch you here again, I will spank your bare bottom!"
She replies: "But this is already my second time here..."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.36.139.1.me: "Leave us alone! We want no master!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.38.100.0.me: "We are protecting our distant relatives. If you want to reach them, you will have to fight your way through!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.39.136.0.me: "Our underground colony sent us here to guard the entrance and protect its dwellings from intruders. How can we trust that you do not intend to slaughter those helpless victims? And even if you defeat us, our colonists are well prepared for the likes of you."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.45.140.1.me: "We will not be enslaved again! We would rather die in battle!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.50.18.1.mes: "Where do your feet lead you, traveller? You surely intend to conquer our home. We cannot possibly allow that. And stop shaking, you little coward! Draw your sword and at least die fighting honourably!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.55.141.1.me: "Rather than serve someone again, we would sooner die fighting for freedom!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.57.59.0.mes: "Wait a moment while we decide whether to fight you or join you."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.58.38.1.mes: "We do not know how you got this far. But we will do everything we can to make sure you never leave!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.60.125.1.me: "How dare you set foot here! Prepare to die!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.60.26.1.mes: "We will never serve you! We would rather die with honour!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.61.66.1.mes: "Welcome, hero. You must be brave and courageous to have made it this far. You have conquered this cave, so our presence here is no longer needed. Please take us into your army, so we can finally have some adventure again."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.64.69.1.mes: "We saw those cowards join you. But we will remain true to our task and continue guarding these treasures. Prepare to fight! You will get nothing for free!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.67.73.1.mes: "At last! We are tired of guarding these treasures forever. We much prefer the din of battle to all this idling. Please take us with you!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.69.42.1.mes: "How dare you set foot here! Prepare to die!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.74.64.0.mes: "For centuries I have guarded this entrance to the fabled treasure cave. No mortal has ever entered it. But whoever defeats us will find fabulous riches."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.monster.79.22.1.mes: "Rather than serve someone again, we would sooner die fighting for freedom!"

map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.25.106.0.comp: You have finally defeated the Faerie Dragons. Will you give me the statuette now? It is an old family heirloom. I offer you the Orb of Vulnerability as a reward. Are you willing to make the exchange?
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.25.106.0.firs: I have a great favour to ask. Some Faerie Dragons flew past recently and stole a valuable statuette of mine. If you defeat them and bring it back, I will reward you well. I will give you an artifact that will make your spells so powerful that even the strongest warriors will fear them.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.25.106.0.next: Do not lose heart. Defeating the Faerie Dragons is difficult, but I am sure you can manage it. My latest information suggests that the dragons have settled nearby, beside the dwelling of some birds.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.55.5.0.comple: The mercenaries will let you pass if you leave 150 Familiars here as their new recruits. Do you wish to make the exchange now?
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.55.5.0.firstV: A band of mercenaries has occupied this tower. They say they will let you pass if you bring them 150 Familiars as new recruits.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.55.5.0.nextVi: The mercenaries still demand 150 Familiars for passage.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.72.64.0.compl: The guard acknowledges that you have reached level 38. Do you wish to pass now?
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.72.64.0.first: "The area beyond me is very dangerous. I doubt you would survive there. However, I will let you pass if you gain enough experience to reach at least level 38."
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.72.64.0.nextV: The local guard will let no one below level 38 pass.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.9.125.0.compl: The mercenaries will let you pass if you leave 150 Sprites here as their new recruits. Do you wish to make the exchange now?
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.9.125.0.first: A band of mercenaries has occupied this tower. They say they will let you pass if you bring them 150 Sprites as new recruits.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.quest.9.125.0.nextV: The mercenaries still demand 150 Sprites for passage.
map.[ab] - honza 2:6.sign.105.105.0.mess: Which way, which way does the path go?

map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.0.description: Another report has arrived from the scouts. They have discovered several monoliths across the country, guarded by powerful warriors. However, they could not discover where the monoliths lead.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.1.description: The scouts have finally learned more about the monoliths. It seems that they link all the regions together. They can also take you to the very "centre of the country". Whoever takes control of this centre is halfway to victory. An old mage also lives there in a hut, and can use his crystal ball to show you all the enemy bases.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.10.descriptio: Your scouts tried to discover the identity of the enemy fighting under the tan flag. Unfortunately, they could not learn a single thing about him anywhere. He must come from far away, since no one in this country or its neighbours knows anything about him. All the scouts could establish is that he is very wealthy, has an enormous army, commands many kinds of magic, and has warriors who were born to fight.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.11.descriptio: You were beginning to think the enemy had stopped robbing your warehouses, but now you see how badly mistaken you were. Your warehouses had unwelcome visitors again last night. There must have been many thieves this time, as the warehouses are almost empty.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.12.descriptio: After the latest robbery, you decided to increase security at every warehouse. From today, strong patrols will guard them all day and night. You cannot let yourself be robbed so brazenly.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.13.descriptio:
Your scouts have discovered that you can reach the centre through a yellow one-way monolith guarded by Titans. However, there are several entrance and exit monoliths throughout the country. You may therefore not reach the centre on your first try.

Note: It is best to save your game before entering the monolith. If you end up somewhere else, reload your save and try again.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.14.descriptio: The scouts advise you to capture the Golem Factory as soon as possible if you want to control the centre. You will have to hand over some golems to the mercenaries, or you will not get past their guard. Be warned, however: they have no interest in ordinary golems.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.2.description: A very important report from your scouts. To enter the enclosed area in the middle of your region, you must use the two-way monolith just a few steps from your starting castle. If you have not found it yet, look harder!!!
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.3.description: An interesting report has arrived from the scouts. They have discovered another enemy in this country who has heard about the disagreements within your family. He wants to exploit them and destroy your entire family.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.4.description: The enemy fighting under the tan flag is building a powerful army. His forces grow stronger every day, and he plans to attack soon.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.5.description: The scouts report finding a military camp flying tan banners. The enemy spotted them, and they barely escaped with their lives. They did discover that a powerful hero leads the army, which is so enormous that they could not even count its warriors.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.6.description: Someone broke into your resource warehouses last night and thoroughly cleaned them out. If you got your hands on those scoundrels, you would wring their necks.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.7.description: This is no longer funny. Scoundrels have raided your resource warehouses again. This time, however, they left a clue. A scrap of tan cloth was caught on a protruding nail in one of the chests. You also tried to talk your scouts into raiding the enemy warehouses, but they did not dare. They claim the enemy guards them extremely well.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.8.description: The scouts report that taking control of the centre will also give you access to several mines. The centre also holds the key to enclosed areas containing enormous quantities of resources. Naturally, powerful warriors guard those resources closely.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.event.9.description: At dawn this morning, a scout arrived with an important report. Several enemy spies have been spotted in your territory. It seems the enemy is assessing the situation and preparing to attack.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.100.71.0.mes:
The head groom greets you:
"Welcome, my lord! Allow me to exchange your tired horse for a rested one. Visit the housekeeper meanwhile. A cup of good wine and a slice of roast meat will do you good too."
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.105.52.0.mes: Before you lies proof that this land was once beneath the sea. You see a fairly well-preserved shipwreck, which has stood here for ages as a monumental memorial to ancient mariners. Who knows whether some forgotten treasure remains aboard...
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.106.37.0.mes: That is the end of the dragons. One of your men, a very skilful fellow, has fashioned a handsome shield from their scales.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.106.59.0.mes:
You are resting with your warriors in a small clearing. You notice one of them take two beautiful pears from his pack and examine them curiously. They smell so wonderful that your mouth waters.
"Could I have one?" you ask him.
Without a word, he hands you one. You eat it with remarkable relish, then notice the warrior carefully peeling his own pear with a knife. You ask why he is doing that: does he dislike the skin? He replies:
"Oh no, Commander. One of them fell into a big turd beneath the tree, and I do not know which one!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.106.63.0.mes: A travelling merchant seeks protection from a band of goblins. In return for your help, he offers a pair of boots made from the softest leather. You examine them closely, fascinated by the ancient runes stamped into the leather, and agree without hesitation.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.108.29.0.mes:
After leaving the monolith, you look around to see where you have arrived. Suddenly, a quiet, monotonous voice seeps into your mind:
"What do you seek in this accursed place, traveller? What ill wind brought you here? Whoever sets foot here shall have his soul damned forever. The terrible guardians of this land will tear your body apart, and your bones will rot here like those of all the unfortunate souls who came before you. No one has ever left."
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.108.40.0.mes:
The Titan's Cuirass is within reach when hideous monsters suddenly charge at you from a rocky crevice.
You have no choice but to fight for your life.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.108.41.0.mes: You put on the cuirass immediately. It fits you perfectly.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.108.42.0.mes: You have won yourself a tidy pile of money.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.108.50.0.mes: You can already see the guards at the mines. It will not be an easy battle, but you are no weakling either. You take a deep breath and command: {"Forward!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.112.36.0.mes: That is the end of the dragons. One of your men, a very skilful fellow, has fashioned a handsome suit of armour from their scales.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.115.23.0.mes: The bandits must have plagued the surrounding countryside for quite some time, judging by the quantity of stolen treasure.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.117.61.0.mes:
An old monk stops you outside the shrine.
"Welcome, weary traveller. Enter and rest your tired body. Within our temple, you will be completely safe from every danger posed by man or nature."
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.119.22.0.mes: An overgrown, winding path leads you ever deeper into the impenetrable jungle. The firm ground slowly turns to sticky mud, and your horse's hooves leave deep prints that gradually fill with water.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.121.23.0.mes:
The shadows of the trees cast fantastic patterns across the narrow path. Your horse's hooves sink ever deeper into the thin marsh mud, slowing your progress despite your constant urging.
Just then, a deep voice booms from the bushes beside the path:
"Not another step, impudent intruder! Turn your horse around and leave, or you will regret it!"	But already the bushes part, and a circle of ruffians closes around you.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.125.59.0.mes: You see veteran mercenaries camped in a picturesque nook. They call you over, offering to teach you a few new tricks of war.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.125.66.0.mes:
You were warned!
{Death to the hero, eternal {damnation to the thief!
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.126.49.0.mes:
On the shore of a nearby lake, you see a fisherman haul a beautiful, buxom mermaid from the water. He examines her briefly, then throws her back in disgust.
"Why?!" you call out.
Disappointed, he replies: "How?!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.128.56.0.mes: As you approach the mill, the miller's hands attack you. Teach them a lesson before they make a habit of this.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.131.43.0.mes: You see a blind old woman approaching the edge of a chasm. You save her at the last moment. But she is so old that she has only a few hours left to live. You promise her a dignified burial, and in return she gives you a magical pendant shaped like an eye. It allows you to see even with your eyes closed.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.131.59.0.mes:
A dreadful troll with a mighty club leaps out from beneath the bridge.
"Halt, traveller," he roars. "Before you step onto the bridge, know that no one crosses without paying."
You rein in your horse.
{"And what price do you demand for passage?"
"The price is a right hand," says the troll with a sneer.
You draw your sword, and in an instant the troll's hand lies on the ground, still clutching its club, staining the grass with dark blood.
{"Here is what you asked for,"} you sneer in turn, and spur your horse on. Behind you, the whimpering troll calls down every thunderbolt upon your head.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.132.36.0.mes: You come upon a caravan of gypsies feasting around a fire and drinking mead. They invite you over and say: "If you can perform the Rama-Buta dance, we will reward you well." Although you do not know the dance, you try to dance something. The gypsies roar with laughter, but admire your courage and give you a curious talisman.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.138.3.0.mess: Do you think that mercury was left here for you? You are sorely mistaken! Its owners have just arrived to collect it. Will you fight them for the mercury?
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.140.2.0.mess: That pile of sulfur is not free for the taking. It is a little snack for the Rust Dragons who are just arriving to gorge themselves. Will you fight them for the sulfur?
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.24.94.0.mess: The bandits must have plagued the surrounding countryside for quite some time, judging by the quantity of stolen treasure.

map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.32.74.0.mess: A deep fissure, whose bottom you can barely see, stops avalanches that might threaten you from the neighbouring territory. On the other hand, it also prevents you from expanding your lands. You will have to find another way. The enemy is not going anywhere.

map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.53.100.0.mes: When nothing remained of the dragons but a heap of bones, you decided to take something as a souvenir.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.56.102.0.mes:
The Titan's Gladius is within reach. Suddenly, however, hideous monsters charge at you from a rocky crevice.
You have no choice but to fight for your life.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.56.103.0.mes: The sword is truly masterfully forged. You can barely feel it in your hand, but when you draw it, you feel as though fresh strength has been poured into your muscles.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.56.104.0.mes: You have won yourself a tidy pile of money.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.56.113.0.mes: You can already see the guards at the mines. It will not be an easy battle, but you are no weakling either. You take a deep breath and command: {"Forward!!!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.58.124.0.mes:

"Why?!" you call out.
Disappointed, he replies: "How?!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.58.87.0.mess:
A little too late, you notice a horde of barbarian warriors sitting around the fire. They are probably resting during some expedition. You do not wait for them to recover, but seize the advantage of surprise and attack!
At least you have learned to look around properly before venturing somewhere next time.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.58.97.0.mess:
After leaving the monolith, you look around to see where you have arrived. Suddenly, a quiet, monotonous voice seeps into your mind:

The terrible guardians of this land will tear your body apart, and your bones will rot here like those of all the unfortunate souls who came before you. No one has ever left."
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.59.128.0.mes: After a gruelling march, you rest in the shade of leafy trees. Suddenly you leap up: you have sat right on an anthill. This prompts an interesting question. "If an ant crawls under a girl's skirt, is it still a decent ant, or an indecent one?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.60.100.0.mes: After slaying the dragons, you wanted a souvenir, but what can you take from ghosts? You can only hope the others believe you really did it.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.60.135.0.mes: Although you held them off, one golem managed to escape and raise the alarm at the factory. As you can see, its internal security force is already waiting at the entrance.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.61.81.0.mess:
One of your warriors complains that he feels rather ill. You tell him: "Stop drinking so much! You should eat more fruit instead, skin and all. That is where most of the vitamins are!"
The warrior says: "All right. But what am I supposed to do when coconuts are my favourite...?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.62.135.0.mes:
This strange factory seems to be working at full capacity. The sounds of all kinds of machinery drift outside. Yet, strangely, not a single human voice can be heard.
Suddenly the mystery is solved. Artificial, mindless beings approach you. It seems your presence here is unwelcome.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.62.75.0.mess:
You were warned!
{Death to the hero, eternal {damnation to the thief!
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.65.88.0.mess: A very skilful blacksmith has settled in this little grove. For a fair price, he will build whatever war machine you need. His work is excellent.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.66.135.0.mes: You have crushed the golems almost to dust. From the few gold plates remaining, your blacksmith has forged you a fine golden helmet.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.66.137.0.mes: Defeating our advance guard does not mean you will carry off our gold. Fight or die!
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.68.133.0.mes:
A dreadful troll with a mighty club leaps out from beneath the bridge.
"Halt, traveller," he roars. "Before you step onto the bridge, know that no one crosses without paying."
You rein in your horse.
{"And what price do you demand for passage?"
"The price is a right hand," says the troll with a sneer.
You draw your sword, and in an instant the troll's hand lies on the ground, still clutching its club, staining the grass with dark blood.
{"Here is what you asked for,"} you sneer in turn, and spur your horse on. Behind you, the whimpering troll calls down every thunderbolt upon your head.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.72.72.0.mess: Here is your reward for defeating the Crystal Dragons.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.73.74.0.mess: The Crystal Dragons have finally been destroyed. All that remains is a heap of crystals, which you certainly will not leave behind.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.73.76.0.mess: Something gleams in the grass. You dismount and find a golden ring on the ground. Delicate engravings run around its entire circumference, with the inscription {"AKL-A-ROM"} etched in tiny runes among them. Instead of a gemstone, the ring holds a dragon's eye. When you put it on, you feel your courage rise.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.76.38.0.mess: A deep fissure, whose bottom you can barely see, stops avalanches that might threaten you from the neighbouring territory. On the other hand, it also prevents you from expanding your lands. You will have to find another way. The enemy is not going anywhere.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.79.11.0.mess: Defeating our advance guard does not mean you will carry off our gold. Fight or die!
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.79.13.0.mess: You have crushed the golems almost to dust. From the few gold plates remaining, your blacksmith has forged you a fine golden helmet.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.79.46.0.mess: A very skilful blacksmith has settled in this little grove. For a fair price, he will build whatever war machine you need. His work is excellent.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.83.12.0.mess: Although you held them off, one golem managed to escape and raise the alarm at the factory. As you can see, its internal security force is already waiting at the entrance.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.84.13.0.mess:
This strange factory seems to be working at full capacity. The sounds of all kinds of machinery drift outside. Yet, strangely, not a single human voice can be heard.
Suddenly the mystery is solved. Artificial, mindless beings approach you. It seems your presence here is unwelcome.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.90.44.0.mess:
One of your warriors complains that he feels rather ill. You tell him: "Stop drinking so much! You should eat more fruit instead, skin and all. That is where most of the vitamins are!"
The warrior says: "All right. But what am I supposed to do when coconuts are my favourite...?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.94.70.0.mess:
A little too late, you notice a horde of barbarian warriors sitting around the fire. They are probably resting during some expedition. You do not wait for them to recover, but seize the advantage of surprise and attack!
At least you have learned to look around properly before venturing somewhere next time.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.guards.99.21.0.mess: After a gruelling march, you rest in the shade of leafy trees. Suddenly you leap up: you have sat right on an anthill. This prompts an interesting question. "If an ant crawls under a girl's skirt, is it still a decent ant, or an indecent one?"
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.header.description: The decisive finale begins, revealing who will truly rule this land. Will the parents win, or the sons? Whom will you favour? The odds are almost even... But only one side can win...
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.header.name: Finale

"Please, friend! Put an end to my suffering. I once did something terrible. Despite the warnings, I stole a book meant only for the initiated. Its guardian cursed me, and I had to leave my brothers."
The dwarf wipes a bitter tear from his bearded cheek and continues:
"I must wander this land, finding peace nowhere. My vile deed weighs upon my conscience. I cannot bear it any longer. Please free my sinful soul. Kill me in honourable combat, and my soul will be free. I beg you. Then take the book. I am sure you will know what to do with it."

map.[ab] - honza 2:7.quest.129.46.0.comp:
Blood-red eyes flare upon the door, and a muffled voice says:
"Why do you disturb me again? Answer in the name of Dog-gur, or perish for your insolence!"
The monk clasps his hands in prayer, bows his head humbly, and begins a quiet but fervent prayer. His voice slowly grows stronger, the air thickens around you, and the gate begins to vibrate.
You see the eyes slowly fade and a bright light shine from behind the door. The radiance grows steadily stronger until it hurts your eyes. To avoid going blind, you must close them for a moment. When you open them, both the tower and the monk are gone.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.quest.129.46.0.firs:
From afar, this tower looked quite ordinary. As you draw closer, however, you see a small door of black metal. You hesitate, wondering whether to knock, when two hungry, inhumanly red eyes open in its centre. They radiate heat at you and seem to hold you motionless.
For a long moment you stand as though hypnotised. All around you is utter silence, but suddenly you hear a distant voice speaking:
"Insolent fool! Who permitted you to ask entry to places forbidden to you? Or do you covet another's wealth? Answer in the name of Dog-gur!"
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.quest.129.46.0.next:
Blood-red eyes glow in the door again. As if from far away, you hear:
"You again? I thought Dog-gur had arrived."
The eyes go dark, and the door looks perfectly ordinary again.

map.[ab] - honza 2:7.town.110.65.0.event: What a turn of events for Honza and Květinka. Under Rebbeca's curse, their three beloved sons have turned against them. They have no choice but to defend their lives. Fortunately, their faithful servant Jean has not abandoned them in this hour of need and has decided to continue serving them loyally.

A scout has arrived with news of an unoccupied castle in your territory. It lies several days' journey north. The road is long, but you should set out as soon as possible. Capturing it would give you a valuable source of warriors for your army.

Your scouts have learned something else of interest. In the middle of your region lies an enclosed area that you can enter only after taking control of the centre. A similar area lies in your sons' territory.

Another report has arrived from the scouts. Several days' journey northeast of your castle lies a region rich in resources. However, dark forces have blocked the road there. You should find out how to enter it.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.town.16.13.0.name: North Tower
The brothers paid a cruel price for wiping out Čáryfuk's family. Under Rebbeca's curse, they have turned against their own parents. They are gathering armies and preparing for what may be the last battle of their lives.

A scout has arrived with news of an unoccupied castle in your territory. It lies almost at the southernmost tip. The road is long, but you should set out as soon as possible. Capturing it would give you a valuable source of warriors for your army.

Your scouts have learned something else of interest. In the middle of your region lies an enclosed area that you can enter only after taking control of the centre. A similar area lies in your parents' territory.

Another report has arrived from the scouts. Just a few days' journey west of your castle lies a region rich in resources. However, dark forces have blocked the road there. You should find out how to enter it.
map.[ab] - honza 2:7.town.81.139.0.name: South Tower
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:0.event.0.descr: You have sent several legions to hold off the humans, so they will not trouble you for a while.
A group of Sokar's men emerged from a cave and reported that they had crash-landed. They joined you.
At last! We have reached the Dragon Utopia. Nothing can stop us now.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:0.header.descri: When Sokar learned of the mighty Dragon Utopia, he simply had to have it. Find the Dragon Utopia and master its dragons, and nothing will stop us. Beware: we must not be destroyed by the enemy, who has the upper hand. Nor must he find the Dragon Utopia before you.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:0.header.name: Stargate, Part 2.
My lord, the 5th Legion has arrived.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:1.event.0.descr: Your adviser approaches and says: “The humans have a larger army than we expected and hold this region firmly. I fear even the dragons will not help us now. We must build the largest army we can, quickly.”
We have finally found you. Now we will conquer planet Earth.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:1.header.descri: Now we can destroy Earth with our dragon army. We must destroy the SGC, or we will never win. But beware: our fortress must not fall. Our flagship, carrying our largest army, crashed on an island. We received a distress message saying everyone survived, but their ship is wrecked. You must find them.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:1.header.name: Stargate, Part 3.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:1.heroes.0.name: Tyelk
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:1.monster.43.64: We guard the Orb of Vulnerability. Leave, or perish beneath our hooves.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:1.monster.59.57: You are not invited. Leave, or we will have to kill you.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:1.monster.68.47: We are the keepers of the Sword of Judgement. Leave, or die.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:1.quest.48.67.0: Oh, thank you so much. Here is your reward.

A dwarf climbs down from a tree and says: “Traveller, my brothers were locked in an underground prison for something they did not do. Bring back my 5 brothers (Battle Dwarves), and I will reward you. But you must bring them within 7 days, or they will hang.”
Hurry and bring my brothers back.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:1.quest.69.19.0: Excellent! Exactly what we needed! Now wait a moment while I combine these three artifacts. Five hours later, the old man emerges and hands you the mighty Sword of Doom!

Long ago, 30 years ago, I found an ancient artifact. As I studied it, I learned more and more, discovering that it was one of three powerful artifacts. Together, they form a mighty weapon of destruction. Bring me the Sword of Judgement and the Orb of Vulnerability, and we can create that artifact.
Nothing yet? I am sure you will soon find the Sword of Judgement and the Orb of Vulnerability. Please keep looking.
My lord, I see a guarded portal resembling the Stargate, but its flow looks strange.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:2.header.descri: Here it is! The final battle for this planet. After a massive aerial attack, all the humans took refuge underground. You must find the entrance to their underground base and destroy the rest of humanity!
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:2.header.name: Stargate, Part 4
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:3.event.0.descr: Along the road, you come upon Sokar's ship. It is empty, but carries resources. They will help us now.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:3.guards.1.31.0: Prepare the Stargate. Reinforcements await beyond it, and then we will conquer this world.
Your soldiers were already waiting for you outside the fortress.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:3.guards.4.53.0: Bow before my power, you wretched humans.
My lord, our scouts report that the humans have also settled underground.
My lord, look, a Stargate. Where might it lead?
How strange. Could the northern gate be abandoned?
A group of Sokar's men appeared on the road. You immediately welcomed them into your legions.
Travelling through the mountains, you were surrounded by many Jaffa. When they recognised you as Sokar, they joined you.
On your journey, you came upon a wrecked ship. Sokar's soldiers were stationed around it. As soon as they saw their god, they joined him.
We walked straight into their trap! We are surrounded! Prepare to fight!
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:3.header.descri: You, the mighty ruler Sokar, have decided to conquer planet Earth. But the humans resisted better than you expected. During your landing, they shot down your ship, which came down by the northern gate. You must reach the Stargate and pass through it to rejoin the rest of your army.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:3.header.name: Stargate, Part 1.
map.[ab] - hvezdna brana:3.monster.8.9.0: My lord, we have finally found you.
map.[ab] - jizne od pekla.event.0.descri: Scouts report that there are advisers in Hell trying to `convince` you that buying your freedom is your only way out.
map.[ab] - jizne od pekla.event.1.descri: Your long-standing enemy has decided to help you fight Hell. It is hard to trust someone you have fought for so many years. But Hell is very powerful, and any help is welcome.
map.[ab] - jizne od pekla.header.descrip: A message from the northern lands reads: "Come visit us! Hell is not bad. We have heated pools, warm mud baths..." Needless to say, you did not take it seriously. So the rulers of the north decided to seize the southern lands by force.
map.[ab] - jizne od pekla.header.name: South of Hell
map.[ab] - jizne od pekla.header.rumor.0: They say the Fire Deity is aid from Hell itself.
Are you willing to pay me 4000 gold to enter this town?
You must pay me 4000 gold to enter this town.
Until you pay me 4000 gold, you will not enter the town.

Enjoy your stay!

map.[ab] - legenda o ptáku ohniváku.even:
In this map, you will meet people you know very well. Whether you like them or dislike them, you cannot choose whom you will play against the others.
A small note: Firebird & the Firebird normally mean the same thing, but in this map they are different. Firebird is the villain you fight, while the Firebird is the one you must find and free.

And I am essentially both...... take your pick.

As usual, a little warning:
There are many quests here, but many are not necessary to finish the map; they simply add variety. I recommend completing them, though: they give you various things!

Good luck!
Made by:
{FIREBIRD
{firebird@email.cz
{http://www.mageo.cz/home/FIREBIRD/

The legends of the Might and Magic world say:
When many of this world's heroes were born, tremendous volcanic activity erupted in a distant land. Several old mages lived there, on the side of good. They decided to create something capable of controlling fire and lava. Using very powerful magic, they created a strange creature, the {Firebird}, which could do this. But they overlooked one thing: they also created something else resembling that bird, {FireBird}! He too is a bird, but with immense power, greater than the Firebird's. FireBird captured and imprisoned him. He created many servants, especially phoenixes. Meanwhile, the mages died, leaving no one to stop him, and he began turning the whole world to ash. Many heroes tried and failed, but others remain: Gremlin, Kal_Kal, Draque & Hidden. Will they prevail?

/Do not think I am crazy because of how this is written. I simply wanted to be the villain./

Thanks go to:
Kal_Kal, for starting to take proper care of the Heroes map collection.
Gremlin, for fixing the errors as usual.
The H&D duo for beta testing, and Pattrick too.
Also my girlfriend, though I do not know what for ..... 
And everyone who let me put their "virtual" mugs in here!
And, of course, all of you who will play this map!

And the power station for supplying electricity, Temelín for not blowing up, and computers for existing. The Austrians for not running me over with a tractor at the border, and for letting me through. And my own name, which really suits this map (§). 
We have had our fun, so let us wrap this up ... 

Enough talk: on with the game!

This map features the virtual faces of these Heroes3 players:

Gremlin, Kal_Kal, Draque, Hidden, Pattrick, Hector, Nomad, Sira, and yours truly, Firebird. There was no room for the others.

Suddenly, you see very strange creatures ahead. You fear they might be relatives of Firebird. They are not: they are Faerie Dragons.

map.[ab] - legenda o ptáku ohniváku.mons: Once again, you see phoenixes ahead who once served the Firebird but now serve Firebird!

"Welcome. I am the true Firebird, and I am glad you have reached me. Victory is yours now. I must remove the lava from the world; I have much work ahead."
"Remember, the difference between Firebird and me is that I was forced to serve him. I am glad that is no longer so."
