map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.event.0.des: One evening, a battle broke out and Gabrielle was abducted. Xena swore to find her. She realised Callisto was behind it. Even her close friend Ephiny conspired against her, settling in a nearby castle and preparing an attack.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.event.1.des: You have just learned that Ares, the god of war who lost his divinity because of Callisto, has been seen nearby. With the remnants of his armies, he is preparing an attack on Xena, whom he blames for his fate.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.event.2.des: “Bad news for you, Xena!” cries one of her servants. “Your friend Joxer has also joined the side of necromancy, willingly or otherwise.”
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.event.3.des: “Xena,” says the messenger, “our gold wagon was ambushed, and we were robbed of
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.event.4.des: Your scouting force ambushed a coach carrying gold for the necromancers.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.event.5.des: Xena was imprisoned, and the others ransomed her for 5000 gold. As usual, it was a trap laid by Callisto to delay her.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.event.6.des: Callisto's first attempt to keep Xena imprisoned failed, so she is trying again. This time she failed too, and Xena escaped. You, however, are another 5000 poorer.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.event.7.des: Everyone in the world is controlled by a mysterious power from Hell, which can be stopped only by conquering Olympus Castle. Callisto seized it after disposing of Zeus, ruler of the gods, with a dagger coated in hind's blood. Through Olympus, she controls everyone who was once friendly to Xena.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.event.8.des: Callisto turned Olympus into a stronghold of hellish monsters and settled there herself. In the south, however, lies a peninsula that looks just like Hell. Hades, ruler of the underworld, and several of Callisto's minions have settled there.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.1.45: Sailing through these rocks, you were less fortunate: a huge hole opened in the ship. All the water transformed into several Water Elementals. If you win, the hole will disappear.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.11.1: “We are at your service, Xena!” says the centaurs' representative.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.12.3: No, Callisto has decreed that Xena is allowed nothing here. This artifact is no exception...
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.12.5: Somewhere in the lands ahead lies Ares's stronghold, unless you have already dealt with him.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.13.2: “I hate to do this,” says Xena, “but I must attack her castle. Good thing Gabrielle is not here; she would not like it at all.”
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.16.3: If they will not let you past the red tower, visit the tent for permission to pass.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.18.4: Well, this will certainly come in handy. But by the looks of it, there will be trouble...
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.2.14: Yes, yes, Ephiny's castle lies somewhere this way.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.2.59: Surely we will not leave them this mine either, will we?
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.20.1: This gate leads from other worlds, but no normal person has ever returned through it.
Suddenly, Poseidon's minions emerge from the sea, seeking a fight to the death. They say you will be rewarded if you win.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.20.4: Deeper and deeper into Hell... It is getting dangerous here.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.22.5: As you journey deeper into Hell, infernal monsters approach you.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.24.2: “I do not like those rocks,” says the captain. “It is as though they have eyes...”
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.25.3: Your attempt to win this castle over has greatly angered Callisto. She has sent a handful of her infernal troops against you.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.28.2: At the forest's edge, you glimpse a beautiful shield, but as you try to take it, Ares's allies charge at you.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.28.4: The second and final castle. Hopefully that will be the end of this nation and Velasca.
“I am alone against everything in this world. The gods are imprisoned in the abyss of time on Olympus, and Callisto will reach the ambrosia. Unless someone stops her, eating it will make her immortal, and then Heaven help the world... So it is up to me,” says Xena.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.31.3: “Some people have it easy, with gold right under their noses,” Xena complains.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.33.4: You are entering what was once a harbour. If you can repair it even a little, you will be able to cross the sea.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.34.1: Shortly after the captain finishes speaking, several Water Elementals emerge from the water.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.35.3: “Yes, this must be Velasca's stronghold,” says Xena.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.36.1: It would be wise to head this way and destroy Velasca, the woman who wanted to become queen of the Amazons, but was not elected and now seeks revenge.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.36.6: “We are entering the southern seas. Some sailors are afraid to sail here,” says the captain of the ship Xena hired.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.36.7: “We must be close now. I can feel it,” says the old captain.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.38.3: Well, let us get to it! This does not look easy at all. Is everyone ready to fight?
You were attacked while trying to rescue these shipwreck survivors.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.4.27: We will be there shortly. I hope she has not gathered too large an army.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.4.34: Sailing between the rocks, a small hole opened in the ship, but the sailors quickly plugged it with timbers.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.4.48: A gold mine always comes in handy, if only those hydras were not there.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.4.53: What is probably Hades's stronghold is now in sight. He too is controlled by Callisto and is preparing to strike against this world......
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.4.69: Well, look: before you even reach the castle, you encounter several wandering skeletons.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.41.1: In the distance, you spot a chest from some long-sunken ship.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.41.4: Now we will see whether Xena (or someone in her place) can save the world and rid it of Callisto once and for all. Onward, then...
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.43.4: “We are confiscating that sawmill for our own use too,” says one of the warriors.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.46.2: The magical helmet is protected by a powerful spell that summons guardians of the underworld to defend it.....
The castle is in sight. Let us hope Velasca is inside.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.47.2: “An amazing artifact!” cries a member of your army. But as you try to take it, you discover it is a trap.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.49.0: This piece of the stone legionnaire statue is extremely rare. Several monsters from Hell share your opinion, however. Think carefully about whether you really want this artifact.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.50.1: These channels are sure to be full of dangers.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.51.5: What could lie beyond this mysterious strait?
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.54.4: This castle is one of Callisto's two main strongholds. Before you can even enter, you are attacked.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.56.3: As soon as you set foot on this island, you wonder whether it is inhabited. By all appearances, it probably is....
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.56.5: Look, you only had to think of danger, and here it is. Several Cyclopes leap from the rocks onto your ship.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.61.8: You disturbed several harpies among those mushrooms. Unfortunately, they now find you more interesting.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.62.4: As soon as your ship enters this bay, several of its guards attack you, sent by Callisto as usual.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.64.1: Infernal monsters commonly lurk in narrow mountain passes...
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.64.4: Someone simply cannot understand that you wanted to help this poor soul clinging to a log with his last ounce of strength. That someone is Callisto, of course.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.64.6: “Carry on that way if you like, but without me. I may be old, but I am no fool,” says the captain.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.66.4: If you are in danger, do not hesitate to enter our little church.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.7.28: Come visit us: we exchange anything.....
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.7.69: “I hate these necromancers,” says Xena. “They are so wicked, and their habits are appalling. They all deserve to be buried forever in the deepest bowels of the earth.”
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.guards.70.3: It looked as though you could simply pass through, but you were mistaken.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.header.desc:
Those who know Xena surely know her greatest enemy (and my favourite), Callisto. You must capture Olympus Castle, guarded by Callisto herself and her extremely powerful army from Hell.
By: FIREBIRD
firebird@email.cz
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.header.name: Callisto's Dominion
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.monster.0.1: “We will have to kill you, Xena. Our ruler has commanded it.”
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.monster.1.3: This mine has always belonged to the Green Dragons. Clearly, they intend to make that quite plain to you.
“We will have to kill you, Xena. Our ruler has commanded it.”
"This mine is protected by the law of these lands. Callisto decreed it, so we may not surrender it."
We have always been devoted to you, Xena, and will not betray you now. If you want us, we are at your service.
“We have always been friendly to you, Xena, but our new ruler would kill us. So we will not surrender these treasures.”
“Your problem. You have chosen death instead. As you wish!”
We will have to kill you, Xena. Our ruler has commanded it.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.monster.3.6: We guard this mine. You will never have it.
As soon as the dragons noticed you, it was clear they had no wish to talk.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.monster.5.1: “We centaurs have always been friendly to you, Xena. Even under Callisto's rule, our attitude will not change.”
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.monster.5.2: A close friend of yours is in this prison, but our ruler has ordered us not to release him to you.
My lady has ordered me to let no one near this mine.
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.monster.8.1: “We will have to kill you, Xena. Our ruler has commanded it.”
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.monster.8.4: This gold mine has always belonged to us. Do you think we will let you in for nothing?
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.sign.10.7.0: A blacksmith is nearby. We will need to buy some war machines...
“There... To starboard! That is one of the underworld rulers' strongholds!” cries a crewman.
“Only you, Xena, may pass through this teleporter,” says the tower's guard, one of the few who have remained faithful to good.
A miracle: there is actually a river flowing here ......
map.[ab] - nadvláda callisto.sign.59.9.1: Build yourself a ship. You can borrow all the tools you need from us.
If you think this is the best thing you can do, enter, but be careful.
This is the River of Death, leading straight to Hell. Whoever enters never leaves.
Suddenly, you notice a nearby temple where you will be safe from all enemies.
The world you see on the horizon was once fertile land. Before the forces of Hell arrived.....
That looks like the Pyramid of Cheops
map.[ab] - novy svet:0.event.0.descripti:
Dayna: Their forces are strong. Breaking through will be difficult.
Sylvan: We must capture both islands quickly, so we do not lose control of them later.
Dayna: Yes, I will fight for my homeland.
Sylvan: You know, looking at you... You have not given up your homeland, and you keep fighting for it. I think that when we finish fighting here, I will return, overthrow my cousin, and build a whole new world.
map.[ab] - novy svet:0.header.descriptio: You managed to catch that mysterious woman, Dayna. Actually, the guards caught her, but that is beside the point. What matters is that she is an elf, one of the last. Goblins burnt her town to the ground, and she used you to defeat them. You agreed to help her. It is time to destroy the goblins.
map.[ab] - novy svet:0.header.name: New World, Part 2.
map.[ab] - novy svet:0.heroes.6.name: Sylvan
map.[ab] - novy svet:0.heroes.9.name: Dayna
map.[ab] - novy svet:1.event.0.descripti: Your captain woke you in the morning and reported: “My lord, we should head south. The scouts say there are hundreds of goblins in the mountains to the west. We stand no chance against them now.” Then he left.
map.[ab] - novy svet:1.event.1.descripti: You wake in the morning to find a woman sitting beside your bed. Her hood hides her face. She immediately says: “There is a small fort south of here. Farther south, you will reach a human town. Gather the largest army you can. We have little time.” You blink, and she is gone.
map.[ab] - novy svet:1.event.2.descripti: You started work with your men first thing in the morning. Thanks to their excellent morale, we have more wood than we needed.
map.[ab] - novy svet:1.event.3.descripti: That woman was sitting beside your bed again this morning. She said: “Destroy the goblins in the mountains. They are plotting evil against you! There is a little surprise outside your tent.”
map.[ab] - novy svet:1.header.descriptio: The king's young son discovered that the rightful heir was not himself, but his cousin. When he protested, he was banished from the kingdom. Fortunately, a few loyal followers remained with him. Now he seeks a new home.
map.[ab] - novy svet:1.header.name: New World, Part 1.
map.[ab] - novy svet:1.heroes.6.name: Sylvan
map.[ab] - novy svet:1.town.20.56.0.name: Pincl
map.[ab] - novy svet:1.town.7.32.0.name: Fortress
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.event.0.descripti:
A soldier ran into your tent and handed you a letter, saying it was from King Uriel, your cousin. You read slowly: “Cousin, how could you join those undead? How could you? All just to overthrow me!”

You thought: “Hmm, no, cousin. I have come to kill you. To kill you all and build a new world here!”
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.event.1.descripti: Sandro told you of an old abandoned fortress to the north. Perhaps we should capture it.
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.event.2.descripti: Your men worked splendidly, so we have enough resources. Unfortunately, you had to pay them.
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.guards.38.52.0.me: You saw something glittering beside the road. Riding closer, you discovered it was a ring.
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.guards.42.43.0.me: You met an old woman on the road and robbed her, since her cloak looked interesting.
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.header.descriptio: At last! The final battle. Now you will overthrow your cousin and build a new world.
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.header.name: New World, Part 4.
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.heroes.144.name: Uriel
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.heroes.65.name: Sylvan
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.town.10.61.0.name: Home
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.town.12.7.0.name: Kriml
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.town.69.60.0.name: Necropolis
map.[ab] - novy svet:2.town.71.15.0.name: Sylvianpolis
map.[ab] - novy svet:3.event.0.descripti: Marching with your army, you met a wanderer. You asked what he was doing, and he said he was looking for his master. Asked who that was, he replied that it was probably you. You also learned that he was a necromancer. Necromancy had always fascinated you, so you took him into your army.
map.[ab] - novy svet:3.guards.57.45.0.me: Along the way, you noticed something glittering in the grass. You reached for it, but bandits suddenly began leaping from the bushes.
map.[ab] - novy svet:3.guards.58.35.0.me: Bow before my power, you wretched humans!
map.[ab] - novy svet:3.header.descriptio: Sylvan has finally returned to his homeland. Now he must face his brother.
map.[ab] - novy svet:3.header.name: New World, Part 3.
map.[ab] - novy svet:3.heroes.6.name: Sylvan
map.[ab] - novy svet:3.town.5.54.0.name: Hinlington
map.[ab] - novy svet:3.town.9.4.0.name: Kiunnis
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.event.0.descrip: For many years, the island of Tigrandia was known as a dangerous place inhabited by the cruel barbarian people of the Hor-kard, who drove out the last peaceful peoples and races many thousands of years ago.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.event.1.descrip: Eighty years ago, however, a group of lost merchants landed on the island and made a new home in its northwest. They built their capital, Arica, cultivated vast stretches of the coastal desert extending to the Eredem Mountains, and founded a new nation.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.event.2.descrip: Naturally, the barbarians noticed their activities. While the tribal chieftain Ocharaz ruled, however, he signed treaties of tribute and vassalage with the new nation's representatives. They fixed the border on the western slopes of Eredem.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.event.3.descrip: After Ocharaz died, his son Ochanaj became ruler, but his reign was short. After 2 months, his eastern vassal Tazar murdered him. Tazar united all the barbarian tribes except the Northern Ogres and resolved to conquer the entire island.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.event.4.descrip: The city of Arica and its current queen, Aris, sent envoys to negotiate the price of peace. But no answer came from Tazar. The envoys were never seen again, and rumours spread along the border of impending raids by Tazar's bloodthirsty hordes. Only one solution remains: war.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.event.5.descrip:
First thing in the morning, a messenger delivers an interesting message: “These are the last taxes you will ever get from us, you extortionist.” Signed, the Council of the Golem Region.
So it has begun. Another territory has rebelled because its inhabitants do not trust you to protect them from barbarian raids. They are preparing their own defences.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.event.6.descrip: Refugees from southern Tigrandia tell you that golems have occupied key sites in the region: mines, roads, and even the tent of the Green Tower's keeper. They have apparently declared martial law. Everyone who is not a golem must leave the newly formed “Golem Republic” by the end of the week.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.event.7.descrip: Refugees from golem-occupied territory have brought supplies they managed to hide from those greedy metal paws.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.event.8.descrip:
That is all. I hope you enjoy the map :) Two tips to start with: upgrade your gremlins and gargoyles, and try your luck to the south and at sea.

Information and questions: aticus@post.cz or aticus@email.cz
The last remnants of the militia are desperately resisting the barbarians.
Oh, those bandits again. They will not leave you alone even when the whole nation is in danger.
A group of Energy Elementals guards this artifact. Will you fight them for it?
The gremlins living here have always been among Tigrandia's most reliable inhabitants. They captured this artifact from the primitive gnolls who lived here before Tigrandia was founded, mostly as cheap labour for the barbarians. Now they offer it to you as a token of respect.
Insane bureaucracy! 50 gold for a stamp on an entry permit. But what can you do? Worse still, some ruffians are blocking access to the tent.
Your men were about to occupy the mine when, lo and behold! Those damned golems mean business, and they seem capable of making your life miserable. Fortunately, there are only a few here.
“Come on, then! Such a degenerate little nation cannot stand against the barbarians. Once you have killed each other off, the whole island will belong to the chosen race of golems!”
The road is crowded with refugees from the Golem Region, telling horrifying stories of terror under the golems' revolutionary committees. They are all willing to join you and return to their homes.
Approaching the stronghold of your former subjects, the golems, you encounter troops pursuing refugees. All your men are filled with righteous anger and prepare to reduce them to a heap of nuts and bolts.
It seems you have grasped this scenario's strategy. Congratulations.
---
Know that some dragons are very friendly.
You are just reaching for the shield when angry gnolls charge from the nearby mountains, led by yet another golem (grrrr..), who shouts: 
“See? We told you they take everything from us. You were right to join us golems.”
You are furious and would dearly like to use brute force. Will you?
Many centuries ago, the heavenly blacksmith Hephaestus drove this sword into the ground here after discovering the greed and hatred of Tigrandia's former inhabitants. He asked the Crystal Dragons to guard it, but their vigilance waned with time. Only one remains, and you must match your strength against it. Will you fight it for the sword?
We are glad you have finally decided to destroy the barbarians, and offer you our services.
The forest seems more populated than it first appeared. Suddenly, a group of mages emerges before you, their leader looking far from friendly.
“Half our clan, which inhabits these woods, died in the last raid by Tazar's bands, and no one bothered to help us. Now we will settle the score with you.”
The mages have apparently disarmed all your garrisons in the northeast. If you defeat them, you can reunite those troops with your army...
It seems the mages are preparing defences against another raid. It would be worth learning something...
Several frightened gremlins were hiding in the surrounding forest, but joined you as soon as they saw you...
You are admiring the majestic peaks of the Great Western Range when a band of golems suddenly rushes through the gorge. An especially stubborn specimen leads them, waving the rather tasteless flag of their newly founded state.
You are leaving the Western, or Desert, Mountains. This region is no longer under golem rule, and the whole army can breathe easier. Danger no longer lurks at every step. Behind every sand dune there is no longer a rebellious golem full of revolutionary ideals, ready to dispense revolutionary justice upon its former oppressor.
Suddenly, a large group of locals emerges before you, looking far from pleased. Their bodies bear the marks of a recent bloody battle.
“Barbarians, a raid... barbarians... Where were you when they attacked us?” they shout over one another, preparing to teach you a lesson...
The mages defending the tower entrance look rather unfriendly at first. Eventually, however, you agree that you share a common enemy, and they join you.
A few dozen ogres guard this club. They will not surrender it: that would mean losing their last protection against the Golem Region's greedy tax collectors. Still, they are only barbarians, and you are at war with them. Will you take it, or leave it to them and thus annoy your troublesome golem subjects?
Slowly but surely, you approach territory inhabited by increasingly savage beings. Its only gold mine is still held by barbarians, though not directly by Tazar. Do you think they will surrender it?
Heading north, you encounter battle-weary mages and gremlins who set out to recapture an important village held by barbarian Wolf Riders. As you approach, an argument breaks out among them. Some would join you, but the others decide to attack...
Those damned golems again.
But what is this? Their metal faces smile at you as a saviour, and their commander says: “My lord, our troops were slaughtered entering the Eredem Mountains. It was Hell on earth. Not only was it so damp everywhere that our iron brothers rusted, but suddenly the whole forest seemed to come alive, and several thousand little green creatures attacked us. We alone survived. But what can we do? If we return home, our revolutionary government will have us dismantled for spare parts as punishment. So we will gladly join you to avenge our fallen...”

What lovely things await me, you think, but you welcome their help.
Several nomads guard this artifact. They alone dare to trade with the barbarians, or have any dealings with them at all. Will you fight them?
In the distance, you see the famed Guardians' Pass. You are wondering what to do when a mysterious voice sounds as though from the surrounding rocks. 
“No one may cross this pass without first proving their courage before the Cave of Power and Glory. If you have not yet overcome your fear of its Guardians, do not enter. Certain death would await you.”

What could it mean? Guardians, the Cave of Power and Glory...

But the voice continues: “The cave lies far to the south, at the very end of Tigrandia. The way there leads across the sea, over an island ruled by the elements themselves.”
Several hobgoblins from the Achyt tribe guard the mine entrance. They were among the first to join Tazar's rebellion.
Do not enter barbarian territory this way. You will antagonise the last barbarian tribe still honouring the non-aggression treaty.
Ogres, faithful servants of the house of Ocharaz the Great, guard this pass
Do not travel west. Certain death awaits you
Signed, Prince Ocharaz.
Tigrandia's army has reached the fortified pass guarded by Tazar's hordes. You must not be intimidated by their strength: you must attack.
All your men are determined to exterminate the barbarian race once and for all.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.guards.49.9.0.m: There is no way through here...
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.guards.50.7.0.m: It seems the ogres leave their weapons lying about. They must not fear anyone carrying them off. But a group of guards is lounging near this weapon. Will you fight them?
Your horses carry you into the land of wolves, the most backward and poorest of all barbarian territories...
So many ogres! Fortunately, only a few are guarding this place...
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.guards.54.7.0.m: Mighty and wealthy is the tribe of Northern Ogres, as you can see all around you. Useful supplies lie everywhere, extracted by the labour of countless slaves, both barbarians and Tigrandians. They always fight for themselves alone, and brute force is the only thing that brings them to their senses!!!
The ogres guard their territory very well indeed. Before a mighty mountain fortress, you meet several wretches who tried to capture it. They join you.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.guards.6.11.0.m:
A clear sign at the border of the Northern Highlands and the Central Desert reads: 
Here runs the imaginary border between the Northern Highlands and the great Central Desert.

Signed, the Tigrandian Hiking Club.

Hmmm.... better than a barbarian club to the head
The Cyclopes are very pleasant people, happy to offer you their sulfur deposits and ask nothing in return... Except 1500 gold, that is.
Unlike their tribesmen guarding the road north, the orcs on guard here will gladly join your hordes...
Suddenly, several dozen wolf riders appear before you, demanding payment for passage.
Your loyal Cyclopes and the ogres have long contested this mine. If you overcome the ogre guards, the Cyclopes will join you.
On this spot, several years ago, Prince Ochanaj, son of Ocharaz, etc., etc., was murdered. Several Cyclopes treacherously stoned him to death on the orders of his vassal Tazar, lord of the Cyclopes, who then seized control of all barbarian territory.....THAT PISSES YOU OFF...
The orcs stand ready to raise their axes for your holy cause, Prince Tazar.
Several orcs guard a shield plainly stolen from the ogres. In these southern barbarian lands, clashes between the races are an everyday occurrence, and no one's life is safe. Especially not those ogres who lost theirs over the shield. 
So, will you take it from the orcs?
Several Cyclopes guard the tower entrance...
The stronghold of the Southern Ogre tribe. Unlike their northern kin, they are rather weak, but will be useful in a strong army.
Our troops have been routed several times attacking the southern borders of the Tigrandian intruders. Now the wolves will finally have their revenge...
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.guards.9.55.0.m: The peaceful natural harbour suddenly becomes a naval battlefield as its guards attack you. Apparently, you forgot to pay the customs duty.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.guards.9.58.0.m: Welcome, hero. You are on the right path. A group of Firebirds wanders somewhere in the forest. Do you dare attack them? Remember, the road to victory must be lined with bravery and courage!
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.header.descript: Queen Aris must capture the main stronghold of the mountain barbarians. It is called Halat-muran, or "Altar of the Wind", after the sacrificial site where humans were offered for millennia to honour the deities of the Four Directions. If Aris dies or flees battle, all is lost.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.header.name: Lord of Tigrandia
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.heroes.115.biog: The great barbarian prince Tazar, ruler of the Four Directions, has united many barbarian tribes and is preparing to reconquer the whole island of Tigrandia. His methods were hardly pleasant, but this warrior follows the maxim "the end justifies the means". He began his rise to power as the great prince's eastern vassal and ruler of the Cyclopes and orcs. Now he is preparing merely to formalise his occupation of the main encampment, Halat-muran, before finally wiping all Tigrandia from the face of the earth
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.heroes.29.biogr: Aris has been queen of Tigrandia for several years. During that time, she has had little opportunity to prove her skill as a ruler, since nothing significant happened. Her great-grandfather founded both Tigrandia and Arica. Aris herself is this state's fourth ruler.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.heroes.29.name: Aris
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.19.38.0: It seems the rebel golems have occupied the tent of the Border Towers' Keeper and are holding the Keymaster hostage. Without his permission, you will never pass the green border tower. You must therefore show the rebels your strength!
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.21.37.0:
"Our Region's High Council has decided that your cruel rule is at an end,” declares the leader of the Diamond Golems occupying the gate.
"Surely we should not quarrel in this hour of need,” you protest. But the golems are very thick-headed. "Prepare to die! Death to oppressors,” their foreman cries, leaving you no choice but to teach them manners.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.23.62.0: If our brothers have joined you, so will we.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.23.63.0: Welcome, traveller. You plainly have courage, and we honour it.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.25.15.0:
As soon as you saw the gargoyles, you knew they would join you and strengthen your army. But what is this???!!!
Unfortunately, you realised too late that not all gargoyles make an honest living. Some are bandits who will not surrender even to their king's regular army.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.28.24.0: The last military unit in this region that has remained loyal to you...
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.29.37.0: Our revolutionary Council has ordered us to occupy every mine in the region and surrender them to no one!!!
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.30.64.0: We are guardians of the ancient dragon lineage, and we will let no one through!!! Especially anyone who consorts with those conceited, more modern dragons!
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.33.17.0: A group of Iron Golems, fortunately living far from their rebellious kin, guards the only road to a profitable gold-panning site.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.34.63.0: These mountains belong to us!!! No one shall cross them!!
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.36.45.0:
Behemoths are an ancient barbarian race that has always kept out of worldly affairs. Only Chieftain Ocharaz managed to make them his elite personal guard, protecting the most important sites in his realm. Unfortunately, this gold mine is one of them.

"Anyone who lays a hand on the gold of Ocharaz, great lord of thunder, will be taught a harsh LESSON!!!"
"Where have you been? Ocharaz has been pushing up daisies for ages."
"What! Our lord is immortal, and you accursed liars shall feel his might!!"
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.39.15.0: Well now! The moment a powerful ruler dies, the barbarians go wild and ignore his decrees. Here, a band of monsters has even occupied an economically important village. But they will not be in the way for long!!!
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.44.32.0:
Behemoths are a very ancient race that has always kept out of worldly affairs. Only Chieftain Ocharaz managed to recruit a few into his personal guard, and the behemoths remain loyal to him even after his death...

This is our forest, and you, vile traitor, will take it only over our dead bodies.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.45.13.0: Who dares disturb the peace of these mountains?!?
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.45.45.0:
As soon as you approached the Guardians' Gorge, the sky darkened, and crazed monsters began closing in from the surrounding mountains, the blood-red rays of the sun glinting off their crystal bodies. On the other side you saw a sight to turn the faint-hearted green with terror. Many barbarians had tried to cross the gorge after Ocharaz's death, but their skeletons were nailed to the surrounding cliffs as an eternal warning to all.
With horror, you realise that you cannot win unless you have dragons like these on your side. 
So if you have none, you must find some somewhere.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.48.21.0: Welcome, O great prince! Our gold fields are at your disposal
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.50.26.0: A group of ogres has blocked the road to the Halat-muran camp, the last who remain loyal to Prince Ocharaz's line. "Halt, you cowardly murderer. We will not surrender our prince's seat to you."
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.52.38.0: This gold mine belongs to the nomadic tribes of the foothills, who hired us to protect it.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.53.23.0: Our tribe stands ready to help you restore your rule over the entire island, great Prince Tazar.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.53.51.0: At first you thought you were facing wolf riders, but closer inspection revealed that there had been no wolves left for these barbarians, so they ride wild boars instead. Naturally, this leaves them permanently disgruntled and very difficult to reason with...
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.54.27.0: All the orc tribes are your subjects, my lord...We offer you the strength of our axes and our very lives.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.56.17.0: Cyclopes and ogres are constantly at war. This little band of cyclopes no longer believes in anything, and it is uncertain whether they will join you...
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.57.10.0: Begone at once! Only the great Prince Ocharaz collects taxes from us.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.58.54.0: This mine belongs to the wolf riders. It is our only source of income, and we will not give it to you.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.60.13.0:
The War School, a training ground founded by Prince Ocharaz during his campaign in the land of the ogres. But its entrance is guarded by a band of orcs who claimed it after his death as compensation for his use of them as expendable troops against the ogres.

And now they are shouting:  This war school is not for you!!
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.60.40.0: This kind of behemoth is now very rare, for the cyclopes of the surrounding lands have slaughtered them and sold their fine hides to the nomads, the only people who dared trade with the barbarians. Since these brutes trust no one, they are unlikely to join you...
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.61.29.0: You are approaching the land of the cyclopes, the second most powerful barbarian tribe, but a few of them still refuse to accept that their sole ruler is Prince Tazar, lord of the four corners of the world, and so on...
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.63.46.0: The Southern Ogre tribe welcomes its lord, the great Prince Tazar..
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.monster.64.35.0: Orcs are a strange race. Many are loyal to Tazar, but many will not even hear his name. Who knows what sort these are.
Firebirds are a curious kind of creature. Their strength is great, and no wonder: of all the strange elemental creatures inhabiting this island, they are the strongest, and can even be upgraded into the legendary phoenixes. But let us return to solid ground...They are all willing to join you.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.11.14.0.me:
Titan-class road

Arica town - 3 fathoms north
South Harbour - 11 fathoms south
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.14.29.0.me:
Delta of the River Memnecora
The river flows into the Great Western Ocean. Its flow cannot be measured here, as the geographical expedition was attacked by a band of gold golems.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.15.24.0.me:
South Harbour

Merchants are strongly advised to buy a ship here and sail home.
Warriors are advised to sail SSW
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.16.20.0.me:
Alchemists' Village - recipient of the Order of Labour

Arica - 8 fathoms NW
South Harbour - 6 fathoms south
North Harbour - 3 fathoms NE
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.20.16.0.me:
Great North Harbour

Here our forefathers landed, the founders of our flourishing little state of Tigrandia. 
Let everyone honour their memory with a minute's silence.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.20.33.0.me:
Gremlin-class road

Mysterious Crypt - 2 fathoms west
Dwellings of the Desert Guardians - 1 fathom SE
Great Pyramid of Neukaur - 4 fathoms SE
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.21.39.0.me: Welcome to the Tower Guardian's grounds. Anyone wishing to obtain a permit should kindly complete form B 52 and affix a revenue stamp worth 50 gold.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.23.12.0.me:
Delta of the River Huarana
The river flows into the Purple Sea. Its flow here is 12658 medium buckets per turn of a Barbarian Brain hourglass.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.23.35.0.me: The authority of the Kingdom of Tigrandia ends here. The autonomous government of the Golem Region is responsible for anything that happens to you beyond this point, and all complaints should be addressed there.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.24.63.0.me: This is one of the few places where crystal dragons can be seen, creatures as old as the world itself and, until recently, the most powerful beings in the entire universe.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.27.64.0.me:
Gremlin-class road

Green Border Tower - 10 fathoms E
Cave of Might and Glory - 4 fathoms W
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.32.45.0.me:
Tigrandian Hiking Club

Eastern "Cliff" Ridge - E
Western "Desert" Ridge - W
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.37.15.0.me: Welcome to Mercury Village, the biggest backwater in all Tigrandia.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.38.17.0.me:
Gremlin-class road

Renegades' dwellings - 5 fathoms S
"Northern Paradise" gold fields - 4 fathoms W
Mercury Village - 2 fathoms N
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.41.38.0.me:
The Eredem Mountains begin here. 
All citizens are forbidden to enter. Disobedience is punishable by 30 years of forced labour in the quarry.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.42.14.0.me:
Warning!!!
Do not provoke the guards of the Northern Ogre tribe. This is the last tribe still loyal to the line of Ocharaz the Great, and they will let no one through!
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.43.44.0.me:
Guardians' Gorge. 
Dragons guard this pass for all eternity as a token of peace between Ocharaz the Great and the Kingdom of Tigrandia.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.44.64.0.me: Tigrandia begins west of the Green Tower. Entry by permit only, which no barbarian will get anyway, so tough luck.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.56.14.0.me:
Ogre River

Here the territory of the cyclopes ends and that of the Northern Ogre tribe begins.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.56.43.0.me:
River Anaj
south - wolf rider tribal lands 
east - cyclops lands
west - Mountains of the Four
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.62.42.0.me: Here lies Ocharaz, grandson of Ochmelka, son of Ochlasta, father of Ochanaj. May the vultures and the wind carry his glory to all four corners of the world!
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.63.23.0.me: The current great Prince Tazar, a native of these parts, studied at this academy. So if you want your children to amount to anything, enrol them here.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.63.27.0.me: You are entering the land of the cyclopes, faithful servants of Prince Tazar the Great.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.9.28.0.mes:
Notice to fishermen: do not leave the area marked by buoys
Signed, Administration of the Southern Regions of the Tigrandian Kingdom
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.sign.9.64.0.mes: Welcome to the Island of Elementals. Those seeking allies here should approach the higher-level races. The lower-level elementals are small but vicious.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.town.8.7.0.even: All the refugees from the Golem Region have reached the capital and offer you their services. They have also brought the last remnants of what could still be salvaged.
map.[ab] - pan tigrandie.town.8.7.0.name: Arica
map.[ab] - pole náhody.guards.0.30.0.mes: A ninja you met taught you a deadly strike.
map.[ab] - pole náhody.guards.0.31.0.mes: A few black dragons joined you.
map.[ab] - pole náhody.guards.1.30.0.mes: You saw three gold dragons in the sky. That brings bad luck.
map.[ab] - pole náhody.guards.1.35.0.mes: I gave you a castle to start with, but there is nothing in it. It is only there to keep you from dropping dead straight away. This landscape is not very pretty, but it will serve its purpose.

map.[ab] - pole náhody.guards.10.27.0.me: You saw three gold dragons in the sky. That brings bad luck.

map.[ab] - posledni ostrov stvoreni.even: A morning like any other. Nothing suggests that anything unusual will happen tomorrow...

According to the astrologers, in two months the heavenly bodies will form the same alignment as at the Creation of the World. Diamonds will rain from the sky, and the way to the Last Island of Creation will open. It is a chance to learn far more about who we are and where we are going...

Legends tell of four gates leading to the island, each on a different island. The Spring Gate is said to lie amid flowering meadows, the Summer Gate is hidden in deep forests, the Autumn Gate stands in inhospitable wetlands, and the Winter Gate lies high in the icy mountains.

It is also said that only a woman's hand can open the way to the Island of Creation.

You have no doubt why the king summoned you. You too understand the immense political and strategic importance of occupying such an island.

The most capable women in your kingdom will be placed under your command. Under your leadership, they will establish strongholds on all four islands and try to find the gates, so that if the prophecy comes true in two months, they will be ready to claim the island in their king's name.

This morning the sky took on rainbow hues such as no one had ever seen. Then it began to rain. The rainbow drops turned into diamonds of unimaginable beauty as they struck the ground... and there were so many of them, everywhere...

At last you can open the gates. The struggle for the cradle of life begins...

As expected, your king is not the only one interested in the island. Someone has built another stronghold within sight of the one you founded in the forest. How fortunate for that insolent wretch that the road to his castle gate crosses the territory of hostile living trees!!! But you will get the better of him...

For now, however, you must send out scouts. Enemy encounters are likely on the other islands as well.

Your suspicions have been fully confirmed. Armies from another kingdom have been sighted on every island. Swift messengers have returned from your ruler, and the orders are clear:

Before the gates open, you must occupy as many islands as possible, whatever the cost! It seems you will not be bored during the remaining seven weeks...
map.[ab] - posledni ostrov stvoreni.head:
Ancient songs tell of the Last Island of Creation, where the ancient Gods of Dawn created all living beings. They also tell that a woman's hand will find the way back when diamonds fall from the sky.

The astrologers agree that this time will come in two months!		
(Designed for two players; the computer does not handle it very well.)
The Last Island of Creation

Legend says the gate will open when diamonds rain from the sky.
Once you lay 1000 gems before the tower gates, you may pass.

map.[ab] - posledni ostrov stvoreni.sign: This is a land of peace and tranquillity. We will not give you our children to turn into soldiers and drag into your senseless wars!
map.[ab] - posledni soud.event.0.descrip: You have just awoken to another ordinary day. A servant entered your room and brought breakfast: milk, fresh bread, some fruit, and a SCROLL.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.event.1.descrip:
You unrolled the letter. It read: DEAR MALCOLM, I HOPE THIS LETTER REACHES YOU AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. 
AS YOU KNOW, MY SETTLEMENT ON THE OTHER CONTINENT IS IN GREAT TROUBLE. EVERY WEEK THERE ARE QUARRELS AMONG MY SUBJECTS. MANY OF MY SUBJECTS HAVE TURNED TO SATANISM AND 
BEGUN WORSHIPPING THE DEVIL.
I WOULD BE GRATEFUL IF YOU WOULD HELP ME STOP THESE FORCES AND PRESERVE MY COLONY IN NEW DANTON.


                                                  your friend THEODOR
map.[ab] - posledni soud.event.2.descrip: You have just received bad news. One of your subjects saw a horseman with several lackeys near your castle. They looked rather strange, like some sort of Satanists.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.event.3.descrip:
Your sailors have discovered a new island at sea. It lies south of Sandy Island.
The sailors named it WINDY ISLAND.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.event.4.descrip: Your elite seaborne scouts discovered an island that rose from the water overnight somewhere in the middle of the ocean. When they returned, they were so frightened that they had left all their notes on the island. These contain observations on the local rock and are written in a hardbound book secured with a lock.
Before you reached the tents you had glimpsed in the distance, a crowd of pirates rushed at you from behind a dune.
As you sailed past these rocks, you were attacked by many harpies living on the cliffs.
You travel some distance, still wondering what MAG. ISLAND means. It occurs to you that someone in the crew might know. When the cook's turn comes, he starts talking at once. Long ago, he says, these seas were home to people so brimming with magic that their power seeped into the very land where they lived.
The cook thinks MAG. stands for magical island. Yet no one has ever managed to find it. They say it is only a tale for little children.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.guards.39.8.0.m:
You have enraged the other arch devils hiding behind the hissing sulfur fumes.
Before you could recover from the last long and exhausting battle, you were attacked again.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.guards.45.104.0: You ride through a forest gateway that seems to have been made artificially, probably by magical forces. Ahead you see the 4 monks described by the old man in your castle.
In the rubble beside one of the mountains, you found an open book containing strange notes.
You remembered that your researchers had left a book on this island in their fright. But it was supposed to be locked!? You opened it roughly halfway through. 
It reads: The soil here behaves in a particularly interesting fashion. The vegetation growing here is 15cm taller each day. The soil is probably magical.
You want to take the book, but there is a cave nearby. You glimpse several pairs of red eyes inside... Before you can think it through, black dragons attack you.
You found a dusty little chest. Something is written on it in Roman letters.
One of your warriors knows Greek and read the inscription to you: "IT SAYS: PLACE YOUR HAND ON THE MARKED SPOT AND TURN SLOWLY TO THE RIGHT." As you turn your hand to the right, the chest starts trembling, leaps 10 metres away from you, and spills out a host of master genies.
Several days ago, you entered a land that seemed quite peaceful. You were mistaken. A band of devilish magogs attacked you outside a house you wanted to visit.
Just as you approach a party of people, several obsidian gargoyles leap at you
from the forest.

from the forest.
Those damned gargoyles seem remarkably well organised...

map.[ab] - posledni soud.guards.62.104.0: On your voyage towards your long-awaited goal, the guardians of these rocks ambush you.
