map.[ab] - posledni soud.monster.16.54.0: I advise you out of the goodness of my heart: do not land on this coast. There are many snares and traps here. Oh, do my eyes deceive me? You are... Malcom! Defend yourself, MALCOM!
I am glad you are coming to our dwelling. I would gladly serve you. I hope you will accept us into your company.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.monster.57.19.0: "This cave will be mine first, so get out of my sight," said one of the sharpshooters. When you did not obey, they attacked with their first volley of arrows.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.11.58.0.c: Yes, the fear that lingered here is gone at last. I will gladly reward your service with a little something.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.11.58.0.f: Oh, who approaches? Ah, it is you, Malcom! I am glad you are here. I have a request concerning a certain scoundrel. I would be most grateful if you killed DRACULA THE NECROMANCER. He is the ancient enemy of my line.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.11.58.0.n: No, he is not dead yet. I feel it in my bones.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.14.51.0.c: Ah, there it is, the Ring of Infinite Gems! I will give you what I promised if you decide to hand it over.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.14.51.0.f: Long ago, a powerful wizard managed to create a magical object. In time, however, the method of its making was forgotten. I would like to learn the technique myself, but I need one of these objects to study how it was made. Bring me the Ring of Infinite Gems, and I will reward you handsomely.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.14.51.0.n: You are here again, but you have no ring. I shall hope you find it and bring it to my workshop.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.22.49.1.c: Yes, these are the ones! Are you ready to begin training in my arenas?
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.22.49.1.f: If you kill the archangels and bring me their scalps, I have the power to train you into the greatest warrior of all time.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.22.49.1.n: No, those are not the right scalps. Once you have them, we can discuss becoming the greatest warrior.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.57.65.0.c:
Ah, there it is! Hand it over, and I will give you all the dragons I have here. 
Well, do you agree?
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.57.65.0.f: Ah, welcome to my home. I have a small favour to ask. I would like you to bring me the Thunder Helmet. I will not tell you why; that is my business. If you bring it to me, I will give you several of my finest little dragons from the cave behind my home.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.57.65.0.n: No helmet, no little dragons. Once you bring it, we can talk about dragons.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.58.90.1.c: You are the right adventurer, and so I shall pass my knowledge on to you.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.58.90.1.f: If you attain these abilities, I will gladly reward you with a small gift: Attack 14, Defense 12, Spell Power 8, and Knowledge 17.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.63.6.1.co: Yes, you are the one I seek! I can give these boots to you. They are no ordinary boots: no one can catch their wearer.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.63.6.1.fi: When you reach the twentieth level, I will give you something useful. You will not regret it.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.63.6.1.ne: No, you are not the chosen one. Come back another time.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.8.74.0.co: YES!!! You killed him! Incredible, I am overjoyed! Many warriors before you set out on this perilous quest, but you are the first to return. I did not want to tell you at the outset that no one had returned. But you came back! Well then, here is your reward. I will choose my 10 finest gold dragons for you.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.8.74.0.fi:
I was a duke on the other continent, but when the dark forces came from the depths of the 
earth, all hell broke loose. Everything that did not look like the devil and his servants was destroyed. I alone escaped. The dark forces seized my family and lands. I would be grateful if you killed one of hell's servants, Devil King. I will reward you well.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.8.74.0.ne:
No, you have not killed him yet. I have very good sources on the other continent.
You will not fool me like this. Once you kill him, you will have your reward.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.9.5.0.com: Ah yes, that is my helmet! Here is what I promised you. Thank you; you are a very good and valiant hero.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.9.5.0.fir: Several years ago, when the forces of evil still held sway over our peoples, I owned a magnificent helmet. But one day devils attacked our village and robbed my friends and me. Their dwelling is somewhere west of here, on an island where nothing lives. So I ask you to return my helmet. I will gladly reward you.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.9.5.0.nex: I am sure you will find the helmet. But you do not have it yet, so I cannot give you what I promised.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.92.51.0.c:
Ah, there they are! I did not know they were so beautiful. Wonderful! Take
the bow, and you may go.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.92.51.0.f:
I am the ambassador of an emperor from a distant land. Recently, his armies were attacked by unidentified raiders. If you brought 
azure dragons, I could reward you very handsomely.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.quest.92.51.0.n: Unfortunately, I see no azure dragon anywhere in your ranks. I hope you find one and bring it to me.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.sign.27.37.0.me:
I hope this letter reaches the shores of my homeland. If not, may it at least fall into the hands of a good person.
HELP, I AM A PRISONER ON MAG. ISLAND.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.sign.45.9.0.mes: This land looks desolate and is rich in resources.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.sign.56.23.0.me:
Carved into the wooden tablet: F.rs.... dr.n. fr.m th. w.ll.. It m.y.
.. come in handy. !!!
map.[ab] - posledni soud.sign.60.53.0.me:
After several weeks of wandering the open sea, your ship anchored
somewhere between two worlds on an island marked on no map. Perhaps Green Island...
map.[ab] - posledni soud.sign.61.99.0.me: Ahead you see rocks, and somewhere within them you glimpse a small light. It is probably a harbour, but the several shipwrecks around the reefs give you pause.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.town.4.105.0.ev: You have just received word that a flight of dragons has appeared around this stronghold and settled in a nearby cave. You decided to persuade them to settle here permanently.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.town.4.4.0.even: There is an abandoned cave behind the castle. Your chief castle architect suggested taking 2 dragons, a male and a female, from your main castle and moving them to North Stronghold. Perhaps they will settle in and breed.
You considered the architect's suggestion and tried to do as he proposed.
The chief castellan of North Stronghold reports that the dragons have settled in nicely.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.town.4.4.0.name: North Stronghold
map.[ab] - posledni soud.town.4.48.0.eve: Mobilisation took a great deal of money from your treasury. The people of your kingdom therefore held a small collection and used the proceeds to build...

Just as the Capitol was completed, the recruiters reported that they had enlisted several new mercenaries. There will, however, be a bill for the alcohol they had to use to get the mercenaries drunk before persuading them to sign up.
The total comes to about 1500 gold: vodka 200,-- Fernet 250,-- peppermint liqueur 200,--
Red Label 500.-- beer 100,-- ?Pickled sausages? 250,-- and that is all.

The workers in your quarries began working at 250%, and the miners who
extract crystals at 300%. In these two days they mined 50 tons of crystals and 
the quarrymen some 60 tons of stone. You ordered a cave built from these resources so that some dragons could move in.
As your kingdom grows, so does the number of your subjects, and thus the revenue from the taxes you imposed after the recent mobilisation.
Your treasurer has just informed you that these taxes could be collected 1x a month, or even 1x every 3 weeks.
map.[ab] - posledni soud.town.5.4.1.name: World's End
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.event.0.desc: According to a prophecy, disaster will soon befall the entire land in the form of an attack by undead knights. Your people and the whole world will then fall into the hands of the undead king and serve him for all eternity. The only hope of preventing this is to capture the undead king's town, which gives him the power to rule the surrounding world. But you must hurry, for the prophecy is to come true in just three months.
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.event.1.desc: Only two months remain for you to save the world. If you have not yet set out from your homeland, you should leave at once!
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.event.2.desc:
Dark shadows have begun forcing their way to the surface. An unmistakable sign of the approaching catastrophe. You have only one month left to avert it.
HURRY!!!
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.event.3.desc: Unless you reach the dark lord's castle today, nothing will avert the destruction of the entire world, and you will have lost.
The guardian was sheltering a band of sharpshooters, who will gladly join you and help you capture the nearby castle.
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.header.descr: The Lord of Ghosts has sent powerful scouts to help him find an artifact that will allow him to fulfil his dreams. Only you can stop him and save the world from his madness. Beware, however, of the neighbouring kingdom, which wants the artifact for itself so that it can seize power over the entire land.
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.header.name: Ring of Conjuring
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.quest.25.6.1: Excellent! You have found {3 {Black {Dragons}, and I can present them to the king. Let me leave with them, and you may pass.
My king sent me to bring him {3 {Black {Dragons}. I must obey his command, but I dare not leave this place. If you help me, I will let you pass.
I am sorry, but I cannot return before the king without {3 {Black {Dragons}. You must try harder.
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.quest.5.28.1: Excellent!!! You brought what I wanted. If you now hand over the {Ring of {Conjuring}, I will let you through. Do you wish to pass now?
This tower belongs to a powerful wizard. The guards will let you pass only if you carry the {Ring of {Conjuring}.
Why have you come? Do you have the {Ring of {Conjuring}? I certainly cannot see it. Go, and do not return until you bring it to me.
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.sign.0.3.0.m: If you have come this far, you may as well turn back. You will find nothing important here.
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.sign.25.15.0: You searched the seaweed and found a bottle with a message. Unfortunately, water had got inside, so once again you learned nothing.
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.sign.30.31.1:
If you would aim your arrows best,
Then you must journey to the west.
For just a small and modest fee,
Your troops can change quite easily.
You opened the bottle, unrolled the message, and could hardly believe your eyes...
The hideous face of the Lord of Ghosts grins horribly at you from the paper.
map.[ab] - prsten zaklinani.sign.7.4.1.m:
If you would aim your arrows true,
A journey south awaits you too.
For just a small and modest fee,
Your troops can change quite easily.
map.[ab] - pán aladionu.header.descripti: Aladion is a beautiful, magical world. Every five hundred years, however, a war is fought to decide who will be the next ruler of Aldion. Who it will be is entirely up to you.
map.[ab] - pán aladionu.header.name: Lord of Aladion
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.event.0.d:
The forces of darkness seep through your body, and you are powerless against them. You feel something unknown weakening you, and all your supplies vanish beyond recovery.

The Lord of Evil knows of you...
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.event.1.d:
The armies of the dead subjugate ever greater territories.
Word has reached you that the barbarian king has forged an eternal alliance with the Lord of Evil, so that Darkness may conquer this world more swiftly… He apparently forgets that he too is part of it.
After a few hours, the old man sobered up and realised that he had accidentally given you several thousand too much. Since you have no wish to make enemies, you took pity on this perpetually drunken man and honestly returned the excess money.

The old man promptly drank it all away in the tavern.
The satisfaction of doing right cannot hide the unfortunate result, but some people simply will not listen...
Deep in the mountains, whose peaks rise to the heavens and whose snowdrifts veil the distant horizon, the castle of Titanius once stood. It belonged to giants who commanded the power of lightning. Yet the way there was not easy to find, and even when someone succeeded, no mortal ever beheld its mighty ruler. These creatures consider all others unworthy of their station.
"Greetings, human," a thunderous voice rang out. "I am Terron, ruler and god of the underworld.
Perhaps you are foolish enough to believe you could survive even a single clash with true Evil. But I know better. I have seen thousands of the dead marching through Signus, the Four Elementals defeated, and forces gathering on the Island of Skulls for the decisive blow.

I alone can break their advance and stop them."
To defeat Evil, the god of the underworld needs countless warriors. Fallen warriors...
All those slain whose souls have never found eternal peace end up in the underworld, awaiting the last judgement.
These damned souls have yet to cross the Lake of Justice.
Your campaign leaves victims in its wake as you kill the guilty and the innocent alike...
With every dead soul, you strengthen Terron and his Army of Earth. That is why he rewards you with what humans value most.
Your lands are prospering, so you decided to impose new taxes. Yet the countryside is still ravaged, and the inhabitants refuse to pay. They are rebelling again.
What will you do about it?
Unrest in your own land is the last thing you need now.
You therefore decided to crush the growing rebellion with an exemplary punishment.

You sent troops to round up all the discontented, mostly the poorest, who cannot afford your taxes.
You had all the offenders brought into the capital's courtyard.

As the clock struck twelve, you had them all executed.
A message from the underworld:
"What have you done, Nestor?
Have you forgotten your mission and your honour?
By murdering those wretched people, you have made many enemies, myself included. Even as a god, I know mercy, but your deeds and greed disgust me. Count on me no longer. I will not help a murderer. You have disappointed me deeply, Nestor...

Your father must be turning in his grave."

(Perhaps it was a necessary step in the struggle against Darkness, you think. Yet in your soul you feel no remorse for your deed. You regret only losing the favour of the god of the underworld.)
Is this the right path?
The underworld was never a place for the innocent. Despite his dreadful appearance, Terron was one of the kind and just gods.
He always held the dead in reverence, and so the execution of the peasants outraged him deeply.

He condemned your shameful deeds.
Your growing power blinds you and awakens an ever greater hunger for strength.
You raise taxes and impose them in other parts of Signus as well.

Beware your own greed!
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.event.2.d:
Evil is already spreading across almost the entire land.
You must hurry. The longer you wait, the stronger evil will become, until it finally engulfs all Signus.
His liberation has cost Terron some of his power, but he is still able and willing to support you on your journey.

Though he is god of the underworld, he stands for goodness and justice, and values honour above all.
Treasure so important an ally.
War is very costly, and the taxes collected from the people are no longer enough.
In the west, a rebellion broke out against your unavoidable measures, and this conflict cost you considerable resources.

You therefore reduce the levies paid into your treasury.
According to an ancient legend, the gods who dwell in the Heavens wield unimaginable power, capable of withstanding anything. The first of the gods possessed the Holy Grail. It was a time of pure goodness, when misfortune did not exist.
But an age came when the power embodied in the Holy Grail was no longer needed. Contentment and peace no longer required the rule of a single being. Goodness was then as the Most High had envisioned it. In a perfect world, he was no longer needed. He therefore renounced his omnipotence and willingly passed into oblivion.

A new age began.

Yet the generations living in contentment felt an ever stronger need to exalt themselves above others. The dark forces of the Earth gave birth to the gods of the Four Elements, who forever yearned and competed with one another to impose their vision of a rightful World. Perfect opposites ensured balance and gave everyone complete freedom to choose their path in life.
Thus arose the World as we know it today. A world where you can be what you deserve to be, a world where the power of the Four means order.
The armies of the Order of Light were made up of those who had been exalted by goodness during their lives and become immortal warriors of the Four Elements.
You had a strange dream in the night.
You saw the Army of the Dead storm into your town.
All resistance was futile. The undead razed everything living to the ground. Just as they were about to kill you too, the heavens opened, and a strange winged creature carried you to safety...
In the morning, the dream left you uneasy.
Was it a warning, or perhaps a prophecy?
Or mere coincidence...
All day you feel as though something is constantly protecting you. Some higher power...
Could it be connected to yesterday's dream?
Do you not regret your pride?

Now you have lost an ally. People throughout the land fear you and are losing faith in you.
Can you still lead them into another war against the enemy? Was all this necessary to prove your superiority? Or are you slowly becoming like those you fight?
Which path will you choose?
{Good} or {Evil}?
One day you will have to decide.
I trust you will choose wisely.
According to legend, mighty creatures called Azure Dragons live in Signus. They are said to be the strongest creatures in the earthly world. No one knows why the gods created them or how their terrifying power can be mastered. It is so great that even the bravest warriors freeze in terror at the sight of them.
They say a demigod once lived who ruled these creatures with a cruel hand.
But he overestimated his strength and, according to legend, fell at the hands of his own warriors.
You awoke this morning deeply troubled. You had another dream in the night...

You saw a beautiful place where peace, goodness, and justice reigned. The people worked honestly and gladly helped their lord.
Suddenly the sky clouded over, and an unknown horseman rode out of the forest with his retinue. He demanded that everyone pay a tax.
But his demands were too high. No one in the village had anything with which to pay. So the rider ordered everyone slaughtered and the village burned. It was terrible. Weeping and wailing sounded everywhere. Streams of blood flowed through the streets. No one escaped...
The rider merely smiled in triumph as he gazed at the burning village...
There was also an old man who sacrificed his own life to save a child. The child managed to hide in the forest.
In the night, you feared falling asleep again. But it was not fear of the enemy.
You feared the nightmares that have haunted you lately. You therefore wanted to stay awake all night.
Only towards dawn did you give in and fall into a deep, exhausted sleep.
Yet you dreamed of nothing the whole time. In the morning, you awoke feeling that you were finally rid of the nightmares.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.event.3.d:
A message arrived, asking for help...
Please help us! We are a forest people, and we urgently need all the livestock you can spare. We cannot pay you, but it is essential for the tribute we pay the Dragon for his protection.
If we fail to deliver it in time, we will pay in our own blood.
Please help!
That night, you had another dream.
You saw a small group of defenceless peasants toiling in the gold mines. A man in a dark cloak came to them and demanded all their earnings. But this was their only livelihood, so they refused to hand it over.
They begged him for mercy.
Yet the man remained implacable. The peasants had no choice: either starve to death or defend their property with their bare hands...
...every last one of them laid down their life in that unequal struggle...
You have not dreamed for several days.
Is that a good sign or a bad one?
Why were you haunted by such dreadful dreams?
You cannot explain it, so you search your conscience for a connection with your deeds.
At last you forced Christian to pay taxes. This lord was among the great nobles and a loyal servant of the king himself. He was always said to be very miserly, despite his immense wealth.
You used a little diplomacy and promised to return the money after the war, since only the true king of Signus was permitted to collect taxes.
One night, you sent a messenger to Pagan to return Christian's borrowed gold. But when the servant entered the great hall, he found Christian feasting with other nobles. The revelry was in full swing, and the wine flowed freely.

They say it is easier to negotiate with a drunk. Instead of repaying the debt, your servant therefore received a generous gift of money...
Drunkenness does not pay.
In time, Christian realised his mistake. But since he lacked the strength to enforce his rights, he had no choice but to rely on your word of honour.
He sent his servant to you, asking that you repay the debt within three days.
It is time to pay your debts, Nestor.
You have my trust, and you know I will always gladly support you, but your expenses are too high, and your debt keeps growing.
Christian himself came to ask for his money, humbly, yet with a nobleman's dignity.
Perhaps your conscience stirred; perhaps it was the memory of Terron's warning, or even the influence of the warriors of the Order of Light...
And so you keep your promises.
You have paid the first instalment, but you still owe Christian a great deal of money.
This time you were less willing to meet his demands. Yet perhaps, through this payment, you were trying to atone for your sins.
Your debt to me is now paid in full, with interest.
Thank you; I appreciate that you have kept your word.
Good luck.
What are you still waiting for, Nestor?
Have you come so far only to give up now?
Everything depends on you.
Surely you will not wait forever…
Nestor, the son of a humble peasant, never knew his mother. In desperate circumstances, she was forced to give her life for her newborn son.
Your father was an honourable man, hardened by years of work in the fields. He had a good heart, and though he had little himself, he always tried to help others afflicted by the same harsh fate, easing the suffering that followed the opening of the Gate of the Dead.
In those days, any defiance was tantamount to suicide. Even so, your father decided to help a sick friend's family escape. He sacrificed his own life in the attempt.
As he lay dying, you promised never to dishonour his memory and to go into the forests, where you would become a warrior.

This art is very rare. Apart from the once-glorious Royal Army, almost no one today knows how to wield a sword.
Years of training made you a man, a capable warrior, and above all an outstanding sharpshooter.
Your father wished you to pass on your gifts, so that others too might grow into people capable of standing against injustice.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.event.4.d:
Flight will solve nothing, yet you remain alone, unable to resist what is happening around you. You have nowhere to go. Having lost your family, you can only hope to escape the evil said to be spreading even into these parts of Signus.
Try to take at least a few of your former comrades with you.
The ancient legend also tells of a God who brought chaos into a world of perfect balance.

...because he summoned the forbidden Evil.
That which slumbered deep within everyone, without exception. That which could destroy this World.
The opening of the Gate of the Dead ushered in the time of the worst nightmares.
Since the power of the Four had long ceased to be united, even the Order of Light could not withstand the hosts of the dead. The One could not be reborn to gain absolute power and the ability to bind the Darkness.
Divine strength wanes with every passing day.
The day draws to a close.
The end heralds a new beginning.
The dawn of Darkness approaches.
The dark path leads to death...

Morning. The sky is stained with the blood of thousands of the fallen, and lamentation carries across the land.
There is no escape.
The time of the apocalypse draws near. Eternal darkness has fallen over the Heavens.
The earth darkens crimson like hands bearing the guilt of years past, when time neared its end and the dying world wept for the fate of the Four. Hot tears fell upon the hearts of those who defied the Lord, despite the weight of eternal damnation and a will buried in pain: to remain blind no longer and cast off the yoke. Like dying dew in a mortal's eye, more fragile than life itself, let fate be fulfilled, and let human yearning give birth to the boundless power of hope...

{643/25}
For a thousand years, Signus was a land where contentment and justice were part of everyday life. Those were years of peace, when mortal souls lived happily under the power of the Immortals... That age has passed.
No one remembers whence the first Gods came. Yet immense power slumbered in their hands. The Four Elements brought balance to a world where one could live in peace, without war or suffering. They ruled wisely and never abused their station.
Yet power is an instrument of misfortune.
According to an ancient legend, only the united strength of the four elements can bind all the forbidden Evil that springs from the hearts of those who choose to forsake the path of goodness.

A path from which more than ordinary mortals can easily stray.

The legend also says that there was a power given to one alone, to decide all things.
This is the Most High, the power of the {Holy Grail}, whose use can have consequences beyond reckoning.
The weakness of the gods, who believed in their limitless dominion over the world then known, soon revealed itself.
Through a mysterious ritual, the Gate of the Dead opened, and Evil was summoned from the realm of darkness. It was the price of foolish pride...
A mind clouded by a blind desire to rule every heart and turn to dust the long-forgotten hint of freedom that springs up around the last who stand with faces unchanged. A soul surrounded by evil yearns to escape its dominion. How to find a way to resist the approaching end of all life in this world...

{803/44}
Centuries ago, Martius foretold that when the balance between worlds was broken, a day would come when all the worst nightmares would become reality. On that day, only death would bring deliverance. That day would change everything. No means would suffice to resist the hosts of the dead, and the Four Elements would become a thing of the past.

Yet it was foretold that {He} would be found. One among millions of insignificant fools like him.
Destined to find a way to defy fate and behold the future of tomorrow...
Does a heart as cold as the morning frost settling over a grey landscape have the right to behold salvation from fate? Should it take upon itself the chance to bridge the divide between the dawn of light and a darkness so black that it would be better to remain forever alone and blind than rest upon the blade's edge that separates a living soul from the void? The void surrounding a man who does not succumb to natural mortality, but endures like a glimpse of salvation in this world's distant future...

{351/12}
The last free places have not yet abandoned hope. Faith in a predestined fate drives the last defenders onward. Though no one knows the answer, someone must bear the burden of deciding.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.event.5.d:
The wood elves were once noble beings who came close to immortality. The warriors of the Order of Light came from their ranks.
Today their realm is gripped by the advancing Evil.
Time is running short for this people too, and defeat threatens them soon.
Death is the only wish, when a broken soul need no longer commit inevitable sins a hundred times before the close of days long past. Clouds of darkness descend upon a man who lived so long ago, upon the years of passing solitude. They give no redeeming answer that might set you apart from damnation. Not a step along the path of whitening radiance, which, like golden metal, leaves hands full and hearts empty. Starless heavens pale, and the last flicker of certainty in this place without a legacy fades, in a faith extinguished by hellfire.

{309/17}
Let the four quarters of the world turn towards the image of a dying land, and let the finger of fate seal the gates within you in blood. Then birth shall stand upon the threshold of a new tomorrow, thanks to what slumbered in thought, hidden by fear that denies the strength to break the end of the future and find oneself an eager child of evil. Passing through the mirror is harder than beholding one's own poisoned life and living with the sense of an enemy within. Then you too, alone in battle against yourself, will curse that burden by which you sign the sentence of damnation with your own heart.

{198/42}
Upon pale lips shall rest the salvation of words that would rather have remained forgotten. The hosts shall become mighty like the beginning of a wretched mortal soul, counting the sands of time in futility and thus giving a terse answer with a bitter taste.

{873/91}
Is eternal life worth anything when mortality loses its humanity? Or when endless ages, bought at a price greater than the very meaning of existence, sever compassion with a dark tear, and futility never ceases to be one's daily bread until the end?

{309/55}
Every beginning is also the end of forgotten days.

{101/12}
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.event.6.d:
As the self-proclaimed ruler and possible liberator of this part of Signus, you need help from everyone who can provide it.
You have therefore imposed taxes on the inhabitants who have survived thus far.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.event.7.d: Darkness has already engulfed much of Signus.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.event.8.d: Your army's wages must be paid.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.event.9.d:
Although gold is no longer such an important currency, you concluded that the desire for wealth still endures in people.
You therefore borrowed some money from an old drunken dealer. Perhaps it will help.
Who will prevail in the eternal struggle between Good and Evil?
Ahead lies a place where a powerful wizard stands between the two forces.

He will advise you how to gain divine power.
As throughout the region, these forests are dangerous for lone travellers. Bandits often hide within them.
As you advance through the forest, unease begins to grip you.
This crown must have belonged to Christian. It seems you are on the right trail.
The guardian Cardus keeps the secret of divine power.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.10:
The little village beneath the castle reminds you of the one where you grew up.
The people here live contentedly, though hard work fills their lives.
Yet they are honest and industrious, and so deserve protection.
You found treasure in the dragon cave.
Perhaps that dreadful feeling can never be forgotten.

As you approach the unicorns' refuge, you hear the distant thunder of hooves...
You flee, but the unicorns are faster and catch up with you.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.11:
Do nothing you might later regret.
These creatures mean you no harm. Go back to sleep.

You are entering dragon territory. Be on your guard!
Though you have heard much about dragons, they remain unpredictable creatures.
The fire of eternal winter flickers nearby. If it goes out, spring will come.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.12:
The wooden guardians are dangerous.
You had best leave their treasures alone.
Do you really wish to bring down their wrath and curse upon you?

The bravest warriors once set forth from this temple.
But after the undead invasion, too few knights remained to rebuild the great royal army.

Water murmurs softly, nature blooms, and peace and tranquillity reign everywhere.
Evil has not yet reached this place.
If only all Signus were like this!

The mountains tower high into the clouds.
They say a mysterious city of giants lies here. No mortal has yet dared look its inhabitants in the eye.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.13:
In your place, I would not provoke the mighty wooden guardians.
Do you still want to take the treasure?
Search the whole island and find the way to the last judgement.
Nothing beats a fresh sea breeze!
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.14:
How could you?
You have shed the blood of innocent people. You no longer have the right to call yourself a knight.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.16:
This is Martius's tower of sorcery.
It has great magical power.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.17:
You did it after all.
You slaughtered every peasant. You should be ashamed.
How could you do it?
Is {gold} worth more to you than a human {life}?
This crystal is prepared for a magical dragon.
Dead souls seeking peace still dig ore in this place of misery.

The Lord of Darkness tried to seize the Heavens and Hell, but his efforts were thwarted.
Now you can side with one or the other by using his remains.
I hope that is not Sir Christian's skeleton.
The last judgement approaches, to punish every sin and reward each person according to their deeds in life.
The Island of Skulls is the place from which Evil, the Gate of the Dead, and the Lord of Evil originate.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.20:
This town belonged to the wizard Martius.
It was a secret sanctuary where he experimented on the souls of the fallen, though he was strictly forbidden to practise magic.
They say he was trying to find a spell of eternal life.
(Perhaps Martius wanted someone to share his immortality.)
But Evil reached even here.

While passing through the cave, you tripped over a stone. The sound echoes all around. You try to be careful, but it is too late. The blind creatures have found you and want to sacrifice you to their god.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.21:
By freeing them, you relieved them of their harsh fate.
Do not rob them of their dignity; leave in peace.
But if you wish to gain this rare gift, you must face their resistance.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.22:
The lands in which you now stand are no longer what they once were.
The people abandoned their traditional way of life and were forced to make often radical changes.
Where fertile fields once spread, bare wastelands lie today. Safe, beautiful forests are full of bandits who will rob anyone who crosses their path without hesitation.
Alas, the golden age is lost beyond recall.

The Order of the Golden Knights was also meant to fight in the Royal Army.
But the clash with Evil took place without them.
No one knows why they failed in their duty.
Everyone came to regard them as traitors.

Various strange creatures accustomed to darkness make their homes underground.
If you are careful, perhaps they will not see you.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.23: To rid yourself of guilt, rid yourself of all that is good.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.25: You have proved your determination to do evil.

Even your home village, which you had to leave at your father's urging, faced the onslaught of evil. Those who survived have changed since then...
You will search in vain for your childhood home and the friends you left behind when you went to train in the forests.
Patience is the key to success. Through arduous training, you have managed to teach some of them a long-forgotten art.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.27: Soon darkness will engulf this place as well.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.28: You hear the lament of the dead.

The library seems safe now. You can learn new, forgotten knowledge.
Years spent behind thick walls have made these people masters of their own minds. They say the best can even poison the minds of others.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.29:
What is this?
A ship tried to reach the shore but was wrecked on these treacherous rocks.
One survivor managed to escape and swim ashore. You offered him help, and since he left everything aboard and now has nothing, he decided to come with you.

Though the royal army's might is long gone, a small handful still remain loyal to the crown.
Yet time shows no mercy, and the old traditional values are no longer what they once were.
Thus a small bribe and the chance to serve new, wealthy masters are enough.
You approach the barbarian capital. The mighty ruler Garaghus VI already knows of you and sends his guards against you. You must be determined to defeat them and find what you seek.

Entry to the abandoned mines has been forbidden ever since several miners lost their lives there.
They are said to be cursed.

Outside the bandit camp, you see human heads impaled on stakes.
What beasts could do such a thing?
You found the prison where Christian was held.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.30: You hear the lament of the dead.

Your good heart seeks vengeance for your decision. How could you do it? You betrayed everything you believed in. You betrayed everything you lived for and wished to die for.
Your conscience will haunt you forever.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.31:
Remember the White Mage's words.
You have passed through the last judgement.

Thousands of the dead rise from their graves.
Evil knows of you.
The Lord of Evil awaits you.

A ritual was being held here, sacrificing livestock to the God of Earth for a better harvest.
Though the power of the Four is long past, the people still keep the old customs.

You unwittingly interrupted them, which is said to be punishable by death.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.32:
Suddenly you see an unfamiliar cave ahead.
This path leads underground.
Perhaps you will meet Terron.
(You would rather avoid that possibility. After angering him, you had best give him a wide berth.)
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.33: Terron, mighty god of the underworld, was imprisoned here. Yet he found a way to escape the fate of the others. Now he is determined to confront his enemies.

The pyramid built for Garagh VI is to serve as a place of sacrifice for imprisoned enemies.
Try to remove the guards and free the prisoners.
You found the Gate of the Dead.
Do you have no doubts about your decision?

An unknown force binds your spellcasting abilities, and you lose all your wondrous power.
Let the prophecy be fulfilled: only one with a pure heart and courage can find a way through the Gate of the Dead.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.34:
The power of the Most High is yours.

Congratulations, you have won!

       {The} {End}
