m.dosek@email.cz
Thank you for your patience with this level. I hope you enjoyed it.

After the bitter fighting, you fall to your knees in exhaustion.
Fear seizes you, and you begin to lose faith in your destiny.
Your entire life passes before your eyes.
...a glimpse before the final trial.

All Evil comes from this place. The Island of Skulls was not always like this.
It was once believed that the immortal souls of fallen warriors dwelt here.
Find the weakest point and put an end to it forever.
There is no way back now...
Your magical abilities attract magical beings.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.35:
Surprisingly, a few persistent mercenaries remain in the tavern before the watchtower, drunk enough to join either side without hesitation, or die with a bottle in hand or beneath the onslaught of Evil.
...they do not care in the slightest.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.36:
Only a god may cross the Gate of the Dead.
Only the Chosen One will defeat the Lord of Evil.
Only {He} will become the Most High.

This is the road to the Island of Skulls. If you have become a God, you may behold your fate.
(You must have found all the Elements and obtained the Sword of Doom.)
You choose the path of EVIL.

You found a fine axe embedded in a tree trunk and are trying to pull it free.
Suddenly an entire herd of centaurs charges at you.
It is a trap!
Will you flee or stand against them?
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.37:
After defeating the Four, Evil failed to destroy these gods completely.
They are now imprisoned and guarded in their own worlds.
They alone can still create a new god.
Find them, free them from eternal damnation, and gain divine power.
Hardened by harsh conditions, the barbarians are able warriors.

You feel the power of the {four} {elements}.

You become a {GOD}.

The Sword of Balance belonged to the Four Elements, but today it has no masters.
Use it to pass through the Gate of the Dead.
Your magical abilities attract magical beings.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.39: You hear the lament of the dead.

The abandoned barracks ceased protecting this town long ago.
Though Griffins is still the capital, its glory, like that of so many others, has long since faded.
Surprised that a small garrison still lives here, you try simply bribing this company too.
Yet honour has apparently not died out entirely, and some refuse to disown their former king.
Your magical abilities attract magical beings.
Welcome to Christian's town. If you come in peace, you may proceed. If not, leave his town.
You found treasure buried here by some adventurer.
If you defeat the Dead Guardian, you will gain a warrior's strength.

Cold can be an unpleasant enemy.
If you decide to journey to the Island of Skulls, you may face an enemy worse even than frostbitten feet.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.41:
Remember the White Mage's words.
You have passed through the last judgement.
You choose the path of GOOD.

The Capital of Signus

Once a wealthy and renowned refuge for travellers and muster point for the Royal Army. After the invasion of the dead, it was sacked and razed to the ground.
Not a living soul escaped the destruction and slaughter. There is no longer room for human life among the ruins. 
For other strange creatures, however, it is a new home.
A White Mage can pass through the Lake of Justice and stand before the last judgement.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.42:
You like hot weather, but this desert is terrible.
You must quickly find a well, or you will not get far.

The demigoddess Mutare is imprisoned here.
She was once a cruel queen of dragons, but she underestimated their strength. The dragons broke free of her dominion and are now free.
She alone managed to tame them.

After she lost her power, her son sealed an oath in blood to avenge himself on those who had done this to his mother. He therefore travelled the land alone, seeking the descendants of the first Free Ones.
He became the Dragonslayer. Today he is little more than a legend, as is the prison of the dragon goddess Mutare.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.43:
Here stood a sanctuary where one could be raised to a warrior of the Order of Light.
After the barbarians allied with Evil, this refuge had to be abandoned.
Their ranks can therefore no longer grow, and their strength is waning.
Heaven alone remains untouched.

How can you walk the path of good when you have done so much evil?
Have you forgotten all the innocents who died by your hand?
Your conscience will haunt you forever.
Your magical abilities attract magical beings.

Suddenly you see a strange creature.
It looks like a mighty azure dragon, which you know only from tales for little children.
They say no one can defeat a creature whose gaze is more dreadful than the worst imaginings.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.44: Do you have no doubts about your decision?
You defeated a mighty titan. News of your victory spread throughout Signus. The titans began to respect you and bestowed their power upon you.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.45:
The old hut looks as though it was abandoned in haste.
You should be careful.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.46: Look into the darkness and discover whence Evil comes.
A duel with the ruler of the titans awaits you. If you defeat him, you will gain his strength and entry to his kingdom.
A sand monster emerges from the windswept dunes.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.47:
No one has ever crossed this desert.
The barbarian tribes are made up of exiles who defied the King's will.
Their territory remains as unexplored as their way of life.
Your magical abilities attract magical beings.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.49:
Your hidden malice has turned against you.

And your worst nightmares have emerged...

Beyond lies only a frozen wasteland, with no safe path across it.
To venture there alone without the necessary experience is certain suicide.
Oasis of the desert nomads.
Here you can refresh yourself and regain your strength.
The dragon left treasure behind in the cave.
You are entering Sir Christian's territory.

Long ago, the demigod Mutare fought the mightiest dragon lord for 2 years.
At last the dragon was defeated and bound with these chains.
Yet no one could master their strength, and in the end the dragons fought for their freedom and overthrew their terrible tyrant.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.50: You are entering the territory of the Forest People. It does not look dangerous.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.51:
Evil has already taken this castle...
Their realm lies beyond the eastern mountains.

Though the final assault has not yet begun, Evil somehow managed to pass through Terron's gate.
The brave elves tried to defend their land, but failed, just as in other parts of the realm.
The capital was defended by the king's son-in-law Naharius, who could not avert its doom.
Now the elves are condemned to the slow extinction of their once-noble race.

The elven lands are inhospitable. After the invasion of the dead, not one stone was left upon another, and everyone would rather leave these once-beautiful lands.
THEY ARE AFRAID!
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.52: This road is old now. No one has walked it for years. Who knows what lies at the end?
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.53:
There is no way back now.
Your strength must match your resolve.

Your horse's hooves sink into the snow.
You are chilled to the bone and can go no farther. Your troops hesitate to follow you.

YOU DID NOT LISTEN!
You will pay for your insolence!
Hosts of undead have emerged from the tomb and want to bury you alive.

You have entered the laboratory of the wizard Martius.
He enjoyed making all manner of beings from precious metals.
But he prepared a trap here for unexpected visitors.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.54: A monster emerged from the swamps.

One of the necromancers was buried here. He tried to conquer this part of Signus, but as you can see, he failed.
If you do not want to be cursed, you had best flee.

You found Martius's tower of knowledge.
He keeps his spells within.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.55: You managed to find the old cave of an even older dragon. His strength is pitifully feeble, but he is determined to follow in your footsteps.
You hear a cry for help from somewhere.

The warrior Daganus lives in this hut. Once a captain of the royal cavalry, he is now a veteran who remembers the first clash with Darkness.
A fortunate few survived that day, but they were never the same again.

The insolence of disturbing eternal rest is unforgivable.
No spell can break the curse, so you must pay for your impudence.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.56:
Another of the cursed tombs of once-mighty rulers and servants of Darkness.
The power of the Four inflicted grievous losses upon the Enemy's ranks.
Thus defeated death now rests for all eternity.

The tower of the warriors of the Order of Light.
Some of the fallen angels who stood against Evil in the war of the Armies are imprisoned here.
No one yet knows what the Lord of Evil intends to do with them.
According to legend, dragons have a cave somewhere here, but no one has seen them for years.

Ahead you see a skeleton fighting a brave soldier.
These people are extraordinarily capable, though they easily fall to brute force.
They are among the finest marksmen in Signus.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.57: The soldier was right. Hosts of skeletons rushed at you from the dead trees.

Ahead you see a devil who has cornered two elves in a dead end.
The elves have no chance, but they will not surrender. They ready their last arrows, knowing they will die in this unequal duel.
Yet they will die with honour.
This gold is to be used to make a new guard.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.58:
You have uncovered the secret of the White Mages.
They were banished from the World for their ability to pass through the Lake of Justice, thus evading the last judgement while still alive.

The well serves all creatures.
Yet a demon has claimed this one for himself and refuses to let others use it.

Perhaps greater justice sometimes pays.
Find the tower of the White Mages, and you will learn how Evil can be defeated.

The Lord of Evil's strength must not be taken lightly. The elves surely knew what they were doing when they avoided this place. You feel a strange chill and begin to hesitate over taking the final step. What if doom truly awaits you?

A fortress created by the dark lord as the main source of strength for the decisive assault on the elves.
Construction began after Naharius's armies were defeated. The Lord of Evil himself consecrated its foundation stone, thus cursing it against every living thing that chose to cross its gates.
This threat is said to be so dreadful that the elves did not even try to prevent construction from beginning. Though the fortress is far from complete, the curse is strong enough to deter any daring soul.
Your hands are frostbitten; you cannot cast spells.

You trudge through the snow, wondering whether it is right to flee your own destiny, and whether the future can be changed...
Suddenly you see a hole in the snow ahead. You wonder what could have dug such a hole.
The ground suddenly trembles, and an ice monster crawls out.

You walk through the forest, breathing the fresh air, when suddenly you feel as though someone is watching you.
You look around but see no one. Just then, a band of robbers attacks, intent on taking your money.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.59:
Once again you feel magical ground beneath your feet.
The power of sorcery radiates from this place.
Oasis of the desert nomads.
Here you can refresh yourself and regain your strength.
A sand monster emerges from the windswept dunes.
A tax is collected for use of the road.
Why are you taking the dragons' freedom away?
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.60: Swamps often herald the presence of Evil.
You found an ancient dragon city, home to the strongest beasts for miles around. Evil has not yet reached this place.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.61:
Evil is near.
The Lord of Darkness shows mercy to no one, so turn back while there is still time.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.62:
A day like so many before, when a person may seek an answer in the hearts of their lives, and an icy gaze endures the deeds of all. Between the salvation of one's own deliverance and darkness flowing clearly through the veins, striving in vain to evade the order of the world.

{703/92}

Many treasures lie hidden in this sacred dragon place, along with unpleasant surprises in the form of dragon guards.

The eternal Eye of the Dragon Lord watches over these creatures' fate. It is both a guarantee and a symbol of deliverance from tyranny and of knowing the sweet taste of freedom.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.63: Beyond this gate lies all evil. Be careful.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.64:
When Heaven was created, the Most High, in his perfection, felt his own existence was needless in a world of pure goodness.
And so the heavenly throne remained empty.
The divided power and balance of the Four Elements were only temporary.
When humans first felt malice, hell was born as punishment for the sins committed in their lives.

One man found a way to pass through the Lake of Justice and avoid the last judgement, which divides people according to their deserts.

By pledging his soul to the God of Fire, he gained immense magical abilities.
He became the greatest and most powerful wizard in the known world. His strength began to rival that of the gods themselves. They feared this threat and therefore forbade him to use magic. In return, he was granted immortality...
For hundreds of years, he has thus avoided the reckoning of the last judgement.
But the invasion of the dead spelled doom for the entire world.
The Four Elements needed every help they could get, so they lifted the ban on spellcasting.
They themselves fell victim to Evil.
The greatest wizard, Martius, met the same fate.
Though he could even bend space and time, he was captured, and his power forgotten...

You stand before Martius's prison.
Destroy its guards and try to free him.

The old woman living in the hut has not seen a living person for years.
Surprisingly, she offered you a favourable bargain: for a small bribe, she will give you equipment to survive in these inhospitable lands.
(You take the old woman's promises with a pinch of salt, and no one in your company believes she could improve their abilities. That, however, would not trouble you so much.
You regret the pouch of gold you paid for her valuable advice.)
You hear the lament of the imprisoned and feel their despair.
You have reached the edge of the wasteland. Could this be the road away from all evil to the peace you long for?

Do not underestimate the power of evil.
This part is the first, preceding the invasion that will utterly destroy the world you have known.
At the clash of the Armies, when the combined forces of the Four Elements, the Order of Light, and human warriors stood against the Enemy, hope was the only thing they still shared.
Since no being could be found to lead the armies of good as one, Evil held an immense advantage. Its warriors crushed the last resistance without fear or mercy.
Today only a handful remain who remember those days.
As at the beginning, there is still nothing to halt the approaching end.
You found the dragons' treasure, amassed here from the spoils of fallen heroes who tried to kill them.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.65:
A few coins lie scattered on the ground, so openly that you find it suspicious.
Will you overcome your curiosity, or will the desire for gold prevail?
As you draw closer, you hear some merchants arguing.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.66:
One learns from mistakes.
Have you learned, or do you need another lesson?

OOOOAAAAAA!
The dragon guard has discovered you in its treasury.
That should not have happened. Dragons are very touchy about their gold and dislike anyone trying to take it.

The land is full of all sorts of characters, so finding a slave market here comes as no surprise.
As you look over the goods on offer, you ponder the purpose of such places.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.67:
This fortress was built as a watchpost to repel raids from the barbarian realm.
Yet all its forces had to move west to fight in the Royal Army.
Today this town is almost deserted.

Dancon was among the finest royal knights, but his desire for justice led him into exile...
One day, he broke into the royal treasury and stole the crown jewels. He then fled and now hides in the swamps. The king never saw his crown again.
Dancon became an outlaw, a thief, and a murderer. He and his band are the greatest brigands in the whole region.
Some say he did it out of hatred for the King and unwillingness to serve the nobility. He became a symbol of resistance to oppression and awakened the people's hope of deliverance from slavery.

TIP: Use the Shackles of War (Shackles of War) against Dancon. If you carry them, he cannot flee from battle.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.68:
As you push deeper through the dark undergrowth, fear grips you ever more tightly.

Is this truly the right and necessary path?
Have you decided to change the fate of people condemned to destruction?
Do you even have the right to take on such responsibility?

The power of the dragon lord has been tamed only once.
Yet no one has ever withstood that terrible responsibility.
Do you think you can be a good master to them?
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.69:
Among many others, you found a healer whose fate ended badly.
Her miraculous abilities are said to cure most diseases.
She was one of those who fell in the clash of the Armies.
Accept her soul and allow her to rest in peace.

Your first true clash with evil awaits. If you fail now, the fate of the elves and Signus is sealed.
You cannot retreat.
You have become entangled in a war whose stakes are the survival of the entire World, rather than your own victory.

You killed the most sacred animal in Signus.
The curse will haunt you all your life.

An unknown magical force stuns you and robs you of the ability to cast spells.
Magical fields grant this place extraordinary powers.

A magical dragon enchanted this place.
He lived in the dragon city like the other dragons, but one day he stole the sacred spellbook, and the dragons exiled him as punishment.
To cast spells, he needs magical crystals that give him strength. But he cannot obtain them himself, so he forces his slaves to work for him in the magical fields.
He is an outcast from the rest of his kind.
Dragon treasures lie scattered throughout the cave.

You enter the dragon cave.
The sound of a dragon's breathing echoes off the walls, the stench of rotten flesh hangs in the air, and human bones litter the ground. This place fills you with dread.

Yet a movement in the distance might belong to something alive.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.70:
This is the Temple of the God of Air.
Its guardians hope to see their lord again one day.

This is the Temple of the God of Earth.
Though their lord is lost, they still believe his power will one day reign again.

This is the Temple of the God of Fire.
The days when they served their lord are gone, but their loyalty and faith in his liberation endure.

You defeated the Lord of Darkness's advance guard.
It seems you are strong enough to face him.
Yet your own fears weaken you more and more.

Evil can sense fear.

You can no longer return to these lands by this route.
You must therefore have the resolve to survive at the other end as well.

Good luck!
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.guards.71:
You have not the slightest idea where you have ended up.
Perhaps this is the Wasteland, where creatures banished from Signus dwell.
Or perhaps you are heading into the barbarian kingdom, which Evil is said to have already conquered.
Suddenly you see unfamiliar beings devouring a piece of human flesh.

The Order of Light was once a feared power throughout Signus.
People still believe that the last of these higher beings will one day witness the end of the war and the defeat of Evil.

Samuel was once a general of the Army of Air, but his god abandoned him in the midst of battle.
He chose eternal dying over cowardice and the loss of honour.
A fee is charged for passage to the other side.
You are leaving your homeland. There is no way back…

This is our greatest treasure.
In return for your help, I will teach you to shoot it. Are you ready for your first lesson?
Crossroads
West – royal treasury
East – gold mines
North – Pagan town
South – towards the exit

Here the slavers sell their living spoils.
If you are dissatisfied with a member of your company, you can dispose of them here at a profit.

In the distance, you hear the rattle of bones...
(The sound awakens long-forgotten memories from your youth, when you witnessed the armies of Evil ravaging these lands. It was also the last sound before your father's death.)
You managed to saddle and tame one of them.
Darkness will soon rule these lands as well.
At last you leave this dreadful place.
This is an old way of travelling, used chiefly by wizards. No one can be certain where they will end up or what awaits them on the other side.

Though you have proved your resolve, you are still an enemy in the giants' eyes.
Be careful, and do not let your own success mislead you.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.header.de:
A world where the rule of the Four Elements maintained the balance...
A world forever changed by Darkness...
A world losing hope.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.heroes.14: Martius, the greatest wizard in Signus
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.monster.1:
If you are looking for Sir Christian,
I saw him. He went hunting down in the forest this morning.

The Skeleton is the weakest, yet also the most dangerous unit in the ranks of Evil.
It excels not in strength, but in sheer numbers and the loss of all compassion and fear.

The old sawmill has long stood idle.
Over the years, nature has come back to life.
Please, let us live. This mine is our only livelihood. If we lose it, we will starve. We cannot defend ourselves, but we would rather die fighting than die a slow death.

Despite their fearsome strength, dragons cannot secure a will of their own.
No one has ever permanently tamed their defiance, and so they are now creatures whose purpose and aims are poorly understood.
The truth is that their passion for combat often leads them into battles they are bound to lose.

Please, do not kill me. I have nothing; I am alone with five children.
Turn back. We do not want to hurt you.
May your black soul never find peace.

This is another former soldier of the Royal Army.
His attempt to escape was in vain, and now he is becoming a servant of Evil, determined to spread death and destruction.
His transformation can no longer be stopped. You can only free the soul that will forever remain loyal to the King.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.monster.2:
I too was once a brave and mighty warrior.
When I faced their troops, my fate became one of endless torment.
End my suffering and kill me. My family's honour is stained.
Only death can redeem my failure.

Mortals had to be born so that they could follow their own paths.
Absolute good brought the Supreme One no satisfaction. Thus came the balance of the Four Elements and a World where good and evil together give meaning to earthly life.
When a mortal's journey ends, they stand before the Last Judgement. Their conscience is tested to determine whether the life they lived merits eternal damnation or salvation.
Only death ends the journey, and the soul travels across the Lake of Justice, where all sins are counted.
This determines whether it will spend eternity in Heaven or Hell.


...only then may a mortal behold the gods...
Yet there is a way to escape the Last Judgement and still stand before the Four...
Seek the answer among the White Mages.

You stand before the Grand Master of this order.
You introduce yourself politely and ask for his help.
(Though you know of their inglorious past.)

The Grand Master, however, is utterly unwilling to join the fight against Evil.
He flies into a rage and immediately sends you away.
You are disappointed. You did not expect such swift and callous treatment. Still, you cannot resist asking why they betrayed the King in the war against the Lord of Evil.
(In truth, you do not even expect an answer, and slowly walk away.)

The Grand Master stops you.
Without blinking or saying a word, he sends a handful of his warriors with you.
(The meaning of his behaviour remains a mystery to you.)

I am in your debt.
Accept this token of my gratitude.

Aha!
Is that Nestor?
What are you looking for here, traitor? Go back to wherever you spent the last 12 years. You were always our friend; I always trusted you. When you left, many followed you, many went out to face their fate. You and your kind have no place here...

(Though your eyes betray disappointment, shame and guilt over your home village, you gather your courage and beg your former friends to join you so that you can leave these lands together.)

HA! Now you come looking for help? Where were you when we needed it?
Are we supposed to run because we have no chance?

(A silence falls. Yet the shared bond of friendship and memories proves stronger... Tears fill both your eyes, and you are forgiven. Finding old friends is a rare thing in these times.)

Passing through the half-empty village, you find others who would gladly leave this place.
As their leader, you now have a chance to share your experience and teach some of them the art of sharpshooting.

The Last Judgement allowed you to look within yourself.
The goodness hidden inside has turned against you.
You are the master of evil.

In the forest, you reach an old abandoned temple, a sort of library. As you enter, you hear footsteps.
Several monks emerge from the shadows and surround you.
You quickly draw your sword and try to escape, but one of them blinds you with a powerful spell. Unable to see, you swing your sword wildly.
These monks guard their secrets well and are among the few who have devoted their entire lives to goodness and the struggle against evil. A pity they do so only within the grounds of their temple.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.monster.3: The God of Fire favoured the Mountains of Fire even before the invasion of the dead. He was more the sort of being who thirsted for power and just retribution. Yet his mighty hand can also fashion wondrous creatures. Thus the mighty Guardian of Fire arose from lava and sulfur.

If you have come looking for Dancon and are another of those hunters, you will meet the same end as many before you.
We will free the people from slavery and exploitation.
If you wish to enter Heaven and become a god, you must gain the power of the Four Elements.

Ha!
I will never submit to a wretch like you.

Only a god of heaven can defeat the Demon of Balance.
This creature guarded and bound Evil beyond the Gate of the Dead.
The Chosen One can obtain the Supreme One's Holy Grail as the only hope of restoring the old order.

Deep in the mountains, you find a dwarf guarding the river crossing.
You cannot agree to his demand for 5000 gold, and are forced to draw your weapons.
Thus you stain the waters of these rivers with the blood of their protectors.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.monster.4:
Martius too belonged to the White Mages. Yet he discovered how to evade the Last Judgement, and longed to become the mightiest of all.

You will never achieve what you are attempting.
Before you die, I will tell you what a mortal must do to cross the Lake of Justice, evade the Last Judgement and gain divine power.

As foretold at the birth of the Four, one day {He} will come to bring a new order to a realm torn by Darkness.
Only the Chosen One can cross the Lake and wield the forgotten power of the Supreme One.
Then he will be able to defeat any foe and give tomorrow a future.
If a mortal passes the Last Judgement, he must find the power of the Four. Only then can he be raised to godhood... Only a god can pass through the Gate of the Dead... Only {He} can defeat the Lord of Evil and gain the power of the Supreme One.

Your time has come.

You feel an evil unlike any you have known closing around you.
The true terror is yet to come.

The creature's roar knocks you to the ground.
You tremble all over, your body frozen in wonder, while looking into the eyes of this marvel sends a chill down your spine.
This is no longer about proving your courage.
Now you are fighting for your life against the lord of dragons.

A mortal can never withstand the power of lightning.
Wretched little human, you are far too weak to face me as an equal.
Let your death be a warning to fools like you.

This looks like a lovely place, full of flowers, birds, trees...
Trees?
AAAH! Those trees have started moving and are coming straight towards you!

The elves cannot defend themselves alone.
The undead advance is gathering speed.
Will you help them, or merely watch their destruction?
You may be their only hope.

You see a dwarf running towards you.
(It is a rather comical sight, since a dwarf's run is about as fast as an ordinary human's walk.)

He is shouting something about an invasion of the dead and the destruction of the elves.
And that flight is the only way to survive.

The Last Judgement remembers your deeds.
No sin goes unpunished.
The malice within you turns against you.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.monster.5:
The armies of evil were led by this general, who faced Samuel in battle.
Though the Order of Light was defeated, the supreme commander is so weakened that he has not yet been able to engulf the Wastelands as his next conquest.

Their town was burned and everyone killed.
Many can no longer recognise friends and have no faith in rescue.
Thank you for your help. I could not have done it alone.
A skeleton almost killed another defenceless person. Your swift intervention saved the unfortunate soul from death.

This hunter is said to hunt dragons here.
Apparently not everyone is troubled by the advance of Darkness, so he cares little what fate awaits him.
He will therefore gladly join your company.
This guard was forged from gold extracted from the nearby mine. The mine is inexhaustible, and so the guard is very strong. It belonged to the wizard Martius, who mysteriously disappeared.

A warrior who knows no fear is a formidable opponent.
Some say this trait is innate, while others believe the undead gain their heartlessness and malice through some mysterious trick.
Either way, they must be put to an end.

Please, help our town. Evil came suddenly and swiftly.
We tried to stand against it, but it was hopeless. There are thousands of them. They killed everyone. Protect me from them.

The devil was just about to strike the final blow when you shot an arrow into him.
He turned and charged at you with a roar.

You enter a crystal mine and see a dragon feasting on crystals.
It is so absorbed in its meal that it does not even notice you, and you manage to take a few pieces. You quickly creep towards the exit when a crystal suddenly falls from your hand. The noise disturbs the dragon, and it attacks you without hesitation.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.monster.6:
A pact sealed in blood gives me the right to this tribute.
Anyone who defies my will shall face terrible wrath. I shall put an end to the wretched Forest Folk.

I have heard of your heroism.
I will gladly join whoever bears the mark of the Lord of Titans.
You came just in time. My life now belongs to you.

Thank you for freeing us. We will gladly accompany you on your journey.
Welcome to our village, and make yourself at home.

You enter the Valley of the Dead.
The Black Rider guards this sacred place, where ancient rites intended to defeat the gods were supposedly once performed.
Perhaps you can deprive Evil of a powerful weapon by freeing this place.
Do come in; my shop is open. I think we can make a deal.

This is the part of Heaven where the gods kept various creatures for their own amusement.
Though you have passed the Last Judgement, you still lack divine power, and cannot command those who belonged to the Four.

These creatures can cast spells thanks to a power of crystals unknown to you.
Since their banishment, they have lived in isolation, but force their subjects to work for their own ends on pain of death.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.monster.7:
You see a poor man, one of the Forest Folk, chosen as a sacrifice to the Dragon dwelling in this cave.
The poor souls cannot pay their tribute in time, so he is willingly sacrificing himself for the others.
You can leave him to his fate, or help him and free them from this tyrant's rule.

Halt!
I must not let anyone through.
Though strong enough to cross these waters, the beast is trapped in the blue depths. Offer your help and save it from certain death.

This must be a trap.
I do not believe you have come to free us.
We are all going to die anyway, so let me give my life defending my family.

Though these majestic beasts radiate great resentment, they are still merely creatures that obey a sufficiently strong master.
Their former master paid the price for his own cruelty.

Respect their blood, and they will help you on your journey.
The gentleman surely has good taste and appreciates first-class goods.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.monster.8:
I have travelled a long way, all the way from the land of the barbarians.
I am glad to have escaped. Our entire expedition was slaughtered.
All the gold for Christian was stolen. Luckily, I hid some beneath my horse's saddle.
The ruler of the barbarians has gone completely mad. Evil has taken full control of him.

Please, find my family, held captive by a terrible dragon that forces them to pay a bloody tribute.
Tell them I am sending them all my savings.
Something attacked you from the tower.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.monster.9:
The commander tasked with crushing the Royal Army and taking control of this part of Signus.
Though the army was almost completely defeated, he still lacks the strength for any greater success.
Put an end to evil in your homeland.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.quest.1.4: May goodness guide you. Are you ready to continue doing good?
You tip the scales in Heaven's favour.
If you are ready, you may look the greatest of the titans in the eye.

Titans are very powerful beings, but prouder still. In their sense of superiority, they have cut themselves off completely from other creatures. 
To pass through the gate, you must gain the strength of a titan by defeating their ruler, who dwells somewhere beyond the frozen wastes.
Bring proof that you have broken the titans' pride.
Travellers can finally sleep peacefully again.

They say Dancon opposed the old customs and fought injustice and exploitation.
The common folk therefore did not greet the news of his death with much joy.
Yet you have fulfilled your task and may accept the promised reward.

The whole kingdom is plagued by a feared outlaw named Dancon.
Rumour has it that he is hiding in the marshes to the east.
Please, free this land from that villain.
Now more of the unclean may lose their lives.
Only brute strength is true combat.

Do you agree?

The barbarians have always hated magic, and since they had to endure Martius's presence, they often hunted down his servants.
If you bring them a few prisoners to execute, they will teach you to fight better.
Excellent! The people are finally safe.
Let their flame die until their master sits upon his throne once more.
The Guardians of Fire escaped from the God of Fire and now ravage the western lands. Find them and bring them back.
Do you wish to undergo a ritual that will reveal the essence of Earth to you?

Then lay down your offering and be initiated into the secrets of divine magic.

This is the altar of the God of Earth.
People come here to ask for salvation and blessings.
Bring gifts and learn the secrets of birth and death.
Your offering is unworthy of the God of Earth.

You have found the lost son.
The traditions to which this family clings seem incomprehensible.
They willingly choose death over a life of shame.

Are you willing to tell them that you fulfilled their request and freed both the family and their son from suffering?
In gratitude, they will give you a spell for banishing evil.

The family living in this hut sent their son to the Royal Army in the hope of honour and recognition, as had been the custom for generations.
That long tradition was broken when the dead utterly defeated most of the warriors.
The family is forced to live in shame.
Try to atone for the failure of one of its members.
Better to die with honour than remain defeated.

You have managed to approach the strength of the giant who lived here. Now you may enter the sacred place.
But are you truly sure you wish to do so?

You approach the dwelling of the giant Gladrusion.
He is not at home just now, and your efforts to open the door may prove fruitless.
Giants possess tremendous strength, often beyond human capabilities.

Only a truly strong being may enter.
You are not strong enough to overcome the lock.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.quest.2.2:
Though Signus has long been without a king, the people still believe someone will come to free this land.
A small company of royal soldiers has pledged loyalty to you for returning the crown jewels.
Are you willing to accept their oath?
Return the crown jewels stolen by Dancon here, and the king will reward you.
Martius spent several days engrossed in his work in his tower.
Though he has never submitted to any authority, he is so grateful to you for rescuing him that he promised to find the secret of immortality for you.
Despite his tremendous efforts, he has failed again...

Dejected by his failure, he tries to repay you in some small way and make up for the promise he gave you.
He offers you the creature that has so far been his only companion in eternity.
Are you willing to accept such a substitute?

This is Martius's sacrificial altar.
Martius once strove tirelessly to find a way to gain immortality, but his efforts never succeeded.
So when he was to surrender his magical powers to the Four, eternal life was his only condition.
In the end, he obtained what he desired.
He has not continued his research since then.
He did discover, however, that he needed to find the horn of an immortal creature. No such beasts live in these parts, which is why Martius never succeeded in his research.
Yet his abilities allow him to overcome any distance and travel through both space and time.
Try to uncover the secret of immortality with Martius's help, and find the beast he seeks.
Though Martius has already gained the immortality he craved, he still owes you for freeing him from prison, and so he might at least help you.
Without sacrificing that miraculous creature, the research cannot succeed.
Ah yes, that is the right remedy. Please, help an old man and give it to me.
I do not want to die yet. If you cure me, I will teach you the art of combat.
Well, what is your decision?

I wanted to stand against evil, but I contracted a fatal disease and am dying. Please, find the Pendant of Life and cure me.
That is the only way you can help me. I have little time; hurry.

No medicine helps.
I have little time left.
You have freed these people.
Your father would be proud of you.

The enchanted fields are the source of the mysterious creatures' magical power.
The peasants have toiled for the tyrant since dawn, without hope of rescue.
Are you willing to help them?
As long as their master lives, no one can help them.
Could the prophecy be true, saying that a mortal will find a way to escape Darkness and be able to fight the armies of Evil?

You have achieved what no one before you could.
Are you willing to accept the spell Miracle of Perfect Destruction as a reward for your bravery?

Defeat the forces of Darkness and prove that you can stand against Evil. Then you will be worthy of wielding the Miracle of Perfect Destruction.
Bring proof of your clash with the Lord of Darkness, and you will command the forgotten might of an ancient power.
You cannot yet face true Evil.

Would you really give up your father's gift for a paltry sum of gold?!
Can his memory be measured in money?
Will you bury your father's traditions and legacy within you???

The history of this temple is unknown, as is its dedication.
Besides their daily prayers, the monks were also skilled craftsmen. It is even said that they made several weapons for the Royal Army itself, which used them in the clash of the Armies.
Today, however, the old traditions are quickly fading, as are the last honest people. Where a renowned smithy once stood, there is now only a half-empty shop selling old, used weapons.

The shopkeeper offers you a rather ridiculous price for your weapons.
The most important is a precious bow. It is precious not for its effects, but because it belonged to your father and was passed down through many generations. Your father gave it to you in the hope of raising you as a warrior, to remind you of him and the ideals he held. Today it is the only thing he left you.
The merchant is not very fussy. He is willing to take two worthless weapons from you for an almost laughable price. You have nothing else, and he cannot afford anything better.
Will you sacrifice your good past?
Do you wish to deny the powers that blessed you and embrace the true faith?
Only malice and anger can face the enemy and lead you to victory. Honour is for weaklings.
Has your soul accepted such a fate?

Rid yourself of all goodness; your soul has always belonged to Hell.
How many innocents have fallen along your path, how many times have you decided matters of life and death, how many families have you robbed of their fathers...
Goodness and the values it upholds are no longer part of your being. The Last Judgement will cleanse you of your burden.
Rid yourself of the Order of Light. Rid yourself of those who would otherwise remain a scar upon your life forever.
Do not hesitate. Show that you can sacrifice and suppress the good within you.
The Lord of Evil is defeated.
Only the Chosen One may gain the power of the Supreme One.

Do you truly believe YOU are the one?

This is the place at the centre of the World, sealed by the Supreme One's power to protect Signus from hidden Evil.
The balance of the Four has been broken, and the Holy Grail remains without the divine power of the Chosen One.
The tremendous strength of the Lord of Evil, in the form of the Helm of Power, bars the way through the Gate of the Dead.
Only {He} can put an end to all Evil once and for all.
The Lord of Evil will not allow you to cross this place.
You have fulfilled the legend.
You have freed Signus.
You will become the Supreme One.
Will you accept your destiny?
Use your divine power. If you truly are {HE}, you will pass through the Gates of Balance.
You cannot take the final step.
The Last Judgement sees into your soul.
It is blackened by the deeds you have committed.
You have freed the Four.
Become one of them.
Free the power of the Four and become a god.
No one can become a god without the artifacts Tome of Fire Magic, Tome of Air Magic, Tome of Water Magic and Tome of Earth Magic.

To be a murderer.
To be a traitor.
To be a tyrant.

...to become EVIL and turn towards evil.
The infernal hordes follow you, and you resemble those who are your enemies.

Reveal your heart, and whether darkness has already engulfed it.
Murdering innocents is but a step towards ruin.

Do you truly wish to become one whose deeds are worthy of you?
I am glad to hear that justice still exists in this world. So let the common folk breathe, and go in peace.
The Last Judgement sees into your soul.
Your heart belongs to good.
We have heard that you succeeded. The Lord of Darkness is finally dead. The elves will be indebted to you for saving them from destruction.
They offer you their finest archers. Will you accept them as a token of gratitude?

The elves beg for your help.
As you have already noticed, their lands have been invaded by the Army of the Dead. They cannot defeat it alone, and so they need you.
In the land of swamps lies a stronghold of evil. It is called the Tower of Souls and is ruled by the Lord of Darkness, their supreme leader.
If you kill him, evil will be defeated and the elves saved.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.quest.5.3:
Freedom and free will are values that stand in the way of exploitation and tyranny.
Are you truly willing to give up this symbol?

Dragons were once beings bound by a god's power.
Today, with freedom reigning in their ranks, no one can subjugate them.
The dragons still remember the days when Mutare's cruel hand led her to her own destruction. Try to find the symbol of draconic strength, boundless freedom and faith in one's own destiny.
The scar Mutare left is still deep.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.quest.5.4:
Does evil truly rule your heart?
If so, this is the right side.
You tip the scales in Hell's favour.
You should survive the journey across the desert if you extinguish the radiance of the eternal flame that divides the worlds.
Are you sure you can do it?

This gate protects all heroes from the desert of death, where an old legend says a nation of barbarians lives. They show no mercy to anyone or anything that enters their territory.
Only someone strong enough to survive this blazing hell can succeed.
The eternal flame bars the way of these brave souls.
I am sorry, but your strength is insufficient.
You remained faithful to the end. Your father lives here within you, just as you have always carried him in your heart. You preserved his memory and thus embraced the values that granted him eternal peace.

May goodness guide your steps through Heaven.

Here, where your soul has come to rest in Heaven itself, you have passed the Last Judgement. It revealed that you never truly stopped believing in goodness, ideals and the legacy your father left you. Prove that you are as pure as he always remained, and honour his memory. May you meet again in eternity after death.

Only empty words remain of what your father taught you.
You sold him out, along with everything he believed in. Your life will not end in eternal peace.
You found it after all! Please, be so kind as to return it to me. I will give you anything you want.
Will you accept my valuable advice?

Now I can die content.

Welcome, Nestor. I have heard of your quest. I too was once a brave warrior. But I have grown old and no longer have the strength to fight. The memory of battling Evil wakes me every night.
My only wish is to die with a sword in my hand. The sword with which I cut off the Lord of Darkness's hand.
The sword will probably never be found.

You defied domination and exploitation, stopped great bloodshed and freed the Forest Folk. Your courage has earned you their alliance.
Everyone is delighted and warmly invites you to their settlement.
Will you accept their invitation?

A terrible Dragon lives in his cave, and the Forest Folk have made a pact with him. They pledged to pay a bloody tribute in exchange for his protection.

But who will protect these poor souls from the terrible wrath of their exploiter?
If you cannot obtain meat for the Dragon, please leave our lands.
Yes, you have found his spells. Are you ready to tame these creatures?

The cave before you is locked by Martius's spell.
You must possess his magical abilities to reach his enchanted creatures.

I thirst for blood. Let the sacrifice sink ever deeper into darkness, an offering of eternal life in exchange for a simple life.
Here may your soul remain alive forever, and your heart as black as the sky above Skull Island.

Will you take the path of death???

Where fear embraces darkness, where dawn erases hope and death suppresses life, you may bring me a human sacrifice. I will give you the SECRET OF LIFE.

Find that which will sprinkle my brow with blood, and a mighty sacrifice, leaving 700 families without fathers.

Darkness binds my heart, and it craves the blood of helpless humans.
Let 700 hearts cry out in anguish, and let crimson dew stain the snow.

You have defeated him; you are the lord of dragons.
Do you wish to enter?

Not just anyone may enter this town.
Whoever dares must first defeat an azure dragon, the mightiest being in Signus. If you succeed, you will gain immense strength. If you fail, you will die…
The azure dragon's strength exceeds yours, so you cannot enter.

By defeating the dragon and displaying its hide, you have ended this village's suffering.
Everyone welcomes you. You are their liberator.
Do you wish to enter?
The Forest Folk, tormented by the terrible Dragon, are protected by his strength, yet unprotected from the Dragon himself
Do you truly wish to sacrifice what may be the only force of good in Signus to Evil?

Even among mortal humans there are worshippers of evil.
They believe in redemption and a better life.
Perhaps they should rest forever in the prison of souls.

They seek to crush the last remaining warriors of the Order of Light.
They demand a sacrifice for the Lord of Evil.
You have shielded yourself with the Dead Statue, an artifact said to suppress all fear, but also all compassion and restraint.
Do you wish to use it as protection against Darkness?

With every defeated enemy, a mortal soul is condemned to wander the Graveyard of Souls forever.
To reach this prison, you must have the courage to enter the darkness.
You cannot face such a curse.

Do you truly wish to sell your soul this way and sacrifice that majestic beast?
Must the dragon's mark, the mark of boundless freedom, really be obtained in such a manner?

Through a mysterious ritual, the power of darkness can raise a sacrifice to the Lord of Evil.
Anyone who duly honours his grace will be rewarded with a mark of their gift, a worthy symbol.
The Lord of Evil cannot accept such a display of your devotion.
You meet the requirements to pass.

This gate separates good from evil.
Terron created it back in the time of the struggle of the Four Elements.
To open it, you must possess the Power of Lightning, have the blessing of the Order of Light and become an exceptional warrior.
Terron still holds Evil bound beyond the gate.
Excellent!
You may pass. Do you truly wish to do so?
You must bring a sacrifice of 6 Giants, or you will go no further.
Your sacrifice is not enough for me.
Yes, Nestor, I knew it was truly you.

This bow belonged to the man who saved her husband. No one now doubts your origins.
This woman and her family hold your father in the highest esteem. Weeping, the old woman begs you for the bow. She wants to preserve the memory of the two dearest men in her life: her husband and your father...
She is willing to give you anything in exchange for this object, sacred to her. 
The most valuable is a beautiful sword forged by a god himself.

Do you wish to trade the bow, your father's gift and symbol, for this mighty weapon?

Though you feel that the old woman deceived you at first, you stop at her hut and ask for lodging for your company.

Taken aback by your interest, the old woman first mutters something reluctantly, then fixes you with a long, piercing stare.
Suddenly, a tear glistens in her eye, and she falls at your feet.
You stand there bewildered.

Weeping, the old woman tells you about a man and says she recognises his young son Nestor in you. She says she was the wife of a man whom your father did not hesitate to save from the forces of Evil. He gave his life so that her husband, his best friend, could live. She also tells you how they had to leave for these inhospitable lands, and how they still remember your father's deeds and bravery...
(Though the details fit what you are hearing, you feel a little uncertain. After all, she has lived here alone for years and is slightly confused.)

When you ask whether she is certain of what she says, she asks you for proof that could unquestionably belong only to the son of the man she speaks of. And so she asks for your father's legendary bow.
The resemblance is undeniable. But unless you prove that you truly are Nestor by showing your father's bow, the old woman will cease to believe it and send you away.
You have fooled the ancient portal by posing as a nobleman.
If you are certain you wish to continue this way, nothing stands in your path.

Some customs endure to this day.
The local portals could only be used by people of high rank, chiefly nobles and kings.
This privilege is apparently denied to you until you prove your noble blood.
Sometimes a good pedigree pays off.
The Forest Folk will share their most precious treasure with you: the Bow of Eternal Accuracy.
Only with a warrior's courage may you take our treasure.
Fear of death prevents you from going further.

Money makes the world go round these days. I offer you pure gold.
Will you accept my price?
In my shop, I will pay you the best price for a great azure dragon.

What are you waiting for?
Make up your mind.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.quest.7.6:
You have proved worthy of your name.
You are welcome as a mighty ruler of dragons.
Only a true dragon king may enter the sacred lands.
No one may pass without the Vial of Dragon Blood artifact.
Wonderful, I am tired of mine.
An excellent trade!

Oh, good fellow, trade me your Dragon.
That beast of mine is fit for little more than dinner.
(The thought of eating dragons turns your stomach.)

The marks the dragons bore engraved deep within their hearts open the gates to unknown power. You are invited to enter and take responsibility for the fate of these beasts, which no one has yet tamed.
Are you different, and willing to see the truth rather than your own fear?

The days when Mutare's power bound the tremendous strength of a dragon have long passed.
Rage and cruelty became the tools for ruling these creatures. The day the last of them broke free from the tyrant's dominion marked a new age that granted freedom to the mighty...
They say nothing in this world can ever again force another's will upon the dreaded dragons.
Once, only a god could do such a thing. Yet the reign of the gods is long past...
Today, a legend remains that dragons carry the marks of their lineage within them, marks that shape mortals' destinies and allow them to see the fire in their eyes once more.
The days of old are gone forever, and no one believes in the Marks of the Dragons any more.

Thank you, dragon hunter; this hide is just right.
Here is your sword. Does it suit you?

Hear my offer.
I have a fine sword for you, but I need dragon hide for new sandals.
You are making a wise choice. These dragons are mightier. Do you want to take them with you?

Welcome to my home, stranger.
Do not listen to the others; give that precious beast to me. I have my newest slave here for you.
He is a little stupid, but excellent at guarding, and in a fit of rage he can be used for digging.
Come on, give it to me.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.quest.8.2:
You again?
I told you to... Wait, that ring belongs to Sir Christian!
In that case, you may pass, and you are our guest.

Welcome to the town of Pagan.
Unfortunately, Christian is not here; he has gone hunting, and the guards cannot let you into the castle without his permission.
They will not let you pass.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.quest.8.5:
Are you willing to side with Dancon, the man who chose to rise against the rule of the rich?
Do you wish to place the crown jewels, the symbol of royal authority, in the hands of these outcasts?
If so, accept this ring as a sign of a better world. Stand with the oppressed and exploited, and make room for the power of freedom.

Dancon, an outlaw and murderer reviled by many, defied the power of the lords and stood for a fairer world. He chose to fight the injustices inflicted upon ordinary people.
The royal lords disapproved of this once-famous knight's attitude, and after he stole the crown jewels from the royal treasury, they put a price on his head.
Stand on the side of justice, find Dancon and bring here the symbol of the power of the tyrants who exploit the poor people of this land.
The outlaw camp still awaits the arrival of its only master.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.11.5: Site of the Royal Army's battle with the undead
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.14.3:
The mighty God of Fire was imprisoned here.
But a Guardian stands in your way.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.19.6: You are entering Sir Christian's free kingdom.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.25.6:
West – village of Sighatria
East – capital of Griffins
South – Tarenis Mountains
North – Wasteland
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.32.5: You are in unknown lands that evil has not yet entirely engulfed.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.44.2:
The mighty God of Air was imprisoned here.
But a Guardian stands in your way.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.62.1:
The mighty God of Earth was imprisoned here.
But a Guardian stands in your way.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.64.3:
Graveyard of Souls
Place of eternal damnation.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.66.5:
Marshes
Hideout of the thief Dancon
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.67.1: Welcome to the Valley of the Dead.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.68.1: Rampart, once a frontier guard province.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.68.6: You will not escape the azure dragon's vengeance.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.70.4: Once filled with some sort of liquor, this bottle is now nothing more than rubbish in the blue ocean depths.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.70.5: A harbour from which no ships have sailed for a long time. No one has crossed the frozen wastes.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.sign.71.3:
The mighty God of Water was imprisoned here.
But a Guardian stands in your way.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.town.10.2:
Survivors of the great royal army's destruction are coming to your castle.
They are still willing to serve a new master.
Christian is trying to restore his lost standing and orders repairs to his old fortress.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.town.44.5:
A thick cloud covers the sky, and a piercing beam of white light shines over the entire town.
The last warriors of the Order of Light descend from the heavens and help you on a path that may bring freedom to this once-mightiest order, which served the gods themselves.

Good is on your side, good has not yet perished; may goodness guide you.
The last warriors of the Order of Light who have not yet succumbed to evil have come down from the heavens.

Terron, the mighty god of the underworld, tried to defeat Evil alone.
He failed.
He was imprisoned on Skull Island. Darkness had once again broken an obstacle on its path to complete dominion over Signus.
Though Terron is a mighty warrior, his efforts amounted to nothing.
It seemed he would end like the other gods.

With a forbidden spell, he opened the underworld within his prison to merge with the power of Earth. This saved him from eternal damnation.
As the legend says, no god can withstand Evil alone.

Terron is beginning to believe in you. He believes that only a mortal soul has enough freedom to pass through the Gate of the Dead.
The souls of departed heroes, the souls of the underworld, those who never stood before the Last Judgement, are coming to help you restore the glory of Signus.

More and more wretched souls are coming to your town, people who, like you, tried to flee the destruction. Yet unrest in the town is growing, so you have set aside funds to resettle these people in the forests indefinitely.

Light shines upon your castle once more, and the greatest warrior of the Order of Light descends from the heavens.
Through your deeds, you have brought a little hope to all who refuse to abandon their struggle against the enemy.
The Order of Light helps you build the Portal of Glory.

You have found Martius's spellbooks.
You are learning to cast spells.

Ruins, ashes, emptiness... That is all that remains of the glorious capital.

Your hope of finding temporary shelter before leaving to save your own life is slowly fading.
It seems you will have to find the means to rebuild part of it, or you will not survive long.

Together with your friends, you try to repair the most important buildings.
There is still much work to be done.

Suddenly, your castle shakes, and several buildings rise from the ground.
The underworld sends you more help.
Terron, mighty god of the underworld, sends you legions of dead slaves to help you build a fortress to defend against the enemy.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.town.53.5:
The Forest Folk are grateful for your help. Their lands are free once more.
Everyone is now working to rebuild the town, and they have managed to repair some of the buildings destroyed by Evil.
The restored town attracts warriors who have long hidden in the forests, waiting for liberation.
The industrious elves continue to rebuild their town.
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.town.60.4:
By occupying the {Black} {Fortress}, you must now face its terrible threat.
The Lord of Evil has cursed this place.
May the soul of the mortal who sets foot here be damned forever. May life turn to dust, and may the destruction unleashed endure for 6 years, burying beneath dark earth every attempt to resist the power of Darkness.
I curse this place! Let 6 plagues engulf everything, and let death come with the dark servant...

The doom the Lord of Evil has brought upon you is terrible.
Disasters have tormented you for 5 years now.
You cannot recover from the horror.
You await the final year. Until now, death has always come on the very same day and exacted a cruel toll.
But today is different.
Could this be the end of the suffering your recklessness earned you?
I curse this place! Let destruction consume all living things, and let death come with the dark servant…
I curse this place! Let destruction consume all living things, and let death come with the dark servant…
I curse this place! Let destruction consume all living things, and let death come with the dark servant…
I curse this place! Let destruction consume all living things, and let death come with the dark servant…
map.[ab] - sila styroch zivlov.town.9.66:
The titans have finally recognised you as their master.
Though their legendary pride prevents complete devotion, your deeds have earned their great respect. Like everyone else, they too struggle to survive Evil's onslaught.

May lightning be a shining light on the path through darkness, a spark of hope born of faith in a swift victory.
Do not underestimate the power of the titans!

You have found Martius's spellbooks.
You are learning to cast spells.
map.[ab] - strasny den v mokrinach.event:
{A Terrible Day in the Marshes

This map really can be won... But I will not tell you how, because it is a competition of sorts. It was originally meant to be unveiled at a gathering of Heroes of Might and Magic fans, but since I did not finish it in time (work on the campaign, laziness, and so on), I am releasing it now...

map.[ab] - svatá zeme.event.0.descriptio:
You, King Christian, address your people.
“We, the faithful, discovered this place, this sacred land, as we fled demons, undead and goblins. Even our greatest allies, the elves, let power corrupt them and drove us here. We have been able to stay here until now, but the air keeps growing thinner, and we have discovered a new threat: underground monsters that will stop at nothing. We have little time left. Wherever there is life, there is also destruction, and we must face it. We shall muster our troops and confront our destiny!”
map.[ab] - svatá zeme.guards.22.71.1.mes: You have discovered an incredible secret: what was there at the beginning of the world, and what will be there at its end!
map.[ab] - svatá zeme.guards.32.30.0.mes: This used to be the land of the elves, protected by mountains. The only way in was through this guarded pass. Now, however, I see that nothing but dust remains of their land. They paid the price for allying themselves with demons and the undead.
map.[ab] - svatá zeme.guards.32.41.0.mes: It looks as though someone dug here and found what they sought. They did not enjoy it for long, though. You reach for the treasure, and griffins swoop down upon you from the sky.
map.[ab] - svatá zeme.guards.38.61.0.mes: This used to be our capital. It appears to be occupied by our enemies.
map.[ab] - svatá zeme.guards.59.45.0.mes: This used to be a fortress where wood was stored. This region produced the most timber.
map.[ab] - svatá zeme.guards.65.67.0.mes: Outside again, back in the world beneath the sun and sky, home again!
map.[ab] - svatá zeme.guards.7.36.0.mess: “Kel rak haluman i dál so!” comes a voice from the volcano, and your priest says, “The demon is coming.”
map.[ab] - svatá zeme.guards.7.47.1.mess: You have entered the Valley of Salvation, from which you came. Back then, however, minotaurs did not guard it, and the place was full of life. Now, apart from the minotaurs, there is not a single living creature here.
map.[ab] - svatá zeme.header.description: The greatest war in history engulfed all the races and peoples who lived in the beautiful world of Aladion. All but the humans were corrupted by power. map.[ab] - svatá zeme.monster.56.69.1.me: We are the guardians of that which must not be revealed.
