When King Roland and his wife, Queen Catherine Ironfist, won the war against the necromancers of Deyja 10 years ago and united humans and elves, there were great celebrations. Yet Roland's brother Archibald was forgotten, and he immediately seized the opportunity to flee straight to the necromancers. Here, after 10 years, when everyone already believed him dead, he has taken command of the necromancers. Now he intends to lead them in repaying his brother and all Erathia for everything he has suffered......

Let us take a quick tour of the dark path in Might and Magic 7.
After winning Lord Markham's contest (very easy), you reach the territory of Harmondale, with its castle of the same name. From this point on, it is your new home. After Judge Grey dies (about 3 months of game time), as a messenger will tell you, your destination is Deyja, specifically the inn "The Snobish Goblin", where you will find Judge Sleen. Take him to the judge's house near your castle. You are now on the side of darkness. You can also enter the Pit, where you receive the initiation quest, the Trial of Darkness: make your way through the Breeding Zone (quite hard at the start). Once you complete it, you receive 3 more quests: bring the soul jars from Thunderfist Mountain; bring pieces of altars from the temples of light and darkness; and deactivate the shield in Clanker's Laboratory in the Tularean Forest. When you complete these too, Tolberti tasks you with killing his light counterpart, Robert the Wise, who is in Celeste. Afterwards, at Castle Gloaming, you receive a quest to kill the devils' leader, Xenofex, who is in the Land of the Giants, a long journey away. Once you have done that too, it is time for the finale: bring back the Oscillation Overthruster from the crashed ship of the "Ancients", who came to Earth in the Time of Wonders. The ship is underwater. So off you go to the Shoals in Avlee. Then take the Overthruster back to Castle Gloaming, and you reach the ending and its cinematic (not much to look at; the light ending is prettier). Phew.
map.[ab] - vzestup ríše nemrtvých.guards: “You made it this far? Incredible! Now only one task remains: destroy Celeste, the city of good. This city is still causing trouble for the necromancers and is a thorn in their side (they have no eyes anyway). You will now receive the spell Fly in your spellbook! Fly over these small mountains and conquer Celeste!”
The Sword of Judgement! A rare artifact!

When you saw Celeste in the distance, you wondered what might be going through your warriors' minds, so you used mind magic (never mind that it does not exist here). You began probing your warriors' minds at random:
"Did I feed the pigs?"
"Where am I?"
"This is going to be another bloodbath!"
"A4, B2, C6" - they are playing Battleships
"What is a bulldozer?"
"When I was alive, was I a man or a woman?"
"2+2=20"
"Do we have brain-eaters in our heads too?"
After a while you gave up. Clearly, your army is ready for anything. You decided to move on.
You have just noticed that taking the enemy's mines will be no easy task, since every approach is guarded. You will have to be careful about how you obtain this key!
Suddenly, as if they had fallen from the sky, behemoths appeared. They looked as though they wanted to have you for lunch. They were just unhappy that necromancers are all bone and no meat.
Everything suggests that this is the territory of the necromantic clan that sided with good. Is that even possible? /They probably promised them a lollipop./

As you sail past the cliffs, you suddenly notice several enormous behemoths. You are already drawing your weapons, but they seem uninterested in fighting you and offer you their services. Will you accept them?
You can sail to the Shoals from here!

Inn:
{The Snobish Goblin
In the wars of old, when many different legions fought in Erathia, this artifact, the Head of Legion, was assembled. It was created in memory of the heroes of that age.
I always wanted a volcano like that at home....
"Want to take a shortcut to the enemy? Then you will probably have to find several Keymasters' Tents!"

Suddenly, you heard a terrible scream. 
"What is happening?" you thought.
Then you saw a goblin falling from a cliff. Two warriors commented:
"Maybe those sharp rocks will stop him..."
Boom, crash.... 
"Apparently not..."
And at that moment, you had company!
You were surely thinking I would not put a guard in this tunnel. Wrong; of course there is one! And they are Nomads, hardy wanderers.

"Welcome to the world of Might and Magic, King Archibald Ironfist! All your subjects place their hopes in you. After the wars over the heavenly sword, "Angelic Alliance", the necromantic kingdom fell apart completely. There is even a nation that serves good. But your troops will be better, much better. Everything living deserves to be DESTROYED!" said a representative of the necromancers who serve you.
"Seek, and you SHALL FIND!"

"Your Majesty!!" came a sudden voice from somewhere in the bushes.
"Yes?" you asked suspiciously.
"I do not know whether word has reached you, but a little to the south is an enemy necromancer who swore to aid King Roland after your defeat ten years ago. It was a crushing defeat, but this commander has an army you certainly cannot match. So search: there is help somewhere around the castle, but unfortunately I no longer know exactly where," came the voice from the bushes again.
"It is Kastore, the one who long ago wished to rule darkness, but was rejected by you, and has now turned against you!"
The Shield of the Dwarven Lords is standard equipment for any warrior. It may be an ordinary shield, but something is better than nothing.
"Leave that alone!"

Suddenly, you spotted several liches by the water and asked:
"What are you doing there?"
"Oh, just doing the laundry so we can show our whites to the whole world!"
"Right, let's get out of here; they have all gone mad!" you exclaimed.
Castle Lambent!
The Centaur's Axe is standard equipment too. It is better to hold one than an ordinary stick, for instance.
Your only worry here in the Shoals is that none of your undead army can swim, so you hope you will not sink.
{The right way!
Avlee, home of the elves, has also come under the rule of light, so it must be delivered into the clutches of darkness!
The moment you stepped here, a large band of nomads set upon you, looking anything but friendly.
"Welcome, King Archibald! We now ask whether we may join you. You alone are our inspiration, not your light counterpart Roland!"
Castle Gryphonheart, Catherine Ironfist's seat, is in sight!
You are sailing into a bay where many humans fell during the wars between elves and humans. As a necromancer, you immediately recruit new warriors from among the fallen...

"The Golden Bow, the finest weapon ever made for shooting enemies, has unfortunately now fallen into your hands. Your intentions towards this world are far from pure, so we do not know whether to give it to you! But your numbers are overwhelming, and we do not wish to become undead members of your army, so we will now hand it over, very reluctantly," say the elven veterans who hold this bow.
The fabled Sword of Doom lies at your feet! Are you willing to give it up? It would be a disgrace for a necromancer to do so, though, so take it and go destroy Roland and Celeste!
Castle Gryphonheart is the stronghold of the human realm, led by Catherine Ironfist. Do you dare enter the castle?
You have been ambushed by a large band of Fire Elementals!

Suddenly, you noticed a group of skeletons walking somewhere. "Where are you going?" you asked them.
"To the cinema!" they replied.
"Huh? Where?"
"Well, that is what we call the puppet theatre."
"Interesting. What is playing?" you asked again.
"How a Skeleton Found His Wits!" they replied.
You thought better of asking more. This really will be interesting: 10 years without war, and all Erathia has gone mad! Where would that skeleton put his wits?
Castle Gryphonheart, Catherine Ironfist's seat, is in sight!
"The Vial of Dragon Blood has been stolen again. Take it now and return it to those who will hide it somewhere deep in the centre of the Earth!"

"I just had a flash of inspiration!" says one of the liches in your army.
"How could you tell?" you asked.
"Lightning struck me..."
Are you certain this gate will take you anywhere? Yes, to the end of this map, but the decisive battle that will settle everything still awaits you!

As you slowly approach the depths of Erathia, you begin to realise, at least a little, what you are actually doing. 
Your good side says:
"Do not do it; you are of the same blood! Just like them!"
Your bad side says:
"Did you bring enough weapons?"
So what will you do now? Go back, or go on? Decide which feels right to you!

"In these parts, once the territory of Deyja, neutral lands spread after good's victory in Erathia. They were occupied by troops from the legendary castle Conflux. As a true follower of darkness, you surely will not leave it in the hands of good, will you?"

"Now, un-mortal, answer these 5 questions!"
"Have you harmed my people and decided to destroy this place?"
"Of course!" you replied.
When the talking tree heard this, it took to its roots and fled.
/That was the first question from Shadows over Riva./
This is Riverstride Fortress!
map.[ab] - vzestup ríše nemrtvých.header: A sequel to the map {Shadows over Celeste}. This time, as Archibald, you set out on a long journey to destroy the human world!
map.[ab] - vzestup ríše nemrtvých.heroes: Tolberti is the dark counterpart of Robert the Wise from Celeste. This time he sets out alongside his master Archibald on a campaign against good.

Archibald Ironfist, the black sheep of the family. He never liked honourable conduct, and had been drawn to dark magic since childhood. One day he reached the necromancers' strongholds, but instead of slaughtering them, he joined them. Ever since, he has been forbidden to return home to Erathia on pain of death. His brother Roland took this hard, but eventually came to terms with it. And so Archibald stands against his living former subjects.....
map.[ab] - vzestup ríše nemrtvých.monste: "Your brother defeated us ten years ago, so do not think we will give way to you!"
"Who is bothering us now? Well, look, Archibald! You have some nerve, King! Show us what you can do!"

"So you are the ones who serve darkness?" you asked.
"Yeah, that is us. So what?"
"I have come to destroy you!"
"What? But you are on our side?!"
"True, but if I want to reach Celeste, that den of goodness, I have to kill you!"
"Then let us see what you have inside you, apart from nothing!"
Yes, these are warriors created by the blackest spells of the underworld.
These dragons told you they must not let you through without a fight. But your leader had better not enter, or he will never return. It all depends on whether you listened!
Here are our old friends from the Shoals, the Water Elementals; in this case, their upgraded version, Ice Elementals. They guard a very valuable artifact here.
All your undead warriors burst into laughter until their bones rattled. But never underestimate your enemy! Even these peasants are no pushovers when there are enough of them!
I cannot resist putting myself here too....

"Welcome, stranger from the land of hell and darkness. What are you looking for here?"
"I have come to kill you!" you replied.
"You certainly are confident. What have you brought against us, a bucket of water?"
"No, I have brought my enormous army, which knows no mercy. They are the finest necromancers!"
"But we burn the likes of them to ashes every day, just as they deserve!"
"There has been no law in this land since you poked your snout outside! I am the law here! Even darkness will not stop me!" say the azure dragons.
"I am a little troll, in my little house of bone. Please take me along!"
"Uaaaaaaa grrrrr!" A truly fitting speech from these dragons.

These phoenixes have one concern:
"How can you tell our males from our females?" they asked you.
"I do not know; I am no zoologist, more of a necrologist. Now, if you wanted cremating, I could help you!" you replied.
"That could happen to you!"
"As a servant of darkness, you do not deserve our favour! We are honourable angels of Celeste! You are the filth of these lands!"
"Bravo, our scouts have already brought us the ashes of those phoenixes (damn, they are fast, you thought), so the passage is now open to you!"

"There is a beach nearby. Hire a ship there and sail to one of the mysterious islands. A band of phoenixes lives there and needs to be killed. That is your task now, so get on with it!" said the human guard of this tower.
"No, the phoenixes are still alive. You are going nowhere!"
"Bravo, give it to us now. We will take it away and destroy it!"

Several zombies in this tower surprised you by demanding the "Sword of Judgement" and saying:
"Something as loathsome as the "Sword of Judgement" has no place in this world. Its very existence weakens necromancers. So go and bring it to us now! We will see to it that it is taken to the necromancers' seat at Castle Gloaming, where it will be destroyed!"
"Bring that sword! So we can grow stronger still! This concerns you too, you know! Get moving!"
"Bravo, we are now at your service! And we will clear the passage for you at once!"

"O mighty King Archibald! We are the surviving kin of soldiers who long ago fought in the legions defending Erathia. We need all the artifacts from that time. But we still lack the Head of Legion. If you bring it to us, we will stand at your side, and the passage will be open."
"You have failed us. We will never have all these artifacts. Go away!"
"The passage is now open to you!"
"We need 200 Halflings. Bring them to us, and the passage will be open!"
"Until you bring them, you are going nowhere!"
"So, will you give away 15 of them or not?"
If you are willing to hand over 15 Ghost Dragons, this is your chance.
Of course, if you do not have them, you cannot give away very much.
The necromancers are greatly relieved; the titans will now leave them alone.

The titans from the fortress near Avlee (which no longer exists, having been sacked) have had their magnificent sword stolen again. Return it to them now! Even necromancers do not want titans for enemies! /As big as they are dim, huge heads and tiny brains. = titans, for letting someone take that sword/
The titans are starting to rebel. Hurry!
Reluctantly, the mages let you through as promised.

"Welcome! From what we can see, you are not on the side of good!" says one of the mages in the tower.
"You see correctly. I will NEVER be on the side of good. Remember that!" you replied.
"But our magic is stronger than yours. We are mages from the Bracada Desert, which you intend to destroy!"
"You know what? Leave me alone and open that tower!"
"Watch it! Do not take that tone with us, or we will summon so many elementals to our side that you will never defeat them! But we will give you a chance to pass. Bring us the Golden Bow!"
"If you were King Roland, we would let you through, but you had better run along and fetch that bow!"
"About time! Could you not have done that straight away?"
"You still have not killed your enemy?"
"Things are looking rather bad for you, King Archibald!"
"Bravo, now take what I have been keeping here for you!"
"Welcome, King Archibald. I can give you something that will help you greatly, but only if you reach an Attack of 20!"
"Was I not clear enough?"
It was a reunion as though after 100 years apart. You gaped in amazement at how much joy finding a lost friend could bring. Necromancers simply can never feel such joy.
There were 3 trolls living in this tower, but one was kidnapped. If you bring him back, the trolls will leave the tower.
Until you find their lost companion, they will not leave!
"Yes, we have already heard they were defeated. Enter now. And may all the saints preserve us!"

The mages in this tower are dismayed that you, Archibald, have made it all the way here to Celeste. But they have no choice; they must let you pass. You must also do a little service for the light, however: a group of Enchanters nearby serves darkness. Kill them, and the way will be clear!
Until you kill them, you are going nowhere!
"Well, there we are. Take your reward!"

Somewhere in this land, 5 Ancient Behemoths are hidden. Nothing says you will necessarily stumble upon them. They are hidden, but there is a hint about them, so anyone who reads everything has a chance!
"You must be looking in the wrong places if you cannot find them!"
"Will you give it to us now? Do not worry; you will lose nothing. You are one of us, after all! We will take it straight to Castle Gloaming!"

A group of liches in this tower says:
"We have travelled the whole world, but the one thing we have not yet found is the "Tome of Fire Magic". We already have the other three elements, but still lack the most destructive, fire. No one has managed to find it yet. Will you try too? You are probably our greatest hope now, so you should!"
"Nothing, eh? A pity. You are going nowhere either!" /unless you grab a shovel and dig a tunnel/

"Then hand them over!"
What sort of treatment did you expect from them? Surely not politeness? They cannot treat darkness kindly, any more than you can treat them kindly!
Rogues have always sided with necromancers, but now the guard from Riverstride Fortress demands 100 of their number from you. You have no choice but to sacrifice them.
The guard has not changed its mind! Without 100 Rogues, you are going no further!
map.[ab] - vzestup ríše nemrtvých.sign.0: This leads nowhere, unless you could sail into another map, but our friends at 3DO(NWC) have not worked that out yet.
map.[ab] - vzestup ríše nemrtvých.sign.6: After King Roland united the land, Sword of Doom was hidden here in the depths. Whether it will ever fall into anyone's hands again, who knows? By all appearances, though, it is lost!
There is nothing of interest in these waters.
map.[ab] - vzestup ríše nemrtvých.sign.7:
Darkness is already swallowing the world. Is it not beautiful? It is.....
For necromancers like you, it is the perfect opportunity to swell your ranks.......
map.[ab] - vzestup ríše nemrtvých.town.3: Just as in the light campaign, the dwarves will build you a castle in the dark campaign too. If you were on the side of good, it would be the castle in Harmondale, but now it is Castle {Gloaming}.
The necromancers are now certain you will not fail them, that you stand on their side. So they have sent prisoners captured during the last campaign to build a Town Hall in your town.
Your achievements are already great, so it has been decided to make your castle the capital!
For those of you who already have the Czech version of H3: the artifact you must bring (Crown of the Supreme Magi) is called "Koruna nejvyššího mága" in the Czech translation. Just a side note, so you know which artifact is meant.
As you have surely noticed, you cannot build a Tavern in the castle. There is a Tavern here, but the question is whether you can reach it.

Not even a year has passed since Mulder found himself in the dark world of The X-Files. It is all happening again, and Mulder has arrived in a harsh, dark world where no rules apply. Or rather, where the stronger make the rules.
Since Mulder could not bring any timber from the forest into this world, or even a bit of stone, he has nothing at all. All he has is a little of the other resources and some gold from home.
A small warning: watch your step, especially at the beginning. One wrong move could be fatal! Above all, do not give up after your first mistake!

Wishing you lots of fun playing this map: FIREBIRD
firebird@email.cz
map.[ab] - x files 2 - dalsí svet.guards: "Take what you can; when things are being given away, you have to take them!"
This cross is sacred, so you will have to fight for it.
It feels as though someone is watching me..... thought Mulder  .....
And he was right ....
So, could this be where Scully is hidden?
"Did you think it would be that easy, Mulder? Then you were sorely mistaken."
"So you found this artifact? Well done. Now for a little more excitement."
Incredibly, it was.
Here are some resources, saved just for you ...
"Hopefully that was the last fight," thought Mulder.
According to reports from various sources, there are a lot of them there.
Well, look, imps. How many could there be?
"Could it really be that simple?" Mulder wonders.
It was not......
Yes, the castle is finally in sight!!
"This artifact, crafted over centuries, is now to fall into your hands, earthling? Most certainly NOT!"
"Well, it is not much, but you can be glad it is something," says a chance passer-by.
Even from a distance, flashes of sunlight could be seen reflecting off the gold in a nearby gold mine. But from what Mulder knows of the world he comes from, he knows it will not be that simple.
No sooner had he said it and taken a single step than several rogues kept him company.
"Friends only!"
Were you expecting a mountain of wood here?
There is not much more here either. In fact, exactly the same amount.
As Mulder passed through a nearby grove, a Magic Elemental charged at him.
At last you have a little wood, Mulder. Treasure it!
"So that castle over there is mine. Now to free Scully. There is a field charged with magic around the castle. This must be a different world from the one I saw last time," thought Mulder.
Well, look, a gate. What could be beyond it?
Now you will have to complete a few tasks, Mulder, before you are allowed to go further.
To keep you from feeling so alone in this world, here is a little visit.
You should have avoided this central spot. You were attacked at once!
You have met several Sprites. They wish to join you. Will you accept?
You would have been better off going around this bush.
Now I know what is here. There is a secluded area with mines.
Several enemies appeared just outside the castle.
A little sulfur for your collection.
This sword, forged in hell, is very rare, but there are several opponents here who have taken an interest in it.
"This shield was crafted over many centuries and is far too precious to be handed to you just like that!!"
"Honestly, there is always someone laying claim to whatever I happen to want," says Mulder. And at once he was no longer alone.
"Now, Mulder, we shall see whether you are worthy of this artifact."
"Enter at your own risk," read a sign near the gate to the underground. Will you enter?
map.[ab] - x files 2 - dalsí svet.header: Mulder has entered another unknown world, where he must face countless enemies. The only way to return with his colleague Scully is to obtain the artifact "Crown of the Supreme Magi" and take it to the castle "FBI Centre". So do your best, and do not let Mulder die here.
map.[ab] - x files 2 - dalsí svet.heroes: Dana Scully is waiting for her colleague to rescue her so that she can give him the rare artifact she carries.
After Fox Mulder managed to clear the previous world of enemies and free Scully, he was given another task: free this land from tyranny.
map.[ab] - x files 2 - dalsí svet.monste: "We are friends. Please take us along...."
"Will you take us?"
"No, these treasures are ours and ours alone!"
"You no longer need this, but the enemy might find it useful."
"Want the shield? Then come and get it!"
"We are your friends."

"You will NEVER pass, do you hear? NEVER!"



They are Firebirds, so handle with care ..............
"Haha, you think you can defeat us? The strongest beings in this world? Hahaaa, then show us!"

"Well, well, we have visitors. Who is riding towards us? Why, it is that fellow from The X-Files. Word has spread across the whole land that he has arrived. Let us make his stay here a little less pleasant!"
"Come on, then, if you feel strong enough!!!"
"We are friends."
"Accept us; you will not regret it!"
"We only give ore to friends, and you are not one and never will be!"
"Gold is scarce in these parts. So you too must fight us, because we alone decide who gets gold here and who does not."
"Are you mad? There is no way we will simply let you through!!"
"You are on our territory, so you will die!!!"
"Come on, crawl over here! We are already sharpening our teeth for you."
The lake before you suddenly froze, and several elementals rose from the ice. (It does not matter that no lake is visible)
"Please, let us join you."
"No, leave us alone. We are guarding these resources just for you!!"
"Accept us; you will not regret it!"
"You cannot have it!"
"We are Firebirds, and we guard this grove against the likes of you!"
This band of peasants wishes you no good either. You must fight them.
"Come on in; I have nothing but rarities here."
"We are the toughest guards in this land. If you defeat us, you truly are a master."

"This would really come in handy for you. The only problem is that we cannot give it to you!" 

Firebirds are not always on the side of good....
"Got it? Will you give it to us?"
The monk in this tower says: "If you can bring me the "Pendant of Life"/Pendant of Life/, I will reward you."
"You do not have it? Then there will be no reward!"
"Our joy knows no bounds at seeing that you have our precious "Mystic Orb of Mana"/Mystic Orb of Mana/. Will you give it to us, then?"
"Mulder, we need a little something in exchange for letting you pass. Bring us the "Mystic Orb of Mana" /Mystic Orb of Mana/, and we will let you through."
"If you do not have it, do not come back here. We are disappointed in you."
"Well, there we are. Will you hand over these goods?"
"Welcome, agent lost in strange worlds. If you wish to go further, bring us 50 wood and 50 ore ( stone ). We need it to repair our tower."
"You do not have it? Then you are out of luck, my friend. Perhaps another time."
"Yes, that is it. Will you give it to me now?"
A very experienced wizard has settled in this tower. He tells you that if you bring him the artifact "Centaur's Axe" /Centaur's Axe/, he will let you through.
The wizard is disappointed, but gives you one more chance.
"You have it? Incredible. So what have you decided? Will you give it up or not? It is a hard decision; it is a rarity, especially at the start. Well?"

Long ago, in ages past, the artifact "Inexhaustible Cart of Lumber"/Inexhaustible Cart of Lumber/ was created. Yes, it is truly a great rarity, and therefore in great demand. The guard in this tower wants it, so run along and find it.
"Nothing? Then get out of here and search!"
"Bravo, the people of this land will never forget it."
The guard in this tower says that if you kill the azure dragons northwest of here, you will be allowed through.
"Nothing? We have no reports that the dragons are dead. This land needs those dragons killed, so make an effort!"
"Yes, at last! Will you give it to me now?"
The powerful wizard who controls this tower looks at you and says that if you bring him the "Head of Legion"/Head of Legion/, he will let you through.
The wizard is angry that you came empty-handed, but if you bring this artifact next time, you still have a chance.
"Excellent, will you trade 30 Titans for passage, then? I know, it is a lot, but I will give you no other option. Make your choice!"
An old priest lives in this tower. Seeing that you wish to pass, he says: "I will let you through if you bring me 30 Titans. I need them to fight the undead."
"You do not have them?" The priest is disappointed, but gives you another chance.
map.[ab] - x files 2 - dalsí svet.sign.1: Did you enjoy the voyage? If so, that is all this trip has brought you, because there really is nothing here.
Legend says it is possible to find something that is not visible at first glance......
map.[ab] - x files 2 - dalsí svet.sign.2: Carved into this very old tablet were the words: "This gate (on the left) leads where no mortal should ever set foot."
map.[ab] - x files 2 - dalsí svet.sign.6: Looking at the map in the editor? Go ahead, if you think it will help. The blue player simply must not be destroyed, and there is nothing anyone can do about it!
map.[ab] - x files 2 - dalsí svet.town.5: The dwarves, on whose side you fought in the previous instalment, have decided to reward you. For your services, they have built a "City Hall" in your castle.
The decision has gone in your favour, Mulder. Construction of a "Capitol" in your castle has been approved.
Xena and Ephiny, welcome to this world of evil, which can only be stopped by delivering artifacts. The swamp people who oppose you were never hostile; it is the fault of the war that has engulfed the whole land and reached even here. So it is up to you whether you manage to stop this nation.
Made by: FIREBIRD
firebird@email.cz
Be careful; this place is full of snares and traps. What else would you expect in the treacherous world of the swamps?
Suddenly, a wagon of goods appeared in the castle. "Why, it is Joxer," says Xena. "What have you brought us?" "Oh, just a few supplies," says Joxer, and unloads everything.
Autolycus, King of Thieves, is not on Xena's side this time. He took advantage of her absence and emptied the castle treasury.
Why, it is Joxer, coming for the second time. And of course, he has brought something too.
On this day, Xena & Ephiny expect another shipment from Joxer, but he and his stagecoach have been ambushed and he has been killed, which means that sadly he will not be coming again.
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.guards.0: You should not have come this way, Xena. Several harpies sprang out.
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.guards.1: Treasure territory. A place where hydras may be encountered.
Yes, Xena, you really will need this!
You are entering the magical regions of this inhospitable land.
If you really think you can succeed here, Xena, you are sorely mistaken !!!
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.guards.2: Rumours say that the legendary castle Conflux is somewhere nearby, but by the time you reach it, it will probably already be inhabited.
It is a jungle in here, thought Xena.
Come and get us, then, if you think you stand a chance!
So this is the sacred castle I have only heard of in ancient legends!
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.guards.3: No, no, Xena. Though we salute you for making it this far, you really must not have this !!
Of course not; here comes company already !
A path straight to the gold mine. If only I can get there so easily!
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.guards.4: The path ends shortly, Xena. No one has yet dared enter the deeper parts of this land, so they remain unmapped.
Rumours say that the legendary castle Conflux is somewhere nearby, but by the time you reach it, it will probably already be inhabited.
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.guards.5: Rumours say that the legendary castle Conflux is somewhere nearby, but by the time you reach it, it will probably already be inhabited.
This parchment contains instructions for the spell "Scuttle Boat".
You are entering the magical regions of this inhospitable land.
Where might this mysterious path lead?
Yes, this is a very important artifact, Xena. You will certainly need it. But can you defeat us?
Do you not think passing through a grove like this is dangerous? No? Then you are mistaken!!
It will not be quite that simple, Xena!
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.guards.6:
Stepping onto this spot was your fatal mistake. It is a gate straight to hell, but you will not win here, so prepare for your death !!! 

And it is so easy to go around !
Come and see, Xena, where you will eventually have to go. How long it takes is up to you.
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.guards.7: This powerful artifact is surrounded by many monks whose life's mission is to protect it.
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.header.d: A difficult task has fallen to Xena: destroy the powerful swamp nation that has claimed this land. But Xena will not win merely by wiping it out ( that is impossible anyway ); she must bring the artifact "Armageddon\'s Blade" to the castle "Artifact Town". This is the only way to win.
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.heroes.2: Ephiny has been Xena's friend for many years. She swore to help Xena and is determined to keep her word.
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.heroes.3: This is Xena, the Warrior Princess. Since Callisto's death, the consequences of the horrors Callisto committed have weighed ever more heavily upon her. From the underworld, Callisto tries to make life miserable for Xena and her friends by making everything look as though Xena did it......
I was stationed at this sawmill to protect it from enemies.
We are with you, Xena, and you alone.
It would be better if the places you are about to enter remained closed to you, Xena!!!
We are friends, and hope you will accept us.
This ore mine belongs to us and us alone.
We guard several very rare pendants here, and you certainly are not among those allowed to enter.

We are allies. Will you take us into your army? 

What else would you expect, since they are Firebirds.........
Thank you, Xena. You helped me obtain the artifact I needed so badly. You may now pass.
The monk living in this tower looks at you and says: "If you bring me the -Sword of Hellfire-, I will let you through."
The monk is very disappointed that you returned without the artifact. He will not let you pass.
Welcome, says a skeleton a short distance from you. I too was once an adventurer, but this is a trap, a plain TRAP ! There is no way out. Accept it !
No, this castle is only here to keep the blue player from being eliminated. That player needs to remain here, after all.
In this world, you must find the sword "Armageddon\'s Blade" and bring it to the castle "Artifact Home", which belongs to the enemy.
map.[ab] - xena & národ z bažin.sign.5.4: There are rumours that several crystal dragons are somewhere nearby. Be careful, Xena.
If you use this teleporter, Xena, you will be taken to a castle that is impregnable anyway.
The gods who favour Xena cast a spell upon the land, instantly building a Fort in the castle.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.0.descri: Your subjects will support you in this war. Each month, they will therefore provide taxes and some able-bodied fighting men.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.1.descri: Word is spreading across the land that Rashaak and Ibirod have a few of the artifacts.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.10.descr: A great troll invasion has swept across all lands, above and below ground. They destroy, burn and devour all the produce of your lands. Complete your task as soon as possible!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.11.descr: The king sends at least some support for your lands.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.12.descr: Hurry !!! Your scouts have discovered that the trolls are preparing a major raid.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.13.descr: Your spies have assured you that on the island where you are to receive the azure dragons, there are 7 doors opened by secret passwords. Only one password is found on that island.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.2.descri: Your subjects pay you their taxes.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.3.descri: The previous message was a hoax!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.4.descri: Kaleva has been attacked by trolls! The neighbouring kings are therefore preparing aid.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.5.descri: On this day, the entire army of the mighty underground rulers mutinied. They must therefore pay unexpectedly higher wages, as well as some goods in kind.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.6.descri: Do not forget to support your ally from time to time.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.7.descri: You received a little financial support from the goblins? That seems odd ...
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.8.descri: While your subjects were accepting the goblins' gift, the goblins looted your warehouses. A very well-planned move on their part.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.event.9.descri: For your information - every state has at least one of Lord Chaos's powerful artifacts within its borders.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.14.26.0: You are entering the magical plains.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.15.45.1: After defeating the manticores, you gained some magical energy from their poisonous tails.
Your Sharpshooters obtained this artifact, but now the dendroids all around are laying claim to it. Do you want to fight them?
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.26.55.1: So many treasures here... But what could be guarding them? Pirates, perhaps .. No perhaps about it - pirates indeed!
Once you defeated the advance guard, the remaining monks surrendered and offered you their services. After you accepted them into your army, they led you to the monastery and gave you their most precious relic - the Tome of Earth Magic.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.36.19.0: This should come in handy when fighting elementals. But what is this? Someone is guarding the scroll. Do you wish to fight for it?
After you defeated the wraiths, their commander appeared and thanked you for freeing them. Then he gave you a strange artifact.
For killing this "puppy", this place is cursed forever! You will never kill these innocent "puppies" again. First its family will attack you, and if you survive, you will be cursed!
This is the famous Pandora's Box. You can tell it radiates magical energy. Do you wish to open it ? If so, you must fight fiery monsters.
Many years ago, a legion of Velarian infantry and cavalry drowned in the swamp here. Though the swamp dried up over the years, the place remained cursed forever. Now they rise whenever someone passes by. You tried to give the place a wide berth, but this is the only way through the local swamps.
And suddenly the wraiths come to life . . .
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.46.13.0: Do not come here! This is the pirates' base!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.53.58.0: Well, look what the dark knights were carrying. It probably belonged to their master. To you, however, it is about as useful as a jackhammer to a mole.
The town of Kalevion looks forward to its liberation from the trolls. A few townspeople have secretly smuggled gifts to you, hoping you will free them.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.56.40.0: From here, your whole army can already see occasional patches of grass on the infernal terrain. Hell clearly lacks the strength to transform the entire landscape. You are filled with energy and determination to destroy Ibirod.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.58.18.0: Abandon hope, all who prepare to enter...
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.59.64.0: I am a castaway from a pirate ship. I was their prisoner. Please save me. I will give you everything I have. They are little statues of creatures of some kind. When you throw them to the ground, they come alive.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.60.29.0: More and more dwarves pour out of the Dwarven Treasury. There are several hundred already. Do you still wish to raid the treasury?
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.63.64.1: Killing the azure dragons has enraged the other dragons. They want to avenge their deaths...
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.66.71.0:
You have crept onto the sacred island where you must hand over the 12 artifacts of Oblivion.
But the island's guardian wants to make sure the artifacts have been obtained by the right ruler. So you must undergo a trial by combat - all you need to do is defeat this army from the Conflux.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.67.69.1: This huge pile of mercury is guarded by a flock of phoenixes, which apparently feed on it. Do you wish to fight them (the pile really is huge)?
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.68.66.1: As you reached for this ring, dark knights came trotting around the corner. They are clearly guarding it. Do you wish to fight them?
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.68.70.1: This used to be part of the dragon's hoard. Now, however, it is part of your treasury.
The town of Ife looks forward to its liberation from the trolls. A few townspeople have secretly smuggled gifts to you, hoping you will free them.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.70.69.1: Here is the Dragonlord's Shield. It is very well made. But the king of the innocent little imps and his retinue guard it. Do you wish to slaughter those little imps?
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.guards.71.67.1: Look! The Crown of the Dragon King! And unguarded! With its help, you can command the azure dragons too!!!!
The town of Frizgred eagerly awaits liberation from the trolls. A few townsfolk have secretly smuggled you gifts to help you free them.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.header.descrip:
In the Land of Oblivion, the underground lords fight the lords of the surface. Victory will go to whoever obtains the 7 artifacts of the Lord of Chaos and trades them for azure dragons.
Whoever controls the azure dragons controls the Land of Oblivion. You can also win in the usual way: by destroying all enemies.
Made by Hidden
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.header.name: Land of Oblivion
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.header.rumor.1: One of the artifacts is the Boots of Speed.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.header.rumor.2: There are 2 very important artifacts underground.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.header.rumor.3: Several guards protect the island of azure dragons.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.header.rumor.5: Whoever finds the Grail will gain an advantage over the others.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.header.rumor.6: The Grail lies on the surface.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.header.rumor.7: Find as many obelisks as possible: they will help you find the Grail.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.header.rumor.8: Defeat Ibirod and victory is halfway yours.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.header.rumor.9: Venture underground too: fabulous treasures await.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.heroes.147.bio: In his youth, Rashaak killed dragons (he was a dragonslayer). Then he met Ibrod and joined the forces of darkness. Now he fights alongside Ibirod and his dark legions.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.heroes.150.bio: Ulfi - Nekro is one of the necromancers who have yet to pass the trial of admission to the dark cult. His trial is to conquer this land.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.heroes.151.bio: The overlords learned that whoever commands the azure dragons will win. So they summoned Ramionka. Of all the overlords, she is the best at commanding dragons.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.heroes.155.bio: Ibirod was evil from his earliest days. He killed his mother at birth. At 15, he became the devil’s apprentice. Now he wants to rule Hell. To do so, he must conquer this land with the help of azure dragons. Then he will sacrifice them to the darkness and become the ruler of Hell. Rashaak is helping him make the task easier.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.11.5.1: Hail, great necromancer! We guard this gate. It leads to your ally’s lands. May we join you?
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.12.4.0: So you want to steal my food??? We shall see who takes what from whom...
Hail, ally of elves and men. We have heard of your mission and wish to join you.
Now you must pass the entrance test. Kill these creatures!
We want to destroy the tree! We want to destroy the tree! What?!? You will not let us? Then we shall destroy your army!
We hate everyone who is not undead. Attack!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.14.3.0: So you have arrived... You want this artifact of oblivion? We certainly will not give it to you! No weakling shall claim this artifact!
Please do not claim this mine. We guard it for our friends, the green dragons.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.14.8.0: Hello, friend! At last, a living soul after two months!
So you will not leave our ladies alone!
Greetings! We guard this gate. It leads to your ally’s lands. May we join you?
You want to rob us of our only livelihood?!? You will pay for this!
So you fancy some maps, do you, little man? Over our dead bodies.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.2.30.0: My lord! We took an artifact from some bandits. Please accept it.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.2.34.0: Monks guard their monastery here. As you approach, you discover that they belong to an order of Hell worshippers. The moment they spot you, they hurl magical bolts at your army.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.2.47.0: Why will these creatures not let you pass? They claim to be guarding the fire that gave them birth, lest it go out. You find that suspicious. So you give the order: Attack!!!
These troglodytes are tough indeed. Before you could intervene, one of your archers fired two practice shots at one of them. The other little beasts did not take kindly to it.
To enter this Altar of Wishes, you must kill your horse. You refuse? Then we shall try killing you!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.21.5.0: Leave this hive alone! You will not be killing any Dragon Flies!
These wights apparently cannot speak. And you hate anyone (apart from elves and humans) who cannot speak.
Where do you think you are going? Our master chooses his servants here!
We will not let you into this fortress! We have been besieging it for ages, and now that the siege is nearly over, you turn up!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.28.5.0: These elementals cannot be very intelligent if they act on instinct alone.
Little familiars stand amid the swamp. They are evidently aggressive because the swamp flies have bitten them.
Leave those imps for us to sacrifice at the nearby altar! You will not leave them? Then we will not leave you alone!
What a mistake! You thought they were medusas, but you attacked nagas!
These gnolls are fighting the garrison of this little fort. Since you protect the people of this land, you attack the gnolls.
Look, raging bulls. And these are very angry indeed. They attack at once.
Griffins are guarding some captives in their prison. It would be good to free them.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.4.12.0: These sacred basilisks are not as tame as they seemed.
Genies have lived on this continent since time immemorial. Someone like you will not unsettle them!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.40.8.0: Woof, woof... Please do not kill me.
The sprites are enjoying their evening tea in peace. When you disturb them, they cast aside their cups and advance towards you. They probably want you to pay for the interruption . . .
We are keeping these secret passwords to ourselves!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.44.3.0: So you will not let us pick our noses in peace?!?!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.5.35.0: So you specialise in archers? There is a useful artifact behind us, especially for you. It will cost 200 000 gold. What?!?! You refuse?!?! Then we will kick your @#$%# !!!
You, Alledonan! Keep your paws off this harbour! It belongs to the infernal cult!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.6.25.0: We hate everyone who is not undead. Attack!
You see some mad imps guarding a rock. Suddenly their leader says, {"Open Sesame"}, and you glimpse some resources. But the smallest imp spots you, and now they are all charging at you.
So you covet my treasures? Then you shall taste Hell while you are still alive!!!!!!!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.69.1.0: You defeated our master Ibirod???? Just you wait....
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.monster.8.18.0: You may not pass! You would kill our sacred basilisks!
You were just about to enter the arena when some little men suddenly pushed in front of you. They refuse to let you inside. You will have to settle this with your fists!
At last! Now I can break the roots of those dendroids in my garden! Would you like me to teach you something?
I know you are at war. Perhaps experience would serve you better than soldiers. Bring me 50 Battle Dwarves and 25 Silver Pegasi, and I shall teach you many things.
Still do not have them? Try a little harder. As far as I know, your enemy is looking for them too. First come....
At last, you hand it over to him. Or do you?

The powerful wizard dwelling in this tower is looking for his nephew’s artifact. He once lent it to him, and now needs it for the celebrations in Ksad Forest near Ife. He will give you a spell scroll in exchange.
So you have not obtained the ring for him? The Fly spell awaits you...
Thank you, thank you, thank you. Here are the crystals.
I heard your kingdom needs crystals. I need 25 diamonds to enrol my son in a school of magic. Bring them to me, and I shall give you the crystals you need.
Hurry, hurry! The school year is about to begin.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.quest.69.2.0.c: Only now will I let you through!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.quest.69.2.0.f: You are on the right path! But I will only let you through if you kill Ibirod and bring me this artifact of his.
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.quest.69.2.0.n: No one passes without that artifact!!!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.quest.70.0.0.c: So you brought me the crown??? Here is your reward! I have never seen anything like it!
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.quest.70.0.0.f: So you are interested in azure dragons? I will give them to you if you bring me the dragon crown...
map.[ab] - zeme zapomneni.quest.70.0.0.n: Still nothing? Perhaps you are not the one after all.
At last, you have killed him. Hail the conqueror of Ibirod!
We are servants of Neutral. We will only let you through if you bring us Ibirod’s head.
You are plainly afraid of Ibirod. But we are waiting for his head!
At last, you have the artifacts. At last, the Land of Oblivion shall know its true master!

At last, you have reached me. I am the master of the azure dragons. I will give you no fewer than 50 if you bring me these artifacts: the sword of a famous warrior, a golden shield, the armour of a titan commander, a necklace of dragon teeth, the ring of the famous wizard Wayfarer, the gloves of an underground lord, and the Boots of Speed.
You desperately need those dragons, not I. Without the artifacts, you are unlikely to survive.

The "Argoth" adventure v0.98 [8.3.]

(c) Qt 1999 

Creation: about 16 hours of actual work

Enjoy yourselves!
map.[roe] - argoth.event.1.description: ...hmm, perhaps I overdid that "meteoric rise" business. Monsters have scattered across the countryside, and some have occupied the mines. Argoth’s sword and shield have also gone missing, most likely carried off by monsters during his desperate struggle for his life.
map.[roe] - argoth.event.2.description: The servants discovered secret stores in the castle. Hurrah! Perhaps I can build the castle up faster now. My meteoric rise is off to a promising start...
map.[roe] - argoth.event.3.description: This is worse than I expected. The villagers are rebelling; they must have liked Argoth rather well. They say they have hired a hero to defeat me. I suppose I shall have to show them who is master here!
map.[roe] - argoth.event.4.description:
Hopefully this is the last piece of bad news. Argoth’s servants guarding the entrances to his estate apparently will not let me out! What a stupid idea, posting incorruptible, bloodthirsty necromancers there... (though once I defeat them, I shall probably do the same:-)

Oh, a few more interesting things turned up in the castle...
map.[roe] - argoth.event.5.description:
So the story about the hero is true, at least according to the scouts...

Damn, I never realised how hard it was to be a novice mage. And all this work leaves me no time even to write my diary... Ah well.
map.[roe] - argoth.event.6.description:
Astral’s diary, ch.II/16:

Murdering Argoth was not easy. I soon lost my entire army, and part of the castle was demolished (including, alas, the library full of spells)... I shall explore the castle further.
map.[roe] - argoth.event.7.description: You have been hired to confront Astral, the evil mage who murdered his teacher Argoth. Astral is now in Argoth’s winter residence, or rather his own, which was created by magic. From there he immediately began terrorising and threatening the surrounding lands. So the people hired you, hoping for a miracle...
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.16.41.0.messag: Hmm... Argoth’s secret sulfur stores. These will certainly come in handy.
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.22.19.0.messag: You have crossed the boundary of the necropolis. Your vision blurs, your thoughts darken and your body grows weak. The voice of the city’s last ruler echoes in your head again and again: "Be cursed, unknown stranger!"
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.24.45.1.messag:
Will you face Hell itself? What do you say...

Keep your chin up: there are still hidden reserves...
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.29.4.0.message: Hmm, it seems the heroes have risen for what really may be their final battle..
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.37.29.0.messag:
The landscape has changed completely. Snowfields and towering mountains give way to plains and meadows so naturally... You cannot imagine what magic could have created all this... [Homam3 editor - Qt’s note]

The change of scenery encourages you to press on...
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.37.42.0.messag:
Remember, this is about more than some castle (albeit one full of spells): this is revenge!
You promised to kill Astral. Get on with it...
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.39.43.0.messag: If only I had a boat...
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.41.1.0.message:
You have reached a sacred place and offered a prayer.
Perhaps one should not put it this way, but IT WAS WORTH IT! Archangels are always useful, are they not?
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.54.6.0.message: A foul stench of sulfur rises from underground...
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.55.7.1.message: Several magogs guard a pile of sulfur... Do you want to take it from them?
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.58.37.0.messag: If this castle is not enough for you, Hell is the only place left to seek help...
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.59.12.0.messag: "If you need a proper base, perhaps you should look at the abandoned fortress of Horborg, south of here," says the guard, closing the gate behind you...
map.[roe] - argoth.guards.66.61.0.messag: The elemental seems to be waving at you, trying to tell you something...
