map.[roe] - bod zlomu.event.1.descriptio:
{Your task}

With the help of the hero Alexandr and his friends, you must find and obtain a mighty artifact that will allow the archwizard Kosmix to save the world from a danger as yet unspecified. May fortune favour your journey! And may you finish it before half a year has passed.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.event.2.descriptio:
{A few tips}

1. Read everything anyone says carefully!
2. Use several different save slots!
3. If you think something cannot be won, look for other ways!
4. Do not let anyone die {needlessly}!
5. Do not give up after a few failed attempts!
6. Celebrate every major step forward :-)
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.event.4.descriptio:
{Enough introductions - Let the game begin!}

From now on, {dear gentleman player} or {dear lady player}, you will hear only from the narrator and the heroes, characters and creatures of this story, which unfolds just beyond the eastern borders of the land called Eluria.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.event.5.descriptio:
{Narrator}

Alexandr and his company spent the night in a mysterious castle on Eluria’s border, where Alexandr was to meet the great wizard {Kosmix}. Suddenly, in the middle of the night, the whole castle began to shake, and everyone was seized by a strange enchantment whose purpose each of them sensed, however dimly, deep within ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.0.19.0.mess:
WE ARE STRONG.
WE ARE MIGHTY.
WE ARE GREAT.
WE ARE ...

What is that? Who is speaking? You take a few steps towards the voices, which was probably unwise: an ugly gorgon spots you. That voice, so quietly loud within your mind, belonged to it, or to them.

WE LET NO ONE PASS. WE ARE MIGHTY. WE ARE GORGONS!

{Another battle erupts!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.0.28.1.mess:
Why do all Kosmix’s mages attack you? And why do they say the much praised Breaking Point has not yet come? You have already experienced it several times, have you not?

You begin to suspect that Kosmix, the most influential wizard in Eluria, has lied to you about something. But what?

For now, though, Kosmix will help you learn a super spell!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.0.55.1.mess:
Kosmix ...
Kosmix ...
Kosmix ...

'What about him? Whose voice is that? Hello!?'

Kosmix ...
Kosmix ...
Kosmix ...

You are certainly none the wiser. What is this? At least you can feel your mana rising again at the mention of Kosmix’s name. About time: you need it!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.0.56.0.mess:
A golden dragon guarded a golden sack.
But now the dragon is dead, so who gets to take it back?

'Alex does, of course!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.0.65.1.mess:
'Suppose we were simply standing here, dear knight. Would that make sense?' said one of the giants.
'Not much,' you replied tensely.
'Yes, correct. You are right. You see, we are guarding something. Oh damn, it was unwise to say that. Now we must kill you!'
'But you have not said...'

{'Objection overruled!'}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.0.68.1.mess:
{'One more thing, Grandioso.}

I chose you as one of my finest pupils to help Prince Alexandr ... yes, that Prince Alexandr ... you know ... on his quest to obtain the - I, I {must not say}. Not yet. Strive, fight, cast spells, think, survive! I am counting on YOU!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.0.7.0.messa: {Alexandr}, where have you ended up? And what mysterious object are you meant to save the world with? What was Kosmix babbling about a Breaking Point? What spell brought you here? What has he done with your friends? Why could he not have left you in bed? Enough pondering: time is flying, and you have none to spare! What obstacles await you?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.1.17.0.mess:
Is it even worth bending down for such a pittance?
Why not let one of my horsemen stoop to the ground instead?
Perhaps collecting all the gold myself is just a habit ...
and Alex advises you to do the same!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.1.20.0.mess: 'Here are two more little trees whose inhabitants will gladly give me tasks and then reward me. Let us hope the rewards are worth the trouble!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.1.25.0.mess: 'I feel a little lonely in this forest without my faithful friends. Perhaps I miss Adriana. Golemina too, perhaps. And in another sense, I miss my Liliputek as well. The First. Even that occasionally pompous Augustus. Where are you, friends? Are you alive? Are you doing all you can? I hope so ... I have barely begun myself ...'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.1.30.0.mess:
'So you champions think you can push us around just because you are on horseback and your lances are a little longer? Not a chance, you swine. We shall see who comes out on top!' shouted the leader of the numerous halberdiers at some of your horsemen.

Before you can even express surprise, battle begins!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.1.33.0.mess: A glittering nugget of gold. Every gold piece helps, does it not?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.1.36.0.mess:
Well, it is not much gold, but why leave it lying here?
But what are those strange noises? You see,

from time to time the breezes bring
strange shrieks and a peculiar din;
then silence through the woodland falls,
your heart pounds wildly in its walls.
{(Have you perhaps just filled your ......?)}
(No, that is only sweat beneath the horse.)

But what is that din?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.1.58.1.mess: You feel uneasy, as though something might fall on you from the sky at any moment. But nothing happens. The feeling passes. Probably just one of those rotten feelings people get sometimes. Or a hidden sixth sense?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.1.61.1.mess: {Grandioso}, the most gifted of Master Kosmix’s pupils, finds himself in a haunted underground forest, where magic sometimes carries his master’s voice into his head. He is meant to help, though he does not yet know how, or even quite whom ... or with what, for that matter.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.1.64.1.mess:
You waited quite a while for your master to speak again, but he never did. He gave you mana and magical power! Why? What are you to help with, and whom? 

Whatever is happening, you must give it your all if it is important enough for Master Kosmix himself to contact you telepathically.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.1.9.0.messa:
'The wanted man Alexandr has been apprehended, General!' one golem told another.
'Thank you, Captain. Alexandr, you are under arrest!' the second golem told you.

You tried your luck: 'Do you know my Golemina?'

'Hmmm. Exactly! Alex, you are under arrest! Damn it! Seize him!'

Time to bring in the heavy cavalry, perhaps?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.10.11.0.mes: 'Another mortal visits our shooting range!' rejoice a good thirty mages. They look tipsy and ... unfortunately, ready for battle!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.10.33.0.mes:
'I could probably swim across, but my horsemen could not. Well, I need another way. We could ford it, but why risk the horses? That leaves only one sensible option, does it not?'

Time to get across the water!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.10.38.0.mes:
They were hardly generous with the gold. Still, it could be worse.
As Liliput sometimes says:

A little luck once in a year
beats a poke in the eye, my dear!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.10.66.1.mes:
'A lovely orchard, indeed. And you have picked it bare. Splendid!'
'But that was not us, sir. We left some ...'
'Then who was it?'
'Them ...'

Several crusaders lie beneath the trees. It takes little effort to persuade them to join you. Dear, good, kind Kosmix! And his spell!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.11.67.1.mes:
'Sir, our grandiose reconnaissance has borne grandiose fruit!'
'Enough beating about the bush,' you snap. 'What did you discover?'

'Well, we brought the fruit. There is an orchard a little farther on, so we picked some supplies!'
'Excellent, excellent. Just what I had in mind for that reconnaissance,' you sigh.

{Life is hard, is it not?}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.11.71.1.mes:
'Crusading through the countryside, crusading through the field,
crusading through the woodland, with no friends to be revealed,
in this dark and dreadful wood,
where the devil shakes for good,
where no hero comes to stay ...'

You spot a group of singing crusaders! Confidently, you call out:
'Your lucky hour starts today! I am your hero!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.12.62.0.mes:
'Whoever murders a guardian of the mountains brings a curse and seventy-seven years of bad luck upon himself. Your eyes reveal you to be one such wretch, poor mortal. Beware our vengeance for our fallen comrade!'

Well, if they want a fight, they shall have one. You have never lost before, after all!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.12.68.1.mes:
'My dear crusaders, yes, those of you still alive, there will be no more singing like that here, or we shall come to a sticky end. Understood?! You will all be quiet and start scouting the road ahead properly. Otherwise we will not get far. I am no all-powerful wizard!'

Your long speech tires you. You feel sleepy.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.12.70.1.mes:
'Crusading through the countryside, crusading through the field,
crusading through the woodland, with no friends to be revealed,
in this dark and dreadful wood,
where the devil shakes for good ...'

Now the other crusaders are singing too. Let us hope they do not attract attention. You shout at them to be quiet. They fall silent.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.15.5.0.mess:
'Is there a hydra gathering somewhere around here, brave warrior woman?' several different heads of several different hydras ask you.

'NO!' you scream hysterically and angrily. Too late, you realise your mistake and your unforgivable conduct, which will surely be punished.

But the hydras are going away. Hurrah!

{Well done, lady!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.2.23.0.mess: That pile of gold looked bigger, but a little gold in your purse beats a punch in the face, does it not? That is roughly how the saying goes.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.2.34.1.mess: 'The Tome of Fire Magic ... hurrah! I thought I would never learn any new spells, but perhaps I will after all! Provided those beasts flying around it and making little fires will let me have it!' Grandioso says into the utter silence. His whole company watches the surrounding flames with grim faces.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.2.4.0.messa: {Alexandr} awakes among some rocks. Nearby stands a tree hut whose inhabitant surely wants something. Alex suspects this is merely the beginning of a long quest for something significant. He also knows his companions are scattered throughout this land and will surely help him however they can.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.2.53.0.mess:
'You stand before the tower of wishes fulfilled, Alex! And since you have often worried these last few days about your dwindling numbers, this aid will fall straight into your lap! Now be gone before I change my mind!' the tower declares.

Strange. But help has arrived!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.2.9.0.messa:
All that glitters is not gold.
A scant hundred in these flowers, all told.

You shout into the copse in wrath
for leaving such a tiny nugget in your path.

Then you think it wise to calm your mood.
What if you angered the wood?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.20.46.0.mes: 'Surely you do not mean to take our idol, our sacred artifact? Perhaps not, but either way you have already desecrated it! You shall not escape punishment, worm!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.20.63.0.mes:
'Alex, look,' says Voriax. 'An ancient magical object over there. Someone probably hid it away for a rainy day. I know how to use it. Keep it about your person, and it prolongs all your warriors’ lives in battle. It delays their possible deaths!'

Clever Voriax. That could be useful!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.23.64.0.mes: 'The miller seems to be putting a little money aside for himself. We shall punish him by taking those savings, shall we, gentlemen ...' you tell your men, who nod in agreement with laughter in their eyes.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.25.19.1.mes:
Satan himself flies up to you. He says nothing, merely waits for the cloud of smoke left by his arrival to clear, then grins horribly. He strikes you with a strange scythe. More devilish clouds appear, and scythe after scythe falls upon you before you can even defend yourself...
{What are these devils guarding???}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.26.19.1.mes: Did Kosmix not tell me to hurry? To press forward as fast as possible? Did he? I no longer know ... my head tingles, my body itches, everything burns, I feel as though I am in Hell. There is a strange reek, it is hot and ... it is probably high time to return to the quest for the cape ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.26.33.1.mes: 'Haha, I think not ... you come here without a stake, garlic or a cross, and expect to take something from us? Not a chance, young fool ... gentlemen, our snack has arrived!' declares one of the many vampire lords flitting around a strange artifact.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.26.52.0.mes:
'INTRUDER! WHO ARE YOU?' a pegasus shouts angrily at you (this time numbered 0604).
'I would just like to pass, please. ALL I WANT IS 2 GO!'

The pegasi attack. If all you want is to GO, they say, they will tear you apart.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.27.31.0.mes:
Soaked in the swamp’s damp and stench, a pair of gloves lies tucked away on the ground. Old and slightly rotten. Probably useless, but why not take them?

You are about to pick them up when someone returns from work, and is not kind enough to let you keep them!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.28.50.0.mes:
'Who are you?' asks a single, solitary pegasus.
'Alexandr,' you try truthfully.
'Oh no, you are surely {Oskar}! And we shall kill you for that lie!'

Suddenly pegasi swarm everywhere, as though someone had summoned them by magic. First they gather their strength, replenish their energy, then take flight and ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.28.52.0.mes:
'INTRUDER! WHO ARE YOU?' a pegasus shouts angrily at you (numbered 0603).
'Me,' {you try playing the fool}, 'me Alexandr. You Jane? Me looking for Tarzan!'

Your trick fails: the pegasi attack. They say you should loosen up, untie yourself from your horse, and give them everything. Your life too, presumably.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.29.29.0.mes:
'Splendid, what a stroke of luck! With you I shall conquer the pole!
Or rather, fly there! What, are you moved to tears, dear souls?'

No, those are not tears of joy. They fear the ones driven mad by the dragon stench of sulfur, who have forgotten all restraint ...
and become Dragon Flies, now racing towards you!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.29.30.0.mes:
You really should not have let that fly, the one about to spew,
stray so very far away from you!

Beyond the edge of those steep hills, hundreds of flies were milling.
And when your little fly arrived, its dreadful cries were chilling.

You have no idea what is happening. What will happen?! What is coming?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.29.31.0.mes:
'This journey is becoming such a bore,
I feel, no kidding, like vomiting for an hour or more!'
says one of the flies to you.

You certainly never expected a fly to confront you with something like that. Fearing the possible vomiting, you send it farther away from the main group.

{You should not have done that!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.29.37.0.mes:
'One hideously black dragon,
now earthbound for evermore,
was the source of all this stinking,
farting, tail-swinging bore!
Or is there still more sulfur here?
More dragons too? Then pity them, I fear!'
you exclaim. The sulfur really is getting to your brain.
At times you are not even sure which one.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.29.47.0.mes:
'Oh, a medallion. I wonder whose it is...'

A shriek interrupts you!
Several enormous grey monsters emerge from behind the forest.

'What a fool I was to ask who owns that medallion! Those creatures look tough. Perhaps even invincible, damn it.'

Several pairs of paws with insanely sharp claws are already approaching!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.3.62.1.mess:
{'Grandioso!}

They would all have been yours had you not let the mages tamper with my spell. But you could not have known. I tried to prevent that battle, and now my strength is gone ... I can help you no more ... I have only secured you a few more dozen crusaders and mana for ...'

Kosmix?
KOSMIX?!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.30.28.0.mes:
'Damn it, holy simplicity, what peculiar flies!
I call upon your mercy, let rain fall from the skies.
I call upon the highest jury,
{let Windows bury them in error messages!}
That should finish them off! Is it so hard to arrange???'

Probably not, but it would take time, and time is the one thing you lack. Battle has begun!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.30.32.0.mes:
It is not as though Liliput has had few surprises here: they come one after another. But you have never seen such strange flying monsters. One of the flies claims they are wyverns, and very venomous.

They are hard to deal with, too. Best finish them off quickly!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.30.48.0.mes: 'This little statue is hardly a masterpiece, but it might be useful for a trade. Otherwise it really is quite useless. Or so it seems at first glance!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.31.68.0.mes:
The familiar creak of joints, the familiar sounds of stone bodies ... golems must be hiding somewhere among those cliffs!

After a long hour of searching, you find them utterly exhausted. Strangely, all their weariness falls away aboard your ship. They say some strange, mighty spell carried them onto the cliffs ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.33.28.0.mes: You are growing sick of this endless fighting. You are an ordinary, almost peaceful Lilliputian, and this slaughter amounts to war crimes. The madness must end. Let them understand that you will kill every last one of them if they will not leave you alone. Let us hope such thoughts bring nothing bad, like ... {oh no!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.33.39.0.mes:
'Liliput, dear Liliputek, hurry, faithful friend!'
'Time is flying, little remains before the end!'
'I would like to see a rainbow once again!'
'Please hurry, old brother, spare me pain!'

{That was Alex!}
By some miracle he has spoken to you!
{Now he writes verse too ... goodness!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.34.35.0.mes:
'Yes, it was that fly right there!'
'That one?'
'No, that one!'
'That one?'
'Yes, that is her!'
'Then she is in for a roasting! Quite literally!'

You suspected two dragons were talking, but their red colour surprises you.
{Their blood is probably red too!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.35.37.0.mes:
'Birds have flown down from the sky,
I see lightning, damn my eye..!
I want to kill, I want to cleave,
to battle now, no time to grieve!'

Your poetic streak returns once more,
you glance to either side as before,
and no one sees your hair turn grey;
if only time returned her to this day!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.35.64.0.mes: 'We are all sick of these water monsters! We would rather return to dry land full of undead than stay here. Most of us are seasick, vomiting and vomiting and vomiting. Our oil supplies are running low, and every other one of us has rheumatic, creaking joints. Turn back, or there will be mutiny!' reports Golemo el Capitano.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.36.24.0.mes: Evil Dragon Flies lurk beneath the crater’s smoke: the ones that never joined you and never will. You must fight them to the death. Not that the winner is in doubt, or that the bookmakers fail to favour your team clearly, but ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.36.27.0.mes:
'I dearly wonder where this little pathway goes!
Will I pass more beasts, will more swine fall beneath my blows?
I know, dear Jasmínka, I should not curse this way;
I should be kissing your shoulder, love, if you were here today!
But I am alone, with only my flies to own. Ah well.'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.36.37.0.mes:
'Another little heap of stinking sulfur ...
but this time there is a different smell;
airy whirlwinds spin within my head,
they knock me backwards with their swell!
From deep within the swamp I feel water’s might,
and suddenly know how to harm in a fight!
At last I can cast a destructive spell,
may my enemies feel an icy chill as well!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.37.27.0.mes:
'Life without you is dreadful, awful, mad!
Like having no sky overhead, and nappies every night, how sad.
The ice in my heart does not chill me, yet even that ice groans!
I, I no longer want to live without you, I ...'

Melancholy has seized you again, BUT SHE IS GONE!!! Pull yourself together!!!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.37.31.0.mes:
'Sulfur, sulfur, clinging like the Jewish faith.'
'Sulfur, sulfur, anyone care for cheese?'
'Sulfur stinks, sulfur is evil: how can I think of May Day now?'
'Of those happy hours when I walked hand in hand with her among the trees.'

But I had not paid God my rent for life,
and God’s punishment came in lightning strikes.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.38.23.0.mes:
'More stinking sulfur, though I cannot smell it. My nose is still full of blood’s reek. Blood from the battle where flies forgot their sisters and fought and fought until they killed each other. Good thing a few of us got through. But what is happening here? There is only a smoking volcano, and NOTHING else!'

{Phew.}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.38.36.0.mes:
'My darling, sweet and dear,
that blow struck her down here.
No longer fair and bright,
but burned beyond all sight.
Now, my flies, can you see
why horror seizes me
whenever my nose scents
these stale and musty vents?'

The flies understand why the sulfur pisses you off,
why you turn as vicious as a snake.
Leave these thoughts behind;
press forward, for goodness’ sake.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.39.15.1.mes:
'We are just arguing about which of us is strongest, and you stroll right in! That will bring you ruin and death! ... ruin and death! ... ruin and death!'

Hard to say which one spoke, but all seven look fearsome!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.39.27.0.mes:
'I would rather gather sulfur at every step,
than slaughter this rabble again and again without rest.
Lilliputians can only take so much blood, I say;
a few more battles and a tumour will grow in my brain one day!'

Even verse no longer calms you. All the Aspirin stayed at Kosmix’s castle.
What now?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.39.33.0.mes:
Some flies are beginning to wobble alarmingly. Perhaps you overdid the booze. Well, it is all gone anyway, so it hardly matters. One or two more would go down nicely. But there is nothing left except stupid, boring water.

Hey, what is emerging from the swamp over there?
Yesterday’s papers said nothing, I swear!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.39.36.0.mes:
'In days long past and gone,
when heavy snow fell on,
I wandered far off track,
just before six, looking back;
I hate to tell you this,
but I was not alone, alas,
when a crash, a dreadful blast,
a bolt from heaven flashed,
ruined my dreams and days.
My...' 
{You burst into tears!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.4.22.0.mess: 'You impudent fool ... what gives you the right to approach the stables? Perhaps this will teach you not to wander off, not to stray aside. To keep to your Path!' says a voice. Then a crusader steps out of hiding and attacks. He is not alone!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.4.42.0.mess:
One of your men points out four-legged creatures grazing just ahead.
'Sir, some stupid rhinoceroses are grazing there. What shall we do? Drive them away or capture them?'

At first you laugh, but it is hardly funny when an elite warrior cannot recognise a unicorn.

You set him straight.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.4.64.1.mess:
'Good thing he released the magical power we needed into the surroundings! We could turn Kosmix’s spell against Grandioso and reverse the course of events, which had been heading the wrong way ...' one mage tells another.

'And the wrong way they shall keep heading, hahaha ...' you interrupt, bursting among them. Your confidence returns.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.4.70.1.mess:
'If you wish to learn Earth Magic, then learn it you shall! Along with the proper spells ...' 
comes a voice from deep beneath the earth. Then you sink, falling and falling and falling, sensing that 

{something strange is happening to you!}

Then, with relief, you suddenly find yourself on solid ground again.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.40.16.1.mes:
A strange feeling of dread falls over you. What could it be?
As though something terrible lurks nearby ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.40.25.0.mes: 'A little stinking sulfur ... though rather more than the usual little amount. Practically a pile or a heap by now ...'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.40.42.0.mes:
Some walking lizards with strange bows in their hands surround you ...

'What do you want here, goblin?' one snaps at you.
'What do you want here, lizard? You act as though this place is yours,
but poor little beast, there is a problem: you cannot match my force!'

{The final battle erupts!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.40.70.0.mes:
'Golemina, Golemina!' a voice speaks inside you. 
'Golemina, you must save us ... the spell that brought you to the island was no longer strong enough for us, so we had to follow by ship. Unfortunately we were wrecked: we are no sailors. We are on the cliffs near ...'

Contact breaks off.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.41.25.0.mes: The flies are growing quite rebellious. You do not really know why. First they keep declaring their loyalty, then this. You have talked them round for now, but something is wrong. They seem irritable, though it is hard to say why. You have done nothing to them, and surely there is nothing nearby to upset them.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.42.37.0.mes: 'A little sulfur with a mighty smell, to give me faith along the trail…'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.42.41.0.mes: 'A little stinking sulfur, to ... this poetry is really getting on my nerves. Constantly struggling with the stink, and having to rhyme about it too? Enough, my poetic foot, leave out the verse. That stench is insane. It could knock an elephant over ... ah well.'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.42.69.0.mes:
'It looks as though we shall be on the water a long time, my lady,' announces El Capitano, the only golem with sailing experience.
'I feel hard days await us, but I sense in my stomach stones that there will be pleasant moments too. What shall we find? A powerful artifact? Friends? Spells? Help? Who knows?' he concludes.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.43.28.0.mes: 'Our lord, thank you so much for gathering the largest lumps of sulfurous stench around here. For years we have spent almost all our time unconscious because of that stink. Now it is over! We wish to serve you faithfully and fight for you to the last, er, fly!' says their spokeswoman.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.43.37.0.mes: 'A little sulfur with a mighty smell, to give me faith along the trail…'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.43.40.0.mes: 'A little sulfur with a mighty smell, to give me faith along the trail…'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.44.27.0.mes: 'A slightly larger amount of sulfur. It smells terribly strong, though. Much worse than the usual sulfur heaps. Could it be because so much sulfur lies, and has lain, all around here ...?'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.44.28.0.mes:
'A truly vast amount of stinking sulfur. Why is there so much here? And why does it smell so strong that I feel drugged? If this is not strange, I am the Pope. Which I certainly am not!'

The sulfur troubles your mind. You can practically feel it inside your head. Perhaps there has simply been so much that even a little now reeks.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.44.29.0.mes: 'A rather larger bit of stinking sulfur. Why is there a little more right here? Well, it probably does not matter. Sulfur here, sulfur there, just hurry onwards!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.44.35.0.mes:
{Liliput}, with a horde of his dear, slow, tiny little but rather warlike dwarves, has reached a swampy coast. Some flies or other are flying along with him. What use will they be? Will they carry him and his dwarves?

All he knows for certain is that he must help with something as quickly as possible!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.44.36.0.mes:
'Hmm, how very pleased I am,
I, Liliput the First, ringed by a swarm
of flying, dragonfly-like beasts to bear;
what shall I do with them here?!
They hardly get along with my little dwarven sprites;
what has that strange wizard done to our lives?
And where am I, anyway?
Is it morning, night or day?'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.44.37.0.mes:
'And there is a dreadful stench here too, sulfur,
my flies insist, but what do I know?
I am only King Liliput,
neither super-sniffer nor Robin Hood.
I have a feeling that my presence here,
with hidden drawbacks still unclear,
is meant to help Alexandr in his fight;
I only hope my aid is welcome in his sight!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.44.38.0.mes: 'A little sulfur with a mighty smell, to give me faith along the trail…'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.44.39.0.mes: 'A little sulfur with a mighty smell, to give me faith along the trail…'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.44.63.0.mes: One of your golems, the very one you recently began to suspect was slightly {retarded}, finds a {club} floating in the water. He wants to keep it, but finally yields to your arguments about golem fashion and the club’s unsuitability as an accessory, and gives it to you. Perhaps it will prove useful!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.45.28.0.mes:
'Where are we?' asks a suspicious band of even more suspicious individuals.
'What? I do not know. In the swamps, surely?' you reply.
'We seem to be lost. Will you show us the way?' Most of the band moves among your flies.
'Well, where do you want...' you begin, then realise
{it was just a dirty trick!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.45.64.0.mes: 'At last! After such long abstinence ... the Reaper shall get drunk!' comes a voice behind you. You barely have time to wonder whether one of your little golems said it, or who is speaking, when vampires swoop at you from every side. Luckily there are not too many ... and golems will hardly quench their thirst, will they?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.46.34.0.mes:
'Cliffs, water, sea? Why do I feel so ill?
Why do I feel I walk in circles still,
led by my own nose all along the way?'

Yet this sea seems somehow familiar. As though you saw it a few days ago, before setting off on this dreadful trek? But surely that is impossible. Or is it?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.46.47.0.mes: 'Come and play with us, sir!' whines one of those clawed monsters with mocking irony. He will be the first to pay, surely?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.46.5.1.mess: 'This used to be our forest. Perhaps we can defend it now, after our deaths. Above all, we mean to defend it against the one who enslaved us!' rings out a strange voice!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.46.69.0.mes:
'Well, here I am. I, Golemina, have been carried by a strange spell to this mysterious, mountainous, sandy island. Most of my golems have wandered off somewhere, too. Where can they be? I almost feel them close by. {Beyond} {those} {mountains}. But can I trust my feelings?
What now? Where to go???'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.48.46.0.mes:
{Sunny - creator of Breaking Point}

You have successfully completed
{the second part of the game}: Alexandr’s journey through green lands, wintry lands, and green lands again.

But to succeed fully, you must prepare well. For somewhere, {the Breaking Point} still awaits you. It draws near!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.49.30.0.mes: Alex’s message fills you with sadness for a moment, because of Jasmína. Why must they keep reminding you? Then you put two and two together (getting four and a little extra, a fairly good result) (for Liliput) and urge your poor little horse into a gallop. If you must hurry, then hurry!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.49.70.0.mes: 'Golemina, our lady! Allow me to kneel before you. We could not follow because of those dragons. They did not notice us, but we could not get away and could only watch your progress anxiously. Thank you for saving us, my lady. We are glad you found us and that we can once again serve a good cause.'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.5.0.0.messa: {Sonja} commands the archers who happened to be camping near Kosmix’s castle. She has no idea what is happening, no idea what the GO is (Original or Quatro). But that does not mean she dislikes it. She loves change. She loves adventure. She loves excitement. And she usually rushes into everything. But today she DOES NOT KNOW!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.5.38.0.mess:
Look, a sash.
Did someone want it?
Yes, someone did.
Now, should I give it to him?

Well, I suppose ... yes.

In any case, I shall take it now.
No one even seems to be guarding it, ha ha.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.5.66.1.mess:
'Grandioso! What have you done to us? What are we doing here?'
That is Brother Kenny’s familiar voice. You did it: the monks are here! Yet you can hardly rejoice. Certain death awaits them here with you, because you are useless.

'Hello, brothers. Welcome, monks. Welcome, crusaders. Good to see you, good ...'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.50.61.0.mes:
'Why do you keep following me?' comes a familiar voice. 
It is the lord who would not give his name, only listing his nine colleagues, now dust! How did he escape? And what is his name?

{'I, lord and also}
 Brother Reaper, that is me!' the strange vampire answers your thoughts.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.50.70.0.mes: 'These are the Dragon Mountains. Only bone dragons, ghost dragons and paper dragons may seek shelter here. But you are clearly something else. So perish!' a voice floats down from above. Ah, little dragons are attacking you.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.51.69.0.mes:
'The Law has flown in with us!' comes a cry above your head. 
A dragon’s wing almost knocks your esteemed head off. Or did it pass through it? Who knows? There is no time for such thoughts: you must fight for your lives ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.52.69.0.mes: 'Something is glittering around the bend, my lady! Probably not worthless tinsel. Nor pearls for your lovely, seductive ... hmm, am I showing off a little for someone made of stone? Anyway, there is some red, shiny stone star or other, and I think I have fallen in love with it ...' blushes the aptly named golem Redling.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.53.7.0.mess: 'Oh, before I forget,' another zealot sidles up behind you, 'before his little son quartered him with the hatchet, the Spirit of that forest sent you another strange spell through me. I hope I remember it properly and do not botch it. Perhaps I can teach you over a few attempts ...'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.54.15.0.mes:
'Now we just open it and we are out!' rejoice the remnants of your company.

They are right. It opens, and then ... what then? Surely no one would build such obstacles unless they guarded something?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.54.5.0.mess:
A good dozen ogres block your path.
'Will you hand over the little woman willingly for our amusement, or shall we just take her? Well, blue-skins? Want a fight?'

Your men look strange. Soon they seem to be considering which option to choose. 
Fortunately, the ogres attack first ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.54.62.0.mes:
Now you have overheard the conversation yourself. There is a vampire gathering on this island (heaven help us), and all the talk concerns vampire lords who supposedly have a pendant, perhaps of the sea guard, or a little fish or something.
No man would be much the wiser. Let alone a woman, eh?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.54.63.0.mes: One of your golems overheard something among the rocks about vampires holding a strange gathering on this island. There was also talk of a sea and a pendant, or a sea pendant, which the vampires supposedly took as a trophy from mysterious liches. And someone called {Reaper}. Who could that be? And where?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.55.15.0.mes:
'I am getting seasick here,' laments one of your men. 'I have had enough! I am not turning this rudder any longer!'

He lets go of the helm, and the ship lurches among the rocks. You rush to help and steer it out of the worst danger, though you too feel ill. The crew is utterly dispirited ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.55.4.0.mess:
Around the bend you see a familiar blue, as though your little zealots were camping there. Yet they are all following you, rigid with fear. Plainly, their robes are full of terror.
'Chins up, my dears,' you try to encourage them. 'We cannot give up after coming so far, can we?'

They pay no attention.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.56.61.0.mes:
One of your golems, called Swiftfoot, wandered deeper into the mountains and overheard an interesting conversation about a rare object owned by one of the two highest vampire lords. They are supposedly to meet at Knight Ugh’s, and both are on their way there.
{Interesting news. But what use is it?}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.56.9.0.mess:
'There, I managed to put that spell together,' the zealot, that teacher of nations, sidles up again, this time from the front. He looks as though he expects a reward, but you make it clear he has no chance unless he teaches you another useful spell.

The zealot hurries off somewhere to meditate ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.57.1.0.mess: 'I once heard a tale of wandering bands living among the rocks, ambushing people on strange wolves. The only defence is to keep them from getting close, because then they slash and slash and slash. You simply have to be faster than they are,' rambles a wounded zealot in a fever.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.57.61.0.mes: Swiftfoot has returned from another scouting trip, this time unauthorised. These trips must stop. Who knows whom he visits and why? What if he is not entirely loyal? He looks quite confused. He says the highest lord is someone called {Ataky}. And {Reaper} is merely his younger brother, from somewhere on the western shores ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.57.8.0.mess:
Another monk comes to bother you. He says he smells something in the air and wants to guide you to it. It will surely be tremendous, he says: he can simply smell it.
You do not know whether to listen to this Sniffer and his smells. He is persistent, though, and wants to travel a mile east ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.59.0.0.mess:
'Ha, ha, hahaha,' horrible laughter spreads through the rocks, multiplied by echoes. Suddenly the earth parts, and strange skeletons climb out. One wears a deathly dead little crown of twigs.
Suddenly you understand. The trouble is, you cannot concentrate on your better spells here ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.59.69.0.mes: Several liches attack from the rocks. You cannot imagine what they hope to achieve with so pitifully few of them. You will squash them like fresh raspberries. Raspberries. Strawberries. Cherries. Where have they all gone? While you daydream, the battle is already raging. Well, battle ... what battle, really?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.59.70.0.mes: Several liches attack from the rocks. You cannot imagine what they hope to achieve: there are not even ten. You will chop them to matchwood. Matchwood? To little pieces, plaits, tiny miserable bloody tangles of noodles and ... While you daydream, the battle is already raging. Well, battle ... what battle, really?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.6.66.1.mess:
You tried desperately to summon more crusaders, and monks from Kosmix’s university. It cost you far too much strength, with no result. Depression overwhelms you. Your father always called you good for nothing. Perhaps he was right: you cannot look after yourself. 
{You feel so wretched!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.60.0.0.mess:
As you enter these rocks, booming, mad laughter seems to welcome you. Where have you heard laughter like that? What does it mean?
'Good God, stand by us,' you hear a zealot pray, hands clasped and eyes raised towards the heavens.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.60.50.0.mes: 'Good thing you found us, Lord Alexandr. We have no idea why that strange Kosmix brought us here, or how we were meant to escape. We are slowly starving, and the water is far too salty to drink. You will get us out, will you not, sir?' says one of the half-dozen horsemen.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.61.3.0.mess: Despite his seven lives, you defeated the leader of all the mad trees after a hard battle. His once-green crown of woven twigs withered with him. But his cruel mockery before he died miserably in agony makes you suspect another trap still awaits you somewhere. Where? And what kind?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.61.4.0.mess:
'Now only I remain, with a few helpers who took shelter among my trees, now lifeless. My personal flying retinue! I do not know what drove you to slaughter us, but now, now the hour of vengeance has come!' thunders a huge tree’s twisted mouth above you.

{You must defend yourself!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.61.70.0.mes: 'You just missed Lord Ironik. Why not pay him a visit? He is a little to the north, miss. You will have far less fun with me. And I, the eldest royal son, the famous Lord Ataky, simply find no joy in war any more. You always kill me, and I come back to life? Is that fair?'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.62.22.0.mes:
'So this is the little spell those beasts were hiding,' says your oldest zealot.
'The Haste spell ... I shall be Swiftfoot, I shall be Swiftfoot, I shall be Swiftfoot, I shall be Swiftfoot, ...'

The zealot cannot be silenced. Best shoot him, though you would probably miss him.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.62.6.0.mess: 'Weeee haaaave you now, you ... you who helped that impossible old conservative who has haunted this place for thousands of years as our forest’s Spirit. We free trees do not want him here, and we do not want you either. We mean to avenge the fallen, every last one. Prepare to die ...' rumble dozens of trees.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.62.62.0.mes:
Swiftfoot went scouting again, once more without permission. You should punish him. But he enjoys the lash, and you can think of no other punishment. 
He brings news, though. Reaper owns a sacred human pendant, a golden sea fish or something, terribly dangerous to all undead. But why? And how?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.62.69.0.mes: Swiftfoot ran off on another scouting mission, this time official and compulsory, and never returned. He is probably done for. Well, life goes on. But his brother, called Hundredfoot Metelka, claims he sensed his last few breaths, full of dreadful fear. Terrible danger must await here. But where?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.63.4.0.mess:
Things look very bad: the trees around you drown in rage.
You wish to explain that those fallen trunks behind you probably rotted or befriended woodworm, but already trees whirl all around ...
One laughs and shouts:
{'Who is wetting her little knickers here?'}

This time it is not sweat ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.63.6.0.mess:
Once again you have strayed dangerously close to the forest. The horses are restless, and even the zealots huddle deeper in their robes. But you are Adriana, noble and highborn: you must look proud and fearless. And so you do. If only your beloved could see you ... 

{Ah, where can he be?}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.63.62.0.mes:
A pair flies over the rocks. Vampires, that is. One asks the other why he is so bloody, whom he drained.
'Well, see that rock over there?'
'Yes!'
'Well, I did not!'

You cannot help laughing. Luckily they do not notice you. 

Then one remarks: 'Good thing the golden fish is ours for ever now. Otherwise...'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.63.69.0.mes:
'You should not have come this way, you street-spawned slut!' remarks the familiar Reaper, almost casually. 'I am going back for my pendant, and nothing will stop me and my vampires today. NOTHING! I do not care if Ironik toys with you and lets you live!'
{This looks bad ...}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.63.70.0.mes: Where are you running? In the graveyard you are lying. Do you believe me now? Are we not lucky to keep meeting? What? You will punch me? Could your sweet lips have misspoken? Did you mean you will pleasure me? I am rather pleased with myself today ... justice shall have its way ... then I shall fly Ironically away!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.63.8.0.mess:
Strange creatures attack, apparently crawling out of the log Sniffer sniffed out. Let him try using that Cyrano nose of his against these stinking, fly-ridden beasts now ... 

'What might these monsters be guarding?' you chirp into a zealot’s hood.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.64.18.0.mes: The young, thoughtful zealot, that teacher of nations, presents the results of his study of the surrounding rocks. You ought to scold him for deciphering rocks instead of fighting, but what if the spell he discovered proves useful?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.64.43.0.mes:
'Perhaps only unarmed people may enter, and perhaps only their leader or something, because ...' says one of your men. Tomb guardians begin swooping down from the rocks.

{They attack with flaming swords!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.64.44.1.mes: 'At last! I thought I had forgotten those spells I used so often to help students achieve better results. Fortunately, FORTUNATELY, I remembered. Now I shall show them all what an ARROW can do. The place will be swarming with arrows!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.64.70.0.mes:
'There we are. A little farther on ... and we shall reach the end!' you urge your wretched little stone fellows. 'Get up. Be hard and strong as stone again. We can do it. Let us get to it. Onwards! Move. Quickly!'
They seem rather unwilling now.

And they do not know what they just avoided. Well, what did they avoid?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.65.62.0.mes:
'Greetings, Golemina. You know, I dislike worms. I am flying over to get you, with company this time. Even Lord Ironik cannot attack suuuch a brave 
{lowborn slut} alone, armed only with aristocratic superiority. I look forward to your sweet blood. Once you fall into the sand, we shall have a wonderful time. Do not forget it!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.65.69.0.mes:
'Irony, irony, that is my delight, irony, irony, that is my ... how does it go, dear Goleminka? Are you not pleased we are together again? Your darling has returned!'

You want to spit in his face, but knowing him, that would only wash it and leave him licking his lips. Can he never be destroyed for good?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.65.8.0.mess:
'My lady, I have worked it out ...'
After an awkward silence, you must humbly ask one of your little blue fellows: 'Worked what out?'
You try to seem uninterested, though the opposite is true.
'How to make the lightning those birds use. Would you like to learn?'

{'Well, yes.'}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.66.1.0.mess:
The forest Spirit’s strange, booming voice speaks again:
'Brave Adriana, I cast my mightiest spell upon your warriors. If you obtain the Centaur’s Axe, the spell will reveal its full power ...'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.66.62.0.mes:
'That royal family is getting on my nerves,' you sigh to yourself.

'{Hard for her, is it not?}' teases a passing golem, probably Swiftfoot. You prefer not to wonder quite what he means. You have more important matters to consider. Where is Lord Reaper? And why does everyone keep mentioning that artifact?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.66.9.0.mess:
Several enormous golden birds fly over the sea. One of your zealots stares rudely and casually takes aim at them.
It is too late to tell him to stop. A few lightning bolts strike towards you, luckily all missing, followed a moment later by the accursed flying monsters themselves.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.67.70.0.mes:
'Enough, Ironik! Now you will learn what elbows and knees and everything else can do. You are really ... terribly annoying me!' you call first, for once.
'Thank you for the compliment. Very good indeed!'
'You, you ... when you die this time, I shall eat every worm in this sand, and that will be that!'
'Hmm, a shame I will not live to see it. A shame.'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.68.1.0.mess:
'If you wish to challenge us to a fight to the death, so be it, fair beauty. As captain of all these centaurs, I salute your luxuriant locks. If you wish, you may give me ... 
a challenge, by answering yes, to fight for a Magic Scroll bearing a spell that kills the mighty!'

'Well, shall we have at it?'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.68.2.0.mess:
More archers hiding in the surrounding trees try to attack your rear.
'Adriana, these look a little different from the last ones. A specially trained unit, it seems ... and they even have elves over there!' your oldest zealot tries to tell you.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.68.22.0.mes:
Several titans lounge atop the tent. As soon as they spot you, they open fire without warning. Before you know it, several of your best men are gone.

What now? Good advice is desperately needed ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.68.56.0.mes: Well, look at that heap of gold! It will certainly come in handy!!!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.68.70.0.mes:
The worms tasted dreadful, but perhaps he is finally gone. Perhaps letting him rise from the dead again and again would have been better than eating them. You will dream about that for years. And what will Alex say? 
'Alex?!'
'Alex?!'
'Alex?!'
'Can you hear me? Are you still alive?'

A magical answer comes ... so he lives!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.69.1.0.mess:
A strange, booming voice speaks:
'I am the mighty Spirit of this forest. Taking pity on you and your poor zealots, I shall give you something to help, if you
bring me the {Centaur’s Axe} for my little son ... some local trees have gone mad and stolen it. They carried it somewhere west.'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.69.17.0.mes: Your crew watches wide-eyed as swimmers in blue robes fight sharks. Only at your command do your little zealots launch destructive smoky missiles at the sharks. In the end you rescue 4 Zealots from the sea. They were revived near the coast by the forest Spirit’s spell, then carried here by the currents.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.69.2.1.mess: 'I have entered the devil’s domain! But should I make a pact with the devil? Something tells me I will have to defeat hordes of devils rather than befriend them and make merry. Enough pondering: onwards against the enemy! If I can reach him through these volcanoes!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.69.40.1.mes: {Augustus} feels useless. Beside him stand only a monolith and several barriers in a row. The barriers cannot be crossed. The monolith is one-way, making it rather risky. So noble Augustus can only sit on his ar.... his horse, and wait. Or enter the monolith?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.69.70.0.mes:
'I, Ataky ...'
'And I, Reaper, me too ...'
'And I, Aja ...'
'And I and me too and I and I, Reaper, and ...'

Are they making your head spin? Or is it the worms? What do they want? Revenge for Ironik?

'We ... we wish to avenge our brother ... and, as he would say, above all those worms!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.7.34.1.mess: 'Surely you do not mean to take anything from me by force? Or are you so grandiose that you do?' asks one of the titans.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.7.54.0.mess: A powerful vision comes upon you: a waking dream of a dark tower. You do not know what it means, but there is a tower just ahead, so you might try approaching it and see. Probably not the same one, but what if it is?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.7.65.1.mess: 'Kosmix, this cannot go on. I need more men. Mana would be welcome too: I often need spells to get by. Perhaps it would help if you could bring my monk friends here somehow, but I should not ask too much. In fact, I can try myself, can I not? I have all the knowledge and power I need!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.7.69.1.mess: Out of nowhere, a group of flying, lion-like creatures attacks from the deep forest. What animals are these? Where did they come from? Are those pincers on their tails venomous? Do they mean you harm?
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.70.0.0.mess: {Adriana} found herself in a strange forest. Besides knowing that a powerful spell had brought her here, she also feels she must help Alex, her beloved, and perhaps even Golemina, that ... that woman who dislikes her and keeps flirting with Alex. She only hopes those two are not together.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.70.21.0.mes:
'This blue tent will come in handy, as sure as I'm a zealot,' said one of your wise little blue zealots. 
At that moment he seemed so sweet that you almost stopped wanting them to risk their necks for you and wanted to deal with your enemies yourself from now on.
But that probably wouldn't be a good idea ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.70.31.1.mes:
'ALEX, YOU WILL HAVE TO DEAL WITH
IMPORTANT AFFAIRS CONCERNING ALL
OF ELURIA. ARE YOU IN ANY WAY
PREPARED AS A STATESMAN?
DO YOU HAVE SOME PASS,
DOCUMENT OR MEDALLION
PROVING YOU ARE WORTHY OF SUCH
HIGH-LEVEL STATE
NEGOTIATIONS? I HOPE SO,
BECAUSE OTHERWISE I,
{KOSMIX}, WILL BE OUT OF LUCK!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.70.44.1.mes: 'There's not much here after all. First it sparkles so brightly, and now it's just this pathetic little lump ...'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.70.60.1.mes: Where on earth has that teleport taken you???
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.70.64.0.mes:
'Well, look at that, a lookout tower buried in tall vegetation. The things you find here, even when you're almost half-blind, like me,' remarked one of the golems.
And indeed, there is a lookout tower to the southwest. But you cannot climb it; it is completely overgrown. What a wasted journey into this jungle!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.70.70.0.mes:
'It's over! We've won!' cried many of your warriors. Many, many ... well, rather few, actually. Only a handful made it through. The mass for the fallen took just a few minutes, then you ate worms for several hours, spent thirty-four minuuutes vomiting, and now you are ready to pass through the monolith. 
{Where might it lead?}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.71.22.0.mes:
'You daughter of a ... of a bitch, you rotten strawberry, you squashed raspberry, you flattened blackberry, you finely ground buckwheat ... you ...' several titans curse you clumsily.
'We slept through your battle with our parents, and that's the only reason they ... they lost,' they add pompously. 'Now we'll tear you a new ... right arm!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.71.63.0.mes:
'Shall we fly up to the lookout? Look out for victims? What do you say, my dear friends?'
asks the smallest vampire of the others.

{Oh dear, vampires again.} You are slowly getting tired of them. You would rather fight those liches, or whatever they're called. Even the most famous one, Vandro or Sandro or something. Ah.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.71.7.0.mess:
'Good gracious, it really is the sea. Endless stretches of water and water and mountains.'
Adriana began sobbing bitterly, joined by her horse and all her faithful little zealots. The nearby lake began growing at an alarming rate.
Fortunately, after several hours there were no tears left to shed, but the sadness remained.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.71.8.0.mess:
'Your most radiant Princess,' one zealot knelt before you. 'I would like to ask for your ... your ... permission to carry on, or we will perish miserably here, and losing me, at least, would be a shame, wouldn't it ... perhaps we can go round the lake to the west ...'

{Of course you agreed.}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.71.9.0.mess:
The waves break against the shore in a thoroughly embarrassing fashion; a few drops have even splashed your magnificent battle dress. Thank goodness the little zealots did not notice. They would certainly want to have the dress dried so you wouldn't catch cold. Their concern can be touching at times.
That does not change the fact that those waves are embarrassingly high.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.8.12.0.mess:
'A living soul, after all these years ... alas, soon there will only be a dead one here, eh, mortal woman,' said an elderly mage.

'Oh yes, there'll be dead souls here. About ten, I'd say. Yes, ten, more or less?'

'And how do you propose to arrange that?' The mage waved his staff and seems to be preparing for battle!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.8.18.0.mess: 'So the great mage is lying on the ground, finished, and I'm waiting to see what I'll learn. I'm really curious! Spelling or grammar, perhaps? Oh, look, something's happening. Something's getting into my head. Splendid! What will it be, then? Some marvellous spell?' you mutter to yourself ...
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.8.58.0.mess: Why the hell is a bunch of crackpot monks guarding a few gold pieces in these remote frozen mountains ... that, more or less, is what the followers who have survived your journey so far are muttering now.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.8.65.1.mess:
Things can never be so bad that they cannot get worse. It looks as though the hundreds of monsters you have just slaughtered have returned from the depths of hell itself and are attacking you again. What luck you're having today! 
You silently snap the twigs you tore from a tree that no longer belongs in the orchard. Why, anyway???
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.8.68.1.mess:
'I hope, sir, that wasn't just the beginning. Because that was very bad indeed. Good thing you gave us such support, or I don't think we would have made it!' one of your men tells you.

Perhaps he is right. Perhaps it was just the beginning. After all, things can never be so bad that they cannot get worse, and perhaps that wasn't so bad after all!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.9.11.0.mess:
'Oh, no you don't! We know what you want here, we know very well, and we'll defend this place and beat you to death, you Alex-loving scoundrel!'

A fine welcome from a mage who still has milk on his chin. Surely even you can cast spells better than he can!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.9.12.0.mess:
'The Prince of Eluria himself! Welcome among those who look down on Eluria from the heights of heaven. Care for a few scratches? Or to lose your head? Well, well, just say the word, Your Highness ... ha ha.'

This mage really seems to be a Joker with a capital J. But he probably isn't joking, which means, hey-ho, hey-ho, another battle is about to go!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.9.14.0.mess:
A beautiful sprite runs up to you through the meadow flowers.

'Oh, sir, did you know strange things happen in the forest up there?'
'Where, my lovely stranger? Tell me.'
'Where ... well, everywhere. I'd show you ... but they'd be angry!'

You wanted to ask Who, but only the north wind now whispers where she stood.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.9.23.1.mess:
You should have called me master,
Then you needn't await disaster.
Nor feel that strange wind blowing faster.
Did you call me? Satan, your master?
No? You say no?
Did a black cat cross your path?
Did a devil fly across your path?
{All things come to those who wait.}

{And then they attacked!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.9.58.0.mess:
SURELY YOU DID NOT THINK THOSE FELLOWS IN ROBES WERE MEANT TO HARM YOU. NO, NOT AT ALL, NEVER. THEY WERE ONLY LOOKING FOR THE ONE PLACE IN THIS FROZEN LAND FROM WHICH I CAN SEND YOU MY POWER.

That must be Kosmix!

MAY THE FORCE BE WITH YOU !!!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.9.66.1.mess:
'In the hundred years we have lived here beneath the trees of this orchard, no passing traveller has ever had the cheek to strip every tree!!!' A hunched little figure emerged, holding a staff or a blunt spear. 'You will pay dearly for your transgression! For your mortal sin!'

{This is bad!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.9.68.0.mess:
'This is our mine! And we won't let anyone near it!' cried one of the club-wielding ogres.
Beating them should be child's play, shouldn't it? Your horsemen on their mounts are almost as tall as the smallest of those little giants!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.guards.9.68.1.mess:
'One of the magical harpies flying past said some unknown traveller murdered the scorpicores!'
'What? Impossible! A traveller???'
'I don't know, that's what she said ...'
'Then he deserves punishment!'

One of your crusaders rashly stepped out of the forest's shade.
{'Punishment? What sort? From you, perhaps?'}

'GET HIM!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.header.description:
With the help of a few of his most faithful warriors and the men of the great sorcerer Kosmix, Prince Alexandr must obtain a mysterious object that should help save the world.
An arduous, adventure-filled journey lies ahead, but you must see it through to a successful end!

(c) Sunny 2000 - version for H3 - Roe
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.header.name: Breaking Point
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.0.name: Lord of Griffins
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.106.name: Avar
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.12.name: Grandioso
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.13.name: Sonja
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.20.name: Liliput I.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.34.name: Golemina
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.4.name: Alexandr
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.6.name: Augustus
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.88.name: Drakon I.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.9.name: Adriana
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.91.name: Konias
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.95.name: Lightning I.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.heroes.97.name: Theodorich
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.monster.0.0.0.mess:
'I am {Kosmix's Second Mage!} I am to tell you, Lord Alexandr, what Breaking Point is. It is the place where waters flow silently through a valley of underground rocks into a mountain reservoir, the place where black dragons hold their annual meetings! Do you understand?!'

{The mage suddenly turned blue for a moment and attacked you!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.monster.0.12.0.mes:
'Aren't you Alexandr?' asked a gold golem.
'Why?'
'Where is Golemina, Alex!?'
'I don't know, she ...'

'Enough, you scoundrel! She was supposed to be with you, you were supposed to protect her, you were supposed to ... and now we have to make you pay!'

{They attacked you!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.monster.0.16.1.mes: 'Where are you hurrying off to, little man?' the harpies ask. And they certainly want nothing you would like.
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.monster.0.2.0.mess:
'I am {Kosmix's Fourth Mage!} I am to tell you, Lord Alexandr, what Breaking Point is. Breaking Point is a place underground, surrounded by lava, where infernal forces rob one of the ability to cast spells, a place that costs you a great many spell points! Do you understand?!'

{The mage suddenly turned purple for a moment and attacked you!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.monster.0.4.0.mess:
'I shall become {Kosmix's Fifth Mage!} For now I am merely an apprentice. I am to tell you, Lord Alexandr, that Kosmix used his magical powers to build the lovely castle of Ni-Moya in precisely the spot where you will need it!'

{The mage suddenly turned green for a moment and attacked you!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.monster.0.71.1.mes: 'You chose Air Magic? A good choice, but I don't know whether you are strong enough to be worthy of it. Prove yourself!'
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.monster.1.1.0.mess:
'I am {Kosmix's Third Mage!} I am to tell you, Lord Alexandr, what Breaking Point is.
It is a place underground where, beyond the lava crossing, Satanas himself tears holes in the ground,
where, concealed in his lair, he often raises Armageddon's Blade towards the heavens!
Do you understand?!'

{The mage suddenly turned red for a moment and attacked you!}
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.monster.1.57.0.mes:
'Surely you don't want myyyy Gold?!' a gold dragon shouted and hissed.

'And what if I do ... ?' you replied.

But he was already flying towards you. And his intentions do not seem friendly!
map.[roe] - bod zlomu.monster.1.66.0.mes: 'Here I stand guard over the little hut where magical powers were once bestowed upon us.
