Your supreme lord appreciates your successes against the enemy and is sending some of his best servants to help you.
An epidemic has broken out among your troops. You summoned the best surgeons, as you desperately need your warriors. Treatment was costly, but successful.

You pulled off a devilish trick. Your guards captured a builder who boasted that he could construct a building in a single night. You decided to test him. Unfortunately, you didn't tell him what to build, and now you're curious to see what has sprung up within your town.
map.[roe] - doly.event.0.description: Try to capture all the mines.
map.[roe] - doly.guards.27.35.1.message: You want Meteor Shower? You must fight for it ...
map.[roe] - doly.header.description: You must capture all the mines.
map.[roe] - doly.header.name: Mines
map.[roe] - doly.sign.27.27.1.message: The scroll holds a powerful fire spell!
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.0.descript:
A message from the priest on the Island of Final Rest: 
I have established telepathic contact with Father Berdorth. Everyone thought he had fallen in the Last Battle, but in truth he is imprisoned with part of his army somewhere in the northwestern Land of Fire.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.1.descript:
To our southern allies:
We, the archers of the east, salute our allies in the south. Our company awaits you at the southeasternmost tip of the Land of Fire, near Dragon City. On to victory!!!
P.S. We hope we can hide from the infernal monsters until you arrive.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.10.descrip:
You really can learn everything at the market in Podhorská ...
Someone brought word that a watch observatory stands somewhere near the old harbour, where partisans keep a lookout for the enemy.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.2.descript:
A message from the north has spread across the land.
It is a letter to the people from Lord Michael:
The enemy's numerical advantage is immense. Thank goodness the archers of the east are coming to help us on both flanks ... I can see some already drawing their crossbows and bows ... Perhaps we shall win ...      Lord Michael
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.3.descript: It has been a week since the battle with the demons began, and still no news ... Who knows what happened there ...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.4.descript:
A soldier arrived in the village:
Oh God, we lost, and Lord Michael is dead ... I carried his body out of the Land of Fire and left it in the monks' care on the Island ... It was a terrible battle, and the archers from the ea ... arghhhh - an arrow in the soldier's throat cuts him short ...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.5.descript:
You awaken on a beach, another crewman lying beside you. You are alive. Sadly, you are probably the hurricane's only survivors...
But is this nightmare over? You look around and sense that the once beautiful Green Land lies beneath a shadow of fear and uncertainty...
What is happening here?
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.6.descript:
The night is over, but the sky is still dark ...
Now a red glow appears on the horizon ... Nooo!!! Those are not the first rays of sunlight. Fiery letters spell out an ultimatum across the sky ... Spring will come, and with it hell shall engulf Green Land.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.7.descript: Some people are stopping work and fleeing south ... Everyone takes whatever they can carry, including resources ... Theft from the warehouses is becoming ever more frequent ...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.8.descript:
Many people fear the coming days, but some gather in small groups and hide throughout the countryside, preparing for guerrilla warfare ...
Perhaps trying to unite them would be worthwhile ... But who knows where all the units are hiding ...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.event.9.descript:
People whisper at the market in Podhorská:
Several partisans have supposedly hidden in the eastern part of the cliffs where crystals are mined ...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.0.51.0.me: To the south, you see an obelisk rising towards the sky. Strange shapes are carved upon it...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.0.53.0.me:
You hear branches cracking ...
The previously motionless trees begin closing in around you, suddenly cutting off your retreat. Echoing voices address you:
“No stranger has ever beheld our sacred obelisk ... And you shall be no exception!!!”
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.10.49.0.m:
A sudden crack of branches, a deep roar from the heart of the woods ...
The trees begin moving ... The tendrils of previously peaceful plants begin wrapping around you ... The forest attacks!
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.10.50.0.m:
The forest is dark and hostile ... They do not seem fond of intruders here ... But you have permission to enter, so surely nothing bad will happen to you ...
Or will it?
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.11.36.0.m: Hssss ... Land-dwelling worm, this wreck belongs to us now!
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.12.61.0.m:
A band of warriors is hiding in a little cave at the foot of the cliffs ... After a brief discussion, they decide to come with you ...
You also learn that another group might be hiding somewhere nearby ...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.14.52.0.m: Damn, you've stepped in ... You don't want to know what. The drinking sessions in this dive must be pretty rough ... Well, on the other hand, you'll be more careful next time ...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.15.50.0.m: The vomit on the steps guarantees that you will find capable recruits here.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.15.54.0.m: A completely plastered man is lying here. Nobody around ... What has the lad got in his pockets?
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.15.59.0.m:
A band of partisans is preparing for guerrilla warfare here ...
You hear one soldier remark:
“I don't see the men who fortified themselves near Podhorská anywhere ... They'd be useful too.”
Unfortunately, before you can question him further, he disappears into the crowd ...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.16.63.0.m:
You want to enter the mines, but a barricade blocks the entrance. A man stands on it, looking anything but friendly ...
“This place is taken! Think you're the only ones who thought of hiding from the demons? Get lost, but leave your belongings!” At his signal, a gang of thugs pours out from behind the barricade ...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.19.54.0.m:
Another rescued castaway stands on the shore ... You wave to him happily, but when he turns towards you, you see madness in his eyes ...
With a terrible roar, he draws his sword and lunges at you. From his screams, it is clear he blames you for the sinking of the ship ...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.2.25.0.me:
The captive monk should be somewhere around here...
Deep in your heart, you pray that he has resisted the temptations of the hellish monsters and remained faithful to the Green Land and the cause of good... Perhaps the tortures of his prison have not broken him...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.21.56.0.m: A band of partisans keeps watch in this makeshift observatory for enemies approaching from the north.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.21.66.0.m: Cleverly built platforms nestle among the treetops... These people do not intend to surrender their alchemist's laboratory to the enemy without a fight...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.22.53.0.m:
The water around the ships begins to foam... Sea monsters start clambering aboard...
"Hssss... Land-dwelling worm, this belongs to us now!"
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.23.68.0.m:
You see a small band at the crossroads...
They are volunteers from the village of Lipov, a little way south.
They gladly join your company...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.26.60.0.m:
You meet a small group of men...
“Errr... greetings, sir... err... we really aren't doing any shady business here... huh... we're here... err... because of you... yes... err... we want to help you... err... don't we, lads? 
Well, better a battle than a prison cell, eh...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.27.28.0.m: Hssss... Landbound worm, sink to the bottom!
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.29.45.0.m:
Here is the entrance to the Grove of Eternal Rest... 
A sign hanging by the entrance reads: " Please be quiet. This is a place of meditation "
P.S. Please do not rob the tombs.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.3.44.0.me:
The trees suddenly begin to move... They turn their crowns towards you, and you hear them speak:
We, the guardians of the northern forest, understand why you are here and will gladly join your army... We shall help you drive the devil from our land.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.30.55.0.m: How maddening... Just off the coast, a ship rocks on the waves, having miraculously survived the storm. Unfortunately, you have no way to reach it...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.31.46.0.m: A company of monks emerges from the monastery. Their blue cloaks and hoods, drawn low over their brows, shine in the setting sun. You feel immense power pulsing around them... This is the help you need...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.31.71.0.m:
The sawmill is deserted... No one has worked here for a long time... Time to change that.
You need a new ship, after all.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.33.16.0.m: The monsters in the forward fortress await you... The Prince of Hell already knows you are in his territory, but had no idea your army was so powerful... You will scatter this little band with ease! Won't you?
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.33.68.0.m:
The path begins to vanish among the roots of ancient trees...
Their crowns conceal the sky, and suddenly the sounds of the forest surround you...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.33.7.0.me:
Here is the seat of all evil. Pillars of fire line a road paved with human skulls. The city must be razed, and the demon Diabolus destroyed along with his fiendish abominations! Your armies look to you, desperate resolve awakening in every heart... 
Lead us TO THE ATTACK!!!
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.34.12.0.m: This is the battlefield where Lord Michael fell... Ruin and devastation lie everywhere... Creatures of nightmare still feast upon the bodies of the Green Land's soldiers... The stench of decay spreads in every direction... Dread begins to tighten its grip upon your soldiers' throats... You stand at the edge of the valley of death...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.34.47.0.m: By the obelisk, you see a monk painstakingly copying a design carved in the stone into a thick book.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.36.55.0.m: Ha! There are the new docks. You see feverish work on new ships.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.37.55.0.m:
You see a group of armed men...
Their leader—a knight with a great axe—rounds on you:
"Halt! That ship is ours. You're not the only one who wants to get out before the demons arrive!"
He draws his axe and charges at you.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.4.54.0.me:
Deep voices suddenly rumble all around:
" Intruder... intruder... destroy the intruder!!! "
The trees begin to move... Suddenly, you are trapped!!!
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.42.16.0.m: A group of demonic monstrosities dances wildly around a campfire. They are surprised, but have no intention of retreating.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.5.28.0.me:
ARMAGEDDON!?!?
The word rings a bell, but just now you cannot remember what it means...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.51.56.0.m: You see two hares mating beneath the brushwood... They clearly couldn't care less that the end of the world is coming...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.52.54.0.m: You stand where the woodland river Stříbřenka flows into the bay...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.54.61.0.m: This is the entrance to the eastern elven forest... The guards are watchful, however, and admit only those with permission...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.56.29.0.m:
This is said to be a very powerful spell...
If so, you must try it!
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.56.45.0.m: The statue has been utterly destroyed... Perhaps the people of Podhorská will manage to build a new one in time...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.56.7.0.me: A deep chasm blocks your path... It seems you cannot go this way...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.57.7.0.me:
Flames begin to bar your way...
Smoke fills the air, and the heat is becoming unbearable...
Suddenly, you see hordes of inhuman creatures emerging from the fire towards you...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.58.64.0.m: The forest ends here, and the road continues into mountains inhabited by dwarves. They are skilled warriors and even finer smiths and miners…
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.59.60.0.m: This is where the forest folk are educated...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.60.3.0.me: Who knows what the chief fiend teaches his lackeys here...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.60.67.0.m:
Far to the south, you see a dwarven mine... 
WAIT!
You see something else... An army of dwarves is camped around great fires. Could this be the promised aid the dwarf in the east spoke of?
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.66.48.0.m: White shadows fly through the forest... Hundreds of pounding hooves shake the earth... Here graze Lady Marion's war unicorns...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.66.51.0.m: You hear something to the north, but the trees grow too thickly to see through... What could it be?
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.7.63.0.me: Here a band of partisans is preparing for guerrilla warfare... They have no intention of leaving their village at the demons' mercy...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.70.42.0.m:
This is a magical place of peace and tranquillity... You long to lie down in the soft grass and forget the horrors lurking outside...
But you cannot, so you walk on towards the gravestone. Suddenly, you feel your body rise several feet above the ground. You spread your arms and let magical energy flow into you...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.71.57.0.m: Hmm... What might this enchanted corner of the forest conceal?
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.guards.9.58.0.me: A band of partisans is preparing for guerrilla warfare here...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.header.descripti:
A terrible storm drives your ship towards a rocky coast. Only a few hours ago, you were looking forward to docking at the Green Land's Northern Harbour. Now you and your crew are fighting for your lives...

This map was made for you by:    LEKI ,     leki@post.cz
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.header.name: Hell's Touch
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.heroes.29.name: Lady Marion
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.heroes.51.name: Lavoroh
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.heroes.53.name: Diablo
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.heroes.6.name: Linnarfin
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.heroes.61.name: Red-Eyed Xqo
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.heroes.8.name: Father Berdoth
Welcome, sir. Unless we find a powerful ally, the demons will utterly devastate our beautiful Green Land... Become our leader and help us in our search... The monks say the lady of the forest, Lady Marion, may be sympathetic to our cause. We must go southeast, find her, and ask for aid.
Welcome, sailor. You survived the storm, but will you survive the days ahead? Hellish monsters are overrunning our land. Their invasion must be stopped. Lord Michael is preparing for a desperate battle against overwhelming odds. If he loses, nothing will stop the devilish army from laying waste to the Green Land.
I am sorry, but your ship is completely wrecked. The storm sank all our ships as well. Those demons must have had a hand in it. We began building new docks in the east, though I do not know whether they are finished... Perhaps you can find a new ship there...
You see men hurrying south.
You try to speak to them, but one shouts before you can say a word...
“You won't stop us! Nobody will stop us! No demons will get us or keep us from heading south!”
God!!! Those walking dead are wearing the tattered uniforms of the Green Land's soldiers!!!
Nooooooo!!!
Welcome, brave traveller. The peace of the dead should not be disturbed outside the appointed rituals. Yet these times demand even such deeds... The monks of the temple will aid you, and the teachers will teach you things you do not yet know.
Hoho, welcome, welcome. I am Master Gremlin. Quite a breeze down here by the water lately, wouldn't you say? That's why I built this windmill here. Go and have a look if you have a moment. Sometimes I watch the sea from its roof, too... We could watch it together, if you like.
I am truly sorry, but under the Oldest Agreement, no outsider may enter the forest under any circumstances without knowing the secret password. Your only chance is to find the monk on the island. Perhaps he will tell you the password you need...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.monster.4.61.0.m: Welcome. Give the password to the guards deep in the eastern mountains. Our brothers may help you. We are having great trouble with monsters from the western swamps and must defend our own homes... But wait, take this sword. May it give you strength in battle. You will have to pay for the war machines, though...
Greetings, Lady Marion! It is a beautiful day, and no one has brought any bad news to our forest... Do go out for a ride...
Welcome. I am Brother Duanadan. I know why you are here. Enter my humble dwelling. We must search the old records for the password needed to enter the Forest.
Welcome. Tell our kin in the west what you need. They are sure to help. Oh... I almost forgot: you must know the password to enter Dendroid Forest. They will gladly tell you in the tent. Good luck.
Damn it, that wretched storm knocked down our lighthouse statue. Take the wreckage away if you like. It is no use to us now.
Welcome. I am keeper of the unicorn herd of the sacred forest. Find their grazing grounds and take them into battle with you.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.monster.58.8.0.m: The horde of monsters charges at you without a moment's hesitation...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.monster.6.22.0.m: The prison guards are surprised, but not for long... Confident in their strength, they bar your path!
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.monster.61.4.0.m: Well, well, a new student... Come along for your first lesson. And your last! Heh heh heh!!!
“Ha! Lord Michael also thought he could rely on our company of archers. Sadly, he never realised we value our northern friends' gold more than our agreements with the south. Prepare to die!”
GODS! TREACHERY! FOUL TREACHERY!
Welcome. We know what is happening in the north, and though the horror is far away now, one day it will reach our caves. We cannot spare many warriors: goblins threaten us from beyond the mountains, and many dwarves must forge weapons. Even so, accept what little we can offer.
This is a sacred place. Only these extraordinary times allow me to let you pass.
Welcome. Command me: I am the island's guardian, and I am at your service.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.monster.8.52.0.m: Our brothers have told us what is at stake. The forest folk will go with you. Do not venture deeper into the woods. Some dendroids there are friendly, but in these dark times others trust no one without roots...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.monster.9.69.0.m: Welcome to our little village. It may be tiny, but it is picturesque.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.11.69.0.mes:
The sign reads in neat lettering:
Welcome to Podhorská—the northernmost village in our land.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.12.35.0.mes: ... a terrible storm... that is no howling wind, but the roar of horrors from another world... we are surely going to sink...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.14.56.0.mes:
North to the Drunken Sailor Tavern
East to the harbour
South to Podhorská
West to the forest (though the guards won't let you in anyway)
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.22.58.0.mes:
Neat lettering reads:
Welcome to the northern harbour of our beautiful Green Land.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.23.67.0.mes:
The Last Crossroads
West to Podhorská
North to the Harbour
East to the woods
South to Lípová and onward towards the Capital
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.25.40.0.mes: Here lies Deadrra, wife of Lord Depresor
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.26.42.0.mes: Here rests Sir Falidvin, treacherously murdered at the temple gate.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.27.45.0.mes:
A fresh inscription reads:
Here lies Lord Michael, called the Just. He died fighting the devil so that we might live.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.28.40.0.mes: Here rests Lord Depresor, the Goblin-Slayer.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.29.42.0.mes: Here rests Gardeion, brother of Lord Depresor.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.3.34.0.mess:
On a rock in the middle of the strait stands a sign:
Welcome to the Great Northern Bay, whose waters wash the northern shores of the Green Land.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.35.9.0.mess: Here the heroic archdemon Diabolus scattered the earthly worms and trampled them into the dust with their leader.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.69.71.0.mes:
This map was conceived and created for you by:
LEKI
Please write and tell me what you think, and whether you would like me to make a sequel.
The address is:  leki@post.cz
Thank you.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.70.32.0.mes:
On a rock in the middle of the strait stands a sign:
Welcome to the Great Northern Bay, whose waters wash the northern shores of the Green Land.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.sign.71.42.0.mes: Here, upon an evergreen bed, rests fair Rachel, the forever young wife of Lord Michael and mother of Lady Marion.
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.town.35.6.0.even: The owner of this town receives 1000 gold a day from the labour of his slaves...
map.[roe] - dotek pekla.town.35.6.0.name: Diabolus
map.[roe] - drací dráp.header.descriptio:
Beware!!! Evil devils mean to wipe out the dragons and have enlisted ghost dragons to help. Defeat them and save the dragons... 
                                   §Niven§
map.[roe] - drací dráp.header.name: Dragon's Claw
map.[roe] - dragonland.header.descriptio:
This land is full of peace and prosperity. There are no worries or serious problems here... except perhaps the underground.

But you are not among the fortunate who live in the light. You are among those who toil beneath the earth. The time has come to end your suffering.
map.[roe] - dragonland.header.name: DragonLand
map.[roe] - dragonland.sign.28.3.0.messa:
Entrance to the underground.

By royal decree, entry to the underground is forbidden on pain of death.
map.[roe] - dragonland.town.14.11.1.name: Akaris
map.[roe] - dragonland.town.29.29.0.even: Gifts for you and your kingdom.
map.[roe] - dragonland.town.29.29.0.name: ForestCastle
Gifts for you and your kingdom.
map.[roe] - dragonland.town.8.6.0.name: Mountain Town
map.[roe] - duel_v1.event.0.description: A messenger delivers a leaflet advertising a training centre for novice adventurers. They invite you to train at their school. As a token of goodwill, they send money to cover your travel expenses.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.event.1.description: Another swift messenger arrives with directions. After studying them, you discover that you must travel through a monolith, then follow your nose.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.event.2.description: After a long war, only two of you remain on the entire continent: you and your age-old enemy. You have already destroyed everyone else. Now a fight to the death begins. Who will emerge victorious?
map.[roe] - duel_v1.event.3.description: Explore the map thoroughly! You won't see everything at first glance!
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.14.63.0.messa:
I see you are worthy of becoming a student at our renowned school.
Enter and learn. But use the knowledge you gain with care and wisdom.
I assign you an experienced instructor to accompany you through our school.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.14.65.0.messa:
Welcome, stranger.
We do not admit just any weakling. You must pass an entrance test so we can judge whether you are worthy to set foot on our camp's sacred ground.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.21.36.0.messa: You were warned! You must pay a fine for ignoring the minotaurs' warning and killing them!
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.25.14.0.messa: Hold on to your hats—we're going downhill...
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.27.31.0.messa: I know you could use it—but you must earn it!
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.37.35.0.messa: A gold mine lies ahead, but the road to riches will hardly be easy. It looks well guarded!
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.37.52.0.messa: That bag of gold was a trap! You had barely slipped it into your pocket when savage vagabonds rushed at you!
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.37.53.0.messa: Something glinted in the nearby thicket. You went closer and found a strange bag.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.38.59.0.messa: Suddenly, a dragon flies out of the nearby dragon city after quarrelling with his mate. Seeing you, he decides to vent his anger upon you.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.45.7.0.messag: These parts look dangerous. You sense something in the air.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.46.6.0.messag: A horde of marauding elves rushed out of the nearby forest and attacked you with wild cries. Your purse was in danger—they emptied it completely.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.47.31.0.messa: I know you could use it—but you must earn it!
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.48.14.0.messa: Hold on to your hats—we're going downhill...
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.5.14.0.messag: A group of mages catches up with you and offers its services.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.5.7.0.message: A horde of marauding elves rushed out of the nearby forest and attacked you with wild cries. Your purse was in danger—they emptied it completely.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.53.35.0.messa: You were warned! You must pay a fine for disturbing the peace of a protected reserve!
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.58.66.0.messa:
Welcome, stranger.
We do not admit just any weakling. You must pass an entrance test so we can judge whether you are worthy to set foot on our camp's sacred ground.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.59.64.0.messa:
I see you are worthy of becoming a student at our renowned school.
Enter and learn. But use the knowledge you gain with care and wisdom.
I assign you an experienced instructor to accompany you through our school.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.6.8.0.message: These parts look dangerous. You sense something in the air.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.guards.65.13.0.messa: You meet a group of mages. They have been following you to help in your struggle against the enemy.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.header.description: Two mages seek dominion over the entire land. Who will triumph? Both have an equal chance, but only the better will win.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.header.name: Duel
map.[roe] - duel_v1.heroes.40.name: Abrakadabra
map.[roe] - duel_v1.heroes.44.name: Čáryfuk
map.[roe] - duel_v1.monster.0.10.0.messa:
Begone, you miserable worm!
I stole these treasures fair and square, and they belong to me alone!
map.[roe] - duel_v1.monster.21.37.0.mess: Stay out of those rocks. This is our territory. Otherwise, you will pay dearly.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.monster.30.53.0.mess: Leave our treasures alone, or we'll settle your hash!
map.[roe] - duel_v1.monster.34.16.0.mess: Why must someone always bother me?
map.[roe] - duel_v1.monster.36.33.0.mess:
You miserable little worm!
We guard the old mines where the dwarves must toil. And you want their gold?
map.[roe] - duel_v1.monster.41.16.0.mess: Come on, then. I've been waiting for you.
map.[roe] - duel_v1.monster.5.47.0.messa: Why can't you leave my little stones alone?

map.[roe] - duel_v1.monster.60.34.0.mess: You want to steal those coloured stones of mine, don't you?
map.[roe] - duel_v1.monster.64.3.0.messa: Why are you going to bother our friends?

Begone, you miserable worm!
I stole these treasures fair and square, and they belong to me alone!

map.[roe] - dust storm.header.descriptio: Long ago, three kingdoms shared a powerful artifact: a magical hat they all guarded. Then one day it was lost in the middle of the Taruharuha Desert. The kingdoms have searched ever since. Everyone knows that whoever finds it will become absolute ruler of the world, so they battle to find it first.
map.[roe] - dust storm.header.name: Sandstorm
map.[roe] - dva svety.guards.50.60.1.mes: There is plenty of gold, but it is well guarded. Think carefully before you fight for it...
map.[roe] - dva svety.header.description: Since ancient times, the world has been divided in two, keeping its kingdoms from fighting one another. Now word has spread of a secret entrance underground, where a passage is said to lead beneath the sea to the far side, allowing the other half of the world to be conquered. Good luck, but beware—unknown dangers lurk below!
map.[roe] - dva svety.header.name: Two Worlds
Those who played the original “Eifel tower” should know that this scenario is a completely different affair. I have entirely reworked its appearance and added many improvements... for the better, I hope. Enjoy the map.

On the western side of the tower lives a nation of rulers who have long oppressed the Eiffel Tower's current inhabitants, so they must be removed. And we have only just learned of a nation north of the tower. It is very powerful, and starting a war with it means certain death...

This map was created for you by: {FIREBIRD
Beta testing by: Gremlin, Hidden, Paladin
I hope you enjoy it.
You can contact me at:
firebird@email.cz
Your treasury, stored on a small island nearby, sank along with the island, and you lost
The wood you recently bought from a dealer was infested with bark beetles. It is now unusable, and you have lost it.
You had so much ore that the floor of its storeroom collapsed beneath it, and it vanished deep underground...
You made a bad bargain. You bought weapons, only to discover too late that every one was defective. You lost 5000 gold.
This time, you imported so much wood from distant lands that it did not survive the long sea voyage. You had no choice but to burn all the rotten timber.
A traveller whose life you saved gave you all his gold as a reward for rescuing him.
According to old books (from our own time), many flooded areas surround the Eiffel Tower, though most contain little of interest. The exception is a bay with mines you need.

...but we must declare war on them, if only for the oppressed inhabitants of the tower and its surroundings. They have already killed many. Take the law into your own hands and make this region safe. For Paris and for freedom!!!!!
You approach places where people and various creatures were once sacrificed to the highest gods.
You enter lands that were once very fertile but have since become a desert.
These are the remains of the old Parisian shipyards.
As you can see, danger lurks even among these rocks.
As you venture deeper into the island, you gradually lose track of where you are...
Look, a castle towers above the mountains on the western side of the tower. So we must be somewhere in the flooded former residential areas!!!
Well, an enemy who isn't even trying to kill me. I'll have to help him along.
You have found your great enemy's main castle, but a far greater enemy still awaits you.
You found it, but we won't hand it over.
A truly beautiful island, but that is not why we are here.
Come in. We will trade even what no one else will accept.
Where might these two teleporters lead ??
You pass a mighty castle, but someone has spotted you.
Visit this ancient altar as well.
Even the little that has lain here for 300 years is no use to you.
Someone sacrificed this rare, magically strengthening artifact here long ago. But as you tried to take it, several skeletons rushed at you.
You are now in the flooded areas of the Eiffel Tower in Paris.
Remember to visit our Magic Well before battle.
According to ancient legends, this road leads straight to the sea—to the flooded areas beneath the Eiffel Tower.
These old ships have survived all this time. It is a wonder they are still usable.
A gateway to other worlds.

Do not enter!!!! 
If you value your life. 

So reads an inscription beside the road.
This is the main castle of the besiegers who sought to claim all of Paris.
You take a great risk by heading this way.
Should you happen to be unwilling to make a sacrifice here, a band of skeletons will help you along....
If you wish to sacrifice something or someone, do it here.
You will find little of interest in these dark waters.
As you tried to sail into a bay where a Parisian bank stood in ages past, a band of golems made of molten gold ambushed you.
Capture this castle. You will certainly need it.
You enter uncharted regions of this French monument.
Look, that is the treasury from a ship that sank nearby.
A precious diamond mine lies before you, but you are not the only one who desires it.
Even this little bit is useful, so why leave it here ?
Truly beautiful scenery. But one of the crew had barely said so when you were no longer alone.
Forgotten lands, where once there was such glory........
At least there is something here after all !
Clearly, passing through here will be no easy matter. Renegade monks live here, having settled in no castle and preferring to make trouble for others.
A Magic Well at your service.
You smelled sulfur from afar, telling you that sulfur fields were near.
A treasure chest bobs on the waves. You tried to retrieve it, but several sea monsters ambushed you.
Saving this drowning man is in your hands.
In the days of Paris's glory, these were fertile fields outside the city. Do not expect great treasures here.
You see a crystal mine ahead, but a group of wyverns stands before it with no intention of letting you pass.
In this tent lives the only man who can give you the key to the red gate.
It seems you must watch your every step. This place is probably full of traps.
You can now see the laboratory producing a precious liquid, but it belongs to the wyverns.
Opening the red passage is unwise. Why, you ask? I'll leave that to you...
This land is ancient, but its inhabitants have been here for only some 150 years. Even that is far too long for them, so they must leave. And I, Lord Haart, shall see to it. I swear...
Over the years, the skeletons of the original Parisians have remained here.
Saving drowning people is commendable, though some think otherwise.
You sail into what was once a residential district of Paris.
Saving this drowning man is in your hands.

You are 500 years beyond our own time. Nothing you knew still exists. The Eiffel Tower in Paris has fallen, but remains fairly well preserved. Many enemies have settled in its ruins, and most of the rest of Paris is flooded. On to battle!! For Paris and for freedom!!
The Eiffel Tower 500 Years Later
Those ships sail to places of the utmost secrecy....
This is our passage, ours alone. Anyone wishing to pass must pay. And you will pay with your life.
These ships will take you to places that must remain secret from you, so we must stop you.
We guard this passage between the two worlds, but we cannot keep the peace forever. Enter, then.
You are the last person we would let in here.
Unfortunately, we cannot simply clear the way for you.
This Tree of Knowledge asked us to let no one approach. We cannot disappoint it.
We are not fools who let everyone do as they please.
We wish to be your allies. We hope you will not refuse us.
These artifacts are mine.
We wish to join you. We hope you will use this place to hide from your enemies.
What do you think? Will we let you pass? The correct answer is NO!
You will never have this mine. We serve the enemy and must not surrender it to you.
Fancy a castle? I can hardly blame you, but this castle belongs to us.
Like the pikemen, we are your friends. Will you accept us?
We never managed to learn any spells, so no one else shall have better ones either.
We always wanted to work for someone important. You are not that person.
Want to see the flooded regions of Paris? First you must get past us.
You will never have this mine. We serve the enemy and must not surrender it to you.
We do not want you to have this archers' hideout.
We won't hand them over. You must take them from us.
We are at your service. We hope our aid will bring you victory.
You will never have this mine. We serve the enemy and must not surrender it to you.
My superiors rejected me. I want to see no one, and I won't let just anyone pass.
You will never have this laboratory. We serve the enemy and must not surrender it to you.
We cannot let you into this prison. You are utterly insignificant to us.........
Another route leads to the flooded regions in the north
Welcome to the flooded regions of this long-forgotten land.
These are not Egyptian pyramids. How would those have got to Paris? A civilisation that no longer exists built these here 250 years ago.
After a long search, you have found absolutely nothing.
map.[roe] - elarie fv.event.0.descriptio: You have heard that the fabled city of Elarie, renowned for its magnificent wealth, lies somewhere near your lands. You must conquer it before your neighbours do, or all will be lost. Before you begin searching, however, you should settle a few matters in your kingdom.

map.[roe] - elarie fv.event.11.descripti: Rescue your friend Aeta from prison. You will find the prison south of the town. Once freed, Aeta will join you.
map.[roe] - elarie fv.event.12.descripti: If you reached the sea too late, your neighbours may have snatched the treasures! You can always improve your lot by completing smaller quests and events, though.
map.[roe] - elarie fv.event.2.descriptio: Try to reach the harbour as quickly as possible. Many treasures await you at sea, but your neighbours may snatch them first.

map.[roe] - elarie fv.event.4.descriptio: Thanks to your trading experience, you gained 5 sacks of sulfur

map.[roe] - elarie fv.event.6.descriptio: An adventurer told you that a gold mine lies south of your island !
map.[roe] - elarie fv.event.7.descriptio: A wandering mage told you of a university on the southern island where you can improve your magical skills.
map.[roe] - elarie fv.event.8.descriptio: Your relatives send a gift worth 5000 gold and 10 sacks of gems.

map.[roe] - elarie fv.guards.20.32.0.mes: If there is no other ship here, your hero or the freed hero will be forced to remain on the island.

map.[roe] - elarie fv.guards.24.56.0.mes: You have stumbled upon a dragon's hunting grounds! You should avoid this place; it may return. One of your companions tells you it nests somewhere nearby.
map.[roe] - elarie fv.guards.24.8.0.mess: A miserable farmer sitting by the river tells you that a pack of lizards has settled beyond the lake and is threatening the locals. He promises 4000 gold if you kill them, but warns that they are very dangerous!
map.[roe] - elarie fv.guards.36.61.0.mes: You have stumbled upon a dragon's hunting grounds! You should avoid this place; it may return. One of your companions tells you it nests somewhere nearby.
map.[roe] - elarie fv.guards.37.34.0.mes: You immediately notice about fifty dwarves armed to the teeth. Whatever they guard so fiercely must be immensely valuable!
map.[roe] - elarie fv.guards.38.41.0.mes: You found it! The beautiful city of Elarie stands before you. As you admire its beauty, a warning arrow lands at your feet. Taking this castle will certainly be no easy task.
map.[roe] - elarie fv.guards.40.44.0.mes: Suddenly, a dozen elves rush at you from beyond the forest. They apparently dislike strangers.
map.[roe] - elarie fv.guards.41.34.0.mes: The artifact the seer mentioned should be hidden somewhere here. Be on your guard.

map.[roe] - elarie fv.guards.51.23.0.mes: Suddenly, your ship becomes entangled in strange seaweed. As you investigate, your crew begins crying for help.

map.[roe] - enroth.event.0.description:
Merchants arrive in port with intriguing news. The island of Mist has
reportedly been attacked by pirates. Without hesitation, you send patrols
to bring reliable reports. You must pay them, however. They will return with news in two days.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.1.description:
On your travels, you met a dying mage. Before he died in your arms, he told you
the tale of the Orbs of Magic. These orbs can increase the power of their respective elements. But on the night of falling stars, their guardians hid them away. You must find and master them.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.10.description: Lord Stromgard attacks you from the west, so destroy him first. Expect demon attacks from Kriegspire to the south and a hard battle for Free Haven. The island of Alamos lies to the east. Taking it would be wise. Every seventh day, you will receive mooring fees from your harbour.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.12.description:
First, rid yourself of Darkmoor's necromancers, or keep them firmly locked away. Conquer the island of Mist to the east, and you will become king of the seas.
As Enroth's rightful heir, you are entitled to taxes from its people. Expect
them every Wednesday.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.13.description: The collectors have brought the taxes
map.[roe] - enroth.event.14.description: You must break through the gates the Ironfists erected against you as soon as possible. Your rightful wealth awaits you in a nearby tomb.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.15.description: Lady Fetsile's troops attacked your gold convoy and took everything.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.16.description: You attacked Lord Stromgard's gold convoy.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.17.description: The tide destroyed your dykes. Unfortunately, this will happen again in about a month.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.18.description: Catherine requests funds for her war in Erathia. Naturally, you comply at once.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.19.description:
This map attempts to show what would have happened had the adventurers' mission in M&M 6 failed.
War is in full swing. Everyone seeks to become king of Enroth, each for a different reason. Neither 3DO nor NWC authorised the changes to the map, but who cares? They are there anyway, so I at least apologise to diehard M&M fans.
BILAJZ
map.[roe] - enroth.event.2.description:
Rummaging through your library, you found a scroll about the Orbs of Magic. It confirms the traveller's story, but you discover something interesting. Each orb
is bound closely to an elemental tome, containing all spells
of that element. Yet only one who has mastered the elemental orb can obtain the tome.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.20.description: Deserters from Catherine's army ambushed your convoy from the mine
map.[roe] - enroth.event.21.description: In retaliation, you attacked disputed territory on your border and successfully plundered it
map.[roe] - enroth.event.22.description: Unknown attackers raided your border and assaulted the inhabitants. It looks like Lord Stormgard's troops.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.23.description: Your aerial patrols report that deserters from Queen Catherine's army are indeed on Mist. They have declared their own domain and even fortified the island. Wouldn't now be the ideal time to plunder and seize Mist? (Diplomatically speaking, that is called annexation.)
map.[roe] - enroth.event.24.description:
Created by: BILAJZ
Tested by: Patrick
Published by: Kalkal
Ee-mail (E-mail for the pedants): bilek.rs@cmail.cz (long live Contactel)
map.[roe] - enroth.event.25.description: A volcanic eruption destroyed an important mining village of yours. Repairs will cost a considerable sum. Unfortunately, the volcano has not quietened, and you never know when it will erupt again.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.3.description:
Your scouts, searching for enemy armies, report
that they overheard several mages discussing an orb their brethren had just brought to the Valley of the Mages. This is clear evidence that the orbs still
exist. You immediately send scouts for more information.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.4.description:
Your scouts bring good news. The Orb of Fire lies within your lands. It
is guarded, however. You will find it in the mountains above the university.
map.[roe] - enroth.event.5.description: More excellent news. Your arch-enemy Lord Stromgard has the Orb of Fire in his territory. That should spur you to greater efforts in your war against him
map.[roe] - enroth.event.6.description:
Your first task is to destroy the combined armies of Lady Fetsile and Lord Stone.
Demons from Kriegspire to the south also threaten you. First, however, try to destroy
and occupy Silver Cove. Every sixth day, you receive border tolls (you have to tax those skiers somehow, don't you?)
map.[roe] - enroth.event.8.description: You have established a stronghold in Kriegspire. From here, you can invade every corner of Enroth. Your best course would be to take Free Haven and launch raids throughout Enroth from there. Every fifth day, a shipment of resources will arrive from hell
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.0.67.0.message: This is a Spyglass, but not the kind the seer seeks. A servant tells you that one was sold to pirates in Smugglers' Cove.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.1.67.0.message: Having mastered the orb, you find mastering the tome a trifle.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.1.68.0.message:
Incredible!!! One of the four Orbs of Magic. Set upon a heavenly pedestal, it is filled with air magic. Unfortunately, you cannot control it, so
its guardians engulf you. FIGHT!! Fight for the power of AIR!!!
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.1.85.0.message: Mages used this land for experiments. That is why it resembles a gateway to hell.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.103.131.0.mess: This orb is guarded by genies summoned by those wand-wielding piles of bones.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.103.132.0.mess: Here is the strongest of all the orbs of antimagic. While you use it, no one can harm you or your warriors with a spell, even a mere sparkler.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.103.135.0.mess: As if the dreadful stench weren't enough, those skeletons with wands have drained all your mana and turned it into genies. Well, ahem, not everything goes exactly to plan, especially with a draught blowing through your brain—or what's left of it.  :)
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.104.131.0.mess:
One of the finest artifacts against dragons. This orb absorbs their immunity
to magic, leaving them vulnerable to spells (do not use
together with Armageddon).
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.11.49.1.messag:
A surprisingly well-kept road runs around the cracked earth.
You follow its course with your eyes and see what you seek—the titans' Cloud Temples.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.113.129.0.mess: ...They now guard three orbs of antimagic. Prepare for a great battle. The ancient mages will not fall easily.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.114.127.0.mess:
You have reached an island on no map, spoken of only in whispers in legends. Here, mages are said to have hidden and guarded three orbs of antimagic, created as counterparts to the elemental orbs. The mages won them at great cost
and placed them on this island...
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.114.128.0.mess: ...Only the greatest mages could guard them, but all save a few were already dead. Thus came the deed that makes this legend so closely suppressed and drives mages mad when they hear it. The mages of that time allied with Darkmoor's necromancers, who summoned the ancient sorcerers back to (un)life...
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.117.92.0.messa: You ride into one of the most fertile regions in all Enroth.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.119.69.0.messa:
You sail into Enroth's largest harbour, on the largest island
of the Misty Islands. Welcome, and follow the buoys to avoid the rocks and reefs.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.12.0.0.message: Having mastered the Orb of Earth, you easily command the tome's guardians to surrender its secrets.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.12.72.0.messag: At last, the final artifact. Now the whole world will fear you.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.13.0.0.message: This is the orb of earth magic. Yet your magical powers are too weak to master the mightiest of the Orbs of Magic. You must FIGHT and show its guardians who commands the power of earth.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.13.20.0.messag: Here in the riverbed, you discover a hidden path following the river, mostly outside the water. It might be worth taking.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.13.72.0.messag: Won't those lizards ever give it a rest?
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.14.72.0.messag: There is no way through without a fight.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.14.73.0.messag:
Do those overgrown lizards really think they can stop you?
Or am I mistaken?
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.14.74.0.messag:
This is the dragon crown, rarest of all the grandmaster's artifacts.
It is guarded accordingly.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.15.122.0.messa:
You have landed on Hermit's Isle. One of the mages' former castles stands here.
But it was also here that demons emerged on the nights of falling stars.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.15.123.0.messa: Your demon race originated here. The castle awaits its rightful ruler. Your servants sense your approach, and some join you.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.15.72.0.messag: They will not surrender their grandmaster's dragon armour cheaply.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.15.73.0.messag: The dragons guard everything that once belonged to their master.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.15.74.0.messag: Those scaly beasts will surrender nothing without a fight.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.17.59.0.messag: It seems the legend was true. Here is the entrance to Enroth's heart. But it is guarded.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.18.59.1.messag: You have entered the centre of Enroth. Follow the road to the teleporter, then on to the titans' birthplace.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.20.22.1.messag:
You are in the Cave of Water, named for Enroth's largest (and
only) underground lake. Legend says a tome of water magic lies somewhere here.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.20.71.0.messag:
A hidden path through the muddy water brings you within sight of what gave this
part of Enroth its name: Dragon Fortress. Scattered around it is the armour
of the dragon grandmaster Shohnug. Dragon guardians watch over it all, mercilessly
hunting anyone who would attempt any mischief here.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.21.7.0.message:
The road brings you to a pass where a group of hydras has settled. It is unusual
for them to settle away from their breeding grounds.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.21.71.0.messag:
The road ends here, but you notice tracks leading west through the mud
towards the mountains.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.22.78.0.messag: Here the path emerges from the riverbed once more and continues south.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.23.102.0.messa:
Here stands a centre of learning that has trained many accomplished
mages and warriors. Now, however, its monks have fortified it and admit no one to their sacred ground.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.23.68.0.messag: The dragon grandmaster's treasure should be hidden somewhere here.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.24.103.0.messa: Another dwarven gate, this time before the dragon dwellings. Capture it and become master of the dragons.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.25.24.0.messag:
...Even the gate the Ironfists built there cannot hold them much longer,
and I fear they have already taken it. In any case, you must stop them. Speak
to my brothers about what you might bring us in exchange for our stolen
artifacts.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.25.25.0.messag:
You reach a seers' settlement, where seers and scholars in green robes welcome you. Their leader takes you to his home and says, “To the south lies the Valley of the Mages, where much of Enroth's magic is concentrated.
Lately, the mages have grown increasingly aggressive and hostile...
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.29.30.0.messag:
You enter Paradise Valley, one of the strangest regions in the world.
Few have returned from here. Legend says the Valley of the Mages is hidden here,
concealing many treasures and relics. It is said to be closely guarded by the mages
who live there. Visit the nearby seers' village to learn more.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.29.78.0.messag:
It seems Galmiel spoke the truth. You see several vampires perched upon 
the seer's hut. Without hesitation, you order the attack.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.31.79.0.messag:
You see a beautiful woman imprisoned in the jail. As you approach, she raises her head and
calls, “Thank you for rescuing me. Evil wraiths imprisoned me here when
I tried to bring the seer a shield from the tomb. Help me, and we shall share the reward.
The road to the seer is guarded too, so accept the aid of me and my friends.”
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.33.57.0.messag:
You stand before the Maw, the greatest cyclops settlement. It is said that an
underground passage leads from the Maw to the very centre of Enroth, birthplace of the titans. If
you are brave enough, explore it. But remember, the cyclopes will not give up easily.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.35.77.0.messag:
Suddenly, wraiths and ghosts emerge from the pyramid. You have roused them from their eternal
sleep, and they seek revenge.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.36.79.0.messag:
Pieces of torn flesh and horses' bridles lie by the tomb. Suddenly, you feel sick and see the corpses beginning to rise. You lack the strength to move,
and your army is hardly eager to fight either.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.37.78.0.messag: This is the tomb of the dragon grandmaster Shohnug.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.38.22.0.messag: Here are their breeding grounds. Time to take control of them.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.38.78.0.messag:
At last, the tomb. Strange rustling comes from within. Suddenly, something
that was once a dragon hurtles at you.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.39.43.0.messag:
The gate to Dragonsand is guarded by the dragons' greatest enemies: dwarves.
Their orders are to let no one in or out. To enter this dreadful land, you must defeat them.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.41.74.0.messag:
This place looks unpleasant. You sense your soldiers' unease. 
Still, you order them onwards. At present, your men's morale 
is far from high.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.5.64.0.message: Mages appeared from nowhere and ambushed you.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.54.85.1.messag: The titans' birthplace indeed. They all come from here, and you have an excellent chance to become their ruler.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.56.36.0.messag:
Here, where two roads meet, an ancient bridge has collapsed. You must repair it 
at considerable expense.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.56.89.1.messag:
Unbelievable: there is snow even underground. Magic must be at work. In any case, the change has cheered your soldiers and strengthened their confidence
before the next battle.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.6.32.1.message: You see a small pool ahead. At your command, a water elemental retrieves a tome of water magic from it. The power of water is yours.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.6.49.0.message: It seems the seer spoke the truth. The gate is occupied, and the mages will not yield it easily. They have also swiftly drained your mana reserves. This will be a hard battle.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.64.101.0.messa:
Here they harvest whatever can grow in the swamps. But you must
fight for these resources, for the original inhabitants will not readily surrender
the fruits of their labour.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.64.79.0.messag:
The Ironfists built a gate here to hold back the undead. Your best course
is to leave its garrison in place.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.64.81.0.messag:
The Ironfists erected this gate to prevent you expanding your domain.
But that will not deter you, will it???
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.64.95.0.messag:
Quarrying has reduced the trees here to dry, barren trunks. 
So what? As long as there is ore to mine. But beware! Greenpeace never sleeps, 
so they have sent their friends against you.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.7.45.1.message: So this is what the titans have guarded all this time. Look inside, if you dare.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.7.75.0.message:
Here is the entrance to the Valley of the Mages. You must defeat its guardians to enter.
The mages have also drained most of your mana to create the genies now
attacking you.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.74.0.0.message: Magnificent!!! Here is one of magic's most perfect creations: the Orb of Fire, one of the four elemental orbs. Sadly, you lack the power to master it. If its guardians destroy you, you will never enjoy it. So MASTER THE POWER OF FIRE!
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.74.30.0.messag: These dendroids were invisible among the trees, making their ambush all the more surprising.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.75.0.0.message: You have mastered the Orb of Fire, so the tome's guardians obey your every word and surrender it without a fight.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.77.28.0.messag:
Dendroids and elven rangers guard Lady Fetsile and Lord Stone's realm with true
skill. A small band of dendroids surrounds you, and the elves' arrows
soon follow.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.78.67.0.messag: You return to your tomb, and some of your former subjects immediately join you.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.79.27.0.messag:
The watchful eyes of elven rangers follow you from afar as they guard this border
alongside the dendroids. You already received reinforcements in their village, but a few 
more join you nonetheless.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.79.72.0.messag:
You approach the tomb of Erik the Mad (indeed, that lunatic is building an army
down beyond the gates instead of being dead), and your army's spirits sink to rock bottom. Black tin cans in armour attack you as well.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.8.33.1.message: You touch a magnificent dark-blue orb when something seizes you and tries to drag you inside. You must FIGHT forces as old as the world for mastery of water.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.80.26.0.messag: The elves and dendroids will not surrender their homes cheaply.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.81.78.0.messag:
A gate protecting against Darkmoor's undead. Leave its garrison where it is,
or hard times await you.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.81.80.0.messag: HA! Those wretched Ironfists think they can stop you with a hovel like this.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.83.24.0.messag:
Elven homes and several dendroid dwellings stand here, waiting for you
to recruit reinforcements.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.85.71.0.messag: A fortress was built here to protect against the dead. But spells gradually drove the griffins mad, and now they hold their commanders captive here.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.85.8.0.message: War rages here, on the border between Frozen Highlands and Silver Cove.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.88.8.0.message: Not another step. There are behemoths here.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.89.8.0.message:
Another ruined bridge—and guarded, too. No wonder it collapsed.
Little could bear the weight of the behemoths roaming here.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.9.33.1.message: The legend was true. Here are the Tome of Water Magic and the Orb of Water.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.90.8.0.message: You would be a fool to go farther.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.93.49.0.messag: Here lies a former mining colony. Who knows what happened here?
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.94.8.0.message: War rages here, on the border between Frozen Highlands and Silver Cove.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.96.60.0.messag:
You have reached the thieves' leader, a former Erathian soldier
who deserted before Catherine Ironfist sailed for Erathia. He wears
a strange cloak that makes him very fast. To claim it, you must kill
not only him but his guard of like-minded wretches.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.97.104.0.messa:
In this treasury, the dwarves keep the treasure they mined through backbreaking toil.
Surely you wouldn't take it from the poor, sweet little things???
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.97.60.0.messag: A renegade mage built a strange device. Mages from the Valley of the Mages stole it and later sold it to these dealers. You find it buried beneath a latrine when you go to relieve yourself. What a stiiink.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.98.60.0.messag:
Below the tent, you find a bed of clover. Most has withered, except this
four-leaf clover.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.98.61.0.messag: They will not let you take what they stole.
map.[roe] - enroth.guards.99.96.0.messag:
You see several mountain dwarves in the distance. It is remarkable they have survived
in such inhospitable terrain. Suddenly their leader calls, “Halt, or
die!”
map.[roe] - enroth.header.description: A year after King Ironfist's disappearance, chaos engulfed the land. Lords began warring, demons subdued Kriegspire, Darkmoor's undead rose under Eric the Mad, and deserters from Queen Catherine's army began ravaging the country. It is up to you to show who shall be king.
map.[roe] - enroth.header.name: Enroth
map.[roe] - enroth.header.rumor.0.text: It is said that whoever controls Mist controls all maritime trade.
map.[roe] - enroth.header.rumor.1.text: Ancient legends speak of a place called the Maw, home to cyclopes. An entrance there is said to lead to the very heart of the earth, where titans are born.
map.[roe] - enroth.header.rumor.2.text: To the southwest lies a volcanic island with a gateway to hell known as Hermit Castle.
map.[roe] - enroth.header.rumor.3.text: The Dead Marshes can be reached only through two gates, garrisoned by the finest warriors the Ironfists can muster.
map.[roe] - enroth.header.rumor.4.text: The dragon grandmaster's tomb lies in an area of strong positive magic somewhere in Dragonsand.
map.[roe] - enroth.header.rumor.5.text: The dragon grandmaster Shohnug's dragons guard all his equipment somewhere in western Dragonsand.
map.[roe] - enroth.header.rumor.6.text: If you obtain all the tomes of magic and become an expert in their elements, you will be an invincible mage.
map.[roe] - enroth.header.rumor.7.text: I wonder how Queen Catherine is faring with the restoration of Erathia.
map.[roe] - enroth.heroes.12.name: L. Stone
map.[roe] - enroth.heroes.14.name: Talonisis
map.[roe] - enroth.heroes.18.name: Galmiel
map.[roe] - enroth.heroes.27.name: L. Fetsile
map.[roe] - enroth.heroes.36.name: L. Temper
map.[roe] - enroth.heroes.4.name: L. Stormgard
map.[roe] - enroth.heroes.44.name: N. Ironfist
map.[roe] - enroth.heroes.49.name: Devil Baa
map.[roe] - enroth.heroes.79.name: Erik the Mad
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.103.133.0.mes: “Khhraaa,” croaks one of the undead. “At lassst, another fool dares come here. I wonder what those bastards on the other side are doing.”
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.103.99.0.mess: You will not take our wealth cheaply.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.109.48.0.mess:
Water elementals are uncommon on the Misty Islands. But you are
unlucky enough to encounter them here.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.129.109.0.mes: Queen Catherine stationed a strong guard of her finest men here as a precaution. They recognise you and eagerly join you.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.131.25.0.mess: Here you breed pegasi, the fabled winged horses. These guards gladly let you in.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.15.0.0.messag: Of course, hydras guard the Orb of Earth here.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.19.71.0.messa: You shall go no farther, worm.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.2.68.0.messag: The mages guard their artifacts very thoroughly indeed.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.20.101.0.mess: Ahhh, an adventurer at last. But you must pay for entry with your blood.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.21.5.0.messag: These hydras have settled rather too close to their pond. You do not know why, but you sense a powerful magical aura here.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.3.63.0.messag: You may enter the teleporter freely. BUT ONLY OVER OUR DEAD BODIES.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.30.30.0.messa:
You stand at the edge of Paradise Valley. Hydras, the valley's ancient
inhabitants, guard the entrance.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.30.56.0.messa: No one shall enter our home!
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.32.42.0.messa: Kriegspire's original inhabitants took refuge here after you drove them out. Time to finish them off.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.35.6.0.messag: Harpies have seized the lake of gems. They must think you'll like them better wearing gems. Sexy, aren't they?
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.39.22.0.messa: You enter harpy territory. These harpies guard the pass to their nesting grounds.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.41.73.0.messa: Spirits of the dead from the nearby crypt guard the tombs. To explore their secrets, you must defeat them.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.48.34.0.messa:
Those harpies really are twisted. Someone tell them you can't sew an ar... 
back onto a face, so they should stop dressing themselves up.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.54.28.0.messa:
Medusas from the nearby mountain temple of the serpent guard the crossroads
between White Cap and Kriegspire.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.59.31.0.messa: Harpies from nearby nesting grounds. Do they really think they'll look prettier?
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.61.105.0.mess: We are from Greenpeace, and we'll show you that destroying rainforests is forbidden.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.63.103.0.mess: Don't hurt us!!! We'll give you everything, just don't hurt us!!!
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.63.30.0.messa:
Harpies nesting in Frozen Highlands flew over the mountains
and seized this little gem lake. They probably think those rocks will make them prettier.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.66.43.0.messa:
Medusas from the nearby mountain chapel guard the crossroads
between Free Haven and Blackhire.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.71.31.0.messa: The local elves eagerly await you.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.72.70.0.messa: Strange. Why do those stinking flying bloodsuckers need a gold mine?
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.74.22.0.messa: Lady Fetsile's pegasi flew over the mountains and seized the local sulfur mine. Such insolence must be punished.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.74.81.0.messa: Troops loyal to House Ironfist have occupied this gate as well.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.84.20.0.messa:
Dendroids guard this mine against your enemies. They welcome you joyfully,
however, and give you what they found around the mine.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.88.7.0.messag: Glory to Lord Stormgard and death to Stone.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.88.9.0.messag: Lady Fetsile and Lord Stone hold their positions firmly. They must be destroyed.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.90.9.0.messag:
Ah, at last you are here. Our colleagues must have told you what is happening. Over there
are the forward patrols of Stormgard's army. At last, we'll give them a thrashing.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.91.8.0.messag: Oh, my lord, thank goodness you are here. We cannot hold back Lord Stormgard's army and behemoths much longer. Another group of our rangers is a little farther on. Speak to them.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.95.106.0.mess: You plundered our village, and now you seek our mines. For that, you must die.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.96.66.0.messa:
These renegade orcs have lived here for decades, creating a haven for dealers and thieves of every kind. No wonder it is called Smugglers'
Cove. In any case, they will defend it by every means.
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.99.103.0.mess: Kill them before they enslave us
map.[roe] - enroth.monster.99.98.0.messa: You did not listen. Prepare to die.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.112.21.0.message: Welcome to the harbour arena. The harbour lies farther south.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.130.112.0.messag:
On a finely crafted sign, even plated with metal around its
edges, a simple message is scratched:
Our capital, Ironfist, lies to the north
The harbour lies to the south
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.137.67.0.message:
The sign's original text is illegible, but a fresh message reads:
“Mist is ours, not the Ironfists'!” Beneath it is a griffin skull.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.20.35.0.message: The Cave of Water lies in the mountains.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.29.102.0.message: King Ironfist's libraries are closed until he is found.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.41.70.0.message: The sign reads: The tombs are haunted. Enter at your own risk
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.6.47.0.message: Valley of the Mages. By invitation only.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.61.46.0.message:
Blackhire lies west. Free Haven lies east. Head south
along the road to reach Lord Temper's castle.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.65.98.0.message: Signposts point west and north towards the quarries, and south towards the sawmills.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.70.32.0.message: North to Silver Cove, south to Free Haven.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.80.72.0.message: Upstream along the riverbed lies Erik the Mad's tomb. Only necrophiliacs, necromancers, and lunatics enter without fear.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.85.105.0.message:
Things look grim. I hope we survive. The wind
drives us towards the cliffs. Oh God, a great wave is coming at u... That is all that remains of an unknown sailor's diary.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.88.21.0.message: Welcome to the lands of Lady Fetsile and Lord Stone.
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.92.8.0.message: Lord Stromgard's territory lies farther west. Entry by special permit only!
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.93.67.0.message:
Something is written on the board, but someone took pains to deface it.
With a little imagination, you can still decipher:
C...VE OF THOSE B..ST..R..
map.[roe] - enroth.sign.97.91.0.message: On a piece of wood, you read: Dwarven mines and village to the south.
map.[roe] - enroth.town.11.12.0.name: Sweet Water
map.[roe] - enroth.town.128.96.0.name: Ironfist
map.[roe] - enroth.town.132.18.0.name: S. Cove
map.[roe] - enroth.town.134.66.0.name: Mist
map.[roe] - enroth.town.14.126.0.name: Hermit
map.[roe] - enroth.town.141.115.0.name: New Sorpigal
map.[roe] - enroth.town.143.4.0.name: Alamos
map.[roe] - enroth.town.42.33.0.name: Kriegspire
map.[roe] - enroth.town.43.8.0.name: White Cap
map.[roe] - enroth.town.56.44.0.name: Blackhire
map.[roe] - enroth.town.57.4.0.name: Stormgard
map.[roe] - enroth.town.62.89.1.name: Titanium
map.[roe] - enroth.town.73.42.0.name: F. Haven
map.[roe] - enroth.town.76.87.0.name: Darkmoor
map.[roe] - enroth.town.87.59.0.name: Temper
map.[roe] - enroth.town.97.21.0.name: Stone
map.[roe] - excalibur.event.0.descriptio: Queen Map raised your son Mordred and granted him magical powers. As Mordred grew, his power and hunger for dominion increased. He therefore resolved to kill you and seize the entire realm.
map.[roe] - excalibur.event.1.descriptio: Your loyal friend and teacher, the wizard Merlin, bound Morgana, Mordred's mother and a powerful sorceress, in the chains of time. This exhausted him, forcing him into a well-earned retirement. He cannot help you, but perhaps he can advise you where to find Mordred's castle.
map.[roe] - excalibur.event.2.descriptio: The messenger you sent to Merlin brings a letter. Brave King Arthur, I gathered all my strength to discover the location of Mordred's castle, Kilgoor. It lies in the southeast, in a dreadful place surrounded by burial grounds and dead trees. I wish you luck in this battle.
map.[roe] - excalibur.event.3.descriptio: Another messenger arrives from Merlin. He writes: Queen Map is imprisoned underground beyond four magical towers. The underground entrance is on a small island in the middle of the land. Queen Map commands powerful gold dragons, so the mysterious orb Mordred is said to own may prove useful.
map.[roe] - excalibur.event.4.descriptio: Do not let him flee from battle. You will need magical shackles guarded by zealots near the gold mine. Beware, however: I have learned that Queen Map's army is very large. I hope we prevail in our holy struggle.
map.[roe] - excalibur.event.5.descriptio: The miners refuse to work all week and are rebelling. The stoppages cost you resources.
map.[roe] - excalibur.event.6.descriptio: You persuaded the miners to endure a little longer. You explained their importance and paid them some extra money.
map.[roe] - excalibur.event.7.descriptio: People throughout the land have collected a large sum to hasten our victory.
map.[roe] - excalibur.guards.10.53.0.mes: The closer you come to the Holy Grail, the higher your men's morale rises.
map.[roe] - excalibur.guards.17.41.0.mes: Suddenly, those wretched harpies guarding Lord Percival's prison are all around you. Defeating them will surely raise your army's morale.
map.[roe] - excalibur.guards.21.15.0.mes: Seek the wizard Merlin's mysterious tome. It holds every spell Merlin studied over the centuries. Ancient legends place it on sacred ground in the north, not far from here. Mages guard it.
map.[roe] - excalibur.guards.36.51.0.mes: You enter dangerous lands. Mordred must be near.
map.[roe] - excalibur.guards.48.51.1.mes: Suddenly, a mass of fire elementals attacks you. That was to be expected here.
map.[roe] - excalibur.guards.52.38.1.mes: The dreadful heat lowers your company's morale.
map.[roe] - excalibur.guards.6.11.0.mess: Your first task is to free Lord Percival from the prison near Harpy Castle. Morgana and Mordred imprisoned him with the aid of a vast number of harpies, which are everywhere. Be very careful.
map.[roe] - excalibur.guards.6.12.0.mess: Lord Percival has found the Holy Grail! Bring it back to Camelot, and its ancient glory will return. Your subjects will regain their lost pride and join your company in greater numbers. The Harpy Castle you seek lies south of Camelot, deep in the woods. Good luck, Arthur.
map.[roe] - excalibur.header.description: You are King Arthur. You must kill your son Mordred and Queen Map, who raised him. The wizard Merlin has taken a well-earned retirement and can no longer help. Muster all your strength and free the land from the suffering caused by Mordred's raids.
map.[roe] - excalibur.header.name: Excalibur
map.[roe] - excalibur.heroes.125.name: Map
map.[roe] - excalibur.heroes.3.name: Mordred
map.[roe] - excalibur.heroes.6.name: Arthur
map.[roe] - excalibur.heroes.7.name: Percival
map.[roe] - excalibur.monster.11.52.0.me: Mordred will give us strength. You will burn in hell, Arthur. GRRRRRR
map.[roe] - excalibur.monster.19.6.0.mes: Mordred sent us to spread devastation through your lands. Killing you will be a pleasure, Arthur.
map.[roe] - excalibur.monster.31.15.0.me: Here, on sacred ground, the wizard Merlin hid his mysterious spellbook. Only one who defeats us may claim it. Prove you are the chosen one, and fight.
map.[roe] - excalibur.monster.31.9.0.mes: The crystals are ours, you... The dwarf never finishes, for you lose your temper and attack. He will never insult you again.
map.[roe] - excalibur.monster.33.2.0.mes: Though we are small, we shall fight to the end. No one will take our crystals.
map.[roe] - excalibur.monster.37.37.0.me: Since the dawn of time, we have guarded the peace of our lady, Queen Map. No one may disturb her rest. Anyone who tries shall die here and now.
map.[roe] - excalibur.monster.5.21.0.mes: We will not let you free the angels. We would sooner die fighting.
map.[roe] - excalibur.monster.5.53.0.mes: We will not surrender Percival. We would rather die.
map.[roe] - excalibur.sign.14.13.0.messa:
SOUTH to Harpy Castle.
NORTH to the ore mines
map.[roe] - excalibur.sign.35.48.1.messa: To pass the four magical towers, you must first find their keys.

map.[roe] - gladiátor.event.0.descriptio:
{Maximus {Decimus {Meridius}
Commander of the Armies of the North, General of the Felix Legions, loyal servant of the true emperor, {Marcus {Aurelius}. Yes, that is Maximus. When the current emperor killed the true emperor, Maximus was sentenced to death, but escaped. Yet the current emperor...
map.[roe] - gladiátor.event.1.descriptio: ...had his entire family murdered. Then Maximus found himself fighting in arenas as a gladiator, later in Rome's Colosseum itself. Now the final battle to overthrow the emperor has come! That is up to you!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.event.3.descriptio: It is true that Maximus dies in the film's final battle, but what happens here is up to you!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.event.4.descriptio: Expect plenty of warriors to recruit, but little gold. This is deliberate, not a flaw in the map. Plenty of gold would make it too easy!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.event.5.descriptio:
The map is based on the film {Gladiator}; some heroes' faces match those in the film.
Do not expect especially elaborate landscapes. This map is chiefly about battles, and I think there are plenty. Something for megalomaniacs!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.event.6.descriptio: A special gold delivery for you!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.event.7.descriptio:
Created by:
{FIREBIRD
{firebird@email.cz
