These pages contain every Heroes3 map I have ever made!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.0.53.0.mess: "A very rare helmet, but are you worthy of it yet, Maximus?"
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.12.48.1.mes: Welcome to the infernal arena, Maximus!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.16.56.1.mes: This land swarms with enemies. You have been ambushed again!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.22.45.1.mes: Many magogs are already eager to sink their teeth into you!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.27.10.0.mes: Gladiators do not usually wear necklaces, but given this artifact's powers, Maximus will make an exception. Yet many enemies from the ice castle (Tower) are here!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.31.64.0.mes: You meet a band of wandering troops who want to join you (what else?).
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.31.67.0.mes: A tremendous treasure. Maximus has never seen so much gold in one place!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.34.13.1.mes: The Arena of Ice and Death!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.35.61.1.mes: Many enemies sharpen their weapons for you in their arena!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.36.4.0.mess: The enchanted ground has lowered your morale!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.39.20.0.mes: A sizable amount of gold, unguarded even in this barbaric world. Surely that is impossible!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.4.2.0.messa: This sword belongs only to the finest gladiators. Are you one of them? In any case, our arena awaits!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.40.56.1.mes: You meet several warriors lost in this part of the land. They offer to help you fight in the other arenas if you take them along!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.41.49.0.mes: If you enter here and find no guards, you are not the first to set foot here. Either way, welcome to the "Valley of Totems".
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.42.17.0.mes: A gang of thieves attacked you. There was no battle, but you lost:
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.43.10.0.mes: You were ambushed while passing between the rocks!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.46.22.0.mes: A renowned gladiator lost this armour in the arena years ago. Dark forces defeated him, and the souls of dead dragons seized the armour!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.46.3.0.mess: You found a small quantity of crystals.
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.49.21.0.mes: The magical ground raises your morale!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.52.12.0.mes: This place must be enchanted, for the moment you entered, your luck improved considerably.
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.56.3.0.mess: Since you still do not know what awaits you, your strength is not yet invincible. Your morale has fallen a little!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.58.24.0.mes: You can gain much experience from this mysterious ancient box. But are you brave enough to open it?
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.58.32.0.mes:
BEWARE!
This teleporter may be a trap. Think carefully about whom you send! You will need MANY warriors there!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.6.6.1.messa: You enter the arenas of death. Many experienced warriors await with their gladiators. Will you face them? You must, of course—you are the best!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.61.4.0.mess:
Suddenly, you could cast “Bloodlust”. You do not know how it happened, but there it is.
Bloodlust = blood lust.
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.63.10.0.mes: You met a sizable band of goblins passing your castle. They offered their services!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.64.13.0.mes: Several ogres wish to join you!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.65.0.0.mess: Quite by chance, you meet a group of cyclopes on your side. Will you accept them?
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.65.67.1.mes: What sort of gladiator would Maximus be without a proper shield for the arenas? This one should suffice. It is the finest in the land, but will not come without a fight. Many hostile barbarian troops want it.
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.66.2.0.mess: You saw a fairly respectable heap of gold, but several dragons circled above it.
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.67.8.0.mess: Many heads have been severed here. For avoiding this trap, you gain:
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.7.62.0.mess: If the enemy reached this island before you, one of the artifacts needed to assemble the Angelic Alliance may already be gone (SoD version only).
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.70.70.0.mes: You must come here, but I hope you did not send Maximus! There is no way back. Remember that!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.71.8.0.mess: You meet several goblins near your castles.
map.[roe] - gladiátor.guards.8.47.1.mess: If you have not already obtained this artifact elsewhere and have the SoD version, you can now assemble the Angelic Alliance! As before, it will not be free.
map.[roe] - gladiátor.header.description: Maximus, the deposed commander of Rome's northern armies, must avenge the true emperor, Marcus Aurelius, by killing the present false emperor!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.header.name: Gladiator
map.[roe] - gladiátor.heroes.101.name: Maximus
map.[roe] - gladiátor.heroes.12.name: Enemy2
map.[roe] - gladiátor.heroes.36.name: Enemy4

map.[roe] - gladiátor.heroes.6.name: Enemy1

map.[roe] - gladiátor.monster.47.65.0.me: “We guard the treasure of this barbaric land's ancient mages! Though you may one day become a hero, you are not yet among the chosen. Therefore, you shall die!”
map.[roe] - gladiátor.monster.57.10.0.me: "You will need every one of us!"
map.[roe] - gladiátor.monster.60.7.0.mes: These goblins are also sympathetic to Maximus.
map.[roe] - gladiátor.monster.71.4.0.mes: “Do not let the enemy seize this Keymaster's Tent, or a cruel punishment awaits you. But enough advice—now we fight!”
map.[roe] - gladiátor.sign.46.18.1.messa: These mines are reserved for this enemy alone, so he has had the road to them closed!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.sign.7.5.0.message: These mines are beyond your reach!
map.[roe] - gladiátor.town.33.61.0.event: Your loyal gladiators have built you a castle!
The cyclopes you met outside the castle have built a dwelling inside!
Lower-level warriors gather at your castle!
If you had not built a castle by now, you have one now!
Your fame is not yet great (who knows if it ever will be), but you already have many allies!
You receive your pay for your victories in the arenas!
You receive some crystals in place of your pay.
Your popularity grows. Many adventurers wish to join you—for suitable pay, of course!
You are not yet famous, but word of your defeat of a feared gladiator precedes you. Weaker warriors wish to join you.
Your name is known throughout the land! Now only the finest join you!
Many adventurers now wish to join Maximus!
map.[roe] - had.header.description: Try to find the blue tent on one of the islands. Once you find it, you will gain the immense wealth the Serpent King hid somewhere at sea. Only a teleportation gate leads there. Beware, though: the Serpent Kingdom guards the gate...

map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.event.0.des:
Long ago, somewhere in ancient Greece...
The people of that world lived free and contented lives, apart from occasional enemy raids. But one day, the inhabitants of a small town awoke to a creature that filled their lives with fear. It was an enormous hydra!
map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.event.1.des: Many heroes tried to kill it, but failed. The villagers decided to summon Hercules, already famed for many brave deeds. Naturally, Hercules agreed to help and set out. But the ground around the town has collapsed, so he must pass through the underworld.
map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.event.2.des:
And as such things go, several warriors and their armies must be defeated below. They include various fallen gods and Hades himself. At the end of it all awaits the Hydra, which must be slain.
Does Hercules stand a chance?
map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.event.3.des:
This map is a sequel to:
{The Deeds of Hercules
It is harder than the previous map—or so I think. Once again, there is a two-week time limit!
map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.event.4.des:
This map was tested by Gremlin and the duo H&D!

map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.guards.15.9: Your next enemy is {Aphrodite}, once the goddess of love, but now seemingly a second goddess of war.
map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.guards.18.4: All troops you find here are friends!
map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.guards.21.2: And finally, the ruler of the underworld himself, {Hades}.
map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.guards.28.1: Your next enemy is the ever-present {Ares}, god of war.
map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.guards.5.15: The first enemy to reach the underworld is {Gabriella}, Xena's friend, who has tired of life on the side of good!
map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.header.desc:
After freeing one region from {black dragons}, Hercules returned home. But his stay was short, for an enormous {hydra} is tormenting an ancient Greek town. Time to set out again!

map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.header.name: Hercules and the Hydra
map.[roe] - herkules a hydra.monster.2.3: “Ah, Hercules! Those mangy villagers sent you after me? If you have any warriors left, come and show me what you can do!”
map.[roe] - hledani svateho grálu.guards: If you do not know the cave's secret, you had better not venture underground.
Unfortunately, fallen rocks block the road to the neighbouring king.

Punish the traitor!
Build a ship and seek the island, for Anachor is close to digging up the Holy Grail.
If you seek the Holy Grail, search the island southwest of your kingdom. Ancient legends say an underground entrance lies there, leading to the Grail.

Hurrah!
At last, you have rescued King Kirius and his army. Waste no time—deal swiftly with the traitor from the neighbouring kingdom.
Legend says the true entrance to the Holy Grail bears the colour of humanity's greatest virtue. Remember, only one path is right.
map.[roe] - hledani svateho grálu.header: Only the Holy Grail can secure final victory in the war.
The Quest for the Holy Grail
map.[roe] - hledani svateho grálu.town.3: War between King Kirius and Archonor's dark kingdom has raged for centuries. Only the Holy Grail can end this cruel war. But a neighbouring king has now imprisoned Kirius. You must free him and find the Holy Grail.
King Archonar beat you to it. He has dug up the Holy Grail!!!
Your spies have learned that King Archonar is close to digging up the Holy Grail! Waste no more time—hurry!
map.[roe] - hvezdné brány.header.descrip: To leave your island, you can either attack another player or enter the stargate!
map.[roe] - hvezdné brány.header.name: Stargates
map.[roe] - jadamsti lordove.guards.35.5: Defeat the titan king and his personal guard, and this artifact is yours.
map.[roe] - jadamsti lordove.header.desc: Dagorlad, in the land of Jadame, is plagued by wars between local lords. Choose a side and conquer this territory, for Jadame's lords no longer have the strength to hold their land.
map.[roe] - jadamsti lordove.header.name: The Lords of Jadame
map.[roe] - jadamsti lordove.monster.101: You may not enter our master's presence!
You will not rob our bank! Grrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!
Villain, how dare you enter so sacred a place!
The lords of Jadame guard this land.
Anyone who dares cross this border will face the wrath of Jadame's lords.
The lords of Jadame guard this land.
map.[roe] - jadamsti lordove.sign.9.10.0: The lords of Jadame guard this land.
The lords of Jadame guard this land.
You are Lord Canenghem, the last of Jadame's lords in Dagorlad. Defend your territory against other power-hungry kingdoms. You have reports of Lucifer Kreegan, Queen Catherine, and Rescuetra of Cloud City.
The tax collectors arrive. After their long journey, they tell of armies appearing in the region.
The stonemason kept his promise. Today, a veritable swarm of his apprentices swept through your town, repaired all your buildings, and even left resources for future repairs.
Your caravan was ambushed. All supplies intended to feed your subjects have been lost.
Several volunteers arrive at your camp wishing to join your army. Very pleased, you begin deploying them in defensive positions.
Your mother is deeply upset. Only now do you realise you forgot Mother's Day. You immediately pack some jewellery and gems and send them to her.
Unrest spreads among the people, probably caused by the frequent skirmishes on your border. You must spend some resources to calm your subjects.
Queen Catherina sends a letter mocking your command. Outraged, you share the news with your subjects. Volunteers immediately come forward, swearing vengeance as you do.

This morning, a priest arrived from Halla Ruina Abbey, a member of the local Ruinovci order. He promised that if you donated some money to the abbey's account, God would favour you alone. Since your situation is beyond desperate, you accept.
Shortly before noon, a band of liches attacked villagers near the town. Your company immediately set out and drove the liches back. Deeply grateful, the rescued villagers enter your service.
You gave a renowned builder lodging for the night and then saved his life as he left town. He told you to expect his masons' work within fifty days.
You are Queen Catherina's envoy to this inhospitable region of Jadame. Since the local lords could not hold it, you must subdue the land for your queen.
Your subjects report that the resource caravan from Queen Catherina has arrived.
Queen Catherina grows impatient. She cannot understand your slow progress in this war, but sends more resources nonetheless.
You send a messenger to Rescuetra to discuss a possible alliance. An alliance with your strongest enemy would be valuable now. You hope Rescuetra accepts, for you have plans for it.
Rescuetra refused. You therefore have a priest of her order arrested in your territory and demand a ransom.
The ransom arrives on time. Yet your anger at the rejection still has not cooled.
Word arrives that Catherina's husband, Roland Ironfist, has sent some of his personal knights to help secure this territory.
This afternoon, the high priest of the Lotus Blossom Temple visited you. He offered the service of some priests for a small sum of gold. You gladly accepted.
Author: Ondřej Podlucký, alias dumbledore. E-mail: dumbledoras@atlas.cz
You have been charged with securing this territory for Rescuetra of Cloud City. Your information suggests the local garrisons of Jadame's lords are very weak. But word has reached you that you are not the only one interested in this land.
Rescuetra sent a group of mages carrying a chest of resources.
Rescuetra sent several messengers to bring you more resources.

Catherina, Queen of Erathia and Enroth, sent a messenger to discuss an alliance. She requests a small sum of money to seal it. Yet you see no reason to ally with the Erathian queen, who has violated your borders more than anyone in the past.

Your reply offended Catherina. While you planned an attack on the last lord of Jadame's territory, she had one of your priests kidnapped. As he is very highly placed, you decide to pay the ransom demanded.

You visited a village near the town with your personal guard. Passing through its eastern slums, you were attacked by seven villagers led by the local sage. For this insolence, you had the village plundered.

Riding through the forest northeast of Lucifer Kreegan's castle, you were attacked by woodland border guards. They swiftly took all your gold and fled. Nothing like this had happened since the end of the dark days. The forest guards always had an alliance with Cloud City. It has clearly been broken.
Rescuetra grows anxious at your wasted time and sends more support troops to help.
Your master, Lord Lucifer Kreegan, sent you here to enforce his claims and seize the entire land by force. He makes it clear that failure will cost you your head.
Lord Kreegan sent a sizable quantity of resources.
While searching the countryside, your scouts found an old druidic rune with resources hidden beneath it. Probably old supplies from the war over the runestone.
We captured woodland elves living here who spy for Catherine. Under torture, they revealed the secret war supplies. We went to the place they named and found useful resources.
We robbed the church where the greatest of Jadame's high priests lived. We killed him and brought back the treasures.
Our Nighon and Eeofol allies sent resources and soldiers. Nothing stands in the way of our plans now.
Eeofol has sent a vast army to support us. It should arrive in about 30 days.
The army has arrived. We are now numerous and strong. We shall annihilate anyone who opposes us. Rescuetra, Catherin, and Lord Canenghem must die.
map.[roe] - jag.event.0.description: Would you mind getting a move on?
map.[roe] - jag.event.1.description:
I have learned that you are killing innocent people. This could cost you your career. 
                                                                                  Admiral Checkwidden
map.[roe] - jag.guards.10.48.0.message: The local fishermen probably won't like someone trying to steal their ship!
map.[roe] - jag.guards.13.24.0.message: You have found the source of the buzzing. Those strange noises come from the overgrown flies living here.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.14.45.0.message: You have just narrowly escaped a group of dragons perched on the rocks.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.16.27.1.message: Something just flew over your head. You begin to feel afraid.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.16.29.1.message:
Suddenly, your stomach aches. 
(Thought about turning back yet?)
map.[roe] - jag.guards.3.22.0.message: Strange creatures resembling Count Dracula suddenly emerge from the crypt and hurl themselves at you.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.3.41.0.message: It won't be free! This isn't Přemek Podlaha's show!!!
map.[roe] - jag.guards.31.56.0.message:
“They say you're in the navy. Show us what you've got,”
says the leader of the strange goblins.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.33.43.0.message: The dragons seem to have gone on holiday. But beware! They could return any moment!
map.[roe] - jag.guards.34.13.1.message: And have you visited the white tent? If not, GET GOING!!!
map.[roe] - jag.guards.34.14.1.message: “You miserable, puffed-up, snobbish, hoity-toity, illiterate, dyslexic snob, supreme idiot, battery-powered halfwit! Can't you grasp that wandering underground isn't so simple? We'll have to teach you not to trifle with the powers of hell.”
map.[roe] - jag.guards.34.28.0.message: You found a lump of gold.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.35.42.0.message:
Want it?? First you must defeat us, ten black dragons!!
HA HA HA HA HA
map.[roe] - jag.guards.38.45.0.message: Your instincts tell you to arm yourself thoroughly!!!
map.[roe] - jag.guards.41.11.0.message: You found a discarded book written by an experienced monk. You read it avidly and gained a little experience.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.41.19.1.message: Now those Angel Wings will come in handy, if you have them!
map.[roe] - jag.guards.41.20.1.message:
If not, you must go back for them.
                              (Wise advice, don't you think?)
map.[roe] - jag.guards.41.47.0.message:
A band of robbers ambushed you and took some money.
You had no time to defend yourself.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.43.16.1.message: “You're very close to Austin!” says your sixth sense—for women.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.47.59.0.message: You're taking rather too much again!
map.[roe] - jag.guards.48.32.0.message: Elves attacked, but you managed to run away. COWARD!!!!!!
map.[roe] - jag.guards.48.33.0.message:
“Aaaah, get them!”
A formation of armed elves charges at you, looking far from friendly.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.50.32.0.message: You have entered the Elven Village.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.52.48.0.message:
“And do you know where they are?” you ask.
“We do now. Come to headquarters, Rabb.”
map.[roe] - jag.guards.52.49.0.message:
“I thought you were behind it.”
“No, terrorists kidnapped them. I didn't want you to know beforehand.”
map.[roe] - jag.guards.52.50.0.message:
Clayton Webb calls to you from afar:
“They've kidnapped Mac and Sarah!! Do something!”
map.[roe] - jag.guards.53.12.0.message:
As soon as you see the ship, an idea flashes through your mind.
“I could look for treasure out on the water.”
“How about asking first, eh?”
A band of goblins confronts you.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.53.39.1.message:
You discover you have a radio. Just now, the admiral is calling:
“You're close now!”
map.[roe] - jag.guards.53.46.0.message: “Now I'll show you where your—our colleagues are imprisoned. Watch closely!”
map.[roe] - jag.guards.57.39.1.message: A horde of guards charges at you.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.59.63.0.message:
Admiral Checkwidden's voice carries from afar.
“Rabb, I have a mission for you! Come to headquarters in the castle.”
“I know,” you reply.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.60.70.0.message: Sailing the seas is no simple matter. First you must win the favour of the ruler of all waters!
map.[roe] - jag.guards.67.68.0.message:
“Here's your reward,”
says the last soldier before your griffins tear him to shreds.
map.[roe] - jag.guards.68.69.0.message:
A band of C.I.A. soldiers emerges from the very first forest.
“We need to thin out that army of yours.”
map.[roe] - jag.guards.7.51.0.message: "We won't just give it to you!!"
map.[roe] - jag.header.description: Well, my friend. You are Harmon Rabb, colleague of Mac Austin and Sarah Mckenzie. And you should know, colleague, that you may never see those two again. They face years in a C.I.A. prison because they did not suit Clayton Webb's purposes. As everyone knows, he belongs to the C.I.A. Whether you meet them again is up to you.
map.[roe] - jag.header.name: JAG
map.[roe] - jag.header.rumor.0.text: So you are Harmon Rabb, a major in the military legal service. Very well. You have no castle, so you must find one. That is the easiest part of this scenario. In time, someone will show you where your colleagues are.
map.[roe] - jag.header.rumor.1.text: Free those two unfortunate women, and you will also receive an artifact: the Crown of the Supreme Magi. Your task is to deliver it to headquarters. GOOD LUCK!
map.[roe] - jag.heroes.2.name: McKenzie
map.[roe] - jag.heroes.3.name: Austin
map.[roe] - jag.heroes.4.name: Harmon Rabb
map.[roe] - jag.monster.12.12.0.message: Four little dragons hover above you. Since they are friendly little dragons, they wish to join your army.
map.[roe] - jag.monster.16.49.0.message: "You won't get through this way, since we're here."
map.[roe] - jag.monster.17.52.0.message:
“This is our home!!!”
all the giants who had been resting peacefully here shouted in thunderous voices.
map.[roe] - jag.monster.18.65.1.message: “We feel right at home here, but what about you?” a pile of mangy bones called from behind you.
map.[roe] - jag.monster.19.18.0.message:
“You are already too close for us to let you go any further!”
came a voice behind you.
map.[roe] - jag.monster.2.30.0.message: "You will not get underground. We must not allow it, at any cost!"
map.[roe] - jag.monster.20.3.0.message: This might be the way to the Grail, so we are not letting you through!
map.[roe] - jag.monster.23.23.0.message:
“Get your army ready, and we can start our dance of the dead,” said one heap of bones.
“One, two, three, one, two, three,” chanted all the bones nearby as they went wild. Yours would have joined in too, had your will not been strong enough to make you start swinging your sword...
map.[roe] - jag.monster.23.39.0.message:
“You cannot defeat us white unicorns!!” a herd of strangely mutated geldings called to you. 
“We shall see,” you replied, readying your weapon.
map.[roe] - jag.monster.24.52.0.message: "You shall not pass. You should have tried going around. It is not that far. But now it is too late."
map.[roe] - jag.monster.25.33.0.message: “Where are you off to, Rabb? Surely not to fetch Austin? Or perhaps MacKenzie???”
map.[roe] - jag.monster.25.42.0.message: "Show us what you have got, sailor!"
map.[roe] - jag.monster.25.7.0.message: Hocus-pocus! Come on, then. Or run away!
map.[roe] - jag.monster.30.41.0.message: "Here are a few fireballs from Satan himself!"
map.[roe] - jag.monster.31.25.0.message: "You want Austin? Then you must defeat us!!!"
map.[roe] - jag.monster.32.52.1.message:
“You must have a digging permit!” cried a grey-haired old man.
“I have no permit. I am from JAG,” you answered.
“I do not care!” said the old man, and whistled. 
Suddenly fifty of the old fellows appeared, carrying these wands...
map.[roe] - jag.monster.35.67.0.message: Hello, sailor. Where are you heading, eh? We will have to thin out your army a little.
map.[roe] - jag.monster.37.35.0.message:
“There is a real treasure here,” you remarked.
“But we are here too,” came a voice behind you.
map.[roe] - jag.monster.40.17.0.message: "This is the goblins’ treasure, and we will not just hand it over!"
map.[roe] - jag.monster.42.54.0.message:
“We will come with you. Better than starving here,”
the griffins cried.
map.[roe] - jag.monster.47.50.0.message: "Show us what you have got, lawyer."
map.[roe] - jag.monster.48.61.0.message: “Halt in the name of the C.I.A.! Property of Clayton Webb!”
map.[roe] - jag.monster.52.17.0.message: “Now you have gone too far.” These words come from the leader of Satan’s servants.
map.[roe] - jag.monster.55.57.0.message:
“Hello,” you said.
“Aaagrrrr,” a group of strange statues returned your greeting.
This probably will not be a very friendly encounter.
map.[roe] - jag.monster.55.67.0.message: “Hi there. I may be one of your kind, but that does not mean I will just give you that titan junk behind me.”
map.[roe] - jag.monster.6.45.0.message: “Hello, friends. Here are a few arrows to welcome you.”
map.[roe] - jag.sign.35.15.1.message: Whoever you are, do not dare set foot on infernal ground.

map.[roe] - jimmy.event.0.description: After many battles fought bravely—and, above all, victoriously—in the service of your beloved King Jan, you were rewarded for your long years of loyal service with the title “Distinguished Duke” and the right to hold a duchy in the north of the kingdom for the rest of your life.
map.[roe] - jimmy.event.1.description: After many days of arduous travel, you have finally reached your duchy. You are already looking forward to lying down in a comfortable bed in YOUR castle and taking a proper rest from the restless, dangerous life you have led on the brink of death.
map.[roe] - jimmy.event.2.description: You still cannot believe it. You, an old war hero, are now lord of an entire duchy. You are already looking forward to finding a pretty duchess and having a brood of children. You swear that you will never draw your sword again!
map.[roe] - jimmy.event.3.description: You pat the pocket where you have stowed the king’s personal letter and set off on the final leg of your journey...

map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.125.126.0.messa: “Hmm, I like it here,” you said to yourself. “This duchy seems quite extensive, and it would be wise to look around. I shall also need to take charge of as many buildings as possible. First, though, I must settle into the castle.”

Out of nowhere, as if from thin air, a stooped man in a black cloak appeared before you, thanked you for the gold, and vanished again.
When you checked your purse, you found it lighter by the promised amount.
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.126.54.0.messag:
Your keen eye spotted a letter beneath a stone. It read: “Some infernal monsters attacked our fortress. We have no hope. The commander ordered me to bury several things that must not fall into enemy hands. Everything is buried beneath the roots of the nearest tree.”
So you began to dig...

“Ha ha ha! So we managed to lead you astray and set our ambush after all!” their leader chuckled. Shouting and wildly swinging a dangerous-looking club, he hurled himself into battle.
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.129.109.1.messa: You reached a half-ruined castle and found signs that someone had been there recently. A familiar breath of death and destruction creeping nearby washed over you.

Your companions recoiled in horror! “Ugh, let us get out of here! This is the dreaded ancient Dragon City.”

map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.137.142.0.messa: You found signs of digging. Nearby, you discovered a pickaxe hidden in the dry undergrowth. Realising that this was probably what had caused the entire forest to wither, you took the pickaxe and began to dig...
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.137.30.0.messag: Hmm, if I could persuade the dragons to help me in the battles to come, their aid would certainly be welcome. After all, this concerns them too!

One breathed out a cloud of sulfur and fire and hissed, “Ssssssss! You are not permitted to speak with the Most High!” Then they all hurled themselves at you.

map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.35.25.1.message:
“This must be Hell itself! The renegade mages’ experiments seem to have reawakened the forces of evil and darkness that were defeated and banished long ago.”
“This is dreadful.”
“Yes. We must put a stop to it at any cost! Otherwise, the world as we know it will soon cease to exist.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.39.82.0.message: “Welcome. The only aid we can offer in your struggle against the demons is a group of our bravest warriors. Our castle is, of course, otherwise entirely at your disposal.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.46.19.0.message: It seems that something in their experiments turned against them, and you find only death and destruction here. Then you notice that some of the body parts are moving! You see what will haunt your sleepless nights to come: severed arms crawling along the ground on their fingers.

map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.54.101.1.messag:
You have reached a recently excavated passage inside the volcano. It apparently conceals the source of everything that has begun happening on the surface. A sturdy gate set into the rock separates you from the passage.
“This was not here before!” your guides remarked.

map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.8.52.0.message: “Welcome. We are plagued by the cold. It has grown steadily colder over recent years, and our people are suffering. Strange things are also happening in the north. The only aid we can offer in your struggle against the demons is a group of our bravest warriors. Our castle is, of course, otherwise entirely at your disposal.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.80.126.0.messag: At last, you reached the castle you had longed for. But you learned sad news: old Duke Valsidal of Axim, whom you were to replace, sailed out to sea to fish a few days ago, and no one has seen him since.

“This was not here before!” your guides remarked.
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.83.128.0.messag: You spotted a wretched-looking group of mages in tattered tunics. Your guides pointed out that they were probably members of the ancient Fellowship of White Magic from the Island of the Rising Sun, which lies a little north of the duchy’s eastern coast. They are said to be friendly.
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.86.120.0.messag: Aha, a ring. The old duke must have lost it here on one of his outings.
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.9.134.0.message: The water in a nearby well began to churn ominously, and several water elementals rose from it. They clearly do not appreciate you disturbing their peace.
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.90.33.1.message: You have reached a dragon cave.
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.97.20.0.message: The barbarians could never have built a castle like this themselves. Someone must have helped them. There was something strange about those recent attacks, too. Hmm. The Northern Islands are closest. Renegade mages are said to live there. I smell devilry afoot.
map.[roe] - jimmy.guards.97.46.0.message: The earth is cracking here. It apparently cannot withstand the immense pressures within it.
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.description:
For his many years of service, the retired war hero Jimmy was rewarded by the king with a ducal title and rule over the Duchy of Axim. He therefore sets off for the north of the kingdom, hoping at last to find his true love and settle down for good. 
How very wrong he was...
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.name: Jimmy
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.0.text: “I heard that when this world was still young, the One True God, newly born to protect the human race from monsters in the depths of darkness, imprisoned the other gods, who were all at odds with one another, in a special prison said to lie somewhere in the middle of the North Sea.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.1.text: “Psst.”... “People are whispering that demons abducted the old duke.”... “I do not believe it.”... “I do. Something bad has been happening on the northern islands lately. Have you noticed that no ship has sailed in from the north for a long time?”... “Perhaps there is something to it.”... “Definitely!”... “Heeey, innkeeper, another one...”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.10.text: “Did you know there is a legend about the Devil’s Maw?”... “No. What legend?”... “They say that when the world was still young, a famous hero whose name has long been forgotten stood against the demons of darkness there. He won and left his sword there to bind the evil within the earth.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.11.text: “The ground has begun shaking frequently of late. My mother believes it heralds evil times to come.”... “Oh, come now, surely you do not believe those old wives’ tales?”... “I do not know, but nothing is as it used to be. I think I shall head south.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.12.text: “Did you know there is a Magic Circle in the southeast of the duchy? They say whoever enters its centre will meet a god. But no one who has dared step inside has ever returned alive.”... “I heard it was God’s Circle.”... “God’s?!? Then why does it kill people?”... “I do not know. Someone ought to investigate!”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.13.text: “If you want more combat experience, visit the training centre above the university.”... “Is it really as good as I have heard?”... “Certainly. As you can probably tell, I have been through several battles, and I must say I learned a few new tricks there.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.14.text: “I heard that only the Holy Grail, said to be buried somewhere, can deliver us from the dark times ahead.”... “I thought it was just a fairy tale!”... “No, it really exists. There are clues all around us. You simply have to look closely!”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.15.text: “Something must have happened to the world. Have you noticed?”... “What?”... “The days seem shorter, and the sun no longer shines as it used to. It is as though we have lost our protector.”... “Who?”... “Ah... the One.”... “?!?”... “God, of course.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.16.text: “No expedition or message has reached the duchy from the Northern Fortress on the northeastern island for a long time.”... “Someone should find out what happened there.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.17.text: “Have you been to the mages’ island yet?”... “No. Have you?”... “Yes. There is snow and bitter cold around their castles!”... “Nonsense! Their island is only a short way off the eastern coast!”... “I am telling the truth! They say the mages draw their power from their immediate surroundings—the earth and air—and cool the air around them in the process.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.2.text: “I tell you, I am none too fond of those monks who settled south of the university.”... “Why? They do not seem strange to me.”... “For a start, there are all those odd things happening near their village.”... “My brother saw something there once that frightened him so badly he did not say a word for a whole month.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.3.text: “I have just returned from the western university. I must say, what I learned there in a single week would surely have taken a year of hard searching anywhere else. If you want to learn something worthwhile, be sure to visit.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.4.text: “They say ships vanish in the middle of the North Sea.”... “Yes, I heard that sailors hear strange singing there.”... “It is the honest truth, you landlubber! No one will ever make me sail those waters again.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.5.text: “Have you visited the Island of Angels yet?”... “No. What is it, and where?”... “There is an island northwest of the harbour where angels are born. It is simply beautiful!”... “Thank you. I shall take a look as soon as I have time.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.6.text: “I heard the ancient cemetery in the eastern part of the duchy is haunted!”... “You do not say.”... “Yes, it is true, I swear. Once, while my son was felling trees nearby, he heard strange howling from the cemetery.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.7.text: “Did you know some monsters have settled in the old mine tunnels in the western part of the mountains? I have heard strange noises several times while working in the mines.”... “Monsters? Probably dwarves!”... “Ha, ha, ha...”... “Quiet! I am serious. Several friends of mine have even disappeared, and no one has heard from them since.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.8.text: “Have you visited the ancient cemetery yet?”... “No. Where is it?”... “According to legend, the last and fiercest battle between humans, gods and demons took place in the ducal forest to the west. Many brave heroes died, and several gods were slain as well. Look around there. You might find some useful artifacts.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.header.rumor.9.text: “Once, when I went to see the Devil’s Maw, I heard a terrifying rasping from deep within the earth. I did not wait around—I took to my heels!”... “Yes, and when you woke up, your hand was in the chamber pot, was it?”... “I speak the truth, upon my soul!”... “You had better look after it, then.”... “Ha, ha, ha.”

map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.100.128.0.mess: “There have been far too many earthquakes lately. I cannot remember the earth ever being this restless. People are nervous and growing afraid. Sometimes they even attack one another for no reason. What the devil is happening to this world?”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.100.83.0.messa: “Take us with you. If our High Mage has been killed, we want to avenge him!”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.101.84.0.messa: “By joining forces, we finally managed to drive off the attackers, but it weakened us so much that we may be of little use in the days ahead.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.102.82.0.messa: “At last. Unknown monsters attacked us. Although we raised a magical barrier against them, they managed to break into the town and abduct the High Mage, taking an artifact with them. If they use it, all living things may be destroyed. Free the High Mage and bring the artifact back!”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.102.85.0.messa: “Welcome. The Elder is already expecting you at the castle. Go and speak to him at once!”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.103.137.0.mess: “I heard that when this world was still young, the One True God, newly born to protect the human race from monsters, imprisoned the other gods, who were all at odds with one another, in a special prison said to lie somewhere in the middle of the North Sea. If only we could find them and persuade them to help!”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.104.83.0.messa: "The town is no longer what it was. Many of us were killed in battle, and some were dragged off to places unknown. Nothing will ever be the same again."
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.106.82.0.messa: “A short way north of this island stands the ancient Northern Fortress, built to defend your people against the barbarians. If the monsters reached us here, they must have passed through that fortress! You must find out what happened. If the Northern Fortress has fallen, nothing stands between the barbarians and an attack on the kingdom!”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.107.81.0.messa: “Many fine mages were killed in the battle. Help us. Our power has no effect on those monsters...”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.107.84.0.messa: “Look around here. There are many scrolls bearing spells that will be useful in the coming battles against the forces of darkness. We hope they will serve you well.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.108.85.0.messa: “I dread the moment when that stolen artifact is used. We mages will lose our power, and the world will be shrouded in eternal darkness.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.111.82.0.messa: “I suspect the renegade mages had a hand in the attack. They were expelled from our fellowship some time ago for their devotion to black magic. They are said to have gone somewhere in the northern islands, where they practise their dark rituals undisturbed.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.111.85.0.messa: “I saw the fleeing monsters carrying our High Mage into the forest along the eastern road!”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.113.88.0.messa: “Wait. Before you enter the magical barrier we built, I must open a passage through it... Good. Follow the road, and you will come to no harm. Stray from it, however, and doom awaits you.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.116.62.0.messa: “Welcome, O hero. Long ago, one of my masters made this wish: If magic should ever threaten the land with destruction, give this cloak to the first hero you meet. It will help him fight evil spells,” said the genie, handing you an artifact.
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.117.21.1.messa: We will allow no one to free the prisoner.
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.118.19.1.messa: We will allow no one to free the prisoner.
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.119.20.1.messa: We will allow no one to free the prisoner.
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.120.21.1.messa: We will allow no one to free the prisoner.
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.121.138.0.mess:
“Beautiful, is it not? Circles like these are called Circles of the Gods. They say that whoever enters their centre will speak with God. Many have tried.” 
“They tried and failed?”
“They tried and died.”
“...oh!”
“I have also heard there is another on the druids’ western island. Unfortunately, I have never been there.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.122.125.0.mess: “My respects, Duke. If I may offer some advice, do not take the eastern road into the forest. Yesterday I was felling trees nearby, and towards evening I heard strange sounds. It was as though someone were wailing without end. Every hair on my body stood on end, I tell you. I ran from there as fast as my legs would carry me!”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.124.132.0.mess: “You must have noticed on your arrival that the southeastern forest has died. No one knows why, though. There is plenty of speculation, but nothing proven.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.124.134.0.mess: “Have you visited the Ancient Cemetery yet? According to legend, the last and fiercest battle between humans, gods and demons took place there. Many brave heroes died, and several gods were slain as well. Look around there. You might find some useful artifacts.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.126.134.0.mess: “I heard in the tavern that some monsters or other supposedly abducted the old duke. I do not really believe it, but these days you never know...”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.13.138.0.messa: Welcome to our little town. Many scholars here will share much of their magical knowledge with you—provided, of course, that you can understand this mysterious art!
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.13.140.0.messa: Evil times are coming. Darkness is beginning to grow in human hearts. We have troubling news from our mage friends in the north. Some ancient evil is awakening again after many millennia.
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.136.7.1.messag: The One must not be freed.
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.142.136.0.mess:
“Greetings, Duke. We expected you several days ago. What delayed you?”
“The journey here was rather difficult, and I am no longer a young man.”
“Then allow us to escort you to your new castle now.”
“Very well, let us go.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.22.135.0.messa:
A passer-by addressed you: “Would you happen to be heading to Magic Town?”
“Yes. How did you know?”
“Well, few people take this road. I would rather not be here myself, but duty is duty. They say strange things happen around the town. Several people have disappeared there, so everyone keeps away.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.25.119.0.messa: “Beware of the Devil’s Maw. Once, when I went to see it, I heard a terrifying rasping from deep within the earth. I did not wait around—I took to my heels!”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.27.118.0.messa: “If you want more combat experience, visit the training centre above the university.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.29.118.0.messa: “There is an island northwest of the harbour where angels are born. It is simply magnificent. Be sure to visit when you have the time and inclination. There is also a viewpoint in the western mountains from which you can see the island in fine weather. It costs a small fortune, though.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.29.120.0.messa: “Our beloved old duke disappeared after setting out to sea. It is strange, for he is the finest sailor I know. He is completely at home at sea. He is also unbelievably lucky and has always escaped every danger with ease! The people love him. Please find him and bring him back.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.32.133.0.messa: “Halt. Some monsters have settled in the old mine tunnels! The miners have heard strange noises several times while working there, and several are even said to be missing. We would be most grateful if you helped us solve this problem.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.68.67.0.messag: We will allow no one to free the King of Fire!
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.70.69.0.messag: We will allow no one to free the King of Water!
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.71.65.0.messag: We will allow no one to free the King of Air!
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.72.67.0.messag: We will allow no one to free the King of Earth!
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.81.129.0.messa:
“Welcome. What brings you to our harbour?”
The oldest of the mages standing nearby spoke:
“Greetings, Duke... You are the new one, are you not?”
“Yes. I arrived only a few days ago.”
“We have come to ask for immediate help, for we have been attacked! We alone managed to escape the encirclement.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.85.132.0.messa: “No expedition or message has reached the duchy from the Northern Fortress on the northeastern island for a long time. Someone should find out what happened there.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.87.131.0.messa: “I heard that ships vanish in the middle of the North Sea, and sailors hear strange singing there.”
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.88.18.0.messag:
“These ships belong to our Dark Lord! None but his servants may use them.”
“The Dark Lord, you say? Who is he?”
“What? You do not know who rules the darkness? His Darkness Nad, of course! You will pay for your ignorance with your lives!”
As one, the creatures reached for their weapons and hurled themselves at the bold intruder.
map.[roe] - jimmy.monster.89.130.0.messa: "If you want to learn something, visit the university to the west."

You received word that a spy sent to murder you had been caught in your castle. Fortunately, you were away at the time. After a gruelling interrogation, it was discovered that the centre of the dark forces is the underground Castle Yksvonelam, where new infernal creatures are summoned every month! This castle must be captured immediately.
Messengers brought word that an ultimatum had been delivered to the castle, ordering all dwellings to be evacuated and every inhabitant to leave within one month. If they do not, everyone will be assimilated.
Messengers from the duchy brought good news. The king has finally grasped the gravity of the worsening situation in the north, ended his wars in the south, and at last sent an entire army of his finest men.

map.[roe] - justinian.header.description: The land of the mages is preparing to attack its ancient enemies, the warlocks. But only the strongest mage will have the honour of destroying the underground race.
map.[roe] - justinian.header.name: Justinian

map.[roe] - justinian.sign.21.14.1.messa: Pride comes before a fall, so do not land on your bloody face.
After an arduous journey, you have finally reached your castle. This castle was given to you as a base. Scouts report that the knights have rebelled and posted guards here. They are said to be guarding the road to the mage. They do not want the mage destroyed, for they fear no one can accomplish it.
Necromancers are said to have settled nearby, hoping to free their master. This land is inhabited by barbarians with whom we have made peace, and they honour it. Unfortunately, they are not pleased by your visit, so do not be surprised if they attack you.
The land is very rich, with treasure simply lying on the ground, so do not be surprised to find it easily. There are magical items here too, reportedly including 4 spellbooks and even the Holy Grail. Try to free Odara, the holy warrior. She wanted to kill the mage, so they imprisoned her.
This week has gone badly for you.

map.[roe] - kletba temneho maga.header.d: The dark mage was finally captured and imprisoned on a magical plain guarded by angels, dragons and magical buildings. Before his imprisonment, however, he cast a spell that turns all wealth taken across the border into stone. You, the young druid Rian, must discover where the dark mage is being held and destroy him.
You have finally arrived, my lord. Please take us into your service and at last lead our people to peace. We know of a barbarian town to the south. Perhaps you can learn where the castle stands.
Beware: only one pile is real. The other two are false and mean certain death to anyone who touches them. On the other hand, the real one is far more valuable than you think.
We will let no one onto Treasure Island.
Behind the monsters, you see a cloak. You have heard of it before: it can produce crystals.
Good day, my lord. We hope you are faring well, and we wish to tell you of great riches at the end of this road. There are mines and plenty of gold there.
We will let no one into the tent. Our master ordered it!

My lord! Stop a moment and hear our advice. As a warning, the dark mage imprisoned Jarik and his army a short way from the elven town. He is immensely experienced and would surely help you. The elven town lies in the mountains to the west, guarded against enemies by hundreds of knights. They will not admit even the king himself.
If you go a little way east, you will reach our town.
We will give no one the key to the dark mage’s towers.

No one shall go to heaven

Not another step

We guard the entrance to the underground, and we will not let you through either.
We will share our secret with no one

We will let no one into our world.

map.[roe] - kníže.event.0.description: After Svatopluk’s death, the realm fell apart. As one of his heirs, you have the right to claim what is yours. Prove yourself worthy of the royal title and unite the land under your rule.
map.[roe] - kníže.event.1.description: The once mighty realm is now fragmented following Svatopluk’s death. As commander of Svatopluk’s guard, you too are a contender for the throne. But you must defeat his incompetent sons and prove yourself worthy of the royal title.
map.[roe] - kníže.event.10.description: My lord. A wandering monk has arrived at your castle. In gratitude for our hospitality, he revealed that a fine sword and shield are hidden behind a cactus below the sandy crater in the Valley of Death.
map.[roe] - kníže.event.2.description: Your father Pribina was forced to leave and seek refuge in Blatno. Svatopluk’s death has given you the opportunity to return and take the place denied to your family. Prove that you are the rightful heir and become king.
map.[roe] - kníže.event.3.description: King Svatopluk’s mighty realm fell apart after his death. As one of his descendants, you have the right to seek the throne. But you must defeat your rivals before you can become king.
map.[roe] - kníže.event.4.description: Your father’s realm fell apart after his death. You can no longer stand by as the male contenders for the throne destroy it. Prove that a woman can rule the land too. Defeat your rivals and become queen.
map.[roe] - kníže.event.5.description: The strongest town in the land is Svatopluk’s royal seat. Taking control of it will secure your power and make your rivals easier to defeat. The lord of Svatopluk’s town has the strongest claim to the throne, so you should seize it before your rivals do.
map.[roe] - kníže.event.6.description: My lord. We hear reports of great hordes of Huns in the northwest, pillaging and plundering. We should prepare for them.
map.[roe] - kníže.event.7.description: My lord. A priest arriving from Svantovit’s shrine has read the omens and says we must not allow the Huns to take Devín. Perhaps we should try to occupy our most distant fortress and prevent it from falling into their hands. If they take it, they will have free access to the land.
map.[roe] - kníže.event.8.description: My lord. Attila has captured Vogast, one of the finest Slavic warriors. Although you have had disagreements with him in the past, we should try to rescue him from the Huns. Winning him over to our side could benefit us.
map.[roe] - kníže.event.9.description: My lord. A wretched pilgrim has arrived at your castle, telling of terrible things he endured in the dungeons. We had better avoid them. Without a strong enough army, we might never return.
map.[roe] - kníže.guards.0.17.1.message: Brave hero, we black knights stand ready to fight beneath your banner. Accept a black sword and black shield as gifts.

A few notes before the game itself begins:
Every battle in the game can be won, so do your best.
There is always a solution to the situation, so do not despair.
Read every text: it will help you.
If you encounter a message from me, follow it. This is necessary to preserve the intended course of the game.

Technical notes:
Map name: Hidden Threat (Touch of Hell II)
Version: 1.0, RoE
Size: XL
Difficulty: Normal
Number of players: 1
Author: Leki   
Address: Leki@post.cz 
Beta testing: Gremlin
Distribution: Kal - Kal

Visit www.mageo.cz - Games section, Heroes of Might and Magic!

The first month of your journey is over... More has happened than you could have expected at the outset...
Still, a little adventure seems to be doing you good...
The Week of the Imp… Such a thing has not happened here for centuries…
What a strange coincidence… The Week of the Imp has come for a second time!
Something underhanded is certainly happening here... A third consecutive Week of the Imp bodes ill! We must get to the bottom of this!
You have been travelling for 99 days... The land is not safe without its ruler...
The brigands’ raid is sudden and unexpected!	The screams and cries of the terrorised people echo through the night...	The robbers’ main target, however, is your treasury and the wealth stored within!

No one slept a wink tonight...	Small tremors at first, then a mighty earthquake towards dawn, destroying people’s homes... Large quantities of materials must be spent on essential repairs to the buildings...
Mild tremors during the night have unsettled the local people…
The ground trembled faintly again tonight... The people fear an earthquake...

Whether you enjoy the game or not, please do not hesitate to send me a few lines at the address above.
To be safe, I shall repeat it: Leki@post.cz
Your suggestions and comments will certainly inspire me!
                                           Yours, Leki
Welcome to Green Land.

War rages in the north...
The spawn of Hell are trying to invade Green Land. The northern harbour lies in ruins, and there is no safe passage through it. The captain of your merchant ship therefore decides to sail around the continent and try to land at the first suitable spot on the western or southern shore...

To be safe, you leave all your possessions aboard the ship and order it to anchor a short distance offshore. Although your journey is unlikely to be dangerous, you do not wish to risk losing your hard-earned wealth.
Every day, tax revenues fall by 500 gold... The war raging in the north is driving even inland inhabitants from their homes... I am sorry, but the situation seems likely only to worsen...

... After several days at sea, a small bay seems a suitable choice. It once served as a landing place for merchants from the southwestern islands... But who knows what it is like now, since pirates began attacking merchant ships and trade gradually declined... In any case, it is worth a try...

... According to the maps in the captain’s cabin, home should lie directly northeast of the landing place... Through a mountain pass... Hmm, the map has seen quite a few years, and some labels have faded... In any case, through the pass in the mountains to the south...

...Then through the Golden Forest, following the road straight to Lake City, where you can board a ship and cross the Great Lake. From there, home is only a short distance away... Altogether, it is no more than 144 miles as the crow flies, about 100 miles through Green Land’s southern holdings and the rest through your territory. It should be easy... Onward, then!
Miraculously, the old war machine factory still works. The dwarves have not yet abandoned it…

You emerge from the Dimension Door, and it seems fortune favours your search... That hooded creature must be the guardian of the Grail!!!
This must be Eden!
Could this be the entrance to the legendary Underground Path linking Zen Tower to the Monastery of the Moon…
You glance up at the surrounding treetops and immediately understand how the nearby village got its name.

a brief merging of the astral world with ours... Though the rift closed, it remained open long enough for infernal monsters to pass through into our world. With the other mages’ help, we tried to stop them, but there were far too many enemies...
This landscape overflows with magical energy. It is the perfect place to perform the most demanding magical rituals.
This landscape overflows with magical energy. It is the perfect place to perform the most demanding magical rituals.
Careful, do not break it!
Beneath the tall trees, the natives busily work the timber.
Hmm, is there anything these mages don't have...
This landscape overflows with magical energy. It is the perfect place to perform the most demanding magical rituals.
Home at last!

You open the long-closed gate of Falcon’s Eye... You try in vain to savour the feeling, interrupted by a sudden commotion... Your ship’s crew has sailed around the southern peninsula, allowing the ship to come upriver far sooner than expected. Your goods and the rest of the crew are already here!!!

A huge lock hangs on your castle’s main gate... A guard named Kal Kal ought to be up in the tower, but he is not called Tippler for nothing... Luna Monastery is nearby, and its tavern is truly excellent... He has surely pitched his tent somewhere close to it!

the spell’s effectiveness... But the experiment spun out of control. The sudden release of enormous energy blasted apart every floor of the tower... The air temperature plunged far below freezing... Countless creatures and plants died instantly...
Far worse, however, was that the wave of energy caused...
And what is this for?

If I knew he no longer posed a threat, I would give you every soldier I have here...
If only I knew he was finished...
An interesting little thing...
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!

A group of young men has heard of your arrival, and all are eager to join you… Each hopes to earn his knightly spurs…
What is that lying beside the road?

resistant to a great many weapons, yet almost defenceless against ice spells. Ordinary spells, though effective, do not cover a wide enough area to stop large numbers of these monsters... So the Grandmaster shut himself in the tower with several senior mages, seeking a way to increase...
You look down to see what you have been treading on all this time... God, the paths between the rocks are filled with heaps of bones whose origins you dare not guess.
And before I forget… The scouts' agreed password is "Citadel"…
The runes inscribed on the scrolls burn with fiery flames... This must be a very powerful spell indeed... You would never have imagined this Gremlin capable of such things...

The founder of this village is buried here… Surely he will not need this thing any longer…
The attack is sudden and unexpected... A band of robbers drops upon you from the treetops!
The scenery around you is enchanting… A pity such scum roam through it!
As you approach the enclosure, you sense a powerful magical barrier... That is the real obstacle, not those few stakes driven into the ground...

Four thugs suddenly rush at you from the cabin...
 But your laughter dies on your lips as a host of others springs from behind the surrounding trees to help them!
The attack is sudden and unexpected... A band of robbers drops upon you from the treetops!

decided to resist. But the enemy’s numbers are overwhelming, so our Grandmaster Drah - or resolved to attempt a very dangerous experiment... If only the times were not so dire, forcing us to such measures... The infernal monsters are very powerful in battle, especially the fiery efreet, who are the opposite of our creations...
Someone seems to live in a cave beneath the steep mountain peak. Judging by his clothes and living conditions, he must be a hermit. Perhaps he can tell you how to cross the mountains...
What might this deserted island conceal? All manner of questions race through your mind as your steps leave tracks in the hot sand…
You emerge from behind the rocks directly opposite a mysterious sarcophagus... What might lie beneath those weather-beaten stone slabs, covered in half-legible symbols?
Unfortunately, it was only a small band... The bandit leader was not among them...
A fire burns low in this clearing. Someone left it only moments ago…

You quietly call out the agreed password... Nothing happens for a while, but a moment later a fellow suddenly appears before you, having been hidden among the boulders.
“Greetings... There is a brigands’ cabin over to the east, but I have not spotted the bandits yet...

You reach for the shield leaning against the head of the sarcophagus, utterly untouched by time... Wanting to try it out, you grasp it with both hands and begin pulling it from the sand... But the sudden scrape of the sarcophagus lid makes you look up... The dead man’s spirit will not let you take his possessions so easily...
The attack is sudden and unexpected... A band of robbers drops upon you from the treetops!

This seems to be the lair of one of the bands...
Cracking twigs catch your attention... Something is happening at the eastern end of the path...
The attack is sudden and unexpected... A band of robbers drops upon you from the treetops!
Over there, among the trees opposite! Figures in green hoods are trying to vanish into the forest... You must catch them before they disappear into its eastern reaches!

Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
That boulder is clearly the largest for miles around… Another scout should be hiding nearby…
Unfortunately, it was only a small band... The bandit leader was not among them...

You quietly call out the agreed password... Nothing happens for a while, but a moment later a fellow suddenly appears before you, camouflaged with grasses and leaves...
“Greetings... There is an old fort over to the east, but it is empty... The robbers seem to be hiding in the southern part of the forest...”

Old Kal Kal has pitched his tent a little apart from the others. Most people know him better as Tippler... No one can match him at drinking... He is responsible for the keys to the main gate of Falcon’s Eye... But instead of being in the guardhouse, he is sitting in the local tavern... Well, his superiors are far away.

Well, Tippler must have drunk terribly heavily yesterday... That hangover is nothing to envy... See how green his face is, and how he keeps swaying from side to side? At least he told us where he put the gate keys...
The attack is sudden and unexpected... A band of brigands rushes at you from behind the surrounding trees and through the hut’s doorway!
There they are! They are fleeing south!

Along the way, the mage begins his tale:
As you know, war has broken out in the north, and infernal monsters are preparing to overrun Green Land. Lord Michael fell in an unequal battle, and all was lost, but fortunately a hero appeared who, with the help of Marion, the lady of the forest...
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
The attack is sudden and unexpected... A band of robbers drops upon you from the treetops!
Unfortunately, it was only an insignificant band… The bandit leader is not among them…

The fight is short and brutal... The robbers’ leader kneels at your feet... You tear away the amulet, which is worth far more to you than the mangy bandit could ever imagine... You turn to leave... Then you remember there is one small thing left to do...
A casual sweep of your sword takes care of it...

At last, the pass through the Southern Border Mountains lies behind you... From here, the shortest route to your town heads northeast. But many miles still lie ahead. Your journey through the mountains has taught you much, however, so the going will be a little easier.
The trail is heavily overgrown. Nevertheless, you stubbornly hack your way towards your goal.

You bend down with interest... Your horse has just stumbled over something. You pick it up and examine it closely... Two dark eye sockets stare emptily at you... You are holding a human skull! Looking around, you see no shortage of others... They fill the entire gorge...
There is the hunters' leader. He seems to be watching an animal moving among the trees at the foot of the strangely coloured cliffs...

Huge boulders block the way through the mountains. No one has maintained this once busy pass for years... A few years were all it took for uncleared avalanches and rampant vegetation to do their work... This way seems impassable... You would need wings to get through here...

You descend through the pass to the far side of the mountains. The landscape here is more hostile... A marsh stretches as far as the eye can see. The ground is treacherous, and an unpleasant stench rises from the dark pools... It will be a hard journey...
You had better stay out of the stone city. You would only turn the spirits against you. Merely entering their territory has provoked them enough…
A sharp pain shoots through the back of your hand! You crush the annoying insect, but another bloodthirsty swamp fly immediately attacks!

You have entered forbidden ground, mortal!!! You will not leave alive!!!
The drawn-out wailing of spirits mingles with the wind roaring among the rocks. Cold sweat breaks out all over your body...
The sudden change from freezing cold to heat takes your breath away.
This must be a gateway to the higher realms. For now, however, it remains closed to you…
You have a grim feeling that once you pass through this gate, there may be no turning back...

One skeleton wears a fine helmet on its skull. You try to remove it, but a red glow awakens in the empty eye sockets... The skeleton comes to life, along with the others that had been lying motionless all around...
You stand a short distance from the gate and look around. You seem to be in some sort of rocky maze. Well... if the legends are true, the answer to the Grail’s whereabouts should lie here...

The battlements of an ancient fortress loom ominously above the pass. Once a resting place for weary travellers crossing the mountains, it is now home to creatures of darkness... You feel little desire to enter through its half-ruined gate... This is where the black cloud shrouding the heavens rises into the sky.
The unicorn is dead. Your first thrill at the hunt has suddenly vanished... The dull gaze of its eyes will stay with you forever... Suddenly you feel utterly wretched...
The sudden change from freezing cold to heat takes your breath away.
Here rests the founder of this refuge…

map.[roe] - les.header.description: Fight on a map full of forests. The Grail may help you win.
map.[roe] - les.header.name: Forest

from every town. (It can only be in a spell book.)

map.[roe] - maturita.event.3.description:

THERE IS A DRAGON CITY TO THE SOUTHWEST.
map.[roe] - maturita.event.4.description: THERE IS A DRAGON CITY AND FREE ANGELS TO THE EAST
