map.[roe] - navrat domu.event.0.descript: Many years ago, the knights of the Order of the Solar Circle invaded the necromancers' homeland. Led by Prince Christian, hordes of knights poured into their country. They razed villages, demolished ancient sacred altars and slaughtered the entire population without mercy.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.event.1.descript: They enslaved every member of the powerful families, humiliating them to deepen their disgrace. Not a stone was left standing in the old homeland. The Brotherhood of the Solar Circle plundered the land and destroyed everything it could. But many knights disliked the harsh conditions of these uncivilised regions.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.event.2.descript: Most of the brotherhood's knights returned to their old homeland laden with spoils. Only Christian and a few of his most loyal companions remained, trying to spread their holy faith among the wild tribes. Some tribes succumbed. Yet the faithful never forgot their ruler, Dracula.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.event.3.descript: They still hope he will return one day and everything will be as it was. You can make their dreams come true. After your father Dracula died of exhaustion in a quarry, you swore by the Great Spirit to take terrible revenge on Christian and his brotherhood.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.event.4.descript: After arduous preparations, you escaped with a handful of your most faithful servants, though the losses were heavy. A harrowing journey brought you to your old homeland. You stand at its border, facing a difficult task. Will you destroy the Brotherhood of the Solar Circle?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.event.5.descript: First, however, you must seize and build a new home from which to raid the brotherhood's knights. Be careful. If you die, your line will end and your father Dracula's name will be forgotten!
Something glinted in the bushes beside the road. You looked closer and found a bag of gold. You tossed it into your saddlebag and rode on. You had barely gone a few paces when a band of gold golems surrounded you: the bag belonged to them. Will you fight them for it?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.103.105.0: Your men discovered the castle's chief footman in hiding. You tortured him horribly, but all he knew was that there was only one way to reach Christian, and it resembled a descent into the depths of hell.
You spotted a necklace in a crack between the rocks and managed to pull it out. A band of devils immediately appeared, demanding your soul in exchange. Would you rather fight them for the necklace?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.12.20.0.m: As soon as you approached the tent, a hydra's monstrous body rose from the swamp. It probably had not had a decent meal in ages.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.19.74.0.m: Damn those ogres. They seem to be breeding out of control. You have found another trace of them. The shield you discovered clearly belonged to those stupid but powerful brutes. You soon get firsthand proof as a whole band emerges from an underground cave. Will you fight them for the shield?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.2.3.0.mes: Home at last! You have crossed the border of your old homeland. Your first task is to seize a settlement and build a new home. You recognise the countryside where you spent your childhood. You recall that a prosperous town once stood to the south.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.2.32.0.me: Before you stand the pitiful remnants of a wild dendroid tribe. Countless dendroids lived here in the old days. Christian's men even built a sawmill to process the poor creatures, as though there were not enough forests around.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.2.81.0.me: A strange little bottle, filled with a silvery liquid. When you pick it up, it feels surprisingly heavy. Before you can ponder this, an odd humming comes from the forest. You soon discover its unpleasant source: a swarm of dragon flies is approaching. Will you stand against them?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.2.94.0.me: You finally obtained the bow, along with a tidy pile of gold the elves were carrying.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.2.95.0.me: You seem to have found what the old witch wanted. As soon as you reached for the artifact, a horde of demons flew out of the abyss. You hope the witch will reward you handsomely if you obtain it. Will you fight for it?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.3.55.0.me: You finally crushed the golems to dust. Among the rocks in the quarry, you spotted a large stone head. You thought of taking it to the castle and displaying it in the entrance hall. But as you began loading it, several giants rushed out of a cave on the hillside. They had commissioned the statue for themselves. Will you fight them for the head?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.3.94.0.me: Something glinted faintly beside a rock. You picked it up and cleaned it, revealing a magical bow of the wood elves. Your delight at the fine prize was spoiled by a terrible roar. A band of enraged elves charged out of the nearby forest. Will you fight them for the bow?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.32.45.0.m: An unusual club caught your eye. 'That would make a fine weapon,' you thought. Before you could touch it, ogre magi surrounded you. 'Leave it alone! We were just coming for it. Our chief lost it last night on our way back from the hunt.' Will you fight them for the club?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.35.66.0.m: This strange building reminds you of a certain great leader. He ended up in a mausoleum too . . .
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.4.36.0.me:
You have reached the Sacrificial Grove. You remember coming here to sacrifice centaurs bred especially for the purpose. Those were wonderful days. 
You realise the town is not far away now. Why not sacrifice a few centaurs? Perhaps the altar is still there!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.41.39.1.m: The castle is within reach. Revenge drives you ever onward. Suddenly, Christian's advance patrol blocks your path. You must defeat it to proceed. Clearly, the brotherhood's rule is ending, and your revenge will soon be complete.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.42.62.0.m: Another crate and the wreckage of a sunken ship. That volcanic eruption must have destroyed many vessels. Who knows whether an entire volcanic island has risen from the sea?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.5.4.0.mes: You see a border fortress to the south. Even from a distance, it looks rather dilapidated. You hope its garrison is in a similar state. Just in case, you perform a dark ritual to contact your father's spirit. He promises to help and teaches you a few spells.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.5.43.0.me: A frightened group of centaurs emerges from the thicket. They seem to have multiplied unchecked: clearly, no one has performed a sacrificial ritual here for a long time. At least your offering will be all the more effective.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.5.65.0.me: Home at last! Time to start building your main stronghold. Then you must urgently send one of your heroes north to the Frozen Lands. You remember your father saying they were the richest region for miles around.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.5.92.0.me: Between the rocks lies a deep chasm, said to lead straight to hell. Judging by the smell rising from it, some might well believe the tale.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.50.42.1.m: 'Come on then, you godless dog,' Christian greets you. You do not let him finish. With your father's name on your lips, you draw your sword and attack. The final battle begins . . . .
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.50.55.0.m: As you approached the strange little house, a tremendous wind arose. It nearly tore the ship's sails apart. Suddenly, air elementals emerged from a whirlwind before you. You prepare for battle: you could never outrun them anyway, for they are terribly fast.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.53.5.0.me: You have barely taken a few steps when you feel the air tremble with supernatural magic. Your father has kept his promise. You would not want to be an intruder in these lands. It would probably end badly for you.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.53.80.0.m: Something suddenly broke away from a towering crag whose summit you could barely see. At first, it seemed a chunk of rock had come loose. Soon you realised your mistake. What everyone had taken for a boulder was a flock of harpies.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.53.83.0.m: The pilot rushed over to warn you of shallows ahead. Before you could furl the sails, the ship struck a submerged rock. You were all frozen with fright. But there is no time for fear: the ship is taking on water and must be repaired.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.58.36.0.m: The air is growing colder, a sure sign that your ship is nearing the Frozen Lands. Occasionally a deep rumble sounds: the volcano seems restless. You all hope it will not decide to erupt as you sail past.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.6.11.0.me: You have discovered that Christian's power is weak along the border, at least. Fortunately for you. But you must not assume the same holds throughout the country. Now hurry south. With your father's magical boots, you realise you can get there in under a week.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.6.13.0.me: The old marsh where you used to hunt victims for ancient rituals has grown. It almost reaches the forest road. Clearly, the land has fallen into neglect and the wilderness is spreading.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.6.61.0.me: At the foot of the cliffs, you notice a collapsed mine. The spirits of the miners who died there guard it.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.60.94.0.m: An ancient dragon dwelling stands on this rocky islet. Dragons dislike uninvited visitors. The moment the dragon sentries spotted you, they attacked without warning.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.62.17.0.m: You hear deep rumbling, and the air reeks of sulfur. An entire new archipelago is visible on the horizon near the passage to the Frozen Lands. Let us hope there is no eruption!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.62.28.1.m: What a dreadful maze. Christian has burrowed in like a mole. He must sense that he is in deep trouble.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.69.19.1.m: You have a feeling this is not the way.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.7.4.0.mes: Your father's spirit spoke: 'Do not waste time on that now! There will be time later. Remember, you will barely make it to town within a week! I will give you my wondrous boots, but you must hurry!'
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.7.42.0.me: You are pleased to find the Sacrificial Grove still intact. No outsider even suspects what lies behind those trees.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.78.92.0.m: Someone dropped a fine ring beside the road. You dismounted to pick it up when a band of adventurers arrived in a cloud of dust. Will you fight them for the ring?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.89.28.0.m: Were you expecting a welcoming committee?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.90.44.0.m: You found a hat in a small forest clearing. You reached for it, but a horde of arch mages burst into the glade. The hat belongs to their grand master. They were about to cast a powerful spell, and you interrupted them. Will you fight them for the hat?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.93.90.0.m: You are nearing the castle and see all the servants fleeing. Your guards caught one, who tries to convince you that Christian is not there. Apparently, he built a new stronghold somewhere underground and is gathering a great army there. But supposedly no one knows how to reach it.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.guards.94.91.0.m: You have reached Christian's main stronghold. You hope the mangy prince is inside. You can hardly wait to see his head roll in the dust at your feet.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.header.descripti:
After escaping captivity, you return to your old homeland, now held by the knight Christian and his brotherhood. Can you win it back? Only you can rid the entire country of the knights and avenge your father's death. 
Created by Hidden
map.[roe] - navrat domu.header.name: Return Home
map.[roe] - navrat domu.header.rumor.0.t: Search the terrain carefully. Many things are hidden at first glance!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.header.rumor.1.t: Remember the Sacrificial Grove. You can sacrifice centaurs for experience or turn them into skeletons at the castle.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.header.rumor.2.t: Set out for the Frozen Lands as soon as possible: you will not regret it!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.header.rumor.3.t: Do not leave your castle undefended: you may regret it!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.header.rumor.4.t: Try to find the Grail, and victory will be within reach!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.header.rumor.5.t: Take a sizeable army against Christian: he is no beginner!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.header.rumor.6.t: Save your game! It will come in handy sometimes!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.header.rumor.7.t: The enemy will never invade the Frozen Lands. If you find the Grail, build it there.
This building reminds you of the school you attended as a child, before the Brotherhood of the Solar Circle invaded your country. The monster outside certainly does not look like a caretaker, though.
Get lost, get lost, get lost! You filthy necromancer! We are not afraid of you.
We won this mine from the dwarves in a fair fight. Do you think you can simply turn up and we will hand it over willingly? You are sorely mistaken. Let us have a fair fight, and the winner gets the mine!
This building radiates so much magic that earth elementals have materialised from it. They are the strongest kind of elemental, but rather slow. You hope your archers shoot straight.
Christian had this monastery built as a training centre for his army, run by monks summoned from distant Tibet. They know secret rituals that can train troops in an instant. First, however, you must prove your worth by fighting them.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.monster.35.3.0.m: Go away, stranger! What are you doing here anyway? Even Christian's followers dare not enter these parts! We will not give you our little stones!
Welcome, our lord! We knew the illustrious house of Dracula would not die out. Praise the dark powers that brought you back!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.monster.4.75.0.m: I dislike the undead! They stink as badly as the sulfur I have to guard!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.monster.4.86.0.m: Another one trying to steal the wood we need to build our nests!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.monster.4.93.0.m: Where do you think you are going, you miserable worm?! Surely you do not want to join us in the depths of hell? One more step and you really will!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.monster.5.33.0.m: What do you want here? Leave us alone! We guard this forest sawmill as a memorial to our fallen brothers!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.monster.5.55.0.m: As you approached the mine in search of building materials, the stone statues, presumably left by craftsmen, suddenly came to life. You have heard that knights like to decorate their castles with larger-than-life statues. But this is the first time you have seen statues come alive.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.monster.5.60.0.m: Welcome, stranger! The Brotherhood of the Solar Circle is responsible for our deaths. Their greed caused the mine to collapse, burying us here forever. Our deaths remain unavenged. Allow us to help you reclaim your land. We give you the treasure left underground.
What do you want, you land-bound worm? Water is not your element! Go back where you came from!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.monster.68.6.0.m: Where are you rushing off to? If you want to reach the next world, I will gladly help!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.monster.9.72.0.m: Looking at these gorgons, you thought the witch living in the tree had chosen some unusual guards. Well, each to their own . . .
The crusaders, ready for anything, closed ranks and charged your party, shouting, 'You will reach Christian only over our dead bodies!!!'
And where might we be heading? You cannot pass this way.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.11.73.0.mes:
Enchanted Glade
A magical sprite lives among the flowers and occasionally gives gifts to passers-by.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.20.41.0.mes:
Come in for advice and service!
The best prices for miles around!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.28.16.0.mes: End of class 1 road. Proceed on foot only!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.32.64.0.mes: Visit our training centre! Quality guaranteed! Express service at low prices!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.39.40.1.mes: Construction halted due to lack of funds!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.40.66.0.mes: SOS, SOS: we will probably die here. We were sailing to the Frozen Lands and preparing to anchor offshore. Suddenly, an underwater volcano erupted and shattered our ship.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.49.29.1.mes: Those mushrooms do not look fit to eat twice. Once might be possible . . .
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.50.18.1.mes: Which way, which way does the path go?
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.50.3.0.mess: You are entering the sacred soil of the Frozen Lands! What are you doing here? This is a very dangerous territory that has belonged exclusively to necromancers since time immemorial!
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.68.54.1.mes: You probably cannot get through this forest. Usually you carry at least five axes, but today, just your luck . . .
map.[roe] - navrat domu.sign.76.24.1.mes: I would not drink from that lake if I were you. Just take a look around.
map.[roe] - navrat domu.town.6.64.0.even: Your father's spirit visited you at night. He reminded you to visit the Frozen Lands as soon as possible. They were the richest region of your old homeland. He also reminded you that they can only be reached by sea.

A foreign supply caravan tried to slip quietly past your castle at night. Your vigilant guards spotted and ambushed it. The spoils were considerable. You also turned all the merchants into skeletons through a dark ritual.

Christian's followers tried to land at your shipyard, but your guards were vigilant. They killed them all, and your mages performed a dark ritual on their corpses. At least your breeding grounds are better stocked now. They destroyed the ship without a trace.

The spirit of the great Dracula visited again and said: 'Son, do you remember our Sacrificial Grove? Go there from time to time and make an offering to the dark powers. Or bring the bred centaurs to your stronghold and turn them into skeletons through a dark ritual. May they serve you faithfully!'
Your scouts brought encouraging news. Christian's power is crumbling. Some of his followers have turned against him, forcing him to fight on two fronts. Yet his power remains considerable.

Another scout, presumed dead, came running back. He confirmed the earlier report and explained that the barbarian tribes based in the northeast had broken away from Christian. You have another enemy, but so does Christian.

On wings of darkness, your father's spirit visited again and said: 'This is my last visit, son. The ruler of the underworld disapproves of my trips to see you. But I have cast a mighty spell that cost me much effort and time.' He paused. Even the air seemed to carry his exhaustion.

After a while he continued: 'Thanks to this spell, no intruder will ever enter the Frozen Lands again. Only you and those you choose will pass unhindered. All others will perish miserably. Only their tracks in the snow will remain, and no one will ever see them again. I trust you will avenge me and honour my memory.'

The spies you sent to locate the leader of the Brotherhood of the Solar Circle are slowly returning. So far, they have only learned that his original stronghold was in the southeast of the country. No one knows where he is hiding now.
Another report has arrived from your spies. They dare not return, for they still have not discovered Christian's hiding place. They continue searching to earn your trust.

Some of your spies returned today. At sea, near the Frozen Lands, they captured a ship carrying supplies to Christian's hideout. After lengthy torture, all they learned from the crew was that they were to anchor by a volcanic island. They knew nothing of Christian's hideout.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.0.desc: You return to the city of Anjelopolis, a city with an illustrious history. A rebellion recently broke out there, and much of the population abandoned the true faith to worship the devil. You return to suppress the revolt, bring the rebels back to the faith, and try to find and destroy the dark powers.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.1.desc: Wonderful! You have recaptured Anjelopolis and defeated the rebels and their dark leader! The people celebrate and sing your praises. But where did their dark leader come from? Is this the end, or only the beginning...?
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.10.des: A storm caught you at sea near home and wrecked your ship. You must travel the rest of the way overland. Fortunately, it is not far now.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.2.desc: A dark cult of Satan worship has spread through the surrounding lands. Very few true believers in God remain. People across the country have begun to rebel. You have only a few days left. You must destroy the Crematorium and every knight who serves Satan. Hurry!
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.3.desc: Only a few hours remain. Soon the last believers will fall into the Satanists' hands and, like so many before them, become blood sacrifices to Satan. Good has failed as never before. Sad, but true. A few more hours, and you will be a blood sacrifice...
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.4.desc: Today went particularly well. Your subjects brought you many resources they happened to find...
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.5.desc: A great fire in the warehouse destroyed resources.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.6.desc: Someone has robbed your royal treasury!!!
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.7.desc: Remember to restore the mines. Most are underground. Unless you restore them soon, you will face serious resource shortages.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.8.desc: A guard spoke to you: 'We saw disturbing signs last night. It seems we will soon be attacked, so we should stay near Anjelopolis rather than travel.'
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.event.9.desc:
An unknown man visited with a message:
'A Tree of Knowledge stands north of the city, but it can only be reached by water.'
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.guards.10.11: Do you have a ship yet? You will need one...
'We could use a ballista, or at least a first aid tent,' your assistant told you.
Ah, the good old mill. It always pays its taxes on time...
A Keymaster's Tent. You have not seen a gate of this colour yet, though.
You do not often see such a beautiful lake.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.guards.25.22: This is the most feared place of all, filled with dark satanic powers. Are you truly brave enough to enter? Once through the gate, you will struggle to return. But if you come in the Lord's name, enter and cleanse this desecrated place of pain and fear!
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.guards.26.16: 'That is the royal mage's crown. It must have been a terrible death,' you thought...
You met a group of cyclopes in the forest. One carries a very valuable artifact!
Do you want to kill him and take it?
That stone monolith is most peculiar. What could it be for? A soldier suggests touching it... then you will see.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.guards.3.6.0: This mine operated in ancient times. You cannot remember what was mined here, though...
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.guards.33.27: A purple tent? The purple gate is north of Anjelopolis!
You pick up a crumpled parchment bearing magical symbols that shimmer beautifully in the light.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.guards.4.2.0: You have found a sword: the very sword mentioned in all this kingdom's legends. One says it will free the kingdom from the darkest evil. Is this coincidence, or are the legends coming true?
The merchant Zamuner always charges reasonable prices. Trading with him is a pleasure.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.guards.4.7.0: 'This must be the griffin tower Konstan mentioned,' you whisper to your assistant, who nods. Wings suddenly flutter, and Konstan's powerful voice rings out: 'So this is where my soldiers live. They will surely want to join you! Ah, here comes my servant Kunist.'
A knight who looks like a demon stands before the city gate. You hear inhuman screeches. You begin praying with your party, giving them courage. Your soldiers' morale rises inexorably!
In the distance you see the famous city of Anjelopolis. The rebellion seems to have escalated. Foreign troops resembling hellspawn move around the city. They must have come to aid the rebels. 'The city is occupied! Hurry, Diana!' your party cries resolutely behind you.
An underground cave. Always a frightening sight...
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.guards.5.3.0: You heard the rustle of great wings. Turning to see archangels, you could only cry: 'Glory to the Father in the highest!!!'
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.guards.5.8.1: You have a strange feeling. This place is steeped in magic, a kind you have known since childhood. The mighty wizard Astral wielded it. Now he is missing. Could he be here, underground?
You are growing uneasy. Your army begins to panic. The soldiers refuse to search the tomb: that would be grave robbing!
'Ah, welcome!' said a short, shaggy man. 'I urgently need our court mage's crown, for a new mage is to be crowned. The previous one probably died with the army on its march against the Crematorium. Let us discuss it over a cup of mead.' Then he went inside.
The skeleton spoke to you:
'If you win, you will receive the artifact I possess!'
Do you want an artifact that will surely help you in the future?
A handful of knights emerged from behind the rocks. Exhausted and wounded, they ask to join your party.
A skeleton lies on the ground. It probably belonged to a worker forgotten when the mines were closed.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.header.descr: You play a cleric returning home to Anjelopolis, a city gripped by rebellion. The people have lost their true faith in God and begun worshipping Satan. Try to avert this dark threat...
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.header.name: Return of the Cleric
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.header.rumor: That dark satanic stronghold lies on the far side of the river's dead arm...
Our dark enemy has great offensive strength and summons devils through black magic...
I have heard of the immense power of the city called the Crematorium. We are lost...
She has returned. Our mighty, beloved cleric Diana has come to restore order and peace to this dying land.
Perhaps brighter days are dawning: Diana has taken power!
Do you remember that old wizard? Astral, I think his name was. A shame he cannot help us now...
People say Astral, our supreme wizard, is imprisoned underground!!!
Valuable artifacts can be bought cheaply on the black market...
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.monster.10.7: 'Please free our fellow warriors for Good. We swear to serve you faithfully until the end of time!'
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.monster.11.3: 'What do you want here? Get out! The underground is ours alone! You will have to get past us first! Hahahahaha!!!'
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.monster.12.2: 'Greetings, most esteemed Cleric Diana. We seek the wizard Astral. Have you seen him, by any chance? No? A pity. Never mind, we have searched everywhere, so we will return to Anjelopolis with you.'
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.monster.15.1: Gold, gold, gold, gold, gold... Is that not a lovely mantra?
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.monster.27.1: 'We recently defeated an army from the west on this field. They thought Good would prevail. Today history will repeat itself! Haaa!!!' said a demonic creature in a voice veiled in darkness. You recognise its kind from books on exorcism.
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.monster.31.2: 'Our forest holds a great treasure that we value immensely. We will not surrender it as easily as you imagine!'
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.monster.4.10: 'Looking for that foolish so-called "wizard" Astral? Then you have come to the right place. We imprisoned him for refusing to submit to Satan.'
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.monster.4.17: 'Good day. I was just flying to see you with an offer. Allow me to introduce myself: Konstan, captain of the griffins. We live a day's journey north. My soldiers would gladly join you, but you must fetch them yourself. They still cannot believe anyone has suppressed the rebellion. With your permission, I will guide you to the tower.'
'Want to buy from me? I have all sorts of artifacts your heart desires. First, though, you must pass a test. A test of life and death. Do your best, or you will not be doing any shopping! Hahahahaha...'
You stare, scarcely believing your eyes. Almost fifty eyes glare at you with hostility, then their owners attack without warning...
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.monster.9.33: 'Ah, is that you, Cleric Diana? We gladly join your side, for we know it is the side of good and will overcome the dark powers. Let us hurry to Anjelopolis and free it from the darkness slowly taking hold!'
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.sign.11.31.1:
A dusty sign gives directions:

Ore – northwest
Wood – north
Crystal – east
A dusty sign gives directions:

Ore – east
Wood – southwest
Crystal – north
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.sign.28.14.0:
A hastily scrawled inscription on the sign reads:

Field of Victory over Good.
The signpost reads:

Shipyard – north
Resource mines – south
map.[roe] - navrat klericky.sign.7.9.1.m:
Created by Psychotron
1/2001
Send comments to:
{psychotron@email.cz}
I would be very grateful if you rated the map on Kalkal's website.
A wooden sign with beautifully painted lettering informs you:

Royal Shipyard and Harbour
A damaged, barely legible sign reads:

Royal Underground Resource Mines.

Fresh lettering has been added:
{Underground {temporarily {closed!}
A successful day. Your warehouses gained some wood and ore.
Troops are gathering in Anjelopolis once more to stand beside you in defence of the Lord...

A strong military expedition, sent long ago to find the Grail, has arrived in the city. After a long and arduous journey, they obtained it, and today is {D}-day: they have brought it home. The Grail and its crusader escort seem to have arrived just in time...
map.[roe] - need for death.event.0.descr:
version: 1.07 /11.7.1999
author: Šír Slada
e-mail: stablst@post.cz
Good luck and have fun
map.[roe] - need for death.event.1.descr: Dear prince. Two kingdoms and only one sawmill. What will you do? Building is difficult without wood, so make sure you find it and take control.
map.[roe] - need for death.header.descri: Four kings in a small country: that bodes ill. Only one can rule. Make sure it is you. But you must start from scratch. Remember: 'Only the strongest can become king.'
map.[roe] - need for death.header.name: Need For Death
version: 1.12 / 1.9.1999
author:      
Šír Slada     
e-mail:   stablst@post.cz
based on Brian Lumley's book – Necroscope III: The Source
Šejtis, it is time to prepare for your final judgement. I, the Garden Dweller, and the barbarians are coming to destroy you, so our world may be as beautiful and peaceful as it once was.
Somewhere in your territory, warriors await you. All are ready to die fighting Šejtis on your behalf. You need only find them and fight your way through. Remember, they are waiting for you.

Dear father, you have finally come to me in the land of vampires. I am the Garden Dweller, and I hope you will help me and the barbarians destroy the vampire race. For now, however, I cannot help you. Conquer a territory here, then seek me out so we can fight side by side.

To win, you must defeat everyone opposing you and also build up the town of Garden. To conquer it, you must first explore World's End and find eight keys to Garden's gates. Good luck searching and conquering.
map.[roe] - nekroskop iii - zdroj.guards: Careful, Harry! You are approaching the entrance to the underground realm.
Whoever you are, you are entering the Garden Dweller's kingdom. All that remains for victory is to enter Garden in triumph and build it up. Good luck.

Harry, many monsters guard the road to your castle. First, though, you must find the key to the gate. Look for the grey tent. 
Good luck.
Harry, your town is small and has no troops. Nearby is an entrance to the underground realm, where you can prepare to fight the vampires. But beware: the road is full of danger and hard battles.
map.[roe] - nekroskop iii - zdroj.header: The necroscope Harry Keogh has appeared in the ancient land of vampires. In this dangerous place, he seeks the Garden Dweller and tries to save the civilisation of barbarian tribes from the vampires' cruelty. Their ruler is Šejtis himself. Harry, find the Garden Dweller and join forces with the barbarians to destroy the vampires.
map.[roe] - nekroskop iii - zdroj.sign.7: The grey tent is almost in sight. Can you see it? No? Are you looking the right way?

map.[roe] - nikita a dvojnici ze sekce 1: Once Nikita destroys all the doubles of Section 1 personnel, everything will return to normal. If she fails, she and the others will die. You would not want that, would you?
In Section 1's old supplies, Nikita found 10000 gold. Section 1 really is a very wealthy intelligence agency.
All the money was counterfeit. The joy of finding it was for nothing.
The spies who provide Nikita with vital services must be paid every week.

You are playing the new version of the map: {Nikita and the Doubles of Section 1}
As for the changes, everything now uses {Czech diacritics}, rather than {unaccented Czech}. All heroes have their own portraits from the television series {La Femme Nikita}. I do not have portraits of the characters from the original film, so these serve instead.
Nikita found a scroll containing instructions for the spell 'Summon Boat'.
A few enemy agents did turn up after all.
You will travel more easily here, Nikita. The Section doubles have little influence in these parts.
Snow-covered plains are visible.
Nikita was attacked while travelling farther inland.
At the castle at last!
Better leave these 'bulls' alone.
One direction is impassable, so be careful. The curious may of course try both ways.
'Be careful, and trust no one and nothing!' reads the message Nikita received from the real Birkof.
Nikita was attacked while travelling farther inland.
It is abundantly clear that this castle will be needed later!
You met several wandering Chaos Hydras.
Trouble: several enemy agents suddenly jumped aboard the ship.
The castle is in sight. Now to capture it.
This would certainly be the best way. But that would be too easy, so Section sent a little excitement.

'You will need the spell Summon Boat, so find it somewhere!'
...You will be there in a moment!
This castle was originally meant to be yours. In the end, it remained neutral.
At the castle at last!
In this world, Nikita, no one gives you anything willingly!
The famous philosopher's stone exists in this world too.
This is one of Section 1's agents. You should rescue him, Nikita.
Remember to recruit gnolls into your army.
You won, Nikita? I cannot believe it! Well then, time for round two.
This looks like a dangerous land.

'We have a present for you, Nikita!'
'I will deal with you first, then take the present.'
Road to the local timber works.
Do not turn away these lizardmen either.
You won again? This has gone too far. The intelligence services have sent a horde of soldiers. This time you will not win. You should have taken the other road.
One of the strongholds of your greatest enemies, Nikita: the doubles of the Chief and Medlin.
"Did you expect to get this mine just for a pretty smile? You are sorely mistaken!"
If you want to be closer to hell, take this artifact!
This club is powerful, so some other intelligence services want it too.

Doubles of all the key personnel have infiltrated Section 1. It is up to Nikita to destroy them all and free her imprisoned colleagues. It will not be easy: the enemies are powerful and command large armies.
BY:FIREBIRD
firebird@email.cz

'Come and get what you cannot proceed without.'
"The price of entry is your life!"
"We guard these parts - this region - this place!"
'Nikita, there is nothing here you could need. Just an empty castle and us as enemies!'

'Dear Nikita, our superiors would never forgive us for letting you have this mine.'
'Then I will take it!' said Nikita.
"We are friends."
This land is harsh and crawling with intelligence services. We fear punishment if we let you pass.
"This totem is not open to visitors either."
"An abandoned ship lies near the water here, waiting for new owners. But we are the owners, not you. First, we do not know you, and second, you are not our ally!"
'This totem is sacred, so access is forbidden.'
'This mine belongs to an intelligence agency. We guard it for them.'

We were assigned to guard this castle.
'But the castle is mine!' says Nikita.
'We do not care in the slightest!' comes the reply.
"No, please do not kill us. We want to help you."
South of her castle, Nikita met a group of wandering friends.
Well, Nikita, which way will you go? One route is clear; the other is not. Beware the traps Section has laid for you. There are plenty of them.
This island is home to the doubles of Medlin and the chief of Section 1.
'Do not open these passages to the sea!' reads Walter's message. 'If you do, an unpleasant surprise may await you.'
The last possible refuge from your enemies.
You can reach the castle visible in the distance only with special permission.
Important notice! The objects by the magic wells in this scenario have no significance. They are just for variety...
Come into the land of eternal snow, where mercy does not exist.
map.[roe] - novoty.event.0.description: Here is the situation: you are Petr Novotný and Radan Dolejš. Petr Novotný must not die, or it is over. (Radan could not make Novoty alone.) You must find 6 guests for Novoty (= do not buy any more people), then bring the artifact, the Ring of Life, to the Komedie Theatre.
map.[roe] - novoty.event.1.description: The Unfriends live in Foreign Land. They want to smash up your Novoty. Watch out for them! Good luck creating a new Novoty!
map.[roe] - novoty.event.2.description: Šlapeto sang at a concert, and Radan has money!!!
map.[roe] - novoty.event.3.description: Word arrived of a new market. They sell everything, so you bought some ore.
map.[roe] - novoty.event.4.description: The postwoman brought you a parcel today.
map.[roe] - novoty.guards.22.61.0.messag: You found a little green stone here. When you looked underneath it...
map.[roe] - novoty.guards.25.26.0.messag: Look! A little crate! But what is inside? You slowly open it...!!!
map.[roe] - novoty.guards.27.45.0.messag: This place is guarded by ... SOMEONE!   Will you fight?!?
map.[roe] - novoty.guards.28.64.0.messag: You met Petr Muk, but he refuses your invitation to Novoty.
map.[roe] - novoty.guards.42.0.0.message: Hey! How did you find that?!?
map.[roe] - novoty.guards.43.35.0.messag: You met Vilém Čok. He REALLY wants to sing on Novoty, but you REALLY DO NOT want to ruin Novoty (!), so you refused. Čok sent his friends after you (HIS friends – author's note).
map.[roe] - novoty.guards.46.25.0.messag: Enemies suddenly leapt out from behind the trees!!!
map.[roe] - novoty.guards.55.26.0.messag: You met Ilona Csáková. She has no time to appear on Novoty, so she at least gave you something.
map.[roe] - novoty.guards.65.55.0.messag: After passing through the gate, you found potatoes.
map.[roe] - novoty.guards.66.19.0.messag: You are walking along when you suddenly trip over a crate.
map.[roe] - novoty.header.description: As Petr Novotný and Radan Dolejš, you must create a new Novoty! Find another 6 famous people around the world and bring the artifact to the Komedie Theatre!

map.[roe] - novoty.monster.70.2.0.messag: You will not reach this sign easily! Evil people on beautiful animals will stop you.
map.[roe] - novoty.sign.10.11.0.message: An endless money mine lies by Mount Nehora.
map.[roe] - novoty.sign.6.68.1.message: This enemy cannot be killed! We must create Novoty, not kill some Oheras!!!

map.[roe] - ostrovy.guards.29.127.0.mess: Walking dead emerge from behind a boulder.
map.[roe] - ostrovy.guards.32.125.0.mess: Bone dragons descend from the sky, and skeletons crawl out of holes.
map.[roe] - ostrovy.header.description:
Conquer all the island lands and find the Grail. Long ago, someone buried it somewhere in the world so no one could become powerful enough to rule the whole world.
But he also built a single obelisk showing the Grail's location. Find that lone obelisk, and the world will be yours...
map.[roe] - ostrovy.header.name: Islands
map.[roe] - ostrovy.sign.138.52.0.messag: The world's only obelisk stands here.

map.[roe] - pan valky.event.0.descriptio:
{This is how it all began:}
In his youth, King Leondegrance of Hallakoron was a heartless, feared warrior, until he discovered the pleasures of idleness and luxury. These weakened his heart and mind. Yet he remained the cruellest king Draganor had ever known.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.1.descriptio: The dragons, Draganor's original inhabitants enslaved by Leondegrance, fled, ending a close friendship that had lasted centuries. Many inhabitants joined the wild barbarian tribes in the east, who had never acknowledged Leondegrance as their king.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.10.descripti: A strange memory turns your thoughts to Lady Sorophina, your former wife. You decide to gather some troops and free her. After all, you will need sons to inherit your mighty kingdom one day.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.11.descripti:
The war continues, and some of your men begin asking when it will end so they can go home.
You stand before them and say: 'I have not come this far to go home now. This is my home! War is the true barbarian's home, and I promise...
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.12.descripti:
'...I promise it will continue until we find our new home! Anyone wishing to return to the desert, step forward!'
No one moves.
You look at your troops and say: 'Then let us waste no time! I smell fresh blood for our swords!'
{'Long live the king!'}
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.13.descripti:
War is immensely expensive. To feed your troops and pay your mercenaries, you had to sacrifice part of your treasure!

(and of course, it does not end there...)
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.14.descripti: This country is truly vast... Does it ever end? Does it even have to?
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.15.descripti: For greater glory, you should obtain the Holy Grail. It is said to lie somewhere underground, but no one knows where. Perhaps it is all just a fairy tale!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.16.descripti:
What is a king?
What is a warrior?
What is cruelty?
...and what the hell is justice?
It grows harder to keep finding answers to these questions.
Perhaps you are growing spiritually...
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.17.descripti:
The priest says: '...and I will strike with great force and furious anger upon you and all who seek to destroy and poison my children. And you will know me, for my name is the Lord, and I will unleash my wrath upon you.'
Hmm, that fits!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.18.descripti:
'Are you never satisfied? Will you never rest?' a young barbarian general asks.
'My good boy,' you reply, 'I found my path in warfare, and while my blood cries out for war, I cannot rest.'
But one thing puzzles you: what will you do once you have conquered everything?
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.19.descripti: Everything looks good. Victory follows victory, and your kingdom keeps growing. Yet you sense this is only the first chapter of your journey, and it will grow harder still.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.2.descriptio: But his divorce from Sorophina, the only being he had ever loved, finally broke his selfish heart, opened his eyes and forced him to face reality again. She was the only one he had ever wanted, yet he had never managed to make her happy. At last he chose divorce, imprisoned her and cursed the surrounding lands.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.20.descripti:
An old battle wound will not heal. You decide to return to Hallakoron, rest for a while and let your generals fight for you.
There is another reason: you know that if you die, the whole kingdom will be destroyed.
Sorophina is pregnant, but your sons will need at least 15 more years.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.21.descripti: Your enemies grow increasingly dangerous. Someone seems to have warned them all...
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.22.descripti:
Your son Armagorn has been born!
The whole kingdom celebrates the new king's birth.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.23.descripti: You collected taxes for years. Now you know why!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.24.descripti: It occurs to you that you must never attack the dragons south of Draganor!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.25.descripti: Today you had an interesting conversation with King Unaghor, former ruler of the Jungle Land. He is bored in his cell and wants to help! Why not have such a powerful hero in the vanguard? You know you will need all the help you can get.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.26.descripti:
Some of your former enemies have acknowledged you as their leader again and wish to join your war.
You are not getting any younger, and some are excellent warriors and mages.
Why worry about their past?
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.27.descripti: Your advisers sense great danger ahead. They advise you {never} to be satisfied with your army's strength!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.28.descripti: Your advisers still sense great danger ahead (is that even possible?). They advise you truly {never} to be satisfied with your army's strength!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.29.descripti: Him again! The tall green keymaster from the brown tent unexpectedly requests an audience. He tells you of a spell long thought lost. Apparently it lies on an island north of Whittledale, to the left of the Library of Enlightenment.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.3.descriptio: He looked upon his ruined kingdom and remembered the days of his power, when he had been not only king but Draganor's mightiest warrior and mage. Then he went alone into the desert. After four weeks of contemplation, he returned determined to change his life. Thus began the building of an army.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.30.descripti:
Who would have thought?
The whole country does {not want} to serve you. Resistance grows stronger every day...
Tales of your cruelty, torture and mistreatment within your kingdom drive your enemies to fight for their lives.
And that is exactly what they do!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.31.descripti:
It is now day 222 of your seemingly endless war.
Surely that number of days calls for a celebration, and another round of taxes!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.32.descripti:
Armagorn is growing quickly, and you are very proud of him.
He will be the greatest of kings, charged with keeping the land.
You are the Lord of War.
He will be the Lord of Peace.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.33.descripti:
Now it is clear!
You know the war will soon end.
But what then?
You cannot imagine life without fighting, fear and bloodlust... You were not born to rule a land at peace.
These thoughts drive you mad...
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.34.descripti:
And still it is not over.
Truthfully, you are in no hurry.
After all, conquering the whole world has taken you less than a year...
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.35.descripti:
A strange man on a winged horse brought a message:
'Official warning:
We are watching you, and we dislike what you are doing! Set foot on our soil, and you will regret it!
Ashari, Queen of Elfia'
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.36.descripti: Three envoys from Elfia arrived today, offering lasting peace. You sent them back with an offer of lasting war.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.37.descripti:
Two men in red robes suddenly materialise before you:
'We are messengers from the Land of Eternal Snow. Our rulers have prepared for war... defensively, for now. Please do not attempt to invade us!'
'Are you trying to intimidate me?' you ask furiously. 'I warn you, that would be unwise!'
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.38.descripti:
A message from somewhere far away:

The royal knights will seal your fate!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.39.descripti:
Another message from far away:

The Land of Eternal Summer is the land of the royal knights.
A wonderful place.
A graveyard for warriors like you.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.4.descriptio: The promise of a great war and unprecedented conquest changed the minds of Draganor's people, and they began loving their king again. They were barbarians in heart and soul, and barbarians are born to fight! That was how it all began...
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.40.descripti:
A third message from far away:

We are the royal knights.
We know who you are.
Enter the Land of Eternal Summer, and you will learn who we are.
Be ready: a legion of archangels awaits you!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.41.descripti:
'Are barbarian creatures not worth more than these mosquitoes?' ask some ogre magi accused of murdering several serpent flies.
'Hmm,' you say thoughtfully, 'no. A murderer is a murderer and will be punished by death. Everyone in my kingdom shall be equal before the law!'
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.42.descripti:
News of equality spreads throughout the land, and all the people, even in Draganor, sing.
'Long live the king! Long live Leondegrance of Hallakoron!'
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.43.descripti: It is wonderful to have such a vast country. Today is even better: taxes are due!!!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.5.descriptio: Your generals advise against haste. Perhaps you should wait at least a week and upgrade your army...
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.6.descriptio: What a feeling! The people adore you and send contributions from everywhere to support your war!
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.7.descriptio: Many strange lands surround you, and you feel a mighty force coursing through your veins. Soon all this will be yours...
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.8.descriptio:
So much blood! Who would have expected so many different creatures to live beyond Draganor...
The thought of battles to come brings a satisfied smile to your face.
map.[roe] - pan valky.event.9.descriptio:
'Cruelty is no way to gain a kingdom!' says a villager.
'Cowardice is the way to lose one!' you reply, and order him beheaded.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.0.54.0.mess: ...and suddenly you face strange snake-like monsters!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.0.82.1.mess: Damn, what a tunnel... It must have taken centuries to dig. You suddenly feel some respect for these people and wonder how to get a few to work in your mines. Goblins are decent workers, but these dwarves truly love their work...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.0.90.0.mess: Wow! What a pile of gold... But the skulls all around seem to watch your every step and movement. Well... do you really want to take the gold?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.1.126.0.mes:
As you leave the enchanted glade, an elven battle cry suddenly rings out:
'Elfia is ours!'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.1.53.0.mess: You hear something very like a snake hissing...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.10.53.0.mes: An enormous mosquito lands on your arm and drinks your blood. Suddenly a cloud of insects emerges from the undergrowth and attacks! 'Ugh, disgusting,' you think as you draw your sword.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.10.62.1.mes: Dwarven treasure, BUT! Look at that mountain of gold beside it!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.100.56.0.me:
This place is terribly hot and dry. Yet the heat seems to rise from the ground rather than the sun...
...and still, you feel as though you are coming home.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.102.61.1.me: Could you have defeated all the shadows?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.103.60.1.me: Something moved again. As though you were approaching a trap...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.104.3.1.mes: Crossing the border, you see a knight and an army standing silently, waiting for you... But what is this? The knight's face has no skin, and his entire army consists of terrifying undead! You shudder with disgust...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.105.12.1.me: Yes! This looks like a true kingdom worthy of conquest! You prepare for the hardest battles and real war... and you are truly happy!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.105.3.1.mes:
The knight waves and calls: 'Greetings, my lord! Thank you for freeing us! We waited at that border so long, but now at last we can spread our undead faith throughout the world!'
You shake your head. 'Actually, I came here to do the spreading!'
'What?' asks the knight.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.106.4.1.mes:
'I thought you were our saviour!' says the knight.
'That is precisely what I am,' you reply. 'I intend to save you from ever fouling our land again!'
'Then you are an enemy!' cries the knight, and his whole army rises at his signal.
You beam and say: 'Correct!'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.11.131.0.me:
The beating of wings in the wind makes you stop and seek its source. Suddenly you see hundreds of winged horses swooping towards you.
'Elfia shall be free!' cry the pegasi.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.119.141.1.m:
The Order of Cavanaugh gladly supports you one last time.
You will be the mightiest king who ever ruled!

Gwhenwyfar and Khamul.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.12.56.1.mes: The dwarven treasure is carefully guarded. Do you wish to take it?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.12.58.0.mes: You found a nest of large silvery eggs. You were imagining an omelette with onions and a little garlic when the nest's owner, his family, relatives and even a few friends suddenly appeared to defend it...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.122.28.0.me: ...and as you try to ride past the holes, hundreds of creatures begin crawling out.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.124.19.1.me: So many undead! These necromancers built a real army to conquer the world... A pity they could not get out.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.125.10.0.me: "Do you know where you are now, King Leondegrance?"
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.127.115.0.m: A tremendous noise comes from ahead. It does not sound very natural... Perhaps it is a trap!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.128.49.0.me: After passing the guards, you find an incredibly vast, long and broad stairway descending through a lava field. It will take you down... but you have no idea where. Sulfur fills the air.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.128.54.0.me: Heat radiates through the barrier. And all around is... nothing! You realise that beyond this boundary, you will find nothing of this world!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.13.124.0.me: The dragons will never be your friends again!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.13.139.0.me: Support from the Order of Cavanaugh for the mightiest king in the world!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.13.14.1.mes: Nephretetos again: 'Now I know who you are. Leo, the Dwarf Slayer, haha. Do you really want to meet me, the mightiest sorcerer?' 'I do not know about meeting you, but I certainly want to kill you!' you reply, feeling your anger rise.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.13.56.0.mes: You suddenly realise you are unwelcome here. 'Hmmm,' you think, 'we must civilise this place a little...'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.137.36.0.me:
Just when the stairway seems endless, you finally reach level ground.
It is hot here.
Lava is everywhere... and the whole place is steeped in magic...
Where the hell are you?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.14.67.0.mes: 'Unaghor is our king!' cries a voice, and another battle begins...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.141.88.0.me:
A mighty spell, long forgotten!
You have found it!
And you will need it!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.15.55.0.mes: It seems this nest is not for you!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.15.57.0.mes: In the distance, you see some grazing cows. As you approach, you notice they are much larger than ordinary cows and are gnawing on large bones in the grass rather than grazing. Suddenly one spots you. In an instant, the whole herd is charging...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.15.77.0.mes:
'Leondegrance!' calls a voice behind the trees. 'You will never conquer our land!' 'Perhaps you are right!' you shout back. 'But only because I am not used to fighting cowards who hide instead of fighting!'
'{Attack!}' roars the voice...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.16.21.1.mes:
'Well done!' says the voice. 'Now I can introduce myself. I am the sorcerer Nephretetos. Hmmm... you do not look like a mage at all... Very well. Ordinary duels are so superficial... But if you insist... Just remember, magic is greater than strength!'
'We shall see,' you reply.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.16.22.1.mes: 'Greetings!' a voice suddenly whispers in your ears. 'It has been so long since anyone visited me. At first I thought you were my brother Lomkorus. Welcome, and accept a little test...'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.16.56.1.mes: After a long and exhausting journey, you suddenly hear mining. 'Dwarves!' you curse, wondering whether to go home rather than be reminded of that loathsome nickname...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.16.62.0.mes: 'That gold is not yours!' comes a roar, and the gnolls attack.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.17.37.0.mes: ...and here are the rest. Oh no, there are plenty behind the laboratory! They simply are not moving. Perhaps they are broken, or spares. Do you wish to continue?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.18.1.0.mess: That was surely the last guard. The road to {Ooresdome}, capital of the barbarian tribes, is now clear.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.18.28.0.mes: Hmm... more gold. And even more lies ahead.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.18.29.0.mes: Your eyes slowly begin to sparkle.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.18.37.0.mes: You discovered some golden creatures working in an alchemist's laboratory. They toil like mindless machines, but some prepare to attack when they see you. Whoever programmed them was no friend of yours. Will you proceed?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.18.7.0.mess: An old ogre mage says: 'We still guard this secret... but we do not know why... The Purple Tower was never found. There is an old tale of a wave of heat... but perhaps it is all a waste of time.'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.19.26.0.mes: Is there any water left in this muddy river?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.19.30.0.mes: More gold... and there seems to be even more ahead.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.2.56.1.mess: This must be the entrance tunnel the dwarves dug to reach the gold. They seem able to sniff it out...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.20.10.1.mes: As you ride through the gorge, a monk suddenly appears and says: 'Leondegrance! You are the greatest warrior, and your war will change the future. We saw you in a prophecy. The Order of Cavanaugh will always support you.'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.20.26.0.mes: Gold and... some dwarves... Never mind.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.20.30.0.mes: Your men found some gold in the river with a net. What a wonderful river!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.20.63.0.mes: Black 'cows' stand ahead. They certainly are not grazing: they are staring straight at you!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.21.23.0.mes: No dwarves... Just gold. Farther ahead, though, you see dwarves. A great many dwarves...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.21.26.0.mes: Dwarves ahead. They guard the gold.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.21.44.1.mes: The cave is dark and reeks of rotting mushrooms. This damp place, with its dripping water and hollow echoes, is thoroughly unpleasant, especially for barbarian troops who love daylight above all else.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.22.24.0.mes: More and more dwarves... You begin to wonder how many are left.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.22.55.0.mes: This place is so beautiful and fills your heart with such music that you cannot help dancing around for a while.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.23.21.0.mes: You are beginning to feel like William Bigdoors, said to have been the richest man on the entire continent.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.25.12.0.mes: ...and perhaps you will be the one to regret it if you keep pushing deeper into the forest for wood.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.25.2.1.mess: The monk advises: 'Seek the red tent in the west! It will be your key to victory! Only the dragons' attitude lies beyond the Order of Cavanaugh's power to change. You must settle that yourself.'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.25.62.0.mes: 'Does my blood taste of honey?' you wonder as a black swarm of those revolting insects approaches...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.26.46.0.mes: 'Aaargh!' roar the gnolls, drawing their weapons...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.27.56.0.mes: As soon as you leave the magic plains, you feel more sluggish, as though you have lost some of your magical power...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.27.63.0.mes: You managed to persuade a few dragon flies.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.27.72.0.mes: This looks like a secret passage!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.28.49.0.mes: 'Nothing for you here!' roars the gnoll army as one... man?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.28.58.0.mes: ...and as the buzzing grows ever louder...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.29.26.0.mes: These endless journeys home for troops are exhausting. Having to go back before you can move forward is really wearing you down. The young officer imprisoned for failing to sit still at a feast might be just the man for the job...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.29.54.0.mes: Rattling snake tails and the outlines of hundreds of heads...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.3.143.0.mes:
What a beautiful place! Great trees, the scent of forest, fertile soil and flowers... A strange melancholy grips you at the sight of such beauty.
Yet this place seems inhabited, and you unmistakably sense great danger ahead.
Prepare for battle!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.30.14.1.mes: These enormous obelisks almost touch the ceiling... What could the strange markings on their surfaces mean?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.30.36.1.mes:
'Perhaps you misunderstood me,' says the voice. 'If you proceed, I will have to kill you. Understand?'
'Yes.'
'Then why are you still riding?'
'Perhaps to prove you wrong,' you reply.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.31.29.1.mes:
'That was very rude!' says the voice.
'Grmpf!' you snort.
'I have been finding out who you are... Leondegrance of Hallakoron, barbarian king... Hmmm... I am not impressed... You should turn around and get out!'
{'And you should run for your life!'} you roar into the surrounding emptiness.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.31.34.1.mes:
'My dragons! Oh, my poor dragons!' wails the voice. 'Why are you so cruel to those beautiful animals?'
'Why did you send them against me?' you ask.
'Well, never mind. You are a cruel, heartless barbarian!' says the voice.
'And you talk too much,' you reply.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.31.35.1.mes:
'I do not understand you,' says the voice.
'You do not have to.'
'But I want to.'
'You will understand soon.'
'Hmmm... That does not satisfy me,' the voice drones on. 'Perhaps I should send a few of my dragons...?'
'Yes,' you reply with a smile...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.31.37.1.mes:
'You are making an enormous mistake,' says the voice.
'You think so?'
'Yes!' says the voice. 'You will die if you ride on.'
'So will you!' you reply.
'Haha, a sense of humour down here underground, haha... Very well, ride on if you insist.'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.32.38.1.mes:
'Well!' a dark voice sounds in your head. 'You are one of those who do not listen, are you?!'
'That depends,' you reply, riding on.
'On what?' asks the voice.
'On who is asking.'
'So you will not listen to me?'
'Of course not,' you reply.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.34.39.0.mes: This is the ancient armour of King Dshardsh the Cruel. Even the earth refused to hold it, so the entire area had to be cursed to keep it underground.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.34.48.1.mes: Is this a secret passage or just a dead end?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.36.34.1.mes: A little gift for those who walk on water!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.36.81.0.mes: The jungle inhabitants know little about the sea... In fact, they have never sailed anywhere. A few tales mention two great islands: one full of flying spirits, the other of many-armed snakes... Hmm, that sounds interesting. Certainly worth sailing farther.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.37.34.1.mes: Another little gift for those who walk on water!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.37.43.1.mes: Strange creatures stand directly ahead, surely magical in origin. A lion's body, a scorpion's tail and an eagle's wings. What a mixture... And they look far from friendly.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.38.33.1.mes: Something else for those who walk on water!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.39.23.1.mes:
'You are no fun... By the way, my name is Lomkorus, greatest of sorcerers.'
'How funny!'
'What is funny about it?' asks Lomkorus.
'I thought I had already killed the greatest sorcerer!' you reply.
'...and you will pay for that too,' says Lomkorus angrily.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.4.132.0.mes: Entering an enchanted glade of strange giant oaks, you sense movement in the surrounding forest, but it is too late. The trees surround you and attack without warning.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.4.29.0.mess: This land has been cursed since King Leondegrance and Sorophina divorced. Now you will pay for your own hatred!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.42.134.0.me: A splendid war! These druids and rangers are tough, clever opponents, but at last their land seems to be yours. You begin wondering what comes next... Perhaps you should look for a shipyard in the north...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.42.45.1.mes: Examining the creatures and their dwellings more closely, you are certain they are waiting for someone or something. The whole area feels terribly unnatural, like the playground of a twisted mind.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.44.11.0.mes: An isolated tent in the wilderness is a strange find. The keymaster is a creature unlike any you have met: blue skin, green hair, perhaps 8 feet tall. He smiles and invites you in. 'I will help you win the war,' he says confidently.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.44.39.1.mes: This trail is full of those strange monsters who call themselves Dungeon Dwellers. Their creators seem to have forgotten them long ago, yet their loyalty remains unchanged.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.44.53.1.mes: The scorpicores' last treasure is guarded by Lcrotat, leader of all scorpicores. He begs you to leave it to them as a gesture of new friendship. Do you wish to kill Lcrotat?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.45.52.1.mes: A whole horde of scorpicores guards their treasure. Do you still wish to take it?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.47.28.1.mes: Things are becoming clearer... A young scorpicore told you of an ancient sorcerer who created this place in case of a great war of succession. That war never happened. Yet these creatures seem very patient.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.48.11.1.mes:
'Very well, Leondegrance of Hallakoron, now we shall see who is right and who is wrong.'
'Yes,' you laugh, 'and whatever happens, I will no longer have to listen to your chatter. That pleases me most of all.'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.5.4.0.messa: These fortifications belong to the wild barbarian tribes. They built them to keep you within your own territory. Perhaps times are changing...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.5.50.0.mess: Wiping sweat and blood from your brow, you look around. You have never seen anything like this. The air is so hot and humid you can barely breathe. You hear insects buzzing and rustling. And these bizarre plants... Nothing pleasant here.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.50.78.1.mes: This is the Golden Bow, worth any battle! Do you need it, Leondegrance?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.52.22.0.mes: Some water elementals have fallen in love with these glittering little stones and now look rather angry. Do you really want to take them?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.52.27.1.mes: This is surely a deadly trap. Do you crave enlightenment in the darkness?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.53.46.1.mes: The Titan's Gladius seems to be waiting for you. Its mystical blade glitters in the water... Do you really wish to take it?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.55.4.1.mess: You cannot believe your eyes: an entire desert, complete with a hot sun shining overhead. You cannot imagine how it was created, and suddenly shudder at the thought of how powerful Lomkorus must have been.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.59.0.0.mess: As you step onto this islet's rocky ground, you feel a powerful current of magic rising from somewhere underground.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.59.5.1.mess: Ha! This place feels like home. After many years of slavery, the inhabitants celebrate their new king, Leondegrance of Hallakoron. Yet some townsfolk do not trust you at all... Never mind, they soon will!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.59.76.0.mes: Looking at the five towers in the sea, you wonder what they were for and who built them. This region must have been much more civilised long ago... and soon it will be again.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.6.23.1.mess: ...and this artifact is guarded by more harpies. Do you really wish to take it?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.6.55.1.mess: Thousands of dwarves guard the purse. Do you really wish to take it from them?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.60.30.1.mes: Again you are attacked from above, from the surrounding walls and even from that black water...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.61.100.0.me: The island of many-armed snakes? Yes, that part was certainly true...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.61.49.1.mes: Do you wish to know every Fire Magic spell?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.63.44.1.mes: A few white creatures lurk among the shadows. Suddenly they all detach from the ceiling and swoop down at you...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.65.54.1.mes: Did you think all that wreckage was merely decorative?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.66.36.1.mes: Countless shadows and bat-like monsters swoop down from the ceiling...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.7.2.0.messa:
Leaving your kingdom for the first time after so many years of sorrow and disorder, you suddenly feel like a true king again. This is power, this is decision-making, {THIS} is true leadership!
Yet ahead lies the barbarians' land, and they will never surrender it willingly.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.7.23.1.mess: Hundreds of harpies guard the artifact, led by a black dragon who says: 'This treasure is not for you! We have guarded it for centuries. Leave while you still can!'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.7.51.0.mess: Movement stirs everywhere in the surrounding vegetation! And it looked so deserted... You decide to bring every available troop on the expedition.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.70.41.1.mes: Strange shadows move beneath the cave ceiling. An icy wind suddenly blows, making you shudder with an odd uneasiness. Though you enjoy this long-missed feeling, you cannot shake a sudden urge to flee back.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.71.56.1.mes: A vial of blood floats silently above the black water... And you are not alone... You sense a trap. Do you wish to take the artifact?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.72.124.0.me: Ah, how pleasant to stand on solid ground again. But the cold of this land has set your entire army shivering.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.72.21.0.mes: Support and aid from the Order of Cavanaugh!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.72.24.0.mes: And here is a gift from the jungle gods. Surely you did not expect them to be pleased...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.73.49.1.mes: The water is icy and blacker than night. Some of your men sense movement within it. Strange sounds echo off the cave's artificial walls. One thing is clear: the many shipwrecks speak of danger...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.73.88.0.mes: The serpent box shines brightly, and you are very curious about its contents... Yet some sixth sense warns of great danger within. A dilemma. You decide to take the risk and satisfy your curiosity!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.74.31.1.mes: Creatures of the night swoop down upon you...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.75.39.1.mes: More and more shadows draw ever closer...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.75.72.0.mes: 'No passage!' cries a blue spectral figure that suddenly appears and flies rapidly towards you.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.75.73.0.mes: ...hmm, perhaps that was not a welcome sign, but you may as well consider it one, especially you! The strange buildings fascinate you, and the distant castle's towers almost touch the sky. Their owner will surely be a worthy opponent...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.76.123.0.me: Brr, it is cold here! This snow and ice have frozen all your fighting spirit.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.76.50.0.mes: An underground entrance on a small island? You would expect water beneath the island... Perhaps not this time... Curiosity drives you onward.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.76.55.1.mes: A vial of blood floats silently above the black water... Shrill sounds seem to surround you... Will you take the artifact?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.76.59.1.mes: Something glitters in the water, so you send some men to retrieve it. Yes! This must be Jason's shield! But there is something else: a magical orb... Hmm, sometimes that is even better.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.77.27.1.mes:
I leave you this spell. Perhaps you will need it more than I do.
Jason.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.78.20.1.mes: A path once led this way, but the bridge was destroyed ages ago. No one ever repaired it because of the water creatures guarding it.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.79.21.1.mes: The water guardians are far from pleased by your arrival...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.79.59.1.mes:
The ship ahead is abandoned and looks as though it has stood here for centuries. After some examination, you decipher the inscription on its bow:
{ARGO}
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.8.45.0.mess: Approaching the enemy fortifications, your heart beats faster and a true warrior's hot blood surges through every vein. Exploring foreign lands may be interesting for a while, but you came here to conquer this territory!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.8.65.0.mess: 'To battle!' rings a voice behind the trees, and the whole forest seems to move...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.81.23.1.mes: This exit seems to have formed naturally.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.81.33.0.mes:
You were not permitted to release Gawain!
His punishment was to be eternal.
Now you must face the guardians of the Holy Grail.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.81.39.1.mes: The shadows suddenly detach from the ceiling, and you hear your men scream in terror...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.82.56.1.mes: A vial of blood floats silently above the black water... Shrill sounds reach you from a distance, though not a very great one... Will you take it?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.84.101.1.me: Leondegrance! This treasure is for you!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.85.0.1.mess: They are still here; they simply have not attacked yet. Perhaps they are waiting to see whether you take this last treasure too. Dare you?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.85.2.1.mess: That strange feeling again... Do you really crave gold so badly?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.85.73.0.mes: Actually, this road leads to neither of those obelisks...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.86.1.1.mess: You sense movement all around... Will you take the gold?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.86.11.1.mes: The Spirit of Oppression watches you. As you approach, you realise thousands of dead eyes are watching from every direction. Do you wish to take this artifact?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.88.35.1.mes: Shadows and bats make every living thing scream in terror throughout this endless night...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.9.2.0.messa: An odd stillness hangs in the air... this looks like a trap.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.9.62.1.mess: 1.000.000 gold, indeed. But your addiction to gold will not bring you happiness. An immensely powerful army guards this treasure! Do you really want to die?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.90.60.1.mes: ...the ceiling suddenly becomes a black shadow, approaching fast!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.91.0.1.mess:
At last, a way out of the labyrinth. But where does it lead, when the surrounding darkness will not lift?
Your head aches terribly. Looking back, you see a wraith draining magical power from your brain...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.92.131.1.me: A voice whispers: 'Reach the wintry part of the Land of Eternal Summer to succeed!'
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.93.123.0.me: The Order of Cavanaugh gladly supports your war.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.94.59.1.mes: Not as large as last time, but movement still stirs all around...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.95.58.1.mes: A truly enormous pile of crystals, but as you approach, you see each crystal's shadow begin to move...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.95.61.1.mes: It really is a mountain of crystals... but...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.96.7.0.mess: This must be the gold of lost souls.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.97.143.0.me:
Leondegrance! 
This is no treasure, but a trap!
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.97.6.0.mess: This must be the gold of lost souls.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.97.7.0.mess: This must be the gold of lost souls.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.98.58.1.mes: ...is a hundred sulfur worth a fight?
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.98.7.0.mess: This must be the gold of lost souls.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.99.55.0.mes: You look back at the calm sea, and strange memories return of crossing this ocean, fleeing great danger... Now it all seems to have happened in another life.
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.99.59.1.mes: And this is the most sulfur you have ever seen...
map.[roe] - pan valky.guards.99.8.0.mess: This blue guard seems important, but where might the key be?
map.[roe] - pan valky.header.description: This is the story of King Leondegrance's war. In ancient times, this great warrior was the first to discover every continent and unite them into one vast empire. Yet he was never a man of peace and honour, but a barbarian in heart and soul.
map.[roe] - pan valky.header.name: Lord of War
map.[roe] - pan valky.header.rumor.1.tex: An old man offers you a treasure map... but you are not interested.
map.[roe] - pan valky.header.rumor.3.tex: The obelisks will not help you find the Grail at all!

map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.1.36.0.mes: Those dragons must be guarding treasure!
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.100.0.1.me: 'Greetings, Leondegrance! The fearsome knights have awaited you since the prophecy was revealed!'
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.12.4.0.mes:
We have waited here for you, King Leondgrance.
News of your great war has crossed the borders, and soon everyone will hear of it! Your kingdom will grow, and we will help you.
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.12.57.1.me: This gold is ours! You are not welcome! You may pass, but do not dare touch our gold!
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.135.34.0.m: Those 'dogs' must be guarding the entrance...
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.135.8.0.me: These tombs are not for you! Whatever you try, you will never enter them, grave robber!
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.16.35.0.me: Inside the laboratory, you found a parchment explaining how to operate gold golems. You discovered the activation button. The golems now seem very willing... Hmm, why not.
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.17.0.0.mes: The wolf riders curse you: 'You will pay for this. We do not want you. We do not want to join you. This is no liberation. This is conquest!' 'Indeed it is,' you reply with a smile, drawing your sword.
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.18.50.1.me: These loathsome creatures seem to crawl from every crack around...
