map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.20.21.0.me: Some of your men began calling you Leo – the Dwarf Slayer. You had to hang a few before they spread the nickname throughout the army. No one must ever dare call you Leo again.

map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.21.30.0.me: A lone dwarf sits by the river, holding a sieve. Seeing you, he cries: 'Leave. This territory belongs to the dwarves. Get out! The dwarves will never let you conquer this land!' ...and runs away.
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.21.99.1.me:
The gods' game, a struggle between good and evil.
b8-c6
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.22.21.0.me: Dwarves are said to be the greediest for gold. Some of your men are reconsidering that opinion. You merely laugh.

c8-h3
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.24.10.0.me: Never in your life did you expect trees to attack you. Now they have. Perhaps they dislike your plan to burn a quicker route through the forest... and perhaps they will regret it.

We will fight for our freedom! 
{Ooresdome will never fall!}

map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.27.71.1.me: Show some courage and fight, Leondegrance!
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.27.78.1.me: The barrier was actually built to keep the Dead out! But now it seems they built it to keep YOU in!
map.[roe] - pan valky.monster.27.99.1.me:
The game of the gods, a battle of good against evil.
e8-e7

map.[roe] - rise slunce.event.0.descript: Somewhere deep in the jungles of South America's rainforests lies the capital of an empire richer than all of Europe. For three centuries the Incas gathered golden treasures, emeralds, diamonds and rare timber there. They sank yet more mountains of gold in the fabled lake of El Dorado as an offering to their god Viracocha.
map.[roe] - rise slunce.event.1.descript:
And you alone can guide Pizzaro towards these fabled treasures. But know this: you will not conquer the Empire of the Sun with a hundred soldiers, as the history books tell it. Not only the Incas, but the jungle and its animals will resist you!
For Spain! For the king! For gold!
map.[roe] - rise slunce.guards.40.14.0.m: Dear adventurer, you are setting foot in a new world richer in gold than any other continent. It is inhabited by the relatively undeveloped Inca civilisation. Yet in Viracocha's name they are determined to defend their land and their capital, Cuzco, to their last breath.
map.[roe] - rise slunce.guards.52.33.0.m: Look at those mountains of gold! Your troops' morale soars to its highest level, for gold is precisely why they came here. This must be the fabled lake of El Dorado!
map.[roe] - rise slunce.header.descripti:
The year is 1532, and the Spanish conquistador Francesco Pizzaro stands on the threshold of a new continent abounding in the vast riches of the Inca Empire. Guide Pizzaro to Cuzco, capital of the Empire of the Sun, and to the fabled lake of El Dorado. After all, gold is what both you and the Spanish king desire. For the king!
For gold!
map.[roe] - rise slunce.header.name: Empire of the Sun

Every battle in the game can be won, so do your best.
Every situation has a solution, so do not despair.

map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.10.descr:
The first month of your journey is over... More has happened than you could have expected at the outset...
Still, a little adventure seems to be doing you good...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.11.descr: The Week of the Imp… Such a thing has not happened here for centuries…
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.12.descr: What a strange coincidence… The Week of the Imp has come for a second time!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.13.descr: Something sinister is certainly happening here... A third consecutive Week of the Imp cannot bode well! We must get to the bottom of this!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.14.descr: You have been travelling for 99 days... The land is not safe without its ruler...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.15.descr: The raiding bands strike suddenly and without warning!	The screams and cries of terrified inhabitants echo through the night...	But the robbers' main target is your treasury and the riches stored within!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.16.descr: Nobody slept a wink tonight...	The tremors, slight at first, culminated towards dawn in a massive earthquake that is destroying people's homes... Essential repairs to the buildings will require a great deal of material...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.17.descr: Mild tremors during the night have unsettled the local people…
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.18.descr: The ground trembled faintly again tonight... The people fear an earthquake...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.2.descri:
Whether you enjoy the game or dislike it, do not hesitate to send me a few lines at the address above.
To be safe, here it is again: Leki@post.cz
Your suggestions and comments are sure to inspire me!
                                           Yours, Leki
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.4.descri:
War rages in the north...
Hellspawn are trying to invade Green Land. The northern harbour lies in ruins, and there is no safe passage through it. The captain of your merchant ship therefore decides to sail around the continent and try to land at the first suitable spot on the western or southern coast...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.5.descri: To be safe, you leave all your possessions aboard and order the ship to anchor a little way offshore. Although your journey will probably be safe, you do not want to risk losing your hard-earned wealth.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.6.descri: Every day, tax revenues fall by 500 gold... The war raging in the north is driving even inland inhabitants from their homes... I am sorry, but the situation seems likely only to worsen...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.7.descri: ...After several days at sea, a small bay seems a suitable spot. It once served as a harbour for merchants from the southwestern islands... But who knows what it is like today? Pirates began attacking the merchant ships, and trade gradually declined... In any case, it is worth a try...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.8.descri: ...According to the maps in the captain's cabin, the road home should lead straight northeast from the harbour... Through a mountain pass... Hmm, the map has seen better days, and some labels have faded... In any case, through the pass in the southern mountains...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.event.9.descri: ...Then along the road through the Golden Forest straight to Lake City, where you can board a boat and cross the Great Lake. From there it is only a short way home... Altogether, it is no more than 144 miles as the crow flies, about 100 miles through Green Land's southern domains and the rest through your own territory. It should be easy... Onward, then!

map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.81.59.0: The wise scholar meditating in this peaceful spot sees your eagerness to learn and reveals the secrets of warfare to you!
Your horse stumbles and collapses from exhaustion. That is the signal the scavengers have awaited...
A sudden shout makes you look back. What you see delights you: a group of goblins from the settlement has come to swell your ranks. They are weary from crossing the desert, but glad to have caught up with you in time.
Suddenly, a dark shadow sweeps overhead. You look up and see one of the flying creatures diving at you from above...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.83.82.0: You creep after the group that caught your attention... Their voices carry back to you... You listen to their conversation... They seem to be in excellent spirits... Unfortunately, they are already too far away again... Hurry after them!
You have been without water too long... Dark silhouettes of birds circle overhead.
The windows of an ancient prison carved into the mountainside stare at you like the eyes of a nightmare monster... God! A sudden cry draws your attention to one of its many windows... SOMEONE IS IN THERE!!!
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.84.78.0: An inconspicuous trail seems to lead deeper into the dense forest, home to all manner of creatures...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.84.98.0: You have gone too far north… Your goal lies farther south!
This is a true maze… And this does not seem to be the right way…
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.85.85.0:
They are delighted with their fine haul! They laugh about how they robbed a dwarf living somewhere west of here, beneath the mountains!
So that is it! These are no honest folk, but rotten scoundrels who deserve no mercy!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.86.12.0: This is the lair of gold dragons...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.86.23.0: The warrior monks, the Zealots, have their monastery here! Your devoted servants and the mortal enemies of hell's monsters!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.86.86.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.86.89.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.87.86.0: You ride into a forest clearing... The bandits are just disappearing beneath the trees at its southern end! Now you can catch them and punish them for their deeds!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.88.53.0: The river flowing out of the lake has heavily overgrown banks... Fortunately, you can sail through the grasses with only a little difficulty... Perhaps it will be easier downstream...
This is the lair of red dragons...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.89.88.1: Your beating heart disturbs the souls of the dead... Suddenly, spectres materialise before you, reaching towards you with bony arms... Fight for your life!
Their leader fought his way east and is now somewhere unknown, trying to build a portal to their world so he can summon reinforcements...
You have a grim feeling that once you pass through this gate, there may be no turning back...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.91.89.0: The band of ruffians has nowhere left to run! This is their secret lair! See justice done!
You creep through the undergrowth towards the place where the true khan is imprisoned... His former wife is just leaving the gates of the old prison. She responds to the hateful cries from one barred window with wild laughter and mockery... She must be involved too!
This is the lair of black dragons...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.94.83.0: The unicorn herd seems to sense your plea... The mightiest among them slowly approaches and joins your army...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.guards.94.95.0: The unicorn herd seems to sense your plea... The mightiest among them slowly approaches and joins your army...
The place where the true khan is imprisoned has finally been discovered! Your work deserves a fitting reward!
This is the dragon shepherd's house... But he refuses to speak to you further until you prove that you too are their friend...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.header.descrip:
War rages in the North...
Hellspawn are trying to invade Green Land. The northern harbour lies in ruins, and there is no safe passage home through it. The captain of your merchant ship therefore decides to sail around the continent and try to land at the first suitable spot on the western or southern coast...

Oh, forgive me, just a moment and I shall have finished my prayer. The little god of luck is very important to us. A hunter without luck... well, you understand.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.1.58.0: Your soul will never leave these crags, mortal!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.10.3.0: The dragon probably took shelter from the cold in the mines...
Your soul will never leave these crags, mortal!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.104.11: I cannot tell you much; I am only an apprentice. Ask one of the masters.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.107.11: Have a drink. See how refreshing the water is…
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.108.10: Oh! Well, well, could the tables have turned after all?

I used the power of the four elements and managed to locate the enemy... Thanks to this place, so steeped in magic, we could also raise a portal leading straight to him! But remember: once you enter, there is no escaping your fate!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.109.77: I am sorry, but as long as our village is threatened by raiding bands from the eastern forest, I cannot give you a single man... My scouts report that their leader has developed a taste for our harvest again... As long as he is here, I simply need the soldiers to defend the village...
Of course! Why shouldn't you join our guild? You need only pass a test of prowess, heh heh. I spent weeks stalking that fine specimen of an ancient behemoth over there, but I think I shall leave it to you. Hunt it down and bring its hide to my tent, a little west of its lair.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.111.64: Leaving the road does not pay… Your presence has angered the forest guardians!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.112.71: Our task is to watch for approaching bandits...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.114.10: I used my third eye to find the demon's lair... It cost me a great deal of strength, but at last I found it... It is right in the heart of Green Land! Come and see!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.114.20: But we have already paid our taxes this year…
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.115.10: Ah yes, it is true. We must restore the Lake Tower to defeat the enemy!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.115.99: This spell will surely prove useful in battle!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.116.58: There is no turning back now, intruder!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.117.70: Our task is to watch for approaching raiders...
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.120.37: Please do not disturb the peace of the dead...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.121.10: We are at your service. Just give the word!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.121.62: I am a courier for the scouts of Green Leaf... If you have already visited our little village and spoken to the mayor, go ahead east. You will find another scout if you follow the road and turn south among the trees at the large stone... But if you have not spoken to the mayor, you had better visit him first to learn what is happening!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.122.10: Hello, hello! What a pleasant meeting... Well, I decided to give those clever fellows a little help; they would be lost without me... But shh! Do not tell them that, it would upset them! Besides, I have something for you. You would never get anything like it from them, heh heh...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.124.12:
The dragon sitting on the rock fixes his deep eyes on you... He studies you for a moment, then speaks:
"Your enemy is mighty, and if you fall to him, our world as we know it will perish too... So take this ring to the Dragon Shepherd in the north as a token of friendship. He will help you!"
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.124.51:
I am a scout from the village a little south of here, though you probably guessed that...
I've tracked a fairly large band... They seem to be heading northeast towards the crags...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.125.72: We built this enclosure from thick trunks, and our wizard strengthened it with a mighty spell... Perhaps it will keep the Wind Riders on the Field of Desolation...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.127.68: Welcome to the Guild of the Guardians of the Plain... Our most sacred duty is to guard the barrier built by our ancestors... It is the only thing keeping the Wind Riders, also known to humans as the Dark Riders, on the Plains of Desolation...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.127.72: I am sorry, but even if we wished to, we could not open a passage through the enclosure... It has no gate, and our wizard's spell prevents anyone crossing it another way...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.127.90: Leki, master mapmaker, does not wish to be disturbed. He is working on another map!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.128.10: Yes! To sum it up... To achieve complete victory, we must prove to all the people of Green Land that the enemy can be defeated! So once you defeat the demon, cut off his head and bring it to Luna Monastery... Let everyone see it! Let all the people stand with us, not just some!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.13.107:
"May the gods protect you on your journey."
An elven hunter quenching his thirst at the spring greets you with these traditional words. "Visit our seasonal settlement to the northwest if you need to recover your strength."
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.132.39: The fleeing bandits are only a few steps from the forest… But this time they will not escape!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.135.20: If you want a shortcut to Zen Tower, use the Underground Path. Its entrance is northeast of the town.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.138.69: The bandits are only a few steps from the trees… But this time they will not escape!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.140.18: If you truly wish to enter the lands guarded by the Spirits of the Stone Forest, you must know the secret word that opens their gate... Come into the tent, and we shall find it in my records.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.140.30:
Eh? Huh?! Whaaat?!?
You are not away travelling?!!? Heh, heh? Hic, hiccup! Well, I know I am meant to guard the gate, but, hic, the Tripod lads here had a little problem, and I, hic, had to come and help!!! Heh, of course, the keys are hanging in the tent... Bleurgh!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.141.70: When the bandits see they can no longer escape, they suddenly turn on you... Their desperate determination makes them dangerous opponents...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.143.38:
“Halt!” their leader roars at the other ruffians... “We won't reach the forest in time anyway, so turn and fight...”
The bandit leader's authority is immense... Not one robber keeps running... As one, they turn to face you!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.143.90: I am a guardian of the Plains of Desolation... My task is to keep the Wind Riders, also known among humans as the Dark Riders, within their territory... If you wish to enter the Plains of Desolation, know that you are certain to encounter them!
Ah… Welcome. Something terrible has happened. Come into the city; part of it still stands… I will tell you what happened…
Welcome. I guard the last land not yet conquered by the vampire lord! This is our final bastion of resistance. Go and speak with our leader.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.17.137: Basilisks... Frightening stories are told of these monsters. They say their gaze can turn an opponent to stone!
Where did these servants of hell come from?
Welcome. I guard the last land not yet conquered by the vampire lord! This is our final bastion of resistance. Go and speak with our leader.
No, I am not the hunters' leader. I am Anabom, a senior hunter. I have just run that unicorn to exhaustion, but I cannot decide whether to finish it or let it live in this beautiful forest. It is such a beautiful, noble beast, after all...
Ah! At last, someone who can help us drive the undead from our land and destroy their vampire lord! Allow me to join you and help you fight!
One more thing. Enter our shrine. We have a powerful spell against the undead here!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.22.109: Greetings! My people sent me to watch the road for a hero who might help us out of our predicament. If you are not in too much of a hurry, please come with me to our village a little way east of here, where you will learn more.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.22.4.0: Hello, I am Master Gremlin. Turned bitterly cold all of a sudden, hasn't it? Winter has come rather early. Come on, let's go to the mill, what do you say? I have something there that fell from the sky the other day... Perhaps it will interest you...
You will never carry the secret of these crags away, mortal!
Trapped among thorny bushes, the unicorn turns towards you. In its eyes, you see a desperate determination to fight for its life.
Welcome. I guard the last land not yet conquered by the vampire lord! This is our final bastion of resistance. Go and speak with our leader.
Welcome, welcome! Come and listen to hunting tales.
Welcome. I guard the last land not yet conquered by the vampire lord! This is our final bastion of resistance. Go and speak with our leader.
The undead seem to infest this entire region!
...and would you believe it, the arrow bounced off her skin as though it were stone. Then she turned and leapt at me. But I was quicker, and as she passed above me, I drove my dagger into her soft belly. I tell you, that gargoyle was the worst thing I ever hunted...
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.3.10.0: I am a mage from the west, preparing to travel towards the lake and then south along the river... There lies an untouched region brimming with magic... My friends are seeking a way to reveal the hidden enemy there.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.3.22.0: This pool belongs to us, stranger!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.3.89.0: We have finished everything and are just discussing when to set out for Green Land. If you have no objection, we can travel together. Just visit the lodges first. Some sleepyheads are sleeping off yesterday's drinking, and you may even have to bribe them to come with you today, ha ha...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.33.112: And you must be the hero the chief is talking about.
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
Your soul will never leave these crags, mortal!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.35.111: The chief delivers a fiery speech: We have lived in the Fortress's shadow too long. It is time to drive the dark forces out of the pass. Today we had to close a second mine because it became haunted... So I call upon you to attack the dark gate! Look, here is the hero who will lead us.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.35.113: You must still persuade those who stayed home out of fear. Gold will surely be a compelling argument!
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.35.6.0: The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
Thank you for saving us! We thought we would all perish here!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.39.141: The creature is afraid of you at first, but then gathers its courage and speaks in broken Common: Please help me, stranger. You are not from here, so surely you can find the courage to save my beloved from death's clutches—the priests want to sacrifice her to the three-headed god. I will give you everything I have.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.4.77.0: More and more monsters rush out of the lair to help drive off the intruder…
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.4.98.0: Good hunting! Our camp is a little north of here.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.40.118: This mine is still working. It is only a matter of time before it becomes haunted too...
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.43.114: This mine is still working. It is only a matter of time before it becomes haunted too...
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.47.4.0: The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.49.140: Just what you needed. A Dragon Fly from the swamp…
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
Ugh, the undead infest our land! They pour out of the gates of Lake City, which a powerful vampire conquered a few days ago, and attack our settlements in the north.
Please help us get rid of them and restore Lake City!
The rattle of dry bones mingles with the clinking armour of the walking dead...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.51.9.0: The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.52.104: Nak shaa! Another sacrifice for our god!
In the name of our khan! Death to the intruders!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.53.115: Ahem, hm hm... Well, head west and our village is only a short way away. East takes you to the barbarians. I'm waiting for a caravan bringing new goods, but it is already two days late... We have excellent trading relations with the khan. Something must have happened!
The undead are terrorising the local people. They must be stopped!
Ahh, another hero who has crossed the underworld to bring back the Grail... Alas, as I told those before you, I must tell you too: the Grail is not here... It lies on the battlefield known to men as the Field of Ruin... If you wish to claim it, you must seek it there...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.6.77.0: Surely you do not want to wipe out this rare species...
Ha! I think I have exactly what you seek! You shall have it, but only if you return the sack of gold a band of ruffians stole from me! They fled east along the mountains, so what are you waiting for? Go, go!!!
The goblins tell you:
Until now, we lived in peace and traded with our neighbours, but some time ago our khan ordered us to kill anyone entering our territory, as well as his opponents among our own people...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.62.103: Thanks for saving me. I've been here for two days, and that monster simply would not give up. I belong to a caravan carrying goods from our town to the west and back. Behemoths attacked us here the day before yesterday... It's strange. Normally that never happens...
Others continue:
Our khan behaves completely differently from before. Our mage even suspects it may not be him at all, but someone impersonating him... We do not want to murder people, but neither do we want to die needlessly. Please help us uncover what is happening here.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.63.128: Several priests stand outside the temple with the high priest. They seem about to set out. But as soon as one sees you, he cries out and charges. The others follow without hesitation.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.64.103: The behemoth ignores you, absorbed by a creature hiding in a cleft between the rocks. Only when you come closer does it turn and look at you...
I am this village's mage, and I wish to tell you this:
I asked the gods, and they told me the khan who now rules us is a creature from another world that has taken his form... He brings destruction and ruin and must be stopped! You must help us find the true khan and destroy the false one!
Nrghu ah! In our khan's name!
Hey, you! I'm the best tracker in this part of the desert. I don't know whether this will help you, but recently I found the tracks of many horses leading southeast from the town into the rocky wasteland... And they all seemed to be in a great hurry.
Wait, stranger. If you have not been there yet, first come to our settlement a little way northwest of here.
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.7.79.0: Suddenly seeing the monster's claws up close, you begin to wonder whether it is worth it at all...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.70.100: In the name of our khan! Death to strangers!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.71.143:
Thank you for saving me!
The grateful girl shows you where the swamp monster keeps its treasure. On a patch of firm ground sheltered by tall standing stones lies a heap of gold and artifacts belonging to fallen adventurers. Only one artifact is worth noticing...
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.75.137: Damn! Soon those basilisks were completely lost among the vegetation...
If restoring the tower does not help, your only remaining hope is to catch the renegade mage named Šedivec, who is hiding from the other mages somewhere in the Stone Forest. His artifact is your last chance... But bind him with the Shackles of War, or he will escape and all will be lost!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.8.72.0: Your soul will never leave these crags, mortal!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.8.88.0: Sorry, but we always come here to pray after a successful hunt, and only members of our hunting fellowship may enter. If you wish to join us, you must see our guildmaster. His tent is a little north of here.
Need help? You've come to the right place!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.86.4.0: The dragons rush at you as though you were easy prey!
Stop, thief!!!
The dwarf stares at you with a madman's eyes... Then he suddenly draws his axe and lunges forward!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.86.9.0: The dragons rush at you as though you were easy prey!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.90.109: Ghah sar nevar!!! This is our gold!
map.[roe] - skryta hrozba.monster.95.4.0: The dragons rush at you as though you were easy prey!
Yes, yes!
We shall send a unit to old Selpa's landing at once. Your goods will be here before you know it!
No, you shall go no farther!
The Crossroads Tavern
Refresh yourselves and change horses.
Welcome to the village of Greenleaf.

Grove of Final Rest.

                    Leki
All the hunters have withdrawn from the woods into the Golden Forest... Suddenly the village is packed, and the marketplace is bursting at the seams. The horses need stabling, too, and the town needs improvements in general...
We need to open a tavern!!!
The stables for the tame unicorns are finished!
map.[roe] - smrt prichází.header.descrip: Eight castles lived in peace for centuries. Then word spread that the sea and underground passages were full of treasures. Every kingdom wanted as much wealth as possible, so they began fighting over territory. Now the fiercest battles are beginning. No one knows who will win; anyone may die, for Death has come!!!
map.[roe] - smrt prichází.header.name: Death Has Come
map.[roe] - souboj titánu 1.event.0.desc:
Welcome, Maestro,
the time has come for you to end the days of the other kingdoms.
map.[roe] - souboj titánu 1.event.1.desc: Welcome, king. You alone can defeat the powers of evil that have threatened this land since ancient times.
map.[roe] - souboj titánu 1.event.2.desc: The neighbouring kingdoms wish to help you. They send gifts in the hope that they will be of use.
map.[roe] - souboj titánu 1.event.3.desc: The other kingdoms fear you and pay you protection money.
map.[roe] - souboj titánu 1.header.descr: Your task is to conquer every town and destroy every enemy hero. The other kingdoms will help you do so.
map.[roe] - souboj titánu 1.header.name: Clash of the Titans
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.0.descript: Welcome, whoever you are. This map took me quite a lot of work; I hope you enjoy it. I am sure you will forgive the odd mistake. One cannot catch everything. Spawn wishes you lots of fun. (If you have anything to say after finishing the game, send it to my email address: l-quo-l@seznam.cz.)
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.1.descript: With a few exceptions, Fly, Water Walk and Dimension Door are unavailable in towns. You will not be deprived of them on this map, but obtaining them will take a little more effort. You will have to search. Some places on the map cannot be reached without flying or teleportation.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.10.descrip: Bad news arrived today, my lord. Your meeting with Keny will probably not take place, for word has come from heaven that Keny has gone to treat his rheumatism with his pal Satan at the Hellish Spa. The stairs have therefore been dismantled and your contribution returned with thanks.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.11.descrip: One of our ships ran aground on a reef while leaving harbour because Captain Cat's enormous wardrobe had overloaded it.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.12.descrip: The ambassador of the Vidalus Empire has come to complain about your ship's crew in their harbour. They cleared out all the supplies of curry and Indian flatbreads. If you want to see Captain Lister alive again, you must pay.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.13.descrip: Terrible news! Captain Kryten's ship has ceased communication and is probably lost forever. Peace to their souls. May they find their way to Silicon Heaven.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.14.descrip: At last, Captain Rimmer's ship has appeared and is approaching its home port. We can expect her in a few days.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.15.descrip: Instead of the victorious Captain Arnold Judas Rimmer and his crew, a horde of feral replicants poured out of the ship and plundered the entire harbour, along with your nearby treasury!
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.16.descrip: Beyond fog so thick you could cut it with a knife, and perhaps even farther, a ship has appeared. After the last incident, the entire harbour is on alert.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.17.descrip: Hurrah!! Captain Kryten, long mourned, has returned on a mysterious ship, bringing great riches from across the great pond.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.2.descript: Your allies in Fushán have decided to send an expedition to find the remains of Cloister the Stupid. As you will surely agree, they will need plenty of wood for their ships. Expect their request soon.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.3.descript: The god who comes through the circle of water asks you to be ready to surrender your wood supplies to him in the coming days.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.4.descript:
Envoys from Fushán have just arrived to humbly request your wood for their holy expedition.
For the sake of good relations, you will surely oblige.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.5.descript: Your god's envoys have come to collect your gift.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.6.descript: Fushán's ruler and people are grateful for your gift and send you a small share of the treasure they found on their journey in return.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.7.descript: Messengers have arrived through the circle of water, bearing gifts to be placed in the shrine.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.8.descript: All nations have joined together to build a stairway to heaven. For your participation in this project, you will have the chance to meet Keny when it is finished.
map.[roe] - spawn world.event.9.descript: Rumours from foreign lands speak of great riches hidden across the great pond. You have instructed your people to prepare an expedition of 4 ships, but this does not come free. It will surely pay off in the future.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.10.91.0.m: Greetings, traveller. Thank you for my brother's message. Now I can die in peace. But I would hate my knowledge to perish with me, so I give you four books full of spells I have collected and written down throughout my life. Use them wisely. Farewell.
Passing through the dark forest has etched fear into your soul and those of your troops. Your only consolation is that you are out of it now.
Free me and my company, and recover my armour, and I shall serve you faithfully. Everything is sure to be well guarded, so take care.
Passing through the dark forest has etched fear into your soul and those of your troops.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.126.100.0: Something shiny has caught among the stones.
What are you doing here, stranger? You will be punished for your insolence!
Try to find the Hellish Prison. The warlord Spawn and his entire army are imprisoned there, on the islands in the Lake of Despair.
The captive souls of warriors wandering here want to drag you into the gates of hell.
Before entering the portal, make sure your company is large enough, for the journey will be long and difficult. You will need plenty of strength; spells are not everything.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.17.64.1.m: Passing through the dark forest has etched fear into your soul and those of your troops.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.2.142.0.m: At the oasis, you found a group of shipwrecked sailors. They offered you gifts in exchange for taking them back to civilisation.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.38.12.0.m: The wind howls, and teeth chatter. Your army is chilled to the bone, and the soldiers do not like it one bit.
Unfortunately, your company became stuck in the muddy riverbanks. Escaping this predicament cost you considerable effort.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.39.73.0.m: Suddenly, a chunk of rock broke off the cliff and fell among your disoriented troops. Fortunately, no one was injured, but morale is poor after the incident.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.41.27.1.m: A water monster seized your ship. You had to bribe it to escape.
Welcome to the Path of the Dead, where either death or great treasures await you.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.67.66.1.m: This lake's treasures are protected. You must prove yourself worthy of them.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.68.68.0.m: Monsters from the depths guard this channel. If you wish to pass, you must defeat them. Otherwise, you will be cast into the depths like so many before you.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.70.13.1.m: Be careful; not everything comes free.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.71.8.0.me: You have awakened the monsters of the deep sea. Now it is time to face the consequences.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.73.19.0.m: Passing through the dark forest has etched fear into your soul and those of your troops. Your only consolation is that you are out of it now.
Monsters from the depths guard this channel. If you wish to pass, you must defeat them. Otherwise, you will be cast into the depths like so many before you.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.78.11.1.m: You have defeated the heavenly army. Free the imprisoned Arch Devils as well; they will surely be grateful. But remain on your guard!
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.79.11.1.m: PREPARE TO SUBMIT TO THE MIGHTY ANGELS!!!!!
You are approaching the ancient city of the titans. Beware: the locals dislike intruders.
Be careful; not everything comes free.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.83.13.1.m: The sky has clouded over, and a heavenly army slowly emerges from the clouds, ready to guard the gate. The sight would frighten even a brave warrior. Flee while you can!!!!
You have defeated the lord of hell. Help free the imprisoned angels; they will surely be grateful. But remain on your guard!
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.83.14.1.m: Leave. My patience is not endless.
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.83.15.1.m: Not every vagrant may knock on heaven's gate, so you had better sail away!
PREPARE TO MEET THE RULER OF HELL!!!
The lord of hell's deafening roar carries through the sulfur-laden air, searing fear into your soul and those of your company. The earth has split open, and the hordes of hell are already forming up at the gate.
You are playing with fire! Last warning. Leave, or you will pay.
Insolent human worm, approach the gate to the underworld, and only torment and eternal damnation await you and your comrades!
An ancient artifact created by mages, to be used only in times of danger. Engraved upon it are the words: "He who has nothing has nothing to lose!"
map.[roe] - spawn world.guards.93.3.1.me: Greetings, traveller. I have not seen a living soul for a long time. I am old now, and I would ask you a favour. Go to the island where the earth bleeds, find my brother there, give him my greetings and tell him I forgive him everything. He will surely be glad and share his knowledge and secrets with you. He is hidden there; you must search...
Suddenly, a chunk of rock broke off the cliff and fell among your disoriented troops. Fortunately, no one was injured, but morale is poor after the incident.
map.[roe] - spawn world.header.descripti:
This map is intended primarily for contests between human players.
Only one thing is needed to win: eliminate every opponent.
map.[roe] - spawn world.header.name: Spawn World
map.[roe] - spawn world.heroes.8.name: Spawn
map.[roe] - spawn world.monster.39.141.1: Welcome, warrior. If you defeat us, we will give you the Tome of Earth Magic.
map.[roe] - spawn world.monster.44.136.1: Welcome, warrior. If you defeat us, we will give you the Tome of Water Magic.
map.[roe] - spawn world.monster.44.142.1: Welcome, warrior. If you defeat us, we will give you the Tome of Fire Magic.
map.[roe] - spawn world.monster.49.141.1: Welcome, warrior. If you defeat us, we will give you the Tome of Air Magic.
Thank you for freeing us. We will gladly join you if you wish.
map.[roe] - spawn world.monster.76.138.1: Thank you for freeing us. We will gladly join you if you wish.
map.[roe] - spawn world.sign.108.110.1.m: To escape, you must defeat the Earth Elementals and leave the Cursed Ground so that you can cast spells again.
map.[roe] - spawn world.sign.112.5.1.mes:
Hellish Prison.
Strange creatures wander its dark passages, and they certainly will not invite you to Sunday lunch.
map.[roe] - spawn world.sign.122.39.1.me:
Lake of Despair:
Many old books record sightings here of the mysterious Squid of Despair.
map.[roe] - spawn world.sign.52.137.1.me: Welcome to the Island of Knowledge. Prove your valour, and you can win many valuable items.
map.[roe] - spawn world.sign.60.105.0.me: Here rests one of Arthur's knights.
map.[roe] - spawn world.town.74.7.1.name: Eden
map.[roe] - spellbinders hat.event.0.des: If you want to find the magic hat, you must search underground. Try to find Pandora's Box there! But no one has yet defeated the underground army of evil!!! If you succeed, you win.
map.[roe] - spellbinders hat.header.desc: Find the magic hat and bring it to the town of Armagedonia.
map.[roe] - spellbinders hat.header.name: Magic Hat
Whoever opens Bandira's Box will die, or gain an enormous treasure, a great army and much more.
map.[roe] - survivor.header.description: Who will survive the struggle for power? Since ancient times, the world has consisted of several parts, and you must add them to your kingdom.
map.[roe] - survivor.header.name: Survivor
map.[roe] - svaty gral.header.descriptio: Whoever finds the Holy Grail will rule the world. Only then can you become the most powerful!
map.[roe] - svaty gral.header.name: Holy Grail
map.[roe] - svaty gral.sign.71.20.0.mess: The Spellbook is guarded by the gods.
map.[roe] - svaty gral.town.31.7.0.event: The castle serves its lords well.
map.[roe] - temnota.event.0.description:
A few notes before the game begins:
Read all the text; it will guide you.
If you come across a message from me, follow it; this is to preserve the intended sense of the game.
map.[roe] - temnota.event.1.description:
Technical notes:
Map name: Darkness
Version: 1.0, Roe
Size: XL
Difficulty: Impossible
Number of players: 1
Number of opponents: 4
e-mail:nostromo@email.cz
Author: Folly
map.[roe] - temnota.event.2.description: 1 week. I hope you are doing reasonably well.
map.[roe] - temnota.event.3.description: You have been travelling for 99 days, so hurry up. You are beginning to bore me.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.1.91.0.messag: I warned you. Now you will lose troops needlessly.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.1.94.0.messag: I warned you. Now you will lose troops needlessly.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.101.140.0.mes: Ah, it is beautiful here, but beware of ambushes by the forest men.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.101.49.0.mess: A mysterious island has emerged before you from the mist and smoke.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.101.84.0.mess: Your reputation is beginning to spread among independent troops eager to join the holy army.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.103.113.0.mes: This dense vegetation is starting to annoy me.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.104.140.0.mes: You are ready to leave your territory, but unfortunately a few small obstacles stand in your way.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.105.121.0.mes: The road is long, and places to rest are scarce. You should return home before you become too exhausted.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.106.65.0.mess: You have entered the lands of the ruthless Thunderal, who has sided with your brother.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.107.63.0.mess: The narrow icy path may conceal all manner of dangers.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.11.142.0.mess:
Perhaps this will help you, but beware: many warriors, even stronger ones than you, have failed. Hidden dangers await you, but I hope you will prevail. Good luck.
You will find the Holy Grail underground, but it is well guarded.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.110.117.0.mes: Little forest men leap out of the narrows. It is your own fault for coming here.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.112.137.0.mes: And you have found a small haul left by thieves. They must have forgotten to take it in their haste to escape you.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.117.101.0.mes: And a lovely forest lane. God, how beautiful it is here!
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.117.98.0.mess: But what has happened? Suddenly everything has begun to move.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.118.127.0.mes: Your scouts have discovered only small, forgotten bands of troops in your territory. You should wipe them out quickly to stop the villagers complaining, and then set off on your journey.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.12.142.0.mess: You will find the Holy Grail underground. You can reach it through a gate on a small island near your brother's capital, to the west beyond the mountain walls and a stretch of sea. The lookout tower will surely help you. The entrance is guarded by a tan tower. I think the spell in Pandora's Box will come in handy.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.122.113.0.mes: Beware: zombies are very treacherous, especially in such numbers.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.122.137.0.mes: I see fresh stumps; there must be a sawmill here.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.123.111.0.mes: This breed of dragon thrives in such high mountains.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.124.94.0.mess: The Alchemist's Lab high in the mountains is a valuable asset to you.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.126.56.0.mess: Today you had an unpleasant conversation with one of your warriors. They are tired and want to go home.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.13.117.0.mess: You have landed in enemy territory. Beware of hidden threats.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.130.27.0.mess: There is an old legend about a sailor who tried to cross this sea but entered another world and never returned. Be careful the same does not happen to you.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.131.100.0.mes: No one has lived within these walls for a long time.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.133.10.0.mess: God, thank you. This will help me greatly.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.133.102.0.mes: A few mosquitoes want a scratch behind the ears.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.133.9.0.messa: Your reputation is beginning to spread among independent troops eager to join the holy army.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.135.40.0.mess: Those little bubbles are not yours, thief!
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.136.111.0.mes: You see stumps ahead and become very uneasy, as though something were in the air.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.136.140.0.mes: The dark wizards must first teach you to fight the forces of darkness.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.136.53.0.mess: Your reputation is beginning to spread among independent troops eager to join the holy army.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.137.52.0.mess: This road was once well travelled, but now it is buried in stones and ice.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.138.89.0.mess: The cold strait will lead you to your doom.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.139.143.0.mes: You must destroy all 4 opponents to stop the rebellion spreading across Euthoria. Otherwise you would lose control of it, and the land would break apart again. Wars and strife would return, as in ancient times.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.139.35.0.mess: Consider this decision carefully. You will open the way into your territory forever... Nothing will protect you from the raids of the knights of darkness.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.140.143.0.mes: Unfortunately, when Eurikus turned 18, the powers of renegade dark wizards took hold of him. When King David died, he left the land to Hargo. Eurikus could not bear his brother ruling one of the greatest countries, and declared war on him alongside 3 other warlords.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.140.45.0.mess: Good thing you can walk on water.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.140.49.0.mess: A powerful earthquake here several years ago opened up the river's lower spring. The river flooded some of the trade routes. We hope this obstacle will not delay you too much.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.142.2.1.messa: You have ventured into a mysterious land of long-forgotten castles. Beware: if the evil forces defeat you, they will gain passage into our world.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.142.62.0.mess: Wondrous items lie beneath the peaks of the high mountains, but they are protected by immense power.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.143.19.1.mess: The journey is long, and your men are beginning to tire of it. Let us hope there is no mutiny.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.143.41.1.mess: Ahh, what do you see? Some sort of walls are emerging from the mist. What might they be guarding?
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.17.107.0.mess: Wandering barbarians have chosen you as suitable prey.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.17.16.0.messa: This is the right place to teleport to the long-abandoned island.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.17.69.0.messa: Danger lay in wait for you in the forest lane.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.18.142.0.mess: I would not tempt fate if I were you. It is true that this single obelisk reveals the Holy Grail's resting place, but the guardians had good reason to keep it closely guarded.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.19.104.0.mess: Your reputation is beginning to spread among independent troops eager to join the holy army.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.19.33.0.messa:
Seek the Holy Grail, and eternal peace shall follow.
You have come far; let nothing stop you.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.19.66.0.messa: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.20.77.0.messa: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.23.18.0.messa: Your reputation is beginning to spread among independent troops eager to join the holy army.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.23.99.0.messa: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.24.120.0.mess: I would not risk it. Take my warning deadly seriously.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.24.66.0.messa: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.27.21.0.messa: Before trying to destroy your half-brother, you should first seek the Grail, which will surely help you fight him.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.29.120.0.mess: You are nearing the landing site. Beware of evil's henchmen.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.29.30.0.messa: Your reputation is beginning to spread among independent troops eager to join the holy army.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.29.36.0.messa: If you open the gate, you will regret it.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.31.81.0.messa: The tree has summoned helpers against you!
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.32.75.0.messa: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.33.88.0.messa: Nasty mosquitoes are beginning to crawl out of the swamps.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.36.132.0.mess: And a university! I hope you stop there and learn something, so you do not turn into some barbarian.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.36.47.0.messa: As you crossed from the swamps into the desert, a small group of barbarians spotted you.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.36.56.0.messa: You hear roaring all around. What could it be... Then you realise: a gladiatorial arena.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.42.104.0.mess: To reach the other side, you will have to overcome a few obstacles. Think you have what it takes?
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.43.124.0.mess: So much water! You could finally have a proper wash, too.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.43.72.0.messa: Your reputation is beginning to spread among independent troops eager to join the holy army.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.44.128.0.mess: Little goblins run out from behind the trees and threaten to kill you unless you pay. You merely laugh in their faces and charge into battle with a mad cackle.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.44.59.0.messa: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.45.121.0.mess: Arkonas, once ruler of northern Euthoria, is in the prison. Your half-brother imprisoned him after betraying him during a military campaign. If you free him, he will be very grateful for his rescue and will surely reward you. But beware: he is extremely well guarded. Think it over.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.45.138.0.mess: Your scouts have excelled again: they have found another dragon breeding ground. Unfortunately, they also bring bad news: renegade gnolls guard it.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.45.54.0.messa: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.48.126.0.mess: A wandering band of mosquitoes has attacked you.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.48.71.0.messa: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.49.63.0.messa: The tree has summoned helpers against you.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.50.95.0.messa: Your men high on the ship's mast have spotted an unpleasant obstacle.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.55.110.0.mess: You have completed one of your first tasks: finding the red tent. But make no mistake, there will be many tasks. You still have a long road ahead. Much time will pass before you complete them all.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.56.68.0.messa: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.57.54.0.messa: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.59.109.0.mess: Your reputation is beginning to spread among independent troops eager to join the holy army.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.59.127.0.mess: You must never come to power. We will soon put you in your place.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.60.21.0.messa: At last, a little luck has smiled on you.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.61.137.0.mess: These unicorns may not be upgraded yet, but they are still powerful troops.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.62.29.0.messa: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.62.99.0.messa: Hungry hydras have emerged from the swamps.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.63.114.0.mess: God, how beautiful it is here!
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.66.28.0.messa: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.66.90.0.messa: Your reputation is beginning to spread among independent troops eager to join the holy army.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.68.17.0.messa: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.69.89.0.messa: Welcome to the island of greedy sprites.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.71.129.0.mess: This is our place. You will pay dearly for your audacity.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.71.28.0.messa: Your reputation is beginning to spread among independent troops eager to join the holy army.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.71.40.0.messa: If you open the gate, you will regret it.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.72.118.0.mess: You have found a warrior dwelling and breathed a sigh of relief. Your army will grow stronger again.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.72.27.0.messa: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.72.36.0.messa: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.73.65.1.messa: For generations, with the help of dark wizards, the Holy Grail was kept safe here among impassable mountains, protected from the Darkness that sought to establish a reign of terror. Fortunately, that never happened, and the wizards did not have to intervene; otherwise chaos would have engulfed the world, and death would have taken a cruel toll. But now a great BATTLE awaits you!
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.74.113.0.mess: Think again whether a few artifacts are worth heavy losses among your troops.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.75.9.0.messag: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.77.35.0.messa: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.77.67.0.messa: To reach the land of evil, you must sail through this strait... But it is somewhat guarded.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.78.131.0.mess: Think you are ready for this battle? Do not risk too much.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.80.127.0.mess: So you want gold? Your greed will be your destruction.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.82.2.0.messag: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.84.13.0.messa: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.86.20.0.messa: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.87.114.0.mess: Ahh, what do you see? A dwelling of your trusty comrades! You must claim it—and there are Fire Elementals too.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.87.44.0.messa: A mysterious island has emerged before you from the mist and smoke.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.88.2.0.messag: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.89.108.0.mess: An overgrown little lake. You almost missed it.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.89.97.0.messa: What do your eyes behold? Ancient wizards left the legacy of their work here. I hope it helps you, but a small obstacle stands in the way.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.90.136.0.mess: You let your guard down for a moment, and the forest men are already attacking. And what is this? They have summoned the trees against you too... Die!
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.91.12.0.messa: Every shadow here seems to have begun moving.
map.[roe] - temnota.guards.94.107.0.mess: That is a truly enormous heap of crystals. Do you want to take this risk?

This morning you were awakened by a pounding on the door. Outside stood several mages who, bored with endless research in their libraries, had decided to join your army.
You knew you shouldn’t lend money to that nuisance down below, but you did it anyway. Now you must pay him a visit and explain the meaning of the word loan.
Your only consolation might be that you are not the only blockhead who lends people money. But it is no consolation, because it means the lord of Nedobytno’s interests conflict with yours. Watch him carefully, or he may snatch your cash.

map.[roe] - vzkriseni temne trojky.event: A messenger arrived during the night with unwelcome news. Thant and his entire entourage have been captured. He will be tried and probably imprisoned.
Your finest warlocks joined forces to locate Thant’s prison. They performed powerful rituals and achieved a result: a small volcanic island near the coast of Orolsko was identified.
Rumours of the immense wealth of the Caves of Unrest have reached the royal palace. Unfortunately, the rumours give no indication of how to enter the cave.

An old beggar supposedly knows the way to the Caves of Unrest. The route leads through ancient gates that open only when a magical formula is spoken. Only the hermits dwelling in the swamps of southwestern Orolsko still know it.
Well-informed sources in Orolsko urge haste in freeing Thant. The leaders of the knightly order have proposed bribing him. He may be swayed and join the living.

More than two centuries ago, your master’s forces conquered Aloney, laid waste to the entire land and established the rule of darkness. Smoke from black rituals shrouded the skies for decades, and enemies dared not defy the master’s will. Above all, the Dark Three, galloping across the countryside at night, filled them with helpless terror.

On the opposite shore of the bay, however, a knightly order gradually formed and began spreading tales of divine light among the people, dangerously raising morale along the entire coast. Now, with the help of several angels, the knights have captured Tharix, and small raiding parties are landing on the shores of Aloney with increasing frequency.

Your master has also lost magical contact with the Head of Legion, the artifact that empowers the Dark Three. They are now trapped between universes and cannot spread the master’s rule in this world. The artifact was stolen from Tharix itself, which stands on an island of the same name west of Atharax.

Your task is to find this artifact and place it on the altar in Tharix, reopening the gate between worlds and resurrecting the Three. Under no circumstances may you leave Atharax unprotected: its fall would mean certain defeat.

The council and your master have proposed conquering Agruk. Once a mighty city, Agruk was ravaged by the red sea and a bitter war, and now lies in ruins. Agruk stands on Mvar, a strategically placed island in the middle of the sea, and occupying it could greatly affect the balance of power.

All of Aloney’s most capable sorcerers searched magically for the lost Head of Legion, the artifact that can restore the power of the Dark Three. Their search failed, leaving only the suspicion that Marshal Goriam, the man who captured Tharix, is hiding the artifact.

Even after several months of searching, the ruler’s sorcerers have failed to find the Head. This suggests that the artifact is protected by an exceptionally strong magical field, probably in a shrine somewhere in Orolsko.
The court sorcerers still have not located the Head of Legion. Your master lost patience and had them beheaded. Their successors are now attempting to find the artifact.
map.[roe] - vzkriseni temne trojky.guard: After all, you failed to petrify any of the gargoyles or capture one alive; even you were surprised by their ferocity and resilience. You at least had the surroundings searched, and your soldiers discovered a breastplate of petrified wood. Closer examination revealed its magical nature.

Travelling along the coast, you found a secret alchemical workshop. Its owner, however, spotted your army’s approach from afar and managed to throw almost all his documents into the fire. Little of use remained: just one spell scroll and one body.

You sensed a magical aura by an abandoned campfire, and your soldiers found an enchanted artifact. You ordered them to bring you the tunic, but suddenly a flock of griffins began circling ominously above the camp. Do you really want the artifact brought to you?

After a fierce battle you finally won this powerful orb, best used by a sorcerer versed in earth magic. You put the precious artifact in your bag, and your journey now leads towards the Cave of Unrest.

You discovered a strange, gleaming box on an obelisk near the road. One of the undead in your army, a wizard in life, told you it was a Pandora’s Box, in which mages store their magical implements or even their power in various forms.

The Pandora’s Box granted you new knowledge and magical power, but at the price of a ritual of light. A powerful, radiant aura surrounded you, alarming your troops, creatures of darkness and shadow. You too are now utterly exhausted.

Deep in the heart of the Encircling Mountains, your unit discovered a long-forgotten monastery, absent even from the oldest maps. You learned that the priests possess a powerful Tome of Water Magic, but refuse to surrender it under any circumstances. Will you slaughter the monks and take the Tome by force?

The coastal Encircling Mountains hold back almost all the moisture brought by the east wind, leaving the region within the mountains very dry. During an arduous journey in which you went without water for several days, you lost many horses. You spent 2500 gold on replacements.

You massacred a village of cyclopes, acquiring several strong bodies from which to make new, hardy warriors for your army. You also found a powerful pendant that reflects every kind of lightning back into the clouds where it was born, safely shielding your troops from its searing effects.

Wading through the swamp, you reached a foul-smelling place, a pool full of algae and decay. Your soldiers recognised it as a troglodyte breeding ground. Rumour has it that the blind troglodytes may possess a Pendant of Second Sight. Do you want to search the breeding ground?

The bridge over the Sippria is destroyed, and your only option is to ford the bed of the river, which is turbulent at this time of year, though shallow. After several exhausting hours, you and your army reach the far bank, but some of the cargo has been swept away.

The gargoyles guarded the entrance to a disused mountain pass, at the end of which stands a small chapel. A few decrepit old men lived there and gave your army no trouble at all. To your surprise, in the treasury beneath the altar you found a powerful crown capable of gathering magical energy.

Harpy eggs fetch a handsome price in the southern markets, so you sent several soldiers to search the surrounding cliffs. Unfortunately, at this time of year the young have already fledged, and the party found only broken shells. In one of the nests, however, lay a powerful magical Titan’s Cuirass.

A trap! A band of swordsmen from Orolsko suddenly ambushed you. They must have secretly landed recently and are now conducting sabotage. Verbal clashes with the representatives of Orolsko have escalated into open war.

After a careful search, you discovered an alchemical workshop, or rather what remained of it. It is difficult to tell whether its owner fell victim to wild animals or his own experiments. You found a few useful things among the ruins.

Here, beneath the blazing sun, the mighty mage Orwyg once created an artifact of tremendous power. He bound the sun’s fire within it, creating a work capable of destroying entire armies. He also appointed a horde of fire genies to guard the orb and keep it from falling into the wrong hands. Do you want to fight for the artifact?

On the road you met a ragged wanderer who told you that gold had recently been discovered in the Snowy Mountains. You were not satisfied with the interrogation, however: the beggar surely knew more, so you had him executed. That night you performed a ritual, and a zombie rose from his body to join your army.

The alchemists of old paid little heed to the code, and their experiments often produced mutants and giant animals. Such experiments also gave rise to the giant dragon flies whose hive you have approached. Their presence suggests that a secret workshop lies hidden here in the swamps. For now, however, you must decide whether to look inside the hive.
This mighty artifact may completely change the course of the war with Orolsko. A sorcerer with great reserves of mana can work absolute wonders with this hat.

At this time, the Koruc forests are full of bands of thieves paid by the order of Orolsko to help guard the entrance to central Orol. You rode into the woods, and in an instant a ragged band emerged from earth, water and air, swept through your army and vanished into the undergrowth again. After the raid, however, some of your cargo is missing.

You reached a tavern for the night, ate dinner and treated your army to some drink and living women. You struck up a conversation with the leader of a band of gnolls and offered to buy his enchanted boots. The gnoll, however, refuses to sell. Will you attack his horde and take them by force?

The farther north your troops travel, the colder the weather becomes, and tonight a blizzard even swept in. Your undead army is untroubled by the cold, but the snowdrifts considerably slow its progress. The wagon wheels sink into the snow, forcing you to abandon several wagons and their cargo.
This artifact creates a magical bond through which you influence the enemy’s mind so that they never even think of fleeing battle. You can only guess how it found its way into a behemoth lair.

Quite unexpectedly, you encountered infernal creatures in this region. You crossed a mountain saddle and saw them a short distance ahead. Even from here you can make out the demon leader’s fiery shield. Will you pit your strength against the band of demons and fight for the artifact?

Travelling in the hot shadow of the volcanic mountains, you scan the slopes through a spyglass. Suddenly you see several dragons gliding beneath the low clouds, and notice the gleaming crown adorning their golden queen. Will you order an attack and fight for the dragon crown?

The tales of the forest’s treasures were true: after a whole day searching the woods, you have your reward. In an unremarkable little grove you discovered an extraordinarily powerful orb radiating immense water magic.

You reached a radiant chapel and saw a precious magical necklace on a small altar. A herd of unicorns, however, is slowly gathering from the surrounding grove. Do you really want to steal the magical artifact and probably have to fight for it afterwards?
The Head of Legion is in your hands once more! It is now clear why your master lost mental contact with the artifact: the Head was hidden in a shrine, protected by an impenetrable magical field.

While exploring the coast, you came across a powerful magical scroll, but it lies in territory inhabited by gorgons. Several gorgons surprised you, and you quickly withdrew. Now you are considering returning for the scroll. Will you summon your courage and fight for the artifact?
map.[roe] - vzkriseni temne trojky.heade:
The knights of Orolsko have captured Tharix, desecrating the fortress from which flowed the power of the Dark Three, your master’s most terrible servants! You must recapture the stronghold and bring it the Head of Legion, the artifact that will restore the Three’s power.
Author: ZUNA
map.[roe] - vzkriseni temne trojky.monst: As you struggled through the freezing gale, you heard the high-pitched screeching of gargoyles between gusts. You immediately ordered a hunt, for magically petrified gargoyles are prized by the wealthy as ornaments for their parks and gardens.

Elementals embody the four basic elements and can appear at any time in the most unexpected places. That is exactly what has happened to you: the elementals seem to have materialised suddenly out of thin air.
The cracked ground, bordered by ravines, is ideal for ambushes. It is a favourite haunt of brigands of every kind.

The elven people favour the borderlands between forest and mountains. Over the centuries, the Amazons of their race have perfected their riding skills and can tame even wild pegasi. Elves always stand on the side of light, so you expect an immediate attack.

While surveying the surrounding hills, your men spotted a dazzling flash. Examination through a telescope revealed a very rare orb. You set out for it at once, but as you climbed, enormous birds suddenly attacked.

The Jolan Lakes region is a favoured refuge for a great variety of animals, from peaceful herbivores to fearsome predators. You were crossing the causeway between Salt Lake and Dark Lake when wyverns flew in and attacked you fiercely from above.

Since ancient times, the entrance to the Snowy Mountains has been guarded by magically animated statues, which some peoples call golems. A golem’s nature makes it resilient, but it moves very slowly. Perhaps your archers can disable them from afar before you meet in hand-to-hand combat.

Elves are an ancient race, virtuous and uncorrupted, always standing with the weak and oppressed. Your master finds these traits utterly repulsive, and an age-old hatred therefore exists between him and the elves.

Deep in the Snowy Mountains stands a mighty fortress. Behind its walls, a secret monastic order performs rituals the rest of the world believes long lost in the depths of oblivion. The mages are not particularly well disposed towards your master, however, and you can obtain their secrets only by subjugating them.

More refugees from Mvar. You are gradually seeing ever more clearly that the Encircling Mountains have become a new home for many different creatures. Fleeing the siege of Agruk, they took advantage of Aloney’s nearby coast and hid in these mountains.

Only recently you discovered a gem mine, and already news of the new deposit has spread to neighbouring lands. The dwarves set out at once to try to rob your master. Their passion for minerals will be the death of them one day.

Never before have gremlins from the Snowy Mountains strayed so far south. Gremlins are a timid, rather unintelligent people whom the mages of the north use for manual labour. How will this wandering band behave?

Small bands of robbers occasionally raid the coasts of Aloney and Orolsko from the now almost deserted island of Mvar. Your master regularly hunts these bands, but catching them is difficult: their usually small groups are very good at hiding in the forests.

After Mvar was ravaged in the Battle for Water, some groups of its inhabitants moved to the mainland. Some began making an honest living, but most were rejected by the locals and had no choice but to survive by robbery and attacks on travellers, just like these hobgoblins.

For centuries, the Snowy Mountains have been guarded by hordes of gargoyles. Entirely immune to cold, they can wait patiently for years in a petrified state until an intruder passes, then swoop down in a furious attack.
Landholders hire the strangest guards to protect their property. This miller even bought diamond golems somewhere in the southern markets.

Dwarves are known for their greed, born of a passionate admiration for anything that sparkles. On the road you encountered a column of dwarves carrying a load of treasures recently dug from the earth. They are unlikely to surrender their treasure willingly.
By your master’s decree, for his benefit and the spread of his power, several vampires were sent to the logging village. They now join your army at your command.

These servants of your master were ordered to guard the mine against the grasping hands of robbers and petty thieves. You, however, hold an edict allowing you to release them from this duty and recruit them into your army. Will you exercise this privilege and take them into your ranks?

While exploring the cave, you reached a tower inhabited for generations by minotaurs whom the ruler once appointed to guard a legendary underground treasure. For decades no one has passed the tower, and now you too face its ready defenders.
You and your party ventured too close to a harpy nesting ground. In an instant every harpy took to the air and circled above your expedition.

Rumour says this rocky islet hides a great treasure in the form of an ancient artifact. After landing from your boat, however, you received an unpleasant surprise: the islet is inhabited by cyclopes, who immediately rushed to defend their homes against you.
It seems the local alchemist brought gorgons from the nearby swamps to protect him. Now, however, your master needs his workshop’s resources.

Basilisks are also typical swamp inhabitants: large lizards that hunt using their unusual ability. Their venom paralyses the body’s motor system, leaving a helpless creature easy prey after a successful attack. Basilisks also use their venom in self-defence when necessary.
Elementals greatly strengthen any army. They fight for no conviction and have no conscience, so they can join either side. Capturing the spring will win you powerful allies.
The marshes are always dangerous. Slimy monsters inhabit them, knowing the terrain and trying to lure you into the heart of the swamp, from which there is usually no escape.

Air genies are frequent allies of the frozen kingdoms of the north and appear near snowy lands. You heard rumours that the genies might possess a powerful artifact enabling flight, so you set off north without delay.
You have found the islet where Thant is most likely imprisoned. You have also discovered the prison hidden among the volcanic craters. Now you must defeat the garrison guarding your ally.
The most feared monster of the southern mountain ranges is the behemoth. Its lairs lie high in the mountain saddles, and it always defends them fiercely.
Only now do you grasp the extent of the conspiracy against your master. Armed bands from Orolsko in the very heart of Aloney are a deeply troubling sight. Without hesitation, you order an attack.
Under certain conditions, terrible fire genies can be born from the heat of lava fields. You have the misfortune, or perhaps the good fortune, to be passing a huge caldera at just such a moment.

The Gleaming White Forest takes its name from the herds of unicorns sometimes seen at its edges. No one has entered its depths, and anyone who has succeeded never returned. The entire forest is magical, and the unicorns protect it by every means at their disposal.

High in the mountains, great cliff-dwelling birds such as rocs build their nests. Although the nests are almost inaccessible to creatures on the ground, rocs attack almost any living creature that appears nearby.

Deep in the high plateau you spotted a group of ogres, and they seem to have spotted you as well. Ogres are humanoids living in remote mountain regions, rarely appearing at lower elevations. They are now gathering to defend their caves.

Dwarves are the oldest people (they lived before the elves, though they came into the world after them), and never fail to remind everyone of it. They are proud of this fact and sometimes treat other races with disdain, even hostility.

The boundary between forest and swamp has always been a refuge for centaurs. This unaggressive people has always preferred letters to warfare, gathering food in the forest and using their knowledge of the swamps when attacked.
The mightiest allies of Orolsko and your master’s greatest enemies now stand against you, ready to defend the Shrine of Spring. Are you strong enough to confront the Warriors of Light directly?

Marching through a gully hemmed in on both sides by steep cliffs, you have an uneasy feeling that something is wrong. Now and then you see pebbles fall, and then it happens. A hail of arrows flies from both slopes, loosed from the bows of lizardmen.
An old sea dog told us of treasure on an islet west of Mvar. We set sail dreaming of riches, but our ship broke apart on the coastal rocks.
Our exploration ship wrecked on the coast of Aloney. The knights and captain are dead, and undead swarm everywhere. God, how will we get out of here?
