map.[roe] - x files.event.0.description: During one of their cases, Mulder and Scully were transported to an entirely different world, known only from the X-Files. Mulder must now explore the real version of a world he had only believed in. If possible, he must also find and free Scully, who was transported here too, but is nowhere in...
map.[roe] - x files.event.1.description: ... sight, which means she has been imprisoned somewhere in this world and is waiting for her colleague Mulder to find her. But that is not Mulder’s only task in this imaginary world full of magic and monsters whose existence is denied. He must destroy the main castle of the great fiends who have settled in this land...
map.[roe] - x files.event.10.description: Your entire treasury has been robbed.
map.[roe] - x files.event.2.description: ... and torment the region. Whether he succeeds is up to you. This world must be rid of these fiends, and Mulder will finally be satisfied that he has seen the world he believed in, whose existence no one believed when he spoke of it. Even if he does manage to return to the present, no one will believe any of this...
map.[roe] - x files.event.3.description: ... It should be obvious that Mulder must not be defeated under any circumstances, or Scully will remain here forever.
map.[roe] - x files.event.4.description: There is also an enemy who will keep you company right from the start, so you will need to quietly remove him.
map.[roe] - x files.event.5.description: Mulder will probably start truly believing in this land’s magic soon, now that his stock of precious crystals has turned into ordinary stone...
map.[roe] - x files.event.6.description: Just as Mulder began complaining about his shortage of gold, his gold supply caravan was ambushed.
map.[roe] - x files.event.7.description: Mulder did manage to ambush a mysterious gold caravan after all.
map.[roe] - x files.event.8.description: The few crystals you managed to find have turned to stone again. This time you did not even get the stone, because it was worthless.
map.[roe] - x files.event.9.description: Your kingdom was attacked by fiends from underground, and repairing the damaged buildings cost you...

map.[roe] - x files.guards.30.41.0.messa: Don’t leave this lighthouse abandoned. It is bound to come in handy.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.30.62.0.messa: Here several monsters from the Arabian Nights pounced on Mulder. That’s what he gets for those crazy X-Files: everything he believed in has now taken physical form.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.30.71.0.messa: You are now sailing into lands full of surprises.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.31.29.0.messa: In this tree lives a very old man who offers a reward for finding a rare object straight from hell. It isn’t your colleague, though, Mulder...
map.[roe] - x files.guards.31.53.0.messa: Mulder must be a brave man to dare explore this land... or perhaps a madman... read the writing on a rock near the water.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.32.42.0.messa: There is a mill in this world too, but the miller is no ordinary man, so watch out. He has sent several of his "gorillas" against you. He says he will give you a gift if you defeat them.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.32.61.0.messa: This island really must be cursed. Nobody wants to hand anything over.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.33.63.0.messa: I certainly wouldn’t want to get lost in the forest around here, Mulder thought.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.33.8.0.messag: You are now approaching the fiends’ main castle in this land. Are you properly armed? If so, don’t hesitate: enter...
map.[roe] - x files.guards.34.66.0.messa: No, no, don’t look for Scully here. We gremlins live here!! Greetings, Gremlin...
map.[roe] - x files.guards.34.8.0.messag: What’s this? Hmm, probably a friendly welcome. Or an unfriendly one?
map.[roe] - x files.guards.35.35.0.messa: Visit our fortress too. You may find things your army needs here, such as better equipment for your troops.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.35.42.0.messa: The journey into the dangerous world of the X-Files is dangerous indeed, but I have to go there anyway.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.36.68.0.messa: Plenty of surprises means plenty of surprises, and several naga queens pounced on our hero, saying they would tear him to pieces.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.37.67.0.messa: Are you sure this is real?
map.[roe] - x files.guards.39.42.0.messa: Here lives a local informant (not a snitch) who knows everything happening in this strange world.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.4.11.0.messag: Well, well, it won’t be that easy. There are still several monsters whose existence absolutely everyone denies. Mulder, if you ever get out of this, no one will believe any of it.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.4.4.0.message: Fancy another trip across the sea???
map.[roe] - x files.guards.41.36.0.messa: This is one of the neutral castles leading to worlds even darker than those so far.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.45.46.0.messa: Perhaps even you can learn something from the stone of wisdom.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.47.38.0.messa: You will find everything you need here, but nobody will give you anything for free.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.47.60.0.messa: Riding among the cliffs is dangerous. This time you only just managed to escape a horde of titans living in the mountains.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.48.17.1.messa: Take a look a little farther ahead before you go there.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.48.3.0.messag: Welcome, Mulder. Do you really think we’ll hand Scully over for nothing?
map.[roe] - x files.guards.48.6.0.messag: I think I’ve found it. I should find Scully here.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.48.71.0.messa: Well, look, Mulder! Welcome to the real X-Files! Let’s see you explain the monsters in this magic box!
map.[roe] - x files.guards.5.69.0.messag: Well now, perhaps I can beat some information about Scully out of him.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.52.10.0.messa: Does the FBI rescue drowning people too? Surely not! You actually care about people? Well, here are some monsters that belong in the X-Files.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.53.53.0.messa: You’ve made it a little farther again, Mulder.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.56.56.0.messa: What will you choose from us? Just make sure you choose wisely.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.60.11.0.messa: Come and claim one of the many spells.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.61.61.0.messa: The world of the X-Files is fascinating and unknown. Only a madman would dare enter it, or... Mulder...
map.[roe] - x files.guards.62.63.0.messa: Visit a magic well unlike anything you’ve seen even in your X-Files.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.62.71.0.messa: All your crystals were taken away. A shame. At least take these... says the old man.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.65.48.0.messa: It’s quite a wilderness around here, untouched nature. But then, if someone enters it, who knows what might jump out at them?
map.[roe] - x files.guards.66.6.0.messag: This is the gate to the underworld, where the ruler of this world dwells: the mighty lord of hell. Quite unbelievable. What do you say to that, FBI agent?
map.[roe] - x files.guards.66.61.0.messa: This is the wood elves’ home. Or were you expecting aliens?
map.[roe] - x files.guards.66.64.0.messa: You see, Mulder, in this world you actually dreamed up yourself, you can learn all kinds of spells too. We offer you the spell "Fire Wall".
map.[roe] - x files.guards.66.69.0.messa: I always wanted to rule a castle, actually, Mulder thought.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.68.71.0.messa: Was I dreaming, or not?... It looks as though I wasn’t. I really have been transported to another world, but what kind? What will I do here? Good God, Scully is gone! We were together last time, so where is she? I’ll have to find her...
map.[roe] - x files.guards.70.23.1.messa: That FBI pokes its nose into everything. He even wants to take this old artifact of mine, but I won’t give it to him, an old man declared.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.71.12.1.messa: You had better sacrifice something here, or someone will sacrifice you.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.71.23.0.messa: There are only abandoned ships here.
map.[roe] - x files.guards.71.62.0.messa: This bow will help you improve your archery a little. But it won’t be free...
map.[roe] - x files.header.description:
An unknown force transported Mulder and Scully to another world resembling the worlds of the X-Files, but Scully must be found. Join the FBI agents and explore this world!
Author: FIREBIRD
firebird@email.cz

map.[roe] - x files.monster.35.41.0.mess: Come along, Mulder, come along. Here lies the harsh world of the X-Files.
map.[roe] - x files.monster.4.41.0.messa: Go on, come to the tent for a pass. Think we’ll just let you in? The FBI is so naive, wandering around thinking they can do anything. We’ll have to disabuse them of that notion.
map.[roe] - x files.monster.52.32.0.mess: I must be dreaming, says Mulder. There are even creatures made of diamonds here, and this world clearly has diamonds.
map.[roe] - x files.monster.57.41.0.mess: Those are mad cows, or complete nonsense... Has complete nonsense ever punched your teeth in, you famous agent?... came a voice from the other side.
map.[roe] - x files.monster.6.27.0.messa: Never, do you understand, NEVER will the FBI be allowed anything in this imaginary land.
map.[roe] - x files.monster.62.23.0.mess: A lion crossed with a scorpion and something that flies? Now that’s a bit much, Mulder said aloud. He shouldn’t have done that...
map.[roe] - x files.monster.63.71.0.mess: Hello, "Mulder". You haven’t chosen an easy world. That’s what you get for those "ex-files" of yours!
map.[roe] - x files.monster.64.67.0.mess: Wood is essential, but we cannot give it to you. You’ll have to take it.
map.[roe] - x files.monster.65.60.0.mess: Mulder, Mulder, you must be the greatest fool who could ever exist in the real world.
map.[roe] - x files.monster.67.35.0.mess: Are you from a fairy tale too? Mulder asked the strange creature. I’ll give you fairy tales, you FBI clown! I’ll beat that nonsense out of your head.
map.[roe] - x files.monster.70.62.0.mess: Welcome, Mulder. This is a harsh world. I don’t know who rules it, but I know I must not surrender this mine.
map.[roe] - x files.monster.70.71.0.mess: Welcome, "Mulder". We haven’t seen Scully, but we’ll help you find her. That’s strange, Mulder thinks. Do they know something about me here?
map.[roe] - x files.monster.71.2.0.messa: But Mulder, these treasures are ours, and you have no claim to them. We don’t care in the slightest that you’re from the FBI.
map.[roe] - x files.monster.71.66.0.mess: The Tree of Knowledge is very rare, so you won’t get it at any price.
map.[roe] - x files.sign.0.23.0.message: Whatever you find is yours, if you find anything.
map.[roe] - x files.sign.0.47.0.message: See, see, you rush into every corner, and there’s actually nothing here.
map.[roe] - x files.sign.39.37.0.message: Entry to these two castles requires a special permit.
map.[roe] - x files.sign.42.41.0.message: Dear FBI agent, if you are looking for useful resources, you must explore the flooded surroundings of these two neutral castles.
map.[roe] - x files.sign.56.43.0.message: The biggest dealers in the entire region gather at this marketplace and trade in just about everything.

Map author: Yokel

map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.1.descriptio: The town of Montessor lies safely in a peaceful land. Its inhabitants have no complaints and want for nothing. But they fear the nearby forest, which they have barely explored, and the mage Gaudill.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.10.descripti: Gaudill has built a Cloud Temple, and the titans are very favourably disposed towards him.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.11.descripti: During the night, the dwarf Auberon advised you in a dream. Don’t linger anywhere: Gaudill’s army is growing faster than yours!
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.13.descripti:
Here are the resources you need for the journey. Go, and do not return to the castle!
I will have one of my gates opened so you can leave our land.
But you will have to cross the unknown and feared forest.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.2.descriptio:
{It all happened so quickly!}
Aymon, son and heir of the current ruler Hervis, wanted to inherit as much as possible. He therefore had to get rid of Guichard, Hervis’s other son. To that end he murdered Gerard, Hervis’s friend, and made it look as though Guichard had killed him.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.3.descriptio: Guichard denied everything, but the king, blinded by grief, did not believe that Aymon had framed him. Hervis banished Guichard from Montessor. He also condemned him to certain death by ordering him to fulfil an impossible task: make the dangerous voyage across the Mosoni River to the southern lands.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.4.descriptio: Guichard must complete every task and reach the mage Gaudill, probably the kingdom’s greatest threat because his spells can hypnotise people. He must defeat Gaudill and bring his crown to Montessor as proof, so he can reclaim his lands, which have been entrusted to his brother.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.5.descriptio: Hervis even stripped you of all your wealth.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.7.descriptio: You were robbed during the night.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.8.descriptio: You paid a traveller for water for your parched army.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.event.9.descriptio: You handed out money to your soldiers for their good service.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.12.48.0.mes: The lighthouse’s current inhabitants attacked you.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.12.65.0.mes: The inhabitants of this small country heard that you had entered their territory, and it made them very angry.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.14.51.0.mes: The sea voyage has indeed proved dangerous. You thought you would cross without much trouble, but water creatures attacked you.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.14.6.0.mess: You won’t rob our land of its wealth!
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.15.48.0.mes: The hobgoblins sold you Equestrian’s Gloves.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.16.18.0.mes: You are no longer allowed into the town!
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.17.44.0.mes: You spotted something glittering in the crater.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.18.17.0.mes: I told you not to return without the sorcerer’s crown. I have ordered all my troops not to join you, so you have no business here anyway. Unless you have already defeated Gaudill.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.18.39.0.mes: You leave the forest, with encouraging shouts from its inhabitants sounding behind you.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.20.66.0.mes: Your army is delighted to see water again.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.22.38.0.mes:
This is the forest’s sacred spring, and drinking from it is forbidden!

Auberon the dwarf.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.25.37.0.mes: You must not drink from this spring. We have guarded it for over 200 years, and you are the first adventurer to come so far. Any attempt to drink is punishable by death!
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.28.17.0.mes:
You have found Montessor’s coat of arms. A band of swordsmen guards it.
{Fight?}
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.29.19.0.mes: Eleven brave knights have offered their help, believing that you did not kill Gerard.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.29.64.0.mes: In this creature’s eyes you see a hunger for human flesh.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.30.26.0.mes: As you pass a tree, you are suddenly surrounded by the group protecting it.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.31.1.0.mess: This way will be easier, but it won’t be free. :o)
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.33.50.0.mes: We have worked this mine for years, and it is our only livelihood. We cannot surrender it!
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.36.56.0.mes: Those cannibals really aren’t doing your army any good.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.38.16.0.mes: You met the dwarf Auberon, ruler of this forest. He told you why people disappeared here: "Everyone who came here had bad intentions. You don’t seem that way, so I will help you. I will give you part of my army.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.38.9.0.mess:
You understood it.
A secret passage.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.39.52.0.mes: You met Garin. He has lived in exile for 40 years and offered to work with you.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.39.54.1.mes: The heat has even drained your magical energy.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.40.20.0.mes:
{Dragon flies flew out of the tree}

"We’re tired of just waiting for someone to come along. We’ll go with you."
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.40.35.1.mes: "I’ve come too far to give up now," you tell yourself, bolstering your confidence.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.40.41.0.mes: You have walked into a trap. All that remains is to draw your weapon.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.40.6.0.mess: This forest is very favourably disposed towards you indeed. They have even organised a selection of the best warriors for your army.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.40.66.0.mes: All the cannibals around here have lowered your army’s morale a little.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.41.5.0.mess: This forest relies chiefly on dragon flies, and they will help you most on your travels. In the land of Sutri, our dragon flies are imprisoned and serve the local people. If you manage to free them, they will surely help you.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.42.10.0.mes: Things disappear quickly in these swamps.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.42.27.0.mes: Do you really want to open the box???
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.43.9.0.mess: Auberon also allowed you to take part of his army and left you some money for it, taken from wicked people in this forest.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.45.49.0.mes: A wandering desert band has ambushed you.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.46.39.0.mes: Hidden in a hole beside you were members of one of the bands that rob passing warriors.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.47.6.0.mess: But good creatures are not the only inhabitants of this forest. A giant basilisk lives at the source of this river, partially blocking its flow.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.51.12.0.mes: Some kind of magic flows from that tree.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.52.20.0.mes: A flock of gulls attacked you.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.54.44.0.mes: You disturbed the sacred peace. The spirits of former pharaohs attacked you for it.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.55.31.0.mes: Gohorru has fallen under the cyclopes’ control. The hobgoblins drove them out some time ago because of their aggressive nature. The hobgoblins want to live in peace.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.57.1.0.mess: On the ground you found the remains of an old spell book. A few pages are still legible.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.57.32.0.mes: Soldiers stand before you, all armed with bows. Will you fight them for the rare bow they guard?
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.59.49.0.mes: This helmet belonged to a mighty ruler of this region, now buried in this tomb. If you want to steal it, you must defeat the guards.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.66.12.0.mes: This stretch of the river is inhabited by elementals.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.67.14.0.mes: Large families of water elementals have settled in this stretch of the Mosoni River.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.67.22.0.mes: The last reinforcements, made up of thunderbirds, have caught up with you.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.68.10.0.mes: Gaudill hypnotised the water elementals, and they attacked you.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.68.12.0.mes: You are sailing past places where water elementals have settled.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.70.11.0.mes: In this stretch of the river you encountered water elementals.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.71.20.0.mes: A scroll bearing a simpler spell lies on the ground.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.guards.8.44.0.mess: Those few angels were just a little warm-up.
map.[roe] - yokel1-gc.header.description:
The knight Guichard was unjustly banished from the town of Montessor. To return, he must fulfil a difficult task: defeat the wizard Gaudill and bring his crown back to the castle as proof.

{Author: Yokel}, email: yokel@seznam.cz

By the way: I recommend playing at 200%.

map.[sod] - ad 1420:10.event.0.descripti: At Christmas in 1422, with the help of traitors who opened the town gates, Sigismund seized Kutná Hora. In a night breakout, an unheard-of manoeuvre by medieval standards, Žižka fought his way out of the encirclement forming around him and escaped towards Kolín. Sigismund proved a complete military amateur. Not only did he fail to pursue Žižka, he even dispersed his troops.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:10.event.1.descripti:
On 6 January, Žižka returned. The crusaders fled in fear, stopping only at Německý Brod. The Hussites destroyed the rearguard covering their retreat at Habry. On 10 January, they captured Brod. Within a week, Sigismund had lost several thousand fighting men, five hundred supply wagons, two major towns, his courage and the last of his prestige. The second anti-Hussite crusade had failed.
And the Hussite chorale became the terror of their enemies...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:10.event.2.descripti: Even though I have given you two days more than Jan Žižka had, hurry as though your life depends on it! If you have no idea what to do first, and even cavalry reconnaissance has not helped, I have one piece of advice: yes, look in an atlas!

map.[sod] - ad 1420:10.heroes.152.biogra: We know little of Jan Žižka of Trocnov’s life. In his youth he probably made his living as a robber knight, and he is also said to have fought under the Polish banner at the Battle of Grunwald. The first reliable accounts of him date only from the Hussite revolution. As commander of the Hussite armies he won the highest glory, but paid for it with the most precious thing of all: on 11 October 1424, Jan Žižka dies.

map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.event.0.descripti:
In spring 1423, Žižka parted company with Tábor, amicably but for good. He went to eastern Bohemia, where he founded Lesser Tábor. It needed a centre of power, and Hradec Králové was a possibility. After the Battle of Hořice, the first clash with Hussite troops on both sides, Žižka seized Hradec. 

But note: this was a Utraquist town! Žižka thus incurred the wrath of Diviš Bořek of Miletínek, who immediately marched against him. At Strachův Dvůr, however, Žižka defeated the punitive expedition, then invaded Moravia to take revenge.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.event.1.descripti:
Having achieved his aims in Moravia, he returned to Bohemia. There he knew no defeat: he won the Battle of Česká Skalice and took Louny, Klatovy, Žatec and other important towns. He escaped encirclement at Kostelec nad Labem by an unprecedented night crossing of the river. During the retreat he fought one of his most brilliant battles: against the Prague troops scrambling up the hill at Malešov, he sent heavy wagons filled with stones, like tanks. 

After his success at Malešov, the blind commander decided to capture Prague. Only the eloquence of the priest Jan Rokycana saved the city, reconciling Žižka with the people of Prague. The renewed allies then agreed on an expedition against Albert of Austria.

Žižka was at the height of his power.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.event.2.descripti: On 11 August 1424, he died suddenly during the siege of Přibyslav.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.event.3.descripti:
I must mention one thing...

Bohemia had now been at war for five years. Žižka’s intransigence, which regarded any call for compromise as treason, contributed greatly to the country resembling an open wound. Žižka too bore responsibility for the civil war that raged until Lipany, often deliberately overlooked in favour of the Hussites’ glorious raids and dramatic defeats of crusader armies. Even if Žižka did not ignite the fire of civil war, he certainly fed it generously...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.event.4.descripti: After Prokop the Bald took command of the Hussite forces, the armies went on the offensive and won many brilliant victories. But one point matters: the Hussites were always willing to make peace, and even at the height of their success called for a church council to decide which side held the truth. For a long time, Europe refused to agree...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.event.5.descripti: It would certainly be tempting to follow the fortunes of the orphaned brethren, their fight for truth and for the right to defend it with arguments rather than the sword. Perhaps another time...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.event.6.descripti: Lead Žižka to the walls of Přibyslav. Someone is waiting for him there.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.event.7.descripti:
The path to success in this scenario is fairly simple: act like Žižka!

First send a punitive expedition into Moravia. Southern Bohemia comes next. Move to the Plzeň region. Sweep through the Hradec region with fire and steel. Then head for Přibyslav...

The plain version sounds less dramatic, but here it is: simply make the rounds of the sausage stands.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.event.8.descripti: Přibyslav is a fortified place halfway between Německý Brod and Jihlava. Look carefully around the map. Can you see it yet? That is where you must go...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.event.9.descripti:
As you have probably noticed, you have an ally: the Tábor town league. Remember that the Hussite movement’s base was very narrow at this time. It consisted essentially of the South Bohemian Taborites and Žižka’s Orebites. After Jan Želivský’s death, Prague became a centre of moderate Utraquists inclined towards peace with Sigismund. Plzeň remained firmly behind the Luxembourger and was never captured during the Hussite revolution. The Plzeň landfrieden league was the strongest bastion of reaction in the country.

So value the Taborites’ help. Perhaps you can forgive them if they snatch a mine from under your nose. After all, you are fighting for the same cause.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.guards.53.51.0.me: Although our knowledge of Jan Žižka in spring 1423 is rather scant, we know one thing for certain. The blind commander waged a guerrilla war in southern Bohemia against the Rosenbergs and the Plzeň landfrieden league. It would be surprising if he gained no experience from the fighting...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:11.guards.62.63.0.me:
Here we part company. But I would like to add something.

Lately, we Czechs are often reminded what cowards we are. That is nonsense, of course: nobody can seriously think we should have defended ourselves against the attack of three armies in the last war. Nor did we stand a chance against the Warsaw Pact hordes. That hardly makes us cowards! Anyone claiming otherwise has earned my implacable hatred.

But take care! This campaign was certainly not an attempt to prove what great warriors we Czechs are. If that had been my aim, I would probably have chosen another, more recent example. I would certainly have found a better way to express my views than the Heroes map editor.

Expect no dramatic resolution, no psychological exploration. I simply like history and games. I tried to combine them. If you enjoyed the result, my efforts were worthwhile. Feel free to write to me sometime at: sasa.batora@seznam.cz

But hurry now! The angels are already waiting for Žižka, to accompany him on his journey to the Kingdom of Heaven...

map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.0.descriptio: As early as the summer of 1420, the Prague wing of the Hussites decided to find the country a new ruler, preferably in Poland. Both Władysław Jagiełło and Vytautas, Grand Duke of Lithuania, refused, pointing out that Sigismund of Luxembourg had not yet been deposed.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.1.descriptio: A national diet was therefore convened. It met in Čáslav on 3 - 7 June 1420 and marked one of the high points of the Hussite revolution. The diet adopted the Four Articles of Prague as law, declared Sigismund deposed and appointed a national government. Unfortunately, it failed to secure a ruler for the country: Jagiełło backed out and offered his nephew, Sigismund Korybut, in his place. Moreover, the Moravian estates held their own diet in Brno, which not only undermined the authority of the Čáslav diet but also placed them on the anti-Hussite side.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.10.descripti: Of course, a mere thousand Champions would be enough to win. You would do better to have at least two thousand, though. A look inside your castle will let you work out how many supporting troops you will then need. I am only adding this advice out of a sense of duty: the scenario does not end when your opponents are defeated, and once you are alone on the map... but that would be underestimating your intelligence, wouldn’t it?
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.2.descriptio:
The period we are about to explore together was one of the most turbulent stages of the Hussite revolution. Various forces were pulling the Hussite factions apart; some of them, such as the Picards, were so extreme that the Hussites themselves destroyed them.

The brotherhood as a whole was still seeking its identity. In the middle of 1421 it reached a high point that would remain unmatched until the glorious raids: the Čáslav diet met in June 1421. This event was so significant that I shall return to it several more times during the game.

So bear with me. There really will not be all that much text.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.3.descriptio: Win a thousand knights to your cause and show everyone that you can unite Bohemia.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.4.descriptio: You have probably noticed that only Jan Žižka accompanies you. This will also be the case in later scenarios, so there is no need to worry too much about training your "couriers".
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.5.descriptio: You certainly cannot go wrong by following our ancestors’ example and sending an embassy to Lithuania. You really should do it. As soon as possible...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.6.descriptio: You have already learned how significant the Čáslav diet was. Representatives of the towns and the lesser nobility participated as equals. The diet placed itself above the monarch and even deposed him. Both were unheard of at the time. Although this assembly did not achieve all its aims, it was nevertheless a major success for the Hussite revolution.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.7.descriptio:
Unfortunately, the diet did not solve the most pressing problem: the country still had no king. It is hard to say whether Korybut was a suitable claimant to the throne. He was a... shall we say, contradictory figure.

We have also discussed the unfortunate conduct of the Moravian estates. They effectively split the country in two, boosting Sigismund’s confidence so much that he immediately began preparing another crusade.

This period also brought another tragedy. Immediately after the Čáslav diet ended, Žižka set off to fight. He went to southern Bohemia and besieged Rábí. There, beneath that accursed castle, he lost his eye. Even an immediate operation could not help: in June 1421, Žižka went blind.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.8.descriptio:
When I started making this campaign, the greatest problem was choosing a portrait for someone of Žižka’s stature. I hope I chose well: Žižka looks sufficiently warlike and seasoned.

One problem remained, however. I almost feel embarrassed to mention it, since everyone knows it, but I would look a fool if I did not. Žižka was, of course, one-eyed. He probably lost his left eye in childhood.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.event.9.descriptio:
I am sure you see what I am getting at. Do not be misled by the portrait I chose! At the time of this story, Žižka had long since lost the sight in one eye, whatever his portrait may show! At Rábí, a blow from a blunt object cost him his right eye and left him completely blind. For the remaining three years of his life, he spread terror and dread among the crusaders... a blind old man!

This is no mockery of cowardly crusaders! It is a tribute to a genius who led armies into battle despite his blindness. Victorious battles!

But more of that next time...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:6.guards.30.68.0.mes:
The time has come.

Žižka lost his sight at Rábí, but survived. After two months of rest, the Hussite commander went to war again. His injury seemed to have made him even more uncompromising. That is the subject of the next scenario...

map.[sod] - ad 1420:7.event.1.descriptio: Jan Žižka went blind during the siege of Rábí. Even that could not stop him from fighting for the word of God: after no more than two months of recovery, he took the field again. And immediately won a glorious victory! When the crusaders heard who stood before the walls of Louny, they fled like cowards to Germany...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:7.event.2.descriptio: The men-at-arms from Meissen formed only one of the five crusading armies, however. Bavarians were gathering in the west of the country, Austrians in the south. Silesian knights attacked through Kłodzko. Sigismund himself occupied Moravia. Fortunately, the crusaders’ attacks were uncoordinated, so Žižka easily repelled them. Early in the new year, Žižka finally buried the second crusade by routing Sigismund in a glorious victory at Německý Brod.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:7.event.3.descriptio: Do not waste time! The crusaders have many times your manpower and resources. Do not wait for their armies to move. Attack! First drive them out of western Bohemia, then out of the Hradec region. Sigismund is an incompetent procrastinator and will not take the field for several months, so do not worry about him yet. Good luck!

map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.event.0.descriptio:
Welcome, dear friend! Allow me to offer a little information.

First, notice that Jan Žižka begins with several powerful spells. These allow Heroes 3 to simulate the three main elements of Hussite warfare: the wagon fort, extensive use of firearms and high morale. Originally, these were to be the only spells in the campaign. Since spells are part of the game, however, I settled on a compromise.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.event.1.descriptio:
You can still learn several plausible strengthening spells. Throughout the campaign, however, you will find no spells that blatantly violate the laws of nature, such as portals, flight and the like. The only offensive spells retained are those resembling missile fire.

With almost no exceptions, you will encounter no mythical or fairy-tale creatures during the campaign. (Halflings represent the young Hussite slingers known as prácata. Surely the presence of troll bridges needs no explanation.)

If that suits you and you fancy trying something a little unusual, I wish you an enjoyable game!
map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.event.2.descriptio: Your first victorious battle is behind you. It is not absolutely certain that Jan Žižka commanded at Sudoměř; all we know for sure is that he was present in the brethren’s army. The battle plan bore such a distinctive stamp of Žižka’s style, however, that we can safely say at least this: if Žižka did not lead the Hussites from the start, he took command during the battle.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.event.3.descriptio: It is me again. I just wanted to warn you against a false sense of invulnerability. Do not try to destroy every opponent: you certainly will not succeed, and Sigismund of Luxembourg in particular is a deadly adversary.

map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.heroes.152.biograp: We know little of Jan Žižka of Trocnov’s life. In his youth he probably made his living as a robber knight, and he is also said to have fought under the Polish banner at the Battle of Grunwald. The first reliable accounts of him date only from the Hussite revolution. As commander of the Hussite armies he won the highest glory, but paid for it with the most precious thing of all: on 11 October 1424, Jan Žižka dies.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.monster.31.65.0.me:
After capturing Rábí, Žižka marched on Strakonice. During the siege, he received a desperate plea for help from Prague: Sigismund’s army had surrounded the city, and its fall would mean the end of the revolution. Žižka therefore went to Prague’s aid without hesitation, thus beginning his glorious campaign.

He returned to Rábí a year later. It was there that a deeply tragic event occurred. But more of that next time...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.monster.65.37.0.me: According to contemporary accounts, only a few dozen Hussite soldiers were fortified in two infantry blockhouses on Vítkov. The crusaders from Meissen, however, were led in a manner that would be very generously described as clumsy. When Žižka received reinforcements, incredible confusion broke out among the knights: many crusaders began falling back, others fled outright, and plenty fell from the steep rocks. In the ensuing panic, the battle was soon over. And so was the first crusade...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.quest.46.57.0.comp: Are you sure you have chosen well? Then let the hundred selected lads throw away their childish slings and take up real weapons...
map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.quest.46.57.0.firs: We have received a shipment of excellent crossbows. Can you find a hundred boys among the auxiliary troops whom you could trust with them?
map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.quest.46.57.0.next: Do not lose hope. In time you will surely find enough capable young slingers.

map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.quest.60.41.0.firs: Sigismund’s forces have cut every supply route. Unless Jan Žižka arrives soon, Prague will quickly starve.
map.[sod] - ad 1420:8.quest.60.41.0.next: The city is on the verge of surrender! Where can Žižka be?

News of the founding of Tábor spread quickly throughout the country, and soon crowds of very different people were making for the town: mostly serfs, but also townspeople, priests disgusted with church politics, and even knights.

Soon after Tábor was founded, it became clear that no one could live in a vacuum. Žižka first consolidated his power in southern Bohemia by capturing several Catholic towns, castles and monasteries. Since there was never enough money for weapons and food, the time came for an unpopular but necessary measure: yes, the Taborites began collecting taxes in the surrounding territory they controlled.

map.[sod] - akrij:0.event.0.description:
Entry from Kristián’s diary:
I have driven every creature that has no business here out of the duchy. However, I was forced to withdraw all my troops and trackers from the lands to the south. The undead resistance suddenly grew stronger, as though someone had sent reinforcements and directed them against my troops. There were consequences, though. Many of the rebuilt buildings have been torn down again. I must repair them and head south once more.
map.[sod] - akrij:0.guards.18.69.0.messa: "Hey, more help. Thank you, Only One."
map.[sod] - akrij:0.guards.27.39.0.messa: This is the eastern mountain road to the Heart of Akrij. Since the southern road is occupied by rebels, this is the only route the enemy can use, and it will probably be closely guarded. You had better be careful.
map.[sod] - akrij:0.guards.28.62.0.messa:
You see that the allied fortress is under siege. It will not hold out much longer.
"I must help them defeat the attacker. But his numerical superiority is terrifying. Hmm, or I could besiege the besieger, haha. Capture all the castles, cut off his supplies and simply starve him out. Let him have a taste of hardship too."
map.[sod] - akrij:0.guards.29.47.0.messa:
The mage stopped and turned to you. "I must warn you, however, that without further help we have no chance against the wild magic wielded by our common enemies. The power of a mighty artifact, lost long ago, would be a great help to us. In our circles it is known as the Orb of Inhibition, and it prevents the use of magic in battle. As you will surely agree, it is very dangerous to mages. I remember reading once that it was last used during the First Dark War, to repel an attack by the Founder, whom the Renegade Mages had resurrected. The artifact should therefore be underground beneath the Field of Fallen Heroes. However, grub-eaters settled there after the Dark War, so it will probably be guarded by black dragons. Entry from Kristián’s diary: 
Well, you return from one battle expecting finally to rest (with a pretty maid in your bed), and what awaits you at home? Another battle. Well, I shall find a way to deal with it. After all, I have escaped worse scrapes.
Yesterday, the commanders of the newly formed militia and I discussed our next steps:
Point 1) First, we must clear the mines and put them back into operation.
Point 2) I shall begin training the villagers in the art of war.
Point 3) To repel attacks on the duchy, we must build a fortress on the border. To hold it, however, I need to squeeze at least {10} passable horsemen - {Champions} - out of those villagers.

You arrived at the chief town of the duchy of Axim, greeted only by averted eyes and the frightened, exhausted faces of its inhabitants.
You sought out the current steward, threw open his door and demanded, "For God’s sake, what has happened here?"
The steward was writing at his desk. At your intrusion he raised his weary eyes, and hope appeared in them as he recognised you. "Ah, Prince Kristián, I am so glad you have finally arrived. You are our last hope. Word of your return reached us recently, and we have been anxiously awaiting you ever since."
Your armour clanking, you walked to the desk, planted your hands upon it and leaned menacingly over the weary old man. "Get to the point, man."
The steward shrank back even further. "Ah, yes, of course. We do not know for certain what is happening either. All we know is that something has happened in the capital. Lately the king has kept raising taxes, and strange reports of undead attacks are reaching us from the neighbouring duchies. It seems they have completely occupied the duchy to our south."
You shook your head in disbelief. "Are you certain my father really has a hand in all this? I have never known anyone as sensible or as attentive to his subjects’ troubles as he is."
The steward nodded. "Yes, I agree. I do not understand it myself, but those who have seen the king lately swear it really is him, and that he is behaving strangely."
You straightened up. "I find that hard to believe. I shall get to the bottom of it."
The steward added wearily, "We are barely able to pay the ever-rising taxes any more. They have now reached an outrageous 25000 gold! Moreover, some monsters have settled in the mountains and prevented the miners from reaching the mines. From time to time an undead army also appears, mindlessly killing every living thing that falls into its claws. I do not understand why they have not wiped us out completely. Probably because they need the gold and gems from our mines, but the end is near. I feel it in my bones..."
You leaned over the old man again. "Calm down, man. We shall find out what is behind all this confusion. I shall go and settle into my quarters now. Send all your garrison commanders to me. We must discuss our next steps together."

Entry from Kristián’s diary:

Well, I have finally recaptured the Ice Mountains too. What a bitter struggle that was! Catching a mage who commands teleportation is almost impossible. 

Now the final stage awaits us: the world beyond the torn veil. Only God knows what we shall find there. 

It seems that even he, the Only One, no longer intends to stand aside. Until now I had found only hints of his intervention: holy artifacts scattered here and there, which greatly helped me in my struggle against darkness. Now he has even sent troops of angels and archangels to our aid. This act has raised my men’s morale almost miraculously. It came at the last possible moment: I was beginning to think everything would collapse around me.

So we still have a chance to rid ourselves of this hellish evil for good...

map.[sod] - akrij:3.event.0.description:
Entry from Kristián’s diary:

It is dreadful how treacherous those beasts are. First they create portals, letting them bypass the fortresses we laboured to build on the approaches without suffering any harm. Now something suddenly appears in one of the castles I have captured, demolishes a few buildings and vanishes without a trace. How the hell am I supposed to fight an enemy like this?

Note:
My allies who command magic have joined forces and cast a powerful spell on the border fortresses, preventing magic from being used in battle. This might make them more effective, because, let us be honest, they have not proved particularly useful so far.
map.[sod] - akrij:3.event.1.description: More archers have arrived at Stromov Castle as aid from the elves of the Dark Forest.
map.[sod] - akrij:3.event.2.description:
Today, on the eve of the expedition to the Ice Mountains, Kristián goes to bed early. His night is far from peaceful, however. 

In his dream, he walks through a land devastated by mighty magic. Hellfire wells up from the sickened earth in many places, its fiery tongues licking at the last remnants of life. Heavy, greasy, choking smoke rolls across the landscape, covering everything in a slowly shifting, claustrophobic darkness like a lurking beast.

The stifling haze suddenly parts before Kristián, revealing an inaccessible fortress. Flames leap from it, and hideous shrieks rise from countless inhuman throats. Kristián stops and watches as the drawbridge slowly lowers with a grating screech. Out of the darkness within steps the worst monster he has ever seen. Its eyes blaze an unearthly yellow, its curled horns jut dangerously forward, and reality itself seems to tighten and twist around it, vainly trying to flee and curl up nearby in pain. Its demonic laughter strikes the deepest reaches of Kristián’s mind, flooding him with uncontrollable terror.

When the monster speaks, its booming bass surrounds and paralyses Kristián. "Well, so you are the human worm who foolishly thinks he can defy my immeasurable power. It may surprise you, but I too was once human, and I still dimly remember that paltry longing for justice that drives your kind. How foolish. A man’s true strength lies in power: over people and over nature. And now I shall show you some of mine..."
Kristián bravely objects, "My father always told me that anyone who claims to be invincible is lying."
The monster roars with laughter. "Ha! Just as naive as your father. And speaking of him..." Before Kristián’s eyes, the king materialises beside the monster, his clothes torn and his body bearing many signs of suffering. The king immediately sinks to his knees, breathing heavily. "Look: not everything you see in waking life is real, and not everything you see in a dream need necessarily be a dream. Here is your father. Genuine, real... and alive."
"That cannot be true! He stood against my troops and paid for it with his life. What did you do to him to make him ally himself with such an abomination?"
The monster merely laughs contemptuously. "You are not listening to me at all! I said your father is not dead. The man killed by your troops was merely a clone I created. I replaced the real king with that clone and threw him into an underground dungeon. It was through the clone that I gained control of the kingdom’s crown. You cannot defeat me. You lack the strength: you and all your wretched rabble put together."
Kristián thinks, ’If he really were invincible, why would he bother creating a clone to seize the kingdom through deceit and pretence? He did not even do that particularly well, judging by our successful resistance.’
The monster speaks again. "And now I shall show you what happens to those who defy my power..." Darkness suddenly begins gathering around its figure, the air crackles with concentrated magic, and a spitting ball of fire slowly takes shape in its hands. It smiles coldly at Kristián and hurls the ball at the king. His clothes instantly ignite, wrapping his body in hungry tongues of flame.
Kristián roars in disbelief, "No! You bastard!"
With the last of his strength, the king whispers in pain, "Son, stop that beast..." Fire rapidly consumes clothing and living flesh, and the air quickly fills with the choking stench of burning meat. After a few horrifying seconds, only a smoking, twisted, blackened skeleton remains on the ground.
Kristián stares hatefully into the monster’s glowing eyes and growls darkly, "We each weave our own fate, but yours is nearing its end!"
The monster laughs thunderously and replies, "Well, the worm can spit too. We shall see how you deal with your own fate..."

Kristián suddenly wakes, drenched in an unpleasantly cold sweat. He opens his eyes in confusion and realises that he is no longer safe in his ancestral castle, but somewhere deep underground in the darkness. Moreover, strange monsters with eyes blazing with hostility are approaching. With a mighty shout he wakes his still-sleeping comrades and prepares for the coming attack.
map.[sod] - akrij:3.guards.30.42.1.messa:
The final chapter of your adventure has begun. The portal has taken you beyond the torn veil into the reality to which the last remnants of the defeated Renegade Mages were banished after the Second Dark War, as you learned from ancient scrolls during your search in the Magic Library. Taking advantage of the disruption to the fabric of space around the Ice Mountains caused by the mages’ teleportation experiments, they connected the two realities again through a dimensional gate and escaped their imprisonment.

It seems that until the Renegade Mages are utterly defeated, you will never be rid of the consequences of their malice. The final reckoning with them rests on you and you alone...
map.[sod] - akrij:3.guards.46.14.1.messa: Excellent, warrior. Recruiting magic-immune black dragons to fight the mages is a brilliant idea and deserves a reward.
map.[sod] - akrij:3.guards.46.23.0.messa: "And now even Angel Wings. I can already see victory within reach..."
map.[sod] - akrij:3.guards.47.15.0.messa: After many hardships, you reached the Magic Library. Here the mages preserve all their knowledge, carefully recorded in books. After many hours, you found the volume you needed. It explained that the rift in reality was actually a magical one-way portal, and also revealed how to reverse its direction. You feel that victory is now within reach.
map.[sod] - akrij:3.guards.49.16.0.messa: "Well, another of the artifacts the Only One is using to help me in my struggle. He ought to join in himself, though."
map.[sod] - akrij:3.guards.54.22.0.messa:
Where the gorge leading to the Ice Mountains once lay, there are now only impassable cliffs.
You merely sighed. "How the hell am I supposed to reach the enemy?"
A voice answered from the shadows behind the nearby rocks. "There is no need. The enemy will find his own way to you."
map.[sod] - akrij:3.guards.70.19.0.messa: At the end of the gorge, you reached a strange rift in space. This is the source of the evil devouring the land like a cancer. Now you must find a way to reach its other side. The answer might be found in the Magic Library in the northwestern part of the Ice Mountains.
map.[sod] - akrij:3.guards.71.23.0.messa: At last, the Ice Mountains, home of the Royal University of Magic. You recalled how, when you were a little boy, your father told you that after the trouble with the Renegade Mages during the First and Second Dark Wars, a royal decree abolished the specialisation of the individual schools of magic. All four mountain castles now offer spells of every element. Several decades ago, after magical experiments threatened to destroy the kingdom, the mages even lost their independence, and the University of Magic came under royal administration. Where are those days of wild, unfettered magic and great mages such as the Founder? Now the mages are glad if they can strain their powers enough to master simple spells. Magic is fading from the world. The age of knights and their valiant deeds is simply beginning.
map.[sod] - akrij:3.guards.71.30.1.messa: Here you found the king’s corpse. He was merely a puppet in the hands of a hideous, heartless monster. You kneel beside him and clasp his stiff hand in yours. "I promise that your death will be avenged. I will find the one behind all this hell!" Then you wipe the tears from your eyes and set off with renewed determination.

map.[sod] - akrij:4.event.0.description:
Entry from Kristián’s diary: 

Excellent. I have rebuilt the destroyed town buildings in every castle of the duchy of Axim. I have also cleared the undead from the castles south of the duchy. Unfortunately, the enemy had time to do considerable damage to them. To use them in my plans, I must rebuild the destroyed buildings, which will take some time.
One thing has gone well, though. We have managed to contact the people of Karel’s Domain. 

Note: 
Before going any further, I must speak to Karel III. Hopefully he is still alive...

...and one more thing. Strange gates have appeared in the region. I sent a few men to investigate, but they claim to have found nothing more dangerous than a few stones. I do not know what to make of it. Those abominations must surely be responsible, and if they are, I can be certain we shall soon have our hands full. I must keep an eye on them. God knows what they might be used for. 

For now, however, I shall begin withdrawing my scattered troops behind the walls. If the enemy strikes, I must hold my hard-won positions at any cost!
map.[sod] - akrij:4.event.1.description:
Entry from Kristián’s diary:

The elves in the nearby Dark Forest have heard of our struggle against the strange monsters. Their Council of Elders realised that the fighting would soon spread to their sacred lands of forests, waters and hills. They therefore decided to set aside our ancient enmity for now and form a temporary alliance with us. One of their most capable elven warriors has been sent to help us.

I believe that deciding to ally with humans was far from easy for the elves. Although humans have forgotten exactly what caused such bitter enmity (I myself remember only fragments of long-forgotten stories once told to me by my father’s father), elven memories are as deep and firm as the roots of ancient trees. 

In those distant days when the elves entered into an alliance of mutual aid with the dwarves, one elf broke the taboo of racial purity and bound his eternity to a dwarf woman. This act outraged the Elders and eventually led to both lovers being banished beyond the Sacred Forest. There, their love gave birth to a new race: humans. Having inherited the dwarves’ toughness and tenacity and the elves’ intelligence and sound judgement, they soon became the dominant race in the lands beyond elven territory.
map.[sod] - akrij:4.event.2.description:
Entry from Kristián’s diary:

Damn it, I should have known! Those strange stone gates that appeared in the region are actually portals. The enemy uses them to bypass the fortresses we laboured to build on the approaches. Not that those could have held back their sudden onslaught, but at least we would have had a chance...

...now I am losing one captured castle after another. My troops cannot match the magical powers wielded by those hellspawn. They can always conjure warriors out of thin air! If this goes on, I might as well sit down on my backside and write my will. Only a miracle can help us now...
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.27.39.0.messa: This is the eastern mountain road to the Heart of Akrij. Since the southern road is occupied by rebels, this is the only route the enemy can use, and it will probably be closely guarded. You had better be careful.
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.29.47.0.messa:
The mage stopped and turned to you. "I must warn you, however, that without further help we have no chance against the wild magic wielded by our common enemies. The power of a mighty artifact, lost long ago, would be a great help to us. In our circles it is known as the Orb of Inhibition, and it prevents the use of magic in battle. As you will surely agree, it is very dangerous to mages. I remember reading once that it was last used during the First Dark War, to repel an attack by the Founder, whom the Renegade Mages had resurrected. The artifact should therefore be underground beneath the Field of Fallen Heroes. However, grub-eaters settled there after the Dark War, so it will probably be guarded by black dragons. They are naturally immune to all magical attacks! From the caverns beneath the Field of Fallen Heroes, one can also find a way to the surface, where the legendary Founder, better known to your people as the Unifier, lies in a tomb alongside the armour he wore during the War of the Titans."
You objected, "But I cannot set off in search of some legendary lost treasure now. My task is to liberate the kingdom’s lands."
The mage sighed. "You are right. To win, we must now take different paths. Those abominations are becoming more aggressive, so we must hurry. If you can spare a few good warriors, I will create a portal and set off after the artifacts. Meanwhile, make it your goal to liberate the Heart of Akrij. Then we shall meet again."
The mage looked thoughtfully into your eyes. "Before we part, however, I must ask one more favour. As I have stressed, my magic is powerless against black dragons. Yet there is one solution. The Orb of Vulnerability can help me overcome their magical immunity. It has lain for ages, carefully guarded by mages, in the gorge northeast of the place where you helped me. Bring it to me, and then we can each attend to our own task."

The portal has taken you beyond the torn veil into the reality to which the last remnants of the defeated Renegade Mages were banished after the Second Dark War, as you learned from ancient scrolls during your search in the Magic Library. It seems that until the Renegade Mages are utterly defeated, you will never be rid of the consequences of their malice. The final reckoning with them rests on you and you alone...

map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.31.48.0.messa: At last you have reached the part of the forest where the fugitive mage took refuge. You see that you have arrived at the last moment: strange monsters have him trapped. The mage is barely clinging to life and struggling to withstand their attacks. The air crackles with magic being unleashed. Anyone attacked by such hideous monsters cannot be your enemy, so you immediately rush to his aid.
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.32.45.0.messa:
The mage you rescued leaned wearily against a tree and gave an exhausted smile.
"Greetings. I had given up hope of living to see tomorrow. My name is Astral, and I am actually still an apprentice. We were conducting teleportation experiments at the university when rifts appeared in reality. Apparently someone with great magical power used our experiments as a catalyst to open a dimensional gate between two worlds. I have no idea who it could have been. During the murderous frenzy that followed, I managed to gather a few artifacts and teleport close to my hometown. I was lucky: I happened to have everything ready for a teleportation spell."
You let out a heartfelt curse, then said, "That is dreadful, but why did you come here into the woods instead of helping to organise the defence?"
Astral sighed. "I had to withdraw into hiding. I radiate a magical aura that other mages can easily detect. I assumed they would send their hunting beasts after me to silence me forever. Thanks to you, however, their plans have failed, and now I shall repay them with interest. I shall avenge my dead friends as well."
You smiled. This you understood. "Very well, join me, and together we will kick the arse of whoever is behind all this."
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.33.37.0.messa: A pack of monsters attacked you from the shadows of the nearby rocks...
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.33.49.0.messa: From the left side of the forest you hear strange hissing and crackling sounds mingled with cries of pain. A strange, flickering glow also comes from that direction.
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.34.0.1.messag:
"So I have acquired the Orb of Inhibition after all. At last we no longer need fear enemy mages."
Suddenly you feel a gust of warm air against your back and hear the beating of wings...
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.35.3.1.messag: Suddenly you smell the distinctive odour of sulfur, and the temperature begins rising dangerously. You know what it means: black dragons are nearby. Through the shimmering haze of hot air, you glimpse a legendary artifact in the distance: the Orb of Inhibition.
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.35.42.0.messa: Welcome, warrior. Here our Brotherhood of Balance conceals a very dangerous relic that could upset the delicate balance of power among all living beings. If you value your life, leave this place at once and never return.
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.37.45.0.messa: "Phew, another sign of the Only One’s help. Perhaps we still have hope..."
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.41.60.0.messa:
You arrived at the chief town of Karel’s domain, where Karel III himself welcomed you:

"Welcome, Prince Kristián. We had given up hope that any more brothers-in-arms would reach us. I am glad our messenger found you. We had more time here to prepare for the attack and fortify the approaches. A mage who fled the Ice Mountains had warned us of the approaching danger. He claimed to be the sole survivor of the hell unleashed after some magical experiments. Immediately afterwards, something seized control of the kingdom’s capital as well, and the king began behaving strangely. Before I could question the mage properly about the situation, however, he left for the northern forest to the left above the castle, for reasons unknown. His behaviour seemed very strange to me."

You thanked him for the new information and replied, "If we join forces, perhaps together we can defeat this spreading evil. First, however, I shall search the northern forest for the missing mage."
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.45.14.1.messa:
You spotted movement and a gleam of eyes in the nearby bushes. You edged closer inconspicuously, then suddenly sprang at the hiding figure. It turned out to be a pink goblin with a rather unintelligent expression. You sensed a chance to learn more about the missing artifact.
You greeted the goblin innocently. "Hello."
He blinked in confusion. "Hello, are you lost too? I am looking for the way back to my master’s castle. Will you help me?"
"Certainly, but first tell me something. My master sent me to find a red orb he lost. Have you seen it?"
The goblin began trembling all over. "Yes, yes. Northwest of here, in the mountains, I saw something like that. There was a strange smell, so I ran away at once. My master certainly would not go there."
The goblin was growing impatient. "Will you help me find my master?"
You smiled kindly at him. "Just follow your nose straight along this road, and you are sure to reach your master."
The goblin began hopping around you. "Thank you, thank you! At last I shall find my master!" With that, he hopped away.
You merely smiled to yourself and set off northwest into the mountains.

map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.48.48.0.messa: "Thank you for your help, Only One."

map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.54.35.1.messa:
A monstrous passage appeared before your eyes, as though burned into the ground. 
"So this is how those abominations got into the castle. Then I can use it to reach the Ice Mountains and finally get to the bottom of this mystery."
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.58.40.1.messa:
The exit of a secret escape passage from the kingdom’s capital appeared before you. The shape of the underground vault surprised you, however. In its northwestern section was a strange passage, seemingly melted by lava, leading deeper underground.
You made a mental note. "I must return here later and investigate more closely."
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.58.44.1.messa:
The king suddenly appeared before you.
"For God’s sake, my king! Put down those weapons! I do not want to hurt you."
But the king ignored your pleas and charged, his eyes vacant.
"No! Stop..."
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.59.49.0.messa: A pack of hellish monsters sprang at you from behind the trees of the nearby grove...
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.59.50.0.messa: "This road does not look very safe. It seems to be closely guarded. I had better find another way. Besides, I remember that somewhere in the mountains east of here there should be an exit from the secret escape passage leading from the kingdom’s main castle."
map.[sod] - akrij:4.guards.66.69.0.messa: "I see that even the Only One is taking this matter personally."

map.[sod] - bitva o poust herathar.event:
Greetings to all Heroes III gamers. 

I made this map because Battle for the Black Forest received such good reviews. I hope this one will please at least some of you too.
As always, send your comments to kuchi.2.@seznam.cz
I would also like to thank Pattrick for an excellent suggestion on making the game livelier and improving its playability.

A parched desert, endless dunes, billions of tons of sand, impassable crags, a merciless sun, dying vegetation and a harsh struggle for survival.
The Herathar Desert conceals a secret surpassing every wonder and every living thing. Many nations have chosen to fight to claim the secret for themselves.

We have not even been here a week, and a shadow moves above the castle. It is hot inside. The stones are boiling. The desert weather is merciless. The water is undrinkable. And the secret still awaits discovery.
A massive sandstorm is approaching from the east. We must prepare for disaster.
The storm struck. People began to panic. Chaos reigned in the castle. The merciless storm takes everything. The swirling sands swept past, striking with immense, destructive, deadly force.
The tracker you sent out returned, telling you that somewhere in the northeast, in the remotest corner of the desert, there is a gate. A mysterious portal, perhaps leading to the Secret.

Endless plains, mysterious ritual stones, blood, so much blood. Hooded figures, blood, flashes of light, endless darkness and a man: a bald man with a long goatee and glowing, fiery red eyes. Darkness, blood. 
A deathbed. And you are lying on it. The man approaches and begins chanting. He raises a dagger and stabs.

You woke screaming and fell out of bed. This was an omen, an omen of something very evil.
Many rulers have begun occupying the desert. The secret seems to be immense. An adventurer like you would never pass up an opportunity like this.
map.[sod] - bitva o poust herathar.guard: You did not understand, you bastard. You unleashed an age-old evil upon the world. It will conquer the desert, then every living thing. You fool, you can no longer stop it. You may conquer this part, but the essence of the evil has escaped. Dark times await us, very dark times.

A ruined wreck beside the rocks bears the kingdom’s emblem. The prince must have landed here. I must search the area and look for him.                                            The Secret must remain hidden? I do not understand.
A scrap of paper lies on the ground. "They split us up. We had no chance. I am on the brink of death. I can slowly feel life draining from me. I can see the light already." The rest is illegible...

The crumbling castle, weathered by wind and time, where people once feasted and celebrated, seems utterly abandoned. Only local beasts and gnawed carcasses remain within. The plaster on the curtain wall crumbled long ago. Beside a small bush, however, you find something unexpected: a sealed message tube. You remove the message and read it carefully. "Dear Lady Roxana, today I am leaving this wretched place and shall try to get as far from it as possible. If this letter reaches you, I want you to know that I love you. I do not know whether we shall ever escape this place. For five days now some alien power has pursued us, draining all life from us. Everyone is slowly succumbing. Many friends are dead, many people have vanished, and many friends I shall never see again. According to Garet, the only tracker who has not yet fallen, there is a road at the end of the only river somewhere in the south of the Herathar Desert. A road that may lead us to salvation or death. My darling, I shall never forget you. Yours, Lothar."

A road, a road to salvation or death. Prince Lothar may still be alive.

On a nearby sapling you spotted a clay tablet bearing an inscription. "Stranger reading these words, listen: beyond this hellish vortex lurks evil, greater evil than you can possibly imagine. This evil was sealed here many centuries ago. 
"Pah, I have a great army." With these words, you set off towards the black gate.

All is lost. The evil will find its way to allies who will serve it; there is no doubt of that. Just as the seer Maxira foretold. "And the evil shall be set free. It shall sow hatred and malice. Many allies shall join it, and many allies shall die. Then there shall be a battle. A battle such as the world has never seen. A battle in which even death may be a longed-for release. Then peace shall reign for many years."
map.[sod] - bitva o poust herathar.heade:
A parched desert, endless dunes, billions of tons of sand, impassable crags, a merciless sun, dying vegetation and a harsh struggle for survival.
The Herathar Desert conceals a secret surpassing every wonder and every living thing. Many nations have chosen to fight to claim the secret for themselves.
map.[sod] - bitva o poust herathar.monst: "Halt, accursed one. Do not enter this cursed place. Eternal suffering and sorrow await you on this road. For centuries I have guarded the entrance to the underground reaches of the Herathar Desert. Thousands of miles beneath the surface lies the Secret. No one must uncover it, for that could upset the balance of the world. Leave. I have no choice: I must fight. But know this: the Secret must not be revealed.
I survived, and I am forced to enter the hellish vortex. One thing I know for certain: the Secret must not be revealed. More than the existence of the world itself is at stake.
Battle for the Black Forest

Author: Kuchars
Email: Kuchi.2.@seznam.cz

Write to me and send your thoughts on what you liked and what you would have done differently.
The Black Forest had never belonged to anyone. Rulers feared going to war over it, for ancient legends said it was cursed, and any mortal who disturbed its peace would die a slow and painful death. After many years, they took the risk and attacked. {But the forest awoke...........}

Day 6: No, not everyone is dead. I do not know where I am. Help. Our ship was destroyed. I barely survived. I fled. It is dreadful. Dreadful. Help. Where am I?
map.[sod] - bitva o schwarzwald.event.11:
The next page is scrawled and very hard to understand. The man must have written it in fear and haste.

Day: They are after me. I do not know who, but they are after me. It is terribly cold here. Cold. fd. Help. They are everywhere. I am running along some path. In the morning, if I survive, I shall head southeast. Help. Prov.
map.[sod] - bitva o schwarzwald.event.12: The final entry is scrawled and stained with blood. The only words he managed to write are Curse and Death.
map.[sod] - bitva o schwarzwald.event.14: Resources are disappearing more and more often.
The rulers have forgotten the forest’s ancient curse and are rushing into battle against one another. All the forest’s inhabitants have set out to defend it with their lives. The curse endures, and in the end all shall succumb to it. Only the strongest, wisest, most cunning and fearless can change the course of the war for possession of the Black Forest.
Good luck, brave heroes, for I promise you will need plenty of it.
After arriving and building your castles, you must send spies to every corner of the forest to find out what is happening. It will cost you something.
After nightfall, word reaches your chamber that the spies have returned. You immediately go to greet them, only to discover that just one has returned, in a wretched state.
He says darkness rules the forest. The forest has awakened, the forest has awakened. All the forest creatures have gone to war against us. Finally, he hands you a book, repeats that the forest has awakened, and dies.
You take the book, climb into your bed and begin to read.

Day 1: I do not know why the king sent us here, but it is certainly worth it for such good money. This place does not look cursed. It is pleasant, even beautifully cosy. We are heading for a small river somewhere to the east.
Tonight you took the book again and began to read.

Day 2: We made camp on the edge of a farm. We thought it best not to go inside. The night was very strange, though. I felt as if someone was watching us, and it was not just one person. There must have been several. Tomorrow we shall march southeast to reach the river before evening.

You do not want to read any further. You close the book and fall asleep.
Something compelled you to open the book and read the next day’s entry.

Day 3: We have finally reached the river. It is a lovely little stream. We shall make camp here. One thing still troubles me. Someone is following us. The nights are growing very cold, and the soldiers are beginning to fear.
You want to read.

Day 4: We are building a boat and will sail south. These waters seem friendly. A man disappeared today. We do not know where he went or when it happened. It is most peculiar. I cannot wait to get out of this accursed forest.
During the night, someone killed the guards and broke into the castle. They emptied the entire treasury and stole some supplies as well.
