                               Says a note beside the table
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.quest.76.47.0.n: Nothing yet? I'm sure you will find the Vial of Lifeblood soon. Please keep looking.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.quest.85.68.0.f: I was carrying my savings to the bank when some nagas jumped out at me, saying the state needed money for IPB. Destroy them and bring me my money.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.3.105.0.me: The Unnamed One lives here. If you want something from him, ring 2x. Otherwise, may the Lord protect you. (I don't know, God in hell? - Sniper)
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.4.105.1.me:
Town for sale!
Proclaims an old sign. Well, in my opinion, no one will buy it...
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.50.37.0.me: Here lies the map's author. He wanted to seize power wherever he went, but someone talked him out of it with a sword.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.50.39.0.me: Here rests Sandro, a mighty necromancer who wanted more than he could handle.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.50.41.0.me: Here lies Santiago the alchemist. He died of sarin poisoning.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.50.43.0.me: "Sleep well, and I shall rest in peace," reads the damaged inscription on the sign.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.53.37.0.me: Here lies the "KillSix" project, which was supposed to consist of 12 maps. And it rests in peace.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.53.39.0.me: Here lies Rudolf Ingerof. He died alone and abandoned.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.53.43.0.me: Here lies Lord Emílio. He overdosed on cocoa.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.56.37.0.me: Here lies Father Frost. He died alone and was replaced by Santa Claus.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.56.39.0.me: Here rests an unknown soldier. He fell for a better world.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.56.41.0.me: Here lies Lord Michael. His desecrated body is the last reminder of the horrors of past years in Green Land.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.56.43.0.me: Here rests the king of thieves. He was treacherously slain by an unknown assassin.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.59.39.0.me: "H*re lies th* man who w*nted a be*t*r wo*ld," reads a sign that has seen better days.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.59.41.0.me: Here lies one of those famous titans. His treasure is out at sea beyond the cemetery.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.59.43.0.me: Here rests Sir Ayana. He died heroically over a bottle of wine.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.74.102.0.m:
The Citadel of the Sun once stood here.
It is now being rebuilt.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.74.81.0.me: JelouStone Castle stood here until the Unnamed One came.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.sign.93.97.0.me:
Welcome to Castle Ike.
Welcome to Castle Ike.
Look for a treasure chest.
Look for a treasure chest.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:1.town.21.49.0.ev: As the owner of ČSOB, you receive money from depositors.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.0.descrip:
Welcome, brave warrior. You have fought your way this far, and for that you have my admiration. But now to business. You are doing more harm than good in my kingdom, so I shall support your opponents with money and resources. Do not expect your battles against them to go as smoothly as the previous ones.
The king of these lands
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.1.descrip: The king gives money to your opponents
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.10.descri: Here you must fight your way to the entrance to the underground in the north. Find Hell underground and conquer it.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.2.descrip: Money and resources from your loyal followers.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.3.descrip: Incidentally, just as an aside: I have occupied the only harbour with my dragons, and I shall send a few more there every week.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.4.descrip: Computer, here is aid from King Duklamod.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.5.descrip: Igenot was supposed to arrive today, but he hasn't. Where could he be?
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.6.descrip: Since Igenot still hadn't arrived, you sent scouts, thieves and subversive elements to find him.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.7.descrip: After a week of searching, Igenot was found....
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.8.descrip: ...dead. But he had something on him.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.event.9.descrip: Today you buried Igenot and, filled with grief, prepared for battle, hoping at least to get home to your own time and space.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.guards.2.71.0.m: The end of the world is your end too!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.guards.44.2.0.m: Think you've got what it takes?
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.guards.45.5.0.m: Enter this territory at your own risk.
Do you want it? And will you fight an invincible army?
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.guards.47.3.1.m: Here you must fight dragons and strive to stay alive in this world.
If you manage to pull this out, write and tell me how. Your author
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.header.descript: Hell is here, home to the last working monolith. You must conquer it within 6 months, because then it will switch off and won't switch on again for 200 years (you understand, you won't live that long).
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.header.name: The End at Last
Don't go to the end of the world, or you'll regret it.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.heroes.118.biog: Inspector Gadget is a bungler, a lazy hero who does no work and lives off other people's fame.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.heroes.118.name: Inspector Gadget
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.heroes.142.biog: Iveta Kršková is a classmate of the map's author. So don't you go hurting her.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.heroes.142.name: Iveta Kršků
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.heroes.47.biogr: Zmrzlík is a good fellow. He will give his master his last gold, even if it is all he has. Not that he suffers from poverty. (For a few years he squirrelled money away in an account somewhere in Central America. That earned him something like 905000000 gold.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.heroes.47.name: Zmrzlík
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.heroes.84.biogr: This tyrant squeezes so much money out of others that he even gives some to charity.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.heroes.84.name: Local Tyrant
I am good, so I will help you.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.sign.6.68.0.mes: Travel to the very end of the world; the super-artifacts are worth it..
map.[sod] - cesta domu:2.sign.8.10.0.mes: A whirlpool has appeared near us. I hope we can avoid it. Ooooh, shit!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.event.0.descrip: Here you must discover the truth, which only the seer in the southeastern corner can tell you.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.1.2.0.me: Advice: The town is down the road to the south....
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.1.33.0.m: This stronghold would be useful to you, but it too has guards outside the castle.
They guard their gold too.
But this time a Gold Golem is guarding it.
You see a cart containing the remains of trees and environmentalists called "friends of the forest"
There are thousands of us workers in this land, but only we will fight you!
"A bag full of fruit," reads the label on the sack. 
Opening it, you discover that the fruit has turned rather yellow.
You see workers busily going about their work.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.15.2.0.m:
You see a ring that might come in handy....
but it is guarded (heavily).
You see a cart full of ore. But union leaders are pulling it, looking so tight-fisted you couldn't squeeze a dollar out of them.....
Do you want to fight them for the cart?
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.2.13.0.m: Since you didn't listen, the {thieves} will now teach you to heed good advice.......
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.2.5.0.me: Did you give the seer 10 Arch Devils? If so, fighting will be harder for you now.....
I wouldn't walk along the river....
A hundred sulfur guarded by a single rusty fellow.
You found a smelly ring in a Rust Dragon's nose. Do you want to cut it out?
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.3.19.0.m: The dragon probably got his supplies here when he had nothing to eat.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.3.34.0.m: You spot some deserting soldiers. When you call to them, they come over and join you, saying: "Overseer Smith (a {Grand Elf}) won't give us a moment's rest, so we decided to desert."
You found the treasure of treasures!







April Fool!!
You are at three wells in the sea.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.4.13.0.m: I wouldn't go near the thieves.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.4.23.0.m: So you felt like training at the fortress. Well, I train through combat.....
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.4.50.0.m: In case there aren't enough, here are a few more.
The souls of the dead have found no peace.....
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.5.19.0.m:
As you tried to take the crystals, a Crystal Dragon spotted you.
Do you want to fight it?
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.5.3.0.me:
You spotted a vial of mercury.
It will cost you your life!!!
You see Edd's scrapyard. He collects abandoned ships and then sells their contents.
Here's what you bought. But you also have to fight. :))
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.6.19.0.m: If I were you, I'd avoid that dragon (but there are 100 crystals there).
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.6.25.0.m: Please go to the sign and read it.
You see peasants attacking a dragon, but then you notice that the dragon is your friend.
When you had gone a little way, dying screams echoed across the land as the guard sacrificed what you had brought him.
This will probably be your last battle....
But will you win? Or lose?
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.guards.8.20.0.m: You see dwarves and unicorns. As you approach, they tell you not to go to the mine.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.header.descript:
You don't know where you are or what you're doing here. Perhaps fate will be merciful and you will survive.
You can advance to level 20.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.header.name: The Beginning of the End
They say the treasure is by three wells in the sea.
Don't trust the gremlin on the island. He guards the treasure of treasures!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.154.biog: The Seeress predicted your arrival, but also that she would lose her head at your hands....
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.154.name: Seeress
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.155.biog: Hellfiend terrorised the surrounding lands until he was caught. He still inspires such fear that most people will not let you pass while he lives.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.155.name: Hellfiend
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.31.biogr:
What's He Doing Here is a stupid name, but I couldn't think of anything cleverer.
His story:
WHDH got his name because his parents had only expected a daughter, but WHDH was born too. It turned out he had a way with pegasi....

WHDH-What's He Doing Here
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.31.name: What's He Doing Here
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.38.biogr: After seducing Juri, Veronika turned to alchemy. Even so, she retains her reputation as a necromancer.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.38.name: Veronika
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.56.biogr:
Vláďa attends Primary School No. 2 in Jirkov and looks remarkably like the portrait (!REALLY!).
If you want to meet him, he lives in Boleboř near Jirkov.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.56.name: Vláďa Bihari
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.62.biogr: The Horned One has been trying to tear off his horns ever since he impaled his beloved necromancer on them.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.62.name: Horned One
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.63.biogr: An error in space-time teleported Alexej here.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.63.name: Alexej
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.74.biogr:
Saša is a distant relative of Yuri and Sniper......
His necromantic leanings went so far that he reanimated his own dog.
And his 1st aid often turns out to be the last :-))))
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.heroes.74.name: Saša
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.monster.11.20.0: We won't give you the mine, because then our Master Gremlin would have nothing to make our brothers from...
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.monster.14.36.0: You shouldn't have disturbed us at work. Now you'll pay.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.monster.26.64.0: That sulfur gets stuck between my teeth. I'll have to change my diet.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.monster.31.56.0:
You see, these are the last shipyards left here, and we spent the last of our savings on them, so you'll agree we can't give them away. Well, perhaps for 1000000 gold.
That #@$%$%(pi*sed) you off so much that you separated their commander's head from his body with your nail file (meaning your sword). The others didn't like that, so they attacked you.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.monster.35.15.0: Leave this island. There's nothing here!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.monster.44.27.0: Our ship sank, and now we're waiting here to be rescued! (they're on lava, so they aren't suffering from the cold)
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.monster.44.28.0: Our ship sank, and now we're freezing here!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.monster.45.28.0: You must have come by ship, which means that if we kill you, we get a ship.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.monster.45.29.0: Our ship sank, and now we're freezing here!
We defend the monument to our fallen brothers, sisters and environmentalists called "friends of nature". 
(Anyone who didn't pick up the cart of wood won't understand)
That mine is dangerous, so we're going with you.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.4.3.0.com: Here is an artifact to give to the seer in the southeastern corner.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.4.3.0.fir: I know why you're here. But nothing is free, so bring me 10 Arch Devils.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.4.3.0.nex:
You haven't got 10 Arch Devils?
Then you're out of luck.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.52.55.0.f:
I am Edd.
A ticket costs 3000. If you haven't got it, come back when you have.
And remember, favourable winds always blow at Edd's!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.55.4.0.co: Alexej, do you want to pass?
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.55.4.0.fi: We've heard of Alexej, so only he may pass.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.55.4.0.ne: The guards insist that only Alexej may pass.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.56.2.1.co: Give it to us, and we'll let you through.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.56.2.1.fi: We don't want to risk Hellfiend escaping. So bring us the {Lion's} {Shield} {of Courage} (Lion's Shield of Courage), so we can be sure you have what it takes!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.56.2.1.ne: You haven't got the artifact. We won't let you through
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.57.59.0.f:
I want to build a house, but I need 10 wood and ore and 5000 gold.
I'll reward you for it. (1 Crystal Dragon)
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.57.59.0.n: No! I'm not giving you anything!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.58.1.1.co: You have the sword, but if you give it to me, I'll give you something too.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.58.1.1.fi: I want the Sword of Hellfire (Sword of hellfire), in case things don't work out for you.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.58.1.1.ne: I won't give you anything until I'm sure.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.58.54.0.c: At last! Give me 50 gems and 50000 gold, and in exchange I'll give you...
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.58.54.0.f: I have goods for you, but you must give me 50 gems and 50000 gold
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.58.56.0.f: I want 50 thousand gold, or I won't let you through!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.58.56.0.n: Since you don't have the required 50000 gold, the guards will not let you pass.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.58.61.0.f:
Would you like to learn something that will help on your sea voyages?
But it'll cost 6000.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.59.58.0.c: Here is your reward, if you give me that dragon.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.59.58.0.f: I want crystals, but I want a constant supply, so bring me 1 Crystal Dragon.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.59.58.0.n:
Haven't got it?
I'm not giving you anything!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.59.59.0.c: At last! Give me 450 sulfur, 100 gems and 10000 gold, and in exchange I'll give you...
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.59.59.0.f: We have the Angelic Alliance (Angelic Alliance) here for 10000 gold, 100 gems and some sulfur.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.59.59.0.n: Oh no! That's not enough. I need 45 sulfur, 100 gems and 10000 gold. I won't give you the artifact for what you have.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.61.56.0.f:
You gave my companions plenty of resources, but I want at least a pittance
from Red for what I give him.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.61.56.0.n: Haven't got it? Then you get nothing!
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.62.36.0.c:
You have brought everything he asked for.
Will you give it to him?
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.62.36.0.f: I'd like to sacrifice 20 Pikemen, 200 Centaurs and 200 Peasants, but I've run out. Bring them to me, and I'll let you through.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.62.36.0.n:
Boooooo!
I can't even sacrifice a measly 20 Pikemen, 200 Centaurs and 200 Peasants.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.67.54.0.c: You have Hellfiend's head, so the threat has passed. Do you wish to pass now?
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.67.54.0.f: Hellfiend passed through here recently. We won't let you through until we have his head.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.67.54.0.n: The guards are still afraid of Hellfiend, so they refuse to open the gate.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.72.71.0.c: The truth is that I was trying to get a strange machine working. Unfortunately, your teleportation overloaded and destroyed it. Here is an orb that will get the strange machine working.
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.72.71.0.f:
You're a man from the future, aren't you? I don't believe you, but I will if you're Alexej 
and have the {Crest of Valor} artifact
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.quest.72.71.0.n: I don't believe you, but I will if you're Alexej and have the {Crest of Valor} artifact
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.sign.2.69.1.mes:
Hellfiend's secret stronghold.
If you've discovered it, you're looking through the Editor (oh, shame on you..)
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.sign.3.26.0.mes:
The town of Alkagrib has stood here since time immemorial.
A cultural monument: please do not demolish, destroy or simply capture it.
             Thank you-Overseer Smith
map.[sod] - cesta domu:3.sign.51.48.0.me:
We didn't see that iceberg.
                                       Titanic
I have bad news for you, my lord. Treasures and some gems have gone missing from our castle.
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 3.guards.1: This is far too good to get for free. Take it; 3000 Imps are waiting for you.
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 3.guards.3: This magical box contains 10 Titans. Whoever wants them must defeat the same number.
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 3.guards.6: We are Imps, and there are 1000 of us here. Anyone interested in seeing us????
Who wants to take on 50 Chaos Hydras??
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 3.guards.8: 20 Black Dragons and 200 Diamond Golems await. Will you enter????
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 3.guards.9: This box contains 50 TITANS. How about that!!!! But nobody gets them for nothing: there are 7000 Monks here. Will you enter????????
This magnificent sword is guarded by 150 Red Dragons.
Anyone interested in this splendid shield must defeat us 150 Behemoths. Enter if you dare.....
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 3.header.d: This map continues Way to glory 1 and 2. It is a little harder again, and to win you must defeat the hero "Clancy".
We're with you. Will you take us in?
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 3.sign.3.1: This rare artifact, owned by Diamond Golems, increases weekly growth of level 4 creatures by 3.
This is the land of a great wizard who has sworn to destroy anyone who enters......
This road leads to the only totem in the game. It will not be easy, however, as you must pass through hordes of infernal monsters.
This map is for those who take Heroes 3 very seriously. To win, you only need to kill the hero Damacon, but you'll soon have to kill all the others anyway, or you'll never reach him. I recommend fully upgrading every town you acquire, especially Castles. Otherwise, death awaits...
This map is one of my very first creations, so don't judge its quality too harshly. It was made for my brother, who plays no other maps!
Author: Firebird
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.guards.1:
What could be hidden in this box? Who knows?
Hujer raises his hand... 100 Griffins! Excellent, Hujer!
You will receive a great reward for this artifact, but first you must defeat 50 Red Dragons.
This must be just what you're looking for. Well, I'm afraid you'll be disappointed: we're still here...
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.guards.3: Cavaliers now wish to join you...
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.guards.6: We won't give it up. You'll have to take it...
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.guards.7: Who is brave enough to dare?
Who wants a great gift from the person who wants this artifact?
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.guards.8: Passing through the gorge, you met a group of pikemen who offered their services. Will you accept?
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.guards.9: The hydras want these boots of movement too!
Anyone who wants 5 Angels must fight through 10 Devils.
The wyverns want this magnificent bow too!
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.header.d: This is the latest map in the Way to Glory series. It is made a little differently from the previous maps, but the difficulty remains the same. As usual, you only need to kill the hero Damacon, who is very well hidden.
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.sign.102: You are heading in the right direction for the castle of the knight Arakes.
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.sign.116: This is the castle of the renegade knight Arakes. He was refused admission to the knights' guild, so he fortified himself here and lets no one near him.
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.sign.117: There is a great surprise here..........
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.sign.129: You need to use a certain spell...
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.sign.139: ... What did you expect? If there were something everywhere, it wouldn't be the same...
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.sign.141: Welcome, stranger. If you value your life... run!
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.sign.143: What do you expect? Something at the end of every road?
Arakes's allies have settled on this island, so beware of them. It would be better to stay away, but there's no helping it: you must go there.
This tent is very important, which is why it is well guarded. Don't go there without a proper army...
Only the red player may enter.
This magnificent sword and shield are truly powerful artifacts. But 200 Titans have their eye on them too (half on each).
Send your thoughts on this map to

           dvorakp@nemji.cz

Now give it your best.
Are you really ready to attack? As you wish, but it won't be easy!
Actually, I wouldn't even recommend coming here, but unfortunately you must.
map.[sod] - cesta k vítezství 4.sign.7.2: If you're looking for information on Heroes 3 and everything related to it, try     web.telecom.cz/gremlin
I recommend saving often. Anyone who doesn't will soon discover why. / Isn't that right, Gremlin? /
This is the only totem on the map. The problem is reaching it.
Greetings to everyone playing this map, especially Gremlin, Kal_Kal, Hidden, Loner and Cedic.
I'm really glad you're playing it.
We are now in a land ruled by gold dragons, who let no one pass. Everyone tries to get there however they can. They say the edge of the land is there, but until someone reaches it, nobody can know...
Dracon arrives in the land, deeply unhappy with his former reckless slaughter of dragons.
"I won't be so foolish this time. Let's see how things develop. I'll gather dragons and win them over to my side. That will be better.
There should be something at the edge, and I'd like to know what it is," said Dracon.

Battle number 2. — You took the harder road.
Battle number 2. — You took the easier road.

Look, angels and archangels engrossed in a long conversation. How about interrupting them? That's not a bad idea at all.
A journey through portals awaits, where you will test your skills and gather more little dragons.
"I don't like lava; I can't stand it. The going is rough, and the horses sink into red-hot slag that even a dog wouldn't tread on," Dracon said to himself.
Damn, gorgons! I hope I can beat them.

Wonderful, more enemies. At least we'll get something out of it, even if it isn't a dragon.
Here you can recruit the last dragon you will need.

  1) You must not lose a single Gold Dragon during the game, or you won't be able to finish it.

This is my last creation for Heroes III. So, on with the game!

Hand over 5 Titans, and the Giant hatcheries are yours.
map.[sod] - cesta na okraj zeme.header.d:
We are now in a land ruled by gold dragons, who let no one pass. Everyone tries to get there however they can. They say the edge of the land is there, but until someone reaches it, nobody can know...

                                                                                    Niven

map.[sod] - cesta na okraj zeme.heroes.1: Many regard Dracon as a magical genius and the greatest dragon slayer in history. Unlike other wizards, he cast aside his ornate robes in favour of more practical battle attire.//Since then, however, Dracon has changed. He no longer slaughters dragons, having realised that it gains him nothing. "Why should I kill such beautiful, powerful creatures when I can make use of them?" he declared after killing the legendary Azure Dragon.
1 dragon is mine.
Just try turning us into mere claws. We won't give in!
Wraiths attack! Get them, and clear them out of our way!

"This is the end. This is what the edge of the world looks like," said the dragon.

"I'm the first to reach this place. Can you tell me more?" Dracon asked him.

"Of course. If, in the future, you bring a drop of my blood to a certain place, you will become a mighty dragon. But you have time; you won't manage it in this lifetime. Unless you find a portal to another world. (For us, that means Heroes IV.)" said the dragon.

"I won't give up now," said Dracon.
3 dragons, that's more like it.
Bulls that spit acid! Let's get them!
Get those wretches! All they can do is shoot, and they're good for nothing else, those miserable elves. Then we'll get dragons out of it, haha!
Boo! Don't let your eyes pop out at the dazzling beauty of the phoenixes' plumage.
Powerful artifacts don't come free.
We are at your service.
And so are we.
Us too.
Dracon, I serve you.
Defeat us, and two Gold Dragons are yours.

"The Hellstorm Helmet is ours, and we have no intention of giving it up," say the Diamond Golems.
"We'll see about that," said Dracon, already thinking about how to get rid of them.
Defeat us and prove yourself worthy of the first dragon, which you must obtain to continue.
There are many of us, so what are you waiting for?
We are yours.
Bones emerge from the ground, forming fearsome dead dragons. They bare their pointed teeth, ready to sink them into us.
"The purple tent isn't for every wretch who comes begging," said one of the dragons.

"Smack, smack, smack... What could that be?" Dracon said to himself.
A moment later, he hears footsteps pounding behind him. Unable to resist, he turns. Hordes of trolls are charging at him, wanting to eat him, camera and all.
Thank you. We are here to serve.
Soldiers, take your branches, legs and eyes, and go into battle.
You can get a Gold Dragon from one of the Pandora's Boxes, so keep looking.
Lava is disgusting, but travellers have no choice but to come here.

map.[sod] - cornel.event.10.description:
... entrusted his son with gathering an army and choosing a suitable commander. The task took Cornel by surprise, but he loved his father so much that he accepted without hesitation. He called the people to arms and sent many messengers to distant lands to find a warrior capable of leading his armies to war.

After weeks of waiting, with the armies of neighbouring lands already nearing the borders, only a handful of envoys returned, and even they had failed. The others had fallen into enemy hands and mostly died in agonising pain. Just as Cornel thought he would have to ...
map.[sod] - cornel.event.11.description:
... lead his armies himself, a woman suddenly appeared at the castle. She hardly looked like a warrior, yet claimed to be one. "My name is Shara," she said, telling the prince of the great wars and battles she had recently fought. Her land had eventually fallen to outsiders, but only because of the enemy's overwhelming numbers. Cornel ran to his father, overjoyed that he might have found the right commander, even if she was a woman. His father, by then thoroughly irritated with everything, drove him away, thinking he was making a fool of him.
  
The saddened prince gathered a few loyal warriors and rode off to parts unknown. The queen watched everything from a distance and finally gave the king a severe scolding for rewarding the prince's efforts by driving him away. Only then did Sarkin realise he had probably made a mistake, and he accepted Shara. After long discussions and strategic planning against the enemy, she could finally march to war. The battles ahead would certainly not be easy!
map.[sod] - cornel.event.12.description:
Shara knew that fighting the enemy was a matter of tactics, the art of war, the strength of an army and its morale. After Cornel disappeared to parts unknown, she therefore tried to find another warrior in her ranks to help her fight.
Repeating the motto "Two are better than one", she eventually chose the warrior Luna. She became Shara's lieutenant and was given a difficult task: to tame the dangerous elements in a castle in the east of the kingdom. Hopefully she would succeed. It would certainly be a great help in the war.
map.[sod] - cornel.event.15.description: You should know that the great infernal lord Xeronek himself, who secretly supports the enemy armies, has called upon the god of fire for aid. No one knows when his pleas will be answered, but the threat grows with every passing day. Once that happens, defeating him will certainly not be easy. Beware!

map.[sod] - cornel.event.4.description:
In a distant land where mornings are beautiful and evenings even more so, where the sun never sets and snow is unknown, King Sarkin lives with his wife Beatis. Their land is called the Kingdom of Eternal Youth. Twenty-five years ago, the royal couple had a son, Cornel.

Most neighbouring rulers envied their peaceful and, above all, loving life, for they were mostly ignorant misers. They joined forces — the one thing they were good at — and declared war on King Sarkin. But the king was already old and had practically no experience of warfare, so ...
map.[sod] - cornel.event.5.description: The war has lasted half a year. It is exhausting and bloody, and the fighting shows no sign of easing. Yet you do not lose heart, returning to battle time and again with faith that it must end someday.
map.[sod] - cornel.event.7.description: Shara rides through the kingdom with her army, whose skill in warfare is constantly improving. It will certainly be needed. So far, none of the neighbouring lands has attempted to invade our kingdom. Only now and then does she glimpse a suspicious fleet in the distance. If only it would stay that way.
map.[sod] - cornel.event.8.description:
What actually happened to the prince? Unfortunately, he was unlucky. After his father drove him away, he left the castle. But he had no intention of simply being pushed aside. With a handful of his most loyal followers, he set out to scout the borders himself.
Sadly, he fell into a trap laid by one of the kings. Despite his soldiers' best efforts, he could not get past the fortifications with which the enemy had blocked a pass on the island. The gate is locked, there is no other way out, and the key's whereabouts are unknown.
Shara will probably have to find the key, or the prince will remain imprisoned, his war over before it even began.
map.[sod] - cornel.event.9.description: Shara met many interesting people on her travels. One was a monk who told her of a land of eternal winter. A very cruel king supposedly lives there, whom the other lands have entrusted with leading the war. "Perhaps defeating him would be enough to make the others leave us alone," Shara thought. It also occurred to her that this king might have the key to free Cornel. We shall see.

Do you wish to fight a merciless battle for this artifact?
map.[sod] - cornel.guards.98.40.1.messag: You are sailing past the reefs. The storm seems to have passed, so you breathe a sigh of relief. Suddenly, you feel a slight bump and see a schooner emerge from behind a reef and pull alongside your ship. Several figures leap aboard and attack at once!
map.[sod] - cornel.guards.98.81.0.messag: "I don't know what happened, but the sight of this beautiful corner of the land made my heart race. It reminds me a little of home. And because I've been travelling so long, it's made me sentimental. But I'm not crying!" You look around and see a strange little house resembling a mushroom. What sort of building could it be? You have many questions, but no answers yet.
map.[sod] - cornel.guards.98.82.0.messag: You glimpsed an oasis in the distance. After a long, gruelling journey, the sight of a patch of green land is a great relief. With joy and anticipation, you ride between the rocks.
map.[sod] - cornel.guards.98.99.0.messag: You are very brave, and you fully deserve this Necklace of Ocean Guidance. Rumour has it, however, that combining this necklace with the hat of a long-forgotten admiral will work a small miracle. Nobody knows what kind, but there's a grain of truth in every rumour, isn't there?
map.[sod] - cornel.guards.99.103.0.messa: This very valuable armour is intended only for the valiant. Are you worthy to wear it?
map.[sod] - cornel.guards.99.17.1.messag: Suddenly, a ship emerged from the darkness, and several figures swung aboard. You recognise the band of pirates your friend warned you about. They attacked him in these waters too. It is time to put an end to their depredations!

I recommend setting the game difficulty to 200%, thank you.
Prince Cornel is in a difficult position. Neighbouring kingdoms have declared war on his father, and he has been tasked with gathering a powerful army. You are the king of a small kingdom and have few worries. Yesterday, however, a gravely wounded dragonslayer arrived in your town, the last of his trade. He warned you of two azure dragons he had failed to kill. They fled from mankind into the underworld, where they intend to breed and then attack the entire land. The dragonslayer breathed his last this morning. His trade died with him, and now the king himself must take up the fight — that means you.
So you went to consult your advisers. You learned that young azure dragons need nine months to grow and gain the strength of adults. That is exactly how long you have to find and destroy them before they destroy you.
As if one danger were not enough, another has appeared. Two enemies have shown up at the borders. One emerged from the underworld and wants to extend his territory to the surface. The other is an old friend of yours, who nevertheless wants to seize your kingdom to improve his own chances of success. You must therefore stay very alert while searching for the dragons, lest someone attack you from behind and destroy you. Good luck.
Only a single night remains before the dragons fly out of their hiding place and begin destroying the entire land. This is your last chance to find and destroy them before they release their young.

map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.event.0.des: {/This map is the first in a series set in the {world of Dragonlance.} {It takes place in Istar a few {hours before the city is driven into the ground by a {fiery {mountain. Karamon must fight his duel in the arena and {then free {Tas. The map does not follow the {story in Legends, volume 1. {Think of it {as a “what if”. The other maps will follow {the same approach. {My notes and jokes are marked with /.../ {and in yellow./}
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.event.1.des: {/I also ask all {Dragonlance fans for ideas on adapting {stories, including invented ones, to {HOMAM. Send your ideas {to {my email {address./}
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.event.2.des: Tasslefoff was caught trying to escape from the arena and locked in Karamon's cell. Meanwhile, Karamon regains consciousness at the arena entrance. He enters with the siren Kiiri, Feragas of Ergot and the Red Minotaur. As always, the giant Raag guards the only entrance. Karamon must reach Tas in the cell, and together they must stop his brother Raistlin from travelling through time. Their lives no longer matter...
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.event.3.des: ... Karamon speaks to Kiiri and Feragas: “Kiiri, Feragas, I don't know what that wizard told you, but I never betrayed you.” Kiiri and Feragas turned away, and tears began to roll down Karamon's face. “It doesn't really matter whether you believe me. You can kill one another over that key {/The Key {of Freedom opens the collars around the prisoners' necks. It is the key {to {freedom./} but I will find my own way to freedom.” Kiiri looked at him in disbelief. The crowd roars excitedly, shouting at the minotaur circling the arena. Kiiri answers Karamon: “You've gone mad. We have real weapons, you don't!” Karamon nodded but did not answer. “Don't do it!” Kiiri moved closer. “We'll help you get through the arena today. I don't think any of us believed that black-robed man. You must admit it looked strange when you tried to get us out of the city. We thought you wanted the reward all to yourself. Look, pretend you're badly hurt and let them carry you out. Tonight we'll help you escape...” “There will be no evening today,” Kramon said quietly. “I cannot explain anything to you; I have no time. I ask only one thing: do not try to stop me.” ...
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.event.4.des: ... Suddenly, everyone felt a tremor. The second one. It heralded destruction. A thought flashed through Karamon's mind: “I must get out of here. They no longer matter. I have only one goal: free Tas and stop Raistlin.” {/This passage was taken from Legends, {volume 1 — Time of the Twins./}
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.event.5.des:

map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.11.2: Here, on this ground consecrated by the Kingpriest, your abilities grow rapidly.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.14.3: Several attendants, driven mad with terror at the approaching catastrophe, attacked you.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.15.2: The only mage ever to fight in the arena died here in a duel. Since then, an impassable magical barrier has formed here.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.16.1: These are Feragas's and Kiiri's cells.
You see the arena crumbling. Beams are falling, and cracks are opening in the walls. No one here will live to see evening.
Several attendants, driven mad with terror at the approaching catastrophe, attacked you.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.20.1: Warriors sometimes come here to pray before battle.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.22.2: Ground dedicated to the four elements. The arena's first warrior died here. The priests' magic kept his skeleton intact, and Arak occasionally places an artifact inside it. Will he do so now? {/Unlikely, he's a real bastard./}
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.23.1: The Tower of Freedom. On it lies the key to the collar around your neck. You, however, must secure your freedom another way. WITH BLOOD!
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.30.6: “Where are you rushing, you empty-headed kender?” came what sounded like Flint's voice from somewhere. “Where do you think?” you think. “To try opening that door. I'm a kender, aren't I?” You search your pockets for a while and discover a dreadful truth: you have been robbed! {/A robbed {kender, now that's something!/} All your lockpicks are missing. You can only hope Karamon comes to free you.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.31.7: You search the cell for anything useful. Suddenly, three guards enter. “What are we doing here, eh? Not trying to escape, are you? Looks like you are, so prepare for a beating!”
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.32.7: “Look, Karamon left something here. I must return it at the first opportunity,” {/Oh, sure. {A kender returning something! /} you tell yourself, and the purse disappears into one of your pouches.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.34.1: Several attendants, driven mad with terror at the approaching catastrophe, attacked you.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.5.20: You hear a faint buzzing from the flowers on the right. What could it be? {/Certainly not a sprinkler./}
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.5.21: You have reached the office of Arak, the arena manager.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.6.17: The field of war and duels.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.6.19: Arak even grows flowers here. You are examining their species when several oversized dragonflies suddenly fly out of them.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.7.19: Arak keeps a beautiful sword here, far better than that toothpick from Kiiri. You pick it up and hear noises behind you. Turning, you see a crowd of arena attendants. “Where do you think you're going with that sword, eh? Put it down at once!”
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.guards.8.24: The muddy ground makes progress very difficult. Your enthusiasm for battle drops considerably.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.header.desc: Only a few hours remain before the catastrophe. Raistlin Majere is preparing a spell for travelling through time. Crysania is listening to the Kingpriest's drivel. Tas was supposed to be ready to prevent the catastrophe, but alas. When he tried to sneak out of the arena, he was caught and locked in Karamon's cell. Now it is up to Karamon to free him.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.header.name: Dragonlance — Arena of Istar
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.heroes.15.b: The kender Tasslehoff Barefoot disrupted Pár-Salian's time-travel spell, landing him and Karamon in the arena of Istar. Like every situation, he sees this as an interesting adventure, {/during which he can fill his three {pouches/}. Thanks to that, you need not worry about your finances.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.heroes.5.bi: Karamon Majere, a Hero of the Lance, is the brother of the archmage Raistlin. He married Tika Waylan and lives with her in Solace. Until recently, he was addicted to an alcoholic drink known as dwarven spirits. Only his stay in the arena of Istar cured his addiction, as the training there made a proper man of him. Together with the kender Tasslehoff Barefoot, he is trying to thwart Raistlin's plans to become a god.
Well done, Karamon! I see you made it. Now just kill that little runt Arak and hurry to Tas.

You may enter here only after defeating the Red Minotaur.
Only then can you settle accounts with that rat Arak.
The minotaur is still alive, so you cannot yet face Arak, who guards the stairs to the tunnels beneath the arena.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.quest.16.15: At last, Tas has sent a rat carrying a pouch of 100 gold coins. :-) You quickly hand them to the ruffians and run towards your cell.

Behind several fallen beams hide some ruffians earning a little extra here in the arena. Several aim bows at you and demand 100 gold. “Tas!” you shout. “Somehow get me the 100 gold I had under my bed!” You hope the kender heard you.
They are adamant, and there are too many to attack.
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.quest.21.12: Only someone with the keys may enter here, and that means Feragas alone.
Only Feragas may enter here. Didn't you understand?
map.[sod] - drg_arena istaru.quest.22.28: Only the Red Minotaur may enter here, so don't you come here at all.
Didn't you understand? Only the Red Minotaur may enter here, and that is not you.
Come in, Tasslehoff is waiting. If you have not yet visited Arak's office, go there immediately.
At last you may enter here, Karamon.
You insert the keys into the lock and enter Arak's office.
Here you need the keys you took from Arak's dead body. Otherwise, you cannot enter his office. And if you cannot enter the office, you cannot reach Tas in your cell either.
If you haven't killed Arak, how did you get here?
Not only is he stupid, he's CHEATING too! :)
Only its rightful owner, the siren Kiiri, may visit this cell. If you want to enter, hope she opens it for you — if she is still alive.
Now I understand why Raistlin wanted to kill you. You're just a mountain of meat with an empty head, as Flint would say. Run to Arak's office for the keys to your cell and stop gawking here.
Minotaur cells. Enter at your own risk.
Eight legendary nations wage war over this vast, rich land. Each has a legendary leader. If you find yours, your path to victory will be easier. Fight bravely!
map.[sod] - enroth.event.0.description:
Merchants have arrived in the harbour with interesting news. The island of Mist has
allegedly been attacked by pirates. Without hesitation, you send patrols to bring you
verified reports. You must pay them, however. They will report in two days.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.1.description:
On your travels, you met a dying mage. Before dying in your arms, he told you
a story of the orbs of magic. They can increase the effectiveness of their respective elements' magic. On the night of falling stars, however, their guardians hid them away for safekeeping. It is up to you to find and master them.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.10.description: Lord Stromgard attacks you from the west. You should therefore destroy him first. Expect attacks from the demons of Kriegspire to the south, and a fierce struggle for Free Haven. The island of Alamos lies to the east. Seizing it would be a good idea. Every seventh day, you will receive mooring fees from your harbour.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.12.description:
First, dispose of the necromancers of Darkmoor, or keep them firmly locked away. If you conquer the island of Mist to the east, you will become king of the seas.
As Enroth's rightful heir, you are entitled to taxes from its people. Expect
them every Wednesday.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.13.description: The collectors have brought the taxes
map.[sod] - enroth.event.14.description: You must break through the gates the Ironfists built against you as soon as possible. Your rightful wealth awaits you in a nearby tomb.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.15.description: Lady Fetsile's troops attacked your gold convoy and took everything.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.16.description: You attacked Lord Stromgard's gold convoy.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.17.description: The tide has destroyed your dykes. Unfortunately, this will happen again roughly every month.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.18.description: Catherine requests funds to wage war in Erathia. Naturally, you grant her request at once.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.19.description:
This map explores what would have happened if the adventurers' mission in M&M 6 had failed.
War is in full swing. Everyone is trying to become king of Enroth, each for different reasons. The map changes were not authorised by 3DO or NWC, but who cares? They are here anyway, so I at least apologise to die-hard M&M fans.
BILAJZ
map.[sod] - enroth.event.2.description:
While searching your library, you found a scroll about the orbs of magic. It confirms what the traveller told you. But you also found something interesting. The Tome of the Element
is bound to the orb by a powerful bond. It contains all spells
of the corresponding element. Only someone who has mastered the Orb of the Element can obtain the tome.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.20.description: Deserters from Catherine's army attacked your convoy from the mine.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.21.description: In retaliation, you attacked the disputed territory along your borders and successfully plundered it.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.22.description: An unknown enemy attacked your border and raided its inhabitants. They appear to have been Lord Stormgard's troops.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.23.description: A report from your aerial patrols confirms that there are indeed deserters from Queen Catherine's army on Mist. They have declared the island their domain and even fortified it. Isn't this the perfect time to plunder and seize Mist? (Diplomatically, this is called annexation.)
map.[sod] - enroth.event.24.description:
Author: BILAJZ
Tester: Patrick
Published by: Kalkal
E-male (email, for the sticklers): bilek.rs@cmail.cz (long live Contactel)
map.[sod] - enroth.event.25.description: A volcanic eruption destroyed your important mining village. You must spend considerable resources repairing it. Unfortunately, the volcano has not settled down, and you never know when it will erupt again.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.3.description:
Your scouts searching for enemy armies have informed you
that they overheard several mages talking. They spoke of an orb their brothers had just brought to the Valley of the Mages. This is clear evidence that the orbs still
exist. You immediately send scouts to gather more information.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.4.description:
Your scouts bring good news. The Orb of Fire is on your estate. It is
guarded, however. It lies in the mountains above the university.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.5.description: More excellent news. Your arch-enemy Lord Stromgard has the Orb of Fire in his territory. That should spur you to greater efforts in the war against him.
map.[sod] - enroth.event.6.description:
Your foremost task is to destroy the combined forces of Lady Fetsile and Lord Stone.
The demons of Kriegspire to the south also threaten you. First, however, try to conquer
and occupy Silver Cove. Every sixth day, you will receive border tolls. (You have to tax those skiers somehow, don't you?)
map.[sod] - enroth.event.8.description: You have established a foothold in Kriegspire. From here, you can invade every corner of Enroth. Your best course would be to seize Free Haven and launch raids throughout Enroth from there. Every fifth day, a shipment of resources will arrive from hell.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.0.67.0.message: This is a telescope, but not the one the seer wants. As one of the servants told you, his was sold to pirates in Smugglers' Cove.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.1.67.0.message: Having mastered the orb, mastering the tome is a trifle.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.1.68.0.message:
Incredible! One of the four orbs of magic! It rests on a heavenly pedestal and is filled with air magic. Unfortunately, you cannot control it, so
its guardians attack you. FIGHT! Fight for the power of AIR!
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.1.85.0.message: The mages used this landscape for experiments. That is why it resembles a gateway to hell.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.103.131.0.mess: This orb is guarded by genies summoned by those heaps of bones with wands.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.103.132.0.mess: Here is the strongest of all the orbs of antimagic. When you use it, no one can harm you or your warriors with a spell, even a mere sparkler.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.103.135.0.mess: Not only does it stink horribly here, but those skeletons with wands have drained all your mana and turned it into genies. Well, not everything goes exactly to plan, especially when your brain is getting a draught... or what's left of it. :)
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.104.131.0.mess:
One of the best artifacts against dragons. This orb absorbs their immunity
to magic, making them vulnerable to spells. (Do not use
together with Armageddon.)
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.11.49.1.messag:
A surprisingly well-maintained road runs around the cracked ground.
You look where it leads and see what you seek: the titans' Cloud Temples.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.113.129.0.mess: ... They now guard three orbs of antimagic here. Prepare for a great battle. The old mages will not be defeated easily.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.114.127.0.mess:
You have reached an island marked on no map and spoken of only in whispers in legends. It is said that the mages hid and guard three orbs of antimagic here, created as counterparts to the elemental orbs. With great difficulty, the mages obtained them
and placed them on this island...
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.114.128.0.mess: ... Only the greatest mages could guard them, but apart from a few exceptions, they were already dead. And so came the event that keeps this legend shrouded in secrecy and drives mages mad when they hear it. The mages of that time allied with the necromancers of Darkmoor, who called the old sorcerers back to (un)life...
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.117.92.0.messa: You ride into one of the most fertile regions in all Enroth.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.119.69.0.messa:
You sail into Enroth's largest harbour, on the largest island
of the Misty Islands. Welcome, and follow the buoys to avoid rocks and reefs.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.12.0.0.message: Having mastered the Orb of Earth, you easily command the tome's guardians to reveal its secrets.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.12.72.0.messag: The last artifact, at last. Now the whole world will fear you.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.13.0.0.message: This is the orb of earth magic. Your magical powers are too weak to master this mightiest orb of magic, however. You must FIGHT and show its guardians who commands the power of earth.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.13.20.0.messag: You discover a hidden path in the riverbed, running alongside the river and, above all, outside its current. Following it might be worthwhile.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.13.72.0.messag: Won't those lizards ever give it a rest?
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.14.72.0.messag: There is no way through without a fight.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.14.73.0.messag:
Do those overgrown lizards really think they can stop you?
Or am I mistaken?
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.14.74.0.messag:
This is the dragon crown, the rarest of all the grandmaster's artifacts.
Its guards are worthy of it.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.15.122.0.messa:
You have set foot on Hermit's Isle. One of the mages' former castles stands here.
Yet demons also emerged from here on the night of falling stars.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.15.123.0.messa: This is where your race of demons originated. The castle awaits its rightful ruler. The servants sense your arrival, and some join you.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.15.72.0.messag: They will not give up their grandmaster's dragon armour easily.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.15.73.0.messag: The dragons guard everything that once belonged to their master.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.15.74.0.messag: Those scaly beasts will give you nothing without a fight.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.17.59.0.messag: It seems the legend was true. Here is the entrance to the heart of Enroth. It is guarded, however.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.18.59.1.messag: You have entered the centre of Enroth. Follow the road to the teleporter, then on to the titans' birthplace.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.20.22.1.messag:
You are in the Cave of Water. It takes its name from Enroth's largest, and also
only, underground lake. Legend says the Tome of Water Magic should be hidden somewhere here.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.20.71.0.messag:
Following a hidden path through the muddy water, you come within sight of the place that gave this
part of Enroth its name: the Dragon Fortress. Scattered around it is the armour
of the dragon grandmaster Shohnug. Dragon guardians watch over it all and mercilessly
pursue anyone who attempts any wrongdoing here.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.21.7.0.message:
The road has led you to a pass where a small group of hydras has settled. It is unusual
for them to settle outside their nesting grounds.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.21.71.0.messag:
The road ends here, but you notice tracks leading west through the mud
towards the mountains.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.22.78.0.messag: Here the path emerges from the riverbed once more and continues south.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.23.102.0.messa:
Here stands a centre of learning that trained many successful
mages and warriors. Now, however, the monks have fortified it and allow no one onto their sacred ground.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.23.68.0.messag: The dragon grandmaster's treasure should be hidden somewhere here.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.24.103.0.messa: Another dwarven gate, this time before the dragon dwellings. Capture it and become master of the dragons.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.25.24.0.messag:
... Even the gate the Ironfists built there will not hold them much longer.
I fear they may already have taken it. In any case, you must stop them. Speak
with my brothers about what you might bring us in return for our stolen
artifacts.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.25.25.0.messag:
You arrive at the seers' settlement. Seers and scholars in green robes welcome you. Their leader takes you to his dwelling and says: “To the south lies the Valley of the Mages, where much of Enroth's magic is concentrated.
Lately, however, the mages have become increasingly aggressive and hostile...
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.29.30.0.messag:
You enter Paradise Valley, one of the strangest regions in the world.
Few have ever returned from it. Legend says the Valley of the Mages is hidden here, with many
treasures and relics. But it is said to be closely guarded by the mages who
live there. Visit the nearby seers' village to learn more.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.29.78.0.messag:
It seems Galmiel really was telling the truth. You see several vampires perched on
the seer's hut. Without hesitation, you order an attack.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.31.79.0.messag:
You see a beautiful woman locked in the prison. As you approach, she raises her head and
calls out: “Thank you for rescuing me. Evil wraiths imprisoned me here when
I tried to bring the seer a shield from the tomb. Help me, and we will share the profit.
The way to the seer is also guarded, so accept my help and that of my friends.”
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.33.57.0.messag:
You stand before the Maw, the largest cyclops settlement. It is said that
an underground passage leads from it to the very centre of Enroth, where the titans were born. If
you are brave enough, you can explore it. But remember, the cyclopes will not give up easily.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.35.77.0.messag:
Suddenly, wraiths and ghosts emerge from the pyramid. You have awakened them from eternal
sleep, and they seek revenge.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.36.79.0.messag:
Pieces of torn flesh and horse bridles lie beside the tomb. Suddenly, you feel nauseous and see the corpses beginning to rise. You lack the strength to move,
and your army is hardly eager to fight either.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.37.78.0.messag: This is the tomb of the dragon grandmaster Shohnug.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.38.22.0.messag: Here are their hatcheries. It is time to seize them.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.38.78.0.messag:
At last you stand before the tomb. A strange rustling comes from within. Suddenly,
something that was once a dragon charges at you.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.39.43.0.messag:
The gateway to Dragonsand is guarded by the dragons' greatest enemies: dwarves.
Their orders are to let no one in or out. To enter this terrifying land, you must defeat them.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.41.74.0.messag:
This place looks far from inviting. You sense your soldiers' unease.
Nevertheless, you order them onward. Your troops' morale
is not at its best now.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.5.64.0.message: Mages appearing from nowhere ambushed you.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.54.85.1.messag: The birthplace of the titans indeed! They all come from here, and you have a splendid opportunity to become their ruler.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.56.36.0.messag:
Here, at the crossroads, lies a ruined ancient bridge. You must repair it,
and it will not be cheap.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.56.89.1.messag:
Unbelievably, there is snow even down here underground. Magic must be involved. In any case, this change has cheered your soldiers and boosted their confidence
before the next battle.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.6.32.1.message: You see a pool ahead. At your command, a water elemental brings the Tome of Water Magic out of it. The power of water is yours.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.6.49.0.message: It seems the seer was telling the truth. The gate is occupied, and the mages will not surrender it easily. They have also quickly drained your mana reserves. This will be a hard battle.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.64.101.0.messa:
Here they harvest whatever will grow in the swamps. You will have to
fight for these resources, however, as the original inhabitants are reluctant
to surrender the fruits of their labour.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.64.79.0.messag:
The Ironfists built a gate here to protect against the undead. Your best course
is to leave its garrison in place.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.64.81.0.messag:
The Ironfists built a gate here against you, to keep you from expanding your domain.
But that will not deter you, will it?
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.64.95.0.messag:
Quarrying has left nothing of the trees here but dry, barren trunks.
So what, as long as you have something to mine. But beware! Greenpeace never sleeps,
and they have sent their friends against you.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.7.45.1.message: So this is what the titans have been guarding all this time. Look inside, if you dare.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.7.75.0.message:
Here is the entrance to the Valley of the Mages. To enter, you must defeat its guardians.
The mages have also drained most of your mana to create genies, who are now
attacking you.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.74.0.0.message: Magnificent! Here is one of magic's finest creations: the Orb of Fire, one of the four elemental orbs. Unfortunately, you lack the strength to master it. If its guardians destroy you, you will never enjoy it. So MASTER THE POWER OF FIRE!
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.74.30.0.messag: The dendroids were completely invisible among the trees. That made your surprise all the greater.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.75.0.0.message: You have mastered the Orb of Fire, so the tome's guardians obey your every word, and you obtain it without a fight.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.77.28.0.messag:
Dendroids and elven rangers guard the realm of Lady Fetsile and Lord Stone with true
mastery. A small group of dendroids surrounded you, and the elves' arrows
soon followed.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.78.67.0.messag: You return to your tomb, and some of your former subjects immediately join you.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.79.27.0.messag:
From a distance, you are watched by the keen eyes of elven rangers who guard this border
alongside the dendroids. You already received reinforcements in their village, but even so, a few
join you.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.79.72.0.messag:
You approached the tomb of Erik the Mad (that lunatic now building an army
down beyond the gates instead of being dead), and your army's spirits sank to nothing. On top of that, black armoured tin cans attacked you.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.8.33.1.message: You touch a beautiful dark-blue orb when something suddenly seizes you and tries to pull you inside. You must FIGHT forces as old as the world for mastery over water.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.80.26.0.messag: The elves and dendroids will not surrender their homes easily.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.81.78.0.messag:
A gate protecting against the undead of Darkmoor. Leave its garrison in place,
or hard times await you.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.81.80.0.messag: HA! Those wretched Ironfists think they can stop you with a hovel like this.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.83.24.0.messag:
Elven homes and several dendroid nests await you here, ready
for you to recruit reinforcements.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.85.71.0.messag: A fortress was built here to protect against the undead. Over time, however, spells drove the griffins mad, and now they hold their commanders prisoner here.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.85.8.0.message: War rages here, on the border between Frozen Highlands and Silver Cove.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.88.8.0.message: Not another step. There are behemoths here.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.89.8.0.message:
Another ruined bridge, and guarded as well. No wonder it has collapsed.
Little could withstand the behemoths roaming here.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.9.33.1.message: The legend was true. Here are the Tome of Water Magic and the Orb of Water.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.90.8.0.message: You would be a fool to continue.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.93.49.0.messag: Here lies a former mining colony. Who knows what happened here.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.94.8.0.message: War rages here, on the border between Frozen Highlands and Silver Cove.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.96.60.0.messag:
You have reached the thieves' leader. He is one of the former Erathian soldiers
who deserted before sailing to Erathia with Catherine Ironfist. He wears
a strange cloak that makes him very fast. If you want it, you must kill
not only him, but his guard of fellow wretches too.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.97.104.0.messa:
Here in the treasury, the dwarves keep the treasure they toiled and mined so hard to obtain.
Surely you wouldn't take it from those tiny, sweet little unfortunates?
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.97.60.0.messag: One of the renegade mages built a strange device. But the mages of the Valley of the Mages stole it from him and later sold it to these dealers. You find it buried beneath one of the latrines when you go to relieve yourself. What a stink!
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.98.60.0.messag:
Under the tent, you find a patch of clover. Most of it has withered, except for this
four-leaf clover.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.98.61.0.messag: They will not let you take what they stole.
map.[sod] - enroth.guards.99.96.0.messag:
In the distance, you spot several mountain dwarves. It is surprising they managed to survive
in such an inhospitable landscape. Suddenly, their leader shouts: “Halt, or
you die!”
map.[sod] - enroth.header.description: A year after King Ironfist's disappearance, chaos engulfed the land. The lords began warring among themselves, demons subjugated the Kriegspire region, the undead of Darkmoor rose under Eric the Mad, and deserters from Queen Catherine's army began ravaging the country. It is up to you to show who will be king.
map.[sod] - enroth.header.name: Enroth v2.0
map.[sod] - enroth.header.rumor.0.text: They say whoever controls Mist controls all maritime trade.
map.[sod] - enroth.header.rumor.1.text: Old legends tell of a place called the Maw, where cyclopes live. A passage is said to lead from there to the very centre of the earth, where titans are born.
map.[sod] - enroth.header.rumor.2.text: A volcanic island lies to the southwest. On it stands a gateway to hell, known as Hermit Castle.
map.[sod] - enroth.header.rumor.3.text: The Mire of the Damned can only be reached through two gates, guarded by the finest warriors the Ironfists can muster.
map.[sod] - enroth.header.rumor.4.text: The dragon grandmaster's tomb lies in an area of strong positive magic somewhere in Dragonsand.
map.[sod] - enroth.header.rumor.5.text: Grandmaster Shohnug's dragons guard all his equipment somewhere in western Dragonsand.
map.[sod] - enroth.header.rumor.6.text: If you obtain all the tomes of magic and become an expert in their elements, you will be an invincible mage.
map.[sod] - enroth.header.rumor.7.text: I wonder how Queen Catherine's restoration of Erathia is going.

map.[sod] - enroth.heroes.14.name: Talonisis

map.[sod] - enroth.heroes.49.name: Devil Baa
map.[sod] - enroth.heroes.78.name: Erik the Mad
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.103.133.0.mes: “Khrrr,” rasped one of the undead. “Finally, another fool who dared come here. I wonder what those bastards on the other side are doing.”
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.103.99.0.mess: You will not take our wealth cheaply.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.109.48.0.mess:
Water elementals are uncommon in the Misty Islands. But you are
unlucky enough to have encountered them right here.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.129.109.0.mes: Queen Catherine left a strong guard of her best men here, just in case. They recognise you and eagerly join you.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.131.25.0.mess: Here you breed pegasi, the mythical winged horses. The guards gladly let you in.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.15.0.0.messag: Of course, hydras guard the Orb of Earth here.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.2.68.0.messag: The mages certainly protect their artifacts thoroughly.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.20.101.0.mess: Ahhh, an adventurer at last. But you will have to pay for entry with your own blood.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.21.5.0.messag: These hydras, however, have settled far too close to their pond. You do not know why, but you sense a powerful magical aura here.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.3.63.0.messag: The way to the teleporter is open. BUT ONLY OVER OUR DEAD BODIES!
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.30.30.0.messa:
You stand on the edge of Paradise Valley. The entrance, however, is guarded by hydras, the valley's ancient
inhabitants.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.30.56.0.messa: No one shall enter our home!
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.32.42.0.messa: Kriegspire's original inhabitants took refuge here after you drove them out. Time to finish them off.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.35.6.0.messag: Harpies have occupied the Lake of Gems. They probably think you will like them wearing gems. Beauties, aren't they?
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.39.22.0.messa: You enter a region inhabited by harpies. These guard the pass leading to their hatcheries.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.41.73.0.messa: The tombs are guarded by the spirits of the dead from a nearby crypt. If you want to uncover their secrets, you must defeat them.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.48.34.0.messa:
Those harpies really are perverted. Someone tell them you can't sew an ar...
onto a face, so they should stop trying to pretty themselves up.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.54.28.0.messa:
The crossroads between White Cap and Kriegspire is guarded by medusas from the nearby
Temple of the Snake in the mountains.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.59.31.0.messa: Harpies from the nearby nesting grounds. Do they really think they'll be prettier?
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.61.105.0.mess: We are from Greenpeace, and now we'll show you that rainforests must not be destroyed.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.63.103.0.mess: Don't hurt us! We'll give you everything, just don't hurt us!
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.63.30.0.messa:
Harpies nesting in the Frozen Highlands flew across the mountains
and occupied this little lake of gems. They probably think those stones will make them prettier.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.66.43.0.messa:
Medusas from the nearby mountain chapel guard the crossroads
between Free Haven and Blackhire.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.71.31.0.messa: The local elves eagerly await you.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.72.70.0.messa: Strange. What do those stinking flying bloodsuckers need a gold mine for?
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.74.22.0.messa: Lady Fetsile's pegasi flew over the mountains and occupied the local sulfur mine. This insolence must be punished.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.74.81.0.messa: Troops loyal to House Ironfist have occupied this gate as well.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.84.20.0.messa:
Dendroids protect this mine from your enemies. They welcome you gladly, however,
and give you what they found around the mine.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.88.7.0.messag: Glory to Lord Stormgard and death to Stone!
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.88.9.0.messag: Lady Fetsile and Lord Stone hold their positions firmly. They must be destroyed.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.90.9.0.messag:
Ah, you are finally here. Our comrades have told you what is happening, then. Over there
are the advance patrols of Stormgard's army. At last we'll give them what they deserve.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.91.8.0.messag: Oh, my lord, thank goodness you are here. We cannot hold back the behemoths and Lord Stormgard's army much longer. Another group of our rangers is a little farther on; speak with them.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.95.106.0.mess: You plundered our village, and now you seek our mines. For that, you must die.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.96.66.0.messa:
These renegade orcs have lived here for several decades. In that time, they have created a paradise for dealers and thieves of every kind. No wonder this place is called Smugglers'
Cove. In any case, they will defend it by every means available.
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.99.103.0.mess: Kill them before they enslave us!
map.[sod] - enroth.monster.99.98.0.messa: You did not listen. Prepare to die.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.112.21.0.message: Welcome to the harbour arena. The harbour lies farther south.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.130.112.0.messag:
On a carefully made sign, which even has
metal-reinforced edges, someone has simply scrawled:
Our capital, Ironfist, lies to the north.
The harbour lies to the south.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.137.67.0.message:
The sign's original inscription is illegible. But fresh writing reads:
“Mist is ours, not the Ironfists'!” A griffin skull hangs below it.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.138.3.1.message: You'd like to get here, wouldn't you? No chance, close the editor and go play!
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.20.35.0.message: The Cave of Water lies in the mountains.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.29.102.0.message: King Ironfist's libraries will remain closed until he is found.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.41.70.0.message: You read the sign: “The tombs are haunted. Enter at your own risk.”
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.6.47.0.message: Valley of the Mages. By invitation only.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.61.46.0.message:
Blackhire lies to the west, Free Haven to the east. Follow the road south
to reach Lord Temper's castle.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.65.98.0.message: The west and north signposts point towards the quarries; the south signpost points towards the sawmills.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.70.32.0.message: North to Silver Cove, south to Free Haven.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.80.72.0.message: Follow the riverbed upstream to Erik the Mad's tomb. Only necrophiliacs, necromancers and lunatics enter without fear.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.85.105.0.message:
“Things look bad for us. I hope we survive. The wind is
driving us onto the reefs. Oh God, a great wave is coming at u...” So ends the remains of an unknown sailor's diary.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.88.21.0.message: Welcome to the lands of Lady Fetsile and Lord Stone.
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.92.8.0.message: Lord Stromgard's territory lies farther west. Entry by special permit only!
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.93.67.0.message:
Something is written on the board, but someone took pains to destroy the inscription.
Still, with a little imagination, you manage to decipher something:
C...VE OF THOSE SH..TH..DS
map.[sod] - enroth.sign.97.91.0.message: On a piece of wood, you read: “Dwarven mines and villages to the south.”
map.[sod] - enroth.town.11.12.0.name: Sweet Water
map.[sod] - enroth.town.128.96.0.name: Ironfist
