map.[sod] - erathia.event.0.description: This map attempts to continue the story of HoM&M 3 and M&M 7. If you have not played them, which I doubt, play them, or at least watch all the cinematics in Heroes. I know cheating is naughty, but sometimes it comes in handy. The story of M&M 7 is important here too. Since it branches in two directions, however, only the events of the good path are described, up to the destruction of Xenofax. So there are no aliens. One small note: do not compare this map to Enroth, which offered an entirely different perspective. Unfortunately, some things could not be done as I intended, so do not be surprised by minor inconsistencies. I hope you enjoy the map and that it is more successful than Enroth, or at least the Arena. But enough talk; here is the story.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.1.description: You must not lose Gem, Gelu or Coronius. Only Gem and Coronius can open the border gates in Nighon and the Pit. If you lose Gelu, you lose the entire scenario. I also added a special victory condition afterwards to make things less simple. The problem is that it has not been tested. If complications arise, contact me. Have fun!
map.[sod] - erathia.event.10.description: But let us return to the present. Your situation is far from rosy. Nighon's armies attack from the south, advancing on the capital, Harmondale. Their numbers are unimaginable. Meanwhile, the necromancer Sandro marches on Steadwick from the north, collecting new helpers from graveyards along the way. He is said to wield the Cloak of the Undead King and the Armor of the Damned once more. Now you have no choice but to retreat behind AvLee's borders, fortify against raids and begin gathering forces for a counterattack. Word has come from Bracada that its wizards will help you. They know well that if AvLee and the Erathian Province fall, they will be next.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.11.description: As you can see, you are perfectly trapped. In a single day, you lost all of northern Erathia, and the subjugation of the remaining territory is only a matter of time. Thank goodness you believed the angels' warning, secured at least the border gates in AvLee and warned most of the peasants to hide in time. If you lose, however, they will be safe nowhere. You should have realised what the unrest in Nighon and Deyja meant. That was why you went to Steadwick to consult General Kendal. Yesterday morning, however, a tremendous roar woke you, and you saw a vast army approaching from the south. Moments later, several riders on pegasi arrived and, with terror in their eyes, told you that an undead army was approaching Steadwick. It happened less than thirty hours ago, but it feels like an eternity. Further fragmentary reports say Lord Haart is attacking Tatalia. Coincidentally, an enormous army also marched north from Uglak, Krewlod's capital, in recent days. But one thing troubles you: the dragons did not come.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.12.description: It is far worse than you expected. The only fortified bastion left in Erathia is Riverstride Fortress, commanded by General Kendal. Perhaps even that has already fallen to the enemy. You wonder whether the Conflux heroes will appear again. But many accounts say the normally peaceful elementals are attacking anyone who approaches them. Something very strange is happening here.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.13.description: As you consider the situation, you realise it will take a very long time to gather an army as large as your opponents'. Moreover, a second wave has marched out of the Pit and Nighon, reportedly as strong as the first. Only one solution occurs to you: Armageddon's Blade. After defeating the Kreegans, you had an Erathian blacksmith melt it down and turn it into several fire artifacts. You then hid them in a cave in AvLee and placed them under guard. Yes, this might be a way to gain a slight advantage. But you must free the dragons as soon as possible, or at least retake Harmondale, where Dragon Cliffs can be built. Your hope is that Sandro and Mutare turn their attention to Tatalia and Krewlod.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.15.description: Now you realise the greatest mistake of your reign so far. You should never have negotiated with Deyja. Shortly after you ascended the Erathian throne, its envoy proposed buying worthless territory east of the Erathian Basin. If you would not sell it, they would take it by force. You desperately needed money, so you agreed. Only now do you realise Deyja gained what it had always needed: access to the sea!
map.[sod] - erathia.event.16.description: Reinforcements from the Pit have not yet arrived, and you decide to act. You send a large detachment of Forest Guard warriors to infiltrate Deyja, seize its mines and hold out until you arrive. As you give them their orders, you see firm resolve in their eyes. But you also see their awareness that they are marching to certain death.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.17.description: The nobility supports you financially once more.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.18.description: You release funds to establish a militia in Erathia.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.19.description: An unconfirmed report says a third wave set out from the Pit and Nighon around noon yesterday, intended to crush the last remnants of resistance. Grim news indeed.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.2.description:
The usual details:
Author: Bilajz
Testers: Patrick, Yokel, Saggi, Fantom, Dobi and others. There were quite a few, and that last one in particular still hasn't finished it. :-) Yokel managed a fairly respectable time, so I'm curious whether anyone will do better.
Published by: Kal-Kal, who else?
Email: bilajz@seznam.cz Ha, I finally got myself an address!
That really should be enough now. Onward to the continent of Antagarich!
map.[sod] - erathia.event.3.description: After the Kreegans were utterly destroyed, Cathrine Ironfist returned to Enroth with her husband Roland. After several years, General Morgan Kendal took charge once again. For two years, he searched in vain for a king. Meanwhile, the ruler of the elven kingdom died, and the lords began fighting for the throne. The people, however, chose the elven hero Gelu, supported by several prominent lords and, above all, heroes. Many nobles could not accept being ruled by some half-elf of common birth. But Gelu proved to be related to the late king, and despite their protests, he was crowned. This also averted a possible war between AvLee and Erathia. Two years after the Ironfists' departure, he was crowned king of Erathia as well, surprisingly without much difficulty. AvLee had prospered under his rule, and the Erathian lords saw an opportunity to enrich themselves. They imagined they could manipulate the new king as they pleased. They were mistaken. Without support from the army, loyal to General Kendal, who was the first to swear allegiance to the new ruler, they could not openly resist. So they attempted a ruse. They asked the lords of AvLee to organise an uprising and unleash civil war. But the elven nobility had by then recognised Gelu as the finest monarch ever to rule their realm, and immediately informed him of the plot. Gelu, already crowned as Gelu I, had expected something like this and prepared a plan. He sent a messenger to Enroth to describe the situation following his election to Queen Cathrine. For two months, the new kingdom was wracked by unrest. Then came a change. Cathrine and Roland sailed to Erathia and officially confirmed Gelu as king of both Erathia and AvLee. Cathrine also proposed a solution for those unwilling to live under elven rule. Roland had expanded his Enroth holdings westward and needed loyal inhabitants. They also brought a message from the elves of Silver Cove, asking the new king of AvLee for permission to return home. This solved the problem. The very next month, ships began departing for Enroth, while the immigrants were eagerly awaited. But many knights and priests who saw no future in Erathia also left with the human settlers. As a sign of his goodwill towards humans, Gelu moved the capital to Harmondale. It was a symbolic step, for the greatest battles had been fought over that very territory. 105 days after his election to the Erathian throne, the united kingdom of AvLee and the Erathian Province was officially founded. Everything pointed towards a peaceful life. Yet Antagarich consists of more than Erathia and AvLee; there are other states too. Here is a brief overview of what merchants and scribes travelling the continent recorded.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.4.description: The inhabitants of swampy Tatalia took a long time to recover from the attack by the dark knight Lord Haart. The witch Andra, the chief architect of victory, tried to unite the now divided country. But she was murdered. Her killer remains unknown, though Lord Markham, seeking to expand his influence, is believed to have been behind it. Fighting for the throne continued for several more weeks. Then, at Markham's invitation, Erathian border lords invaded Tatalia. They tried to annex it and supposedly “civilise” it, meaning exterminate all its nonhuman inhabitants. They would almost have succeeded, had Lord Markham himself not betrayed them. He drove the occupiers into the swamps and returned to the capital as a victor and hero. The people then elected him king.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.5.description: In barbarian Krewlod, the barbarian Kilgor took power after winning the Festival of Life. He had few enemies, having killed most of them during the festival. He quickly gathered an army and set out to show his Erathian neighbours who sat on Krewlod's throne. But an earthquake struck his army as it passed through a mountain pass, and he barely escaped back to Krewlod with a few loyal followers. All routes into Erathia were buried. The only remaining way led through Tatalia. Preparations for war began.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.6.description: In Bracada, after the death of Grand Vizier Magnus, the young, ambitious dragonslayer Dracon became ruler. Alone among the neighbouring rulers, he recognised Gelu's claim to the throne and publicly offered him all the aid of Bracada and Celeste. One day, however, panic erupted in Celeste. The angels, the city's ancient protectors, had vanished. They left only a message saying they were going to the Valley of Angels to prepare for the coming catastrophe. No one then knew what they meant. Everyone believed peace would last forever.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.7.description: Little news comes from Nighon. There is talk of a red dragon uniting the entire country and eliminating anyone in its path. Bracada sent its enchanters there, but they never returned. One day, a whole flight of black dragons was seen over Harmondale, heading for Deyja. Many swore a red one led them.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.8.description: If news from Nighon is scarce, even less comes from the land of the necromancers. All that is known is a power struggle between its former ruler, Archibald Ironfist, and a faction led by the lich Sandro, who has risen to prominence again. But one thing is certain: Lord Haart walks the world once more.
map.[sod] - erathia.event.9.description: There are several other inhabited regions too. For example, the dwarves of Stone City publicly confirmed their willingness to cooperate with the newly founded realm north of their home. In Eeofol, dragons nesting there are now locked in battle. So far, everything points to victory for the dragons of good. We also have one good piece of news from there: the demonic Kreegans have been destroyed for good. Not a single hero remains to gather an army.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.102.50.0.mess: Dragons at last, but they won't come free.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.104.76.1.mess: The inhabitants of the local tunnels begin crawling out of a nearby hole.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.105.65.1.mess: The inhabitants of the local tunnels begin crawling out of a nearby hole.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.107.125.1.mes: The inhabitants of the local tunnels begin crawling out of a nearby hole.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.11.113.1.mess: You enter the supreme temple of darkness. This will be far from pleasant.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.11.28.0.messa: You enter the home of the azure dragons. But they do not like anyone poking around their lairs.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.112.67.0.mess: You approach the mightiest artifact of the dragons of good. Suddenly, a vision of an old gold dragon appears before you. “Hurry!” it says, and you decide to obey.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.116.86.1.mess: The inhabitants of the local tunnels begin crawling out of a nearby hole.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.118.50.1.mess: The inhabitants of the local tunnels begin crawling out of a nearby hole.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.12.41.0.messa: Suddenly, Ciele's ghost appears before you and speaks: “Thank you, Gelu, for avenging my death. You must have wondered whether the Conflux heroes would again aid the people of Erathia and AvLee. But I must disappoint you. We will not come; we are all dead. Mutare forced her witches to use the Vial of Dragon Blood to control the elementals. They then destroyed their rulers. No one survived.” The water lady's spirit fades away, and you realise winning this war will be harder than you expected.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.123.70.1.mess: The inhabitants of the local tunnels begin crawling out of a nearby hole.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.128.73.0.mess: The rust dragons have amassed treasures from the mines here. Do you dare take their wealth?
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.129.96.1.mess: The inhabitants of the local tunnels begin crawling out of a nearby hole.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.13.14.1.messa: The final battle draws near. The necromancers have thrown everything they had against you. Now destroy the last remnants of resistance. You raise your sword and cry: “For AvLee, Erathia and Enroth! For Cathrine and Roland!” Your heartened soldiers reply: “And for King Gelu!”
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.137.36.0.mess: The signet ring that sealed the treaty granting Emerald Island independence rests peacefully in a display case in the mayor's room. You wonder whether the mayor knew of its magical power. As you pick it up, the soldiers behind you suddenly form up for battle. The locals have decided to avenge their mayor's death.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.142.90.1.mess: The inhabitants of the local tunnels begin crawling out of a nearby hole.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.32.64.1.messa: Choose your path here. One is the lesser evil.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.36.66.0.messa: Before you lies Tatalia's fortified border. It is now most likely controlled by Lord Haart's followers, however, and thus belongs to the necromancers.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.48.65.1.messa: You have made it through the traps of the Hallways of the Pit. But that was only the beginning. You have just entered the Pit.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.52.30.1.messa: At last you reach the fire artifacts. Only one man, an Erathian blacksmith, can forge them into Armageddon's Blade. You slowly reach for the first when the spirit of the infernal Xeron appears before you. “So, Gelu, you think you can command fire? Let us see how you fare against your former allies.” The surrounding flames suddenly begin taking the shapes of birds.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.55.29.1.messa: The deeper you venture into the cave, the more unbearable the heat becomes. You are already hallucinating from it. You see flocks of fiery beings flying around your army. Suddenly, they attack, and you realise they are real.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.55.86.0.messa: You enter the region that once suffered most from raids by Krewlod's barbarian hordes. After a small earthquake buried every pass used by the barbarians, peasants settled here, and farming began to flourish rapidly. A few families who chose not to leave Erathia also remained. They now hail you as a liberator and, in gratitude, give you gifts to support the war effort. Your army also finds renewed resolve for the battles ahead.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.58.91.0.messa: This pass was opened only recently to ease access to Steadwick. Unfortunately, it is now guarded by the combined forces of Nighon and Deyja.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.59.50.0.messa: Many bands of undead roam Deyja. You were unlucky enough to encounter one of them.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.60.24.1.messa: You enter the Cave of Fire. After destroying the Kreegans, you had the dwarves excavate it as the best hiding place for Armageddon's Blade. Once cool and damp, the cave has become a blazing furnace under the influence of its components. Only with the greatest effort does your army continue towards its longed-for goal.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.60.76.0.messa: You emerge onto the open plain beyond the fortress and see something that takes your breath away. Several thousand undead march along the road from the capital. Flies swarm around them, and the stench is so foul that you begin to vomit. This battle will not be easy to win.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.62.53.0.messa: Many bands of undead roam Deyja. You were unlucky enough to encounter one of them.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.64.44.0.messa: Many bands of undead roam Deyja. You were unlucky enough to encounter one of them.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.64.76.0.messa: Looking out from Riverstride Fortress's battlements, you see an undead army surging towards Steadwick. Several regiments break away from the mass and head for the fortress. Yet their numbers are not so great. Hope begins to dawn within you. You quickly gather the garrisons of both gates and, with a battle cry, march out to meet death.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.65.51.0.messa: Here dwell the dark knights serving Deyja. The moment they see you, they raise the alarm. From their fortresses' courtyards comes the pounding of many iron-shod boots. You draw your sword and charge towards the first wave of attackers, shouting: “For AvLee!”
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.68.41.0.messa: Many bands of undead roam Deyja. You were unlucky enough to encounter one of them.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.68.76.0.messa: You begin to understand that your death is inevitable. Whichever way you look at the situation, you see only one end: death. But you decide to die as a knight, in battle. You quickly gather this gate's garrison and raise the Erathian Province's war banner, a griffin on green. Beside it, you unfurl another: the banner of Queen Cathrine and the former Kingdom of Erathia, a griffin on blue and white. “For Erathia I lived; for Erathia I shall fall!” you cry. A chorus answers: “For Erathia and Enroth! For Gelu and Cathrine!”
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.69.8.0.messag: Here, on AvLee's northernmost tip, stands a fortress inhabited by titans. For many years, they plagued the surrounding countryside. Now it is time to destroy them at last.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.7.107.0.messa: You have entered the angelic city of Celeste. There are no angels here today, as they are needed elsewhere. But Bracada's grand vizier, Dracon, master of Light Magic, still resides here. {/If you think {Celeste is in the water, {you are {damn well mistaken. {Can't you see the clouds around it? {There simply wasn't {a better way to do it.}
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.70.5.0.messag: During the long years the titans threatened the local people, they amassed great wealth. Now it belongs to you.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.74.42.0.messa: Many bands of undead roam Deyja. You were unlucky enough to encounter one of them.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.74.76.0.messa: The enemy already controls everything around the fortress. There is no way back. You must fight your way onward.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.75.39.0.messa: “So, Gelu, you have come this far? Excellent,” comes a voice from deep within the cave. You realise your plan to slip inside unnoticed has failed. “Yes, I have come this far, and I will go farther,” you reply timidly. “You are mistaken. You will end up like those around you. Just look at Bracada's once-mighty army.” Indeed, dead and mutilated bodies of enchanters and other servants of Grand Vizier Dracon lie everywhere. Suddenly, however, they begin to stir, and you prepare for battle. Somewhere in the distance, you hear laughter.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.76.44.1.messa: All around, voices cry: “Blood, warm blood! Meat!”
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.76.54.0.messa: Many bands of undead roam Deyja. You were unlucky enough to encounter one of them.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.78.115.1.mess: You enter the dwarven throne room. Several dwarves who hid in the local hiding places now hurry to help you.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.79.47.0.messa: Many bands of undead roam Deyja. You were unlucky enough to encounter one of them.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.81.42.0.messa: You have just entered your arch-enemy's territory. You are in Deyja, home of the necromancers. You follow an old road built here by King Gryphonhearth I. It is now in very poor repair. As you pass a fissure, reanimated corpses begin crawling out. “The welcoming party didn't take long,” you think, and order an attack.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.82.35.0.messa: This is all that remains of the wealth of the Turlean Caves.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.83.35.0.messa: The Turlean Caves, AvLee's royal treasury, once stood here. By accident, however, a Conflux town sprang up here. After it vanished, only a crater among the mountains and cracked earth remained. Deyja's proximity brought the dead miners' bodies and souls back to life, and they haunt this place to this day.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.85.122.0.mess: Welcome, adventurer. Surely you know our struggle against the forces of darkness is going nowhere. I would even venture to say we are losing. With your help, however, we can win. Please accept us into your army, and we will help you settle accounts with the darkness.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.86.132.0.mess: As you approach the Temple of the Moon, many of its priests and their servants charge at you. The final battle between the two churches is approaching. With the aid of the priests of the sun {/If you don't have them, you're pretty screwed./} you now lead an attack on the ancient symbol of darkness. If you win, you will deal the forces of evil a heavy blow from which they will recover only slowly.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.90.137.0.mess: Your sailors take out oars and poles, and your ship slowly begins moving again. Far away in the sky, you see a dark cloud heading towards you. After a few moments, you recognise the servants of the moon. This will be a hard fight.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.90.138.0.mess: You sail into the Evenmorn Islands. Your ship suddenly slows noticeably, and you immediately see why. All the water around you has frozen. You suspect it is a consequence of the battle between the temples of the sun and moon. You should try to do something about it.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.90.68.0.messa: AvLee's border gates are within reach, and you breathe an inward sigh of relief. But alas. Mutare has sent part of her army to patrol the entrance to your realm's interior, and you must fight your way through.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.91.66.0.messa: Here dwell the finest archers of Erathia and AvLee, your brothers and comrades of the Forest Guard. But they do not welcome you; there is no cause for celebration. The land is at war, and they guard its borders. Still, you glimpse several skilfully camouflaged faces nodding to you. But they show sadness and fear.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.95.121.1.mess: You have just entered Nighon's tunnels. It is even worse here than you heard. Damp walls, dripping water and an indistinct rustling do little for your soldiers' spirits.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.96.106.0.mess: A dwarven university was recently established here. Anyone wishing to enter must pay 5000 for the teachers.
map.[sod] - erathia.guards.98.65.0.messa: You are entering the nesting grounds of the good dragons. They quickly fly to join you and help fight their oppressors.
map.[sod] - erathia.header.description: A year after Queen Cathrine returned to Enroth, a king was finally chosen. It was Gelu, commander of the Erathian rangers. After less than two years of rule, he settled the dispute with AvLee once and for all. He became its king and united the two kingdoms. Now he must face a renewed threat from Nighon and Deyja.
map.[sod] - erathia.header.name: Erathia
map.[sod] - erathia.header.rumor.0.text: After Roland's return, the situation in Enroth settled down, and things there are said to be even better than before.
map.[sod] - erathia.header.rumor.1.text: Even the threat of total destruction failed to make Tatalia and Krewlod cooperate.
map.[sod] - erathia.header.rumor.2.text: It seems the traitor Lord Haart truly is immortal, just like Sandro. Both have been killed several times, yet once again they roam Antegarich, spreading death.
map.[sod] - erathia.header.rumor.3.text: Morgan Kendal is said to have stood alone against the combined armies of Deyja and Nighon. But he paid with his life.
map.[sod] - erathia.header.rumor.4.text: They say only the hero Coronius can overcome dragon terror.
map.[sod] - erathia.header.rumor.5.text: The dark knights of Deyja have risen again to spread death and destruction.
map.[sod] - erathia.header.rumor.6.text: They say hordes of undead roam Deyja.
map.[sod] - erathia.header.rumor.7.text: The territory occupied by Nighon is ruled with an iron fist. Yet its inhabitants are better off than those who fell into Deyja's clutches.
map.[sod] - erathia.heroes.148.biography: Gelu I, king of AvLee and the Erathian Province. He was chosen for his services to Queen Cathrine and her husband Roland. He achieved the impossible: uniting the human and elven kingdoms. Now, however, his qualities as a ruler will be tested.
map.[sod] - erathia.heroes.148.name: Gelu I
map.[sod] - erathia.heroes.153.name: Mutare Drake
map.[sod] - erathia.heroes.24.biography: Coronius rightfully earned the title Dragonslayer in the war for Erathia. His battle tactics, supported by the Slayer spell, are deadly to all dragons. He alone can pass through the dragon gate without going mad, and therefore he must survive until the end.
map.[sod] - erathia.heroes.27.biography: Gem governs the Harmondale region. She earned this post through her service to the king during Sandro's first defeat. Rumour says a deeper affection binds her and Gelu. In any case, you must not lose her, or you will not defeat the forces of darkness. Only Gem can break the spell protecting the teleporter to the Pit.
map.[sod] - erathia.heroes.5.name: Lord Markham
map.[sod] - erathia.heroes.6.biography: A hero of the wars to restore Erathia. King Gelu entrusted the former capital, Steadwick, to his care. Now, however, his days seem numbered.
map.[sod] - erathia.heroes.7.biography: General Kendal became regent of Erathia twice: first after King Gryphonhearth's death, then after Cathrine's departure. He secured the throne for his protégé Gelu and was the first to swear allegiance to him. This began the unification of AvLee and Erathia. Today, he is among the few human heroes who remained in Erathia to face the threat from Deyja and Nighon. He has retreated to Riverstride Fortress, where he and his loyal followers stand ready to resist Nighon's army again. But he has little hope.
map.[sod] - erathia.heroes.7.name: Gen. Kendal
map.[sod] - erathia.monster.103.94.0.mes: Thank you for rescuing us from this predicament. We were being transported as slaves to Nighon when the ship holding us struck the reefs. Many of us survived, and we are willing to join you. We also saved a large chest of gold. Accept it as a token of our gratitude.
map.[sod] - erathia.monster.109.70.0.mes: So you think you can defy the might of Nighon?
map.[sod] - erathia.monster.12.43.0.mess: Here are those to whom you gave a component of the Elixir of Life in gratitude. Under the influence of darkness, however, they killed their mistress Ciele and became servants of evil. It is time to avenge the lady of water and reclaim what is yours.
map.[sod] - erathia.monster.136.37.0.mes: “Ha! So-called King Gelu I would like to expand his domain, eh?” says the mayor of Emerald Island. You calmly reply: “No, I have not come to seize this territory. Queen Cathrine granted Emerald Island independence. I have come only for the signet ring that sealed the treaty. But I do not want it for nothing.” You point to a chest full of gold. The mayor's eyes gleam. “I have a better proposal. We keep the treasure and the ring, and take your head as well!”
map.[sod] - erathia.monster.55.61.0.mess: The thieves will not surrender their home easily.
map.[sod] - erathia.monster.60.26.0.mess: As you approach the entrance to the fiery cave, one of the guards steps forward. “Well, our king! What brings you to your faithful servants? Have you finally come to increase our pay for this thankless duty?” “Unfortunately not,” you reply, “but I need to borrow that sword down in the cave for a while.” “That is impossible,” the spokesman objects. “You know very well what you told us: Do not let even me into that cave. Kill anyone who tries to obtain Armageddon's Blade immediately. Fry his balls with spells, without mercy. That is what you said, and unfortunately, we must now obey. Defend yourself, Gelu!”
map.[sod] - erathia.monster.69.6.0.messa: You are creeping around the mountains when a voice sounds above you: “Look, brothers! Another earthbound rat who wants to rob us of our wealth. Well, we haven't had anything to do since those four fools came and stole our bow. Boys, let's show this pipsqueak what it means to be negatively charged with electrons.”
map.[sod] - erathia.monster.78.114.1.mes: The dwarves do not recognise you. They are so blinded by their fight for freedom that they fail to see a friend approaching.
map.[sod] - erathia.monster.88.25.0.mess: Sulfur mining has devastated the landscape here. Your predecessor on AvLee's throne bred lizards here to guard the Turlean Caves. You pledged to exterminate all these monsters. It is time to keep your promise.
map.[sod] - erathia.monster.98.71.0.mess: Of course there would be goblins here. But rather more of them than expected.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.101.50.0.compl: At last you enter the gate with the Power of the Dragon Father in your hands. Suddenly, an old gold dragon flies up and speaks: “Thank you for freeing us. Enter our nesting grounds. But first, defeat those purple monsters that imprisoned us here.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.101.50.0.first: The evil dragons entered the good dragons' caves and stole their most precious artifact, the Power of the Dragon Father. This forced them to remain neutral in the coming war. They also forced the faerie dragons to block the entrance to the dragon caves. You can break the spell only by returning the Power of the Dragon Father. Please hurry; without the dragons, victory will be difficult.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.101.50.0.nextV: Little time remains. The armies of Nighon and Deyja have surely seized most of the continent by now.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.109.69.0.compl: The guard sees your green banner and allows you to pass. Do you accept the offer?
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.109.69.0.first: {/This measure prevents {anyone other than you {from entering here./}
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.114.50.0.compl: “You are truly brave,” says the tree, tears running down its cheeks. “This is our most important and saddest day. We once swore not to interfere in the affairs of walkers. Yet, as you see, we have no choice. Very well, we will join our forces to yours, and together we will try to defeat the darkness.” The tree suddenly tears its roots from the ground, and the whole forest around it does the same.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.114.50.0.first: “Welcome, walker,” says the oldest tree. “A few years ago, others like you came here. They too needed help fighting the darkness. I promised to help them, but only after they returned our forest's heart. They did bring it, but it was dead. I ask you to bring our forest a potion that will restore the heart's steady beat. Then you too will receive your rightful reward.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.114.50.0.nextV: “Without that elixir, I cannot awaken the guardians who would help you in your struggle.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.134.72.0.first: This gate is here for purely practical reasons.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.20.119.0.compl: “Excellent! So Sandro is dead?” “Yes,” you reply. “I sent him and his hordes of rotting bones back where they belong. Here is the artifact you asked me for.” You hand the priestess the cloak. She accepts it and blesses your onward journey.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.20.119.0.first: “Welcome, king of AvLee and the Erathian Province!” the High Priestess of Light greets you. “As you see, the traitor Sandro once again wields the Cloak of the Undead King. Our entire church and I have finally found a way to destroy this artifact. We ask you to bring it to us.” “Of course, Your Holiness,” you reply.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.20.119.0.nextV: “Sandro, the most powerful man in Deyja, has the Cloak of the Undead King.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.39.109.1.compl: “Yes, that is the accursed armour. Now come, I will teach you some of the dwarves' renowned skill. You will need it in Nighon's tunnels.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.39.109.1.first: The dwarven master smith invites you into his forge. “Come in, friend. I need a small favour. As you surely know, the necromancer Sandro uses the Armor of the Damned. But it did not always serve evil purposes. My grandfather originally forged it for the king of AvLee. The necromancers stole it, however, and desecrated it with their filthy rituals. I ask you one thing: bring me that stinking piece of tin, and I will make it what it originally was again — a piece of iron. And I will teach you to swing an axe properly.” “I'll see what I can do,” you reply.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.39.109.1.nextV: “Still nothing? Sandro, that corpse in a tin can, has our former creation.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.40.62.0.comple: Yes, those are the ones. I swore never to touch them again, but apparently I have no choice.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.40.62.0.firstV: So you want to reforge Armageddon's Blade? Very well, but I need the fire artifacts. Bring them to me, and I will forge this fearsome sword from them once more.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.40.62.0.nextVi: What do you think I could forge it from? You hid the fire artifacts somewhere. Without them, there will be no sword.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.52.120.0.compl: I knew you would succeed. Come with me to the study. I will teach you something you will badly need on your travels.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.52.120.0.first: Welcome, great warrior. I see you wish to become a worthy mage too. After several years, a golem must be assembled once again. Its parts are scattered across the continent. Bring them to me, and I will teach you a spell that will prove very useful.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.52.120.0.nextV: Bring me the assembled golem, and I will teach you a very powerful spell.

map.[sod] - erathia.quest.66.66.1.comple: With her arms outstretched, Gem advances ever closer to the teleporter. Nothing can stop her now. The tormented souls around her utter unbearable sounds, yet within them you hear thanks for their release.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.66.66.1.firstV: You have passed the traps of the Hallways of the Pit. Now you need only enter the teleporter to reach the very heart of evil. But the necromancers have created a magical shield here from the bodies of tortured people. Only Gem, with her healing abilities, can break the spell of the imprisoned souls.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.66.66.1.nextVi: Only Gem can break the necromancers' power.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.67.9.0.complet: “I see you are an honourable king,” says the old man, tears glistening in his eyes. “Yes, this is my son's pendant. God, why? Why me...” The old man begins to wail, and you slowly realise you can expect no help from him. Suddenly, however, a fine company of pegasus riders gathers outside his house. Their leader steps towards you: “Forgive my brother, my lord. His son's death has struck him hard. He still hoped that at least he had survived. But he keeps his promises, and we are here to help you fight for our homeland.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.67.9.0.firstVi: “Oh, welcome, our king,” the village elder greets you. “You surely need as many brave warriors as possible. I have a proposal. When the Turlean Caves collapsed, my son died in them. Please bring me his necklace. It is a family heirloom and will remind me of him until the end of my days. Then I will try to gather as many relatives as possible, who will surely join you in battle.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.67.9.0.nextVis: “No, you won't fool me with some trinket,” says the old man sourly. “Until you bring me what I asked for, you will get no warriors.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.87.66.0.comple: “So you succeeded after all? Excellent. Now I can rest knowing my homeland has one fewer enemy. Here is your reward.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.87.66.0.firstV: “Welcome to Lawrence Mark's house,” the famous archer greets you. “I know why you have come. You surely need the Bow of the Sharpshooter, my grandfather's bow. I will give it to you, but you must perform one service for me. As you surely know, renegade titans have a fortress in northern AvLee. Several times, I have sent adventurers to bring something back from there. But I ask only one thing of you: destroy them and raze their fortress, so they can no longer harm AvLee's innocent people. And bring me the breastplate of their leader, the villain who killed my father and brother.”
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.87.66.0.nextVi: “The titans' fortress still stands? I know it is no easy task, but otherwise I will not give you the bow. I am sorry.”

map.[sod] - erathia.quest.97.103.1.nextV: Do not tempt fate without the proper knowledge.

map.[sod] - erathia.quest.97.104.1.first: Only Coronius has the power to overcome dragon terror and open this gate.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.97.104.1.nextV: One look at the gate shaped like an evil dragon is enough to make your knees buckle. Cold sweat runs down your back. You cannot understand how Coronius can face these monsters all his life.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.97.77.0.comple: You bring the old man the azure dragons. When he sees you, he says ominously: “I thought you would never return.” He whispers to himself: “Can nothing stop him?” But as you hand over the dragons, they begin to rear and roar. Dragon terror grips your army, and even you. The largest dragon says to the old man: “You think we will serve your vile masters? Remember this: we dragons will never fight under Deyja's banner. Go and tell your rulers!” The old man curses, mutters something and vanishes in a cloud of smoke. “What is happening here?” you ask the dragon when the terror passes. “You did not recognise him, Gelu?” it replies. “That was Judge Sleen, the necromancers' lackey.” Now you know where you remember him from. You shudder at the thought that you could have helped Deyja. Searching Sleen's hut, you discover a secret entrance underground. There you find several imprisoned gold dragons.
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.97.77.0.firstV: An old man stands outside the hut, looking familiar. “Welcome, traveller,” he says. “No one has visited since the Kreegans' defeat, and I am glad to see a living soul. Since their fall, I have lived here alone, not counting those winged monsters. I would like to ask for your help. As you see, dragons thrive here, and I would like some too. But these want nothing to do with me. So please bring me some dragons from the Frozen Reaches. If you bring them, I will reward you more than generously.” You leave the strange old man, wondering where you might have met him. Perhaps he was a prisoner you helped free from a Kreegan prison. But why on earth does he want dragons? And from the Frozen Reaches in particular? Only... only AZURE DRAGONS live there!
map.[sod] - erathia.quest.97.77.0.nextVi: “Why do you specifically want azure dragons?” you ask the old man. “And who are you, anyway?” “I am Slee... I mean, Prowler Harmed, the last of the Harmed family of southern Erathia,” he replies. “I want the dragons to improve this inhospitable region a little.” You do not quite believe him, but on the other hand, you see no reason not to bring them.

map.[sod] - herkulovy ciny.event.1.descr:
In a small country, several hundred years ago...
The inhabitants of the smallest country in the world of that time, lying in the southeast, had always lived peacefully. Then black dragons arrived and began slaughtering people without mercy. The desperate inhabitants no longer knew what to do. At last they remembered that the legendary hero Hercules was staying nearby, and set out to find him. When they found him, he readily agreed to help and set off at once. But his ship was wrecked on the country's northeastern coast. Hercules found himself in unfamiliar territory, reportedly home to several enemy heroes who were none too fond of him. There is nothing for it but to set out!
But can Hercules prevail in this struggle?
map.[sod] - herkulovy ciny.event.2.descr:
A small note:
Ignore the error messages the map displays when you press Shift+V. Everything is fine.
Some places are deliberately inaccessible to make the map look better.
You have a time limit of 2 weeks, so do your best!
Your first unpleasant opponent is already in sight: Callisto, one of the fallen goddesses!
Your third and most difficult opponent is Ares, god of war and Hercules' brother, who sided with evil, unlike him. This will be the hardest battle. It all depends on how much strength you have left!
map.[sod] - herkulovy ciny.guards.25.4.0: “If you get far enough to upgrade your Firebirds to Phoenixes, this artifact will come in handy. But if you happen to have too many left, do not expect to have time to upgrade them all!”

map.[sod] - herkulovy ciny.header.descri:
When I wondered who would fit into this world, I was unsure at first. Then it struck me: who else but Hercules? After all, he fought a hydra and similar monsters from ancient myths and legends. So here he is!

map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.0.descriptio: In the morning you spotted an unfamiliar ship on the horizon. So someone did survive after all! You hope the strangers bear you no ill will.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.1.descriptio:
At last one of your scouts has returned, but his news is far from cheerful.
You learn that another battle between your sons and your wife has ended. It did not go well. Your wife won and captured your rebellious sons' castle, but the sons escaped, and she was left with only a few soldiers. While she was replenishing her armies, a surviving member of Čáryfuk's family ambushed her. According to the scout, it was the very man to whom you surrendered the three legendary artifacts. With what remained of her army, Květinka could not withstand the brutal attack. All her soldiers are dead, and she herself languishes in captivity. You decide that as soon as you reach your estate, you will begin preparing to rescue Květinka.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.10.descripti: The frequent shallows mean the ship needs constant repairs. Unless you want to sink, you must occasionally dip into your purse and pay for at least the most essential work.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.11.descripti: It seems the weather has improved. It has not rained once since you put to sea. Strangely, though, the water is not receding at all. You may be spending more time aboard than you expected.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.12.descripti: After all these days aboard, your crew have become quite competent sailors. When you recall those first days, you can hardly believe they are the same crew. Everyone behaves like an old sea dog. If only everything came as easily as learning to handle this ship, which has become your temporary home.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.13.descripti:
This is what really happened:
When Honza discovered that Čáryfuk's mother-in-law, Rebecca, had cursed his sons, he realised that his chances of success were very slim. Yet he also knew that his magical abilities could not save both himself and his wife Květinka. So he used all his powers to create a double of himself. He agreed with Květinka that as soon as he reached somewhere safe, he would do everything in his power to save her. He said a hurried farewell and escaped along a secret underground path.

Thus it was Honza's double who was responsible for the fateful meeting with Honza's sons. Meanwhile, Honza hurried through the underground with a few servants towards an estate he had prudently rented just in case. A short while ago he emerged from the final monolith, only a few days' journey from his estate. With firm resolve, he sets out...
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.14.descripti: Now that almost the entire landscape is underwater, you can barely find your bearings. The ground must have collapsed somewhere, and in several places the water roars down into the underground. At least, that is what the huge whirlpools you have seen suggest. All you know is that your estate lies somewhere to the north.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.2.descriptio:
Wondering why Honza has appeared again? Those who defeated him at the end of the previous campaign are probably even more puzzled...

Stop wondering. All will soon be revealed.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.3.descriptio: What really happened? Did Honza survive his last adventure or not? Of course he did. Otherwise you could hardly meet him again. Those who played the last campaign as Honza's sons might object at this point. But I must set them straight. So here are a few words of explanation.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.6.descriptio: You decide to send scouts to discover how the struggle between your sons and your wife is progressing. You want the most accurate information possible so you can decide how to get Květinka out of this mess.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.7.descriptio: Two weeks have passed since you sent out your scouts. You have not received a single report. Where are they? Why have they not been in touch?
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.8.descriptio: There is still no news from your scouts. You are slowly losing hope that any of them will return. You consider sending another group. You will wait a few more days before deciding.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.event.9.descriptio: This morning you pulled another castaway from the sea and learned from him what is happening here. Several local lords have taken advantage of the devastating floods and turned to the lucrative trade of piracy. Their swift ships scour the seas and attack all survivors. You must beware of them. They show no mercy to anyone.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.10.105.1.me:
A sudden twang startles you out of your thoughts. You duck instinctively, and only that saves you from an arrow which misses you by a hair and buries itself several inches into the cave wall beside your head.
Now you see your attackers too. Several elves crouch behind a rock. Suddenly they lower their bows and wave to you in friendship.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.11.105.1.me: Ahead you glimpse a gloomy gateway through which muted daylight and a strange rustling sound enter the underground. What does that sound remind you of? You rack your brains in vain... Drops of water fall onto your head from somewhere above, unpleasantly cold and preventing you from concentrating.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.12.103.0.me: After scattering the Ice Elementals, you notice something gleaming underwater in the shallows near the trees. You send one of your warriors over, and he soon returns with a strange helmet.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.13.51.0.mes: Your keen eye has paid off :-)
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.14.73.1.mes: Suddenly you hear strange sounds. You stop, and everyone listens intently. Then you realise: the groans of wounded dwarves echo through the cavern. You hurry on to help them as soon as possible.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.17.104.0.me: An astonishing sight greets you. An awakening volcano spews streams of molten lava from its crater, mingling with the cold seawater. Clouds of hot steam rise into the sky. It would be unwise to linger here too long.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.19.101.1.me:
“For heaven's sake, what is happening in this country? Has everyone here gone mad...”
you ask your company, but no answer comes.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.22.102.0.me: A strange hut floats on fluffy clouds, with a swarm of pixies fluttering around it. You can see at once that they are barely managing to stay airborne and would like to seize the hut so they have somewhere to rest.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.22.99.1.mes:
Unfortunately, you miss the end of the story when some ancient inhabitant of the dark underground blocks your path.
His intentions are certainly far from friendly...
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.23.99.1.mes: The dwarves tell you an interesting story. Their band maintains the underground caverns and keeps the passages clear. Now, however, the dwarves are deeply unhappy because their work is going terribly. Wherever they start digging, water immediately gushes out. It is as though this place lay beneath an enormous lake. Yet unless your memory fails you, there should be nothing of the sort above...
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.24.99.1.mes:
You come across a band of sorrowful dwarves sitting helplessly on the ground. They visibly brighten when they see you.

"At last, someone who can end our suffering! We see you have some of our kin with you. Take us along, and we will tell you what troubles us."
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.27.102.1.me:
“Who wakes us? Who disturbs us? We cannot see a thing here, but judging by the disgusting stench of manure, some four-legged creatures will not leave us in peace.
Hey, brothers! We have intruders!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.3.104.0.mes: After defeating the troublesome Water Elementals, you learn how to control the element of water. Your seamanship improves as a result.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.3.96.0.mess:
Among a pile of wreckage from a ship, you spot a dwarf clinging to a piece of wood with the last of his strength. You immediately order him hauled aboard. After a generous dose of rum, the dwarf revives and says:

"Thank you for saving my life. But I have one more favour to ask. Some friends and I opened a small mine a little way north. Unfortunately, the supports gave way during the flood and the mine collapsed. My wounded friends are waiting by the mine, and I set out to find help. But I overestimated my strength, and a violent storm smashed my raft. Please save my friends as well."
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.33.68.0.mes: One of the deckhands points out tents on a patch of dry land. Perhaps some castaways are surviving there. You agree that every additional crew member will improve your chances against any pirates. You order the ship towards the shore.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.33.74.0.mes: Ahead you spot an abandoned ship. You are hardly surprised. You expect to encounter the aftermath of the elements' destructive fury rather often.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.35.61.0.mes: Perhaps these shackles were what the Storm Elementals defended so fiercely.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.4.106.0.mes: As soon as you board and put to sea, the rain miraculously stops, and the water stops rising too. Yet as far as you can see, the land is submerged. Only the higher ground protrudes, and the remnants of forests form tiny islands teeming with vermin. Who knows whether anyone survived the flood at all?
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.44.76.0.mes: As your ship passes a tall cliff, a band of ruffians suddenly leaps aboard and a fierce battle begins.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.5.107.0.mes: You manage to hire the last available ship. The dealer fleeces you, taking every coin you have. You must also give him all the resources you had saved for a rainy day. Unless you want to be stranded here and drown in the rising water, you have no choice. This bay may be shallow, but beyond the gate to the north the water must surely be deep. Fortunately, you persuade the dealer to include a few crew members for that outrageous price.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.52.76.0.mes: You took pity on the souls and freed them. For this, a sprite who had charged them with guarding the treasure awarded you a Badge of Courage.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.7.107.0.mes: When you emerge from the underground, you cannot believe your eyes. You stand on a small patch of dry ground, looking out over water. But there was never a sea here before! You can even make out the outline of a ship near the shore. To make matters worse, it is raining so hard you can only see a few metres.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.8.105.1.mes: You have barely accepted the offer of a few warriors when a much larger band appears and offers its services too. These men, however, demand their pay in advance. You know that the stronger and more numerous your company, the greater your chances of survival. Without hesitation, you pay the sum they ask, and your company grows once more.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.9.69.1.mess: You order the dwarves tended to; fortunately, their wounds are not serious. Having come all this way, you decide to resume work at the mine.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.guards.99.102.0.me: Ahead you spot a swarm of malicious pixies fluttering low over the water, trying to drown a castaway. He clings to a beam with the last of his strength, calling weakly for help. You immediately steer your ship towards him.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.header.description: After a long and arduous journey, Honza has reached the region where he prudently rented an estate. He must reach it at all costs and do everything he can to bring Květinka here too.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.header.name: On the Run
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.heroes.26.biograph: Honza is an old acquaintance of yours by now. What else would you like to know about him? If you still do not know him, play his previous campaigns.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.heroes.26.name: Honza
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.heroes.54.name: Zhryn
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.heroes.7.name: Styr
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.heroes.82.name: Daen
"Why are you interfering? That castaway made indecent proposals to us. If you are defending him, you must be just like him!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.monster.2.103.0.me: "What sort of behaviour is this? Since when do land-dwelling worms splash about on the water? Water is our element! It seems it will fall to us to correct this mistake of nature! But we will not let you into the tent willingly."
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.monster.24.102.0.m: “Some magical wind is blowing from that hut. Like it or not, we are landing on your ship, and we will not leave willingly.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.monster.36.62.0.me: A host of Storm Elementals surrounds your ship. They are in a foul mood and make sure you know it. The sea begins to rage, and a fierce wind threatens to tear your sails apart. Unless you want to become fish food, you have no choice but to fight back.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.monster.51.75.0.me: "We have guarded this treasure since ancient times. Only a hero who defeats us in battle can free our souls. His reward for this deed will be the treasure we guard."
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.monster.7.105.1.me: "Forgive our rash actions, but dragons have tried to attack us several times already. Once again, we apologise. Now that you are here, perhaps you can help us. We took shelter underground because a terrible storm is raging on the surface. It is a veritable deluge up there. It has rained for weeks, and water has flooded the whole country. In recent days the water has begun seeping underground too, and we fear we will drown. Will you help us get out?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.monster.9.68.1.mes: "At last! Help has arrived! Do not leave us to die here. Take us into your company, and take this gold we have mined so far as well."
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.2.82.0.compl: With guards like these, I shall certainly be safe. I will teach you a spell to defend yourself effectively against the undead, who are everywhere since that terrible flood.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.2.82.0.first: As your ship approaches the strange dwelling, a peculiar little man peers out of the window and says: "I hope you are not one of those who wish to harm me. These are troubled times, you know. Since those terrible floods, all manner of characters have been roaming about here, and a man fears for his life around them. But I see you have a capable crew. If you leave me 10 Centaur Captains to protect me, I will teach you a useful spell."
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.2.82.0.nextV: You must understand that a weak creature like me needs protection. I think your 10 Centaur Captains could keep me safe.
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.4.100.0.comp: "I see you have finally realised you have no choice. Will you return my family inheritance?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.4.100.0.firs: "Honza, I know very well that long ago your wicked sons obtained three precious artifacts for you which belonged to my great-uncle, the wizard Čaryfuk. I have a rightful claim to these things. If you wish to get out of here, you must surrender them to me."
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.4.100.0.next: "Until you give me the Lion's Shield of Courage, Sword of Judgement and Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment, you shall go no farther!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.42.81.0.comp: "There, I see you have come to your senses. Are you willing to pay gold for the artifact?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.42.81.0.firs: An old sea dog greets you: "I cannot blame you for wanting to get away from here, young man. I am old enough, and I will live out the rest of my days here. But I have an artifact that might prove useful to you. As I do not wish to go hungry in my final days, I will sell it for 20.000 gold. At least that will let me buy enough food from sailors passing by."
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.42.81.0.next: "Oh no! What you have is not enough. I need 20.000 gold. Otherwise I would starve to death here."
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.46.54.0.comp: Well, that looks better. Are you still interested in my maps?
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.46.54.0.firs: Of course I have maps of these waters. But I will not give them to you for free!
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.46.54.0.next: For the little you have, I would not sell you even one tiny map!
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.99.8.0.compl: "There you are! You have come to your senses after all. Well? Do you still want to pass?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.99.8.0.first:
An old toll collector stops you:
"I do not care whether you have rented an estate here. That is your problem. My job is to collect tolls from everyone. Looking at how many of you there are, I would say it will cost you at least 75.000 gold plus five of each rare resource."
map.[sod] - honza 3:0.quest.99.8.0.nextV:
The old fool will not budge:
"Until you pay me, you go no farther! So stop loitering and go find some money!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.103.39.1.me: If you feel tempted to disobey the previous instruction, I would advise against it.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.105.25.1.me: A mysterious voice whispers that Květinka should be the first through the gate. Whether you heed this voice is entirely up to you...
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.105.42.1.me: Why did you ignore the instruction on the signpost? You really should not have come here. An age-old battle between good and evil is being fought here over a mighty artifact that can be used to rule the world. But this will be the last battle you ever fight!
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.105.56.0.me: After defeating these rebellious elementals, you learn how to control them.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.16.12.1.mes: The abandoned temple of a long-dead god of the underworld.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.18.38.1.mes:
To your surprise, a dwarf steps out of a side cavern and asks:

“What brings you to these remote parts? You must be after the gold we mine here!”

You try in vain to explain why you have come. The dwarf whistles, and hundreds of little miners come charging at you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.19.106.1.me: I thought your task was to find Květinka, not collect every forgotten treasure! As you approach the chest, all the diamonds tumble out and come to life!
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.29.76.1.mes: A group of exhausted hydras huddles among the rocks. They entered the underground as younglings and have wandered here ever since. As soon as they see you, they show a wish to follow you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.30.102.1.me: Not every blocked side passage points the right way.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.32.35.1.mes: Not every blocked side passage points the right way.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.34.83.1.mes: A horde of angry ... rushes at you from a neighbouring cavern.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.35.59.1.mes: There was truly nothing good awaiting you in this passage. Swarms of Evil Eyes pour at you from every side tunnel. You really should not have come here...
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.38.89.1.mes: Hollow echoes return the sound of your footsteps, and everyone feels as though something very unpleasant could happen at any moment.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.41.8.1.mess: Not all roads lead to the goal you seek.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.5.48.1.mess: You encounter a band of warriors wandering aimlessly underground. When they see you, they decide to join forces with your army.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.5.53.0.mess: After defeating these rebellious elementals, you learn how to control them.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.51.75.1.mes: Sounds of digging echo from deep within the passage. Who on earth could be searching for something in such a remote place?
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.52.28.0.mes: Well, well! Someone has hidden a strange box here. What could be inside? An unpleasant surprise, or some thieves' loot?
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.53.28.0.mes: In the bushes behind the tavern, you find a discarded pair of nearly new boots. Who could have left them here?
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.53.43.0.mes: Beyond this gate lies the second key to the underground labyrinth. You begin to suspect there will be several more keys yet.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.53.45.0.mes: If you have obtained the key to this gate, it can mean only one thing: you must have performed many heroic deeds. Your efforts deserve a small reward.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.53.87.1.mes: You have barely touched the pile of gold when new hordes of dwarves come charging at you. The previous group must have been merely the vanguard.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.54.50.1.mes: “Well begun is half done,” you tell yourself, and order an attack on the second group.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.54.85.1.mes:
To your surprise, a dwarf steps out of a side cavern and asks:

“What brings you to these remote parts? You must be after the gold we mine here!”

You try in vain to explain why you have come. The dwarf whistles, and hundreds of little miners come charging at you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.56.51.1.mes:
Suddenly your path is blocked by a group of Dragon Flies fighting skeletons. You must admit that, if you had time, you would enjoy watching to see how it ends. The skeletons have the advantage in numbers, but the Dragon Flies fight bravely.
Yet it cannot be helped. Either the combatants let you pass, or both sides will suffer.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.57.53.0.mes: You have passed the first guard defending the way to the underground labyrinth. Another strong garrison lies ahead. You firmly believe you can deal with it too. But who knows what awaits you in those dark underground caverns...
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.58.104.0.me: After defeating these rebellious elementals, you learn how to control them.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.58.84.1.mes: Suddenly soil and a great deal of crushed stone appear on the ground ahead. Even in this dim light, you can make out small footprints. Who could have left them?
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.58.94.1.mes:
A thunderous voice rings out:
"Why did you kill my servant? What did that poor little fellow ever do to you? Now you will pay for your insolence!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.59.31.1.mes: At last you see your journey's destination. All that remains is to hope it is the prison you seek. Yet you begin to doubt it, as you see no guards nearby. Only a watchtower stands before the prison entrance.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.59.97.1.mes: You spot an imp putting up these ridiculous signs. As soon as he sees you, he runs away shrieking. But he stands no chance against you. Such insolence must be punished!
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.61.2.0.mess: After defeating these rebellious elementals, you learn how to control them.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.62.93.1.mes:
“So you are the one attacking my subjects without cause!”
You look around for the speaker, then see the ruler of hell himself with his lackeys. You barely have time to prepare before the fiends attack...
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.66.52.1.mes: Perhaps you should have believed the little cowherd. If you had, you would not have found yourself right in the middle of a band of hungry underground dwellers!
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.66.72.1.mes:
You meet a herdsman with a herd of cows. He is so exhausted he can barely speak.
"Greetings, hero! I do not even know how I wandered down here several weeks ago, and I cannot find the way out. Could you take us into your company? This passage leads nowhere. I swear it. So you can turn back."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.66.8.1.mess: Your choice was not a particularly fortunate one.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.68.6.1.mess: Your choice was not a particularly fortunate one.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.72.97.1.mes: Apart from a dead bat, you find nothing in this corner.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.74.60.1.mes: Several hungry dragons crawl out of an underground cavern. They hope at last to satisfy their hunger!
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.78.30.1.mes: You must have taken the wrong direction, or failed to read the previous signpost.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.83.88.1.mes: You have disturbed some little beasts feasting on a carcass here!
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.guards.9.7.0.messa: The rumours clearly told the truth. The dragon treasure really was worth the fight.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.header.description: Honza must find and free Květinka. To complete the scenario, he must also destroy all his enemies except one, who will become his secret ally.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.header.name: In Search of Květinka
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.heroes.145.biograp: Honza's wife, who is forever getting herself into trouble, leaving Honza to rescue her time and again. A typical woman, in short :-).
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.heroes.145.name: Květinka
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.heroes.26.biograph: Honza is an old acquaintance of yours by now. What else would you like to know about him? If you still do not know him, play his previous campaigns.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.heroes.99.name: Achillea
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.101.82.0.m: "Why venture among the undead? Have you grown tired of your miserable life?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.103.26.1.m: "Anyone who enters the underground labyrinth of their own free will must remain here forever. So not another step!"
"As long as we stand guard here, you will not reach the monolith easily! And there is no other way to your Květinka."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.105.97.0.m: "We will not give up the gold willingly. And even if you defeat us, you will not enjoy your victory for long: you will die miserably underground, where countless traps await you."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.106.3.0.me: "If you wish to recruit some of our kin into your army, prove that a capable hero will be leading them."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.106.56.0.m: "Our former master must have sent you here. He wants to enslave us again, does he? We will not surrender! We have tasted freedom and will never serve anyone again. Besides, when we escaped, we stole the orb our master used to control us. We would sooner die free than give up our freedom!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.11.6.0.mes: "Another greedy wretch after our treasures! You are not the first to try. But we will not surrender our treasures!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.11.88.0.me: "You may not enter, mortal! We would sooner give our lives than let you pass willingly!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.12.80.1.me: "We have waited a long time for you to appear. We knew you would pass this way. We are here to make your journey a little less pleasant!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.2.104.1.me: “How did you get here, mortal? Surely you have not murdered our elder brothers? You will not get away with that! And even if you do happen to defeat us, you will still die miserably in this labyrinth!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.2.33.0.mes: A horde of Ice Elementals is trying to break into the lighthouse and seize it. When they spot your ship, they abandon the lighthouse and turn on you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.20.37.0.me: "This island has always belonged to our clan. How dare you even set foot here?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.32.25.0.me: "Our master told us to let no one reach the tent. Hidden inside is the first key to the underground maze, where our master is holding someone very important prisoner."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.43.58.1.me: "You must be very bold and brave to have come this far. Let us see how you fare in battle against us!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.51.13.0.me: "I was ordered to stand guard before this gate. It seems pointless to me, though, since the key to it, somewhere in the icy lands, is guarded well enough already. I would much rather get out of here."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.54.49.1.me:
"You could at least have waited until we settled things with those Dragon Flies! Why meddle in something that is none of your business!"

With these words, the skeletons forget the Dragon Flies and hurl themselves at you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.55.48.1.me: "Thank you for helping us. Another moment, and who knows how it might have ended. For saving us, we offer you our services. Will you take us into your army?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.59.104.0.m: "Our former master must have sent you here. He wants to enslave us again, does he? We will not surrender! We have tasted freedom and will never serve anyone again. Besides, when we escaped, we stole the orb our master used to control us. We would sooner die free than give up our freedom!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.59.39.0.me: "We are tired of being stuck in one place all the time. Please take us out into the world with you."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.6.53.0.mes: "Our former master must have sent you here. He wants to enslave us again, does he? We will not surrender! We have tasted freedom and will never serve anyone again. Besides, when we escaped, we stole the orb our master used to control us. We would sooner die free than give up our freedom!"

We have tasted freedom and will never serve anyone again. Besides, when we escaped, we stole the orb our master used to control us. We would sooner die free than give up our freedom!"

map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.8.19.0.mes:
"Greetings, hero. So you are searching for your imprisoned wife? Our lady Achillea sent us to scout out more information about that prison. But the long journey tired us out, and when we sat down to rest, our paws froze to the ice. 
Take us away, and we will help you open the way to the Lord of the Elements. From him you will obtain the first key to the underground maze. But do not let any of us die. Otherwise you will never see your Květinka again."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.86.11.0.me: A horde of Ice Elementals is trying to break into the lighthouse and seize it. When they spot your ship, they abandon the lighthouse and turn on you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.monster.99.24.0.me: “Who dares disturb mighty creatures born of magic? You will pay dearly for your thoughtlessness!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.33.25.0.comp: "At last I can regain control over those rebels. If you return those mighty artifacts to me, I will not bar your way to the tent. Well, do you agree?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.33.25.0.firs: The ruler of all elementals has settled in the old tower. His subjects rebelled and scattered to every corner of the world. Each kind also stole the powerful orb of its element, which he used to control them. If you bring him all the orbs so he can regain control over his servants, he will clear your way to the tent.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.33.25.0.next: "Until I regain control of my servants, I will not leave this tower!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.34.25.0.comp: "I see you truly are Achillea's friend. Do you wish to pass now?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.34.25.0.firs: “I received word from the barbarian Achillea that I may only let you pass if you bring 10 Rocs as proof that you bear her no ill will.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.34.25.0.next: "You do not look like a friend of Achillea's. I need the proof she told me about."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.4.55.0.compl: “Excellent! At last I can return to my sovereign. Let me leave with 5 Chaos Hydras, and you may pass.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.4.55.0.first: “My king sent me to bring him five Chaos Hydras. I must obey his command, but dare not leave this place. If you help me, I will let you pass.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.4.55.0.nextV: “I am truly sorry, but I cannot return to the king without 5 Chaos Hydras. You must help me, or I am not moving.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.58.34.1.comp: "There we are! Now I have the beginnings of my future magical library. Will you trade those books for free passage? I will also tell you that the monolith behind the prison takes you back to the start of the labyrinth. If that is where you are heading, of course."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.58.34.1.firs: "I would like to become a good wizard, but I have no books to learn from. Bring me at least three books on magic, and I will clear your path."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.58.34.1.next: "If you do not bring me those books, I will remain stupid forever. And I would not like that. So make a little effort."
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.quest.61.35.0.comp: At last Květinka herself has arrived. Do you wish to pass?
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.102.21.1.mess:
You have almost reached the place you want to be.
Unfortunately, you are one step off.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.11.82.1.messa: The prison and the exit from the underground are close together. But the road between them is long...
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.17.70.1.messa: Go back where you came from!
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.17.97.1.messa: This passage leads to the edge of the underground.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.27.50.1.messa: Death awaits you at the end of this passage!
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.29.100.1.mess: Do you think this way will get you anywhere?
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.34.56.1.messa: Take this passage, and you will meet Nemakačenko's fate!
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.43.55.1.messa: Only one of these paths is the right one!

Seers' Settlement 
Entry permitted to true heroes only.

Entrance to the dwarven mines.
If you are dwarves, press the secret switch and open the passage. Everyone else, go back where you came from.

map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.58.102.1.mess: This passage does not lead to the imprisoned heroine.

If you are dwarves, press the secret switch and open the passage. Everyone else, go back where you came from.
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.64.92.1.messa: Which way, which way does the path go?
map.[sod] - honza 3:1.sign.80.74.1.messa:
Up: somewhere unknown

map.[sod] - honza 3:1.town.31.21.0.event:
You receive another message from Achillea:
"My friend,
I have discovered that your scouts were captured. But the enemy did not guard them well, and my warriors managed to free them. I will send them to you as soon as they recover from the torture the enemy subjected them to. I have learned that there is only one way into the underground labyrinth, secured by a complex system of gates and monoliths. The Lord of the Elements can tell you more. According to my information, he is somewhere in your territory. But to reach him, you must bring my warriors who became lost near the ice plains to the guards before him.
--{Achillea}"
Today your scouts returned from Achillea. They still bear the marks of torture, but should be well in a few days. You send them to rest and recover before the coming battles.
Achillea sends you gifts as a token of her goodwill.

A wandering beggar whom you sheltered for the night told you a remarkable legend. Somewhere in the icy lands, it says, lies a great treasure hoarded by dragons. It is an enormous pile of gold, but the dragons guard it carefully.
Thinking it over, you realise that if you could obtain the treasure, it would provide valuable funds for your expedition.

The first reports from your scouts begin to arrive. Several clans have settled in this strange land. Each occupies its own enclosed territory. They are all villains of the worst sort. Yet they have made an agreement among themselves and do not attack one another. Quite the opposite: whenever a stranger appears, they join forces to destroy them.
One more clan lives in the southernmost reaches, but the scouts have been unable to enter its territory at all. So you know nothing yet about this last enemy. Surely they will be no better than the others.

Květinka must be imprisoned somewhere in this region. You have taken quarters in a strange town and immediately sent a few men to scout. Before their first reports arrive, you should look around and get to know the warriors you will command.

A strange messenger visited your estate today. An enormous golden bird descended into the courtyard, lightning flashing around it. In its beak it held a parchment scroll, which it laid at your feet. You began reading at once.
"Unknown stranger,
I am Achillea, a barbarian warrior. My home lies in the south of this region. I know why your steps have brought you here. I merely wish to assure you that you have nothing to fear from me. I have nothing to do with the other clans in this land. If you leave my territory in peace, I promise to try to help you. As proof of my good intentions, accept this small gift and the information that the woman you seek is imprisoned underground. I have sent out my scouts, and if I learn anything new, I will inform you.
--{Achillea}."

You finish the letter and write just two words on the back:
{“Agreement accepted.”}
You hand it to the strange messenger. He takes it in his beak and vanishes southwards in a blaze of lightning.
Well, that is settled. At least some good news. You are pleased to have a kindred spirit in this hostile land.
