map.[sod] - honza 3:2.event.1.descriptio: Your scouts bring interesting news. They have learned that the villain who tricked Honza out of three powerful artifacts is indeed hiding in this region. They do not yet know exactly where. They also tell you he did not come here by chance: he has powerful allies here. To strengthen his position, he gave each of them an artifact. He thinks this will put them in his debt and make them easier to control.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.event.2.descriptio: Your scouts set out early this morning to learn more about this region. Until they return, you will work to build up and fortify your base.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.event.3.descriptio: One of your scouts returned late last night. As the guards did not wish to disturb you, they only brought him before you today. He reports that two powerful clans live on the far side of the bay and help each other. But he has learned nothing yet about the scoundrel you seek.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.event.4.descriptio:
During breakfast, the guards tell you another scout has returned. You order him brought before you at once.
His news is very interesting. He largely confirms everything you have learned so far, but the enemy is less united than it first seemed. The artifacts you seek are to blame. Each clan received one, awakening envy between them. Everyone believes the other clan has the better artifact. There are signs that war may break out over them, for each would dearly like to have them all.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.event.5.descriptio:
Another scout report arrives. Unfortunately, the original suspicions have proved unfounded. The two great clans across the bay, once on the brink of war, have agreed to a temporary truce. The man who caused all this has hidden somewhere underground.
Hmm, an interesting situation. At first it seemed you would catch the villain, beat the artifacts out of him and return them to Honza. Instead, you will probably have to hunt for them across the whole country. What a nuisance!
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.event.6.descriptio:
A letter arrives from Honza. He asks how you are progressing and whether you need help. Privately you admit that it would be welcome, but your barbarian honour will not let you humble yourself like that. So you tell the scribe to write that everything is going according to plan.
After the messenger leaves, you notice another question in Honza's letter: have you captured the castle on the ice plains yet? Oh well, no matter. You will tell him next time.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.event.7.descriptio:
Today a messenger brings another letter from Honza:
“Achillea,
It has been three months since you set out to find the artifacts. How are you actually progressing? You have written almost nothing about your successes so far. Those few words about everything going according to plan did not tell me much. Make time to send a detailed report.
--Honza”
What can you tell him? How are you supposed to find time to write reports? For now, you will simply put it out of your mind. Especially since the last warrior who could write was lost in battle last week.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.event.8.descriptio: This morning you managed to capture a merchant. His pack animals carried little cargo, but more importantly, you discovered that the merchant can write. So he was enlisted in the army as chief scribe. At least someone will be able to write to Honza if he asks how you are doing. Oh dear, these intellectuals are a handful.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.event.9.descriptio:
A special messenger from Honza brings interesting news.
"Achillea,
If you have already visited the northern ice plains, you must have noticed the gate to the underground. I would like to tell you that beyond it lie four rare artifacts which can be combined into a single, even rarer one. If you manage to obtain these artifacts, you may keep them as a reward for your help. They will surely prove useful in your future adventures.
--Honza"
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.100.83.0.me: Something gleams in the bushes beside the road. You look and discover a bag of gold. You toss it into your saddlebag and ride on. You have barely gone a few steps when a band of Gold Golems surrounds you: the bag belonged to them. Will you fight them for it?
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.103.105.0.m: The men of your company discover the castle's head footman in hiding. You subject him to cruel torture, but all he knows is that the villain you seek is hiding somewhere underground. Only one path leads to him, resembling a descent into the depths of hell.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.103.15.0.me: You spot a necklace in a crack between the rocks. You manage to pull it out, but a band of devils immediately surrounds you. They want you to sign away your soul for it. Would you rather fight them for the necklace?
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.12.20.0.mes: The monstrous body of a hydra suddenly emerges from the surrounding swamp. More and more crawl out behind it. They clearly have not had a decent meal in a long time.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.18.74.0.mes: Damn those ogres. They seem to have multiplied here. Once again you find traces of them. The shield you discover plainly belonged to those stupid but strong creatures. A moment later, you learn this firsthand as a whole band emerges from an underground cave. Will you fight them for the shield?
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.2.3.0.messa: Pursuing the villain from whom you must recover Honza's artifacts has brought you to these remote parts. But just beyond the border, a sudden snowstorm wipes out his tracks. Your best course is to settle somewhere and send scouts to discover where the wretch is hiding. According to the plans Honza gave you, there should be a town due south.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.2.32.0.mess: Ahead you see the pitiful remnants of a wild tribe of trees. Countless numbers lived here in days gone by. But as you can see, someone even built a sawmill here to process the poor trees. As though there were not enough forests around.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.2.66.0.mess:
A town at last!
But it seems to have some unwelcome visitors. Quickly take it over, then set about building your main base.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.2.94.0.mess: You finally obtain the bow, along with a tidy pile of gold the elves were carrying.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.2.95.0.mess: It seems you have found what the old witch wanted. As you reach for the artifact, a horde of demons flies out of the abyss. You can only hope the witch rewards you handsomely if you obtain it. Do you wish to fight for it?
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.28.46.0.mes:
An interesting club catches your eye. “That would make a good weapon,” you think. But before you can even touch it, Ogre Magi surround you.
“Leave that club alone! We have come to collect it. The chief lost it last night on our way back from hunting.”

Will you fight them for the club?
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.3.55.0.mess: A large stone head lies among the rocks in the quarry. You think of taking it to your castle and displaying it in the entrance hall. But when your men begin loading it, several giants rush out of a cave at the foot of the cliff. They commissioned the statue for themselves. Will you fight them for the head?
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.3.94.0.mess: Something gleams dully beside a rock. You pick it up and clean it, discovering a magical bow of the Wood Elves. But a terrible roar interrupts your delight at the find. A band of furious elves rushes from the nearby forest. Will you fight them for the bow?
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.34.11.1.mes: All that fuss over an artifact, and then the guards let you take it so easily.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.36.10.1.mes: "Oh, damn! Nobody told you about guards at the treasures. Not even that treacherous watchman in the tower!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.39.57.1.mes: Of course! When the wretch saw that his final hour had come, he quickly hid the helmet. But it did him no good. With him, the last descendant of Čáryfuk's accursed family has vanished from the face of the earth. Now hurry back to Honza!
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.41.57.1.mes:
This is the last hero. Who knows whether he carries the artifact you still lack? If not, it must be hidden somewhere nearby.
Suddenly a flash catches your eye. Did you imagine it, or did something really gleam beneath the rock at the back? What could it be?
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.43.15.1.mes: "Oh, damn! Nobody told you about guards at the treasures. Not even that treacherous watchman in the tower!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.43.18.1.mes: All that fuss over an artifact, and then the guards let you take it so easily.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.46.5.1.mess: Your first steps underground are not very encouraging. You look around in vain: no trace of treasure. What you cannot miss is that the passage branches into several caverns. Perhaps you will find some treasure somewhere after all.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.5.4.0.messa:
Suddenly a strange bird lands on your shoulder and asks in a human voice: "Are you the warrior Achillea?"
Speechless with amazement, you can only nod.
"Good thing I found you. I am not used to cold like this. But I will not keep you long. Honza sends you this little thing. He says it may come in handy."
Then it drops a necklace into your lap, flaps its wings and heads off somewhere south.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.5.91.0.mess: Among the rocks you see a deep chasm, said to lead to hell itself. Judging by the stench rising from it, you could almost believe it.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.50.55.0.mes: As you approach the strange house, a fierce wind rises, almost tearing the ship's sails. Suddenly Air Elementals emerge before you from a whirlwind. You prepare for battle. You could not outrun them anyway: they are incredibly fast.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.53.80.0.mes: Something suddenly breaks away from a towering crag whose summit you can barely see. At first it seems a piece of rock has fallen. A moment later, however, you realise your mistake. What you took for a boulder is a flock of harpies.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.53.83.0.mes: The pilot runs to warn you of shallows. But before you can shorten sail, the ship strikes a submerged rock. You freeze in alarm. Yet there is no time for fear: the ship is taking on water and must be repaired.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.55.19.1.mes: "Oh, damn! Nobody told you about guards at the treasures. Not even that treacherous watchman in the tower!"

map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.56.76.1.mes: "This probably is not the right place."
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.58.26.0.mes: The air is growing colder. An unmistakable sign that your ship is approaching the Icy Reaches. Occasionally a deep rumble sounds: the volcano must be restless. You all hope it will not erupt as you sail past.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.6.11.0.mess: Well, a little fight like that merely warmed your barbarian blood. It hardly took any time, either. Now hurry south to find a town where you can settle.

map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.62.13.1.mes: "Oh, damn! Nobody told you about guards at the treasures. Not even that treacherous watchman in the tower!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.62.9.0.mess: Despite the helmsman's and pilot's best efforts, you scrape a submerged rock. Fortunately the ship holds together and does not sink. But you have to repair it in a hurry.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.63.10.0.mes: Suddenly you feel the air around you trembling with supernatural magic. You see that Honza kept his promise. You would not want to be an intruder in these parts. It probably would not end well for you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.64.15.1.mes: All that fuss over an artifact, and then the guards let you take it so easily.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.64.18.0.mes: You hear a deep rumbling, and the air reeks of sulfur. On the horizon you see a new group of islands near the passage to the Icy Reaches. Just let there be no eruption!

map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.7.6.0.messa: The border fortress is already visible to the south. Even from a distance, it looks rather dilapidated. You hope the garrison is in the same condition. To be safe, though, you warn your company to stay alert and avoid being caught off guard by an attack.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.7.62.0.mess: At the foot of the cliffs lies a collapsed mine. The souls of the miners who died there guard it.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.72.92.0.mes: Someone has lost a pretty little ring beside the road. You dismount to pick it up, just as a band of adventurers arrives in a cloud of dust. Will you fight them for the ring?
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.77.57.1.mes: "This probably is not the right place."
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.79.16.0.mes: You are about to order an attack when a crowd of minotaurs bursts from the gate. They keep close together, trying to conceal a blind shaman in their midst. map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.90.44.0.mes: The dragons are reluctant to surrender their artifact so easily. Will you fight them for it?
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.guards.94.91.0.mes: You are only a few steps from one of the enemy castles. Suddenly a suspicious noise comes from the bushes, as though someone were hiding there. You send a few men over at once. They soon return with a frightened footman trying to conceal something beneath his cloak. To your astonishment, he was trying to smuggle the Sword of Judgement you seek out of the castle.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.header.description: The search for three powerful artifacts has brought Achillea to these distant lands. She must not die, or she will be unable to help Honza! If she assembles the Cornucopia, she will carry it into the next scenario.

map.[sod] - honza 3:2.header.rumor.2.tex: Do not leave your castle unguarded. It could cost you dearly!
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.header.rumor.3.tex: Leave nothing to chance. Every wrong step could cost you victory.

map.[sod] - honza 3:2.monster.26.32.0.me: This building radiates so much magical energy that Earth Elementals have materialised from it. They are the strongest kind of elementals, but also rather slow. You hope your archers' aim will be true.

map.[sod] - honza 3:2.monster.35.3.0.mes: “Go away, stranger! What are you doing here anyway? As far back as we can remember, no one has dared venture into these parts. We will not give you our little stones regardless!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.monster.35.70.0.me: “At last, someone who might take us away from here. We have been bored here long enough, and have had enough of it. We would much rather join a proper expedition.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.monster.4.75.0.mes: "We do not like uninvited guests! Looking at you, we are sure you want to take our mine. Then prepare for battle!"

map.[sod] - honza 3:2.town.20.10.0.name: North Stronghold
A special messenger arrives from Honza. Reliable sources have told him that an abandoned barbarian castle lies to the north, in the land of eternal ice.
The only way into this territory is by sea. At one point, however, you must sail through a very dangerous strait. Honza wants to try something, but until he is entirely sure, he does not wish to raise false hopes.

Another messenger from Honza arrives with very welcome news. Honza has used all his skill and magical abilities to cast a powerful spell over the strait leading to the northern barbarian castle. He has ensured that no unauthorised person can enter the icy lands except you and your people.
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.town.3.64.0.name: Base
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.town.71.106.0.name: Beneath the Cliff
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.town.81.15.0.name: Tyranny
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.town.95.71.0.name: On the Plains
map.[sod] - honza 3:2.town.95.89.0.name: Beyond the Gate
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.0.descriptio: When Achillea brought Honza the artifacts, she also met Květinka, and they quickly became friends. She felt deeply sorry for everything Květinka had endured. Above all, she grieved to see her wasting away day by day from the effects of her long imprisonment. Then Achillea remembered a distant barbarian land whose shamans knew of a magical elixir. It might help even in such a severe case. She decided to take Honza there and help him obtain it.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.1.descriptio: The journey was long and arduous. At last, however, the two heroes reached a small archipelago inhabited by fierce barbarians. A great shock awaited Honza: this wild, primitive land knew almost nothing of magic, and he would have to deal with any enemies by brute force. Yet Achillea assured him that some local shamans knew at least the simplest spells. So Honza would not lose his beloved magic entirely.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.10.descripti:
Another messenger arrives from Achillea. You would rather not even describe the state of the letter he brings, since merely thinking of it turns your stomach. This time the letter is very brief.

"Hullo nuthing noo Achillea."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.11.descripti:
At last, news from Achillea. As the goblin hands you the letter, you notice a brown stain on the other side. The goblin sees your look and merely shrugs with a smile: "Had to go. Came on all sudden."
You order the goblin to unfold the letter and hold it in front of you. It reads:

"Found! Bluddy vial Gnoll stole when run from island there their wizard hav on Ded island hid sumwhere Achillea."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.12.descripti:
Honza's messenger catches up with Achillea in the morning. He hands her a letter in which Honza asks how she is progressing.
After reading it, she merely sighs.

“By great Gruh-la! I will have to write again! Why did I ever let myself be talked into learning to use a quill? Things were so much simpler when I could not write. And sometimes I managed to capture someone who could. Now I have to do everything myself.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.2.descriptio:
To make the search for the elixir as effective as possible, Honza and Achillea split up and begin searching independently. They agree that whoever learns anything important will immediately send word to the other.
But something very unpleasant happens to Honza. After landing on the island where he intends to begin his search, he is suddenly surrounded by a horde of natives. Before he can even react, they seize his hard-won artifacts and scatter in every direction.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.3.descriptio: In the few days before setting out to find the elixir, Honza managed something almost impossible: he taught Achillea to write. Now they can exchange messages regularly without waiting for Achillea to capture someone who can write. Her letters may look terrible, but it is progress all the same. A barbarian woman who can write! That is a first.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.4.descriptio:
This morning a messenger sent by Achillea catches up with Honza. He hands you a greasy piece of parchment with scraps of food still falling from it. Slowly, you take it between two fingers and try to read what Achillea has written.

"Deer Hanzo,
my scout found elixur sumwhere ogre mag took apart one ring each tribe last not there lost try serch Achillea"

That does not make you much the wiser. You spend a long time wondering what Achillea was trying to tell you. She must once again have no scribe in her company and have written the letter herself. At least she has learned to sign her name correctly.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.5.descriptio: Honza could barely sleep all night, pondering what Achillea had meant to write. Then it dawned on him. She must have meant that Ogre Magi had taken the elixir apart. Now each tribe owned one ring. But the last artifact had gone missing. That must be it. A few more letters like this, and Honza would become an expert at deciphering secret messages.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.6.descriptio:
Another messenger arrives from Achillea. The little goblin comes up to you, pulls a piece of paper from his pocket, unfolds it, stuffs a piece of bacon into his gob and hands you the paper. Carefully, to avoid getting filthy, you begin to read.

"Hanzo,
down at noon one and one tribe their seer hav one ring one get me one you last not know Achillea."

This time it is easier to decipher. You understand that two enemy tribes live to the south, each possessing one ring. Achillea will obtain one, and you must obtain the other. The last artifact has still not been found.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.7.descriptio: Honza decides to send out his own scouts as well. Perhaps they will have better luck and discover the last artifact needed to assemble the Elixir of Life. He does not trouble himself over the choice. However he chose, the result would be the same. So he picks five goblins at random, gives them instructions, and the “scouts” set off.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.8.descriptio: You have not heard from Achillea for a long time. So you write a report on your progress and ask her to let you know if she has learned anything new.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.event.9.descriptio: Your "brave" scouts return. As they approach, the stench around them almost knocks you over. They are still shaking with fear as though stricken with St Vitus's dance. The brown stains they leave on the ground suggest that something frightened them very, very badly indeed. Knowing them, however, it could have been anything. You already know they have found out bugger all. You do not even let them come closer, but immediately send them to bathe and change their clothes.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.14.11.0.mes: During the battle, you realise these warriors would be a welcome addition to your company. So you head towards their dwelling to try to persuade the remaining inhabitants to join you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.23.15.0.mes:
And the goblin talked and talked...
You have never seen such a talkative goblin. But you learn nothing else of importance. Except perhaps that the locals are terribly stingy and never give anything away for free. So you hope Achillea has brought the Cornucopia she mentioned. Otherwise you would be in a fine mess.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.24.15.0.mes:
"If you ever wish to visit this island in future, beware of those cows!
Watch out for the rocks surrounding the island, too. Many goblin ships have been wrecked on them, which is another reason the goblins believe the island is enchanted."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.25.15.0.mes:
"Recently, however, a ship returned from sea with interesting news from its crew. During a violent storm they had to anchor in a bay off Burial Island. It takes its name from the ancient burial grounds that once lay there. That is another reason no locals dare set foot on the island. Everyone believes the souls of the dead haunt it.
A few sailors went ashore to replenish their drinking water, though in the end they found none.

And that was when it happened. In the lightning flashes they saw gnolls among the trees, though everyone believed they had died long ago. Yet the truth was quite the opposite. The gnolls settled on Burial Island, where they bred a new, highly aggressive kind of cow. We wonder how the gnolls can control these cows. Yet the cows obey them, and also protect them from the undead."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.26.14.0.mes:
"And so, in time, the goblins conquered practically the entire territory. But in a few places Ogre Magi defied them and took over some of their settlements. The orcs did not much care who ruled them. Since they could throw axes, no one dared pick on them.

Gradually, however, the land began to grow overcrowded. Several tribes therefore decided to exterminate the weakest people: the gnolls. But they failed, because the gnolls fled by ship to an island in the middle of the region. No one has heard from them since."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.27.13.0.mes:
The goblins tell their tale:

"In ancient times, four main peoples lived here: orcs, gnolls, ogres and goblins. The goblins were the most numerous: weak, perhaps, but plentiful. The second people, the orcs, were less numerous. Their agility made up for it, and they used it to throw their axes. At first the ogres had the advantage of strength, but when they realised they could not stop the goblins alone, they began learning simple spells. The last people, the gnolls, had no great advantage."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.29.11.0.mes:
You promise the goblins you will help their settlement. But before you set out, the goblins notice that your boots are utterly unsuitable for this wilderness. In return for your promised help, they give you better boots.
You put them on and follow the goblins along a path leading somewhere south. On the way, you hear an interesting story...
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.3.27.0.mess: Those walking lumps of wood never stop talking... But long before they get around to acting, they are a heap of splinters.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.30.19.0.mes: Just capture the sawmill, and you can head for the town the goblins told you about.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.34.67.0.mes: One step is enough to produce a loud crunch beneath your foot. You see that the ground is covered in bone fragments and the decayed remains of the dead. This must be Burial Island. The gloomy surroundings do nothing for your warriors' courage. You struggle to keep them all from fleeing.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.38.59.0.mes: One step is enough to produce a loud crunch beneath your foot. You see that the ground is covered in bone fragments and the decayed remains of the dead. This must be Burial Island. The gloomy surroundings do nothing for your warriors' courage. You struggle to keep them all from fleeing.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.39.57.0.mes: Among the trees, you spot a group of gnolls driving a herd of fearsome cows. You all stand as though turned to stone, not daring to move. The moments before the group disappears from sight seem endless. Fortunately, they do not notice you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.4.5.0.messa: As you approach the castle, panic breaks out on its walls. The few inhabitants of this derelict den prepare a desperate defence. They would surely do better to join you. As it is, you will have to slaughter them without mercy.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.40.67.0.mes: Branches crack in the thicket ahead, and a herd of wild cows driven by gnolls bursts onto the path. Enraged by the colour of your war banners, the animals suddenly charge.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.44.54.0.mes: This time you are less fortunate. Gnolls with a herd are passing nearby again. One goblin fails to watch his step, and the sharp crunch of a skull beneath his foot echoes like a gunshot. The fearsome herd stops. The cows stare at you with bloodshot eyes. A gnoll barks an order, and suddenly you have nowhere to retreat. You can only fight for your lives.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.49.51.0.mes: A few steps ahead, the path ends at a strange hut. Perhaps there you will learn something about the vial you seek.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.52.61.0.mes: Green slime runs down the walls of the guard gate, a suffocating stench fills the air, and suddenly the cursed souls of dead warriors fly out through the gate...
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.56.58.0.mes: You spent so long collecting those precious artifacts, and now you have lost them again. That has hardly cheered you up, has it?
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.56.68.0.mes: At last this land is free of the undead who terrorised it. As proof that these vampires have been destroyed, you take a cowl left lying here.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.58.59.0.mes: A broad plain stretches around you. On it stands the largest herd of cows you have seen in this country. But where are the herdsmen? They must be taking a siesta somewhere, while the cows are furious because there is nothing on this ground to destroy. By the look of them, they intend to vent their anger on you!
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.59.67.0.mes:
The ground beneath your feet suddenly comes alive. Bony limbs clutch at you, chunks of rotting flesh falling from them.
Zombies have ambushed you...
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.61.53.0.mes: Bones grow more plentiful in the cursed soil, and in places they seem to have been laid as traps for uninvited guests. One of your orcs, for instance, cuts his leg on a bone. You decide to dismount, cursing this land because you have lost the page bearing the View Earth spell. Now you have no idea what lies in store for you ...
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.62.57.0.mes:
What must be the largest bones you have ever seen jut from the earth. They look as though they belonged to the primeval mother of those cows the gnolls are so fond of using for protection. Suddenly one of your goblins speaks:

"Th-th-th-that b-b-bone m-m-m-moved!"

And he is right. While you were looking at one part of the skeleton, the other bones around you silently assembled themselves into Bone Dragons, and now they attack!
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.63.45.0.mes: One step is enough to produce a loud crunch beneath your foot. You see that the ground is covered in bone fragments and the decayed remains of the dead. This must be Burial Island. The gloomy surroundings do nothing for your warriors' courage. You struggle to keep them all from fleeing.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.63.48.0.mes: Among the trees, you spot a group of gnolls driving a herd of fearsome cows. You all stand as though turned to stone, not daring to move. The moments before the group disappears from sight seem endless. Fortunately, they do not notice you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.63.64.0.mes: The walls of the guard gate are spattered with dried blood, flaking to the ground in great scabs among the remains of torn bodies. The gate leaves creak open, and dark horsemen in black armour pour through towards your company...
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.63.9.0.mess: Those stupid ogres have been taught a lesson. You take their leader's club as a souvenir.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.65.50.0.mes: "Who dares disturb the peace of the dead? Who treads upon the bones of the ancients?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.69.8.0.mess:
Those wooden creatures never stop talking...
But keep your distance and there is nothing to fear. At least your wood supply has grown again.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.70.53.0.mes: The dead dislike your presence in their territory, and make it very clear. Suddenly your company is surrounded by spirits thirsting for the blood of the living...
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.70.58.0.mes: The trees' dark shadows suddenly begin to move, and the shades of long-dead warriors emerge from the cursed soil. The undead shriek, a chill runs down your spine, and battle begins...
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.86.7.0.mess: You see stables ahead and cannot stop wondering how they came to be in this wilderness. As far as you know, these primitive tribes have never bred horses. Still, you hope the stables will let you exchange your tired horse for a rested one.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.89.22.0.mes: It seems the local tribe has tamed wolves to pursue its enemies more effectively. But they probably do not feed them much, for you can hear their hungry howls from here. If they prove to be good fighters, however, they will surely find a place in your army too.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.90.24.0.mes: So they really can fight, unlike your slow, lazy goblins. You keep that thought to yourself, lest they take offence and run away. Right now you need every warrior. So you head towards the primitive dwelling to try to hire a few.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.guards.97.23.0.mes: Before you lies evidence that monks once tried to civilise this barbarian land. But the local tribes dealt with them in their own fashion. Only this shrine remains as a memorial to them.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.header.description: Honza and Achillea must find all the artifacts needed to assemble the Elixir of Life so they can heal Květinka.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.header.name: The Search for the Elixir
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.1.13.0.mes: "This chapel is for capable wizards only! Do not even come near it, or you will get hurt!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.102.33.0.m:
“Our master is resting and does not wish to be disturbed! Come back in a few hours. We do not care if you have no time! {HALT!}”

You have had enough of listening to these overgrown monsters. You tighten your grip on your sword hilt, and at your gesture your warriors form up to attack.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.12.45.0.me: "Do you really think we are slaving away building a ship just for you? You could not be more wrong!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.13.10.0.me: “We are a free tribe and wish to serve no one. But if you prove yourself a great warrior, perhaps some of our brothers will agree to join your company. It will not be free, though. You must pay us the usual wages when recruiting.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.22.11.0.me: "If you know so much about magic, why not create a spell yourself instead of stealing ours?!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.27.21.0.me: "This settlement works for us! If you want slaves of your own, find another one!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.28.12.0.me: "Help us, stranger. Our little settlement lies a short way south of here. But some time ago a few ogres discovered it and forced our tribe to cut wood for them. We only escaped by chance, but we want to help the others in the settlement too. Afterwards, you are welcome in our town to the northwest."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.44.3.0.mes: "This gold mine is under our protection! Gold is rare in these parts, and we have no intention of giving it up so easily!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.48.21.0.me: A group of Earth Elementals is trying to break into the trading post, from which desperate cries for help can be heard. Perhaps saving the owner will earn you a special offer.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.5.54.0.mes: "At last, someone who can help us. We have been locked behind this gate for a long time and are terribly hungry. We never dared hope that a meal would serve itself up right under our noses!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.55.67.0.me: "Why do you desecrate our sacred land? Why do you kill my servants? But this time your luck has run out. Your journey ends here!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.56.85.0.me: "What are you looking for here? Do you not know this place is dangerous for you?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.6.4.0.mess: And the stone statues in the quarry suddenly come alive and begin advancing towards you...
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.63.8.0.mes: "This chapel is for capable wizards only! Do not even come near it, or you may have an accident!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.68.7.0.mes:
"Do you think you can defeat us?
Ha - ha - ha!
Do not make us laugh!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.7.22.0.mes:
A small group of ogres blocks your path.
"Bringing us some new slaves?" their leader asks.
"No, I am not," you reply calmly.
"I am here to deal with scoundrels like you!"
Before the ogres work out what you mean, your troops have taken up battle positions and charge...
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.70.26.0.me: "It took us ages to create this spell. And now we are supposed to give it up?!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.77.37.0.me: "What are you looking for here? Do you not know this place is dangerous for you?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.89.25.0.me: “We are a free tribe and wish to serve no one. But if you prove yourself a great warrior, perhaps some of our brothers will agree to join your company. It will not be free, though. You must pay us the usual wages when recruiting.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.9.43.0.mes: "Someone has betrayed us! A stranger has discovered our hideout!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.92.65.0.me: "Aaargh!!! Who wakes us? Why will you not let us rest in peace? You will pay for this insolence with your life!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.monster.93.19.0.me: “Nobody knows how to ask nicely these days. If you did, perhaps we would sell you a ship. But since you have no manners, we will show you we can use our axes for more than chopping wood!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.104.32.0.com: "Excellent! A truly magnificent piece! Will you trade it for the helmet?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.104.32.0.fir:
As you enter the hut, a splendid helmet hanging above the fireplace immediately catches your eye. Just then, a merchant comes in from the back room.

"Welcome. I see you like the helmet. It really is a fine piece. I came by it quite by chance, since I mostly trade in weapons. I would happily exchange it for your sword. Interested? Or perhaps we could make another arrangement. I have long wanted an Ogre's Club of Havoc. Bring me one, and I will trade it for the helmet. Though to tell the truth, I like your sword better."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.104.32.0.nex: “Unless you bring me an Ogre's Club of Havoc, you will not get the helmet. Unless, of course, you would trade your sword for it. But you probably would not want to do that. So stop standing there and go find the club.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.18.6.0.compl: “You must really want that sword if you are willing to pay the asking price. Do you wish to buy it back, then?”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.18.6.0.first: “So you are Honza? Then I have an offer for you. Some thieves recently sold me this Sword of Judgement. They said it was very valuable to you and you would pay me well for it. If you want it back, bring 10.000 gold and 50 of each rare resource. If it really is so precious, pay up and I will return it.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.18.6.0.nextV: "Oh no! That is not enough. I asked for 10.000 gold and 50 of each rare resource!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.19.34.0.comp: “I see you have reached level 17. You might be the one my master is expecting, then. Do you wish to visit him?”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.19.34.0.firs: "I cannot let you pass, because my master is expecting a great hero. But he did not tell me who it would be. To avoid being scolded needlessly, I have decided to open the way only for a hero of at least level 17."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.19.34.0.next: “My master is in an exceptionally foul mood today because the hero he is expecting has still not arrived. I do not wish to risk admitting someone else. If you want to pass, you must reach at least level 17.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.21.34.0.comp:
“You must really care about that shield if you are willing to pay the asking price.
And before I forget: on my last trading voyage, I spoke to a merchant on one of the islets who had a magnificent helmet above his fireplace. Looking at you, I think it would go well with your sword and this shield.
Do you wish to buy the shield back, then?”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.21.34.0.firs: "My friend who lives to the north told me you paid him well for a sword. For my part, a very rare shield came into my hands some time ago. But you will not get it as cheaply as you got the sword. This time it will cost you 20.000 gold and 100 of each rare resource. If you truly want that shield, surely that is not too high a price for you."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.21.34.0.next: "Oh no! You will not fool me! You must bring me 20.000 gold and 100 of each rare resource!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.28.100.0.com: "At last I can send for the finest water. Thank you for your help. In return, I offer you this ring."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.28.100.0.fir: “Behemoths have settled on an island with a well of exceptionally refreshing water. Because of them, I cannot go and fetch any. Drive them off the island, and I will reward you generously.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.28.100.0.nex: “What kind of hero are you, afraid to face a few Behemoths?”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.33.70.0.comp: "Have you finally found the right proof?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.33.70.0.firs: "Only brave heroes may continue. Bring me proof that you are one of them."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.33.70.0.next: “You cannot be much of a hero if you do not have what I require.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.35.19.0.comp: "The elixir must matter a great deal to you if you are willing to give me these warriors. Do you wish to pass now?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.35.19.0.firs: "Hardly any boys have been born in our tribe in recent years. We fear this will put us at a great disadvantage against the other tribes. We urgently need to replenish our warriors. Bring me 50 young warriors, and I will let you pass."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.35.19.0.next: “I am sorry, but my tribe's interests matter more to me than your search for some dubious elixir.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.36.65.0.comp: "Have you come to your senses? Will you trade the Admiral's Hat for free passage?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.36.65.0.firs:
A little gnoll peers from a window high in the tower.
“I have heard that you have become quite good at sailing the seas. They say your hat deserves much of the credit. Our people intend to leave this island, for the herds of cows have grazed it bare. We want at least some chance at sea. So you could give us your Admiral's Hat. In return, I will clear your path.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.36.65.0.next: The gnoll is adamant. Unless you surrender the Admiral's Hat to his people, you have no chance of getting any farther.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.40.58.0.comp: The guard sees that your flag is the right colour and allows you to pass. Will you accept the offer?
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.40.58.0.firs: The guard in the tower says that only a hero fighting under a flag the colour of freshly spilled blood may pass.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.40.58.0.next: "Your flag is not the colour of freshly spilled blood!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.44.70.0.comp: "We are glad you have accepted that you have no choice. Will you trade the Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment for free passage?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.44.70.0.firs:
The guard in the tower stops you.
"You cannot enter cursed ground with holy objects. As long as you possess the Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment, we cannot let you pass. We will only admit you if you surrender it to us."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.44.70.0.next:
The guard in the tower is unyielding:
“You have caused enough trouble here with that helmet. If you want to go farther, you must hand it over.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.5.55.0.compl: The guard sees that your flag is the right colour and allows you to pass. Will you accept the offer?
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.5.55.0.first: The guard in the tower says that only a hero fighting under a flag the colour of freshly spilled blood may pass.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.5.55.0.nextV: "Your flag is not the colour of freshly spilled blood!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.53.49.0.comp: "Thank you for your help. You are clearly a true hero. You deserve a medal for your courage. Will you accept this reward?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.53.49.0.firs: "Unfortunately, I know nothing about the vial you seek. But I can help you in another way. Vampires live on the far side of the island. Every night they attack animals all over the island and drink their blood. If this continues, soon not a single creature will be left alive. Please kill the vampires, and I will reward you. But you must bring me proof that they are truly dead."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.53.49.0.next: "The vampires are still attacking the island's animals. Until you kill them, you will receive no reward."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.55.57.0.comp: "I see you have come to your senses. Are you willing to pay me to leave this place?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.55.57.0.firs: "I have heard that when you truly want something, you are willing to pay any price. And I am demanding. If you wish to go farther, you must bring me 250 of each rare resource. Otherwise I am not moving."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.55.57.0.next: "Do not be a miser. If you will not pay, you are out of luck."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.56.56.0.comp: "Excellent! Exactly what I needed! Here is the reward I promised. Will you trade your Cornucopia for this vial?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.56.56.0.firs:
"I have heard that reaching me cost you much effort and expense. I have also learned that you have met nothing but fools so far. Each thought only of lining his own pockets, with no thought for the future. If someone can amass such wealth, he must surely have something that guarantees it.
If you wish to obtain from me the vial containing the precious blood of life, bring me your source of wealth!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.56.56.0.next: "You cannot be very interested in the vial if you are unwilling to part with a single artifact. Or am I mistaken?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.57.59.0.comp: "Well? Will you leave the Sword of Judgement and Lion's Shield of Courage here?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.57.59.0.firs:
A gnoll leans out of the tower and says:

“You look fearsome with those weapons. I cannot let you approach our seer like that. He is old, and frightening him might give him a heart attack. If you wish to go farther, you must surrender the Sword of Judgement and Lion's Shield of Courage here.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.57.59.0.next: The gnoll will not be talked round. Until you surrender the Sword of Judgement and Lion's Shield of Courage, he has no intention of clearing your path.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.62.47.0.comp: The guard sees that your flag is the right colour and allows you to pass. Will you accept the offer?
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.62.47.0.firs: The guard in the tower says that only a hero fighting under a flag the colour of freshly spilled blood may pass.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.62.47.0.next: "Your flag is not the colour of freshly spilled blood!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.85.28.0.comp: "The elixir must matter a great deal to you if you are willing to give me these warriors. Do you wish to pass now?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.85.28.0.firs: "Hardly any boys have been born in our tribe in recent years. We fear this will put us at a great disadvantage against the other tribes. We urgently need to replenish our warriors. Bring me 50 young warriors, and I will let you pass."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.85.28.0.next: “I am sorry, but my tribe's interests matter more to me than your search for some dubious elixir.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.92.67.0.comp: The guard sees that your flag is the right colour and allows you to pass. Will you accept the offer?
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.92.67.0.firs: The guard in the tower says that only a hero fighting under a flag the colour of freshly spilled blood may pass.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.92.67.0.next: "Your flag is not the colour of freshly spilled blood!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.96.80.0.comp: "At last I can bathe in my favourite little lake again. Thank you for your help. In return, I offer you this ring."
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.96.80.0.firs: “Behemoths have settled on an island with a picturesque little lake. Because of them, I cannot bathe in my favourite spot. Drive them off the island, and I will reward you generously.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.quest.96.80.0.next: “What kind of hero are you, afraid to face a few Behemoths?”

Here rests the First Shaman.
Please do not disturb his peace.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.sign.19.16.0.messa: Bwangala - just a few miles northwest.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.sign.2.19.0.messag:
Remember that one day you too will end up like this.
So leave my remains alone!

map.[sod] - honza 3:3.sign.63.20.0.messa: Enter and give thanks to the god Kawa-wa-ga.

Island of Dark Rituals.
No unauthorised entry!

map.[sod] - honza 3:3.town.3.2.0.event.0: The goblins are delighted by your presence in this region, so they have decided to declare their settlement the continent's capital.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.town.3.2.0.event.1:
Around noon, someone knocks at Honza's stronghold. You discover it must have been the parents of this goblin baby crying in a basket. Inside the basket is a note:

"our babee got nowhere sleep an eat pleez raise him big warrior.
-- parunts"

If you did not know Achillea had no children, you would think she had written it. So you order the servants to raise the goblin.
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.town.3.2.0.name: Bwangala
map.[sod] - honza 3:3.town.4.103.0.name: Umba Lay
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.event.0.descriptio:
While Květinka was unwillingly confined in the religious fanatics' prison, raiders approached the borders of her homeland, where her capital stands.
Today you and Honza reached the borderlands. You settled in one of the smaller towns, needing rest after the long journey. A short while ago, however, your scouts returned with news that the capital had been burned down and most of the country occupied. Now the raiders have decided to attack the remaining towns still beyond their control.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.event.1.descriptio:
The situation now stands as follows:
- You hold only four towns in the entire country, all very poor.
- Five enemy clans oppose you, seeking to occupy this land.
- So far, however, only the leaders of the three most powerful clans have arrived.
- Unless you act, the whole country will soon belong to the enemy.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.event.2.descriptio: Today your scouts report that the last towns still holding out have fallen to the enemy. Surely this cannot be happening! The situation is growing serious. If the clan leaders find support in the towns, a bloody war will erupt. You must recapture the towns and regain control of the entire country.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.event.3.descriptio: Today the enemy nation's king arrived in this country. He has decided this land is ideal for his research. He is experimenting with controlling good heroes and their troops and using them in the final battle between Good and Evil. If Evil won, he would gain the strength of all the heroes of Good, then simply destroy them. After Květinka and Honza discussed it, they reached a decision: once they have secured most of this territory, they will deal with him.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.event.4.descriptio: Your scouts report that the enemy king is hiding in a remote corner of the region. Apparently only one path leads there, and it is very well guarded. You should not march against him until you have a strong army.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.event.5.descriptio: The enemy king has achieved the impossible! He has taken control of the troops from a Tower! If this keeps up, you might as well start digging your grave!
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.event.6.descriptio: Under Honza and Květinka's leadership, the country is beginning to recover, and its inhabitants have been able to contribute money to the war effort.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.event.7.descriptio: Conditions in the country continue to improve, so the inhabitants have decided to send financial aid regularly.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.0.12.0.mess: A forgotten pile of gold hints at what this mine once was. Now you need only resume mining, and it will be useful again.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.13.20.0.mes:
A band of warriors blocks your path. Their leader steps forward, pays homage and says:

"Welcome to our lady's homeland. She has been away from these parts a long time, and we hear that you have become lord and master of her heart. Your wish is our command. We will serve you as faithfully as we would serve her herself. Take us into your ranks, and we will strive not to betray your trust."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.19.8.0.mess: How interesting. You have seen a little village like this a few times before :-).
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.20.29.0.mes:
Damn! Nobody mentioned that the garrison behind you has been empty for quite some time.
Suddenly one of the goblins standing nearby sidles up to you and says: "Psst! I heard that one day the remaining warriors vanished from this garrison. If you want to find them, you should know they were killed by Fire and Magma Elementals."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.21.6.0.mess: At last the village is free again. No one will extort its people any longer. One of your warriors points out, however, that before the last thief fell, their leader fled into the forest behind the village. Realising the fight was hopeless, he took a small chest with him. He must have escaped with the stolen treasure.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.22.31.0.mes:
The roar of flames and the bubbling of flowing lava reach your ears. You gaze in wonder at the largest lava field you have ever seen. You hope to cross it unharmed.

Your warriors are terrified by the fire, and only with the greatest effort do you persuade them to continue.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.23.3.0.mess: After your warriors emptied the stolen treasure from the chest, you were about to leave when you discovered another bag full of gold in the thick bushes.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.24.3.0.mess: You have found the thieves’ leader hiding here with a strange chest. He will surely defend his loot to his last drop of blood.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.38.50.0.mes:
Before you lies a land where, according to legend, a holy war once raged. Fire and Magma Elementals did not want Rampart troops settling here. When negotiations failed, a war broke out that the inhabitants will long remember. Unfortunately, neither side won.
The dispute was finally settled by Ancient Behemoths, who would have disliked either side winning. They divided the territory with a Border Guard and hid the key in one of the Keymaster’s Tents.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.38.52.0.mes:
At last you have left the dangerous fields of fire. The land beyond the gate looks much more welcoming.

You hope it truly is. First impressions are not always reliable.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.60.36.0.mes:
Oh dear. This land is full of extremes. One moment flames leaping from lava scorch you, then you stumble over gravestones on holy ground. You have even glimpsed snow-covered mountain peaks, and now you must wade through bones jutting out of the cursed earth at every step...

Thank goodness your warriors can adapt to these conditions. They are clearly no softies like halflings, for instance. Those start whining as soon as they leave a muddy meadow and step onto snow.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.60.37.0.mes: Fragments of bone crack beneath your feet. An unmistakable sign that you have entered cursed ground inhabited by the undead.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.61.48.0.mes: Unbelievable! How has the snow here in the middle of the lava not melted? The Azure Dragons living here must have something to do with it!
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.72.64.0.mes: You have an unpleasant feeling that you will not emerge from the next battle with just a few scratches. Could it be the nearby undead?
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.73.74.0.mes:
You discover a lookout tower among the rocks. Some warriors on its gallery seem to be waving their bows at you. Or are they waving at all?

Too late, you realise they were signalling their comrades, who attack you from behind.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.guards.91.42.0.mes: As soon as you approach the abandoned mine, swarms of elementals emerge from the billowing magical mist!
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.header.description: Květinka returns to her homeland with Honza. During her long absence, however, several enemies have set their sights on it. Defeat their leaders and victory is yours.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.header.name: Conquest of the Homeland
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.heroes.37.name: King
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.1.12.0.mes: "Many of our brothers died when this mine collapsed. We have stood guard here ever since to prevent any further deaths. We will not let you enter. We will fulfil our duty even at the cost of our lives."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.109.39.0.m: “You are not our master! We will not serve you!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.11.76.0.me: "We have just finished training in this fortress. If you are curious about what we learned, we will show you right away!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.12.26.0.me: "At last, someone to look after us. No one has tidied our camp for ages, and a few of our companions refuse to let anyone in. If you deal with them, we will regularly supply a few warriors for your army."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.14.4.0.mes: "If you had asked nicely, we could have come to an agreement. But since you know nothing of manners, we will teach you!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.16.36.0.me: "Do not bother us now! I am arranging a meeting with the sprite."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.18.24.0.me: "Welcome! I have been waiting here to hand this laboratory over to you. I trust it will be in the right hands."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.2.22.0.mes: "Come on, then! We have not had fresh meat in ages!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.20.63.0.me: "Why do you want to take something that is not yours?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.21.7.0.mes:
A band of thieves charges at you from the bushes.

"Our clan has controlled this village for some time. We have no intention of letting every wandering vagrant into it!"

You try in vain to explain that you are no vagrant. The thieves press their attack, leaving you no choice but to defend yourself.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.24.59.0.me: "We are ready to defend our home to our last drop of blood!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.26.10.0.me: “We guard this quarry for our master! We are to let no one near it. That includes you, whoever you are!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.26.24.0.me: The behemoths look thoroughly enraged as the hot lava burns their paws.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.30.22.0.me: "Why do you wish to visit our seer? What gives you the right? We will not let you bother him without good reason!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.31.31.0.me: "Stay out of our business, or you might get hurt!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.32.31.0.me: "What we are discussing is none of your business!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.32.9.0.mes: "We have claimed this mine for Inferno! Looking at you, you are not one of us. Defend yourself or die!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.33.58.0.me:
"We were here first. You must wait until we have obtained our horses.
Are you deaf!? No pushing in!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.35.23.0.me: "They will not let us into the university because they say we are mindless creatures. If we cannot get in, neither will you!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.36.28.0.me: "What we are discussing is none of your business!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.4.32.0.mes: “The local inhabitants have oppressed our kind for a long time, calling us {overgrown {lizards}. I hope your arrival will change that.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.40.55.0.me: "This spell is for mages alone, not just anyone who takes a fancy to it!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.42.9.0.mes: "No one has ever dared bother us before. You must be either very powerful or very bold. Show us what you are made of!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.45.69.0.me: "These warriors serve us. Do not dare even approach their dwelling!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.50.5.0.mes: "What are you doing in territory belonging to the dead? Would you like to join their ranks?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.53.2.0.mes: "Do not disturb this dead man’s rest!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.55.8.0.mes: “We have already got the miller. Now it is your turn!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.60.71.0.me: “Leave us alone so we can gather mercury for our masters in peace!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.62.12.0.me: "We worked here when we were alive. And no one is driving us out now, either!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.63.48.0.me: "If you wish to use our services, we must know whom we have the honour of addressing."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.68.58.0.me: “We know a certain seer wants us defeated. But we will not be beaten so easily. Leave now, or we will burn you with our breath!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.7.3.0.mess: "Ssss... Why do you disssturb usss? Ssstop! Or you will die!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.7.39.0.mes: "We have gone hungry long enough. At last we have a chance to feed again!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.72.96.0.me: A group of nagas is trying to enter their home, from which their relatives apparently drove them out. Seeing you, they abandon their futile efforts and decide to vent their anger on your party.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.73.60.0.me: “You have found what you seek: your death!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.78.65.0.me: "How dare you set foot in these lands! Our flames will burn you to ashes for this!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.83.7.0.mes: "Ha! Another fool who thinks he can subjugate us!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.90.11.0.me: "Typical of you! Robbing our ancestors’ tombs! You will pay dearly for your insolence!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.93.28.0.me: "We have almost rusted away from lazing about here so long. At last we can stretch our limbs in battle!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.monster.93.85.0.me: "We will defend our brothers at any cost! We are no weaklings, and we will prove it right now!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.101.1.0.comp: "Thank you. For now, I will let you through after all. Or do you not wish to pass?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.101.1.0.firs: "We meet again. I am quite a powerful mage now, but I still lack a few things to achieve perfection. For now, all I need is another artifact, pictured on this parchment."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.101.1.0.next: “You know me. Surely you know there is no point talking to me without the item I want.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.141.91.0.com: "At last! You must be Honza. I have something here for you. Will you accept this gift?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.141.91.0.fir: “Only Honza may collect what I have. I will give it to no one else.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.17.92.0.comp: "Thank you! At last my greatest dream has come true, and I shall become a mage unlike any the world has ever known!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.17.92.0.firs:
So we meet again. I now know what I need to become the most powerful mage. There are three artifacts in the world that can be combined into the Ring of the Magi. I need only one more artifact to assemble it
-
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.17.92.0.next: “You know me. Surely you know there is no point talking to me without the item I want.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.30.21.0.comp: At last you have defeated the Crystal Dragons, and the area is safe again! Are you ready to accept your reward?
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.30.21.0.firs: Crystal Dragons threaten the northwestern part of this land. If you were brave enough to defeat them, I would reward you well.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.30.21.0.next: Do not lose heart. Defeating the Crystal Dragons is a difficult task, but I am certain you can do it.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.30.39.0.comp: "So you have decided to help me after all?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.30.39.0.firs: "I have heard that pieces of a powerful artifact are hidden in this land. With its help, I shall become a great mage. Bring me at least one of these artifacts, and I will let you through."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.30.39.0.next: "I remember what I promised you, and what you promised me."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.39.66.0.comp: At last! With these dwarves, we shall protect our empire! Here is your reward. Are the warriors ready to leave?
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.39.66.0.firs: I am an agent of the emperor of a distant land. His armies recently suffered a crushing defeat. If you bring me 120 Dwarves, I will reward you generously.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.39.66.0.next: Have you had no luck finding 120 Dwarves? Please hurry! The fate of our empire rests in your hands.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.74.59.0.comp: "At last I see Květinka, the most beautiful woman I have ever heard of! I have a small reward for you. Will you accept it?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.74.59.0.firs: “I have long heard of a beautiful woman as lovely as a little flower. If you bring her to see me, I will see that you are rewarded.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.74.59.0.next: "Sob! My heart has grieved for so long because I have yet to see Květinka."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.74.84.0.comp: “At last! With the help of 20 Chaos Hydras, I shall claim the princely throne. Here is your reward. Are the warriors ready to leave with me?”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.74.84.0.firs: "I was once one of the three princes of our land. But the other two conspired against me and defeated me in battle. Yet I never abandoned hope of revenge. Now my time has come. I am building a powerful army, but I lack support troops. If you help me, you shall be rewarded."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.74.84.0.next: “Have you had no luck finding 20 Chaos Hydras? Please hurry!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.89.113.0.com: "Have you finally defeated them? And what were they really called? Hmm, ogres, you say. Is that some strange variety of goblin?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.89.113.0.fir: "Once, during my travels, a band of creatures ambushed me. I do not know what they are called, but judging by their behaviour, I started calling them blockheads. I would like revenge, but it happened far to the west. I have no intention of ever visiting those parts, so I would like to ask you to deal with them."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.89.113.0.nex: "All I really know is that it happened near this land’s western border, close to a collapsed mine."
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.98.125.0.com: Excellent! You have found 30 Halflings, and I can bring them before the king. Let me leave with them, and you may pass.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.98.125.0.fir: My king sent me to bring him 30 Halflings. I must obey his command, but I dare not leave this place. If you help me, I will let you pass.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.quest.98.125.0.nex: I am sorry, but I cannot return to the king without 30 Halflings. You must try harder.
map.[sod] - honza 3:4.town.102.11.0.even: Under your leadership, the City of Death prospers, and more warriors have moved in today.
