map.[sod] - honza 3:5.event.0.descriptio: After Honza and Květinka listened to the titan, they learned that he had come from a neighbouring land to ask for help. The realm of the Titan King had been invaded by the malicious Dragon Lord. He had captured the king, and his dragons were now ravaging the whole country. Apparently, their own land was no longer enough for them. Their fiery breath was wreaking havoc in the icy regions, and no one’s life was safe. There was only one way to save the kingdom: invade the dragons’ land.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.event.1.descriptio:
Only one region of the entire kingdom had managed to hold out. Yet it was only a matter of time before it fell. That was why the titan had come to ask you for help.
Honza did not deliberate for long. He had been lazing about and resting for quite long enough. Květinka, like a good wife, agreed with him. After a few preparations, Honza cast a teleportation spell. Unfortunately, he had not used it for a long time and muddled it slightly. They did reach their intended destination, but a small error had crept in. Worse still, their mighty armies had been sent goodness knows where.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.event.2.descriptio: Your scouts have discovered that the Dragon Lord’s commanders fight only alongside the finest warriors. The Dragon Lord himself has settled in an old knight’s castle in a remote corner of the land. Reaching him will certainly not be easy.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.event.3.descriptio: A special messenger arrived this morning to announce that the scouts had discovered the prison holding the Titan King. It lies in the very heart of the dragon kingdom. As long as the Dragon Lord lives, however, the king cannot escape.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.event.4.descriptio: The scouts have discovered that the dragons’ land is divided into several regions. Each has its own commander, who answers to the Dragon Lord. In a remarkable feat, the scouts learned that two commanders whose territories they explored more closely possess parts of the Statue of Legion, which serve as passes to the Dragon Lord. The other commanders probably hold the remaining parts.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.event.5.descriptio: Late last night, your scouts learned that the necromancers fighting under the Dragon Lord’s banner once had to renounce their art. They swore to keep no troops but dragons in their armies. This separated them from “ordinary” necromancers, who disowned them and stopped caring what they did in this land.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.event.6.descriptio: The castle’s inhabitants told you that the dragons have even occupied the entrance to the monolith in the southern part of the land. It leads to a small island with an ancient burial ground. Those accursed dragons will not even leave the remains of the titans’ ancestors in peace. You should rid that island of the shameless creatures.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.event.7.descriptio:
An old man approached Honza and said:
"We will probably meet many more times. I wanted to tell you that I have tried to do something to limit the enemies’ expansion a little. Each stays within an enclosed region. I have placed guard towers between the regions. If I may offer some advice, do not open passages into new regions until you have completely cleared the previous one. It will spare you unpleasant surprises. Unfortunately, two clans have gained access to the sea, so they could still pose a threat to you."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.100.43.0.me:
The idea for the territory beyond the next gate comes from the map
{Fall {and {Rise {of {the {Sharai}.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.100.65.0.me:
“So you are the hero who decided to help the Titan King?” asks a little man who suddenly appears before you. He reaches into his satchel and takes out a golden helmet.

“Since you have earned one of my brothers’ trust, I shall trust you too. Take this helmet. Perhaps it will help you fulfil your task.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.102.28.0.me:
"You will face many difficult trials and travel a long road. The choice is yours alone. If you heed my words, your sons’ souls will find eternal peace. Above all, do not forget what I have told you.

Now go in the name of good and complete your task. Accept my blessing and set out to meet your destiny."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.102.29.0.me:
"When Rebecca spoke her curse, your sons’ souls fell prey to the dark powers. When they were first wounded after the curse, the dark powers managed to obtain a few drops of blood from each son. The demons performed a secret ritual with that blood and took control of their souls. Now the denizens of hell possess these three vials of your sons’ blood and intend to use them to forge a weapon with which to rule the world. Obtaining these vials will be far from easy.
To succeed, your wife must enter a monastery and pray for the innocent victims whose lives you took. You yourself must renounce your strength and abilities and set out on a journey of penance.
You must seek out the denizens of hell, kill them, and take the vials of your sons’ blood. You must bring the vials of your sons’ blood to the Holy Place and give them to the White Mage, who will perform a Purification Ritual with them."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.102.30.0.me:
You are only a few steps from the Dragon Lord’s castle when the grey-haired seer appears in the avenue once more and says:

"I see you are doing well. Before you stands the Dragon Lord’s own castle. But now, to the reason I am waiting here. My servants have already hinted that there is a way to lift your sons’ curse and bring eternal peace to their souls.
You have performed many heroic deeds in your life. Although you have often harmed the innocent too, your good deeds still outweigh the bad. Everything you have ever done, you did in the name of good and justice.
But come. I will accompany you to the castle gate and tell you what you must do to free your sons’ souls."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.114.72.0.me: This should be the castle of the last of the Dragon Lord’s commanders. At last you have the final piece of the Statue of Legion. You can boldly march against the Dragon Lord himself and teach him a proper lesson.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.119.35.0.me: Before you lies a picturesque village like one you have visited before. At least you know what you can find there.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.131.102.0.m: This warrior will no longer need his weapon. You hesitate, but finally grasp the axe and twist it from the skeleton’s hand.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.28.21.0.mes: The patrol from the Dragon Utopia is not lounging about as you expected. It is always alert.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.4.15.0.mess: You encounter enemy scouts, who attack the moment they see you.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.4.49.0.mess: In a remote corner of the land, you encounter enemy scouts. The Dragon Lord is preparing a campaign and is surely trying to learn as much about you as possible.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.43.117.0.me: So far, everything is going smoothly. Another castle stands before you, and you have obtained the statue’s next-to-last piece. You can hardly wait to have a go at the Dragon Lord himself.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.46.8.0.mess: You are almost at the tent when a strong patrol suddenly appears. This does not look good for you. Remember, though: you must not fail!
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.47.73.0.mes: A few steps from the castle, one of your warriors runs up to you. In a secret cache among the trees, he has discovered a piece of the Statue of Legion that was meant to serve as the local commander’s pass to the Dragon Lord.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.48.5.0.mess: You find a frozen traveller carrying a purse stuffed with gold.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.61.59.0.mes:
An old hermit stops you and offers you a sword, saying:

"I am delighted that someone has decided to free this land from the dragons’ rule. Take this weapon. It will surely help you in your struggle.
One more thing: I have heard of the misfortune that befell your family when Rebecca cursed your sons. I know it troubles both you and Květinka greatly. But there is a way to free their souls. One of my brothers will tell you more."

He hands you the sword, and before you can ask him anything, the hermit vanishes without a trace.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.71.86.0.mes: Instructions for creating this interesting location can be found at {http://mapmakers.kgb.cz.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.74.37.0.mes: You approach another castle and send the warrior who found a piece of the Statue of Legion at the previous one to search the area. He soon returns, saying he has found another piece in a nearby ravine. Why do the commanders hide the artifacts near their castles instead of keeping them on their persons?
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.86.98.0.mes: You are no longer even surprised when your warrior, whom you have started calling Keeneye, discovers another piece of the Statue of Legion near the castle.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.guards.91.89.0.mes:
"So you have already spoken to my younger brother," says a quiet voice.

You turn to see a frail old man barely able to hold a shield.

"Yes, yes, my lad. This shield belongs with the sword my brother gave you. I see he entrusted it to the right hands. So take this shield as well. As for freeing your sons’ souls, you will learn everything in due time. First, though, you must defeat the Dragon Lord."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.header.description: Defeat the Dragon Lord, whose hordes of dragons are invading the surrounding lands. As a reward for your work, you will learn something very interesting.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.header.name: Land of Dragons
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.heroes.2.name: Adjutant
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.heroes.88.name: Titan King
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.monster.13.4.0.mes: “I have just managed to escape from the gem mine. At last I am free of the endless fog surrounding it. I think you could claim it, since no one is guarding it now. But you will have to search carefully; the fog is very thick. Now I do not know where to go. Will you take me in?”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.monster.3.139.0.me: “We hear the Dragon Lord has put a bounty on every hero under the red flag. So fight!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.monster.3.7.0.mess: “We are glad a hero willing to help our land has been found. The Dragon Lord grows bolder by the day. If you do not help us, the kingdom faces destruction. Please take us into your party. We will help you capture the Cloud Temples, where you can recruit our mightiest warriors.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.100.44.0.com: "At last, Honza himself has arrived. Do you wish to pass through and fulfil your destiny?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.100.44.0.fir: Only Honza may undertake this difficult and demanding task.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.100.44.0.nex: The guard cannot be talked round. They still insist that only Honza can accomplish this demanding task.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.100.66.0.com: “Have you really brought me 5 Ghost Dragons? That can only mean one thing: the necromancers to the south have been wiped out. Do you wish to pass now?”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.100.66.0.fir: “Have you finished off the necromancers to the south? If you want to convince me, bring me 5 Ghost Dragons as proof. Or try the neighbouring tower; perhaps they will be less demanding.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.100.66.0.nex: “I do not see you bringing 5 Ghost Dragons. That means the necromancers still roam freely in the south.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.102.27.0.com:
“What? You have the Statue of Legion? That can only mean one thing: all the Dragon Lord’s commanders are dead!”

With these words, the watchman turns and scampers off, raising clouds of dust behind him.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.102.27.0.fir: “How dare you even demand admission to the Dragon Lord? Each of his chief commanders had to present one piece of the Statue of Legion at an audience. You are a stranger, though, so you would need the whole thing before I would let you through. Ha ha ha!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.102.27.0.nex: "You are no friend of the Dragon Lord, so you will go no further."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.102.48.0.com: "I see you have passed the test. Defeating the Dragon Lord will not be as easy as you think, though. Do you wish to pass through and try?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.102.48.0.fir:
An old seer leans out of the tower and speaks:

“Beyond this tower begins the Dragon Lord’s own territory. I want to be certain you can handle him. You must therefore pass a test of readiness. Go and defeat the Crystal Dragons dwelling south of the 5th fortress. Only then will I be convinced that you can take on the Dragon Lord.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.102.48.0.nex: “If you have not yet defeated the Crystal Dragons, you are clearly unprepared for the decisive battle. Get out of my sight!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.102.63.0.com: “What skull are you carrying? Why, it is the head of the necromancer Smrák! I see you dealt with them after all. Do you wish to pass now?”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.102.63.0.fir: "Have you finished off the necromancers to the south? To convince me, you must bring me Smrák’s head. Nothing else will persuade me."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.102.63.0.nex: “I do not see Smrák’s head. I therefore conclude that the necromancers are still running wild in the south.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.105.50.0.com: "I see you understood my words correctly. At last I can get out of here. Do you wish to pass now?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.105.50.0.fir: "The mighty hero Elder stationed me here to let no one through. Only he can revoke his order! There is one possibility, though. If Elder were dead, I would no longer be bound to anyone. See what you can do about that."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.105.50.0.nex: "Elder has not revoked his order, nor have I heard that he is dead. So I will not let you through!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.108.48.0.com: "So you were not lying after all! All the Dragon Lord’s commanders are dead. Are you ready to learn a new spell that will help you cross the treacherous swamps to the southwest?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.108.48.0.fir: "I see you are a brave hero. This land is almost free of the Dragon Lord’s rule forever. Victory is within your grasp. But to complete your task, you must do something for me. I want to be certain that all the Dragon Lord’s commanders are dead, so bring me 10 of each of their mightiest warriors. If you do, I will teach you a spell to help you cross the treacherous swamps to the southwest. Without it, you will not complete your task."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.108.48.0.nex: "How can I believe that all the commanders are dead when you cannot carry out such a simple task as the one I gave you?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.3.10.0.compl: "I see you were not lying. Do you truly wish to leave this place?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.3.10.0.first: “Welcome, stranger. You claim to have come to help our kingdom? How do I know you speak the truth? If you are not lying, surely you can bring 4 Giants. Otherwise, I will not clear the way.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.3.10.0.nextV: “I made myself clear! Until you bring me 4 Giants, you will go no further!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.32.16.0.comp:
“At last! With the help of 10 Diamond Golems, the artifact will be finished in a few hours. Wait here; I will bring it to you shortly.”

And indeed, after several hours, the alchemist appears and hands you a mysterious orb set in a golden stand.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.32.16.0.firs:
An old alchemist welcomes you.
“I am glad someone willing to save our kingdom has finally been found. I think I have discovered a way to fight the Dragon Lord’s servants effectively. I could make you an artifact that suppresses their natural resistance to magic. But I lack workers. Please bring me 10 Diamond Golems. They are hardworking and can withstand a great deal.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.32.16.0.next: "Without those golems, I shall never finish the artifact. I need to perform some dangerous operations that only golems can withstand. So stop wasting time and find those golems."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.33.122.0.com: "Give me the dragon, and you may continue your journey."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.33.122.0.fir: “If you wish to pass, you must bring one Rust Dragon so I know you can handle dragons.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.33.122.0.nex: “I am sorry, but you cannot enter the monolith without a Rust Dragon.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.56.57.0.comp: "Our commander has already heard that Torrin is dead. You may now enter this territory whenever you wish."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.56.57.0.firs: “The ranger Torrin has plagued this land for a long time. I fear he could cause even more damage in the lands behind me than their own commander. So until Torrin dies, this region will remain closed to everyone.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.56.57.0.next: "No, no! As long as Torrin lives, no one passes this way."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.59.60.0.comp: "So you have come after all, Honza. Do you remember what my master told you? Do not open this passage until you have completely cleared this region. If you have already done so, however, you may pass."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.59.60.0.firs: A gremlin looks down at you from the tower. "My master ordered me to open the passage only for Honza. If you meet him, tell him that."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.59.60.0.next: "A pity. You are not Honza. I would be grateful if you told him to come here."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.63.60.0.comp: "So you have come after all, Květinka. Do you remember what my master told you? Do not open this passage until you have completely cleared this region. If you have already done so, however, you may pass."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.63.60.0.firs: The guards in the tower say their orders allow only Květinka to pass.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.63.60.0.next: “A pity, you are not Květinka. I would be grateful if you told her to come here.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.70.104.0.com: "I have heard that Stormbringer is dead. That means you do have some skill after all. Do you wish to pass now?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.70.104.0.fir: “Before the Titan King was imprisoned, he managed to build this tower to prevent the necromancers from spreading throughout the land. If you want to pit your strength against them, I must know you are no beginner. Prove it by bringing me the wizard Stormbringer’s head.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.70.104.0.nex: “I have not heard that Stormbringer has fallen. Return when you have dealt with him.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.70.90.0.comp: As soon as the Rust Dragons catch the scent of their future court mage, they are beside themselves with joy. They now welcome you without hesitation. They also tell you that, in return for what you have done, they will never support the Dragon Lord again.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.70.90.0.firs: The Rust Dragons have long been unfamiliar with magic. If you bring them a dragon to serve as their court mage, they will let you in.
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.70.90.0.next: The Rust Dragons are displeased with your failure and open their jaws at you threateningly. Do you really think failing the task will do you any good?
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.76.86.0.comp:
"Yes! That is it! Will you give it back to me now?

When you venture into the swamps, be careful! They are treacherous and very deep in places. But a seer lives to the northwest who can tell you how to cross them."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.76.86.0.firs: "I once owned a very valuable pendant, which I lost somewhere on the other side of these swamps. Until I get it back, I will not leave this spot."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.76.86.0.next: "You have not brought my pendant yet, so I am going nowhere!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.93.89.0.comp: "Word has reached me that Conqueror died a disgraceful death. Do you wish to pass now?"
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.93.89.0.firs: "Have you forgotten what I said? Do not open passages until you have cleared the previous region. I can let you through only when Conqueror is dead."
map.[sod] - honza 3:5.quest.93.89.0.next: “I hear Conqueror is still running wild in the northeast. I cannot let you through yet!”

map.[sod] - honza 3:5.town.116.71.0.name: 5th Fortress
To give your warriors some entertainment in their spare time, you authorised the construction of a tavern in town.

Honza had a strange dream during the night. His sons’ souls visited him, begging him to lift their curse. Their anguished wails sent chills down his spine. He woke drenched in sweat.
In the morning, he remembered the words of the hermit who had given him the sword. He realised that his sons had always obeyed his every word, and that even the curse had fallen upon them only because they were carrying out his orders. He decided then that as soon as he fulfilled his promise to the Titan King, he would begin searching for a way to free their souls.

The titan who persuaded Honza and Květinka to embark on this adventure has managed to recruit some warriors in a distant land. They arrived in your town during the night. They also brought resources the titan had gathered to support the war.
Last night’s terrible dream returned tonight. This surely cannot be a coincidence!
For the third night in a row, Honza had that dreadful dream. He then resolved once and for all to do everything he could to bring eternal peace to his sons’ souls.

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.0.descriptio:
The old seer led Honza to these lands. He waved his wrinkled hand, and a guard tower sealed the way back.
He waved again, and Honza felt terribly weak and tired. He realised that the seer had stripped him of all his strength and abilities.
Then the seer entrusted a peasant to him, saying he would lead Honza to a town where he could stay and which would serve as his base.
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.1.descriptio:
"Before I forget," says the seer, "if you remember, I once told you that you would have to start all over again. So, one more little thing."

The seer’s hand swept through the air once more, and Honza felt all his travelling bags of supplies collapse, empty.

"Now go and prove you are worthy of freeing your sons’ souls!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.10.descripti:
The seer’s scouts brought you little cheer with their news. Apparently, the commander of the denizens of hell returned to their main stronghold last week, but he came alone. His adjutant and army remained goodness knows where.
To avoid attracting attention, the scouts called off their search, as the sea is teeming with the enemy’s ships. They attack every vessel without warning, and the scouts’ light craft would stand no chance against them.
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.11.descripti:
"Honza, I am seriously concerned," the seer began as he appeared in your camp, "that the vial held by the leader of the denizens of hell may no longer be in this land. I have seen foreign messengers here. There is suspicious activity among them, and by all appearances they are planning something sinister. I simply do not yet know what. Perhaps it concerns the new base they are building."

This news does little to raise your spirits. Yet you trust yourself, your abilities, and your warriors to complete your task in the end.
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.12.descripti:
The old seer stopped by again for a moment.

“Forgive an old man’s failing memory,” he says. “Last time I was here, I forgot to tell you that my scouts discovered where the adjutant and his army went two months ago. He is hiding on one of the islands behind an elaborate defence system. Perhaps you already know that yourself. It merely occurred to me that he might have his leader’s vial.”
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.13.descripti:
Honza had a strange dream during the night. The seer appeared to him and said:

"Honza, so you cannot accuse me of being heartless, tomorrow when you wake your abilities will be much improved. You will be able to train your shooters better than ever before. Remember my words!"

He remembers nothing after that. On waking, he does indeed feel different, but he does not yet know what has happened to him. Perhaps he will discover it in time. The sooner, the better for him.
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.2.descriptio:
The old seer visited you today.

"Well? How are things?" he asked with a mischievous smile. "I told you it would not be easy! But from what I can see, you are doing reasonably well. Keep going, and perhaps your efforts will be crowned with success."
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.3.descriptio:
Your old acquaintance the seer visited again.

“Honza, I have learned that the enemy has begun building a secret base in a remote location. There is no need to worry yet. It will take at least half a year to finish. If you do not idle, you can complete your task by then. But do not delay too long, or you may regret it!”
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.4.descriptio:
After some time, the seer appeared again.

"Honza, construction of the new enemy base is proceeding at a dizzying pace. I think the enemy will finish it sooner than I expected. Still, I do not believe it will be ready for another two months. You should therefore begin exploring this land more widely. If you keep hanging around your base, you will never complete your task!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.5.descriptio: A month has passed since the old seer’s last visit. You thought he would appear again to hurry you along. But you watched for him in vain; the seer never came. The situation must be less serious than he tried to make you believe.
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.6.descriptio:
Just when you least expected it, the seer visited again.

"The situation is becoming critical," he began the moment he saw you. "Only a few weeks remain before the new enemy base is fully operational. Reliable sources have confirmed that it is well protected and you will be unable to attack it. Furthermore, the enemy has made an agreement with a villain just like himself to receive regular, sufficient reinforcements. Unless you complete your task very soon, you will be in for a rough time."
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.7.descriptio:
{"It has happened!"

You nearly fell off your chair in fright. The old seer burst into your tent like a storm wind.

"The last brick of the new enemy base was laid this morning. You can expect fresh enemy raids any day now. You have idled too long, Honza. Who knows whether you are capable of completing such a demanding task at all? Well, I shall see how you fare."
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.8.descriptio: You received a message from the old seer informing you that one of the vials you seek is in the town of the denizens of hell. The castle’s supreme commander apparently has some unusual plans for it, but unfortunately no one has discovered what they are. You should hurry before he does something with the vial.
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.event.9.descriptio: Terrible news. The seer himself came to tell you. A few hours ago, the supreme commander of the denizens of hell boarded a ship with his adjutant and a powerful army. The seer does not know where they went, as he lost them in the morning fog. He promised, however, to send his scouts to discover where the vial carried by their commander has gone.
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.guards.121.37.0.me:
No sooner do you touch the strange artifact than the old seer appears beside you again.

"Honza, you have successfully completed another part of your trial. I hope you will be just as successful in completing the rest of your task."

With these words, he vanishes, leaving no sign that he was ever here.

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.119.60.0.nex: "Still nothing? I am certain you will find the Pendant of Holiness in the end. Please keep looking. Remember the generous reward."

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.54.106.0.fir: "Once on my travels, I anchored by an island to replenish my drinking water. Behind a dark blue gate were some trolls shouting filthy insults at me. map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.54.106.0.nex: "Not much success so far, eh? Those trolls are still alive. As I told you, they are behind the dark blue gate."

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.55.13.0.next: "You do not have the Badge of Courage, which tells me you are not the person I may let through!"

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.63.67.0.firs: "I lost my livelihood as a seer because someone stole my Cards of Prophecy. Now I tend a herd of unicorns nearby. If you return those cards, I will give you my entire herd."
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.63.67.0.next: "I suppose I shall remain a herdsman all my life if no one can help me."

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.68.100.0.nex: "Are you not interested in my Golden Bow? I think I offered you a good deal. If you do not want it, do not come back!"

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.68.74.0.next: "No, no! I cannot return to my master without that servant!"

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.75.71.0.next: "You know the terms. Either bring me the Spyglass and get the dragons, or stop bothering me!"
map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.79.11.0.comp: As you approach the tower, one of the Mighty Gorgons lets out a long bellow. The guards panic immediately. They all flee headlong, with no thought of guarding anything. Nothing blocks your path now. Do you wish to continue?

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.79.11.0.next: The guards in the tower do not look willing to let you pass.

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.quest.90.86.0.next: "Have you not found the Charm of Mana yet? Never mind. Perhaps you will have better luck after all."

map.[sod] - honza 3:6.town.70.73.0.event:
A dusty messenger arrives at your base with a message from the old seer. You immediately break the seal and begin to read.

"Honza,
I have other duties, so I could not come in person. I merely wanted to tell you that you are doing fairly well so far. I should not do this, but I have decided to send you some warriors. They should reach your base sometime next week."

At dawn, the warriors the seer wrote about last week arrive at your base. They have even brought some supplies.
What is that old fox up to? What does he hope to achieve by helping you? What are his aims?
These are the questions that keep running through your mind. In the end, you decide not to think about it at all. You have been through worse. Besides, you will deal with problems when they come.
When the dwarves in your town heard of the disaster heading your way, they began to fear for their property. So they built a Treasury beside their dwelling.

map.[sod] - imperium.event.3.description:
And now for the story itself...
Josef Novák is an ordinary mortal of the twenty-first century, in which a suspicious group of Heroes players has seized control of the world. Returning home, he finds a reminder in his letterbox that he has not yet attended the “Heroes of Might and Magic 5” training course, compulsory for everyone aged 5 to 85. Furious, he decides to wipe out every last one of this breed with their own weapons. But it will not be easy...
map.[sod] - imperium.event.4.description:
From “Might and Glory”, the magazine published by the Heroes players’ sect, you learn that all might and glory this year has been entrusted to Hector, ruler of the eastern lands.
Defeat him and victory is yours! Otherwise, you will wander forever through a land plagued by tyranny.
map.[sod] - imperium.event.5.description: Through suspicious and certainly less than honest means, the seasoned Heroes players have managed to hack your account and drain your supplies...
map.[sod] - imperium.event.7.description: The rules of this map are very simple. You have one hero, whom you must not lose. Opposing you are the Heroes players, whom you must defeat to the last one. A special bonus is defeating the hero Hector, whose defeat also means victory for you.
map.[sod] - imperium.event.8.description: Many people have heard of your brave battles against the oppressors. They have decided to support your struggle against the Heroes players.
map.[sod] - imperium.event.9.description: The whole country, groaning under the rule of the Heroes players, is rooting for you. Keep it up...

map.[sod] - imperium.quest.11.18.0.first: You have finished your training. But are your shorts the right colour?
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.13.21.0.compl: That is more like it! Now you will really give those Heroes players what for!! Are you in?
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.13.21.0.first: The local sports club, {BOXING {UNIVERSE}, has decided to admit no one weaker than its champion. Anyone without both Attack and Defense at level 8 has no chance of passing.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.13.21.0.nextV: As soon as the trainer sees your condition, he loses his temper and roars: “Get to work, and come back when you have learned something!”
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.19.42.0.compl: Excellent, now the real fun begins.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.19.42.0.first: Ahh, Mr Josef Novák! You have not yet contributed to our St Nicholas party. If you wish to attend, you must bring two angels.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.20.42.0.compl: The caretaker leans out of the first-floor window and shouts: “If I were you, I would hide quickly. One of them was prowling around here a moment ago! Are you sure you want to go out there?”
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.20.42.0.first: You reach a battered, tower-shaped house and see a bleak, stony plain opening before you.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.20.42.0.nextV: The guards here allow only those fighting under the red flag to pass.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.29.43.0.compl: Well, since I promised, go on, then. Shall I open up?
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.29.43.0.first: Oh dear, the road is blocked, and the tower guard wants an Azure Dragon for his private menagerie. There is one somewhere nearby, but it will not be easy to find. You must bring it to him, or simply look for ANOTHER route.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.30.43.0.compl: Splendid, Nomad and his riders now rest in the eternal steppes. The passage is clear.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.30.43.0.first: The local ruler Nomad has plagued us for a long time. Whoever defeats him may pass freely.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.30.43.0.nextV: No chance. Destroy Nomad, and then we will see.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.50.31.0.compl: Do you wish to enter, O our new master?
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.50.31.0.first: We will reveal nothing we know; red is our colour!
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.67.63.0.first: Anyone who has not proved their courage in battle against Kal_kal will never pass this way.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.67.63.0.nextV: Your task is not yet complete.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.68.62.0.compl: You have proved your bravery in battle against Draque, so enter.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.68.62.0.first: Only someone who proves their worth in battle against Draque may pass this way.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.68.62.0.nextV: Our ears still hear the unbearable whistling of dragons. Go north and destroy their master.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.69.62.0.compl: Excellent, Leki and his demons are destroyed, so you may enter.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.69.62.0.first: As long as the hero Leki of Mageo lives, no one passes this way.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.69.65.0.first: Anyone wishing to visit Hector must fight under the red flag and understand that this will be the last thing they ever do :)
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.70.63.0.compl: Do you wish to enter, then, my lord?
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.70.63.0.first: This gate will open only when we learn that the hero Quetzalcoatl now rests on the field of honour and glory...
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.70.63.0.nextV: No, no, Quetzalcoatzl is still alive.
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.71.11.0.compl: Certain death awaits you beyond this tower! Do you wish to enter?
map.[sod] - imperium.quest.71.11.0.first: An old watchman peers out of the hut and immediately begins: “You have the right banner, but I advise you to hurry away while there is still time. You can complete your task another way.”
map.[sod] - imperium.sign.1.27.0.message: Anyone following this forest path will get something...

map.[sod] - imperium.sign.34.18.0.messag: Welcome to Mageo Castle. Admission is free, but things occasionally CRASH here. So mind your head.

!!! We will never forget !!!

!

map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.0.descri: The trade unionists demand the swift occupation of every mine in the region to create more jobs.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.1.descri: The Opposition Agreement has been terminated, and the time has come for a fierce struggle for supremacy over the entire Czech Republic. Klaus, chief of the Blue Bird tribe, and Zeman, chief of the Red Rose tribe, have equal chances of becoming the Great Guru of our great and glorious Czech superpower.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.10.descr: Your starting town is Ostrava, where you crushed Klaus in the elections. Now you begin advancing into the western territories.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.11.descr: The third week of fighting draws to a close. The war-weary populace has risen throughout the country and even looted your rich and luxurious residence in the capital. In monetary terms, the losses are considerable.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.12.descr:
The citizens of the occupied territory have decided to proclaim you Zeman the Great, emperor of the entire Czech Empire and a demigod.
The coronation cost you 3500 Kč, but it was worth it. Becherovka flowed freely, female members of the Social Democratic Party danced on tables, and your weary soldiers gained the resolve to fight more decisively.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.13.descr: The merciless struggle has lasted more than a month now. While you devoted yourself to the holy war against Zeman, treacherous asset-strippers sneakily robbed you of your hard-earned savings.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.14.descr: A secret sect of bat-dropping worshippers infiltrated the entire territory, intending to burn themselves in a ritual. Using every available resource, you managed to put them out, but you must pay the firefighters something.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.15.descr: More supplies have disappeared into the pockets of greedy asset-strippers. You must do something about it!
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.16.descr: The unions are draining ever larger subsidies. Hurry; once you take the throne, you will put a stop to them!
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.2.descri: As you have surely noticed, you have only 3 capable politicians at your disposal. Under their chief’s leadership, they will mercilessly destroy their colleagues from the Chamber of Deputies. If all of them are defeated, however, your party faces a grim end. No one else wants to do work as dirty as politics...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.3.descri: Welcome, Klaus, great and ever-infallible chairman of ODS. Your journey to even greater glory and a larger bank balance begins.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.4.descri:
A message arrives from your rival Zeman: “You arrogant asset-stripper, revenge is in my... hic... hands... hic.”

Such injustice has rightly angered your loyal and honest businessmen. They have decided to overcome their stinginess and give you a little support.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.5.descri: Thanks to your clever tax policy, you introduced Wednesday tax collection. Soon, however, no one was paying, so you collected a miserable thousand.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.6.descri: You begin in your stronghold, Prague. It is up to you whether you annex the eastern territories and destroy Zeman.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.7.descri: Welcome, Zeman, great chairman of the glorious Social Democratic Party and tireless drinker of Mr Becher’s divine liqueur. Your journey begins, at the end of which you will personally strangle Klaus with his own tasteless tie.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.8.descri: Your spies in the People’s House have reported that Klaus’s thugs raided them, and they must withdraw immediately. All the fugitives offer you their services.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.event.9.descri: Operation Clean Hands has produced its first results. The last thousand has been saved for the state treasury.
Here near the Dutch border, the place is crawling with drug addicts.
You have entered no man’s land, and a Polish customs checkpoint stands before you...
Polish profiteers hide their goods here near the border, but they will not surrender them willingly.
A few louts are guarding it. Will you show them the strength of a representative of the ruling party?
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.11.54.0: Surely you cannot leave this lying here. You are about to take the bow when several former Sudeten Germans appear. They are having a picnic and eating eintopf. The terrible stench of this delicacy compels you to put them out of their misery. Will you take their bow?
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.11.59.0: You slowly approach the border fortress of Rozvadov. German tourists drive their wagons out of Bohemia at a gallop, having lost all appetite for the further delights the country has prepared for them. In the distance stands the customs house, guarded by officers who love to make a meal of anyone...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.13.59.0: Camping in the forest, in winter, in the border zone? They will freeze! Better confiscate everything, then march on, pleased with this clever economic move.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.17.60.0: Those Vietnamese stallholders and their dwarves again—and they are not all made of plaster, either...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.18.47.0: Hmm, it would suit you. An infallible head like yours deserves a royal crown. But the miners from the nearby mines are furious with you. Quite rightly, incidentally. Now you can decide whether to take that ornament from them.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.19.54.0: Medieval festivals are taking place at Žebrák and Točník. At first, the actors are suspicious, but once you deal with a few loudmouths at the entrance, they stop making a fuss and support your struggle against the left with their resources.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.20.37.0: Several foreign-speaking pimps of those priestesses of love suddenly emerge from the roadside bushes and demand money. “What about payment, boss?” They look far from friendly. This looks like quite a brawl!
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.20.65.0: The abandoned sawmill in the Bohemian Forest would be useful. But the King of the Bohemian Forest wants payment; otherwise, he will lead you and your entire army into the swamps...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.21.53.0: Unbelievable, admission to Karlštejn now costs 200! Worse still, there are German tourists with German shepherds here, and you must fight your way past them to take the tour.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.22.14.0: The camp guards are alert and thoroughly German in their diligence...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.22.39.0: A sword forged from the red glow over this region is thrust into the ground. But the trade unionists will not simply hand it over.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.28.52.0: Prague is within reach. Alarm bells ring from every church, and the rotten capitalists muster for one last desperate battle against you, saviour and redeemer of the entire Czech Empire. From the underground dungeons come the desperate cries of Social Democrats and trade unionists suffering terrible torments. They await deliverance at the hands of the red messiah!
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.29.47.0: The local farmers want nothing to do with any Prague types...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.31.99.0: A group of Austrian border guards fleeing in panic from the local fanatical barbarian hordes will join anyone...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.33.64.0: A group of drunks, “Budvar consumers”, stands outside the South Bohemian Mining Company’s mine, demanding admission fees! As you can see, they have already relieved someone of an interesting artifact today. Defeat them, and it is yours.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.35.55.0: Ever since your clever economic policy introduced tolls on the D1 motorway, money has poured into the sacred state treasury. But the collector is on holiday somewhere in the Jizera Mountains and took the key with him. You must do something about it...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.36.33.0: Those stallholders again. Fortunately, only a few dwarves are guarding the place...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.38.26.0: Look what the tourists are throwing away. There will be a scene when the environmental activists catch them! But what is this? The activists are already here, claiming it for themselves. Will you show them who is in charge?
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.38.34.0: The asset-stripped Boleslav car factory has switched to a different, more profitable line of production. But admission still has to be paid.
Germany is a rich country. Gold lies in the streets here.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.40.29.0: But what is this? A thoroughly enraged brothel owner whose business you ruined leaps from the bushes onto the road, demanding blood. Yet you cannot die now. Surely you are destined for higher things, so you order the attack.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.47.43.0: Hradec Králové, seat of the once-mighty Christian Democratic tribe that plagued the region around the Elbe for years, awaits conquest by your powerful armies...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.49.25.0: Those activists again. And with Polish accents, too.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.49.43.0: The Christian Democratic tribe’s elite military units have blocked the road to their tribal headquarters.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.56.58.0: Do not imagine such an important mine is unguarded. Quite the contrary: it is controlled by Viktor Kamenný’s dubious company, Harward Capital & Mining...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.61.44.0: Anyone could use this, but a few local textile workers who made it are guarding it.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.67.41.0: This would be useful against Klaus, but it is well guarded. Many local inhabitants guard it, using this artifact to defend their mountains against the influx of tourists.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.69.37.0: Surprisingly, no one is guarding this place. The guards have probably got drunk on the notorious local beer, HOLBA.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.69.77.0: A few rather unfriendly policemen guard the entrance to the legendary Špilberk. “Get out of here; you have no business here! We are guarding an important prisoner.” But you are kind by nature, and you will free the poor fellow.
You have glimpsed the immense riches spread across the vast German lands.
But the Staatspolizei will not give them up so easily!
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.72.86.0: They want nothing to do with Czech scum here. The river border police will not let you through, either on a diplomatic passport or for a bribe of a case of Becherovka!
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.73.53.0: Unfortunately, the local fishermen will not hand it over. Will you take it from them?
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.76.68.0: Unfortunately, the local authorities on the western bank of the Morava have no intention of letting you through. Unless, of course, you carry out extensive tax reform and ease the burden on the hard-pressed businessmen. Only an analyst at Red Keymaster Tent knows what they have in mind. That company prefers not even to be based in the Czech Republic, having settled in a business paradise: the Slovak Empire.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.76.87.0: Dear customers, our company, Red Keymaster Tent Slovakia, provides macroeconomic analysis at the very reasonable price of 3500 golden Slovak crowns...
Your armies have come within firing range of Bratislava, the proud seat of Mečiar I, scourge of the Czech Empire’s eastern borders. You can already make out the mighty castle, the impregnable seat of King Mečiar I, before whom both the partisans of the Tatras and wild Hungarian raiders trembled.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.77.45.0: Oh no, those trade unionists again. They should be on your side...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.79.64.0: The military academy in Vyškov has prepared a welcome for you. You will take part in a little war game, and if you win, you may continue.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.81.28.0: On the road to Wrocław, the Polish police catch you speeding. Even diplomatic immunity will not help.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.84.42.0: You are reaching for a hat to cover your spreading bald patch when several tough lads emerge from the bushes and lay claim to it. Will you teach them a lesson?
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.88.58.0: As you approach southern Moravia along the motorway, the police stop you for speeding. There is no point arguing; you could end up like Sládek in Špilberk, so you pay an exorbitant fine.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.89.72.0: This is bad. You confiscated the wealth that Zlín’s businessmen stole from the working people, but hired Chechen mafiosi have ambushed you.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.89.86.0: Damn it. No sooner do your armies head south than thousands of missiles rain down from the surrounding mountains, and hordes of partisans charge towards you with a mighty roar, having mistaken you for the Slovak ruler’s secret police!
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.91.70.0: The businessmen of Zlín will not give up their gold so easily.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.91.77.0: Near Uherské Hradiště, archaeologists have unearthed an interesting little object, but they will not part with it. Will you use force against those intellectuals?
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.92.94.0: What a sight... It looks as though there could be environmental activists here too. But no, they were all hanged from these trees, which were then ritually felled in honour of the god-king Mečiar I.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.97.43.0: And... another Polish black market—but perhaps they have something interesting.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.97.65.0: All those stumps everywhere! The owner of this sawmill must be some ruthless businessman, but he will feel the iron strength of social democracy...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.98.78.0: Business is booming in Slovakia too. But everyone must pay trade tax. Especially Czech scum.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.guards.99.58.0: Your troops approach Ostrava. You can already make out the tall, smoking chimneys of its mighty factories, where Zeman burns captured businessmen for fuel. All your loyal followers are filled with determination to put an end to the accursed Social Democratic Party once and for all!
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.header.descrip: Two political parties vie for power in the Czech Republic: the Social Democrats, led by the hero Zeman, and ODS, led by the hero Klaus. Which will triumph and cast the other onto the rubbish heap of history?
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.header.name: Klaus & Zeman
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.140.bio: Sládek is a very popular hero who was imprisoned in Špilberk for talking back to King Havel I. His aim is to form a removal crew to deport troublesome tribes from the Czech Empire far to the northeast, to the Land of Eternal Winter, or have them thrown into the sacred little Vltava River.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.141.bio: Ruml chairs the demonic association known as the Freedom (or Lack Thereof) Union. He is grateful to you for freeing him from the correctional institution where he suffered as a member of the 3rd resistance.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.20.biog: Former chief of the tribe inhabiting the regions south of the Czech Empire.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.20.name: Wranitzky
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.45.biog: The new and ambitious Austrian chief Haider will expand eastward.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.45.name: Haider
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.49.biog: Helmut Kohl is chief of the great Germanic tribe inhabiting the lands west of the Czech Republic’s borders.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.49.name: Kohl
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.53.biog: Mečiar is chairman of HZDS and lord of the mighty eastern realm of Slovakia. Distinguishing feature: an innate aversion to "Czech scum".
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.53.name: Mečiar
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.6.biogr: Macek is Klaus’s chief adviser on tooth extraction.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.6.name: Macek
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.60.biog: Adenauer is Kohl’s elderly predecessor, who helps him spread German culture to all the weaker countries nearby.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.60.name: Adenauer
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.62.biog: Kováč is a former Slovak ruler who was consigned to the rubbish heap of history because the common Mečiar won the competition within the Slovak species.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.62.name: Kováč
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.73.biog: Buzková is a rebellious vassal of King Zeman I who was pardoned in exchange for 1 hectolitre of genuine Karlovy Vary liquor.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.73.name: Buzková
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.75.biog: Zeman has chaired the Social Democratic Party for many years. His greatest achievement so far was winning the election in northern Moravia, where he also has his headquarters. He is determined to bring the Czech Republic under his control at any cost, then fix the price of Becherovka once and for all at approximately 4,50 per litre.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.75.name: Zeman
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.79.biog: Standa Gross is Zeman I’s successor to the Czech throne... If he manages to secure it, that is.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.79.name: Gross
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.8.biogr: Klaus heads ODS. He is the party’s sole and sovereign master, punishing all internal rivals with lifelong exile. His deputy Ruml was the latest to suffer this fate; he fled Klaus’s wrath and founded the 4coalition together with KDU-ČSL. Klaus is absolutely, truly absolutely determined to bring the entire Czech Republic under his control.
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.8.name: Klaus
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.9.biogr: This individual has not provided a biography... What could be behind that?
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.heroes.9.name: Benešová
A single German lesson here costs 100 DEM. Such cheek offends your thrifty nature, and you decide to show them what is what...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.monster.101.45: Here begins the Republic of Poland, and the customs officers are very officious and intrusive...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.monster.102.48: The Czech customs officers will join your armies...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.monster.104.14: Remnants of the crusaders still roam the region...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.monster.104.44: Shall we buy something at the Polish market? But the local police are conducting a raid and have come after us too...
Karlovy Vary is a rich town, but at present only the Russian mafia squeezes money out of it. They completely ignore your claims to be Klaus I the Infallible, ruler of the Czech Republic...
The trade unionists striking outside the Sokolov mines clearly do not like you much...
Prague types have no business here in Plzeň!
German customs checks are fairly strict too, and they will not let just anyone into the Fatherland...
These tough lads somehow refuse to recognise one-party rule by ODS.
Hmm, as you slowly approach Dubí, your men begin yearning for some fun with the lovely local maidens... They want more than the usual price, but you will make them see reason...
This gold is solely for the internal needs of our poor, wretched mendicant order.
You will find no favour in northern Bohemia, Klaus, and the trade unionists are making that quite clear.
A group of People’s Police officers guards the entrance to the National German Geographical Institute...
The river border police are alert...
Environmental activists crowd the gates of Temelín, nailing one another to the gate. But the moment they see you, they all rush at you shouting "Down with Temelín" and "Back to the trees".
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.monster.26.102: A group of tough Alpine highlanders guards this place...
map.[sod] - klaus & zeman.monster.3.62.0: No, this belongs to the First German Bank!
A fierce battle has erupted in the streets of České Budějovice between the owners of the "Budvar" brewery and their American competitors. The brewers join you, hoping you will defeat the foreigners.
The local miners do not like the government trying to seize their mines, especially since it will surely sell them to the Germans afterwards! "You will not get this for free, you extortionist," they shout over one another...
The American businessmen hired the Abkhaz mafia, who occupied both the brewery and the port through which the beer is exported worldwide.
All of Boleslav is paralysed by a strike of local hauliers. They have even blockaded the local barracks.
Camping in the Jizera Mountains is great, but the tourists do not take kindly to people peering into their tents.
Hmm, it seems the closer you get to the border, the more opportunities there are for fun with the local priestesses of love...
Well, really, surely I do not have to pay admission to every battlefield as well!
The Christian Democratic tribe’s elite military units have blocked the road to their tribal headquarters.
Those German tourists occupying the lucrative tourist region of the Giant Mountains again. Still, it is wealthy here...
The Austrian customs officers on the Dyje will not let you through!
A group of local natives protects this little lake in the Eagle Mountains and will not surrender it easily.

Southern Moravia is a rich land, but its pious inhabitants want nothing to do with some Social Democrat...

Several heavyweight businessmen block the road to southern Moravia!

map.[sod] - krev hrdiny.event.1.descript: Your scouts have discovered another castle of your race hidden on the far side of the island. It is lightly guarded, but most importantly, it has a tavern. There you are sure to find more adventurers eager to join your search for the Grail and, of course, your battles against the other heroes, who would gladly slit your throat around the next corner. You must therefore stay alert and never underestimate your rivals. They are just as cunning as you.
map.[sod] - krev hrdiny.header.descripti: The most famous and powerful heroes of every race throughout the land have set out for the Antarian Reaches in search of the Holy Grail. map.[sod] - krev hrdiny.header.rumor.0.t: An obelisk bearing a piece of the map is hidden on every island of the Antarian Reaches. But local dragons guard it to keep the secret from falling into the wrong hands.
map.[sod] - krev hrdiny.header.rumor.1.t: Unfortunately, seven other races have arrived here besides yours, with very powerful heroes who share your goal. You should waste no time. Try to conquer the island where you have settled as soon as possible, then set out for the others, for they too hold hidden obelisks.
map.[sod] - krev hrdiny.header.rumor.2.t: You have heard that ships are sailing from your enemies' homelands to join them. You wonder what cargo they might carry, but your spies could not find out. You will just have to hope it is nothing dreadful. :o)

map.[sod] - kurforst.event.1.description:
Legends tell of a man who attended the Project X party.

The legends also confirm that he is near Minas Morgul, the Black Kingdom from the legends of The Lord of the Rings. He is asking for help. Set him free.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.10.descriptio: Legends tell of dragons known to very few. They are said to guard the route through a portal into a dark land.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.11.descriptio: My lord, scouts report that someone has enchanted the gates on the borders of our territory, turning them into a gate whose key we must find before we can leave the country.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.12.descriptio: Excellent news! The nation likes the idea you presented at the great council, and the people are already helping to develop your kingdom. They hope you will later share some resources from other territories with them as well.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.13.descriptio: My lord, we now know how to reach our enemies. Those dragons guard not only the road to the Black Land, but also the way to tents of various colours. If we succeed, we will later be able to enter anywhere.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.2.description: The Varks are a race who love nature and believe in higher beings. Your task is to rid the land of your opponents, or at least drive them out of your territory, for the Varks have always been peaceful rather than quarrelsome.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.3.description: Rektus, also known as the giants/orcs, are a race respected throughout the world. However, they resent the insults of three nations, and have therefore decided to unite and fight everyone. (This nation knows only two words... Sword and death.)
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.4.description: Varquis, also known as the destroyers. This race destroys nature and entire territories alike. They have plunged their land into eternal winter and frost. They are called mages and delight in spells and sorcery. They would gladly smother the whole world in snow, for they have grown very accustomed to winter and believe in the coming of Santa.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.5.description: Marton is an ancient race made up of intriguing jungle creatures. Very little is known about the Martons, for they never attended gatherings of kings and kept to their own territory. They still believe in what they were given and give thanks for it. They hope others will also leave them in peace and avoid provoking disputes.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.6.description: Kaqusto, also known as the underground kingdom. It spans an immense territory beneath the earth. They command their territory very, very well. Few can even force a draw against them, let alone win.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.7.description: Ugqost, also known as the elves. The Ugqost are among the most decent races in this world. They love nature deeply and use only its riches. They are reliable and very selfless, always happy to help. When it comes to trade, no one surpasses them.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.8.description: Excelent is the kingdom of the elements. The elementals are the pride of this land, and are not to be trifled with. People rarely ask them for anything, for if they fail to repay their debt, the earth begins to rebel: the elementals are the very force of the earth. They are difficult to fight, yet some still enjoy provoking them and challenging them to battle.
map.[sod] - kurforst.event.9.description: Islands raised from the ocean floor. Long ago, a kingdom flourished here, but after several thousand years a natural disaster flooded the land. At last, after ten thousand years, the islands rose above the surface once more, bearing only the kingdom's ruins. You can rebuild them.

map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.event.0.desc:
You sit in a soft armchair, watching the fire crackle in the hearth, occasionally sipping tea from the mug in your hand, and thinking. Footsteps sound. You turn and see your master approaching. He settles into the chair opposite and begins to speak. He tells you about a remote little town called Willovbend, on the edge of Deadman's Marsh. "Rumours have reached me of trouble among the people of Willovbend. They say the marsh has begun expanding incredibly quickly, forcing them to abandon some houses because the ground has become unstable. The town must also withstand attacks by marsh creatures never seen there before. The marsh itself is said to have grown more treacherous and dangerous, though no one knows why."
You offer to look into it. "I expected nothing less of you, Rozcheval. Set out, then. You know I would gladly accompany you, but the monastery and my age bid me remain here."
In the morning you saddle your horse, and your master bids you farewell. After two days' riding, you reach the town.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.event.1.desc: Several passers-by you meet in the street confirm your master's account. The marsh is indeed expanding at an unprecedented rate. The villagers fear they too will soon lose their homes and beg you to help. You explain that this is precisely why you have come, and they willingly lead you through the village to the edge of the marsh...
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.event.2.desc:
Welcome, player! 
This is the first released demo of the forthcoming campaign {Great Deeds} {of Olden Times}. It is a fully playable map, and I hope you enjoy it. Since I recently became the owner of Heroes 4, you may well encounter the campaign itself there. 
Have fun.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.11.12: The path ahead is completely shrouded in fog. You have a bad feeling about this...
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.11.34:
Ah, at last the fog is clearing. But something is moving at its edge...
Some kind of lizard? No, it's bigger. Good heavens, it's a... HYDRA!!!! You cannot slip past without at least one head noticing you. You will have to fight it, but the outcome is written in the stars.
The skeleton is half submerged in mud. It has undoubtedly lain here a long time. The smell of decay is barely noticeable in the air. Nearby, a snakeskin bag is caught on a branch. You take it down and open it. There is nothing inside but a scroll of paper. You break the seal and examine the writing. It resembles the language of the dark elves of Haal'run. But what would desert elves be doing in a swamp?
If it is indeed that language, the scroll reads as follows: 

 Kylroen, 
               I think I finally have the right formula for controlling -the next word is illegible-... If this experiment succeeds, they will be left forever where they can harm no one. I am placing them in a chest... -the rest of the letter is in a different script, unknown to you-

You can only guess what it means.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.15.51: The old mill wheel creaks, and water races through the millrace. The miller is a cheerful fellow, so you stay a while. He suggests taking a trip out onto the lake. A fisherman told him that a strange gate stands on a small island near the shore. That is worth investigating.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.17.42: "BOO!!" comes a sudden cry from the bushes, followed by a quiet chuckle. You reach into the bushes and lift the hobbit who was mocking you by his collar. Then you throw him into a nearby pool and continue on your way. The hobbit climbs out, gives you the finger and scampers into the undergrowth. Kylroen sees this and chuckles, while Nolcius dryly observes that good manners will probably be in very short supply here.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.18.23: "Hssss, sisters, look at him. His flesh must be tender," comes a voice from the mist, and three strange beings emerge to meet you.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.21.14:
The water in the pool suddenly begins swirling and bubbling. A tentacle shoots from the water and wraps around your leg. Instinctively you fall backwards and slash at it with all your strength. A hideous head rises from the pool, and the loathsome Grendel reaches towards you with more tentacles. You quickly sever the one gripping your leg and slide out of reach of two more. Then you stand and hurl your sword at Grendel's head with all your might. It instantly pierces the brownish skin and lodges deep in the monster's brain. Grendel writhes in his death throes, and you imagine what your master would say: "He won't think of attacking us again. You've given him such a splitting headache, the poor creature must be in two minds about it." You smile.
Grendel has meanwhile fallen silent, so you search his pool. In one skeleton's cloak, you find a small statuette.
Well, look, a crypt. Pools and mud surround it. Whoever owns this little place probably avoids company, and if he kills anyone, the mud will never give them up. Practical.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.25.13: Could this be a secret path?
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.25.50: Kylroen tells you that you are approaching a small settlement of fishermen and hunters. He doubts they can be of much use to you, but a trip on the lake might be worthwhile. Nolcius shakes his head at this reasoning and remarks that he would prefer a nice dry library to rowing back and forth across a lake. Kylroen promptly asks whether the learned gentleman knows of any libraries in the immediate vicinity, and Nolcius falls silent in defeat.
You open the old, moss-covered door and a musty draught washes over you. Whatever is in here has not come out for a long time. Cautiously, you descend stone steps cut into black rock. You reach a door, throw it open and peer into a spacious room. Several tables stand inside, covered in parchments and scrolls densely inscribed with writing you cannot understand.
There are also several open books written in runes. A pentagram drawn on the wall radiates a strange warmth. This looks like a true wizard's lair.
Another small door stands in the north wall. You pass through into another hall. A hexagram is carved into the floor of black tiles. Judging by the charred furniture and scorched floor, a fight clearly took place here. Someone botched a spell, probably a demon summoning, and then fought the result.
Hmm.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.28.41: You had a fine time, but when it came to paying, you were rather reluctant. When you saw the pimp slowly draw his weapon, however, you changed your mind.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.28.54: According to Kylroen, a renowned collector of all manner of things should be living down here.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.3.2.0: You pass the last house in Willovbend, and an endless sea of greenery opens before you. A narrow, seldom-used path winds between the trees deeper into the marsh. You set off along it.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.32.16: The ancient lizardfolk have eked out a peaceful existence here since the dawn of their race. They are not hostile, merely a little suspicious, but after a while you win their affection.
You force the door and find an old wizard in one of the rooms, staring dejectedly out of a window. When he sees you, he suddenly jumps up and dances joyfully around the room. He must have been here a long time. After a while he falls at your feet and thanks you. You learn that his name is Kylroen, and that beings from another world captured him and his companion and locked them in this building, which seems to block magic. His friend nevertheless managed to escape, but he remained. Later, his friend sent word that he was trying to seal the beings in a container, so far without success.
The mage is convinced that he must accompany you on your travels in return.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.4.3.0: You turn back one last time and duck beneath the low branches.
The sound of dripping water echoes throughout the cave.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.44.41: A small shack stands amid the tangled trees. Before you can approach, three ruffians emerge, curse and charge at you.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.45.60: You cut a claw from the dead beast as a souvenir.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.46.45: Well, look, a gnoll has set up shop here. Judging by the shabby state of his store, business cannot be going very well.
Suddenly you hear heavy footfalls, seemingly all around you. But that must be your imagination. In this fog, you simply cannot tell exactly where they come from. Drawing on your paladin's abilities, you barely dodge an axe blade that would otherwise have taken your head off. A minotaur emerges from the mist and swings at you again with a roar. You must defend yourself.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.5.9.0:
BZZZZZZ!!
Damn it, the flies are swarming!
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.50.11:
Beside a small pool stands a hooded man. The flame of the candle he holds flickers in the draught, casting terrifying shadows across the cavern walls. You approach and tap him lightly on the shoulder.
"Ah, what are you doing here? Go away and leave me alone!" He throws a purse of gold at your feet. You explain that you are no brigand, but a paladin who has come to solve the mystery of {Deadman's {Marsh}. At first he doubts you, but when you show him the seal of the temple in Yoolyn, he believes. He introduces himself as Nolcius, a sage and scholar seeking peace here for meditation and study. He agrees to join you. You return his purse, but he refuses it. What is his is now yours as well, he says.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.50.18: Well, Master Nolcius has built himself a little retreat here... A truly dedicated scholar, if he can think even in the adverse conditions of a damp underground cavern.
You have a strange feeling that something is watching you.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.59.14:
And indeed it is. Watching you from the bushes behind you is... a little yellow pig.
The sight unsettles you somewhat. Pigs aren't yellow!
The pig emerges from the undergrowth and introduces himself as Ignác of Haal'run. Your head spins. A yellow, talking pig who claims to come from the deserts.
This is too much even for you. Your vision darkens, and you collapse before the astonished pig. You awaken a little later, propped against a tree, and see that the pig was no illusion. He is pulling your sword from the mud. You call to him, and you chat. You learn that he is searching the marsh for a nice wallowing hole, but unfortunately there is little peace for mud baths here, so he intends to return home. You ask how he protects himself from potential attackers. The pig smiles, bids you farewell and vanishes. VANISHES BEFORE YOUR VERY EYES!! This is maddening.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.59.52: The monastery's monks welcome you. It was they who discovered Dyenor's madness. You stay a while and enjoy the monastery's hospitality. When you leave, a few younger brothers join you, led by their master.
Damn, fog. Well, it had to happen sooner or later.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.60.40: An unusual building. Demonic gargoyles adorn its walls, and balconies and terraces are everywhere. A figure in a dark red robe stands on the highest gallery. One of the elves lends you a spyglass, and you see that the figure's eyes are closed as he recites something. He raises his hands, and you see energy pulsing within them. But something must have gone wrong: the figure suddenly jerks, and the energy disperses into the surroundings, briefly enveloping the entire tower. This cleric is truly mad, toying with spells he cannot control and endangering both himself and everything around him.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.61.24: Glowing runes cover the box, and the whole thing seems to pulse with energy.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.61.39: Resolutely, you lead your troops towards the gate, draw your sword and cry: "Come now, my faithful followers! Onward! Let this tower fall and blacken with our enemies' blood!"
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.67.35: This plain was formed by escaping magical energy.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.guards.71.63: The dwarves in the fortress are delighted that someone has finally found the courage to stand against Dyenor, and quickly join you.
Well, well. Those little creatures had a little treasure hidden here... Now it's yours.
You hear bubbling in a nearby pool, but nothing happens yet.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.header.descr: You are a man of honour and courage, a paladin. For a long time you heard unfounded tales of {Deadman's {Marsh} and ignored them. But one day your teacher and friend told a similar story, so you decided to discover the truth of it...
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.header.name: Mist over the Marshes
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.heroes.40.bi: A mad wizard and cleric whose actions have made Deadman's Marsh a danger to Willovbend.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.heroes.6.bio: A young paladin seeking to learn the unknown. He roams the world in search of mysterious or frightening places and phenomena. Most recently he set out for Deadman's Marsh to investigate the tales surrounding it.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.heroes.8.bio: Nolcius is a truly dedicated member of the scholars' guild. His latest exploit was to enter Deadman's Marsh in search of peace for contemplation.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.heroes.88.bi: While experimenting with magic, he opened a rift into another world. Strange beings invaded through it and imprisoned him and his friend in a fortress they had built.

map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.monster.23.5: No good, lad. They're not biting today.

map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.monster.29.4: Come on, I'm waiting just for you. Aaaaah aaaaaaah ooooh....
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.monster.45.6: A behemoth has climbed down from the rocks to drink. He must be famished, to charge at you the moment you appear...

map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.monster.63.7: "That's him! This stranger will lead us against the dark mage!" cries an elf. Seeing your puzzled expression, he explains: "The lord of this region, the wizard and cleric Dyenor, has gone mad. Several years ago he began magical experiments with horrific effects on the marsh. His creations gather there and commit vile deeds. His magic has also caused the marsh to expand..." You understand. That wizard is responsible for the deaths of the people of Willovbend whose houses the swamp swallowed! Determined to put an end to him, you agree to lead the elves against him!
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.monster.66.7: Ho there, greetings. I stand watch at the monolith, but I can see you pose no threat to our people. Come with me to the village. Our chieftain will surely welcome you.
map.[sod] - mlha na blatech.monster.9.40: A hiss sounds, and three medusas surge from the undergrowth.
You knock, and after a while you enter. "Oh, you again? What is it this time, gentlemen?" the collector asks rather unwelcomingly. You unfasten your backpack and take out a piece of behemoth claw. The collector's face lights up, and he invites you further inside. He hurries to a chest by the wall and takes out a dangerous-looking flail. "It is enchanted and will increase your strength," he explains.

You knock, and after a while a voice calls: "It's unlocked. Come in." You enter a small, modest antechamber whose walls are lined with dozens of different trophies, such as gorgon horns and a wyvern's sting. Whoever lives here must be a truly passionate collector. You talk for a while, and then he makes an offer: "My collection is renowned indeed, yet one trophy still eludes me. I would surely find a fitting reward if you helped me. You see, I would dearly love a behemoth claw, but since those creatures do not live nearby, I still lack one. So if you find one anywhere, bring it here, and we shall discuss the price."
The collector is a little disappointed, but does not show it and invites you in for a cup of tea.
Oh, thank you. I hope you dealt with him as he deserved, and that the mud swallowed his bones. Please give it to me. In return for your services, I will gladly teach you something of the magical arts.

Friend, you must have passed through that devilish marsh. Tell me, did you meet a tall man in unmarked plate armour?
That thief stole my sash one night recently. Please, traveller, can you help me?
Keep searching, friend, and do not lose hope.

That artifact is just there to tease you-:)
