map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.event.1.descrip:
And now, about this map.
Above all, remember that it is part of a larger whole. Nevertheless, it is a complete map that can be played and, most importantly, finished.

The version included in the campaign is, of course, slightly different from the standalone version. It has a few extra quests, some altered terrain, enemies and so on.

Your goal is to bring the main heroine, Rebeca, to the Ice Tower, rising above the waters of Misty Lake. The name is fitting, for the entire lake is constantly shrouded in mist that shifts as though it had a life of its own.
But the way is not direct. You must complete many quests before you stand before the mysterious tower's gates.

Good luck.

"Greetings! I know why you are here. One of our people stole your sacred relic. Know that from that moment he became an outcast to us as well. He may wear our town's colours, but we no longer consider him one of us. He returned here, but we drove him out. We want no quarrel with you. As far as I know, he rode somewhere south. Perhaps to Hot Spring. Now leave. Our town has done no wrong, so go pursue the thief instead of trying to breach our walls! Farewell!"
The dwarf signals, and the gate opens a little to let him return. At once, archers appear on the walls with bows drawn.

map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.header.descript: Hidden in the frozen wastes, Misty Lake has been shrouded in mystery for ages. Perhaps the answers to many questions lie here. But before Rebeca uncovers the secret of the Ice Tower, she must face many trials.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.header.name: Misty Lake
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.148.biog: Rebeca de Lirium - the last living descendant of the de Lirium family.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.148.name: Rebeca
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.26.biogr: A thief whose name no one knows, but who had the sheer nerve to steal a relic from your monastery.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.26.name: Thief
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.28.biogr: The mayor of Goldmine is an honourable dwarf.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.28.name: Mayor
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.40.biogr: Yes, this man alone can help you find the way to the Ice Tower. He has roamed Misty Lake on his flying steed for ages, and surely knows the secret route.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.40.name: Pilgrim
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.6.biogra: An ordinary drunkard who stumbles from one scrape into another thanks to his love of alcohol.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.6.name: Dug
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.72.biogr: The immortal spirit of the Ice Plains has roamed this land for ages.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.72.name: Ice Spirit
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.73.biogr: The immortal spirit of the Ice Plains has roamed this land for ages.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.heroes.73.name: Ice Spirit
Peasants.
Waving pitchforks and looking forward to spring...
Or do they want something else?
Listen carefully. A short way west, hidden in the mist, an Azure Dragon sleeps. If you sneak up and cast this spell on it, it will become a faithful helper. But remember, nothing comes free!
We will never let you through, fool!
One more thing.
That drunkard Dug, who was sent to guard South Bay as punishment, may now return home. His sentence is over. If you happen to pass that way, tell his superior.
Thanks.
Yes, we do indeed produce mercury here. We are at your service, if you wish.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.106.106: Caw, caw! The blue waters will swallow your bones once we pick them clean of flesh!
The living dead. Someone has been practising necromancy here again!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.11.41.0: This is our fortress, but you may train here too.
We work for those who seem honourable to us...
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.13.14.0: Brrr... It's freezing! A fight will surely warm us up!
We have no interest whatsoever in working for you!
We don't toil here just so someone can come along and take everything from us!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.19.74.0: Every hero wants to master the finest spells...
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.22.49.0: A group of monks examines you. They are inscrutable... What might they be thinking? What will they do?
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.23.12.0: Pay us to use the bridge!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.23.34.0: The golems seem to dislike warm-blooded creatures.
Take us into your company. You will surely need our help.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.26.61.0: The tree warriors examine you as though taking your measure.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.27.73.0: The elemental moves through the river like lightning. It is a difficult target!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.28.81.0: The trees came out to meet you.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.3.4.0.m: Thank you for saving me. They held me prisoner here for a very long time to keep this valley safe from winter's onslaught. Now I am finally free, and though I do not yet know what lies ahead, it feels much better.
We are a free people! No one will enslave us!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.31.47.0: This is our mine tunnel, and even if it is blocked now, you won't be loitering here!
Yes, I traded for your relic with a man whose name I do not know, and who then rode somewhere east. But I see no reason to give it to you willingly. You won't get into my storehouse easily, and I won't give you the keys for nothing! 
You can buy something, of course, but that is about all. Business is business...
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.36.91.0: We already work for another master!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.40.87.0:
Everyone wants a drink...
And everyone will pay the ultimate price for that one sip!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.41.16.0: Life in the frozen desert is harsh. Everyone makes a living however they can. By robbery, for instance...
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.44.92.0: We know what you are now! You won't get our mine!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.46.81.0: Well now, that won't work! This is our mine tunnel, and only we may dig here!
Today is a good day to die in battle!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.48.15.0: Damn it! Our den has frozen over! It's your fault!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.49.39.0:
Good heavens!
Dragon spirits hover in the air, barely distinguishable from the blanket of snow all around you.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.5.5.0.m: We will never leave our valley. We will defend it to our last breath!
The unicorns do not respond to your friendly gesture...
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.56.81.0: The mist did not deter you from continuing your journey. Now that is courage. Allow us to join you and help.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.57.23.0: Disturbing us during meditation! Unheard of!
Greetings!
I have stood here all alone for a long time, bored out of my mind. Take me along on your journey so I can have some fun, or leave me be.
This is all we own. We will defend it at any cost!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.64.93.0: We keep watch for approaching enemies. I admit it is rather boring.
This land belongs to the dead. You cannot pass through.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.68.81.0: Ha! The others may believe your nonsense, but we know you are here to take our mine!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.69.86.0: You aren't heading into our camp, are you?
It's our turn now! And no one is jumping the queue!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.81.97.0: That was not a good idea.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.82.72.0: We don't like you, but we do like your belongings!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.85.81.0: No one will enslave us, not even you!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.87.19.0: A group of dwarves possessed by an evil spirit guards their cursed mine.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.91.66.0: Welcome. I gladly improve the skills of anyone willing to listen to me.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.93.74.0: If you defeat us, we will serve you. But I warn you, no one has ever succeeded.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.94.60.0: This is our sanctuary. We will not let someone like you desecrate it!
Before you leave, I must tell you that someone stole our sacred relic. Return it to us and punish the coward who crept into the monastery under cover of night and carried it away!
Poor Brother Tshober, who guarded it that night, has chosen to live as a hermit to atone for his negligence.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.monster.97.36.0: This is our sacred building! We may not know what it is for, but that doesn't mean we will willingly let you near it.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.20.1.0.co:
Yes, yes, this is exactly what I need! Wait, I will be right back with your reward!
It takes a long time, but eventually the seer emerges from his hut and says:
"The land's fate is unclear... Though I used all my knowledge, I found no answers to my questions. Hmm. Still, your efforts deserve a reward. Here is the Rib Cage of the corpse you brought me. It can serve you as quite useful armour."
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.20.1.0.fi: Welcome. If you want answers about the fate of the land, you must bring me a dead body. With its help, I can perform a divination.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.20.1.0.ne: Hmm, you have plenty with you, but none of it is useful to me. I need only that one dead body for the ritual.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.29.71.0.c: Excellent. You deserve a generous reward!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.29.71.0.f: Welcome, welcome. I need someone just like you. My experiments require the aid of the world's four elements. Bring me someone who commands them, and I will reward you richly.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.29.71.0.n: Unfortunately, I still cannot begin the experiment. I am still missing:
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.34.1.0.co:
Ha! Hand it over. Such a thing does not belong in unworthy hands.
Now go and take that contraption! It is a far rarer artifact than your little trinket! What are you waiting for!?
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.34.1.0.fi:
I have heard that another example of this magical armour may exist. Now I don't know whether I own the original or merely a good imitation. Bring it to me, however you get it.
Hmm, hmm... Unless these are merely rumours, of course.
Then your search would be in vain...
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.34.1.0.ne: No, as I said, there is only one thing I will accept in exchange for the relic.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.42.4.0.co:
The patrol greets you:
Welcome. Are you heading north as well? A rider passed through here a little while ago, in quite a hurry.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.42.4.0.fi:
The patrol greets you:
Welcome. Are you heading north as well? What's that, you're searching for a relic thief?
A rider passed through here a little while ago, in quite a hurry. Ride quickly before he gets away!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.42.4.0.ne:
The patrol greets you:
Welcome. Are you heading north as well? A rider passed through here a little while ago, in quite a hurry.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.62.1.0.co: Oh, I can hardly believe it!! I have another sword here. Accept it as a reward for returning mine. It is far more powerful, but the one you brought meant much more to me, for I inherited it from my father.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.62.1.0.fi: Some scoundrel stole my sword and fled west with it! I hope he dies in the deepest snow for it! Still, if you happen upon that thief, please take the sword from him and return it to me. I will reward you as generously as I can!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.62.1.0.ne: If you happened to find my sword, I would reward you richly!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.62.56.0.c: Remove your shoes as a sign of humility before going further.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.62.56.0.f: Only a holy man may enter the tower.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.62.56.0.n: I am sorry. The magical gate will admit only a holy man.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.66.96.0.c:
Blasted hell!
So it's true that a gang was trying to raid the settlement.
Alaaaarm!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.66.96.0.f:
The watch captain is clearly bored.
Yes, yes, everyone is talking today about enemies preparing to attack our settlement. But no one has brought proof. Something like this would convince me:
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.66.96.0.n: Yaaawn, the same old story. But without proof I won't mobilise the garrison for anything. They already have plenty to deal with.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.95.9.0.co:
No, I cannot believe my eyes! That is our sacred relic! It is back!
Oh, a thousand thanks to you and you alone. Please accept this gift, which is unquestionably yours!
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.95.9.0.fi:
I am condemned to live as a hermit for the rest of my days...
There is no other way to atone for failing to guard our sacred relic.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.95.9.0.ne: God, my hands and feet are freezing... Someone even put out my fire. Whatever shall I do...
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.99.92.0.c: Well, Dug will be delighted. To tell the truth, I was beginning to feel a little sorry for him myself.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.99.92.0.f:
No, no!
Your punishment is to guard South Bay, so do your duty. The order was clear. At least next time you will think twice before taking a swig of spirits.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.quest.99.92.0.n: Your pleas are in vain. Orders are orders...
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.sign.104.63.0.m: The sign announces that this village is called Goldmine.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.sign.11.11.1.me:
This part of the map supports the upper part.
If you got here, I probably overlooked something :-))
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.sign.23.42.0.me:
The faded sign reads:
Low prices and a wide selection of goods.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.sign.25.50.0.me:
The snow-covered sign announces:
Welcome to Gornodol.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.sign.41.2.0.mes:
Southern border of the Ice Mountains.
Passage permitted only with a valid visa from the Green Tent.
An embassy in your territory will open next year.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.sign.43.3.0.mes:
The sign announces:
Border zone.
Customs inspection.
Please present your luggage for examination.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.sign.43.5.0.mes:
The sign proclaims in red lettering:
Welcome to North Pass.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.sign.73.99.0.me:
This hot spring was discovered in year 126 of the Mu dynasty.
Wet your lips, traveller, and warm your frozen bones.
map.[sod] - mlzne jezero.town.107.62.0.e: The town has just survived an attack by marauding bands. But the price is far too high...

The town, which recently survived a raid by marauding bands, is badly damaged. Every building must be repaired, and that costs money.
Fortunately, not very much.
The marauding bands strike suddenly, without warning! They plunder and burn. This time the loot is rich!
The people have constructed a new building in town!
The people have taken up a collection. It is quite a respectable pile of money!
The people have built another part of the town!
The gods have finally answered the people's prayers. Their gifts are richer than ever!
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.event.0.descripti:
The last rays of sunlight cast their glow over a beautiful 
and unspoilt land of magic, chivalry and courage. Bound by brotherhood, the heroes defended themselves against the raids of the EVIL ONE.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.event.2.descripti:
All attempts, including the forces of EVIL's attempt to conquer the Dead Land,
failed to divide them.
Yet these efforts of EVIL disrupted the harmony of the existing world.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.event.3.descripti:
The EVIL ONE's attacks sowed discord among the clans.
These disagreements marked the beginning of long
and arduous battles.
Your task is to destroy not only all your opponents,
but also the ruler of the underground.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.event.5.descripti: An ambassador has arrived with modest gifts from the neighbouring kingdom.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.guards.33.15.0.me:
You think some money would come in handy. 
But it seems you have been robbed.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.header.descriptio:
The goal of this game is to destroy all opponents. Red and Green play together, or Blue and Tan
play against Orange. The orange enemy will be the toughest opponent, so take particular care with him.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.header.name: Dead Land
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.header.rumor.0.te: Rumour has it that the great chaplain Ratlík intends to create a Circle of Magic from which the world will draw its power.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.header.rumor.1.te: The court astrologer has read in the stars that many great battles will come, and the road to victory will be long and very hard.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.header.rumor.2.te: The only road to the EVIL ONE leads across the sparkling plain.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.header.rumor.3.te: Rumour has it that to reach the EVIL ONE, you must first overcome many beasts.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.monster.11.49.0.m: You have found a little money.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.sign.12.54.0.mess: This enchanted castle is the last bastion before the sparkling plain.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.sign.74.89.1.mess:
Warning!!!
Enter at your own risk!!!
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.sign.87.8.1.messa:
Warning!!!
Enter at your own risk!!!
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.sign.9.16.1.messa:
Warning!!!
Danger!!!
You are entering the CHAMBER OF DEATH!!!
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.town.104.6.0.even: The people learned that you intend to wage war against the EVIL ONE, so they built you a Marketplace.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.town.106.104.0.ev: The people learned that you intend to wage war against the EVIL ONE, so they built you a Marketplace.
map.[sod] - mrtva zeme.town.5.104.0.even: The people learned that you intend to wage war against the EVIL ONE, so they built you a Marketplace.
The people learned that you intend to wage war against the EVIL ONE, so they built you a Marketplace.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.event.0.descr: It is a beautiful day when you wake and eat breakfast in peace. Servants and soldiers watch silently. Once you have finished, your captain of the guard ventures to interrupt you with terrible news. Our fortress in the north has been captured by treacherous elves. The moment you hear this, you begin raging and cursing. The elves must be punished, slaughtered to the last one. You immediately order all your troops mobilised and send a messenger to your brother, Lord Frost, asking for help in fighting the elves.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.event.1.descr: You are discussing the best way to defeat the elves with your generals when the doors open and guards enter with a deathly pale peasant. He tells you that a powerful necromancer has cast some mighty spell upon our fortress in the south. All the inhabitants and soldiers died, then suddenly rose again and now walk about the fortress. You refuse to believe it. You will not listen to such nonsense, so you order the peasant executed to stop him spreading any more such foolishness.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.event.2.descr: A week has passed since you sent a messenger to your brother, Lord Frost, when an answer finally arrives in the form of the messenger's severed head. You immediately declare war on Frost and vow to impale him upon your battlements.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.event.3.descr: Letters have arrived from the commanders of your scouts in both the south and the north. Both report sighting strange gates from which hordes of demons have begun pouring, along with rumours that some enormous demon who has never been defeated has taken command of them.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.event.4.descr: The fishermen complain that pirates are attacking their coastal villages. You should deal with them immediately, or the fishermen will stop supplying you with food and your army will starve.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.event.5.descr: You have heard of a great basilisk living in the swamps to the south. You immediately covet its fur coat and send your scouts and soldiers to track it down and hunt it for you.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.event.6.descr: Rumours begin spreading throughout your kingdom that a powerful dragon has awakened in an old cave. The people grow afraid, and half your army deserts. You must deal with it immediately before more soldiers flee. It seems your kingdom stands on the brink of war with practically the entire world.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.event.7.descr: The angels do not seem fond of you. Even so, you should try to persuade them to join your fight.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.header.name: On the Brink of War Erik
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.heroes.1.name: King
The basilisk is dead. You are a fine hunter. We will gladly join you.
A terrible basilisk lives in these woods. If you hunt it down, we will go with you.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.quest.29.55.0: The Elf King is finally dead. We are joining you, as we promised.
The elves' capture of our fortress cost many good lives. But if you defeat their king, we will join you.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.quest.37.88.0: The necromancer is dead. We will follow you anywhere.
We are monks who hunt necromancers. A particularly powerful necromancer has recently appeared near your kingdom. If you kill him, we will join you.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.quest.58.69.0: Well, well. I can hardly believe I am hearing the same thing from 300 people. I only hope you forced them to leave their families. Here is your reward. Enjoy it while your kingdom still stands. :D
I have heard that the peasants consider you a cruel tyrant and slaver. But if you bring me 300 peasants who clear you of that accusation, I am willing to give you a very powerful artifact.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.quest.65.14.0: Frost is finally dead. We feared we would die here. We are coming with you, my king.
Frost captured us and locked us in this magical prison. If you kill him, his spell will be broken and we will help you.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.quest.80.80.0: You show the angels the demon's head, and they join you immediately.
These angels will join you once they see the head of the demon you claim is attacking your kingdom.
map.[sod] - na kraji valky.quest.83.52.0: The pirate is dead. Please accept this artifact as a reward.
Pirates are attacking our villages. One of them is particularly terrible. If you kill him, I will reward you with a powerful artifact.
The dragon is dead. We are coming with you.
A small band of dragonslayers lives here. If you prove worthy of becoming one of them, they will join you. You must find a dragon and kill it.
At last the northern troops have mobilised and prepared for battle. Unfortunately, elves attacked the camp, and much of the army fell. The few survivors find refuge in your castle.
Reinforcements from the south have arrived. Unfortunately, many people opposed your war against the elves and your brother Frost, and are therefore staying in their homes.
You have persuaded a small group of angels that your cause is just. Some also despise demons, so they join you.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.0.descrip:
Welcome, hero.
This map will teach you the most basic elements of {Heroes {of {Might {and {Magic {3}. I will give you detailed advice on how to proceed and win this scenario. Read all instructions carefully and follow them.

Now click the button below and read what you should do first.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.1.descrip:
To move the rider representing your hero to a location on the Adventure Map, click the place you want to reach. If the cursor shows a galloping horse, you can go there. If it shows a rearing horse, you can visit an object or collect an item.

Each new day, however, we will build in the castle first. Only then will your hero set out across the map.

Now click the button below again to continue.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.10.descri:
Start by building a {Fort}. I will give you enough resources, so you need not worry about lacking the funds for any building. In a real game, however, I will not be helping you. You will have to look after yourself.

Now click the button below and enter the town to build a {Fort}. Then take your hero to the {signpost}, where you will learn what to do next.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.11.descri:
As you may have noticed, more than half the creature dwellings in your town are already built. Today we will begin constructing the second half.

Switch to the Town Screen and build a {Monastery}.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.12.descri:
Your town is slowly growing. But do not expect things to be this easy in a normal game. There, shortages of resources or gold will often slow you down. Since that will not happen on this map, go ahead and construct another building.

When you switch to the Town Screen, you may notice that you cannot build any more creature dwellings. First you must build {Stables}. Build them and continue playing.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.13.descri:
Since you built {Stables} yesterday, today you can build a {Training Grounds} in your town.

I hope you no longer need instructions on how to do this. You have already constructed several buildings, so don't be shy: show what you can do.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.14.descri:
Today you will bring the {Grail} to your home town. When you then click the {City {Hall}, the computer will ask whether you want to build a {Grail {structure} here. Answer "Yes". 

Clicking the {Grail {structure} will show you the benefits it provides.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.15.descri: If you are following my instructions exactly, today your hero, {Explorer}, will reach the spot where the {Grail} is buried. Stand on the place marked with a cross on the puzzle map. You must wait until tomorrow to dig up the {Grail}, however.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.16.descri:
Today is an important day. Your hero, {Explorer}, will dig up the {Grail}. When Explorer's turn comes, simply press {"D"} on your keyboard. This is the shortcut for digging up the Grail.

Once you have done so, you can look at the Hero Screen to see what the {Grail} looks like. You may continue along the route you chose for your other hero.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.17.descri: Take Explorer to your town so that you can build a {Grail {structure} there. The journey is long, however, so you will not arrive until tomorrow.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.18.descri:
When you switch back to your town's screen, you will see that all the basic types of dwelling available in this town have now been built.

I will leave it to you to decide what to build next. You can begin upgrading individual creature dwellings or construct other missing buildings. I would recommend starting with a {Citadel}, however, which will further increase creature growth in your dwellings.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.19.descri:
Your hero, {Explorer}, is strong enough to march against the enemy. Head south and pass through the light blue {Border {Guard} to enter enemy territory.

The choice is entirely yours. You can set out immediately or finish building your entire castle first.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.2.descrip:
First, let us look at your town.

After reading this message, click the button below. Then double-click the town icon on the right side of the screen. Inside the town, you will see that it has almost no buildings. It is time to start building.

In town, click the {Village {Hall}. A list of everything you can build will appear. If a building's label is grey (as with the {Portal {of Glory}, for example), you cannot construct it in this town. If the label is red, you have not met all the requirements for construction, or you lack the resources. 
If the label is green (for example, {Fort}), you can construct the building.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.3.descrip:
Today, build a {Tavern} in your town.

As you did yesterday, switch to the Town Screen. Click the {Village {Hall} again and build a {Tavern}. This will let you hire another hero and begin exploring the area around your castle.

You also need a {Tavern} to upgrade your village to a town. You will do that tomorrow, however, because you can construct only one building per day in a town.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.4.descrip:
Once you have built the {Tavern}, click it and hire one of the two heroes currently inside.

After hiring your hero, click the {Mage {Guild} and buy a {Spell {Book} (unless the hero already had one when hired). A {Spell {Book} allows your hero to cast "combat spells" during battle or "adventure spells" on the Adventure Map. You can buy a ballista at the {Blacksmith}. Then leave the town.

After leaving, select your new hero and move them out of the town. There they will receive further instructions to guide them onward.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.5.descrip:
Right, let us build again first. Switch to the Town Screen (I hope you remember how).

On the Town Screen, click the {Village {Hall} and build a {Town {Hall}. Your town will now earn you 1000 gold per day.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.6.descrip:
Today you will begin building dwellings where you can recruit new troops. Switch to the Town Screen and build a {Guardhouse}.

To recruit new troops, simply click their dwelling in town and buy them. Remember, however, that each dwelling holds a limited number of creatures. New creatures appear on the first day of every new week. If you do not buy all the creatures in a given week, they will not disappear: they remain in the dwelling.

Once you have several dwellings, you do not need to buy troops from each one separately. Simply click the {Fort} (later the {Citadel} or {Castle}) to buy all available troops from one screen.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.7.descrip:
You can now build another creature dwelling. Switch to the Town Screen again and build an {Archers' {Tower}.

In a normal game, you need not follow the same building order I am recommending now. Nor is that always possible. It depends on the scenario you are playing. For now, however, it is best to follow my instructions.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.8.descrip:
Another new day, and today we will build a {Barracks}. Try building it using the procedure you surely remember by now.

You may notice that you cannot yet build the next dwelling in town. Right-clicking it will show that it requires a {Barracks}. Build it, then continue exploring the map with both heroes.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.event.9.descrip:
A new week begins today. This means that new troops have appeared in every dwelling you have built so far. In a normal game, you could replenish your army. You do not need to, however.

Instead, get back to building. Enter the town in the usual way and build a {Griffin {Tower}. Then continue exploring the map with your heroes.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.0.22.1.m:
Here I will introduce some locations where you can increase your primary skills.

First, however, visit the strange building ahead: it is a {Cartographer}. For 1000 gold, you can buy a map of the entire underground.
Then continue downwards.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.1.23.0.m:
You are approaching a {Sulfur {Dune}. Its guards have noticed you too and are shaking their spears impatiently. It will do them no good, however. They cannot defend the {Sulfur {Dune} against you.

Advance boldly, defeat the guards and claim the mine for yourself.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.1.25.0.m:
You stand beside a tall {Redwood Observatory}. Visiting it reveals the surrounding area within a radius of 20 squares, as though you had climbed the {Redwood Observatory} and surveyed the countryside from above.

Then continue upwards and turn right at the {Gem {Pond}. The path will lead you to another mine with a cart of red crystals beside it.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.1.29.0.m: You have reached a place near where you began the game. A short distance from your hero, you can see another {Obelisk}. Go and visit it.
You stand beside another mine. Unlike the previous mines, it is not immediately clear what is extracted here. That is because it is an {Abandoned {Mine}. At present it produces nothing, for troglodytes have settled inside.

To resume production, you must kill them. Enter the mine, and when asked whether you wish to enter, answer {Yes}.

Once production resumes, the mine will begin supplying a resource (anything except wood). Then head down and right towards another mine with a cart of gold beside it.
As you may have guessed, this is an {Obelisk}. {Obelisks} reveal pieces of the puzzle map, which shows the location of the {Grail} once fully uncovered. In most cases, one {Obelisk} will not reveal the entire puzzle at once. The whole puzzle appears only after you have visited all the {Obelisks}.

Visit it, then head left towards the green goblin waving his club so menacingly.
You stand before a {University}.

Here, for 2000 gold, you can buy up to 4 random secondary skills. You can learn a skill with a green label. A red label means you have no free slot for that skill, or lack the money. The final possibility is a grey label. In that case you cannot learn the skill even if every requirement is met (for example, a hero of good cannot learn Necromancy).

After visiting the {University}, head right towards the stone rising from the ground.
You are correct: this is indeed a {Gold {Mine}. Once you claim it, it will add 1000 gold to your treasury every day.

From the mine, head towards the small cottage among the mountains, with an Archangel standing guard outside.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.14.9.1.m: This monolith is {one-way} only. That means entering it will transport you somewhere, but you cannot return by the same route. Continue without fear, however. The monolith will take you back to the surface, where you will continue exploring the map.
Ahead of you is a {Crystal {Cavern}. Surprisingly, it has no guards. Claim it and follow the path around the volcano to another building with a grey cauldron outside.
You have already encountered a {Keymaster's {Tent} on the surface with your other hero. This tent is a different colour, so visit it too.

From the {Keymaster's {Tent}, continue upwards into the purple monolith.
The object ahead is a {Learning {Stone}. Every hero who visits it for the first time receives 1000 experience points.

Visit it, then continue to the next building to the east.
You have stopped before an {Alchemist's Lab}, which produces mercury. No guards were visible at first, but when you approached, enemies suddenly surrounded you. They probably had their eye on the {Alchemist's Lab} too.

You have no choice but to fight them for this mine. After winning, claim the mine, collect the cauldron of mercury and follow the path left. It will lead you to another mine.
Well, this hero has done their share. I have no further tasks for them. If you wish, you can take them through the green gate into the underground and follow the same route you took with Explorer. 
You can visit all the locations and train this hero further.
You have reached a {Library of Enlightenment}.

Visiting the {Library of Enlightenment} benefits only a hero who has reached level 10. Sometimes a lower-level hero can learn here too, but they must have the secondary skill {Diplomacy}. With Expert {Diplomacy}, you can learn at the {Library of Enlightenment} as early as level 4.

After a visit, your hero's Attack, Defense, Spell Power and Knowledge each increase by +2. You have already reached level 10, so you may enter.

Then head northeast to the last building in this "cave".
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.2.24.0.m: Defeating those infernal troglodytes was surely no trouble for you. Now claim the {Sulfur {Dune}, collect the pile of sulfur and head left to visit the {Redwood Observatory}.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.2.26.1.m:
If you bought the underground map, you can see everything waiting here. Continue downwards and visit the round building. It is an {Arena}.

The first time a hero visits an {Arena}, their Attack or Defense increases by +2 points (your choice).
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.2.29.1.m:
After visiting the {Arena}, head downwards again towards what looks like a group of tents. It is a {Mercenary {Camp}.

The first time a hero visits it, their Attack increases by +1 point.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.2.3.0.me:
To make your new hero less defenceless, I have decided to give them some rapid training.

Your hero will receive enough experience to gain a few levels. Each time a hero gains a level, one primary skill increases by +1, and you may choose to improve one of two secondary skills (or learn a new one).

Then collect the {Campfire} and visit the light blue {Keymaster's {Tent}. Once you have done so, begin claiming the mines with this hero.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.2.33.1.m: Enter the {Mercenary {Camp}, learn from it and head right towards the {Star Axis}.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.2.35.0.m: Ahead is a {Entrance {to {the Underground}. Place the cursor over the entrance and enter the gate. You will reach the underground, where I will introduce more important locations. After emerging from the gate, continue downwards.
This stone building is a {Hill Fort}. Visiting it allows you to upgrade all your ordinary creatures.

The lowest-level creatures are upgraded for free at the {Hill Fort}. Upgrading the others costs gold, and most of the strongest creatures also require a rare resource (whichever resource is needed to buy them in town).

From the {Hill Fort}, continue left towards the green tent.
The strange tree ahead is actually a {Seer's {Hut}.

A seer lives inside and will give you a quest. Complete it successfully, and the seer will reward you well. The seer living here is expecting you in particular. Visit him, then continue left towards the stone building.
This is a {School of War}.

Here you will meet a combat instructor who, for 1000 gold, will increase your Defense or Attack by +1. Agree with him which skill you wish to improve, then continue to the building glowing green.
Continue straight upwards to reach the enemy's castle. If you meet an enemy hero along the way, feel free to attack. You should win the battle.

Then capture the castle, and victory is yours.
Do not be alarmed by the figure ahead. He is no warrior, but a {Scholar} who can help you on your adventure.

He can teach you a primary skill, a secondary skill or a spell (as determined by the map's author). Speak to him, then continue towards your original destination.
Your scouts have just informed you that the enemy castle is close by. Victory is within reach.

I recommend stopping at the {War Machine Factory} directly ahead. You can buy any war machines you still lack there.
This is a {two-way {monolith}. That means you can travel through it in both directions—there and back. Now enter the monolith. Once it transports you elsewhere, head north (up).
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.29.9.1.m: Ahead you see a building with barred windows. Yes, you are right: it is a {prison}, where a hero awaits rescue. Go and free him. Then continue to the strange tree.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.3.21.0.m: The next mine has guards too. Do not worry, though; you can easily deal with them.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.3.28.1.m:
If you have followed my instructions, your hero has run out of movement here. Since there is nothing more you can do, it is time to let the enemy take a turn.

To do this, click the hourglass icon on the right of the screen (or press {"E"} on your keyboard). Once the enemy has finished, it will be your turn again.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.3.30.0.m: This is the second and final {obelisk} on this map. Visiting it will reveal the entire puzzle map, which shows where the {Grail} is buried.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.3.7.0.me:
You have now reached an {ore pit}. Once you capture it, it will provide 2 units of ore every day.

Wood and ore are called basic resources. This is because you can find them almost everywhere, and they are needed to construct many buildings.

After capturing the {ore pit}, claim the {Archer’s {Tower} to your hero’s right.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.4.1.0.me:
Visit the {Keymaster’s {Tent}. This will later allow you to open a {Border {Guard} or pass through a {Border {Gate} of the same colour. Then go and capture the {sawmill}.

The {sawmill} is the little wooden building with a wagon beside it. The flag at the {sawmill} is currently grey. Once you capture the {sawmill}, the flag will turn red. The flag’s colour tells you which player owns a mine or creature dwelling.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.4.17.0.m: You have defeated those arrogant goblins, so you can now claim the {gem {pond} for yourself. Once you have done so, follow the road south towards the yellow mounds.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.4.2.0.me: Since your army is too weak, several warriors have come to help you.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.5.14.0.m: This is an {artifact}. {Artifacts} are a special group of items that modify your hero’s attributes. Click your selected hero again to open the {hero {screen}. On the right is a picture of your hero’s body, showing the {artifacts} your hero owns. Each slot can hold only one. Click a slot to remove an artifact and put it in the backpack (the slots below the hero’s body). Players swap artifacts when they want to equip a stronger or more useful {artifact}. Once you have looked at the hero screen, head right towards the white building.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.5.30.0.m:
By now you surely know where the {Grail} lies. If you have forgotten, you can view the puzzle map again by pressing {"P"} on your keyboard.

The {Grail} is buried at the spot marked with a cross on the map. If you are still having trouble finding your way, the spot is just ahead of you on the lava terrain. It is below and to the left of the large volcano, and one square to the right of the small lava pool. Go there and stand exactly where the cross is.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.6.33.1.m:
Ahead is a {Star Axis}. Visiting it increases your Spell Power by +1.

From the {Star Axis}, continue right towards the {Garden of {Revelation}.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.7.28.1.m:
This is a {School of {Magic}. For 1000 gold, you can increase your Knowledge or Spell Power by +1 (again, the choice is yours).

Enter the school, then continue right towards the building with mushrooms growing in front of it.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.7.3.0.me:
Now capture the {sawmill} and pick up the pile of wood. Once you control the {sawmill}, it will supply you with 2 units of wood every day.

Then pass through the light blue {Border {Gate} towards the next mine: an {ore pit}. You can recognise it by the ore-filled cart standing beside it.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.7.31.1.m:
The {Marletto {Tower} increases your Defense by +1.

Visit it, then continue upwards again to the next tower, which has little stars flashing around it.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.7.35.0.m:
Ahead is a {signpost}. Go to it and read where your hero should go next.

Do not worry about an enemy hero attacking you. He cannot leave his territory.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.8.11.0.m: This is a {Witch {Hut}. Here you can learn the basics of a secondary skill. Sometimes, however, you have no room for it or already know it, and learn nothing. Go inside and have a look, then pick up the ring with an eye to the southwest.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.8.33.1.m:
The {Garden of {Revelation} increases your Knowledge by +1.

Your hero’s Knowledge determines how many spell points are available for casting spells (spell points = Knowledge x 10).

So go and learn something, then head upwards to the {Marletto {Tower}.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.guards.9.7.0.me:
The {Archer’s {Tower} is a creature dwelling. These buildings let you recruit new warriors. Each dwelling you control on the map also increases creature growth in the corresponding dwelling in your town by +1.

Dwelling places of stronger warriors are guarded, however. Luckily, you do not have to fight the archers. Recruit a few archers, then follow the road down to the hut in the tree.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.header.descript:
This tutorial map will teach you the basics you need to survive in {Heroes 3}. Read the instructions carefully and try to follow them.
{Created by H&D
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.header.name: Learn to Play Heroes3
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.heroes.0.name: Explorer
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.heroes.6.name: Prisoner
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.monster.20.26.0:
"You have finally made it this far. The little building behind me is a {Trading Post}. There you can sell, buy or exchange surplus resources for others you lack. The exchange rate is not ideal, but it is still better than trading resources in town.

Visit the {Trading Post} if you wish. I would like to join your army myself. Do you agree?"
"What are you doing here, hero? We guard this {gem {pond}, which adds 1 gem to its owner’s treasury every day.

We will not surrender the pond willingly. If you want it, you will have to fight for it!"
"We know we stand no chance against you, but we will not hand over this mine without a fight. Unless you are a coward, fight!"
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.quest.24.9.1.co: "At last! So you are Explorer? Wait here; I will fetch the warriors who have been waiting for you. Will you take them into your army?"
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.quest.24.9.1.fi: "Welcome, hero. Several mighty warriors are staying with me. They say they are waiting for a hero named Explorer."
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.quest.24.9.1.ne: "You are not Explorer. Get out of here!"
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.sign.6.35.0.mes:
Continue to the gate that looks like a huge skull embedded in the ground.

Leave exploration of the surface to the hero you recruit on the second day.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.town.3.2.0.even:
To help you a little and speed up your town’s development, I have decided to build three structures for you. You need these to upgrade your little town to a city tomorrow.

While you were resting, I was hard at work, and these three new buildings have appeared in your town: a {Blacksmith}, a {Marketplace} and the first level of the {Mage {Guild}.

Return to your town screen and build a {City {Hall}, using the method you surely remember by now.

Your town will now earn you 2000 gold every day.

In a normal game, constructing these buildings will secure at least a basic income. Tomorrow we will start building dwellings where you can recruit new warriors for your army.
map.[sod] - nauc se hrat.town.3.2.0.name: Your Town
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.event.0.d: Until yesterday, peace reigned in your kingdom. But last night a demon emerged from the depths with his minions, and darkness engulfed part of your kingdom. He surrounded his territory with rocks, making it impregnable, and hordes of enemies are pouring out of the Red Gate.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.event.1.d: Your task is to find a way into the dark territory and put an end to the infernal minions. Chaos has gripped your land, and the people do not know what to do. Do not expect much support from the countryside.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.event.2.d: Good luck in destroying the powers of Hell, hero.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.event.4.d: Today you had a strange dream. The wizard you remember from childhood recited a rhyme he once taught you. It went like this:
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.event.5.d: Yellow as the sun, a liquid that can slay. Red as blood keeps beauty from decay. But blue as the ocean drives all sickness away.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.event.6.d: Today you learned that some crackpot inspector confiscated the {Everpouring Vial of Mercury} from your mercury-producing chemical works, claiming it violated mercury production regulations. Now you cannot produce mercury. How bloody annoying!!!
The wailing continues, but you can now see your destination.
You made the wrong choice, and now you have really screwed yourself over.
The moment you step out of the monolith, all your burdens fall away and you feel wonderfully relaxed. Birds are singing everywhere, and there is not a single creature from Hell in sight.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.guards.14: The passage keeps growing darker. All you can do is hope it really leads where it should.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.guards.16: You made the wrong choice, and now you have really screwed yourself over.
Wailing echoes all around you, sending chills down your spine. Yet no one dares attack you.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.guards.22: Stubborn beast, but we have its hide and a few teeth. We can make the strongest armour from those!
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.guards.24: The powerful smell of sulfur fills the air. It seems we are nearing our destination.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.guards.26: Damn, that chest probably belongs to someone!
Suddenly an old wizard steps out of the grove. You recognise the familiar wizard from your childhood. In a calm voice he says, "Kaleval, there is no time for a long conversation. A great evil has entered your world, and it is up to you to destroy it. A sage lives on the surface; perhaps you have already met him. He asked you for the royal symbol, which had to be hidden from the throne’s enemies."
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.guards.30: So this is the gate of evil. Unfortunately, only evil can open it. But you are not evil, are you?
The wizard continues, "The king’s symbol now lies within your reach, but do not use it. Many people have ruined their lives with it. Give it to the sage; he will return it to its rightful place."
The wizard continues, "You may already have heard of a town called Pe-Klo, but that is not the goal of your campaign. You must destroy the demon who reached the surface. Once he is destroyed, all the darkness will vanish."
You see an inscription carved into the rock: If you seek the royal treasure, prove your royal blood beyond all measure. Solve the riddle and fortune you shall gain. Fail, and in burning Hell you shall remain.
The wizard continues, "I can help you no further. The sage will help you more once you show him the royal symbol." With these words, the wizard vanishes.
At last it is yours: the royal symbol.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.header.de: A demon has emerged from the dark depths, intent on destroying your kingdom and then the entire world. Can you stop him?
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.header.ru: Yellow as the sun, a liquid that can slay. Red as blood keeps beauty from decay. But blue as the ocean drives all sickness away.
You had better avoid the sirloin in cream sauce...
The creator of this map spends his life in this tavern.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.heroes.26: For a long time, Kaleval ruled the Kingdom of Korvent, which lived in peace with all the surrounding lands. Now he must wage a bitter war against the powers of Hell that have emerged from the underworld onto the surface of Korvent.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.monster.1: This man is far too clever, so we had to detain him. We will never let you speak to him. That could be our undoing!!!
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.monster.2: Suddenly an old man begins to take shape before you, but he is transparent. He immediately says, "I guard this treasure, and gladly greet you here. Nothing keeps you from taking it, yet its legends fill men with fear. Everyone who used it met an unhappy end. So take it and hide it, lest you follow their trend. Now I must disappear; I shall summon someone you would like to hear."

WE guard this passage. WE have been here for centuries. WE will let no one pass. WE will not let the great evil pass into your world, and therefore you must die!! (You probably cannot explain that they failed to contain the evil and it has long been loose in the world. Better reach for your sword.)
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.monster.3: AAAA!! A hero, help! We must warn our master {Morthor}. (So {Morthor} is the bastard’s name. We shall see how he looks when he meets Kaleval.)
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.monster.7: My lord, terrible things are happening! Monsters from Hell have overrun our beautiful land. My people have discovered a monstrous town called Pek-Lo to the east, from which all the enemies are pouring out.
Good, you have obtained the symbol. You must destroy the demon, but you probably know that already. Here is a pendant to protect you from the dangers of the cursed ravine, and I will give you another little something that will come in handy! But it is in my other hut. Come along, please.
In these troubled times, I trust no one. Show me the royal symbol or leave.

As soon as you dripped the liquid onto the rocks, everything began to hiss and explode. Fire and smoke were everywhere. You and your company quickly ran into the gate for shelter, and when you emerged a while later, the passage lay clear before you.
Oh no! So near and yet so far! The road is blocked by rocks. What now? How about trying the test tube the sage gave you?
Ah, here it is. Take it; it will certainly help you.
"It is time to settle the score with evil!!!" declared Kaleval, wearing an expression reminiscent of a crazed sadistic maniac!!!  Do you want to finish this now?
This is a job for Kaleval alone.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.quest.3.3: Now we will see whether that pendant is any use. Do you want to continue?

This pass is cursed. Everyone who has tried to cross it has never returned. Yet it seems to be the last possible way to get at the demon. Legends tell of a mysterious pendant that can protect its wearer from all evil forces. That pendant might help us reach the demon.
Thanks, I will give them hell today! Here is something I confiscated at another laboratory as an unauthorised method of producing mercury.

I am a product safety inspector. I have been watching this new lab for a while, but I am still not sure whether the mercury they produce is safe. Unfortunately, the guards will not let me in, so I cannot investigate. If you brought me a sample, I would give you something no one else could get you.
Go ahead and leave. I will find another way.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.quest.6.3: The inscription in the rock has changed: Brave Kaleval, you may now pass through; strength alone will not defeat what awaits you.
A mysterious inscription is carved into the rock: On this path, your life need not cause you dread, but only Kaleval may tread ahead.
The inscription continues: Whoever is unworthy to pass is pretty much out of luck :-)
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.sign.19.2: There is very little room here, so—welcome, editor users, to real Pek-Lo !!!
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.sign.29.2: This laboratory is the 1st of its kind. Mercury is produced here by splitting atoms. Beware of nuclear waste!
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.sign.32.1: Only a wise wizard knows how every illness goes. Enter the monolith whose hue matches the magic potion’s brew.
map.[sod] - nebezpeci z hlubin.sign.5.11: 1st Chemical Works – temporarily closed due to the confiscation of essential equipment.
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.event.0.de:
After Leki created (and even conquered) {"Wetlands"}, he decided to subjugate another land in person.
The famous town of "{Map Factory}" caught his eye.
So he gathered a strong army and set out on a campaign of conquest. First, however, he sent his girlfriend Sira ahead through one of the many monoliths. Unfortunately, his attempt to teleport Sira did not quite go as planned (that is his weakness: taking several attempts to do certain things :-)).
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.event.1.de:
So Sira and her army ended up trapped behind a Border Gate. Leki had no time for further attempts, as Hidden, the local ruler, had heard of his plans. Firebird had flown past with his flock of Firebirds while patrolling the countryside and blabbed everything to him. Hidden abandoned his tour of his estate and is hurrying home.
Unfortunately, he is at the opposite end of the land, so he hastily summoned several friends who had selflessly helped him so often before. But you know how it is—it is summer, the holiday season, so only a few of them turned up in the end.
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.event.2.de:
Surprisingly, Leki’s own teleportation succeeded, and he arrived not far from the {Map Factory}. Now it is your turn.
Will Hidden get home in time to defend the town?
Will he get there at all?
And if he does, will he defend it?
Or can his friends perhaps manage on their own?
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.event.3.de:
Show what you are made of and defend the town. Fight to your last drop of blood, but fight honourably. The spirit of one of this map’s creators will watch over you throughout.
Enough talk, and {into battle!!!
Your gremlins’ heroic shouting can be heard a very long way away. The gremlins are merry indeed. Several giant brothers, however, are displeased: the singing has woken them from their sweet summer slumber. Suddenly figures taller than even the largest pine in this forest appear before the gremlins. The gremlins begin to panic, but their commander is undaunted.
{"We may be small, but we are brave! Always remember David and Goliath. {Charge, my brave warriors!"
You have found an enormous pile of gems, surely worth a tremendous fortune.
The pile of crystals is so enormous that even with your warriors’ help, you can barely carry it.
Now you understand why the sharpshooter patrol was so strong. The treasure is well worth the battle.
You have never seen such a huge cauldron of mercury in your life. You immediately order it loaded up.
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.guards.2.6:
You are almost at the Border Guard when an archangel suddenly descends from the clouds before you.
{"I know what you are trying to do. Take me with you, and I shall {help you in your task. Accept this mighty {weapon too. It will serve you well in battle."
With these words, the archangel hands you a magnificent sword that radiates dazzling light, bright flashes running across its surface.
When the behemoths guarding the Keymaster’s Tent spotted you, they sent a few warriors to stop you.
Something glinted in the dust of the road. As you approached, your keen-eyed friend found an old nickel. It looks just like Uncle Scrooge’s lucky nickel! Without hesitation, you immediately slipped it into your pocket.
When the behemoths guarding the Keymaster’s Tent spotted you, they sent a few warriors to stop you.
When the behemoths guarding the Keymaster’s Tent spotted you, they sent a few warriors to stop you.
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.guards.3.2:
Nomad had barely taken a few steps when his nomads suddenly raised a clamour.
{Over there!!! Over there!!! Look!!!"
The entire army stopped as one, staring in awe at the unreal beauty of a lake nymph surrounded by clouds of spray. The warriors are drooling with delight, and their horses are no better. The whole army threatens to drown in the swamp at any moment. But Nomad intervenes and gives the order to march...
Even from a distance, you can see that this enormous pile of gold is guarded. Do you still want to risk an attack by its guards?
I do not know what use that bow will be to you, but you will have to win it from its original owners first anyway.
Are you still interested?
Here you encountered a black crow, which dropped a message at your feet addressed to you personally. The message from Leki reads:
{"I know you are here, Firebird. I know you blabbed to the local ruler about the {planned attack on the Map Factory. You have signed your own death warrant. Every {supporter of Hidden and his friends will be punished—with death. Today you {have no friends with you. There is no Fox Mulder, Xena, Callisto, Nikita or {any other dubious character here. There is only me and your death. I will reach you {a few days after the Map Factory falls. Your death will reach you a few minutes after {me. Nothing will stop me.
{--Leki"
The time has come for Firebird’s Firebirds to prove whether they really are as good as their owner claims. Can you demonstrate their worth?
You have won the first battle. If you suffered any losses, though, you had better leave that sulfur alone.
If you won without losses, charge boldly into the next battle :-).
This time the guards are even stronger. Do you still want to take the resources?
Suddenly legions of peasants pour out of a nearby farm, where Leki secretly breeds them as a source of food and new warriors alike.
I know this artifact is a great temptation. But will you abandon the fate of the entire land for your own greed?
Besides, the dragons have no intention of giving up their relic willingly. Do you really want to take this artifact?
I do not know what use that artifact will be to you when you will not have time to enjoy it anyway. Even so, you will not get it for free. You will have to win it from several gold golems.
Are you still interested in this artifact?
The nearby cartographer reminds Kal Kal of his favourite maps. He is delighted: using a secret magical formula, he can draw on the cartographer to replenish his spell points and even gain some extra energy.
I know very well what you have in mind. But I will never allow it!

As you approach the dark figure, you realise you know this person. She was once a mighty sorceress, but Leki seized control of her mind, creating his own personal plaything. Outwardly she resembles the legendary heroine, but evil has taken over her soul. You must kill this horrific creation of Leki’s imagination. Only then will her soul be free to return to her original body.
Tormenting thoughts begin to trouble you along the way. Will you reach the castle in time? Will your friends help you? What would happen to you if the Map Factory fell? What if Leki is killing innocent peasants to swell his army while you trudge uselessly along here? But then you pull yourself together. After all, you found the Bow of the Sharpshooter and the Ring of the Magi. With these artifacts, commanders have won even more hopeless battles. You must overcome your fears and think positively. Your mood could spread to the troops, and that would be bad. How many armies have fallen simply because their warriors’ morale was low? You hope yours will not be one of them...
Your idea was not bad. Unfortunately, this does not seem to be the way through. Prepare to die!
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.header.des:
You may have survived {A Terrible Day in the {Wetlands}. But the same horrors may await you elsewhere. Will you live to see a second day in this land?
Created by H&D
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.heroes.0.b: Kal Kal is one of the Map Factory’s most frequent visitors. He makes the rounds of all such castles, collecting maps that anyone can pick up from him. Now that the Map Factory is in danger, Kal Kal is nearby and doing everything he can to help.
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.heroes.130: Firela occasionally visits the world of Heroes. This time, when she heard of the danger threatening the Map Factory, she decided to do her bit.
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.heroes.133: Firebird chose the best pair of his Firebirds (a male and a female). Unfortunately, he overestimated their strength. In the harsh conditions, the birds failed to reach the town and landed in this arctic landscape. Fire may seem useless in this battle, but all that could change.
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.heroes.144: H0nza did not have to hurry. He has been chilling out for some time, never leaving his computer. When needed, however, he can lend a hand. Will his army be enough to stop Leki?
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.heroes.149: A warrior famed for his tactics—that is Jaguar. He has proved his worth in many battles at world-famous tournaments. When he received an urgent message asking for help, he did not hesitate for a moment. He took a few of his best warriors and is waiting for his time to come.
Bilbo, who made his name in another world, has already proved his worth in the world of Heroes too. How will he fare in this battle?
Pegasus only visits the Map Factory when he needs advice or new maps. On another trip to pick up some maps, a plea for help reached him on the road. He gathered his herd of Silver Pegasi and set out.
Gremlin and his gremlins were the first to reach the Map Factory. He was in such a hurry that he left all his spell scrolls at home. He did not bring much of an army either. All his gremlins are celebrating the release of the game’s Czech translation in the tavern and could not give a damn about a military campaign. How much can Gremlin achieve with this little band of blue helpers?
Hidden is one of the best-known mapmakers. This time, however, his reputation and honour are at stake. Can he pass this fateful test?
Although Sira usually sides with good, this time she succumbed to Leki’s promises and decided to accompany him on this expedition. Through no fault of her own, she ended up here and cannot leave.
What would you like to know? Surely you all know Leki well enough.
Nomad was among the first to rush to help. First, however, he went to some old acquaintances, hoping to obtain reinforcements. A little too late, he noticed that there was no direct route to the castle from this side. Will he be useful in this battle?
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.monster.14: Welcome, our leader! We are so lonely here. Take us into your army.
You will get the treasures we guard only over our dead bodies. If you can defeat us, that is.
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.monster.17: Well, you little runts? Get lost, or we will tear you to pieces!
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.monster.51:
Good day.
Please, have you seen a copy of the guide {"The Peasant and Heroes3"?
We need to improve at this game. You have never heard of it? At least take us with you so we can learn something.
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.monster.70: You dare challenge us with such a tiny herd? Do not make us laugh!
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.quest.25.6: Will you leave me 100 Battle Dwarves? I will reward you royally.
I need brave, courageous warriors for my king’s army. I see you have some with you. Leave me at least 100 and I will reward you well.
Your dwarves cannot be brave warriors if even a minor skirmish costs them so many lives. Unless you bring me a full hundred, I cannot help you.
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.sign.21.46: You really do not need to go here!
map.[sod] - nejen v mokrinách.town.5.3.0: A very valuable gift arrived from your supporters a short while ago. When they heard what lay ahead of you, they joined forces and built a Grail structure in your town.
map.[sod] - ohen a led.event.0.descripti: For over ten years, you and your rival have been unable to agree on who should rule the Land of Ice, your ancestral homeland. You have tried to compromise, but the other always made a different proposal, and you ended up back where you started. A week ago, you both tried to destroy each other with spells, but the resulting devastation merely split the territory in two. Your lightning struck the rock in the centre of the land, burying the only pass connecting the two sides.
map.[sod] - ohen a led.event.1.descripti: Your advance will now slow, as you must first find another route to your opponent. You must ride out on your trusty steed and explore the surroundings.
map.[sod] - ohen a led.event.2.descripti: In less than a day, you have already found a possible route to your rival. Near the castle lies an entrance to the land of eternal fires: Hell itself. This does not cheer you much, for you know how treacherous its denizens are. But you tell yourself that nothing will stop you from defeating your rival. At least he will see your strength, and perhaps surrender. Besides, you think he is too cowardly to venture into Hell himself. That could be your advantage.
map.[sod] - ohen a led.event.3.descripti: What is that? Something is moving among the trees ahead. You ride towards whoever or whatever is hiding there. As you draw closer, you see it is none other than your long-lived messenger, trotting towards you at a leisurely pace. When he reaches you, he bends over, breathing heavily. Once he catches his breath, he tells you he has discovered an old castle on the other side. There is much activity around it, and something very strange about its inhabitants: they all wear your rival’s emblem on their clothes. They must be lost soldiers who could not get home when the rock fell and blocked their way, so they settled in that castle.
map.[sod] - ohen a led.event.4.descripti: It seems a few complications have arisen, but you do not worry too much. It would probably be best to capture that castle first, weakening your opponent a little without him even knowing he has lost any soldiers. He has probably lost contact with them. As you ponder this, a thought gives you pause: what if something similar has happened to some of your own men? But you tell yourself your soldiers are very well trained and can take care of themselves if they were stranded on the other side.
map.[sod] - ohen a led.event.5.descripti: A month has passed, and you still have no news of your enemy. Never before have you gone so long without word of him. Unfortunately, that is because the collapsed rock separates you. On the other hand, you have an advantage: you have found an entrance to the Land of Fire, and can prepare to invade its depths.
map.[sod] - ohen a led.guards.3.35.1.mes: Now you are in the Land of Fire, home of infernal creatures. Vapours rise everywhere, and you can sense the mysterious power hidden here. This will hardly be a bed of roses. But if you want to be the best, a few demons cannot shake you. Or can they?
map.[sod] - ohen a led.guards.35.5.1.mes: Now you are in the Land of Fire, home of infernal creatures. Vapours rise everywhere, and you can sense the mysterious power hidden here. This will hardly be a bed of roses. But if you want to be the best, a few demons cannot shake you. Or can they?
map.[sod] - ohen a led.header.descriptio: Two longstanding rivals vie for the Land of Ice. Neither will yield; each wants to defeat his opponent and prove that he alone is the greatest wizard.
map.[sod] - ohen a led.header.name: Fire and Ice
map.[sod] - ohen a led.town.35.33.1.even: Because you have taken so long to win, the infernal lord has received reinforcements from his associate Satan. You will have your work cut out.
Because you have taken so long to win, the infernal lord has received reinforcements from his associate Satan. You will have your work cut out.
Something has emerged from the dark smoke. Prepare for battle.
If you open the box, several dragons will attack you!!
Your soldiers are beside themselves with joy.
Halt! No one may go any further. It is dangerous for you.
map.[sod] - okres semily.header.descript: Everyone wants to control the entire district, but only whoever finds and builds the Grail can succeed.
map.[sod] - okres semily.header.name: Semily District
Several gold mines and enormous riches lie in one part of the underground.
An old prison is hidden underground, holding several mighty heroes.
One Pandora’s Box, roughly in the centre of the map, contains 5 Faerie Dragons and 3 Azure Dragons. Beware of them.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.0.biogra: Nothing at all is known about Ferdinand. One day he appeared in the local tavern and brutally beat up the local commander. He has replaced him ever since, fighting for Jablonec’s interests.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.0.name: Ferdinand
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.102.biog: Crag Hack is probably the greatest brawler in the land. He believes in nothing but brute force in single combat. This barbarian comes from the distant Frozen Highlands, where he learned to fight. Once peace settled there, he set out for Harrachov to make his name in the greatest battles.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.116.biog: General Uštván is the most famous Hungarian commander. With his army of Mighty Gorgons, he has already won many battles. He now fights for Paseky, seeking to control the entire district and live in financial security until his death.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.116.name: Uštván
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.134.biog: Fujin was once a great mage, but decided to devote more attention to combat and tactics. This angered his superiors, who imprisoned him.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.134.name: Fujin
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.137.biog: This young sorceress comes from Bracada, where she studied elemental magic. After accidentally casting Armageddon on a friendly village, she was imprisoned. She is now willing to fight for her liberator’s cause.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.137.name: Jennifer
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.145.biog: Adrienne is a dark witch from the swamps. Little is yet known about her.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.146.biog: Johanka is one of the few women who chose knighthood as their profession. Yet she excels at it far more than some men. Johanka was captured during the battle for Paris.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.146.name: Johanka
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.147.biog: Lazarus is one of the dark mages belonging to the "Black Hand", an organisation devoted to dark magic. During one of his experiments, however, he wiped out the entire royal family of a distant land and was imprisoned.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.147.name: Lazarus
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.148.biog: Gelu is probably the finest archer for miles around. He has proved it in many battles, but in one of them his comrades betrayed him and he was sent to prison.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.150.biog: Baal is a member of the trio of brothers Diablo, Mephisto and Baal, and has been killed and resurrected several times. This makes his power even greater.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.150.name: Baal
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.151.biog: Andariel is the mysterious ruler of the underground. She is very strong and powerful, and hates titans with a deadly passion.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.151.name: Andariel
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.153.biog: Wormthrax leads all the dragons in the world. He is probably the most powerful individual of all.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.153.name: Wormthrax
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.154.biog: Duriel is a huge, strong barbarian. His barbaric habits and inclinations are probably his most distinctive traits.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.154.name: Duriel
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.155.biog: Lord Diablo, as this devil is known, is one of Hell’s most powerful representatives on earth. Yet he was betrayed and imprisoned.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.155.name: Lord Diablo
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.21.biogr: Arnošt Šír is one of the land’s most experienced commanders. He also has the greatest knowledge, and understands both combat and magic. His only weakness is cards. Otherwise, this ranger is tough and unyielding.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.21.name: Arnošt Šír
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.23.biogr: Miroslav Kobr is a respected hero who fights for none of the great towns, but for the interests of small villages such as Poniklá, Výchová, Hrabčov and others.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.23.name: Mirek Kobr
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.33.biogr: Adolf Wagner comes from Germany. He taught magic in Jilemnice for a time, but someone tried to kill him, so he left for Vysoké. He now seeks to control everything that can possibly be controlled.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.33.name: Adolf Wagner
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.48.biogr: Hyjacint is the only Demoniac who actually comes from Semily. He hides his murderous, angry nature well, but it is common knowledge that he murdered all his friends and family. As a commander, however, he is indispensable to Semily.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.48.name: Hyjacint
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.65.biogr: Jeníček is a famous and dangerous necromancer from Rokytnice, like all the other necromancers.  He has already wrought great havoc with his army of skeletons.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.65.name: Jeníček
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.83.biogr: Von Bork was once a member of the STASI, then became a nuclear physicist. A head injury during an experiment left him intent on killing his former boss Adolf Wagner, who now serves Vysoké.
map.[sod] - okres semily.heroes.83.name: Von Bork
map.[sod] - okres semily.monster.45.37.1: This is my artifact, and you will not take it from me!
map.[sod] - okres semily.monster.77.35.1: It is unsafe beyond here. We must kill you!
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.26.56.0.c: Oh, splendid. Here is your reward.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.26.56.0.f: Destroy Adolf Wagner and I will reward you.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.33.48.0.c: Oh, I have always longed to meet someone as powerful as you.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.33.48.0.f: I collect information about powerful heroes. Reach Spell Power 20, then come to me and I will reward you.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.33.48.0.n: Have you found someone with Spell Power 20?? No?? Then keep looking!
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.43.34.1.f: Entry to the treasury is very expensive. You must pay 50000 gold, 20 of each resource, and 50 each of wood and ore.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.43.34.1.n: You have not paid. You are going nowhere.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.49.29.0.c: Splendid, thank you. Here is your reward.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.49.29.0.f: I am old now, and would like to speak to someone who has reached level 20. Please, if you know such a person, send them to me.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.49.29.0.n: Oh no. Return when you reach level 20.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.50.45.0.c: Oh, splendid. Just what I needed. Take my wizard’s hat as your reward.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.50.45.0.f: Long ago there lived an evil mage who created a mighty orb called ORB OF INHIBITION. Bring it to me, and I will give you something even mightier.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.50.45.0.n: Nothing??? Then why bore me with your presence??? Go and find ORB OF INHIBITION!
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.76.48.0.c: Done?? Good, the way is clear.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.76.48.0.f: If you wish to go further, you must defeat the Faerie Dragons north of here.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.76.48.0.n: You have not defeated them?? Then why are you wasting my time?
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.80.33.1.f: I demand 8 Ghost Dragons for a pass
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.80.33.1.n: I am sorry, but unless you bring me 8 Ghost Dragons, I will not let you through.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.80.37.0.c: Oh, done. Thank you. Accept this reward.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.80.37.0.f: Von Bork is a threat to us all, so he must die.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.80.37.0.n: Von Bork is still alive and free. Do not linger here.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.81.24.1.f: I want 8 Archangels to let you through.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.81.28.1.f: I want 8 Black Dragons, then you will receive a pass.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.81.28.1.n: You do not have 8 Black Dragons with you!
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.89.24.1.f: I want 8 Titans, or you can leave.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.93.24.1.f: I want 8 Ancient Behemoths, then you will be free.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.93.28.1.f: I want 8 Chaos Hydras to let you through.
map.[sod] - okres semily.quest.93.33.1.f: I demand 8 Arch Devils to let you through.
map.[sod] - okres semily.sign.73.69.0.me: Enter the whirlpool and you will find treasure.
map.[sod] - okres semily.sign.86.33.1.me:
From the north, in rows, left to right:
1.Castle  2.Rampart  3.Tower   4.Stronghold 
5.Dungeon   6.Fortress 
 7.Necropolis  8.Inferno
map.[sod] - ostrovni valka.header.descri:
You plan to occupy the islands around your country, but your neighbours want the same thing.
Gather an army and go to war.
map.[sod] - ostrovni valka.header.name: Island War
map.[sod] - pasti.guards.1.19.0.message: Where have you been all this time, my commander?
map.[sod] - pasti.guards.1.35.1.message: Take my advice: you can still turn back.
