map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.event.0.de: After Judge Grey's death, peace also perished in this land of humans and elves. Humans and elves are at war, playing into the hands of Deyja's necromancers. As the representatives of humanity, King Roland Ironfist and his wife Queen Catherine Ironfist, your task is to resolve this problem. You follow the path of light, so you must find and assemble the powerful artifact {"Angelic {Alliance"} and deliver it to Judge Fairweather, who eagerly awaits you in the heavenly city of Celeste. If you fail, humans and elves will slaughter one another, and their bodies will form undead armies fighting for the necromancers of Deyja! You must not allow this! At their head stands Archibald Ironfist, the family's black sheep, who has sided with evil. He too no longer deserves a place in this world!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.event.1.de:
A little warning:
Whenever you receive any troops, never take them into battle. If you lose them, you have no hope of bringing the winning artifact to Celeste!
Read everything written along the way. It will often put you on the right track.
Lose neither Catherine nor Roland!
Guard the red tent carefully!
Also, pay no heed to the actual story's progression from region to region. My version is a little different.
Keep every artifact you find. You never know which one you will need!!!
That should do...
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.event.2.de:
The war between humans and the elves of Tularean Forest over the rule of Erathia is reaching its climax. The battle comes to a head on a hill in Tularean Forest. As a proper adventurer, you could hardly miss it. Considering the situation, you saw that the humans greatly outnumbered the elves, which would mean elven defeat, leaving no one to put things right. You spotted a strange trumpet among the warriors, took it and left. A soldier later told you that this trumpet could decide the battle. It depended on whether you delivered it to Erathia or the elven king. Either choice, however, meant defeat and enslavement for the other side. So you decided to give it to Judge Fairweather in Celeste. You sent it with a mage who happened to be returning there. This was probably the best thing you could have done. It does not end the war, but can secure peace for a time. Final unification is possible only with the Angelic Alliance artifact.
Your decision also earned you a reward:
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.event.3.de:
Many quests await you on this map! Around 20 - 30, perhaps. (I do not know the exact number; I cannot be bothered to count them.) Stick with them all: victory will feel all the sweeter afterwards.

Send me your winning score tables (the final scores where you enter your name), so I can see how you did. 
{FIREBIRD
{firebird@email.cz
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.guards.0.4: "Beware, my lady. One of Deyja's necromancers has been teleported here. He is no novice, so please take care!" says an inhabitant of a nearby hut.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.guards.1.3: Do not dismiss this hero under any circumstances, or you will never win!!!
"You should have chosen the other side. There are plenty of enemies here!"
As you made your way among the rocks, you saw something gleaming. You approached and saw it was an artifact. At first you could not identify it, but closer inspection revealed a "Necklace of Ocean Guidance" /Necklace of Ocean Guidance/. According to the reports and legends you knew, it allowed a ship to travel faster over water. That could be useful, you thought. But surely someone in this region must want it?
"Only Catherine Ironfist, and no one else, may enter Celeste!"
You glimpsed an enormous club among the rocks. Your warriors said it had belonged to some supreme ogre. The elves killed him here, leaving this artifact behind. They had no interest in it, but you should, because you will certainly need it. It will not be easy, though: some ogres have remained here for many long years to guard the club!
A truly difficult trial awaits you now! Stay alive and show what you are made of!
This is the Familiar Place tavern, where Judge Fairweather was collected. He now awaits you in Celeste. Do not disappoint him!
The titans ruling Avlee charge everyone entering their territory 25000 gold pieces! You must pay too!
This portal leads straight into the heart of the necromancers' kingdom... headed by Archibald Ironfist!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.guards.2.0: "Welcome. Only because you surrendered those 50 Ghost Dragons to the Riverstride Fortress patrol is this artifact now available, and yours alone. Take care not to lose it anywhere, or your chance to unite humans and elves and destroy the necromancers will be wasted! Be careful, and do not fail the people of Erathia!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.guards.2.2: "You are entering the training grounds. Pay the entrance fee!"
"This artifact, the "Skull Helmet" /Skull Helmet/, is not among the finest, but necromancers prize it highly. Surely you are here to deprive this rabble of the artifact they use for black magic, the worst evil humanity could face. Take it now, lord of Erathia, and carry it away. If my information is correct, someone nearby will want to exchange passage into Deyja's flooded regions for it."
"In the past, this artifact was heavily guarded because of its unusual power. Many dubious characters constantly sought it. Now it is yours!"
After failing to be elected, Judge Sleen decided to take revenge on all living things and stationed his servants in every corner of Erathia and Enroth!
"Did you not hear the warning? Suddenly, numerous basilisks stood against you!"
"This journey is very important to you, for the Evenmorn Islands hold many rare things. Yet even Lord Markham did not expect opponents of his, and yours, along the route he sent you on!"
"I rule all Erathia! Lord Markham's authority extends only over Tatalia, so stop wasting my time and disappear! In these lands, I AM the law!" you replied.
"Do you think we care? We will destroy you here, and no one will ever know!"
You are entering the flooded regions around the Bracada Desert, which gradually became swampland.
Stone from the nearby Erathian quarry.
/It has been closed for ages, but someone has "stolen" some again./
The journey through the jungle will not be safe!
"These boots were made over 250 years ago somewhere in Tatalia by an armourer. Since he made them under a full moon, assisted by a monk, they gained considerable powers. Take them and look after them!"
Suddenly, zombies began crawling out of the ground!
An opponent so good that he is immortal!

As soon as you entered this place, you saw a vast number of monks, who immediately approached. You learned that this was sacred ground, where the Order of Baa was founded long ago. These monks, however, do not belong to that sinister clan. They have always opposed it and fought to destroy the Order of Baa, but have always been too weak. So they guard this place and admit no one, lest the power of ancient times affect a visitor and draw them into the Order of Baa. Some decided to join you precisely because the order's high priest still lives...

In the middle of the forest, you saw an old, half-ruined hut. Inside sat an ancient seeress at a table with a deck of cards. The cards looked very old. She told you this was no ordinary deck, but possessed a rare power. You could hardly believe she eventually gave it to you. She said she had kept these cards for someone like you for a long time. She had others, but those would be worthless to you. You thanked her and left.
This is certainly not the one. You chose badly!
"You ignored the warning? Your mistake. Draw your weapon!"
"Do not let the enemy even approach this tent. If they get it, you have lost!!"

Relax, I will not trouble you with science fiction here, as unfortunately happened at the end of Might and Magic7. Everything will stay comfortably in ancient times. Laser rifles really do not belong in this world. 3DO and NWC did not think that one through very well.

{Firebird

P.S. I look forward to receiving your winning scores at:
{firebird@email.cz

WARNING!
Only one of these two paths is safe!

Beyond the mountains, you glimpsed a mysterious castle. Could it be the castle on Mount Nighon? Probably not: that one is not in Deyja, but beyond the Nighon Tunnels linking Stone City to Mount Nighon.

WARNING!
A TRAP lies a few steps below!
You reached a meadow filled with four-leaf clovers. How strange, you thought. So many in one place? Something is wrong; there must be a catch. Then you saw a larger one in the middle, somehow different from the rest. You approached. Yes, this one was made of stone. Probably an artifact, you thought. You picked it up and waited to see what happened. The others vanished. You kept it and decided to leave this strange meadow.
As you sailed here, several belligerent water elementals immediately gathered around you. 
"What are you doing here, stranger? In these waters?"
"I must sail this way, so stand aside and stop bothering me!"
"These are our waters. Get out!"
"NO! I am sailing on, and unless you stop, I will kill you all and have some peace!"
Seeing that your army was many times larger than theirs, the water elementals realised they could not defeat it and decided to join you. The only question is whether you want them. But you should take them: you may miss them later!
Suddenly, zombies began crawling out of the ground!
A little wood.
/Someone has dismantled another person's house again./
As you bent to pick up this Centaur's Axe, a group of centaurs spotted you. They told you their king had indeed died, but of old age, through no one's fault. You had not wanted to believe the Rust Dragon's account, but hearing it from the centaurs themselves convinced you. They then gave you permission to take it, so you did.

"You are a truly capable commander to have made it this far! The "Wizard's Well" artifact is now within reach. Take it: at last, after 700 years, it has a new owner. Use it as well as you can. Plenty of bandits will be after your blood now. Its power means nothing to them; they chiefly want to sell it on the black market, where Deyja's necromancers will pay a fortune. Bracada's mages will be disappointed that it has fallen into such evil hands, but will no longer want it. So let no one take it from you!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.guards.4.9: "You can get out only if King Roland finds the red Keymaster's Tent!"
"Nothing pleasant awaits you here. You are in the land of Deyja's necromancers. What do you think will face you? Go on, guess."
"A warm welcome?" you said "wittily".
/You certainly talk a lot for someone about to fight./
"Are you mad? That is the last thing awaiting you. We have something else."
"Shall we go for a glass of fine wine?" came your 2nd reply.
"Are you that stupid, or pretending? These lords think they own the world. Well, the surprise we prepared is several liches. Quite a lot, actually. Enjoy yourself!"
"Good Water, for your PREDATORY life." /Enjoy, Gremlin!!!/
"Well, someone is curious how he measures up against the other enemies. You may be the most important person in Erathia to us, but they are important to themselves, and there are many of them! Be careful, and do not give up!" says a peasant.
Ancient dark mages created this artifact to support their dragons, but more powerful light (white) magic killed them. The artifact was then hidden deep among the rocks to keep it from the wrong hands. Nevertheless, it was stolen and brought here. No one knows who brought it. Take it now. It is useless to you, since you have no dragons, but others here do. Or trade it somewhere for something you need more.
The surrounding countryside frightened your army, greatly lowering its morale.
Your magical abilities improve a little more!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.guards.5.1: You have entered a place where a great heroic deed once occurred. Bandits were about to hang a Bracadan mage here when a brave warrior from Tatalia saved him. Ever since, that warrior has held a place among Bracada's finest mages. He sent an archangel here to protect the site, and to join and aid anyone pure of mind who follows the light. That means you. From this moment, the angel is in your service!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.guards.5.5: "Our church is at your disposal, my lady!"
Think very carefully before sacrificing any artifact here!!
Genuine Erathian flour is milled here!
"You are leaving the Barrow Downs. I hope you enjoyed your stay. Come again!" says a dwarf standing near the portal.
"What? Are you advertising this place or something? Do you want people to return?"
"Of course, provided they are not necromancers."
How strange, you thought. What else will this world bring, now that even advertising has arrived? /At least it is not for Rama... Never mind, that just slipped out.../
"I heard there were dwarves in the Barrow Downs, but I see Ghost Dragons over there."
You have entered a place where a great heroic deed once occurred. Bandits were about to hang a Bracadan mage here when a brave warrior from Tatalia saved him. Ever since, that warrior has held a place among Bracada's finest mages. He sent an archangel here to protect the site, and to join and aid anyone pure of mind who follows the light. That means you. From this moment, the angel is in your service!
"But which of them are friends now?"
This is The Snobish Goblin tavern, where Judge Sleen, the representative of Deyja's necromancers, waited. After being rejected, he turned against all living things...
"Where might this portal lead, standing right beside this necromancer's castle?"
As you passed the forest, something suddenly flashed within. Wondering what it was, you sent in scouts. They returned about 15 minutes later, reporting an enormous quantity of gems. You followed them and indeed found an unprecedented hoard. You looked around for a while, but when no one appeared, you collected the pile.
According to reports from Tatalia, Judge Sleen is also roaming these parts. He was not chosen, but will gain power if you fail! If he does, the entire land will fall to Deyja's necromancers, and legions of undead armies will arise to conquer the whole world, piece by piece! This must be prevented. Surely every human and elf who does not wish to wander the countryside as a zombie must agree...

"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"
"I am a crystal spring. Please drink!"

/Which film was that from?/
This is Castle Harmondale, seat of the local lords. A route once led from here to the Land of the Giants (Land of the Giants), but the portal was destroyed during the wars between humans and elves. No one can ever reach it again. A pity: great riches lay there.
"Ah, that is his private road straight to the gold mine. I am not lucky enough to have a gold mine there."
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.guards.7.5: "Only Catherine Ironfist, and no one else, may enter Celeste!"
"You defeated these phoenixes who sided with evil all by yourself. Now take your reward, king (queen) of Erathia!" says a dwarf.

Yes, this is the feared homeland of the necromancers: DEYJA. Onward, then! Many enemies lurk here, but so do places holding the items and treasures needed to complete your final task. Good luck, and search well. It will take some effort!

"For Erathia, then!!"
you cried, and charged deeper into Deyja.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.guards.9.5: The names are taken from Might and Magic 7, which I consider the best of the three latest M&M games (=6, 7, 8). Anyone who has not played it has missed a lot!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.guards.9.6: "Which way will you go now? One route will be very difficult!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.header.des:
Make peace between humans and elves, and unite all Erathia and Enroth! You fight for humanity's rulers, Queen Catherine and her husband, King Roland Ironfist! Drive out Deyja's necromancers, slaughter them and free Deyja for humanity!
{Created by: FIREBIRD
{firebird@email.cz
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.heroes.146: Catherine Ironfist, Queen of Enroth. Before she married Roland Ironfist, her name was Catherine Gryphonheart. She now rules Enroth and Erathia alongside Roland. Her military experience is needed to help Roland in Erathia fight the necromancers of Deyja, who are spreading throughout the land and raising ever larger armies of undead. Catherine naturally follows the path of light, goodness and peace, though peace is difficult to maintain now that war has broken out between humans and elves...
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.heroes.152: King of Enroth and Erathia since marrying Catherine Gryphonheart. His brother Archibald Ironfist sides with the necromancers!
"Why, Queen Catherine of Enroth herself! What brings you to Erathia?"
"I have come to help my husband, King Roland Ironfist, at Gryphonheart Castle, against the necromancers of Deyja," says Catherine.
"In that case, allow us to help you!"
"Of course. I would be delighted to welcome you into my army."
"Can it be? The Queen of Enroth wandering around Erathia? Be careful this isn't your last outing!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.10:
"What's happening? It feels as though there's an active volcano somewhere!!" you cry.
No sooner have you spoken than several magma elementals rise from the magma all around you. They do not look inclined to invite you to lunch /unless you are the lunch/, but they are certainly eager for a fight. You have rather too many enemies here!!

"So you're seeking Celeste now? We once lived in Celeste too, but we were expelled, supposedly for treason we never committed," say the archangels.
"You must have done something. Otherwise nobody would ever have thrown you out of Celeste," you reply.
"So you're against us too? We won't stand for that! You will die!"
"We'll see!" you cry, signalling your army to attack.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.16: "Come on, we've been waiting here for you for days!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.17:
"Well, well, we must be dreaming! His Lordship from Erathia himself! What are you doing here?" booms a deep voice from above, echoing everywhere.
"I'm going to visit the village of Avlee," you reply. You have to shout very loudly to be heard all the way "up there"...
"Avlee is ours! They refuse to find our lost sword, so they shall suffer!"
"But isn't that pointless? Couldn't you reach some agreement with them?"
"Listen, little human. You're nothing beside us, and your army is laughable. We come from the Titans' fortress nearby, and we guard the entrance to Avlee. If you want to pass, you'll have to earn it!" says the enormous voice of this enormous creature...
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.18:
"No, we cannot let you into this temple!"
"You don't address me as my lord (my lady)?"
"We see no reason why we should!"
"Because I am the king(queen) of this country, where you live too!"
"And what does that do for us? It means nothing to us. Besides, that glorious House of Ironfist of yours wanted to close our temple!"
"So you mean to insult me? This is the end of you!!!!"
"Stop showing off and prove yourself!"

"We are the original inhabitants of the Eeofol tunnels!" say the behemoths.
"What's that to me? Am I supposed to take my hat off to you?" you reply.
"You could. You'd be hard pressed to find warriors as fearless as us!"
"Warriors? Don't you mean monsters?" you say.
"Who are you calling monsters, little human? We are the terror of these parts!" 
"Ooh, I'm scared..." you mock them.
The thoroughly irritated behemoths can take no more /their nerves must have snapped/ and charge at you!
"But you belong to the guard at Gryphonheart Castle!" says Queen Catherine.
"We did, but not anymore!" say the griffins.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.20:
A dark cloud descends over you. /No, Firebird wasn't flying past; they're not holding an air show today./ Looking up, you see a great many ghosts, but these are no ordinary ghosts guarding some musty graveyard. They are the spirits of long-dead dragons who fell into the clutches of necromancers after death. There can hardly be anything worse than these dragons! Facing a dragon's ghost is no soldier's dream. Yet now you must drive off and destroy this band of dragons. 
"A pity I have no light magic. That would teach them!" you remark, already watching the dragons prepare to attack...

These majestic titans can be seen towering over the landscape from far away. As you approach, you can scarcely believe their size. They truly are enormous creatures. Without your army, they would surely smash you to pieces. 
"Hey, up there! Would you mind moving aside?" you shout.
"Who do you think you are, little human? Look how tiny you are!"
You signal your army to form up behind you, infantry neatly in front and archers behind, and order them to prepare to fire.
"We have the advantage, and I've already defeated many titans with this army!"
"So you're the one who has been wiping out our friends from the Titans' fortress and the land of giants? Well, now you've met the best of them! This is your end! Just like the elves of Avlee!"
"We'll see whose end it is, do you hear? Soldiers, to battle!"
At your cry, the titans immediately begin hurling enormous lightning bolts that are almost impossible to dodge. Your army is very experienced by now, however, and can take a beating. Your archers open fire at once. Amid that sea of arrows, even warriors like the titans struggle to survive... 
And how did it turn out? That's up to you...

"Well, well, Lord Ironfist himself! We don't get visitors like you every day. We must savour you: would you prefer to be lunch or dinner?"
"Neither, but you'll make lovely rugs!"
"We know! We'll put you in storage and save you for a special occasion."
"We'll see about that!" you say. You will have to fight!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.21: Long ago, when Erathia was still a young land, before humans and later elves settled here, all manner of monsters made their homes in these parts. Among them were some very wealthy peoples. Great wealth was not unusual then. Some possessed vast quantities of diamonds from nearby mines that now stand empty. But then this people vanished, and Erathia as we know it today began to emerge. From that heap of diamonds came many golems, fashioned from this extremely hard and precious mineral. Their creation was a consequence of the first experiments with black magic in those days. Now it falls to you to face them.

"You're guarding this pitiful hoard?" you cry.
"It may not be much to you, but it's everything we have!" say the water elementals.
"Or is it something you stole somewhere, eh?"
"You've got some nerve!"
"Now I remember where I know you from! You're from Avlee, where you guard the Titans' fortress! Against the elves!"
"It's true. We used to be there, but the elves beat us all up and…"
"Then the Titans came to help you! I know, everyone knows that story!"
"So you're a friend of the elves too?"
"Not exactly, but I am helping to bring peace between humans and elves," you reply.
"Peace? You can't be serious! Get him!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.24: "Well, a hero! Another one who wishes to die! Come on, then!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.25: "Welcome, King of Erathia (Queen). We may be mummies, but we are on your side! We have nothing to do with the necromancers of Deyja, and never have. So don't kill us; take us with you instead. We will certainly be useful, but be careful that nothing happens to us, or your mission will probably go very badly."

Suddenly, a huge forest fire spreads all around you.
"What on earth is happening!" you cry.
Whoooosh... several warlike Firebirds fly overhead... /me/
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.27:
"Are you on the elves' side?"
"Yes, we are."
"And how do you feel about humans?"
"We don't like humans."
"But I am the king(queen)! You must fall to your knees before me!"
"Haha! Was that a joke or a threat? The only one falling will be you, at our knees!"

"We come from Avlee, where elves and titans are at war. As you can surely see, we resemble titans more than humans or elves. In fact, we're rather like their relatives. Now you must fight us, whether you like it or not. It makes no difference to us whether you've returned the sword to the titans of the Titans' fortress. We answer only to ourselves! So fight and show us what you're made of!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.29: "We've been waiting for you! What took you so long? Take us with you now, and remember that none of us must come to any harm!"
"The great ruler of Erathia himself, King Roland. We are delighted to have found you, my lord. May we join you now?"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.30:
"Trolls aren't on the side of light, are they?"
"We are. We're from Tatalia," says one of the trolls.
"But bitter wars rage in Tatalia between trolls and the inhabitants. Why should I believe you?"
"It's true. Our fellows drove us out because we no longer wanted to fight humans. Even Lord Markham, ruler of those lands, could scarcely believe it, or that we were willing to join you. He even offered us places in his army. We wanted to accept, but the people and soldiers there didn't want us. Besides, we would then have had to fight our friends, the other trolls, and we didn't like that. So we set out, left Tatalia, and ended up here on this island, which we haven't yet managed to leave. Will you accept us now?"
"I must have gone mad, but I believe you. Join us, then. There aren't many of you, so beware - if you try anything, you'll be killed!"
"We won't let you down! But none of us must fall, so please look after us."
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.31:
"You won't find better swordsmen than us anywhere in Erathia!"
"Just don't praise yourselves too highly!" you say.
"If you don't believe we're the best, come and test your strength against us!"
"As you wish, but I warned you," you reply.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.32:
"Well, those people in the watchtower have sent me another helping. How kind of them. But there's one thing we don't believe: that you're serving evil!"
"No, I'm not, but I must fight you. Otherwise they won't let me reach the dungeon, where some commander is surely being held!"
"Then you will die!"

"We salute you, King Roland. Erathia has needed someone like you for a long time. At last it has found its hero, and that hero is you. Accept us into your service. We would be honoured to die for you!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.35: "We've been waiting for you! What took you so long? Take us with you now, and remember that none of us must come to any harm!"

"Welcome, King Roland. We're just wandering the countryside, waiting to meet a capable commander, and you look like one. Would you like us to strengthen your army?"
"Of course I would like to hire you!"

"Trolls aren't on the side of light, are they?"
"We are. We're from Tatalia," says one of the trolls.
"But bitter wars rage in Tatalia between trolls and the inhabitants. Why should I believe you?"
"It's true. Our fellows drove us out because we no longer wanted to fight humans. Even Lord Markham, ruler of those lands, could scarcely believe it, or that we were willing to join you. He even offered us places in his army. We wanted to accept, but the people and soldiers there didn't want us. Besides, we would then have had to fight our friends, the other trolls, and we didn't like that. So we set out, left Tatalia, and ended up here on this island, which we haven't yet managed to leave. Will you accept us now?"
"I must have gone mad, but I believe you. Join us, then. There aren't many of you, so beware - if you try anything, you'll be killed!"
"We won't let you down! But none of us must fall, so please look after us."
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.37:
"Gryphonheart Castle is cursed! Our friends were shot there!" say the griffins.
"That was probably the hunters. We're fighting them."
"Clearly not very hard! Fight us; we don't believe you!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.39:
"The land of Erathia needs more flames!"
"No, I'll never allow that!" you say. 
"You'll have to! You have no choice! Have your trousers ever caught fire?"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.40: "This is the axe of the centaur king, who died and charged me with guarding it!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.41:
"Don't stare at us in astonishment. We don't belong to the guard at Gryphonheart Castle either."
"But if you surrender, I'll gladly hire you as an honour guard. We're running short of griffins."
"No, we're not interested in being anyone's lackeys. We'd rather kill you and that ridiculous army of yours!"
"This training arena is under our supervision!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.42: "We were among the griffins that used to fly above Steadwick in Erathia. But one day an army came and shot some of us, so we left Steadwick, and we won't let just anyone mine ore here!"

"We guard the path to a powerful artifact created more than 700 years ago, during a very difficult time for Erathia, when barbarian raids were frequent. The mages of that age created this artifact, and nobody has managed to reach it since. It is an artifact that restores all mana every day, making it indispensable to any proper wizard. The mages of the Bracada Desert were also preparing to claim it, saying their ancestors had made it and it was their inheritance, but they brought no proof, so they were not admitted. If you have proof that its creators were your ancestors, enter, and we shall join you. Otherwise, fight! Well, do you have proof or not?"
"I have no relatives in Bracada or anywhere else, and never have. I have nothing to do with those mages either!"
"Then what are you doing here?"
"Every artifact is worth having!"
"Then draw your weapon and fight!"
"Many, many years ago, a group of mages gathered near what is now the Bracada Desert. They fashioned a powerful artifact, then created us to defend it. Every intruder was killed, and so will you be!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.43: "This is our tower, where an army of archers can be recruited /Robin Hood, for instance./. That doesn't mean it's yours too!"

Pools of lava surround you. If that lava suddenly spilled over its banks, we'd all be finished, you think. But as you stand there pondering, you suddenly notice several strange dragons gathering overhead. They resemble the dragon you met near your own Gryphonheart Castle while trying to obtain the Centaur's Axe. There is one small problem: there was only one dragon near the castle, but here there is a whole flock. 
I have no choice but to fight! "Army, attack!" you cry, and your army charges at them!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.46: Suddenly, you feel as though you have stepped into a story. Before you stand many dragons familiar from Erathian fairy tales, told to children even in your own city of Steadwick. Yet this is no flight of fancy. It is real!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.48: The moment you see this group of hydras, you want to slaughter them. But when they tell you that you will certainly need them, you give up the idea, and they join you.
"Our magma has very powerful fiery effects. If you have no protection against fire /a wooden shield, for example/, say goodbye to your life!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.52:
"This forest is full of treasures and artifacts. If you are worthy to claim them, enter, and we will join you as well. But if you are unworthy of these treasures, leave!"
"I am the king (queen) of Erathia, so I think I have a right to them."
"Just because you're the king (queen) doesn't mean you can have everything you want!" 
"Will you clear the way, then?"
"NO!"
"Then I'll make my own way. Soldiers, attack!" /Blasters at the ready!/
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.53: "We have never served your House of Ironfist. Neither we nor our ancestors, and we have no intention of changing that now. Come on, then, and show your military prowess against us peasants, the best of the best!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.56: These diamonds belonged to Erathia. For many years, the people of Erathia have mined diamonds here for Gryphonheart Castle, then sold them throughout the surrounding lands. Many well-paying buyers have even been found in Jadame. But now gold golems have moved in, and they need to be evicted! See to it!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.61: "Our spells that affect the mind are very powerful. There is no defence against them. If you're not very experienced in battle, you're DEAD!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.62:
"Well, well, His Lordship from Erathia himself! To what do we owe your visit, my lord?"
"I need to visit that guard tent to get permission to pass these gates."
"Everyone would like that, and we cannot allow it. Unless you pay!"
"And what is the price?"
"The price is your surrender!"
"That is out of the question. I must not fail Erathia and Enroth!"
"But you're here now, so you'll have to pay with your life!"
"Come on, then, dragons! Show me what you're made of!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.67: "We're the ones, and don't let anything happen to us!"

"We come from Celeste," say the archangels.
"Then what are you doing here?" you ask.
"We were stationed here to help anyone seeking to unite this land, and we think that might be you!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.68: "You haven't the slightest chance against us. We attack your mind, and there is no defence against that!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.monster.71:
"More mummies! But what else could I expect in Deyja? Troops, attack!"
"No, wait! Stop! We're not on those madmen's side. We were alive too, before we came here. The necromancers discarded us like this because we resisted the spells meant to bring us over to their side."
"Really? In that case, welcome to my army!"

"Legend says phoenixes are mythical birds that guard the mighty treasures of Erathia. Is that true?" you ask the phoenixes /Firebirds are better anyway!!/.
"Yes, it is true. But we don't guard them for no reason. We do it to keep them from falling into the wrong hands."
"So that means you won't give it to me?"
"You guessed it. Not for anything. We have allied ourselves with Judge Sleen, whom you humans rejected. But he has a sound view of the world, and he is sure to prosper!"
"So that's how it is! Sleen is involved! But he wants to expand the necromancer nation, and you want to help them? I must be dreaming! Anyone who sides with evil shall die! That is one of Erathia's laws!" you cry, charging at the phoenixes.
/According to some Greek or other legend, a phoenix is a bird that destroys itself once every 500 years and is born again... interesting/
According to every report, the Bracada Desert is full of griffins. 
"So it's true!" cries a soldier in your army. "Look at them! There are so many! A legion! They have designs on Celeste too!"
"Excellent! Our colleagues will be escorted back to Bracada. Thank you!"

The mages of Bracada in this tower ask you to bring them 5 of their fellow Enchanters (Enchanters), who have been captured and imprisoned here in Deyja. Only by finding them will you be allowed through.
The mages are disappointed that you have not brought their colleagues, who were captured many days ago, but they give you more time.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.1.31:
"So you actually did it? Well, I'm impressed! We'll spread the word throughout Erathia that you helped the necromancers! Everyone will despise you then. We'll be promoted, and you? You'll be crawling through Erathia's sewers so no one can see you!! Haha!!"
Unable to bear the thought that all this might really happen, you shoot the whole gang of goblins as soon as the gate opens. Now no one will ever know, and you will remain a hero of Erathia...

As soon as you enter this watchtower, a gang of goblins emerges to confront you. The necromancers of Deyja have assigned them to guard this passage. They say:
"Well, look who's visiting! How did you get through Deyja's traps? Never mind. You want to pass, Your Lordship of Erathia, don't you? It won't be that easy. We have a task for you!"
"I won't do any task for anyone from Deyja!" you reply.
"You'll have to if you want to reach this dungeon."
"I do. There's surely someone in there waiting for me!"
"Then listen. Southeast of here are some azure dragons who are not on Deyja's side. Kill them for us, and we'll let you through!"
"What? Kill someone for you? Those dragons may not be our friends, but why should I kill them just so you in Deyja can rest easy? NEVER!"
"Tough luck, then! You're going nowhere!" says the guard.
So you turn and ride away, your mind churning at the thought of having to help the necromancers with their wicked schemes...
"As we said, until those dragons are dead, you won't get permission to pass!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.10.1: He is so delighted that he cannot say a single word, and you hand them over in exchange for passage.

Not long ago, you helped the ruler of the underwater kingdom in the Shoals fight the sharks. Now another request has arrived from him. This time he asks for 10 ancient chaos hydras /Chaos Hydra/, which he needs for purposes he refuses to discuss. So you ask no questions and promise to fulfil his request.
The king is disappointed, but he will wait for them.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.16.6: "Yes, word has reached us too that Judge Sleen has fallen, along with his dark armies. Our Judge Fairweather's position is no longer threatened!"

"Passage back to the surface will only be allowed once Judge Sleen and his armies have been defeated. As long as he remains here, Judge Fairweather is still in danger!" says the representative of Bracada's mages.
"We have no reports yet that Sleen has been defeated!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.17.2: "Excellent, I am delighted! At last there will be peace in the Shoals, my kingdom. You have my thanks, friend. If you ever need anything, do not hesitate to ask us!"

The king of the underwater realm in the Shoals asks you for 100 Water Elementals to protect his people from the sharks, which, as everyone knows, are very numerous in the Shoals. Finding them surely cannot be too difficult. They are said to be somewhere in this water channel, but none of his people has found them yet. Bring them to him yourself.
"No, I really will not let you through unless you bring me those 100 Water Elementals, who are supposedly somewhere in the channel. But hurry! My people are almost helpless against the sharks now!!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.19.5: "Incredible! You really found them? Please give them to us now. Here is your reward. We will immediately return them to their rightful places in the Erathian provinces."

Celeste's chief guard addresses you:
"Welcome, brave hero. Assembling the artifact is a very difficult undertaking, but you have made your choice, and there is no turning back. We have decided to help you. But it will not be free! We need 3 artifacts from you, fashioned over many centuries in Tatalia, Avlee and Erathia, then stolen from their shrines and carried off to places unknown. Your task is to find them, wherever they may be."
"These are the artifacts we seek:"
Legs of Legion /Legs of Legion/
Loins of Legion /Loins of Legion/
Torso of Legion /Torso of Legion/
"If you bring them to us, you will receive the supreme artifact, currently held within Celeste's walls. It is being kept for a true hero like you. This artifact would fetch an incalculable sum on the black market. You are among the few given this opportunity. Do not fail like those before you, who could not find these artifacts and paid with their lives. We place our hopes in you! And the reward reflects that!"
"You don't have them? Your loss. You get nothing. And we had such high hopes for you. Never mind, perhaps someone else will come along."
The guards are pleased. At last the sacrifice to the light can be made. These dragon spirits will be sacrificed, and their destruction will restore life to 50 people in Erathia.

The guards from Riverstride fortress, who protect a powerful artifact, demand 50 spirits of dead dragons (Ghost Dragons). Only if you bring these dragons, who will be sacrificed in the temple of light, will you be allowed through!
The guards will not let you pass unless you bring those dragons!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.20.9: "Yes, you are Tyris. You may enter!"
"Only the knight Tyris is allowed entry."
"As we said, only Tyris may pass."
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.21.7: "It is a lot, I know, but still little enough for that artifact!"

"If you want the reward, pay up!"
"The price is:" /Retail price./
500 wood, 250 mercury, 500 ore, 250 sulfur, 250 crystals, 250 gems and 50000 gold.
"If you don't pay, you get nothing. It's only logical!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.22.2:
"Bravo! Now hand them over!"
You hate hearing those words: handing poor peasants over to the necromancers. They will be easy prey, and ugly thoughts run through your mind as you imagine each one becoming a skeleton or zombie... 
Unfortunately, you have no choice!
/Oh well, they'll look like Leki's icon on Mageo..!/
"Bring 500 Peasants, or you have no right to enter!"
"Without those peasants, you haven't a chance of getting in here. Forget it!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.23.2:
"Excellent!" The elf cannot hide his delight.
"Now come with me, straight to the fortress."
You and your army set out for the Titans' fortress, hidden in the mountains of Avlee. The moment you see it, you realise what an enormous stronghold it is. Then the titans emerge. You have never seen one before and marvel at their majesty. As soon as they see their sword, they seize it. You receive many words of thanks and promises of help against Deyja's necromancers. Having titans on your side is no bad thing at all, you think... 
And the elves of Avlee are safe from the titans too... for now.

"Many hundreds, perhaps even thousands of years ago, the masters of warfare themselves, the magnificent titans in the Titans' fortress in Avlee, created a mighty sword, "Titan's Gladius" /Titan's Gladius/. But it was later stolen and lost, and nobody knows where. The titans now demand their sword back. Otherwise they will leave their fortress and raze all of Avlee to the ground. Facing titans is hardly what the elves of Avlee desire. You may be human, but elves are almost human too, so help us. Surely driving out the necromancers is what matters!!" says a very old elf who lives in this tree.
"Of course, the titans have promised a reward if you bring it to me," he adds.
"You don't have it? May heaven have mercy on the town of Avlee. If the titans come, we haven't the slightest chance!" says the elf dejectedly.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.24.7: "You wear the colour of blood. You may enter!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.25.3: "If your colour is red, you have come to the right place."
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.26.3: The guards are delighted. Your name will be spoken of throughout the surrounding lands for a long time to come. Enter now.

The guards from Riverstride fortress ask you to destroy the giants in the southern part of the mainland, away from this island. If you do, you will be allowed through. If not, you will be refused, and all your troops from Riverstride will consider you a cowardly commander. What will you choose?
The guards are disappointed in their commander when they see that the giants have still not fallen.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.28.3:
"We'd almost given up hope of seeing you again!"
"I had little choice. If I want to save Erathia, I had to find them."
"And now you'll hand them over, won't you?" says the guards' spokesman.
"I don't know. For such well-mummified remains, I would earn recognition at the temple of the sun for taking them on their final journey, towards the light..."
"Do as you wish. If you'd rather take them to the temple of the sun, go ahead. But take the trolls with you too; we won't need them then either. You've disappointed us. Leave...  Still, we'll ask you one last time:"
"Will you hand them over or not??"

This territory belongs to Riverstride fortress, whose guards will not let you pass unless you bring 20 Mummies and 20 Trolls. You will receive 10 of each beyond these watchtowers. But you must find another 10 of each yourself.

"Bring us what we want, then we can discuss what you want! Of course, we already know: you want to pass. But it isn't that simple! Anyone could say that, yet nobody wants to do anything for us. Now get moving! Let's see those iron horseshoes strike sparks!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.29.3: Returning from your long journey, you see that the man is recovering well. When he first sees you, he gives you a suspicious look /Stares like a calf at a new gate, really./, but then recognises you. When you show him the club for which he risked his own life, his delight knows no bounds. So, willingly or otherwise, you exchange the club for free passage. The man remains in your debt for the rest of his life and swears to help whenever you need him. But what can a single soldier do?

In an old, crumbling tower, you find a bleeding man and help him. He tells you the tower belongs to him. Reluctantly, he also begins to tell you how he tried to find the mighty club "Ogre's Club of Havoc" /Ogre's Club of Havoc/ in the very heart of Deyja, but could not get past its vast (and still growing) numbers of necromancers and assorted wraiths and ghosts. With the artifact almost in sight, a large group of black knights ambushed him and dealt him many wounds. Miraculously, he escaped and made it back here to this tower. And because you saved him (if you had left him alone, he would have died and you could have passed normally), he now demands that you bring him this club.

The man has recovered quite well since your last visit, though he still cannot walk. Seeing that you bring nothing, he merely waves a disappointed hand and pretends not to see you.
"Let's kill him, then, and the passage will be ours!" cries a soldier in your army.
"Absolutely not!" you snap. "He is human like us, and Erathia is his home. The House of Ironfist does not murder defenceless soldiers. If this is what the man wants, we shall do it, whatever the cost. And keep such remarks to yourself in future!" you tell the soldier.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.3.39: So you are another who will be admitted. Welcome among the finest warriors in the land!
Riverstride fortress is renowned for having the finest warriors in the land, and therefore requires anyone wishing to enter to match their prowess! You must have an Attack of 15!
Without an Attack of 15, you will never gain permission to enter.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.3.71: "Several armies of gold golems /Gold Golem/ are somewhere here in Erathia, but only some of them will join you. Be careful: lose any of them and you've lost! And I want exactly 100 of them!" you learn from this tower's guard.
"If you don't have them, you're going nowhere!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.32.1: At last we have it. Now we can pass.
It seems that without the artifact "Centaur's Axe" /Centaur's Axe/, we have no hope of reaching the place where we can obtain permission to pass the red gate!
It really is true. Without the artifact, they will not let us through to obtain permission to pass the red gate.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.32.4: You are red, of course, so enter!
Only the red player is allowed entry!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.38.7:
The old seer's delight knows no bounds. He immediately exchanges Armageddon's Blade for another rare artifact, as promised. You accompany him to the great temple of the sun, where the sun's monks and clerics conduct the ceremony needed to return Armageddon's Blade to its place on the sun altar. Now no unauthorised person can reach it, for it is protected by powerful spells of light magic, against which darkness has no chance. Necromancers cannot learn honourable light magic. 
"Thank you. You are a true hero Erathia can be proud of!" the seer says before returning to his hut.

You enter the hut of a very old seer, the oldest man in all Erathia. He needs the most powerful artifact ever known in Erathia: the mighty sword "Armageddon's Blade" /Armageddon's Blade/, over which many battles were fought in the recent past. When Gelu, the half-elf, half-human hero, sought this artifact… he failed. Now it falls to you to find Armageddon's Blade and bring it to this man, who will place it in the great temple of the sun, where it truly belongs. Naturally, he does not expect this for nothing. If you really manage to bring it, you will be rewarded. He too will give you a sword, but a different one, worth far more to you than Armageddon's Blade!

"It seems you too will join those who failed to find Armageddon's Blade. But at least you returned empty-handed. Many before you never returned at all, so that alone surprises me. Hurry now! It is high time Armageddon's Blade was restored to its place in the great temple of the sun!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.42.3: The goblin can no longer even remember his own name, but the sight of the artifact brings him round a little, and he lets you pass. Then he staggers a little (a lot) and falls over... He will probably never get up again...

A goblin is sprawled in the tower, rather tipsy. He says:
"Bring me the artifact Skull Helmet /Skull Helmet/, and perhaps I'll let you through. Now get lost. I feel a bit sick..."
The goblin is barely conscious now. He has drunk so much... /More than LEKI???? - Well, certainly not more than me/
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.44.1:
"See how nicely you're financing Deyja!! Haha, that's what we like!"
You feel terrible, but what choice do you have? The necromancers will buy some weapons now, but you must be stronger! And you must kill them all!

"Well, the House of Ironfist is famous for its wealth, so we must take advantage of that too. Pay up! The price of passage is 95000! If you haven't got it, get lost. Otherwise, pay!" says a black knight in this tower.
"You're an extortionist, taking advantage of someone who wants to pass!"
"I don't care. As I said, you want to pass? Then pay!"
"I must have been wrong about yours being a wealthy family. Damn it, can you even afford bread? Get out of here before we really get angry!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.61.1:
"Well, when we in Deyja whistle, humans come running. I like that! Now we just need to conquer every territory, and Deyja will rule the world!! Haha!"
"I wouldn't get too cocky if I were you. You'll be destroyed anyway!!"
"We'll see about that, understand? Now clear off, since we've let you through!"

"This place is under Deyja's rule!" says a goblin.
"Very nice, but I don't care in the slightest. Deyja should be destroyed!"
"Deyja will never be destroyed. The mighty liches and vampires will never allow it!"
"But I need to pass!"
"Very well, we'll let you into this territory, but on one condition: bring us 100 Halflings!"
"And where am I supposed to get them?"
"That's your problem. Otherwise, we won't lift a finger for humans!"

"You haven't got them? Then clear off again!"
"What do you need them for, anyway?" /Probably out of grub./
"That's none of your business!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.61.7: "Do you intend to trade them now?"
If you bring the seer in this tower 20 Archangels, you will be rewarded.
"You will only receive the reward if you bring those 20 Archangels!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.63.5: "Welcome, Your Majesty. You may pass now!"
Only Catherine Ironfist is allowed entry!
"No, only Catherine, as I already said!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.65.2: "Any hero who has reached experience level 20 during their military campaigns may enter here."
"No, nobody below level 20 will ever get in here!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.70.7: "Your colour is red, the colour of blood. I hope your enemies' blood will be on your hands!"
"Only the red player is allowed entry!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.72.3: "I see I misjudged you. But to err is human, and I admit my mistake. Take this artifact from the distant lands of Jadame. Keep it. Its power will make you a far, far better commander and warrior than you are now!"

As soon as you enter, you see a very old man whose best years are behind him. Struggling to rise, he addresses you:
"Welcome. I was a commander in Erathia some years ago, but I no longer have the strength. Now I merely scrape by here. Yet there is something that might ease my old age a little: the artifacts "Clover of Fortune & Cards of Prophecy" /Clover of Fortune & Cards of Prophecy/. I have sought these 2 artifacts all my life. Together, they would make me feel much better. Please bring them to me. Naturally, I do not expect it for free!"
"You can count on me!" you say.

"You have disappointed me! I am too old to find and obtain these 2 artifacts myself. I was relying on you so much. Perhaps you're not as good as I used to be. Well, what can I do? I'll give you another chance, but don't disappoint me this time. Otherwise I might die, and then you'll get nothing! What I'm keeping here for whoever brings me those artifacts is a powerful shield from the distant realm of Jadame, somewhere in the vicinity of Erathia."
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.72.7: If you bring this old man the artifact "Arms of Legion", he will reward you. /Though a spare prosthetic limb would probably be more useful to him./
"No use trying! Without the artifact, you haven't a hope of a reward!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.8.20:
"So Archibald has been defeated! BRAVO!" says the guard.
"Yes, but he is not dead. I turned him to stone, and his statue has been placed in the library at Gryphonheart Castle until his fate is decided," you reply.
The guards clear the way.

The watchtower you have just entered is manned by guards from Erathia. In your name, King Roland, they demand that Archibald Ironfist be defeated in battle. You are reluctant to fight, but have no choice. After all, he is Roland's brother. He may serve evil, but he is still his brother.
The guards have no reports yet that Archibald has fallen.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.8.22: "Welcome, King Roland. This passage is now open."
"We are sorry, but you are not Roland. Go away!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.9.37: "Welcome, King Roland. Do you wish to enter now?"
"Only King Roland has the right to enter this territory."
"No, you are not Roland, King of Erathia. We cannot let you through!"
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.9.56:
As soon as you approach the wall, it dissolves of its own accord, without you having to do anything. You merely notice that the Vial of Dragon Blood you were to bring has vanished. You feel as though you have passed the initiation trial of light. You are simply glad you did not really have to enter the Walls of Mist...
/The Walls of Mist in M&M7 are a rather unpleasant initiation trial of light, in which you must not kill a single creature./

You stand before the gates of the heavenly castle of Celeste, a fabled place where the finest mages have gathered throughout the centuries of Erathia's known history. Your name too could be carved on its wall of fame if you unite humans and elves and destroy all the dark peoples in Deyja, led by Archibald, the black sheep of the Ironfist family, and Judge Sleen, who planned to turn Erathia into a land of undead. Celeste is ruled by Gavin Magnus, the highest priest in all Erathia and a grandmaster of light magic. Resurectra also lives here, a woman whose great deeds against the undead earned her a place in Celeste's government itself. So does Lady Carmine, who owns a very rare dagger indispensable to necromancers. But Celeste is very well guarded, and it has never been stolen. 
You learn all this before the gate leading directly into Celeste, currently sealed by some unknown magical force. Naturally, here in Celeste, it is made of light magic. Suddenly, Gavin Magnus himself appears behind this gate, which resembles the "Walls of Mist" /Walls of the Mist/, and speaks to you:
"Welcome, brave hero. Few would dare undertake what you have. But before you are admitted to the castle itself, you must bring the "Vial of Dragon Blood" /Vial of Dragon Blood/. This will rob the dark dragons of their power, and the vial will be kept here in Celeste, guarded by the finest mages, so it can never be misused again. Bring it to us, then. We shall already regard you as a hero, but your greatest glory will come only with the unification of this land!"
Once again you try approaching this translucent magical wall, but nothing happens. You have no choice but to bring the artifact after all.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.9.57: "Only Catherine Ironfist will be admitted to Celeste!" says a guard from Steadwick, now serving here in Celeste.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.quest.9.66: The mages are delighted and are already leading the dragons straight to Celeste, where they will form the castle's honour guard. They thank you and clear the way.

The mages of Bracada are the finest in all Erathia. Though they do not know dark magic, which they reject as men of pure faith, they are the best. Only Deyja's necromancers can learn dark magic. You are now in a tower containing several light mages, who demand 2 faerie dragons (Faerie Dragon), needed to guard Celeste Castle because of their magical abilities. It is up to you to find them! Whether you like it or not, you must. You are almost at the end, so do not back down now! 
Go and find those dragons. The mages are waiting!
Come on! The mages need those 2 dragons, and you come empty-handed? Without them, you're going nowhere!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.sign.28.47:
Somewhere in these parts is a group of monks who will join you!
But the sign gives no further directions...
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.sign.39.67: The castle you can see is Castle Navan, home of Parson, king of the elves in the Tularean Forest.
The waters of the Shoals seep even here!
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.sign.47.51: These mountains contain one of the rarest and most highly prized artifacts since the founding of Erathia and Enroth.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.sign.47.63:
The war between humans and elves still rages, so these elves will remain here, just like the humans (you).
Tularean Forest.
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.sign.54.22: You will need these peasants, so keep collecting them...
map.[sod] - stíny nad celeste.sign.61.52:
Barrow Downs
Barrow Downs
/The Barrow Downs are home to the dwarven city of Stone City, where the entrance to the Nighon tunnels lies. These tunnels lead to Mount Nighon./
The Erathian fortress of Riverstride, protecting Steadwick from goblin raids and bandits.
You are the rightful ruler of Gryphonhearth Castle in Erathia. Your first task, before setting out on the path of light, was to clear it of goblins and rats. You completed that task long ago. So the dwarves whose petrified fellows you rescued from the Red Dwarf Mines (red dwarf mines), after they were turned to stone by the sight of medusas, promised to help repair your castle. They have kept their word, and suddenly a fortress stands where your little guard town once stood!

/In the original M&M7, this concerns Harmondale after leaving the Evenmorn Islands. Here it is a little different, arranged to suit me. Just so you know, before you all write to tell me I've made a mistake./

This day marks an important Erathian anniversary. A festival of warriors is held every year on this date. You attended too, and found many warriors willing to serve you. The only question is whether you have dwellings for them yet!
map.[sod] - the forgotten rivers.event.0:
Welcome to a land of confusion. The dilapidated estates you inherited face invasion. The most precious treasures lie hidden in uninhabited wilderness, and famous explorers are imprisoned. Find and free them. Find the lost rivers and follow them upstream to their sources. 

Listen to the old seeresses. Generous rewards await you for completing their tasks.

And do not waste time.

Good luck,
Darksmile
Is the prison still ahead of you? The mighty hero Voy the Seafarer awaits you there. Do you have room for him in your army?

Is the prison still ahead of you? The mighty hero Voy the Seafarer awaits you there. Do you have room for him in your army?

We, masters of magic resistance, have guarded this mighty pendant for centuries. And we are many. Will you try to take it?

We, masters of magic resistance, have guarded this mighty pendant for centuries. And we are many. Will you try to take it?

Do you really want to steal our weapon? Leave it alone unless you wish to meet your doom. Do you still wish to awaken the sleeping troop?

Do you really want to steal our weapon? Leave it alone unless you wish to meet your doom. Do you still wish to awaken the sleeping troop?
This orb is very dangerous to us. We will not let it fall into your hands. Will you fight several black dragons and their friends?
Are you wise enough to learn from a scholar? Think carefully!
We stayed here to guard an ancient scroll. It may not even be worth the fight. Will you try to take it from several troops of foot soldiers?

Is the prison still ahead of you? The mighty hero Kyrre the Runner awaits rescue. Do you have room for him in your army?

Is the prison still ahead of you? The mighty hero Kyrre the Runner awaits rescue. Do you have room for him in your army?
These sandals will not help you move faster, but they are useful equipment in battle. Will you face the numerous zealots?
Will you fight numerous efreet sultans for their weapon?

There is more to this tunic than meets the eye. We, a horde of cyclopes, will not give it up without a fight. Will you face us?

There is more to this tunic than meets the eye. We, a horde of cyclopes, will not give it up without a fight. Will you face us?

Is the prison still ahead of you? Sir Mullich, the fastest knight, awaits rescue. Do you have room for him in your army?

Is the prison still ahead of you? Sir Mullich, the fastest knight, awaits rescue. Do you have room for him in your army?

Is the prison still ahead of you? Gunnar, lord of the earth, awaits rescue. Do you have room for him in your army?

Is the prison still ahead of you? Gunnar, lord of the earth, awaits rescue. Do you have room for him in your army?

Is the prison still ahead of you? Gelu, trainer of sharpshooters, would gladly serve you. Do you have room for him in your army?

Is the prison still ahead of you? Gelu, trainer of sharpshooters, would gladly serve you. Do you have room for him in your army?
Will you fight numerous efreet sultans for their shield?
Are you wise enough to learn from a scholar? Think carefully!

A group of lonely creatures has decided to join you.

A group of lonely creatures has decided to join you.

A cursed place! Magical power drains from your body.

A cursed place! Magical power drains from your body.

At last you have found us. We are an ancient monastic order guarding this holy relic. Prepare for a hard battle. Will you undertake it?

map.[sod] - xena - návrat callisto.quest:
"Yes, yes, she is finally dead!" The man was overjoyed. 
"But there was no need to bring me her heart as proof. I have a delicate constitution," the man adds when he sees the heart of Velaska that Xena presents to him.
"Now come and take the artifact!"
In this tower lives a man whose purpose in life is to see Velaska dead. He has therefore decided to surrender the artifact he guards only if Velaska dies.
The man has received no reports of Velaska being defeated. He therefore refuses access to the artifact.
"There you are. Will you hand it over to us, then?"

The guard in the tower says:

"According to all reports, you will have to destroy Velaska first," the guard adds.

"Will you leave these warriors with us now, Xena, in exchange for free passage?"
The guard in this tower demands 45 Monks from you. Unless he gets them, he will not let you through.
"You do not have them? Then off you go and fetch them!"
"Well done. Now you may take your reward. It is very rare, so take great care of it!"

As soon as Xena entered the hut, she saw an old woman moving very slowly around an enormous cauldron.
"Come in," she says. "I have been expecting you. Your destiny is to destroy Callisto. Only then will you have everything you need to drive evil from our land and unite it all once more!"
"And how can you know all this?" asked Xena.
"I can see it all. I need only look into your future!"
"Very well, we shall see what can be done," said Xena, and left to find Callisto.
"Oh no, I cannot see on the surface of the cauldron that Callisto is dead. Keep trying. She is not so far from here!"
"Excellent. If you want to meet Callisto, hand them over to us!"

"If you want to go any further, Xena, bring me 75 Phoenixes," says an old soldier.

map.[sod] - z pekla stastie.header.descr: The notorious fiend Xeron wants to conquer the entire territory of the present magical continent. Your task is to defeat all of Xeron's armies and take his place. You can do so only by building the Grail structure in his capital, Hell. Good luck and have fun.
map.[sod] - z pekla stastie.header.name: Luck from Hell
map.[sod] - z pekla stastie.monster.85.2: Have you come to recharge with electricity?
map.[sod] - zememori.guards.43.42.1.mess: Welcome to the afterworld, an endless paradise and an endless wasteland. Endless pleasures await you here, and the endless sorrow of loneliness. That is the afterworld. But remember: once you enter, you can never leave!!
map.[sod] - zememori.guards.67.35.0.mess: You will never get the high priest's secret!!!!!
map.[sod] - zememori.guards.69.57.0.mess: You beings are always chasing discoveries, and so you must die.
map.[sod] - zememori.header.description: Earthsea is a small region between two peninsulas. For such a small place, it is home to far too many beings: humans, barbarians and others. There is not enough room or food for them, so they wage wars over more islands. Yet no one dares venture onto the mainland, for it is utterly devastated.
map.[sod] - zememori.header.name: Earthsea
map.[sod] - zememori.quest.13.35.1.compl: At last! With the help of 50 Royal Griffins, 30 Angels and 10 Archangels, we will bring peace to the Afterworld! Here is your reward. Are the warriors ready to depart?
map.[sod] - zememori.quest.13.35.1.first: Welcome to a place of God, a place of hatred, a sacred place in the afterworld. My task is to bring peace to the entire region, from the elemental castle to the human settlements. For this I need 20 Angels, 10 Archangels and 50 Royal Griffins. If you bring them to me, I will reward you with an artifact called Titan's Thunder (Titans Thunder).
map.[sod] - zememori.quest.13.35.1.nextV: No luck finding 50 Royal Griffins, 30 Angels and 10 Archangels? Please hurry! Peace in the Afterworld is in your hands!!
map.[sod] - zememori.quest.43.67.1.compl: Here is the Hirui stone. You took hold of it and felt its power. You did not know whether you could take in so much power at once, but decided to try anyway. You began absorbing the power from the Hirui crystal, and once you had absorbed it all, you felt like a new man!
map.[sod] - zememori.quest.43.67.1.first: In my youth, I was the greatest warrior in the afterworld. I promised that when someone stronger than I once was came along, I would pass my demonic power on to him. I stored it in the Hirui crystal, which can hold both demonic and spiritual power. If you are stronger than me, I will give you the stone so you can draw my demonic power from it.
map.[sod] - zememori.quest.43.67.1.nextV: Are you stronger than me yet? You must have an Attack of 20.
map.[sod] - zememori.quest.65.20.1.compl: At last, it is time to face him.
map.[sod] - zememori.quest.65.20.1.first: I have long wanted to kill that clown who wants to declare peace in the Afterworld. He lives to the west. If you bring me 100 Skeleton Warriors, I will give you Boots of Speed (boots of speed).
map.[sod] - zememori.quest.65.20.1.nextV: No luck finding 100 Skeleton Warriors? Please hurry! That bastard is persuading more and more people!!
map.[sod] - zememori.town.67.2.0.name: Dead Castle
map.[sod] - zlé casy a+e.header.name: Hard Times A+E
Wyverns are bloodthirsty beasts. Defeating them takes an incredibly strong personality.
map.[sod] - zlé casy a+e.quest.35.44.0.f: Lizardmen are experts in sabotage and tactics. They will join you only if you prove that you are better at waging war than they are.
map.[sod] - zlé casy a+e.quest.45.40.0.f: Hydras will follow only a seasoned war veteran who has been through fire and water.
map.[sod] - zlé casy a+e.quest.54.63.0.f: A basilisk's attacking power is terrifying. To overcome it, you need an even more terrifying Attack.
map.[sod] - zlé casy a+e.quest.59.79.0.f: Gorgons are powerful, intelligent beings. They will obey only an intelligent commander.
map.[sod] - zlé casy a+e.quest.72.61.0.f: The only thing that can force a dragon fly to submit is a mighty wind spell. You need great Spell Power to cast such a spell on these dragon flies.
map.[sod] - zlé casy a+e.quest.75.77.0.f: The Gnolls will join you only if you prove you are a capable warrior.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.0.descripti: The old ruler is dead. It will not be long before the leaders of the newly scattered families begin fighting one another for supremacy. Your task is therefore clear: do everything you can to unite our clans and set them back on the road to prosperity.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.1.descripti: This is a great undertaking indeed, one that will require a strong alliance. Find allies who will be loyal to you. And do it before it is too late...
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.10.descript: You will do it anyway, because unfortunately you need their shops right now.  You need them urgently enough to arrange for someone to personally vouch for your good reputation...
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.11.descript: Your financial advisers suggest that it would be wise to make sure you have enough dough for lunch at least once in a while.  You can only agree.  After all, today you must join them for a lunch of nothing but soup.  Hopefully you will soon discover how good the cooks in Downtown are...
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.12.descript: Your financial adviser was kind enough to inform you that your bank account is almost empty.  It seems you have no choice but to pull a sock over your head again and… do that thing once more.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.13.descript: There are four keys to the city.  Find them and you will win over both the city and its inhabitants.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.14.descript: You have heard a rumour of a hidden cellar somewhere in Al Capone's summer residence.  You ask around everywhere until at last you find an old shopkeeper who not only tells you where the cellar is, but even gives you an old scrap of paper with a crudely drawn map.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.15.descript: Without a single clear thought in your tired head, you at least send a few of your men out to scout.  Who knows, perhaps they will even find and dig up something valuable...
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.16.descript: My friend, the boss wants to extend his influence overseas.  He is tired of blackmailing local government offices and rigging beauty pageants, so he decides to sell the stupid girls to his Arab pals.  Besides, it seems easier than smuggling Coca-Cola into Minsk.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.17.descript: You will go to a land of many opportunities, where you will meet racketeers among the very rich.  They know how to keep their mouths shut, so do not worry about them.  The local mafia, however, may give you a headache.  In that case, let your swift sword do the talking >:)
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.18.descript: Our government's allies have expressed a desire to go into business with us.  You must meet them and strike a profitable deal.  If all goes well, we will buy all of Downtown, and it will work for us and us alone.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.19.descript: A tiny complication has arisen...  Of the promised 4 keys to the city, you can obtain only one.  It looks as though alliances and clever deals will be needed to acquire the other keys.  We must show everyone that our way is best.  Once you have the remaining keys to the city, you will show them all...
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.2.descripti: It seems the black dragon's orders will attempt to delay your advance.  Amid the chaos, you failed to notice his presence. You cannot afford to make such a mistake again if you ever hope to become a leader.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.20.descript: Do you know anyone with whom you could strike a profitable deal?  If the answer is "no", you had better find some new friends very quickly... Hurry.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.21.descript:
Your orders are simple: assemble a special crime-fighting unit in very little time and eliminate crime before the next election. 
Although these orders come straight from the commissioner's office, even though you voiced them as sternly as your commander, you are certain they are true.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.22.descript:
You know how close the commissioner is to the mayor, so you figure you had better give up any thoughts of promotion. 
You can certainly make use of help from the local authorities.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.23.descript:
It is known that police officers have been kidnapped by the local bad boys.  Your informant is kind enough to give you precise information about where they are hiding.
You do not usually meddle in police affairs, but when you see the look on his face, you sense that even worse trouble could follow.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.24.descript: Your informant has been busy this week, working through stacks of secret reports.  One of them caught his eye.  It concerns the great, wealthy city of Downtown.  Hmmm, this looks serious and should be investigated as soon as possible.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.25.descript:
It seems someone has been snooping around, trying to obtain information 
about the city of Downtown.  Your instincts tell you it is someone in your own party, someone who aroused your suspicions back at the office.  Then again, most office rats look suspicious...
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.26.descript: You soon pick out a former army officer who now works as a private snoop.  You think he is suspicious enough to keep close to him.  Perhaps you could even use his shady character to confuse your enemies... You have just had an idea about how to use him...
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.3.descripti: You must eliminate the threat at once, before it spreads like cancer and kills you.  After a brief council, the elders concluded that to defeat the black dragon, you must destroy his sacred temple, where his followers gather and train new recruits.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.4.descripti: Your agents bring news of a place of immense power, power that could bring about the black dragon's defeat and leave no one standing in your way.  The place is called Downtown, and the thought of it makes your mouth water...
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.5.descripti: Your situation looks grim. You must do whatever it takes to bring back what will help you win, but that is not enough.  There are still many black dragons, your agents tell you, and they are ready to join forces with others to cut off your head and serve it on a platter.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.6.descripti: Desperate and exhausted, you toy with a thought running through your head, though you ought to dismiss it as an old wife's superstition...
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.7.descripti: A rumour circulating among your followers tells of the spirit of an old warrior.  It claims the spirit can be awakened when hard times come.  People have been telling this tale for a long time...
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.8.descripti: Whenever the godfather returned to Sicily, a great power vacuum opened up.  You should take advantage of it, should you not?  Show the world of organised crime how great the Calzone family really is.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.event.9.descripti: Your "friendly neighbourhood cop" warns you against doing business with the banks to the west.  He says they will not tolerate a bad reputation for several months.
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.guards.102.89.0.m:
As you approach the dock on the coast, you trip over something in the dark. Lost in thought, you stumble along, then suddenly hear breaking glass and a man's voice: "You broke my 
bottle, you idiot!"  An enormous man emerges from the shadows, and he is not alone!
map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.guards.15.55.0.me: This is a contest for the great, wealthy city of Downtown. You can win either by capturing it or by defeating everyone with their eyes on it.

map.[sod] - zlí kámoši.guards.36.23.0.me: "So you need some help, do you?  Sit down, then, and let us chat."  >:)
