map.[sod] - zradce.event.1.description:
After the death of Merhox I, king of the united kingdoms of Aldur and Loogria, his heir Merhox II ascended the throne. Loogria, however, would rather see its high druid Jerwall on the throne than some “ordinary ranger”.
This greatly worsened relations between Loogria and Aldur!
map.[sod] - zradce.event.10.description: The scouts returned today. They discovered that Jerwall has signed a military treaty with Ghan Raag IV, ruler of Espaux. Both rulers have joined forces against you!
map.[sod] - zradce.event.14.description: It is wonderful to have such a vast country. Today it is especially useful: tax collection day has arrived.
map.[sod] - zradce.event.15.description: Everything looks excellent. Victory follows victory, and your kingdom keeps expanding. Yet something tells you this is only the first chapter of your journey, and things will grow ever harder.
map.[sod] - zradce.event.16.description:
Today marks 200 days since the start of your seemingly endless war.
That many days is certainly cause for celebration, and for collecting taxes!
map.[sod] - zradce.event.2.description: Your advisers warn you that Loogria could pose a danger. Its rebellion could seriously threaten your kingdom, or even bring about its downfall! You do not take these words too seriously, but a little caution certainly cannot hurt.
map.[sod] - zradce.event.3.description: You have had the border with Loogria fortified, and the border with Espaux, land of wild barbarian tribes, as well, just to be safe.
map.[sod] - zradce.event.4.description:
This worsened relations between the two kingdoms even further. Loogria also built fortifications, and it seems the united kingdom will not last much longer.
Rumours among the people suggest Loogria is planning something underhanded.
map.[sod] - zradce.event.5.description: You want to resolve the situation, so you have invited Qubar, the spokesman for Loogria, to discuss the future of the united kingdom. He should arrive in Ronnalia today. Hopefully you can settle everything there once and for all!
map.[sod] - zradce.event.6.description: Only now do you realise how naive you were. Ronnalia has fallen to Qubar's attack. What vile treachery from Loogria! This marks the end of the united kingdom. You declare war on Loogria and everyone else, for no one in this land can be trusted any longer.
map.[sod] - zradce.event.7.description: You should take several precautions. First, capture the Loogrian village of Capuletta northeast of Aldur before enemy armies begin gathering there. The village lies in unsecured territory, so attacks from there would be particularly troublesome.
map.[sod] - zradce.event.8.description: An attack by Qubar from Ronnalia is expected in the coming days. It would be wise to retake Ronnalia as soon as possible.
map.[sod] - zradce.event.9.description: Today, to be safe, you sent scouts beyond Aldur's borders. In a few days they will bring reports on the situation in Loogria and Espaux.

map.[sod] - zradce.guards.129.39.0.messa: You found an artifact caught in a bend of the river. Some mage probably lost it, and the water carried it here.

map.[sod] - zradce.guards.136.143.0.mess: Only angels live on this island. They guard the Armor of Wonder that belonged to the archangel Derett before the devil Xaramor killed him. The armour is a memento of Derett and also the only hope of bringing him back to life. That is why the angels value it so highly.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.136.8.0.messag: Surely that was the last guard. The way to Merthonia, capital of the White Kingdom, is now clear.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.137.49.0.messa: Suddenly several undead from a nearby wreck appeared aboard your ship.

map.[sod] - zradce.guards.140.99.0.messa: The road to Redrock seems clear. But that is really only how it seems.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.141.108.0.mess: You sailed too close to a rock and breached your ship's hull. You will have to repair it, for you would not get far like this.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.141.3.0.messag: An object lies here half-buried in the snow.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.142.47.0.messa: It seems you have landed on an island that serves as the base of the pirates of these seas. Prepare for battle.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.143.48.0.messa: They hid all their plundered treasures in this chest.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.143.74.0.messa: If you want a powerful spell, you must fight for it!
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.15.105.0.messa: The dwarves are ready to raise their hammers for your holy cause.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.16.95.0.messag: One of your soldiers reported that a woodcutter was felling trees in your territory. Your troops attacked him. He chose to leave all his belongings behind and take to his heels.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.17.3.0.message: By the shipwreck you found a necklace that probably belonged to the captain.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.17.69.0.messag: A nomadic barbarian tribe has ambushed you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.18.102.0.messa: The road you are travelling has existed for a very long time. Fishermen built it before the reign of Merhox I to improve their connection with Aldur.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.18.72.0.messag: Large flocks of thunderbirds have been circling above you for a long time. Just now, one small group has plucked up the courage to attack.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.19.124.0.messa: If you have the Sword of Judgement, you must now decide what to exchange it for. Choose wisely; much depends on it.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.19.13.0.messag: The bones of a long-dead warrior crumble beneath your touch, revealing a cloak that remains in your hands.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.2.131.0.messag: You could have expected someone to attack you here.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.2.47.0.message: So it was true after all. Several groups of ghosts live here, and they know how to guard their lighthouse.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.21.48.0.messag: You have disturbed several harpies nesting on the surrounding cliffs.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.21.55.0.messag: One of the many barbarian tribes roaming Espaux has ambushed you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.21.80.0.messag: A great treasure! But it is guarded.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.21.99.0.messag: In this treasury, the dwarves hoard their wealth for the time when it will be needed most. That time has come, but blinded by riches, the dwarves will not surrender it without a fight.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.22.64.0.messag: One of the many barbarian tribes roaming Espaux has ambushed you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.23.4.0.message: The ocean waves washed a buried pirate treasure onto the sandy beach.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.26.79.0.messag: You noticed a large bird's nest on the rock ahead. Now you know why this place is called "Thunderbird Creek".
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.27.58.0.messag: One of the many barbarian tribes roaming Espaux has ambushed you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.28.107.0.messa: A fairly large pile of gold. Surprisingly, no one is guarding it. You take the gold and make yourself scarce.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.28.38.0.messag: Searching the bushes paid off: you found an artifact hidden here.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.29.42.0.messag: You were already reaching for the ring when you noticed a group of dragons hovering overhead. Something tells you the ring probably belongs to them. Do you still want to take it?
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.29.78.0.messag: Beyond this gate is a training camp for the warriors of Espaux.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.29.86.0.messag: You are crossing the border when your horse suddenly sinks into the sand. This will be a difficult journey.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.3.38.0.message: You have disturbed a group of liches trying to resurrect their former leader here.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.3.94.0.message: You are entering an elven homestead that houses some of the finest elven archers. They quickly gather to help you on your journey.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.30.12.0.messag: You have disturbed a group of troglodytes trying to bury something here.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.31.56.0.messag: One of the many barbarian tribes roaming Espaux has ambushed you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.31.82.0.messag: Here you can enrol in the school of war. They offer quick training for 1000 gold.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.32.57.0.messag: You approach an old tree to rest in the shade of its crown. Then you notice several figures preparing to cut it down. They intend to dig up the gems and gold buried here by heroes seeking knowledge. You must prevent this.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.32.88.0.messag: Hunters live in this region. Perhaps they would like to join your ranks.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.34.32.0.messag: You have disturbed several harpies nesting on the surrounding cliffs.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.34.86.0.messag: The pegasi guarding the entrance to the tower look rather unfriendly at first. In the end, however, you agree that you have a common enemy, and they join you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.34.9.0.message: You noticed something glittering at the bottom of the canyon.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.35.65.0.messag: Ahead you see the border, fortified by the combined armies of Loogria and Espaux.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.35.77.0.messag: This gate separates Aldur and Espaux. It must never be opened!
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.36.36.0.messag: You have never seen this structure before. In any case, several undead have flown out of it.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.36.75.0.messag: Here lies gold that belonged to the behemoths. It seems you can take it now.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.36.84.0.messag: A fortress stands before you. The ringing of metal on metal echoes through the area. They are working hard on combat equipment in there.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.37.59.0.messag: Several goblins are fishing on the bank of a pond. As soon as you approached, they jumped up and attacked. Afterwards you discovered they had been so fiercely defending a cart.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.37.78.0.messag: The hunters have had their sights on these behemoths for a long time. It is high time to kill them before they breed any further.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.37.93.0.messag: Your curiosity paid off this time. The water has washed an interesting artifact here.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.38.100.0.messa: It seems Loogria has its eyes on your dragons. You are watching your green dragons defend themselves against a much larger group of Loogrian gold dragons. Loogria must never get your dragons!
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.38.103.0.messa: A resource merchant lives in this hut. You could trade something here sometime. His rates are not the best, but they are still better than those at the town marketplace.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.38.66.0.messag: You are approaching the arena when several enraged bulls and a bullfighter suddenly run out.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.39.128.0.messa: There is a harbour a little further along the road. You need not fear setting sail; these waters are safe.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.4.45.0.message: As you approach the mainland, you recall a story your father told you. Whoever approaches this lighthouse never leaves. But perhaps it is only a tale.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.41.76.0.messag: You are approaching your border when you suddenly hear what sounds like snakes hissing. You should be careful.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.42.36.0.messag: You have encountered a group of Enchanters practising their skills in the desert, where they cannot cause any damage. They think you look like a suitable target for their spells.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.42.74.0.messag: Now you know where the hissing came from. Medusas have built a storehouse here on the border. Perhaps it would be worth looking inside.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.43.105.0.messa: Few people visit this region. Only a handful of fishing communities live here, and Aldur's Sharpshooters train in the forests. You could pay them a visit.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.44.118.0.messa: The region you are entering is rich in gold. You once sold it to the wizards of Lassa and Sanya. Now, however, you will need those mines.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.45.33.0.messag: In the rock you discovered the remains of a gold mine that, for some reason, was never worked out. You are gathering gold when the foundations suddenly shift. You barely escaped being buried inside.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.45.48.0.messag: The long voyage is wearing you out.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.45.79.0.messag: Capuletta is within reach, and fortunately Loogria has not yet gained much strength here. Capture it as soon as possible!
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.45.85.0.messag: The town's master hunter lives here. He could help you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.47.110.0.messa: You are entering a secret Sharpshooter training camp known only to a few fishermen.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.47.91.0.messag: Unfortunately, this pile of crystals already belongs to someone!
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.48.90.0.messag: This spell will certainly help you capture castles.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.5.53.0.message: One of the many barbarian tribes roaming Espaux has ambushed you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.50.110.0.messa: Where did all this gold come from?
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.51.118.0.messa: Several windmills stand here on the coast. They were once the kingdom's most important source of resources. They will still come in useful now.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.52.143.0.messa: The mage Farnivon lives on this island. He is not very powerful, but he owns a rather important artifact.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.52.96.0.messag: You sailed too close to a rock and breached your ship's hull. You will have to repair it, for you would not get far like this.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.53.20.0.messag: Suddenly several undead from a nearby wreck appeared aboard your ship.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.53.32.0.messag: You confidently went to claim this mine, only to discover suddenly that you were not the only one interested in it.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.54.17.0.messag: Out of nowhere, the wind rose before you and began forming into air elementals.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.55.46.0.messag: The ocean waves washed a buried pirate treasure onto the sandy beach.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.56.110.0.messa: A glittering little pile behind the mill caught your eye.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.57.69.0.messag: A band of Loogrian elves attacked you. This time, however, they badly misjudged their chances.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.58.58.0.messag: You have encountered a small band of warriors heading for Loogria.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.58.91.0.messag: You have never seen creatures like these before. You do not much like the look of them.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.59.76.0.messag: Visit us: you can trade anything here...
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.6.10.0.message: Bromyr, one of the greatest sailors of all time, is imprisoned on this island. Azure dragons imprisoned him here long ago. It would be good to finally free him after so many years.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.6.140.0.messag: A forward patrol from Khaldooth has attacked you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.6.61.0.message: One of the many barbarian tribes roaming Espaux has ambushed you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.61.108.0.messa: You are sailing towards the Island of Earth Magic when something suddenly attacks you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.62.16.0.messag: The ocean waves washed a buried pirate treasure onto the sandy beach.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.62.66.0.messag: The merchant gave you a shield. He no longer has any use for it.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.63.69.0.messag:
Well, well, quite a clever move! :)

Yokel
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.64.12.0.messag: You noticed a pair of boots almost buried in the sand.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.64.89.0.messag: The lighthouse is not as deserted as it first appeared.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.65.46.0.messag: You found a skeleton in the forest near the Magic Spring. In its bony hand you see a spellbook. The dead man no longer needs it; it will do you more good. You prise open the dead fingers and take it, feeling a little guilty.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.68.140.0.messa: A ring lies on the ground, probably lost by some wizard.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.68.40.0.messag: King Merhox I had this library built because conditions in Aldur were unsuitable for such a structure. For a long time, however, it served Jerwall, and it was thanks to it that he gained such power.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.68.78.0.messag: An old, lonely and very sad dwarf lives here.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.72.11.0.messag: You sailed too close to a rock and breached your ship's hull. You will have to repair it, for you would not get far like this.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.72.38.0.messag: This artifact is guarded. Do you want to fight for it?
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.73.7.0.message: Undead from the surrounding wrecks have swooped down onto your ship.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.73.90.0.messag: Artifacts this rare are not usually left lying around without an owner.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.75.108.0.messa: You have disturbed several harpies nesting on the surrounding cliffs.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.75.25.0.messag: You sailed too close to a rock and breached your ship's hull. You will have to repair it, for you would not get far like this.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.77.15.0.messag: You found an interesting artifact in the bow of the wreck.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.78.124.0.messa: The ocean waves washed a buried pirate treasure onto the sandy beach.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.78.31.0.messag: Barely had you landed when you heard clinking tankards, music and laughter from the nearby "At the Wreck" tavern. It seems lively in there.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.78.82.0.messag: You could have expected someone to attack you here.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.79.23.0.messag: It is said that anyone who rests beneath the crowns of these trees will become a little wiser. You tried it, and it works. But only once in a lifetime.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.8.117.0.messag:
Before you lies the only skeleton on this map, so perhaps you will be lucky and find something :) 

{Yokel}

map.[sod] - zradce.guards.8.79.0.message: Beyond this gate lies the richest territory in all of Epaux. Conquering it would bring you great advantages. Espaux guards it very well, however.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.80.9.0.message: Several dragons flew out of the Dragon Utopia and are heading towards you. You were already drawing your sword when you noticed they were gold dragons wishing to join you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.82.133.0.messa: Suddenly several undead from a nearby wreck appeared aboard your ship.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.83.49.0.messag: Your horse stumbled over something. Examining the spot, you discovered a chest full of gold.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.84.123.0.messa: Suddenly several undead from a nearby wreck appeared aboard your ship.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.84.53.0.messag: You should not set sail without a proper army. Many dangers may lurk at sea.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.85.6.0.message: Something suddenly glittered before you. Looking carefully at the ground, you saw a shield in the bushes. You glanced around to see whether any dragons were guarding it, then took it.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.86.18.0.messag: You spot figures in the distance ahead and slowly approach. You can now make out gnolls carrying a shipment of resources from Nessus to Boachra. It must be a large shipment, for their guards attacked you immediately.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.88.43.0.messag: The welcome was not long in coming. Barely have you crossed the border when you must face lizardmen and other monsters once again.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.88.45.0.messag: You are approaching the border of another enemy: Lagros, kingdom of the lizardmen.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.88.63.0.messag: Before you lies Therania, home of the mage Theran.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.89.49.0.messag: Pirates attacked you on the beach and stole some of your gold and other valuables. Before you could do anything, they jumped into a boat and fled out to sea. They must have a base somewhere out there.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.89.9.0.message: Nessus, the main castle of Lagros, is within reach. Put those repulsive lizards out of their misery as quickly as possible!
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.89.90.0.messag: You have encountered one of the many bands of undead roaming Lethia.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.9.109.0.messag: There is a small griffin patrol here. Do you want to fight them for a pile of gold?
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.90.100.0.messa: You have encountered one of the many bands of undead roaming Lethia.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.90.87.0.messag: You are entering the city of Tharuul, the supreme temple of darkness. Nothing pleasant awaits you here.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.90.94.0.messag: You have encountered one of the many bands of undead roaming Lethia.

map.[sod] - zradce.guards.95.105.0.messa: You have encountered one of the many bands of undead roaming Lethia.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.95.85.0.messag: You are stepping onto cursed ground, into the main home of bone and ghost dragons. Watch your step!
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.96.37.0.messag: A small band of gnolls guarding their settlement has attacked you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.96.46.0.messag: You thought the mine was yours. Unfortunately, a guard remained here.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.97.79.0.messag: Dragons guard their tombs well. And they do not like people like you here. It will be a savage battle.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.97.9.0.message: You are entering a place home to an incredible number of swamp warriors. It was not long before most of them threw themselves at you.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.98.16.0.messag: By the forest, you spotted dendroidcutters chopping dendroids into pieces of wood. You immediately want to help them /the dendroids, of course/.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.98.22.0.messag: You are passing a Dragon Fly Hive. A moment later, thousands of the winged creatures fly out.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.98.95.0.messag: You have encountered one of the many bands of undead roaming Lethia.
map.[sod] - zradce.guards.99.4.0.message: Mosquitoes thrive at this time of year.

map.[sod] - zradce.header.description:
After the death of Merhox I, king of the united kingdoms of Aldur and Loogria, his heir Merhox II ascended the throne. Loogria, however, would rather see its high druid Jerwall on the throne than some “ordinary ranger”.
This greatly worsened relations between Loogria and Aldur! 
Created by {YoK}3{L} ..
map.[sod] - zradce.header.name: Traitor
map.[sod] - zradce.header.rumor.0.text: There is a very wealthy region in Espaux with a great many gold mines.
map.[sod] - zradce.header.rumor.1.text: The relic near Loogria is guarded by only one peasant.
map.[sod] - zradce.header.rumor.2.text: Bromyr is imprisoned in the northwestern corner of the land. He is a very good sailor.
map.[sod] - zradce.header.rumor.3.text: You should exchange the Sword of Judgement for the Elixir of Life.

map.[sod] - zradce.monster.2.96.0.messag: “Welcome. Our village is entirely at your disposal!”
map.[sod] - zradce.monster.29.93.0.messa: “We are glad you have finally decided to destroy Loogria, and we offer you our services.”
map.[sod] - zradce.monster.35.97.0.messa: “Thank you. We could not have held out much longer on our own.”
map.[sod] - zradce.monster.37.98.0.messa: As soon as the Loogrian gold dragons spotted you, they ignored the green dragons and threw themselves at you.
map.[sod] - zradce.monster.4.96.0.messag: “We heard you are preparing to punish Loogria's treachery! You can count on us!”
map.[sod] - zradce.monster.44.111.0.mess: “Welcome, our lord! We will help you on your travels!”
map.[sod] - zradce.monster.44.79.0.messa: “Entry to Capuletta is forbidden,” says the dendroid guarding the border. Yet you must get in. You have no choice but to kill the guards, though you do so reluctantly. In truth, you are killing your own people.
map.[sod] - zradce.monster.49.115.0.mess: “Have you forgotten? You have already sold these mines! And now you cannot take it back!”
map.[sod] - zradce.monster.51.108.0.mess: “Welcome, my lord. You can obtain a ship at my shipyard. I do not have enough materials, however, so it will not be free.”
map.[sod] - zradce.monster.62.83.0.messa: Where could the mages have obtained such an artifact?
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.100.57.0.comple: “Yes, that is exactly it! Now I am ready to demolish the gate.”
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.100.57.0.firstV: When you came to the gate, its builder told you he would demolish it in exchange for the Elixir of Life.
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.100.57.0.nextVi: The builder is adamant. He will not demolish the gate without the Elixir of Life.
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.123.21.0.comple: At last, Merhox II himself has arrived. Do you wish to pass?
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.123.21.0.firstV: The guards in the tower say their orders allow only Merhox II to pass.
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.123.21.0.nextVi: The guards say only Merhox II may pass.
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.141.39.0.comple: “Excellent. Now Derett can never rise from the dead! Here is your reward.”
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.141.39.0.firstV: “Bring me the Armor of Wonder guarded by angels in the southeastern corner of this land. I must prevent the archangel Derett from returning to life, so that senseless war against hell does not break out again. Only this armour can bring him back. You will receive an artifact that could help you greatly if you can use it correctly.”
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.141.39.0.nextVi: “No, I really want only the Armor of Wonder.”
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.47.85.0.complet: “You made short work of them, proving your strength. I will give you what I promised.”
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.47.85.0.firstVi: An old elven hunter came out of the hut, saying: “If you kill the Ancient Behemoths nearby, I will give you a few of my men.”
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.47.85.0.nextVis: “The behemoths are still alive. You have not yet proved you are a good warrior. I will not give my hunters to just anyone!”
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.70.78.0.complet: “Excellent, that is it. Do you want to exchange the shield for this helmet?”
map.[sod] - zradce.quest.70.78.0.firstVi: “Jerwall killed my son. My son had a shield. I would like to get it back. I would give you another artifact in exchange, one that has no value to me but might be useful to you,” he told you, then went back into his hut.
